sanskrit_iast: oṃ
meaning: ओं

sanskrit_iast: śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitā
meaning: श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहिता
text_mt: The Jayākhyasaṃhitā in the venerable Pāñcarātra.

sanskrit_iast: śāstrārambhaprayojanaṃ nāma prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: शास्त्रारम्भप्रयोजनं नाम प्रथमः पटलः
text_mt: First chapter, named 'The Purpose for Commencing the Scripture'.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ sakalakalyāṇadāyine cakrapāṇaye |
viṣayārṇavamagnānāṃ samuddharaṇahetave || 1 ||
meaning:
नमः सकलकल्याणदायिने चक्रपाणये |
विषयार्णवमग्नानां समुद्धरणहेतवे || 1 ||
text_mt:
Salutations to Cakrapāṇi, the giver of all blessings,
the cause of deliverance for those sunken in the ocean of sense objects. || 1

sanskrit_iast: [śāstrāvataraṇam]
meaning: [शास्त्रावतरणम्]

sanskrit_iast:
susiddhapūjite sthāne devabrahmarṣisevite |
tapasvijanasaṅkīrṇe puṇyakṛdbhirniṣevite || 2 ||
meaning:
सुसिद्धपूजिते स्थाने देवब्रह्मर्षिसेविते |
तपस्विजनसङ्कीर्णे पुण्यकृद्भिर्निषेविते || 2 ||
text_mt:
At a place worshipped by the accomplished, frequented by gods and divine sages,
crowded with ascetics, attended by doers of merit, || 2

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthottame prabhāse vai yatra sannihitaḥ sadā |
viśvātmā bhagavān viṣṇurlokānugrahakṛtprabhuḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
तीर्थोत्तमे प्रभासे वै यत्र सन्निहितः सदा |
विश्वात्मा भगवान् विष्णुर्लोकानुग्रहकृत्प्रभुः || 3 ||
text_mt:
at Prabhāsa, the excellent sacred ford, where ever present is
Lord Viṣṇu, the Universal Self, the master who bestows grace upon the worlds; || 3

sanskrit_iast:
tatra śuśrūṣaṇaparaḥ pitrādigurusantateḥ |
nityamevāpavargārthī virāgī vītamatsaraḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
तत्र शुश्रूषणपरः पित्रादिगुरुसन्ततेः |
नित्यमेवापवर्गार्थी विरागी वीतमत्सरः || 4 ||
text_mt:
there, intent on serving the lineage of gurus beginning with his father,
ever seeking liberation, detached, free from envy, || 4

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvartakaḥ kāntinidhirdṛṣṭvā magnaṃ svakaṃ vapuḥ |
prāñjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā aurvaṃ pitaramabravīt || 5 ||
meaning:
संवर्तकः कान्तिनिधिर्दृष्ट्वा मग्नं स्वकं वपुः |
प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा और्वं पितरमब्रवीत् || 5 ||
text_mt:
Saṃvartaka, a store of splendour, having seen his own body sunken [in existence],
with hands joined in reverence and bowing, spoke to Aurva, his father: || 5

sanskrit_iast: saṃvartakaḥ-
meaning: संवर्तकः-

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārārṇavamagnasya mamopāyo hi kathyatām |
yaṃ jñātvā na punarjanma syānmamānyasya kasyacit || 6 ||
meaning:
संसारार्णवमग्नस्य ममोपायो हि कथ्यताम् |
यं ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्जन्म स्यान्ममान्यस्य कस्यचित् || 6 ||
text_mt:
Tell me, indeed, the means for me who am sunken in the ocean of transmigratory existence,
knowing which neither I nor anyone else would undergo rebirth. || 6

sanskrit_iast: aurvaḥ-
meaning: और्वः-

sanskrit_iast:
purā kṛtayuge vatsa matpūrvaiḥ saṃyamasthitaiḥ |
vedavedāṅgapārajñai ṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
पुरा कृतयुगे वत्स मत्पूर्वैः संयमस्थितैः |
वेदवेदाङ्गपारज्ञै ऋषिभिश्च तपोधनैः || 7 ||
text_mt:
Formerly in the Kṛta age, my child, by my ancestors established in self-restraint,
sages who had crossed to the far shore of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, rich in ascetic penance, || 7

sanskrit_iast:
kenāpi cātmabhāvena etadālocitaṃ tu vai |
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi tapastaptvā sudāruṇam || 8 ||
meaning:
केनापि चात्मभावेन एतदालोचितं तु वै |
बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि तपस्तप्त्वा सुदारुणम् || 8 ||
text_mt:
out of some inner reflection, this was considered,
having performed very severe ascetic penance for many thousands of years, || 8

sanskrit_iast: p. 2) (santoṣaniyamāḍhyaṃ ca vratacaryāsamanvitam)
meaning: प्. 2) (सन्तोषनियमाढ्यं च व्रतचर्यासमन्वितम्)
text_mt: rich in contentment and restraints, and accompanied by the observance of vows. || [8cd*]

sanskrit_iast: [niḥśreyasālābhānmaharṣīṇāṃ nirvedaḥ]
meaning: [निःश्रेयसालाभान्महर्षीणां निर्वेदः]
text_mt: [The great sages' despondency at not attaining the highest good]

sanskrit_iast:
kālena tapaso'nte vai vayaṃ saddharmamāsthitāḥ |
siddhigocaramaprāptāḥ procchvasantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
कालेन तपसोऽन्ते वै वयं सद्धर्ममास्थिताः |
सिद्धिगोचरमप्राप्ताः प्रोच्छ्वसन्तः पुनः पुनः || 9 ||
text_mt:
"In time, at the conclusion of ascetic penance, though established in good conduct,
we have not reached the realm of attainment, sighing again and again: || 9

sanskrit_iast:
na vidmaḥ kiṃ bhaviṣyāmo hyadyāpi gahane bhave |
na sthitiḥ śāśvatī svasthe na ca bandhaparikṣayaḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
न विद्मः किं भविष्यामो ह्यद्यापि गहने भवे |
न स्थितिः शाश्वती स्वस्थे न च बन्धपरिक्षयः || 10 ||
text_mt:
'We do not know what will become of us, even today, in deep transmigratory existence;
there is no eternal permanence in the self, nor is there the destruction of bondage; || 10

sanskrit_iast:
na caiveha sthirā bhogāḥ kiṃ kuryāmo'tra vaiśase |
ityevaṃ gahane prāpte tapasaścānavasthiteḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
न चैवेह स्थिरा भोगाः किं कुर्यामोऽत्र वैशसे |
इत्येवं गहने प्राप्ते तपसश्चानवस्थितेः || 11 ||
text_mt:
and pleasures here are not stable; what shall we do in this ruin?'
Thus, when difficulty was reached and because of the instability of ascetic penance, || 11

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāptāḥ sma tato mohaṃ tadā vāṇī mahatyabhūt |
bhagavaddharmajijñāsairdhyānāsaktaiḥ pracoditā || 12 ||
meaning:
संप्राप्ताः स्म ततो मोहं तदा वाणी महत्यभूत् |
भगवद्धर्मजिज्ञासैर्ध्यानासक्तैः प्रचोदिता || 12 ||
text_mt:
we fell into delusion. Then a great voice arose,
impelled by those desirous to know the Lord's dharma, intent on meditation: || 12

sanskrit_iast: [paratattvajñānasya niḥśreyasahetutvam]
meaning: [परतत्त्वज्ञानस्य निःश्रेयसहेतुत्वम्]
text_mt: [Knowledge of the highest reality as the cause of the highest good]

sanskrit_iast:
na yajñavedādhigamairnaca dānaistu kevalaiḥ |
kriyābhirna tvanekābhirvrataiścāndrāyaṇādikaiḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
न यज्ञवेदाधिगमैर्नच दानैस्तु केवलैः |
क्रियाभिर्न त्वनेकाभिर्व्रतैश्चान्द्रायणादिकैः || 13 ||
text_mt:
'Not by sacrifices, mastery of the Vedas, nor by mere gifts,
nor by manifold rites, nor by vows such as the Cāndrāyaṇa || 13

sanskrit_iast:
svarge vai na bhavet sthairyaṃ bandhamokṣaśca vai kutaḥ |
ajñāte paratattve tu śāśvate cākṣaye'cyute || 14 ||
meaning:
स्वर्गे वै न भवेत् स्थैर्यं बन्धमोक्षश्च वै कुतः |
अज्ञाते परतत्त्वे तु शाश्वते चाक्षयेऽच्युते || 14 ||
text_mt:
can there be stability in heaven, and whence the liberation from bondage,
so long as the highest reality is unknown—eternal, imperishable, Acyuta, || 14

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpake tu jagannāthe nityatṛpte nirañjane |
icchārūpadhare nitye śuddhe buddhe sunirmale || 15 ||
meaning:
व्यापके तु जगन्नाथे नित्यतृप्ते निरञ्जने |
इच्छारूपधरे नित्ये शुद्धे बुद्धे सुनिर्मले || 15 ||
text_mt:
all-pervading Lord of the Universe, ever content, untainted,
assuming forms at will, eternal, pure, awakened, spotless? || 15

sanskrit_iast:
evamādyaḥ paro devo jñāto yāvanna vai dvijāḥ |
tāvadevāpavargastu durlabho yugakoṭibhiḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
एवमाद्यः परो देवो ज्ञातो यावन्न वै द्विजाः |
तावदेवापवर्गस्तु दुर्लभो युगकोटिभिः || 16 ||
text_mt:
As long as such a primordial, supreme God is not known, O twice-born,
so long is liberation hard to obtain even in tens of millions of ages. || 16

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādyatadhvaṃ yenāśu hṛdāvāso jagadguruḥ |
kevalaṃ citsvarūpaśca guṇaguṇyaśca nirguṇaḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
तस्माद्यतध्वं येनाशु हृदावासो जगद्गुरुः |
केवलं चित्स्वरूपश्च गुणगुण्यश्च निर्गुणः || 17 ||
text_mt:
Therefore, strive that quickly the Universal Preceptor residing in the heart,
who solely consists of consciousness, possesses attributes, and is attribute-free, || 17

sanskrit_iast:
prasādameti vai kṣipramanāthānāmasaṃśayaḥ |
abhūtapūrvaṃ śrutvaivaṃ sthitāste hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
प्रसादमेति वै क्षिप्रमनाथानामसंशयः |
अभूतपूर्वं श्रुत्वैवं स्थितास्ते हृष्टमानसाः || 18 ||
text_mt:
may swiftly bestow grace upon the helpless, without a doubt.'
Having heard this, never heard before, they stood with joyful minds. || 18

sanskrit_iast:
tasminneva kṣaṇe puṇye śrutamātreṇa putraka |
kimetatkena kathitaṃ kiṃ tadbrahma hyanāmakam || 19 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्नेव क्षणे पुण्ये श्रुतमात्रेण पुत्रक |
किमेतत्केन कथितं किं तद्ब्रह्म ह्यनामकम् || 19 ||
text_mt:
At that very auspicious moment, just upon hearing it, O son,
[they said,] 'What is this? By whom was it spoken? What is that nameless Brahman? || 19

sanskrit_iast:
jñāsyāmastatkathaṃ samyagevamūcuḥ parasparam |
p. 3) saṃśaye'bhiniviṣṭāstu dīrghakālaṃ yadā tadā || 20 ||
meaning:
ज्ञास्यामस्तत्कथं सम्यगेवमूचुः परस्परम् |
प्. 3) संशयेऽभिनिविष्टास्तु दीर्घकालं यदा तदा || 20 ||
text_mt:
How shall we know it properly?' Thus they spoke to one another.
When they had remained plunged in doubt for a long time, then || 20

sanskrit_iast: punarevotthitā vāṇī gaganādamṛtopamā |
meaning: पुनरेवोत्थिता वाणी गगनादमृतोपमा |
text_mt: again a voice arose from the sky, like nectar:

sanskrit_iast: [paratattvavivecanam]
meaning: [परतत्त्वविवेचनम्]

sanskrit_iast: yattadakṣaramakṣobhyaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam || 21 ||
meaning: यत्तदक्षरमक्षोभ्यं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् || 21 ||
text_mt: 'That which is imperishable, unshakable, the eternal supreme Brahman, || 21

sanskrit_iast:
parā gatiryā sarveṣāmacyutaṃ vitta taddvijāḥ |
munayo brahmaniṣṇātā yamāśritya bhavodadhim || 22 ||
meaning:
परा गतिर्या सर्वेषामच्युतं वित्त तद्द्विजाः |
मुनयो ब्रह्मनिष्णाता यमाश्रित्य भवोदधिम् || 22 ||
text_mt:
the supreme goal of all—know that, O twice-born, to be Acyuta.
Relying on whom, sages steeped in Brahman cross the ocean of transmigratory existence, || 22

sanskrit_iast:
taranti puṇḍarīkākṣo devo nārāyaṇastu saḥ |
śaṅkhacakradharaṃ viṣṇumānandasyandanirbharam || 23 ||
meaning:
तरन्ति पुण्डरीकाक्षो देवो नारायणस्तु सः |
शङ्खचक्रधरं विष्णुमानन्दस्यन्दनिर्भरम् || 23 ||
text_mt:
he is the god Nārāyaṇa, the Lotus-Eyed One.
Viṣṇu, who bears the conch and discus, brimming with the outflow of bliss— || 23

sanskrit_iast:
ye saṃśrayanti taṃ bhaktyā sūkṣmamadhyātmacintakāḥ |
te yānti vai padaṃ viṣṇorjarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
ये संश्रयन्ति तं भक्त्या सूक्ष्ममध्यात्मचिन्तकाः |
ते यान्ति वै पदं विष्णोर्जरामरणवर्जिताः || 24 ||
text_mt:
those who take refuge in him through devotion, meditating on the subtle inner Self,
they go to the realm of Viṣṇu, freed from old age and death.' || 24

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā ca tato bhūyaḥ sā vāgastamitā yadā |
tadā vayaṃ hṛṣṭatuṣṭāḥ prāyaśo vigatajvarāḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा च ततो भूयः सा वागस्तमिता यदा |
तदा वयं हृष्टतुष्टाः प्रायशो विगतज्वराः || 25 ||
text_mt:
Having said this, when that voice fell silent once more,
then we were joyful and content, mostly freed from anguish. || 25

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsāṅkavapurdevastrātā śāsti jagattraye |
cetaso'vasthitiṃ kṛtvā ṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
श्रीवत्साङ्कवपुर्देवस्त्राता शास्ति जगत्त्रये |
चेतसोऽवस्थितिं कृत्वा ऋषिभिश्च तपोधनैः || 26 ||
text_mt:
'The God whose body bears the Śrīvatsa mark, the protector, rules in the three worlds.'
Fixing their minds on this, the sages rich in ascetic penance || 26

sanskrit_iast: cintitaṃ ca tadā bhūyo jñāsyāmastaṃ kathaṃ vibhum |
meaning: चिन्तितं च तदा भूयो ज्ञास्यामस्तं कथं विभुम् |
text_mt: then reflected again: 'How shall we know that omnipresent Lord? || [26cd*]

sanskrit_iast: [paratattvādhigamopāyajijñāsayā śāṇḍilyaṃ pratyabhigamanam]
meaning: [परतत्त्वाधिगमोपायजिज्ञासया शाण्डिल्यं प्रत्यभिगमनम्]
text_mt: [Approaching Śāṇḍilya with the desire to know the means to attain the highest reality]

sanskrit_iast: ko vettā devadevasya trailokye'smin yathārthataḥ || 27 ||
meaning: को वेत्ता देवदेवस्य त्रैलोक्येऽस्मिन् यथार्थतः || 27 ||
text_mt: Who in this threefold world truly knows the God of gods? || 27

sanskrit_iast:
prasannaḥ kasya bhagavān paramātmā'pyadhokṣajaḥ |
prabhāvāttapasaḥ sarvaṃ cintitaṃ manasā tadā || 28 ||
meaning:
प्रसन्नः कस्य भगवान् परमात्माऽप्यधोक्षजः |
प्रभावात्तपसः सर्वं चिन्तितं मनसा तदा || 28 ||
text_mt:
With whom is the Lord, the Supreme Self, Adhokṣaja pleased?'
By the power of ascetic penance, everything was then reflected upon with the mind. || 28

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvadviditaṃ paścātsarveṣāṃ bhāvitātmanām |
kṛtakṛtyo jagatyasmin śāṇḍilyaḥ śrūyate bhuvi || 29 ||
meaning:
यथावद्विदितं पश्चात्सर्वेषां भावितात्मनाम् |
कृतकृत्यो जगत्यस्मिन् शाण्डिल्यः श्रूयते भुवि || 29 ||
text_mt:
Afterwards, it was known accurately by all those purified souls:
'Śāṇḍilya is heard of on earth as one who has accomplished his task in this world.' || 29

sanskrit_iast:
te caivaṃ svaśramātsarve phalapuṣpakarodyatāḥ |
prayātāḥ sa muniryatra kṛtakṛtyo'vatiṣṭhate || 30 ||
meaning:
ते चैवं स्वश्रमात्सर्वे फलपुष्पकरोद्यताः |
प्रयाताः स मुनिर्यत्र कृतकृत्योऽवतिष्ठते || 30 ||
text_mt:
And so, with hands bearing fruits and flowers, all went forth from their hermitage
to where that sage who had accomplished his task resided, || 30

sanskrit_iast:
sukhāsīno dvijaiḥ sārdhaṃ yogaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
tapasā tejasā yuktaḥ parvate gandhamādane || 31 ||
meaning:
सुखासीनो द्विजैः सार्धं योगैश्वर्यसमन्वितः |
तपसा तेजसा युक्तः पर्वते गन्धमादने || 31 ||
text_mt:
seated comfortably with twice-born [companions], endowed with the sovereignty of yoga,
endowed with ascetic penance and splendor, on Mount Gandhamādana, || 31

sanskrit_iast:
nānāścaryasamāyukte nānāpuṣpopaśobhite |
phaladrumasamākīrṇe nānādhātuvicitrite || 32 ||
meaning:
नानाश्चर्यसमायुक्ते नानापुष्पोपशोभिते |
फलद्रुमसमाकीर्णे नानाधातुविचित्रिते || 32 ||
text_mt:
which was filled with various wonders, adorned with manifold flowers,
crowded with fruit trees, variegated with various minerals, || 32

sanskrit_iast:
siddhairadhyāsite ramye devajuṣṭe manorame |
tapaśśīlaissudāntaiśca yogavrataparāyaṇaiḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
सिद्धैरध्यासिते रम्ये देवजुष्टे मनोरमे |
तपश्शीलैस्सुदान्तैश्च योगव्रतपरायणैः || 33 ||
text_mt:
inhabited by accomplished ones, charming, frequented by gods, delightful,
[and he was surrounded] by virtuous ascetics, well restrained, devoted to yoga and vows, || 33

sanskrit_iast:
p. 4) sacchiṣyairjñānasaṃpūrṇairvṛtaścandra iva grahaiḥ |
dṛṣṭvā(ṣṭo ?) jñānakriyāḍhyo'sāvṛṣibhiḥ prāñjalisthitaiḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
प्. 4) सच्छिष्यैर्ज्ञानसंपूर्णैर्वृतश्चन्द्र इव ग्रहैः |
दृष्ट्वा(ष्टो ?) ज्ञानक्रियाढ्योऽसावृषिभिः प्राञ्जलिस्थितैः || 34 ||
text_mt:
surrounded by true disciples full of knowledge, like the moon by the planets.
Rich in knowledge and ritual action, he was seen by the sages standing with joined hands. || 34

sanskrit_iast:
sa cābhivāditassarvaiḥ kramāttena ca te tathā |
pūjitāḥ phalamūlādyairambunā kusumaissaha || 35 ||
meaning:
स चाभिवादितस्सर्वैः क्रमात्तेन च ते तथा |
पूजिताः फलमूलाद्यैरम्बुना कुसुमैस्सह || 35 ||
text_mt:
Saluted by all in proper order, they were likewise
honored by him with fruits, roots, and the like, together with water and flowers. || 35

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛtte'bhyāgate dharme sotsukairbhagavānmuniḥ |
pṛṣṭastapodhanaissarvaiḥ śāṇḍilyassurapūjitaḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
निवृत्तेऽभ्यागते धर्मे सोत्सुकैर्भगवान्मुनिः |
पृष्टस्तपोधनैस्सर्वैः शाण्डिल्यस्सुरपूजितः || 36 ||
text_mt:
When hospitality to the guests was concluded, the venerable sage Śāṇḍilya,
worshipped by the gods, was asked eagerly by all the ascetics: || 36

sanskrit_iast: [bhagavattattvatadārādhanaprakārapraśnaḥ]
meaning: [भगवत्तत्त्वतदाराधनप्रकारप्रश्नः]
text_mt: [Question regarding the nature of the Lord and the manner of his worship]

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavanśrotumicchāmo viṣṇoradbhutakarmaṇaḥ |
upāsālakṣaṇaṃ karma kathayasva prasādataḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
भगवन्श्रोतुमिच्छामो विष्णोरद्भुतकर्मणः |
उपासालक्षणं कर्म कथयस्व प्रसादतः || 37 ||
text_mt:
'O Venerable One, we wish to hear of Viṣṇu of wondrous deeds;
please tell us, through your favor, the ritual action characterized by worship, || 37

sanskrit_iast:
śrutamatyadbhutaṃ yasmādasmābhirgaganāntarāt |
ajñāte bhagavattatve durlabhā paramā gatiḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
श्रुतमत्यद्भुतं यस्मादस्माभिर्गगनान्तरात् |
अज्ञाते भगवत्तत्वे दुर्लभा परमा गतिः || 38 ||
text_mt:
since we have heard a most wondrous thing from the midst of the sky:
if the Lord's reality is not known, the supreme goal is difficult to obtain, || 38

sanskrit_iast:
tathā'nārādhite caiva sātvikena tu karmaṇā |
santāraṇārthamasmākamanyeṣāṃ bhavināṃ tathā || 39 ||
meaning:
तथाऽनाराधिते चैव सात्विकेन तु कर्मणा |
सन्तारणार्थमस्माकमन्येषां भविनां तथा || 39 ||
text_mt:
and likewise if he is not worshipped with sātvika action.
For the sake of carrying us and other transmigrating beings across [the ocean of existence], || 39

sanskrit_iast: yathārthaṃ bhagavaddharma vaktumarhasi sarvathā |
meaning: यथार्थं भगवद्धर्म वक्तुमर्हसि सर्वथा |
text_mt: you ought by all means to explain the Lord's dharma as it truly is.'

sanskrit_iast: [asya śāstrasya pravṛttikramaḥ śāṇḍilyaḥ-]
meaning: [अस्य शास्त्रस्य प्रवृत्तिक्रमः शाण्डिल्यः-]
text_mt: [The course of transmission of this scripture; Śāṇḍilya said:]

sanskrit_iast: śruṇudhvaṃ saṃyatāssarve viṣṇoradbhutatejasaḥ || 40 ||
meaning: श्रुणुध्वं संयतास्सर्वे विष्णोरद्भुततेजसः || 40 ||
text_mt: Listen, all of you with restrained minds, concerning Viṣṇu of wondrous splendor. || 40

sanskrit_iast:
sārabhūtamidaṃ śāstraṃ jñānopaniṣadaṃ mahat |
rahasyamaprakāśyaṃ ca brahmagarbhaṃ ca śāśvatam || 41 ||
meaning:
सारभूतमिदं शास्त्रं ज्ञानोपनिषदं महत् |
रहस्यमप्रकाश्यं च ब्रह्मगर्भं च शाश्वतम् || 41 ||
text_mt:
This scripture is the essence, the great Upanisad of knowledge,
a secret not to be disclosed, containing Brahman within, and eternal. || 41

sanskrit_iast:
anugrahārthaṃ ca purā kathitaṃ nāradasya tat |
tathācātirahasyatvālloke'sminna prakāśitam || 42 ||
meaning:
अनुग्रहार्थं च पुरा कथितं नारदस्य तत् |
तथाचातिरहस्यत्वाल्लोकेऽस्मिन्न प्रकाशितम् || 42 ||
text_mt:
And formerly it was spoken for the sake of grace to Nārada;
and because it was extremely secret, it was not made public in this world. || 42

sanskrit_iast:
na cāpi coditaṃ caiva kenaciddharmagauravāt |
tathoktasya (tathā'neka ?) dinasyānte antardhānagataṃ tu tam(t ?) || 43 ||
meaning:
न चापि चोदितं चैव केनचिद्धर्मगौरवात् |
तथोक्तस्य (तथाऽनेक ?) दिनस्यान्ते अन्तर्धानगतं तु तम्(त् ?) || 43 ||
text_mt:
Nor was it even prompted [to be taught] by anyone, out of reverence for dharma.
And at the end of many days after it had been so spoken, it vanished from sight. || 43

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaścaivāvatīrṇena viṣṇunā prabhavaṣṇunā |
munervai svāṃśabhūtasya yaduktaṃ punareva hi || 44 ||
meaning:
भूयश्चैवावतीर्णेन विष्णुना प्रभवष्णुना |
मुनेर्वै स्वांशभूतस्य यदुक्तं पुनरेव हि || 44 ||
text_mt:
And when the powerful Viṣṇu had descended once again,
that which was spoken anew to the sage who was his own portion, || 44

sanskrit_iast:
badaryāśramasaṃsthena prabhunā lokakāriṇā |
dharmamārgāvatārārthaṃ vratenānena sattamāḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
बदर्याश्रमसंस्थेन प्रभुना लोककारिणा |
धर्ममार्गावतारार्थं व्रतेनानेन सत्तमाः || 45 ||
text_mt:
by the Lord, the creator of the world, residing at the hermitage of Badarī,
for the sake of the descent of the path of dharma by this observance, O best of men, || 45

sanskrit_iast:
siddhānaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva tathā gaganacāriṇām |
p. 5) devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca narādīnāṃ tathaiva ca || 46 ||
meaning:
सिद्धानं शृण्वतां चैव तथा गगनचारिणाम् |
प्. 5) देवानां च ऋषीणां च नरादीनां तथैव च || 46 ||
text_mt:
while the Siddhas and the sky-farers were listening,
as well as the gods, the sages, and men and the like, || 46

sanskrit_iast:
mṛkaṇḍutārkṣyapūrvāṇāmādityānāṃ mahātmanām |
kinnarāṇāṃ ca daityānāṃ vasūnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 47 ||
meaning:
मृकण्डुतार्क्ष्यपूर्वाणामादित्यानां महात्मनाम् |
किन्नराणां च दैत्यानां वसूनां भावितात्मनाम् || 47 ||
text_mt:
headed by Mṛkaṇḍu and Tārkṣya, the great-souled Ādityas,
the Kinnaras, the Daityas, and the purified souls, the Vasus, || 47

sanskrit_iast: sāṅkhyānāṃ yogasiddhānāṃ jñānavijñānavedinām |
meaning: साङ्ख्यानां योगसिद्धानां ज्ञानविज्ञानवेदिनाम् |
text_mt: the Sāṅkhyas, the adept in yoga, and those who know knowledge and higher knowledge—

sanskrit_iast:
[gurornāradādadhigatasyāsya śāstrasya munīn prati
yathādhigatamupadeśapratijñā]
meaning:
[गुरोर्नारदादधिगतस्यास्य शास्त्रस्य मुनीन् प्रति
यथाधिगतमुपदेशप्रतिज्ञा]
text_mt: [The declaration of the instruction to the sages of this scripture obtained from the guru Nārada as it was obtained]

sanskrit_iast: tacchṛṇudhvaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ dharmaṃ saṃsāratārakam || 48 ||
meaning: तच्छृणुध्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः धर्मं संसारतारकम् || 48 ||
text_mt: hear that, O best of sages, the dharma that carries one across transmigratory existence! || 48

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛkprāptaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ parituṣṭācca nāradāt |
sarvajñānakriyāyuktaṃ sarvasiddhiprasādhanam || 49 ||
meaning:
यादृक्प्राप्तं मया पूर्वं परितुष्टाच्च नारदात् |
सर्वज्ञानक्रियायुक्तं सर्वसिद्धिप्रसाधनम् || 49 ||
text_mt:
Just as it was previously received by me from the delighted Nārada,
replete with all knowledge and ritual action, accomplishing all attainments, || 49

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣiptaṃ ca mahārthaṃ yattathā samyagvivekadam |
jñātvaivaṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca adhītaṃ hi purā mayā || 50 ||
meaning:
संक्षिप्तं च महार्थं यत्तथा सम्यग्विवेकदम् |
ज्ञात्वैवं सारभूतं च अधीतं हि पुरा मया || 50 ||
text_mt:
concise and of great import, conferring correct discernment,
having known it to be thus the essence, it was indeed studied by me formerly. || 50

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādvai dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāmāśusiddhikṛt |
adhītya ca śrutaṃ paścāt jñānānāṃ jñānamuttamam || 51 ||
meaning:
यस्माद्वै धर्मकामार्थमोक्षाणामाशुसिद्धिकृत् |
अधीत्य च श्रुतं पश्चात् ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम् || 51 ||
text_mt:
Since it quickly brings about the attainment of dharma, desire, wealth, and liberation,
having studied it, this highest of knowledge was subsequently heard [by me]. || 51

sanskrit_iast:
yatprasādāttu vai bhūyo bhave'sminna bhavāmyaham |
tadyuṣmabhyaṃ pravakṣyāmi āmnāyena yathāsthitam || 52 ||
meaning:
यत्प्रसादात्तु वै भूयो भवेऽस्मिन्न भवाम्यहम् |
तद्युष्मभ्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि आम्नायेन यथास्थितम् || 52 ||
text_mt:
By whose grace I shall not come to be again in this transmigratory existence,
that I shall proclaim to you according to the traditional transmission as it stands. || 52

sanskrit_iast: [śraddhābhaktipūrvakamupasannasyaiva śāstrasyāsyopadeśe pātratā |]
meaning: [श्रद्धाभक्तिपूर्वकमुपसन्नस्यैव शास्त्रस्यास्योपदेशे पात्रता |]
text_mt: [The eligibility for instruction in this scripture belongs only to one who has approached with faith and devotion]

sanskrit_iast:
rahitaṃ saṃśayaissarvairguruśiṣyakrameṇa tu |
parijñātaṃ krameṇaiva yasmācchāstraṃ phalapradam || 53 ||
meaning:
रहितं संशयैस्सर्वैर्गुरुशिष्यक्रमेण तु |
परिज्ञातं क्रमेणैव यस्माच्छास्त्रं फलप्रदम् || 53 ||
text_mt:
Because, free from all doubts, through the succession of guru and disciple,
the scripture bestows fruit only when properly understood in due order, || 53

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnayaṃ dvijāḥ pūrvamāśrayadhvaṃ prayatnataḥ |
bhaktiśraddhāsametaṃ tu astitve (āstikye ?) nāpyalaṅkṛtam || 54 ||
meaning:
तस्मान्नयं द्विजाः पूर्वमाश्रयध्वं प्रयत्नतः |
भक्तिश्रद्धासमेतं तु अस्तित्वे (आस्तिक्ये ?) नाप्यलङ्कृतम् || 54 ||
text_mt:
therefore, O twice-born, first resort to right conduct with effort,
endowed with devotion and faith, and adorned with belief in the transcendent. || 54

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasvamapi yo dadyāt bhaktiśraddhāvivarjitaḥ |
nayācāravinirmukto mānī śāstrārthadūṣakaḥ || 55 ||
meaning:
सर्वस्वमपि यो दद्यात् भक्तिश्रद्धाविवर्जितः |
नयाचारविनिर्मुक्तो मानी शास्त्रार्थदूषकः || 55 ||
text_mt:
Even if one should give all one's possessions, if one is devoid of devotion and faith,
divorced from right conduct and proper custom, arrogant, and a defamer of the meaning of scripture, || 55

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya śāstraṃ vaktavyaṃ brūte vā yassa yātyadhaḥ |
samācāreṇa yo brūyācchṛṇuyādyaśca tāvubhau || 56 ||
meaning:
न तस्य शास्त्रं वक्तव्यं ब्रूते वा यस्स यात्यधः |
समाचारेण यो ब्रूयाच्छृणुयाद्यश्च तावुभौ || 56 ||
text_mt:
the scripture must not be spoken to him; or if one speaks it [to such a person], he goes downwards.
He who speaks it with proper practice, and he who listens—both of them || 56

sanskrit_iast: gacchetāṃ tu jagadyoneḥ padaṃ ghoraviparyayāt |
meaning: गच्छेतां तु जगद्योनेः पदं घोरविपर्ययात् |
text_mt: shall go from terrible adversity to the abode of the source of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
[gurormahimānuvarṇanagarbhaṃ gurau bhakteḥ
śreyaḥsādhanatvavarṇanam]
meaning:
[गुरोर्महिमानुवर्णनगर्भं गुरौ भक्तेः
श्रेयःसाधनत्ववर्णनम्]
text_mt: [The description of devotion to the guru as the means to the highest good, containing a description of the greatness of the guru]

sanskrit_iast: śāstrāyattā yataḥ sarve bhogamokṣādayo dvijāḥ || 57 ||
meaning: शास्त्रायत्ता यतः सर्वे भोगमोक्षादयो द्विजाः || 57 ||
text_mt: Since all worldly enjoyment, liberation, and the rest depend upon scripture, O twice-born, || 57

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavaṃ jñānavaktāraṃ vidyādviṣṇuvadgurum |
p. 6) pūjayedvāṅmanaḥkāyaissa śāstrajñassa vaiṣṇavaḥ || 58 ||
meaning:
वैष्णवं ज्ञानवक्तारं विद्याद्विष्णुवद्गुरुम् |
प्. 6) पूजयेद्वाङ्मनःकायैस्स शास्त्रज्ञस्स वैष्णवः || 58 ||
text_mt:
one should know the Vaiṣṇava guru, the speaker of knowledge, to be like Viṣṇu;
he who knows scripture, that Vaiṣṇava, should worship [him] with speech, mind, and body. || 58

sanskrit_iast:
ślokapādasya vaktā'pi yataḥ pūjyassadaiva hi |
kiṃ punarbhagavadviṣṇossvarūpaṃ vivṛṇoti yaḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
श्लोकपादस्य वक्ताऽपि यतः पूज्यस्सदैव हि |
किं पुनर्भगवद्विष्णोस्स्वरूपं विवृणोति यः || 59 ||
text_mt:
For since even the speaker of a quarter of a verse is always worthy of worship,
how much more he who reveals the true nature of Lord Viṣṇu! || 59

sanskrit_iast:
śāstrasya caiva vaktā'pi tadbhāvagatamānasaḥ |
vibhoḥ śāstrasya ca gurostritayasyāsya pūjanāt || 60 ||
meaning:
शास्त्रस्य चैव वक्ताऽपि तद्भावगतमानसः |
विभोः शास्त्रस्य च गुरोस्त्रितयस्यास्य पूजनात् || 60 ||
text_mt:
And the speaker of the scripture whose mind is directed toward that reality—
from the worship of this triad of the All-Pervading One, the scripture, and the guru, || 60

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ bhavatyanūnaṃ vai iha loke paratra ca |
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma tajjñānenābhigamyate || 61 ||
meaning:
फलं भवत्यनूनं वै इह लोके परत्र च |
नारायणः परं ब्रह्म तज्ज्ञानेनाभिगम्यते || 61 ||
text_mt:
there is unfailing fruit indeed in this world and in the next.
Nārāyaṇa is the supreme Brahman; he is approached through knowledge of him. || 61

sanskrit_iast:
jñānasya sādhanaṃ śāstraṃ tacchāstraṃ guruvaktragam |
brahmaprāptirato hetorgurvadhīnā sadaiva hi || 62 ||
meaning:
ज्ञानस्य साधनं शास्त्रं तच्छास्त्रं गुरुवक्त्रगम् |
ब्रह्मप्राप्तिरतो हेतोर्गुर्वधीना सदैव हि || 62 ||
text_mt:
Scripture is the means to knowledge, and that scripture resides in the mouth of the guru;
therefore, the attainment of Brahman is always dependent upon the guru. || 62

sanskrit_iast:
hetunā'nena vai viprā gururgurutamaḥsmṛtaḥ |
yasmāddevo jagannāthaḥ kṛtvā martyamayīṃ tanum || 63 ||
meaning:
हेतुनाऽनेन वै विप्रा गुरुर्गुरुतमःस्मृतः |
यस्माद्देवो जगन्नाथः कृत्वा मर्त्यमयीं तनुम् || 63 ||
text_mt:
For this reason, O Brahmins, the guru is remembered as the weightiest of all;
since the divine Lord of the Universe, having assumed a mortal body, || 63

sanskrit_iast:
magnānuddharate lokān kāruṇyācchāstrapāṇinā |
tasmādbhaktirgurau kāryā saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā || 64 ||
meaning:
मग्नानुद्धरते लोकान् कारुण्याच्छास्त्रपाणिना |
तस्माद्भक्तिर्गुरौ कार्या संसारभयभीरुणा || 64 ||
text_mt:
out of compassion lifts up the worlds that are submerged, with the hand of scripture,
therefore devotion to the guru should be practiced by one who fears the danger of transmigratory existence. || 64

sanskrit_iast:
śāstrāñjanena yo'jñānatimiraṃ vinipātayet |
śāstraṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ bhogamokṣadam || 65 ||
meaning:
शास्त्राञ्जनेन योऽज्ञानतिमिरं विनिपातयेत् |
शास्त्रं पापहरं पुण्यं पवित्रं भोगमोक्षदम् || 65 ||
text_mt:
He who would dispel the darkness of ignorance with the collyrium of scripture—
scripture destroys sin, is holy, purifying, and bestows enjoyment and liberation; || 65

sanskrit_iast: śāntidaṃ ca mahārthaṃ ca vakti yassa jagadguruḥ |
meaning: शान्तिदं च महार्थं च वक्ति यस्स जगद्गुरुः |
text_mt: and he who speaks this [scripture] which grants peace and is of great import is the Universal Preceptor.

sanskrit_iast: [atha tattvaśuśrūṣayā munibhiḥ śiṣyabhāvaḥ]
meaning: [अथ तत्त्वशुश्रूषया मुनिभिः शिष्यभावः]
text_mt: [Now the assumption of discipleship by the sages out of desire to hear the truth]

sanskrit_iast: ityuktāstena munayo muninā brahmavedinā || 66 ||
meaning: इत्युक्तास्तेन मुनयो मुनिना ब्रह्मवेदिना || 66 ||
text_mt: Thus addressed by that sage who knew Brahman, || 66

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktāsanāstatassarve babhūvuśśāntamānasāḥ |
tatpādamūle patitāstaccittāstatparāyaṇāḥ || 67 ||
meaning:
त्यक्तासनास्ततस्सर्वे बभूवुश्शान्तमानसाः |
तत्पादमूले पतितास्तच्चित्तास्तत्परायणाः || 67 ||
text_mt:
all those sages then left their seats and became calm in mind;
they fell at his feet, fixing their minds on him, wholly devoted to him. || 67

sanskrit_iast: [athopadeśārambhaḥ]
meaning: [अथोपदेशारम्भः]

sanskrit_iast:
datto mūrdhni tatasteṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām |
viṣṇuhastaśca (?) tuṣṭena muninā brahmavedinā || 68 ||
meaning:
दत्तो मूर्ध्नि ततस्तेषां मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् |
विष्णुहस्तश्च (?) तुष्टेन मुनिना ब्रह्मवेदिना || 68 ||
text_mt:
Then, on the heads of those sages, the purified souls,
the hand of Viṣṇu was placed by the gratified sage who knew Brahman. || 68

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca sa viprendraḥ praṇipatyācyutaṃ harim |
kramāgataṃ mahacchāstraṃ jñānāmṛtaṃphalapradam || 69 ||
meaning:
अथोवाच स विप्रेन्द्रः प्रणिपत्याच्युतं हरिम् |
क्रमागतं महच्छास्त्रं ज्ञानामृतंफलप्रदम् || 69 ||
text_mt:
Then that best of Brahmins, having bowed down to Acyuta Hari,
spoke the great scripture handed down through tradition, the nectar of knowledge that bestows fruit: || 69

sanskrit_iast:
[asya śāstrasyārambhakālaṃ-pravartakapuruṣaviśeṣa-
ākhyāviśeṣāṇāṃ nirūpaṇam]
meaning:
[अस्य शास्त्रस्यारम्भकालं-प्रवर्तकपुरुषविशेष-
आख्याविशेषाणां निरूपणम्]
text_mt: [The determination of the time of commencement, the specific inaugurating person, and the specific names of this scripture]

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte yuge pravṛtte tu kasmiṃścinmunisattamāḥ |
p. 7) pauṣkare brahmakalpe tu pratyakṣasthe'pyaghokṣaje || 70 ||
meaning:
कृते युगे प्रवृत्ते तु कस्मिंश्चिन्मुनिसत्तमाः |
प्. 7) पौष्करे ब्रह्मकल्पे तु प्रत्यक्षस्थेऽप्यघोक्षजे || 70 ||
text_mt:
When a certain Kṛta age had commenced, O best of sages,
in the Pauṣkara Kalpa of Brahmā, even while Adhokṣaja was perceptibly present, || 70

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakrodhavinirmukte pravṛddhe tu pitāmahe |
sthite niṣkaṇṭake samyaktrailokye sacarācare || 71 ||
meaning:
कामक्रोधविनिर्मुक्ते प्रवृद्धे तु पितामहे |
स्थिते निष्कण्टके सम्यक्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे || 71 ||
text_mt:
when the Grandfather [Brahmā] was fully grown, free from desire and wrath,
and the three worlds with the moving and unmoving were completely untroubled, || 71

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpravṛddhe tathā dharme adharme nāśamāgate |
nāradena yathā pṛṣṭo devaḥ kamalalocanaḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
संप्रवृद्धे तथा धर्मे अधर्मे नाशमागते |
नारदेन यथा पृष्टो देवः कमललोचनः || 72 ||
text_mt:
when dharma was greatly flourishing and adharma had met destruction,
as the Lotus-Eyed God was questioned by Nārada, || 72

sanskrit_iast:
jayārthamapi bhaktānāṃ hitārthamapi cātmanaḥ |
anuṣṭupchandobaddhena sārātsāratarā śubhā || 73 ||
meaning:
जयार्थमपि भक्तानां हितार्थमपि चात्मनः |
अनुष्टुप्छन्दोबद्धेन सारात्सारतरा शुभा || 73 ||
text_mt:
both for the victory of the devotees and for the benefit of himself,
bound in anuṣṭubh meter, more essential than the essence, auspicious, || 73

sanskrit_iast:
proktā trailokyaguruṇā pṛcchate nāradāya tu |
sārabhūtaṃ samuddhṛtya saṃhitā'mṛtagarbhiṇī || 74 ||
meaning:
प्रोक्ता त्रैलोक्यगुरुणा पृच्छते नारदाय तु |
सारभूतं समुद्धृत्य संहिताऽमृतगर्भिणी || 74 ||
text_mt:
having extracted what is the essence, the collection pregnant with nectar
was spoken by the Guru of the Three Worlds to Nārada who was asking. || 74

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñatvaguṇenaiva kṛtsnaṃ jñātvā ca tattvataḥ |
sārdhakoṭipramāṇaṃ tu jñātṛjñānopabṛṃhatim || 75 ||
meaning:
सर्वज्ञत्वगुणेनैव कृत्स्नं ज्ञात्वा च तत्त्वतः |
सार्धकोटिप्रमाणं तु ज्ञातृज्ञानोपबृंहतिम् || 75 ||
text_mt:
By virtue of his omniscience, having known everything in reality,
[a text] of the extent of fifteen million [verses], amplifying the knowledge of the knower, || 75

sanskrit_iast:
jayāvyaṃ niṣadaṃ tantraṃ brahmamūlādvinissṛtam |
amūrtādgaganādyadvat nirghāto jāyate svayam || 76 ||
meaning:
जयाव्यं निषदं तन्त्रं ब्रह्ममूलाद्विनिस्सृतम् |
अमूर्ताद्गगनाद्यद्वत् निर्घातो जायते स्वयम् || 76 ||
text_mt:
the tantra named Jayā, an Upaniṣad, emerged from the root that is Brahman,
just as a lightning stroke arises by itself from the formless sky. || 76

sanskrit_iast:
śāntātsaṃvinmayāttadvacchāstraṃ śabdātma cotthitam |
avikāramasaṅkalpaṃ yadrūpaṃ tatparaṃ vibhoḥ || 77 ||
meaning:
शान्तात्संविन्मयात्तद्वच्छास्त्रं शब्दात्म चोत्थितम् |
अविकारमसङ्कल्पं यद्रूपं तत्परं विभोः || 77 ||
text_mt:
In the same way, the scripture consisting of sound arose from the tranquil [reality] that consists of consciousness.
That form of the All-Pervading One which is without modification and without conceptualization is supreme; || 77

sanskrit_iast:
yadvikāraṃ jagaddhātuśśabdabrahmeti tatsmṛtam |
tataḥprabhṛti kālācca loke'sminmunisattamāḥ || 78 ||
meaning:
यद्विकारं जगद्धातुश्शब्दब्रह्मेति तत्स्मृतम् |
ततःप्रभृति कालाच्च लोकेऽस्मिन्मुनिसत्तमाः || 78 ||
text_mt:
that which is the modification of the Supporter of the Universe is remembered as the sonic Brahman.
From that time onward, O best of sages, in this world, || 78

sanskrit_iast: jayeti vimalaṃ nāma praṇītaṃ viśvakarmaṇā |
meaning: जयेति विमलं नाम प्रणीतं विश्वकर्मणा |
text_mt: the spotless name "Jayā" was formulated by the Creator of the Universe.

sanskrit_iast: [adhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ]
meaning: [अधिकः पाठः]

sanskrit_iast:
pañcarātrasya kṛtsnasya vaktā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
iti sarvatra vikhyātaṃ bhagavacchāstragauravam || 1 ||
meaning:
पञ्चरात्रस्य कृत्स्नस्य वक्ता नारायणः स्वयम् |
इति सर्वत्र विख्यातं भगवच्छास्त्रगौरवम् || 1 ||
text_mt:
Nārāyaṇa himself is the speaker of the entire Pāñcarātra;
thus the dignity of the scripture of the Lord is renowned everywhere. || 1

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvataṃ pauṣkaraṃ caiva jayākhyaṃ tantramuttamam |
ratnatrayamiti khyātaṃ tadviśeṣa ihocyate || 2 ||
meaning:
सात्त्वतं पौष्करं चैव जयाख्यं तन्त्रमुत्तमम् |
रत्नत्रयमिति ख्यातं तद्विशेष इहोच्यते || 2 ||
text_mt:
The Sāttvata, the Pauṣkara, and the excellent tantra named Jayā
are known as the "three gems"; their distinctive nature is stated here. || 2

sanskrit_iast:
sāraṃ sāttvataśāstrasya rahasyaṃ prājñasaṃmatam |
ratnatrayamidaṃ sākṣādbhagavadvaktraniḥsṛtam || 3 ||
meaning:
सारं सात्त्वतशास्त्रस्य रहस्यं प्राज्ञसंमतम् |
रत्नत्रयमिदं साक्षाद्भगवद्वक्त्रनिःसृतम् || 3 ||
text_mt:
The essence of the Sāttvata scripture, a secret approved by the wise,
these three gems emerged directly from the mouth of the Lord. || 3

sanskrit_iast:
pravartitaṃ tathaivedamanyūnānadhikatvataḥ |
anyānyāni tu tantrāṇi bhagavanmukhanirgatam || 4 ||
meaning:
प्रवर्तितं तथैवेदमन्यूनानधिकत्वतः |
अन्यान्यानि तु तन्त्राणि भगवन्मुखनिर्गतम् || 4 ||
text_mt:
And in just this way it was set forth, being neither deficient nor excessive;
whereas the other tantras, having emerged from the mouth of the Lord, || 4

sanskrit_iast:
sāraṃ samupajīvyaiva samāsavyāsadhāraṇaiḥ |
vyākhyopabṛṃhaṇanyāyādvyāpitāni tathā tathā || 5 ||
meaning:
सारं समुपजीव्यैव समासव्यासधारणैः |
व्याख्योपबृंहणन्यायाद्व्यापितानि तथा तथा || 5 ||
text_mt:
by drawing upon its essence through concise, elaborate, and intermediate formulations,
were extended this way and that on the principle of explanatory amplification. || 5

sanskrit_iast:
vyākhyāmūlanayenaiṣāṃ gauravaṃ sampratiṣṭhitam |
tantre'pyaṣṭottaraśate pārameśvarasaṃhitā || 6 ||
meaning:
व्याख्यामूलनयेनैषां गौरवं सम्प्रतिष्ठितम् |
तन्त्रेऽप्यष्टोत्तरशते पारमेश्वरसंहिता || 6 ||
text_mt:
Their authority is established through the principle of commentary and original text.
Even among the one hundred and eight tantras, the Pārameśvarasaṃhitā || 6

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣkarārthavivṛtyarthā vyākhyārūpā'vatāritā |
sāttvatasya vivṛtyarthamīśvaraṃ tantramuttamam || 7 ||
meaning:
पौष्करार्थविवृत्यर्था व्याख्यारूपाऽवतारिता |
सात्त्वतस्य विवृत्यर्थमीश्वरं तन्त्रमुत्तमम् || 7 ||
text_mt:
was brought down in the form of a commentary to elucidate the meaning of the Pauṣkara;
and the excellent Īśvaratantra to elucidate the Sāttvata. || 7

sanskrit_iast:
jayākhyasyāsya tantrasya vyākhyānaṃ pādmamucyate |
bhagavadvyaktideśeṣu svayaṃvyakteṣu bhūtale || 8 ||
meaning:
जयाख्यस्यास्य तन्त्रस्य व्याख्यानं पाद्ममुच्यते |
भगवद्व्यक्तिदेशेषु स्वयंव्यक्तेषु भूतले || 8 ||
text_mt:
The commentary on this tantra named Jayā is said to be the Pādma.
Among the manifestation sites of the Lord that are self-manifest on earth, || 8

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśate mukhyaṃ ratnabhūtaṃ catuṣṭayam |
śrīraṅgaṃ veṃkaṭādriśca hastiśailastataḥ param || 9 ||
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशते मुख्यं रत्नभूतं चतुष्टयम् |
श्रीरङ्गं वेंकटाद्रिश्च हस्तिशैलस्ततः परम् || 9 ||
text_mt:
there is a principal quartet among the one hundred and eight that are like jewels:
Śrīraṅga, Veṅkaṭādri, then Hastiśaila, || 9

sanskrit_iast:
tato nārāyaṇādiśca divyasthānacatuṣṭayam |
veṃkaṭādriṃ vinā'nyeṣu devadevasya dhāmasu || 10 ||
meaning:
ततो नारायणादिश्च दिव्यस्थानचतुष्टयम् |
वेंकटाद्रिं विनाऽन्येषु देवदेवस्य धामसु || 10 ||
text_mt:
and next Nārāyaṇādri—these form the quartet of divine sites.
Except for Veṅkaṭādri, in the other abodes of the God of Gods, || 10

sanskrit_iast:
ratneṣu triṣu ratnāni trīṇi tantrāṇyupāsate |
mūlavyākhyānarūpatvādupajīvyaṃ parasparam || 11 ||
meaning:
रत्नेषु त्रिषु रत्नानि त्रीणि तन्त्राण्युपासते |
मूलव्याख्यानरूपत्वादुपजीव्यं परस्परम् || 11 ||
text_mt:
they worship with the three tantras that are jewels in these three jewels [of places].
Because they have the character of root text and commentary, they are mutually dependent. || 11

sanskrit_iast:
tantratrayamidaṃ vidyādekaśāstraṃ tathā budhaḥ |
sāttvataṃ yaduśailendre śrīraṅge pauṣkaraṃ tathā || 12 ||
meaning:
तन्त्रत्रयमिदं विद्यादेकशास्त्रं तथा बुधः |
सात्त्वतं यदुशैलेन्द्रे श्रीरङ्गे पौष्करं तथा || 12 ||
text_mt:
The wise person should understand this triad of tantras as a single scripture.
The Sāttvata holds sovereign sway at the lord of mountains Yaduśaila, the Pauṣkara at Śrīraṅga, || 12

sanskrit_iast:
hastiśaile jayākhyaṃ ca sāmrājyamadhitiṣṭhati |
pādmatantraṃ hastiśaile śrīraṅge pārameśvaram || 13 ||
meaning:
हस्तिशैले जयाख्यं च साम्राज्यमधितिष्ठति |
पाद्मतन्त्रं हस्तिशैले श्रीरङ्गे पारमेश्वरम् || 13 ||
text_mt:
and the Jayākhya at Hastiśaila;
the Pādmatantra at Hastiśaila, the Pārameśvara at Śrīraṅga, || 13

sanskrit_iast:
p. 9) īśvaraṃ yādavādrau ca kāryakāri pracāryate |
śrīraṅgādyādavādreśca hastiśailo viśiṣyate || 14 ||
meaning:
प्. 9) ईश्वरं यादवाद्रौ च कार्यकारि प्रचार्यते |
श्रीरङ्गाद्यादवाद्रेश्च हस्तिशैलो विशिष्यते || 14 ||
text_mt:
and the Īśvara is promulgated as practical manual on Yādavādri.
Hastiśaila is superior to Śrīraṅga and Yādavādri, || 14

sanskrit_iast:
padmarāgācca vaiḍūryādyathā vajraṃ mahāguṇam |
purā kṛtayuge brahmā sākṣātkṛtya ramāpatim || 15 ||
meaning:
पद्मरागाच्च वैडूर्याद्यथा वज्रं महागुणम् |
पुरा कृतयुगे ब्रह्मा साक्षात्कृत्य रमापतिम् || 15 ||
text_mt:
just as the diamond is of great virtue compared to the ruby and the cat's-eye.
In ancient times, in the Kṛta age, Brahmā, having perceived directly the Husband of Ramā, || 15

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ samarcayitvā'tha tadarcākramamuttamam |
śiṣyebhyo mahanīyebhya upadiśya kṛpāvaśāt || 16 ||
meaning:
स्वयं समर्चयित्वाऽथ तदर्चाक्रममुत्तमम् |
शिष्येभ्यो महनीयेभ्य उपदिश्य कृपावशात् || 16 ||
text_mt:
and having himself worshipped Him, then taught that excellent sequence of His worship
to his venerable disciples out of compassion. || 16

sanskrit_iast:
tairevārādhanaṃ kāle kārayatyabjasaṃbhavaḥ |
ityevaṃ nāradācchrutvā punarevāhamabruvam || 17 ||
meaning:
तैरेवाराधनं काले कारयत्यब्जसंभवः |
इत्येवं नारदाच्छ्रुत्वा पुनरेवाहमब्रुवम् || 17 ||
text_mt:
The Lotus-Born One has the worship performed at that time by them alone."
Having heard thus from Nārada, I spoke once again: || 17

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavan kamalākāntaḥ kathaṃ sākṣātkṛtaḥ kadā |
tadetadbrūhi me svāmin hastyandreścāpi vaibhavam || 18 ||
meaning:
भगवन् कमलाकान्तः कथं साक्षात्कृतः कदा |
तदेतद्ब्रूहि मे स्वामिन् हस्त्यन्द्रेश्चापि वैभवम् || 18 ||
text_mt:
"O Lord, how was the Lover of Kamalā directly perceived, and when?
Tell me that, O Master, and also the majesty of Hastyadri." || 18

sanskrit_iast:
iti pṛṣṭo mayā prāha nārado bhagavān ṛṣiḥ |
sādhu pṛṣṭo'smyahaṃ vatsa ślāghanīyo'si me mataḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
इति पृष्टो मया प्राह नारदो भगवान् ऋषिः |
साधु पृष्टोऽस्म्यहं वत्स श्लाघनीयोऽसि मे मतः || 19 ||
text_mt:
Having been asked thus by me, the divine sage Nārada said:
"Well have I been asked, my child; I hold you worthy of praise, || 19

sanskrit_iast:
yadadya kariśailasya vakṣyāmi tava vaibhavam |
purā mayopasannena bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
यदद्य करिशैलस्य वक्ष्यामि तव वैभवम् |
पुरा मयोपसन्नेन भगवान् भूतभावनः || 20 ||
text_mt:
since today I shall speak to you of the majesty of Kariśaila.
In ancient times, when approached by me, the divine Creator of Beings, || 20

sanskrit_iast:
jagatsraṣṭā surādhīśo'nuyuktaścaturānanaḥ |
hastiśailasya māhātmyaṃ varadasya kṛpārasam || 21 ||
meaning:
जगत्स्रष्टा सुराधीशोऽनुयुक्तश्चतुराननः |
हस्तिशैलस्य माहात्म्यं वरदस्य कृपारसम् || 21 ||
text_mt:
the Creator of the World, the Lord of the Gods, the Four-Faced One was questioned;
and he described the greatness of Hastiśaila, the essence of the grace of Varada, || 21

sanskrit_iast:
satyavratasya kṣetrasya vaibhavaṃ cānvavarṇayat |
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi saṃgraheṇaiva sāravat || 22 ||
meaning:
सत्यव्रतस्य क्षेत्रस्य वैभवं चान्ववर्णयत् |
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि संग्रहेणैव सारवत् || 22 ||
text_mt:
and the majesty of the sacred site Satyavrata.
That I shall declare to you concisely and essentially. || 22

sanskrit_iast:
sāvadhānaḥ śṛṇu prītyā guhyaṃ sāramidaṃ yataḥ |
bhagavannābhipāthojājjāto dhātā'bjasaṃbhavaḥ || 23 ||
meaning:
सावधानः शृणु प्रीत्या गुह्यं सारमिदं यतः |
भगवन्नाभिपाथोजाज्जातो धाताऽब्जसंभवः || 23 ||
text_mt:
Listen attentively with love, for this is a secret essence.
The Lotus-Born Creator, born from the navel-lotus of the Lord, || 23

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭvā carācaraṃ viśvaṃ garvaṃ paramupāyayau |
ābhijātyaṃ sadācāro vidyā ceti madatrayam || 24 ||
meaning:
सृष्ट्वा चराचरं विश्वं गर्वं परमुपाययौ |
आभिजात्यं सदाचारो विद्या चेति मदत्रयम् || 24 ||
text_mt:
having created the moving and unmoving universe, succumbed to great pride.
High birth, good conduct, and learning: this triad of intoxications || 24

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānevābhibhavati kimu sarvādhike pade |
tato'sau mattacittaḥ san devadevaṃ ramāpatim || 25 ||
meaning:
सर्वानेवाभिभवति किमु सर्वाधिके पदे |
ततोऽसौ मत्तचित्तः सन् देवदेवं रमापतिम् || 25 ||
text_mt:
overcomes everyone—how much more so one in the highest position of all!
Then he, his mind intoxicated, desiring to perceive directly || 25

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣāccikīrṣuryogena paraṃ yatnamupāgamat |
devadevasvarūpādisākṣātkāravirodhinā || 26 ||
meaning:
साक्षाच्चिकीर्षुर्योगेन परं यत्नमुपागमत् |
देवदेवस्वरूपादिसाक्षात्कारविरोधिना || 26 ||
text_mt:
the God of Gods, the Husband of Ramā, through yoga, undertook the utmost exertion.
By an immeasurable, great wrongdoing that opposed || 26

sanskrit_iast:
aprameyena mahatā duṣkṛtenaiṣa vāritaḥ |
punaḥ punaḥ prayatne'pi sumahatyapyanuṣṭhite || 27 ||
meaning:
अप्रमेयेन महता दुष्कृतेनैष वारितः |
पुनः पुनः प्रयत्नेऽपि सुमहत्यप्यनुष्ठिते || 27 ||
text_mt:
the direct perception of the true nature and attributes of the God of Gods, he was prevented;
and though he exerted himself exceedingly again and again, || 27

sanskrit_iast:
na sa siddhimanuprāpat samādheḥ pratyahanyata |
atha cintāparo dīnaścintayitvā muhurmuhuḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
न स सिद्धिमनुप्रापत् समाधेः प्रत्यहन्यत |
अथ चिन्तापरो दीनश्चिन्तयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः || 28 ||
text_mt:
he did not attain success; his meditative absorption was continually broken.
Then, overcome with anxiety and dejected, reflecting repeatedly: || 28

sanskrit_iast:
p. 10) vṛthaivācaritaṃ kaṣṭamiyatā mandabuddhinā |
devāvāsasamārohāvārohābhikhyakelitaḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
प्. 10) वृथैवाचरितं कष्टमियता मन्दबुद्धिना |
देवावाससमारोहावारोहाभिख्यकेलितः || 29 ||
text_mt:
"In vain has hardship been endured by me of dull intellect for so long!
From the sport known as ascending and descending the abodes of the gods, || 29

sanskrit_iast:
nirmocanārthameko'pi kṣaṇo hanta na yāpitaḥ |
athālambya dhṛtiṃ dhīmān bhūlokaṃ pratyapadyata || 30 ||
meaning:
निर्मोचनार्थमेकोऽपि क्षणो हन्त न यापितः |
अथालम्ब्य धृतिं धीमान् भूलोकं प्रत्यपद्यत || 30 ||
text_mt:
alas, not even a single moment was spent for the purpose of release!"
Then, summoning his resolve, the wise one descended to the earthly realm. || 30

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāmadhye mahadghoraṃ tapastaptumupākramat |
aṅguṣṭāgrapadāttiṣṭanniruddhaśvāsaceṣṭitaḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
गङ्गामध्ये महद्घोरं तपस्तप्तुमुपाक्रमत् |
अङ्गुष्टाग्रपदात्तिष्टन्निरुद्धश्वासचेष्टितः || 31 ||
text_mt:
In the midst of the Gaṅgā he began to perform fierce and terrible ascetic penance;
standing on the tip of his big toe, with his breath and movements restrained, || 31

sanskrit_iast:
ūrddhvabāhurnirāhārastapastepe sudāruṇam |
kāpeyacapalaṃ cittaṃ na svāsthyaṃ prāpa tasya yat || 32 ||
meaning:
ऊर्द्ध्वबाहुर्निराहारस्तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् |
कापेयचपलं चित्तं न स्वास्थ्यं प्राप तस्य यत् || 32 ||
text_mt:
with arms raised, taking no food, he performed exceedingly severe ascetic penance.
Yet his mind, fickle as a monkey, did not find composure; || 32

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇamātramapi śrīśaṃ na dhyātuṃ prābhavattataḥ |
atha dīne kṛśe dhātaryākāśādaśarīriṇī || 33 ||
meaning:
क्षणमात्रमपि श्रीशं न ध्यातुं प्राभवत्ततः |
अथ दीने कृशे धातर्याकाशादशरीरिणी || 33 ||
text_mt:
therefore, he was unable to meditate on the Lord of Śrī even for a single moment.
Then, as the Creator was dejected and emaciated, a sacred, bodiless voice || 33

sanskrit_iast:
vāṇī prādurabhūtpuṇyā bodhayāmāsa padmajam |
adhikāramahānandarasamagrasya te manaḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
वाणी प्रादुरभूत्पुण्या बोधयामास पद्मजम् |
अधिकारमहानन्दरसमग्रस्य ते मनः || 34 ||
text_mt:
manifested from the sky and instructed the Lotus-Born One:
"Your mind, immersed in the savor of the great bliss of high authority, || 34

sanskrit_iast:
sahasreṇāśvamedhānāṃ vinā śuddhiṃ na gacchati |
aśuddhasyeha manasaḥ svāsthyaṃ saṃpādyatāṃ katham || 35 ||
meaning:
सहस्रेणाश्वमेधानां विना शुद्धिं न गच्छति |
अशुद्धस्येह मनसः स्वास्थ्यं संपाद्यतां कथम् || 35 ||
text_mt:
does not become pure without a thousand horse sacrifices.
How can composure be attained here for an impure mind? || 35

sanskrit_iast:
asvasthe manasi dhyānaṃ sādhu niṣpadyatāṃ katham |
kartavyagauravātkālavilambācca bibheṣi cet || 36 ||
meaning:
अस्वस्थे मनसि ध्यानं साधु निष्पद्यतां कथम् |
कर्तव्यगौरवात्कालविलम्बाच्च बिभेषि चेत् || 36 ||
text_mt:
When the mind is not composed, how could meditation succeed properly?
If you fear the magnitude of what must be done and the delay in time, || 36

sanskrit_iast:
upāyaṃ sukaraṃ vakṣye yathāvadavadhāraya |
gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe bhāge yojanānāṃ śatadvaye || 37 ||
meaning:
उपायं सुकरं वक्ष्ये यथावदवधारय |
गङ्गाया दक्षिणे भागे योजनानां शतद्वये || 37 ||
text_mt:
I shall tell you an easy means; comprehend it properly.
Two hundred yojanas to the south of the Gaṅgā, || 37

sanskrit_iast:
pañcayojanavistāraṃ pañcayojanamāyatam |
tīrāntaṃ pūrvavārāśeḥ sarvaiḥ sumahitaṃ guṇaiḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
पञ्चयोजनविस्तारं पञ्चयोजनमायतम् |
तीरान्तं पूर्ववाराशेः सर्वैः सुमहितं गुणैः || 38 ||
text_mt:
five yojanas in breadth and five yojanas in length,
extending to the shore of the eastern ocean, highly extolled for all virtues, || 38

sanskrit_iast:
siddhikṣetraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śrīśasyābhimataṃ param |
satyavratamiti khyātaṃ yathārthākhyāvabhāsakam || 39 ||
meaning:
सिद्धिक्षेत्रं महापुण्यं श्रीशस्याभिमतं परम् |
सत्यव्रतमिति ख्यातं यथार्थाख्यावभासकम् || 39 ||
text_mt:
there is a sacred site of attainment, exceedingly holy, most dear to the Lord of Śrī,
renowned as Satyavrata, illuminating its name by its true reality. || 39

sanskrit_iast:
ekastatra kṛto dharmo vardhate hi sahasradhā |
tatra tvamaśvamedhena yajerekena ceddharim || 40 ||
meaning:
एकस्तत्र कृतो धर्मो वर्धते हि सहस्रधा |
तत्र त्वमश्वमेधेन यजेरेकेन चेद्धरिम् || 40 ||
text_mt:
A single righteous act performed there multiplies a thousandfold.
If you sacrifice there to Hari with a single horse sacrifice, || 40

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrasyāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpsyasi niścitam |
tatra śarvatare kalpe diggajā viṣṇumavyayam || 41 ||
meaning:
सहस्रस्याश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्स्यसि निश्चितम् |
तत्र शर्वतरे कल्पे दिग्गजा विष्णुमव्ययम् || 41 ||
text_mt:
you will certainly obtain the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.
There, in an earlier cosmic age, the world-elephants worshipped Viṣṇu the imperishable || 41

sanskrit_iast:
kasyacidgirivaryasya śikhare paryapūjayan |
teṣāmāvirabhūddevaḥ karuṇāvaruṇālayaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
कस्यचिद्गिरिवर्यस्य शिखरे पर्यपूजयन् |
तेषामाविरभूद्देवः करुणावरुणालयः || 42 ||
text_mt:
upon the peak of a certain excellent mountain;
to them the God appeared, an ocean of compassion, || 42

sanskrit_iast:
kamalākāmukaḥ kāntavigrahaḥ kañjalocanaḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti śailendro yayau karigiriprathām || 43 ||
meaning:
कमलाकामुकः कान्तविग्रहः कञ्जलोचनः |
ततः प्रभृति शैलेन्द्रो ययौ करिगिरिप्रथाम् || 43 ||
text_mt:
the lover of Kamalā, of radiant form, with lotus-eyes.
From that time forward, that lord of mountains gained the renown of Karigiri. || 43

sanskrit_iast:
p. 11) tameva vedikāṃ kṛtvā vājimedhena taṃ yaja |
lakṣmīvallabhakāruṇyavīkṣāvaibhavato mahān || 44 ||
meaning:
प्. 11) तमेव वेदिकां कृत्वा वाजिमेधेन तं यज |
लक्ष्मीवल्लभकारुण्यवीक्षावैभवतो महान् || 44 ||
text_mt:
Having made that very [mountain] your sacrificial altar, sacrifice to Him with a horse sacrifice!
By the majesty of the compassionate glance of the Beloved of Lakṣmī, you will become great, || 44

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaḥ kṛtārtho vimalo bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ |
iti vāṇīṃ samākarṇya viriñco hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
धन्यः कृतार्थो विमलो भविष्यसि न संशयः |
इति वाणीं समाकर्ण्य विरिञ्चो हृष्टमानसः || 45 ||
text_mt:
blessed, your purpose fulfilled, and stainless—there is no doubt."
Having heard this voice, Viriñci, joyful in his heart, || 45

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraṃ satyavrataṃ puṇyaṃ tvaritaṃ samupāgamat |
tvaṣṭrā hastigireḥ śṛṅgaṃ ṭaṅkaiḥ santakṣya śobhanām || 46 ||
meaning:
क्षेत्रं सत्यव्रतं पुण्यं त्वरितं समुपागमत् |
त्वष्ट्रा हस्तिगिरेः शृङ्गं टङ्कैः सन्तक्ष्य शोभनाम् || 46 ||
text_mt:
hastily went to that holy site Satyavrata.
Having chiselled the peak of Hastigiri with adzes through Tvaṣṭṛ, || 46

sanskrit_iast:
yāgārhāṃ yajamāno'yaṃ yāgavedīmakalpayat |
yathāśāstraṃ ca lakṣmīśaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam || 47 ||
meaning:
यागार्हां यजमानोऽयं यागवेदीमकल्पयत् |
यथाशास्त्रं च लक्ष्मीशं सर्वकारणकारणम् || 47 ||
text_mt:
this sacrificer fashioned a beautiful sacrificial altar fit for sacrifice.
And according to scripture, the Unborn One sacrificed to the Lord of Lakṣmī, || 47

sanskrit_iast:
īje'jo vājimedhena yāgānāmuttamena saḥ |
tatra sarveṣu mantreṣu tattaddaivatanāmabhiḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
ईजेऽजो वाजिमेधेन यागानामुत्तमेन सः |
तत्र सर्वेषु मन्त्रेषु तत्तद्दैवतनामभिः || 48 ||
text_mt:
the Cause of all causes, with the horse sacrifice, the best of sacrifices.
There, in all the mantras with the names of the respective deities, || 48

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhyamāneṣu dhātā'yaṃ devadevaṃ ramāpatim |
hṛdaye samanudhyāyaṃstasmai sarvaṃ havirhutam || 49 ||
meaning:
पठ्यमानेषु धाताऽयं देवदेवं रमापतिम् |
हृदये समनुध्यायंस्तस्मै सर्वं हविर्हुतम् || 49 ||
text_mt:
being recited, this Creator, meditating in his heart
upon the God of gods, the consort of Ramā, offering to him all the oblation poured in sacrifice || 49

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā samarpayannetadalameko'pi veditum |
sarvameva havirdevaḥ puṇḍarīkekṣaṇo hariḥ || 50 ||
meaning:
भक्त्या समर्पयन्नेतदलमेकोऽपि वेदितुम् |
सर्वमेव हविर्देवः पुण्डरीकेक्षणो हरिः || 50 ||
text_mt:
with devotion, was alone sufficient to know this.
Every single oblation the god Hari, the Lotus-Eyed One, || 50

sanskrit_iast:
svayameva samādāya samāsvādayadādarāt |
svān svān bhāgānparīkḷptānkāleṣvanadhigacchatām || 51 ||
meaning:
स्वयमेव समादाय समास्वादयदादरात् |
स्वान् स्वान् भागान्परीकॢप्तान्कालेष्वनधिगच्छताम् || 51 ||
text_mt:
took up himself and tasted with respect.
When they did not receive their own portions that had been allotted at the appointed times, || 51

sanskrit_iast:
unmukhānāṃ vañcitānāṃ devānāṃ kṣubhitaṃ manaḥ |
brahmāṇamatha te sarve samāgatyānvayuñjata || 52 ||
meaning:
उन्मुखानां वञ्चितानां देवानां क्षुभितं मनः |
ब्रह्माणमथ ते सर्वे समागत्यान्वयुञ्जत || 52 ||
text_mt:
the minds of the expectant, cheated gods were agitated.
Then they all came together and questioned Brahmā: || 52

sanskrit_iast:
kimidaṃ vartate mohaḥ kṣobhitā vañcirā? vayam |
brahmā tu smayamānastān sāṃtvapūrvamabodhayat || 53 ||
meaning:
किमिदं वर्तते मोहः क्षोभिता वञ्चिरा? वयम् |
ब्रह्मा तु स्मयमानस्तान् सांत्वपूर्वमबोधयत् || 53 ||
text_mt:
“What delusion is this taking place? We have been agitated and cheated!”
Brahmā, however, smiling, consoled them first and instructed them: || 53

sanskrit_iast:
devā mayā purā sṛṣṭāḥ sraṣṭā'haṃ bhavatāṃ pitā |
kimetadyatpitā putrānupāstāṃ vinayāditi || 54 ||
meaning:
देवा मया पुरा सृष्टाः स्रष्टाऽहं भवतां पिता |
किमेतद्यत्पिता पुत्रानुपास्तां विनयादिति || 54 ||
text_mt:
“The gods were created of old by me; I am the creator, your father.
What is this, that a father should serve his sons out of humility? || 54

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāramārganiṣṇātaistattatphalamabhīpsubhiḥ |
yūyamārādhanīyā hi tadarthamadhikāritāḥ || 55 ||
meaning:
संसारमार्गनिष्णातैस्तत्तत्फलमभीप्सुभिः |
यूयमाराधनीया हि तदर्थमधिकारिताः || 55 ||
text_mt:
By those steeped in the path of transmigratory existence, desiring various fruits,
you are indeed to be worshipped; for that purpose you have been appointed to office. || 55

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāntarātmā sarveśo mama cāpi pitā hariḥ |
kamalāvallabho devastamevoddiśya hūyate || 56 ||
meaning:
सर्वान्तरात्मा सर्वेशो मम चापि पिता हरिः |
कमलावल्लभो देवस्तमेवोद्दिश्य हूयते || 56 ||
text_mt:
The inner self of all, the lord of all, and my father too, Hari,
the god who is the beloved of Kamalā—directed solely to him is the offering made. || 56

sanskrit_iast:
iha sarvaṃ haviryajñe nāmamātraṃ tu mantragam |
bhavatāṃ tattadarthastu bhagavān kamalāpatiḥ || 57 ||
meaning:
इह सर्वं हविर्यज्ञे नाममात्रं तु मन्त्रगम् |
भवतां तत्तदर्थस्तु भगवान् कमलापतिः || 57 ||
text_mt:
In this sacrifice, every oblation belongs only in name, within the mantra,
to you; but its true meaning is the blessed Lord, the consort of Kamalā. || 57

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ madyajñasārasya dhoraṇī sāramādhurī |
paramaikāntināṃ nṝṇāmapyeṣaiva nibodhata || 58 ||
meaning:
इयं मद्यज्ञसारस्य धोरणी सारमाधुरी |
परमैकान्तिनां नॄणामप्येषैव निबोधत || 58 ||
text_mt:
This is the continuous flow of the essence of my sacrifice, the sweetness of its core;
understand that this alone is [the way] even for men of absolute, single-minded devotion.” || 58

sanskrit_iast:
p. 12) iti saṃbodhitā devā gatakṣobhāḥ prajāpatim |
sārārthāvagamāttuṣṭāḥ sādhu sādhvityapūjayan || 59 ||
meaning:
प्. 12) इति संबोधिता देवा गतक्षोभाः प्रजापतिम् |
सारार्थावगमात्तुष्टाः साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन् || 59 ||
text_mt:
Thus instructed, the gods, their agitation gone, pleased
with Prajāpati by understanding the essential meaning, praised him: “Excellent, excellent!” || 59

sanskrit_iast:
śreyasāṃ kila kāryāṇāṃ pratyūhānāṃ śataṃ śatam |
tathā tatra mahāyajñe vighnānāṃ śatamutthitam || 60 ||
meaning:
श्रेयसां किल कार्याणां प्रत्यूहानां शतं शतम् |
तथा तत्र महायज्ञे विघ्नानां शतमुत्थितम् || 60 ||
text_mt:
For good undertakings, indeed, there are hundreds upon hundreds of obstacles;
likewise, a hundred hindrances arose in that great sacrifice. || 60

sanskrit_iast:
devadevo ramānāthaḥ kṛpayā parayā mudā |
sarvānpraśamayāmāsa pratyūhān samupasthitān || 61 ||
meaning:
देवदेवो रमानाथः कृपया परया मुदा |
सर्वान्प्रशमयामास प्रत्यूहान् समुपस्थितान् || 61 ||
text_mt:
The God of gods, the lord of Ramā, with supreme grace and joy,
pacified all the obstacles that had presented themselves. || 61

sanskrit_iast:
atha kāle bahuguṇe vapāhomocite tadā |
āvirāsannimittāni manohārīṇi sarvaśaḥ || 62 ||
meaning:
अथ काले बहुगुणे वपाहोमोचिते तदा |
आविरासन्निमित्तानि मनोहारीणि सर्वशः || 62 ||
text_mt:
Then, at that auspicious time suitable for the offering of the omentum,
charming omens appeared on every side. || 62

sanskrit_iast:
meṣamāse site pakṣe caturdaśatame tithau |
śobhane hastanakṣatre ravivāreṇa saṃyute || 63 ||
meaning:
मेषमासे सिते पक्षे चतुर्दशतमे तिथौ |
शोभने हस्तनक्षत्रे रविवारेण संयुते || 63 ||
text_mt:
In the month of Meṣa, in the bright fortnight, on the fourteenth lunar day,
under the auspicious asterism Hasta, conjoined with a Sunday, || 63

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ savanakālīne vapāhome samāpite |
tāṃ vapāmadhare hṛhṇannagnerāvirabhūddhariḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
प्रातः सवनकालीने वपाहोमे समापिते |
तां वपामधरे हृह्णन्नग्नेराविरभूद्धरिः || 64 ||
text_mt:
at the time of the morning pressing, when the offering of the omentum was completed,
Hari appeared from the fire, accepting that omentum in his lower [hand], || 64

sanskrit_iast:
sūryakoṭipratīkāśe taptakārtasvarojvale |
vimāne puṇyakoṭyākhye śrībhūmisahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 65 ||
meaning:
सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशे तप्तकार्तस्वरोज्वले |
विमाने पुण्यकोट्याख्ये श्रीभूमिसहितः प्रभुः || 65 ||
text_mt:
resembling ten million suns, radiant as molten gold,
in the aerial chariot named Puṇyakoṭi, accompanied by Śrī and Bhūmi, the Master, || 65

sanskrit_iast:
paścimābhimukho dīptakirīṭamakuṭojjvalaḥ |
ūrdhvapuṇḍrollasatphālapaṭṭo rājīvalocanaḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
पश्चिमाभिमुखो दीप्तकिरीटमकुटोज्ज्वलः |
ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रोल्लसत्फालपट्टो राजीवलोचनः || 66 ||
text_mt:
facing west, radiant with a blazing diadem and crown,
his forehead-plate shining with an upright sectarian mark, lotus-eyed, || 66

sanskrit_iast:
tilaprasūnasaubhāgyanāsākalpalatānvitaḥ |
pravālakhaṇḍasuṣamāmoṣadakṣādharoṣṭhavān || 67 ||
meaning:
तिलप्रसूनसौभाग्यनासाकल्पलतान्वितः |
प्रवालखण्डसुषमामोषदक्षाधरोष्ठवान् || 67 ||
text_mt:
endowed with a wish-granting creeper of a nose having the beauty of a sesame flower,
possessing a lower lip that robs the loveliness of a piece of coral, || 67

sanskrit_iast:
kambugambhīrakaṇṭhāntarlambikaustubhavibhramaḥ |
śrīvatsavakṣā hāraśrīśobhamānabhujāntaraḥ || 68 ||
meaning:
कम्बुगम्भीरकण्ठान्तर्लम्बिकौस्तुभविभ्रमः |
श्रीवत्सवक्षा हारश्रीशोभमानभुजान्तरः || 68 ||
text_mt:
having the charm of the Kaustubha jewel hanging within a neck deep as a conch,
his chest marked with the Śrīvatsa, the expanse of his chest gleaming with the splendor of necklaces, || 68

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāyudhollasadbāhucatuṣṭayamanoharaḥ |
sapadmena kareṇoccairvahannabhayamudrikām || 69 ||
meaning:
पञ्चायुधोल्लसद्बाहुचतुष्टयमनोहरः |
सपद्मेन करेणोच्चैर्वहन्नभयमुद्रिकाम् || 69 ||
text_mt:
captivating with four arms resplendent with the five weapons,
holding aloft the hand-gesture of fearlessness with a lotus-bearing hand, || 69

sanskrit_iast:
gadāṃ cāpaṃ ca vāmena pāṇinā paribhūṣayan |
kaṭibandhe dharindivyaṃ naṃdakaṃ khaḍgamuttamam || 70 ||
meaning:
गदां चापं च वामेन पाणिना परिभूषयन् |
कटिबन्धे धरिन्दिव्यं नंदकं खड्गमुत्तमम् || 70 ||
text_mt:
adorning the mace and the bow with his left hand,
bearing the divine, excellent sword Nandaka at his waist-band, || 70

sanskrit_iast:
pītāmbaralasannābhigahvarojvalavihvalaḥ (grahaḥ ?) |
kāmārāmīyakadalīkelīcororubhāsvaraḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
पीताम्बरलसन्नाभिगह्वरोज्वलविह्वलः (ग्रहः ?) |
कामारामीयकदलीकेलीचोरोरुभास्वरः || 71 ||
text_mt:
shining with the radiance of his navel cavity gleaming above his yellow garment,
splendid with thighs that steal the playfulness of the plantain trees in Kāma's garden, || 71

sanskrit_iast:
mukurākārajānūtthalāvaṇyaprasarādbhutaḥ |
kalācikārucispardhijaṅghādvitayasundaraḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
मुकुराकारजानूत्थलावण्यप्रसराद्भुतः |
कलाचिकारुचिस्पर्धिजङ्घाद्वितयसुन्दरः || 72 ||
text_mt:
wondrous with the flow of loveliness arising from knees shaped like mirrors,
beautiful with a pair of shanks rivaling the luster of a fore-arm, || 72

sanskrit_iast:
padmasaubhāgyasarvasvahāripādamanoharaḥ |
karuṇārasapūrṇābhyāmīkṣaṇābhyāṃ caturmukham || 73 ||
meaning:
पद्मसौभाग्यसर्वस्वहारिपादमनोहरः |
करुणारसपूर्णाभ्यामीक्षणाभ्यां चतुर्मुखम् || 73 ||
text_mt:
enchanting with feet that steal all the beauty of the lotus,
with eyes filled with the sentiment of compassion [looking upon] the Four-Faced One, || 73

sanskrit_iast:
p. 13) ādarādanugṛhṇānaḥ smitāñcadadharāntikaḥ |
evaṃ svayamudāttena rūpayauvanaśobhinā || 74 ||
meaning:
प्. 13) आदरादनुगृह्णानः स्मिताञ्चदधरान्तिकः |
एवं स्वयमुदात्तेन रूपयौवनशोभिना || 74 ||
text_mt:
graciously favoring him with respect, his lower lip touched by a smile—
serving the god thus arisen in person with a noble || 74

sanskrit_iast:
vigraheṇoditaṃ devaṃ ramākāntaṃ jagatpatim |
āsevya sarve saṃhṛṣṭāḥ kṛtārthanayanodayāḥ || 75 ||
meaning:
विग्रहेणोदितं देवं रमाकान्तं जगत्पतिम् |
आसेव्य सर्वे संहृष्टाः कृतार्थनयनोदयाः || 75 ||
text_mt:
form, shining with beauty and youth, the beloved of Ramā, the Lord of the world,
all were overjoyed, the purpose of their eyes accomplished, || 75

sanskrit_iast:
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyamityuccairudaghoṣayan |
caturmukho'pi nayanairaṣṭābhirdevamacyutam || 76 ||
meaning:
अहो भाग्यमहो भाग्यमित्युच्चैरुदघोषयन् |
चतुर्मुखोऽपि नयनैरष्टाभिर्देवमच्युतम् || 76 ||
text_mt:
and loudly proclaimed: “O fortune, o fortune!”
The Four-Faced One also, with eight eyes, served the god Acyuta, || 76

sanskrit_iast:
praṇatārtiharaṃ nāthaṃ varadaṃ samasevata |
saharṣasaṃprabho nānāceṣṭāstāstāḥ svayaṃ caran || 77 ||
meaning:
प्रणतार्तिहरं नाथं वरदं समसेवत |
सहर्षसंप्रभो नानाचेष्टास्तास्ताः स्वयं चरन् || 77 ||
text_mt:
the Lord who removes the distress of those who bow down, Varada,
filled with joy and radiance, himself performing various acts of service. || 77

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa śāntasaṃrambho devo nābhipracoditaḥ |
vatsa satyavratakṣetramāhātmyaṃ paśya padmaja || 78 ||
meaning:
क्रमेण शान्तसंरम्भो देवो नाभिप्रचोदितः |
वत्स सत्यव्रतक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं पश्य पद्मज || 78 ||
text_mt:
Gradually, his excitement subsided, and the God, prompted from the navel, [said]:
“Child, Lotus-Born One, behold the greatness of the Satyavrata site! || 78

sanskrit_iast:
ekena hayamedhena sahasrasya phalaṃ tvayā |
kāṃkṣitaṃ tena cittasya śuddhistena ca cetasaḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
एकेन हयमेधेन सहस्रस्य फलं त्वया |
कांक्षितं तेन चित्तस्य शुद्धिस्तेन च चेतसः || 79 ||
text_mt:
By a single horse sacrifice, the fruit of a thousand [sacrifices]
was desired by you, and thereby purity of the mind, and thereby || 79

sanskrit_iast:
sthairyaṃ tena ca niṣpattirdhyānasyetīpsitaṃ tvayā |
ante pratīkṣitaṃ yatte phalaṃ parvakramātkila || 80 ||
meaning:
स्थैर्यं तेन च निष्पत्तिर्ध्यानस्येतीप्सितं त्वया |
अन्ते प्रतीक्षितं यत्ते फलं पर्वक्रमात्किल || 80 ||
text_mt:
steadiness of the mind, and thereby the accomplishment of meditation—this was sought by you.
The fruit which was expected by you at the end through the sequence of rites, || 80

sanskrit_iast:
prathame parvaṇi prāptaṃ sukhenaiva prajāpate |
prasanno'smi tavānena hayamedhena suvrata || 81 ||
meaning:
प्रथमे पर्वणि प्राप्तं सुखेनैव प्रजापते |
प्रसन्नोऽस्मि तवानेन हयमेधेन सुव्रत || 81 ||
text_mt:
has been obtained with ease at the very first rite, O Prajāpati.
I am pleased, O one of noble vows, with this horse sacrifice of yours. || 81

sanskrit_iast:
vapāraso'yaṃ madhuro mama hṛdyo mano'harat |
pāramaikāntisaurabhyasārāmṛtamanoharā || 82 ||
meaning:
वपारसोऽयं मधुरो मम हृद्यो मनोऽहरत् |
पारमैकान्तिसौरभ्यसारामृतमनोहरा || 82 ||
text_mt:
This sweet essence of the omentum has delighted my heart and captivated my mind.
Enchanting with the nectarous essence of the fragrance of absolute devotion, || 82

sanskrit_iast:
vapeyaṃ sarvabhakṣyebhyo mama prītikarī sadā |
varaṃ varaya tasmāttvaṃ yathā'bhimatamātmanaḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
वपेयं सर्वभक्ष्येभ्यो मम प्रीतिकरी सदा |
वरं वरय तस्मात्त्वं यथाऽभिमतमात्मनः || 83 ||
text_mt:
this omentum brings me more pleasure at all times than all [other] eatables.
Therefore, choose a boon according to your heart's desire. || 83

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ saṃpatsyate puṃsāṃ mayi dṛṣṭipathaṃ gate |
iti devena saṃdiṣṭaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ paramārthavit || 84 ||
meaning:
सर्वं संपत्स्यते पुंसां मयि दृष्टिपथं गते |
इति देवेन संदिष्टः प्रहृष्टः परमार्थवित् || 84 ||
text_mt:
Everything will be attained by men when I have come into their range of vision.”
Thus instructed by the God, rejoicing, the knower of the highest truth, || 84

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā praṇamya bahuśaḥ stutvā ca prārthayadvibhum |
vaikuṇṭhe tu yathā loke yathaiva kṣīrasāgare || 85 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मा प्रणम्य बहुशः स्तुत्वा च प्रार्थयद्विभुम् |
वैकुण्ठे तु यथा लोके यथैव क्षीरसागरे || 85 ||
text_mt:
Brahmā, having bowed down many times and praised the All-Pervading One, requested:
“Just as in the world of Vaikuṇṭha, and just as in the ocean of milk, || 85

sanskrit_iast:
tathā satyavratakṣetre nivāsaste bhavediha |
hastiśailasya śikhare sarvalokanamaskṛte || 86 ||
meaning:
तथा सत्यव्रतक्षेत्रे निवासस्ते भवेदिह |
हस्तिशैलस्य शिखरे सर्वलोकनमस्कृते || 86 ||
text_mt:
so may your residence be here in the Satyavrata site,
upon the peak of Hastiśaila, reverenced by all the worlds! || 86

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakoṭivimāne'smin paśyantu tvāṃ narāssadā |
iti saṃprārthito devo bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
पुण्यकोटिविमानेऽस्मिन् पश्यन्तु त्वां नरास्सदा |
इति संप्रार्थितो देवो भगवान् भक्तवत्सलः || 87 ||
text_mt:
May men always see you in this Puṇyakoṭi aerial chariot!”
Thus petitioned, the blessed God, affectionate to his devotees, || 87

sanskrit_iast:
hitāya sarvalokānāṃ tathā'stvityanvamodata |
tasmin kṛtayuge brahmā devadevamadhokṣajam || 88 ||
meaning:
हिताय सर्वलोकानां तथाऽस्त्वित्यन्वमोदत |
तस्मिन् कृतयुगे ब्रह्मा देवदेवमधोक्षजम् || 88 ||
text_mt:
assented, saying: “So be it,” for the benefit of all the worlds.
In that Kṛta age, Brahmā personally worshipped || 88

sanskrit_iast:
p. 14) svayaṃ tenaiva rūpeṇa samārādhayadacyutam |
mahāśāntagajendro'tha tretāyāṃ harimārcayat || 89 ||
meaning:
प्. 14) स्वयं तेनैव रूपेण समाराधयदच्युतम् |
महाशान्तगजेन्द्रोऽथ त्रेतायां हरिमार्चयत् || 89 ||
text_mt:
the God of gods, Adhokṣaja, Acyuta, in that very form.
Then, in the Tretā age, the great and peaceful lord of elephants worshipped Hari || 89

sanskrit_iast:
svakarāgroddhṛtaiḥ padmairatha grāheṇa pīḍitaḥ |
śaraṇāgatimādhāya varadena vimocitaḥ || 90 ||
meaning:
स्वकराग्रोद्धृतैः पद्मैरथ ग्राहेण पीडितः |
शरणागतिमाधाय वरदेन विमोचितः || 90 ||
text_mt:
with lotuses raised by the tip of his trunk. Then, afflicted by an alligator,
having taken refuge, he was liberated by Varada; || 90

sanskrit_iast:
hariṇā dhāma ninye svaṃ vāhanena garutmatā |
atha dvāparasaṃjñe tu yuge devaguruḥ svayam || 91 ||
meaning:
हरिणा धाम निन्ये स्वं वाहनेन गरुत्मता |
अथ द्वापरसंज्ञे तु युगे देवगुरुः स्वयम् || 91 ||
text_mt:
he was taken by Hari to his own abode on his mount, Garutmat.
Then, in the age known as Dvāpara, the preceptor of the gods himself, || 91

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya varadaṃ devaṃ svābhīṣṭāṃ siddhimāpnuta |
tataḥ kaliyugasyādau brahmāṇaṃ varado'bravīt || 92 ||
meaning:
आराध्य वरदं देवं स्वाभीष्टां सिद्धिमाप्नुत |
ततः कलियुगस्यादौ ब्रह्माणं वरदोऽब्रवीत् || 92 ||
text_mt:
having worshipped the god Varada, attained his desired attainment.
Then, at the beginning of the Kali age, Varada said to Brahmā, || 92

sanskrit_iast:
parāmṛśan jagatsarvaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā |
kālo'yaṃ kalirāyātaḥ sarve svārthaparā janāḥ || 93 ||
meaning:
परामृशन् जगत्सर्वं प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना |
कालोऽयं कलिरायातः सर्वे स्वार्थपरा जनाः || 93 ||
text_mt:
surveying the entire world with a joyful inner self:
“This Kali age has arrived; all people are intent on their own selfish ends. || 93

sanskrit_iast:
na ko'pi tattvato bhakto drakṣyate kālaviplavāt |
ayute vā parārdhe vā yadi ko'pi ca tādṛśaḥ || 94 ||
meaning:
न कोऽपि तत्त्वतो भक्तो द्रक्ष्यते कालविप्लवात् |
अयुते वा परार्धे वा यदि कोऽपि च तादृशः || 94 ||
text_mt:
No one will be seen as a devotee in truth, due to the corruption of the age—
or if there is anyone of such a kind in ten thousand or in a trillion, || 94

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhāvyate guṇotkṛṣṭaṃ na taṃ loko'numaṃsyate |
doṣānāropayetkaścinmatsarāttasya mūrddhani || 95 ||
meaning:
संभाव्यते गुणोत्कृष्टं न तं लोकोऽनुमंस्यते |
दोषानारोपयेत्कश्चिन्मत्सरात्तस्य मूर्द्धनि || 95 ||
text_mt:
is considered distinguished by virtues, people will not acknowledge him;
out of envy, someone will heap faults upon his head. || 95

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tathaiveti sarve'nye dhoṣayiṣyanti sarvaśaḥ |
ante tasyāpi nairāśyāccyutireva manogateḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
तं तथैवेति सर्वेऽन्ये धोषयिष्यन्ति सर्वशः |
अन्ते तस्यापि नैराश्याच्च्युतिरेव मनोगतेः || 96 ||
text_mt:
All the others will proclaim everywhere, “It is just so!”
In the end, from despair, his very inner resolve will fall away. || 96

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyati tathā nāma kālo'yaṃ kalirūrjitaḥ |
ato na rocate vatsa hastiśailasya mūrdhani || 97 ||
meaning:
भविष्यति तथा नाम कालोऽयं कलिरूर्जितः |
अतो न रोचते वत्स हस्तिशैलस्य मूर्धनि || 97 ||
text_mt:
So indeed will this mighty Kali age be;
therefore, dear child, it does not please me to dwell here on the summit of Hastiśaila || 97

sanskrit_iast:
divyenānena rūpeṇa vastuṃ kāle kalāviha |
pratijñātaṃ ca kalpāntamavasthānamihaiva me || 98 ||
meaning:
दिव्येनानेन रूपेण वस्तुं काले कलाविह |
प्रतिज्ञातं च कल्पान्तमवस्थानमिहैव मे || 98 ||
text_mt:
in this divine form, in the Kali age.
Yet my dwelling here until the end of the kalpa was promised. || 98

sanskrit_iast:
ato'tra kriyatāmevamahaṃ tvāmanumānayet |
varado'haṃ vidhe bhaktajanānāṃ karuṇākaraḥ || 99 ||
meaning:
अतोऽत्र क्रियतामेवमहं त्वामनुमानयेत् |
वरदोऽहं विधे भक्तजनानां करुणाकरः || 99 ||
text_mt:
Therefore let it be done here in this manner; I shall direct you.
I am Varada, O Brahmā, a mine of compassion for devoted people. || 99

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ sthalamidaṃ puṇyaṃ tyāgamaṇṭapamucyatām |
yogamaṇṭapasaṃjñātu śrīraṅgasya mayā kṛtā || 100 ||
meaning:
अतः स्थलमिदं पुण्यं त्यागमण्टपमुच्यताम् |
योगमण्टपसंज्ञातु श्रीरङ्गस्य मया कृता || 100 ||
text_mt:
Therefore let this sacred place be called the Pavilion of Renunciation (tyāgamaṇṭapa);
for the designation ‘Pavilion of Yoga’ (yogamaṇṭapa) was given by me to Śrīraṅga. || 100

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpamaṇṭapamityākhyā veṅkaṭādervirājatām |
anyadyadugiristhānaṃ vidyāmaṇṭapamucyatām || 101 ||
meaning:
पुष्पमण्टपमित्याख्या वेङ्कटादेर्विराजताम् |
अन्यद्यदुगिरिस्थानं विद्यामण्टपमुच्यताम् || 101 ||
text_mt:
Let the name ‘Pavilion of Flowers’ (puṣpamaṇṭapa) shine for Veṅkaṭa and the like;
let the other place, Yadugiri, be called the Pavilion of Knowledge (vidyāmaṇṭapa). || 101

sanskrit_iast:
sarvottamamidaṃ puṇyaṃ kṣetraṃ sthānaṃ ca śobhanam |
mama prītikaraṃ divyaṃ muktikṣetreṣu cottamam || 102 ||
meaning:
सर्वोत्तममिदं पुण्यं क्षेत्रं स्थानं च शोभनम् |
मम प्रीतिकरं दिव्यं मुक्तिक्षेत्रेषु चोत्तमम् || 102 ||
text_mt:
This sacred site and beautiful place is the best of all,
giving me delight, divine, and the best among places of liberation. || 102

sanskrit_iast:
naitasya sadṛśaṃ kiñcit kṣetraṃ vā tīrthameva vā |
ato madājñayā brahman ālayo'tra vidhīyatām || 103 ||
meaning:
नैतस्य सदृशं किञ्चित् क्षेत्रं वा तीर्थमेव वा |
अतो मदाज्ञया ब्रह्मन् आलयोऽत्र विधीयताम् || 103 ||
text_mt:
There is no sacred site or sacred bathing place equal to this;
therefore, by my command, O Brahmā, let a temple be constructed here. || 103

sanskrit_iast:
p. 15) sarvamantrasvarūpatvāt sarvebhyo'bhyadhiko bhuvi |
saṃsthānasyālayasyāsya svarūpaṃ paramārthataḥ || 104 ||
meaning:
प्. 15) सर्वमन्त्रस्वरूपत्वात् सर्वेभ्योऽभ्यधिको भुवि |
संस्थानस्यालयस्यास्य स्वरूपं परमार्थतः || 104 ||
text_mt:
Because it consists of all mantras, it is superior to all on earth.
In the highest reality, the essential nature of this holy seat and temple || 104

sanskrit_iast:
na vettuṃ prabhavedanyo madīkṣāvīkṣitānnarāt |
kālikālocitāṃ rītimāśritya manasā mayā || 105 ||
meaning:
न वेत्तुं प्रभवेदन्यो मदीक्षावीक्षितान्नरात् |
कालिकालोचितां रीतिमाश्रित्य मनसा मया || 105 ||
text_mt:
no one can know except a man initiated through my initiation.
Adopting mentally the procedure appropriate for the [present] age, || 105

sanskrit_iast:
pāñcarātrāhvayaṃ tantraṃ yathāvadavatāritam |
taduktena prakāreṇa mūlakarmotsavāśrayāḥ || 106 ||
meaning:
पाञ्चरात्राह्वयं तन्त्रं यथावदवतारितम् |
तदुक्तेन प्रकारेण मूलकर्मोत्सवाश्रयाः || 106 ||
text_mt:
the tantra named Pāñcarātra was duly brought down by me.
According to the manner taught therein, taking resort to the primary rites and festivals, || 106

sanskrit_iast:
tisro mūrtiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya pūjanaṃ pratipādaya |
balyarcā ca vidhānena sādaraṃ parikalpyatām || 107 ||
meaning:
तिस्रो मूर्तिः प्रतिष्ठाप्य पूजनं प्रतिपादय |
बल्यर्चा च विधानेन सादरं परिकल्प्यताम् || 107 ||
text_mt:
install three icons and carry out the worship,
and let an icon for daily offerings (balyarcā) be respectfully prepared according to the rules. || 107

sanskrit_iast:
ratneṣu triṣvapi śreṣṭhaṃ jayākhyaṃ tantramucyate |
taduktena vidhānena pratiṣṭhādi pravartyatām || 108 ||
meaning:
रत्नेषु त्रिष्वपि श्रेष्ठं जयाख्यं तन्त्रमुच्यते |
तदुक्तेन विधानेन प्रतिष्ठादि प्रवर्त्यताम् || 108 ||
text_mt:
Among the three gems, the tantra named Jayākhya is declared the best;
according to the procedure taught in it, let the installation and other rites be carried out. || 108

sanskrit_iast:
kāṇvīṃ śākhāmadhīyānāvaupagāyanakauśikau |
prapattiśāstraniṣṇātau svaniṣṭhāniṣṭhitāvubhau || 109 ||
meaning:
काण्वीं शाखामधीयानावौपगायनकौशिकौ |
प्रपत्तिशास्त्रनिष्णातौ स्वनिष्ठानिष्ठितावुभौ || 109 ||
text_mt:
Aupagāyana and Kauśika, who study the Kāṇva recension,
who are steeped in the scripture of surrender, both steadfast in their own discipline— || 109

sanskrit_iast:
jayākhyatantramārgeṇa dīkṣayitvā'bjamaṇḍale |
ācāryake cābhiṣicya tābhyāṃ pūjāṃ prakalpaya || 110 ||
meaning:
जयाख्यतन्त्रमार्गेण दीक्षयित्वाऽब्जमण्डले |
आचार्यके चाभिषिच्य ताभ्यां पूजां प्रकल्पय || 110 ||
text_mt:
having initiated them in the lotus diagram according to the path of the Jayākhya tantra,
and having consecrated them to the office of preceptor, assign the worship through them. || 110

sanskrit_iast:
tadgotrasaṃbhavā eva kalpāntaṃ pūjayantu mām |
jayākhyenātha pādmena tantreṇa sahitena vai || 111 ||
meaning:
तद्गोत्रसंभवा एव कल्पान्तं पूजयन्तु माम् |
जयाख्येनाथ पाद्मेन तन्त्रेण सहितेन वै || 111 ||
text_mt:
Only those born of their lineages shall worship me until the end of the kalpa,
by means of the Jayākhya together with the Pādma tantra. || 111

sanskrit_iast:
mūlavyākhyānarūpābhyāṃ samarcayatu māṃ sadā |
na tantrasaṅkaro doṣastantrayoranayoriha || 112 ||
meaning:
मूलव्याख्यानरूपाभ्यां समर्चयतु मां सदा |
न तन्त्रसङ्करो दोषस्तन्त्रयोरनयोरिह || 112 ||
text_mt:
Let them always worship me through these two which have the nature of root text and commentary;
there is no defect of mixing tantras in the case of these two tantras here. || 112

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryake tathā'rtvijye pūjane vā mamābjaja |
tāvetau gotriṇau mukhyau mama prītikarau matau || 113 ||
meaning:
आचार्यके तथाऽर्त्विज्ये पूजने वा ममाब्जज |
तावेतौ गोत्रिणौ मुख्यौ मम प्रीतिकरौ मतौ || 113 ||
text_mt:
In the preceptor's office, likewise in the priesthood and in my worship, O Lotus-born,
these two lineage-holders are considered primary and pleasing to me. || 113

sanskrit_iast:
paricaryāsu tattāsu yogyānnirṇīya cetasā |
dīkṣayitvā ca te tatra niyujyantāṃ yathāvidhi || 114 ||
meaning:
परिचर्यासु तत्तासु योग्यान्निर्णीय चेतसा |
दीक्षयित्वा च ते तत्र नियुज्यन्तां यथाविधि || 114 ||
text_mt:
Having determined in mind those who are fit for those various services,
and having initiated them, let them be appointed there according to rule. || 114

sanskrit_iast:
atrādhikāre ubhayostayoreva kulīnayoḥ |
śāṇḍilyaśca bharadvājo munirmauñjāyanastathā || 115 ||
meaning:
अत्राधिकारे उभयोस्तयोरेव कुलीनयोः |
शाण्डिल्यश्च भरद्वाजो मुनिर्मौञ्जायनस्तथा || 115 ||
text_mt:
With respect to this authority belonging to those two well-born ones,
Śāṇḍilya, Bharadvāja, and the sage Mauñjāyana, || 115

sanskrit_iast:
imau ca pañcagotrasthā mukhyāḥ kāṇvīmupāśritāḥ |
śrīprāñcarātratantrīye sarve'smin mama karmaṇi || 116 ||
meaning:
इमौ च पञ्चगोत्रस्था मुख्याः काण्वीमुपाश्रिताः |
श्रीप्राञ्चरात्रतन्त्रीये सर्वेऽस्मिन् मम कर्मणि || 116 ||
text_mt:
and these two—members of the five gotras adhering to the Kāṇva [branch]—
are foremost in all this work of mine in the Śrī-Pāñcarātra tantra. || 116

sanskrit_iast:
iha tābhyāṃ ciraṃ vatsa toṣito'smi tapobalāt |
tayorayaṃ varaḥ prītyā prādāyi prārthito mayā || 117 ||
meaning:
इह ताभ्यां चिरं वत्स तोषितोऽस्मि तपोबलात् |
तयोरयं वरः प्रीत्या प्रादायि प्रार्थितो मया || 117 ||
text_mt:
Here, dear child, I was pleased by the two of them for a long time through the power of ascetic penance;
this boon, requested of me, has been granted with affection to them. || 117

sanskrit_iast:
mantraiḥ kātīyasūtreṇa nirdiṣṭairvaidikaiḥ saha |
bhagavacchāstrasaṃsiddhairdivyairmantrairvimiśritaiḥ || 118 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रैः कातीयसूत्रेण निर्दिष्टैर्वैदिकैः सह |
भगवच्छास्त्रसंसिद्धैर्दिव्यैर्मन्त्रैर्विमिश्रितैः || 118 ||
text_mt:
With the Vedic mantras taught by the Kātīya-sūtra,
combined with divine mantras perfected in the scripture of the Lord, || 118

sanskrit_iast:
p. 16) garbhādhānādikāḥ sarve saṃskārā nityakarma ca |
naimittikaṃ ca śrāddhādi kartavyaṃ tairatandritaiḥ || 119 ||
meaning:
प्. 16) गर्भाधानादिकाः सर्वे संस्कारा नित्यकर्म च |
नैमित्तिकं च श्राद्धादि कर्तव्यं तैरतन्द्रितैः || 119 ||
text_mt:
all sacraments beginning with conception, daily rites,
and occasional rites such as ancestor offerings (śrāddha) are to be performed by them without indolence. || 119

sanskrit_iast:
ācāreṇaivāmunaivāhaṃ bhavāmi prītimānasaḥ |
śarkarāsahitenaiva kṣīreṇa kamalāsana || 120 ||
meaning:
आचारेणैवामुनैवाहं भवामि प्रीतिमानसः |
शर्करासहितेनैव क्षीरेण कमलासन || 120 ||
text_mt:
By this very practice my mind becomes pleased,
just as with milk accompanied by sugar, O Lotus-seated One! || 120

sanskrit_iast:
pratyabdaṃ caitramāse tu svena rūpeṇa māṃ vibhum |
pūrṇimāyāmihāgatya tvaṃ māmārādhayānagha || 121 ||
meaning:
प्रत्यब्दं चैत्रमासे तु स्वेन रूपेण मां विभुम् |
पूर्णिमायामिहागत्य त्वं मामाराधयानघ || 121 ||
text_mt:
Every year in the month of Caitra, on the full moon,
coming here in your own form, worship me, the All-Pervading One, O sinless one! || 121

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ rātrikāle tu śeṣaḥ phaṇabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
aprākṛtena rūpeṇa māṃ samārādhayiṣyati || 122 ||
meaning:
प्रत्यहं रात्रिकाले तु शेषः फणभृतां वरः |
अप्राकृतेन रूपेण मां समाराधयिष्यति || 122 ||
text_mt:
Every day at night, Śeṣa, the best among serpents,
shall worship me in a non-material form.” || 122

sanskrit_iast:
iti devena saṃdiṣṭaḥ paratantramanā vidhiḥ |
tathiva tatsvayaṃ prītyā niravartayadādarāt || 123 ||
meaning:
इति देवेन संदिष्टः परतन्त्रमना विधिः |
तथिव तत्स्वयं प्रीत्या निरवर्तयदादरात् || 123 ||
text_mt:
Thus instructed by the god, Brahmā, whose mind was devoted to another's will,
himself carried it out with love and reverence just so. || 123

sanskrit_iast:
devāvatārasamaye vimānamatulaprabham |
sarvadevamayaṃ divyamagnimadhyāt samutthitam || 124 ||
meaning:
देवावतारसमये विमानमतुलप्रभम् |
सर्वदेवमयं दिव्यमग्निमध्यात् समुत्थितम् || 124 ||
text_mt:
At the time of the god's descent, a temple tower of unequalled splendor,
composed of all the gods, divine, had arisen from the midst of the fire; || 124

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva devadevasya varadasya nideśataḥ |
bhūtale vāstuvidhinā pratiṣṭhāmadhyagamyata || 125 ||
meaning:
तथैव देवदेवस्य वरदस्य निदेशतः |
भूतले वास्तुविधिना प्रतिष्ठामध्यगम्यत || 125 ||
text_mt:
just so, by the instruction of Varada, the god of gods,
it was consecrated on earth according to the rules of architecture. || 125

sanskrit_iast:
divyālayasya nirmāṇaprakāro viśvakarmaṇe |
devādeśādviriñcena sphuṭamevātyadiśyata || 126 ||
meaning:
दिव्यालयस्य निर्माणप्रकारो विश्वकर्मणे |
देवादेशाद्विरिञ्चेन स्फुटमेवात्यदिश्यत || 126 ||
text_mt:
The method of constructing the divine temple was clearly shown
to Viśvakarman by Brahmā, by the god's command. || 126

sanskrit_iast:
