text_mt: "Tell me the definition of these two, upon which the supreme state depends, // 43cd

sanskrit_iast: vistareṇa jagannātha bhavābdhipatitasya me |
meaning: विस्तरेण जगन्नाथ भवाब्धिपतितस्य मे |
text_mt: in detail, O Lord of the World, for me who have fallen into the ocean of worldly existence." // 44ab

sanskrit_iast: [yamaniyamanirūpaṇam]
meaning: [यमनियमनिरूपणम्]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān-
meaning: श्रीभगवान्-

sanskrit_iast: śucirijyā tapaścaiva svādhyāyaśrutipūrvakaḥ || 44 ||
meaning: शुचिरिज्या तपश्चैव स्वाध्यायश्रुतिपूर्वकः || 44 ||
text_mt: "Purity, worship, and ascetic practice preceded by study and hearing [of scripture], // 44cd

sanskrit_iast:
akrūratā'niṣṭhuratā kṣamā caivānapāyinī |
satyaṃ bhūtahitaṃ caiva yadabādhā pareṣvapi || 45 ||
meaning:
अक्रूरताऽनिष्ठुरता क्षमा चैवानपायिनी |
सत्यं भूतहितं चैव यदबाधा परेष्वपि || 45 ||
text_mt: absence of cruelty, absence of harshness, and unfailing patience, / truthfulness, welfare of living beings, and harmlessness even toward enemies, // 45

sanskrit_iast:
parasvāderahiṃsā ca cetaso damanaṃ mahat |
indriyābhyavahāryāṇāṃ bhogānāmapi cāspṛhā || 46 ||
meaning:
परस्वादेरहिंसा च चेतसो दमनं महत् |
इन्द्रियाभ्यवहार्याणां भोगानामपि चास्पृहा || 46 ||
text_mt: non-injury to others' property and the like, great self-control of the mind, / and lack of desire for objects of enjoyment experienced by the senses, // 46

sanskrit_iast:
āsane śayane mārge asaktiścāpi bhojane |
hṛdgataṃ na tyajeddhyānamānandaphaladaṃ ca yat || 47 ||
meaning:
आसने शयने मार्गे असक्तिश्चापि भोजने |
हृद्गतं न त्यजेद्ध्यानमानन्दफलदं च यत् || 47 ||
text_mt: detachment in sitting, in lying down, upon the path, and in eating; / one should not abandon meditation residing in the heart, which yields the fruit of bliss; // 47

sanskrit_iast:
ātmaśaktyā pradānaṃ ca satyaṃ vākyamaniṣṭhuram |
amitreṣu ca mitreṣu samā buddhissadaiva hi || 48 ||
meaning:
आत्मशक्त्या प्रदानं च सत्यं वाक्यमनिष्ठुरम् |
अमित्रेषु च मित्रेषु समा बुद्धिस्सदैव हि || 48 ||
text_mt: giving according to one's capacity, truthful and unharsh speech, / and an even mind always toward foes and friends, // 48

sanskrit_iast:
ārjavatvamakauṭilyaṃ kāruṇyaṃ sarvajantuṣu |
etadaṅgānvito yo yo yamo yamaniyāmakaḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
आर्जवत्वमकौटिल्यं कारुण्यं सर्वजन्तुषु |
एतदङ्गान्वितो यो यो यमो यमनियामकः || 49 ||
text_mt: straightforwardness, absence of crookedness, compassion toward all creatures: / endowed with these components, whatever yama [is practiced] controls Yamarāja. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
[kriyākhyātsattākhyaniṣpatterbrahmābhinnajñānodayaḥ, tena
brahmopasampattiḥ]
meaning:
[क्रियाख्यात्सत्ताख्यनिष्पत्तेर्ब्रह्माभिन्नज्ञानोदयः, तेन
ब्रह्मोपसम्पत्तिः]
text_mt: [The Rise of Knowledge Undivided from Brahman Through the Realization of the Existential from the Active, and Union with Brahman Through It]

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kriyākhyātsattākhyaṃ jñānaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
p. 32) brahmaṇyabhinnaṃ sattākhyāt jñānājjñānaṃ tato bhavet || 50 ||
meaning:
एवं क्रियाख्यात्सत्ताख्यं ज्ञानं प्राप्नोति मानवः |
प्. 32) ब्रह्मण्यभिन्नं सत्ताख्यात् ज्ञानाज्ज्ञानं ततो भवेत् || 50 ||
text_mt: Thus, from the active [knowledge] a person attains existential knowledge; / from existential knowledge, knowledge undivided from Brahman then arises; // 50

sanskrit_iast: brahmābhinnāttato jñānādbrahma saṃyujyate param |
meaning: ब्रह्माभिन्नात्ततो ज्ञानाद्ब्रह्म संयुज्यते परम् |
text_mt: then, through knowledge undivided from Brahman, one is united with supreme Brahman. // 51ab

sanskrit_iast: [brahmasamāpatterapunarbhavalakṣaṇamokṣarūpatā]
meaning: [ब्रह्मसमापत्तेरपुनर्भवलक्षणमोक्षरूपता]
text_mt: [The Nature of Liberation Characterized as the Attainment of Brahman Consisting in Non-Rebirth]

sanskrit_iast: anādivāsanāyukto yo jīva iti kathyate || 51 ||
meaning: अनादिवासनायुक्तो यो जीव इति कथ्यते || 51 ||
text_mt: Endowed with beginningless latent impressions, that which is called the individual self: // 51cd

sanskrit_iast: tasya brahmasamāpattiryā'punarbhavatā ca sā |
meaning: तस्य ब्रह्मसमापत्तिर्याऽपुनर्भवता च सा |
text_mt: its attainment of Brahman is indeed freedom from rebirth. // 52ab

sanskrit_iast: [brahmābhinnatvaprakāropapādanam]
meaning: [ब्रह्माभिन्नत्वप्रकारोपपादनम्]
text_mt: [Demonstration of the Manner of Undividedness from Brahman]

sanskrit_iast: yatsamyagbrahmavettṛtvaṃ manāgyā caiva bhinnatā || 52 ||
meaning: यत्सम्यग्ब्रह्मवेत्तृत्वं मनाग्या चैव भिन्नता || 52 ||
text_mt: That which is complete knowledge of Brahman, and whatever slight difference [remains], // 52cd

sanskrit_iast: īṣadbrahmasamāpattistadabhinnaṃ tu vai smṛtam |
meaning: ईषद्ब्रह्मसमापत्तिस्तदभिन्नं तु वै स्मृतम् |
text_mt: is a partial attainment of Brahman; but [otherwise] it is remembered as undivided from It. // 53ab

sanskrit_iast: [avidyāyogādātmano devādibhedaḥ]
meaning: [अविद्यायोगादात्मनो देवादिभेदः]
text_mt: [The Distinction of the Self into Gods and the Like Through Connection with Ignorance]

sanskrit_iast: jñānaṃ tvanekabhedairyattattvatāmeti cātmanaḥ || 53 ||
meaning: ज्ञानं त्वनेकभेदैर्यत्तत्त्वतामेति चात्मनः || 53 ||
text_mt: Knowledge, through various divisions, assumes the reality of the self // 53cd

sanskrit_iast: gauṇa(ṇe ?)vidyāmaye tattve samyagvidyāmayasya ca |
meaning: गौण(णे ?)विद्यामये तत्त्वे सम्यग्विद्यामयस्य च |
text_mt: in the subordinate principle consisting of ignorance, as well as of that consisting of complete knowledge." // 54ab

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ-
meaning: नारदः-

sanskrit_iast: kā guṇākhyā hyavidyā ca yatra jñānamayaḥ prabhuḥ || 54 ||
meaning: का गुणाख्या ह्यविद्या च यत्र ज्ञानमयः प्रभुः || 54 ||
text_mt: "What is that ignorance called the attributes (guṇas) where the Lord, consisting of knowledge, // 54cd

sanskrit_iast: tvayoktaṃ yattu (tattva ?)tāmeti bhedairnānāvidhairvibho |
meaning: त्वयोक्तं यत्तु (तत्त्व ?)तामेति भेदैर्नानाविधैर्विभो |
text_mt: assumes real form, as spoken by You, through various divisions, O All-Pervading One?" // 55ab

sanskrit_iast: [avidyāsvarūpanirūpaṇam]
meaning: [अविद्यास्वरूपनिरूपणम्]
text_mt: [Exposition of the Nature of Ignorance]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān-
meaning: श्रीभगवान्-

sanskrit_iast: guṇatrayasya yatsāmyaṃ sā'vidyā'nekarūpiṇī || 55 ||
meaning: गुणत्रयस्य यत्साम्यं साऽविद्याऽनेकरूपिणी || 55 ||
text_mt: "The equilibrium of the triad of attributes is that multiform ignorance, // 55cd

sanskrit_iast: rāgādīnāṃ ca doṣāṇāmutpattisthānameva ca |
meaning: रागादीनां च दोषाणामुत्पत्तिस्थानमेव च |
text_mt: and the very birthplace of defects such as passion." // 56ab

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ-
meaning: नारदः-

sanskrit_iast: brahmaprāptau tu yassamyagupāyaḥ kathitaḥ purā || 56 ||
meaning: ब्रह्मप्राप्तौ तु यस्सम्यगुपायः कथितः पुरा || 56 ||
text_mt: "The means that was fully explained before for attaining Brahman, // 56cd

sanskrit_iast: sa ca kiṃlakṣaṇo brūhi yaścātmeti tvayoditaḥ |
meaning: स च किंलक्षणो ब्रूहि यश्चात्मेति त्वयोदितः |
text_mt: and what its characteristic is, tell [me]; as well as that which was spoken of by you as the self." // 57ab

sanskrit_iast: [jīvātmanornirūpaṇam]
meaning: [जीवात्मनोर्निरूपणम्]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān-
meaning: श्रीभगवान्-

sanskrit_iast: yattatsthitaṃ ca cidrūpaṃ svasaṃvedyādyanirgatam || 57 ||
meaning: यत्तत्स्थितं च चिद्रूपं स्वसंवेद्याद्यनिर्गतम् || 57 ||
text_mt: "That which exists as consciousness, not departed from self-awareness and the rest, // 57cd

sanskrit_iast: rañjitaṃ guṇarāgeṇa sa ātmā kathito dvija |
meaning: रञ्जितं गुणरागेण स आत्मा कथितो द्विज |
text_mt: colored by attachment to the attributes—that is declared to be the self, O twice-born."

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ-
meaning: नारदः-

sanskrit_iast: jñānamātmasvarūpaṃ ca māyā tadrañjikā tu vai || 58 ||
meaning: ज्ञानमात्मस्वरूपं च माया तद्रञ्जिका तु वै || 58 ||
text_mt: "Knowledge is the essential nature of the self, and māyā indeed colors it. // 58cd

sanskrit_iast:
ācakṣva bhagavanbrahma prāgva(gya ?)tsaṃcoditaṃ mayā |
tanme na viditaṃ samyagyadarthaṃ kriyate kriyā || 59 ||
meaning:
आचक्ष्व भगवन्ब्रह्म प्राग्व(ग्य ?)त्संचोदितं मया |
तन्मे न विदितं सम्यग्यदर्थं क्रियते क्रिया || 59 ||
text_mt: Explain Brahman, O Blessed Lord, as was requested by me earlier; / that is not fully known to me, for the sake of which ritual action is performed, // 59

sanskrit_iast: p. 33) yatprāpya na punarjanma bhave'sminprāpyate budhaiḥ |
meaning: प्. 33) यत्प्राप्य न पुनर्जन्म भवेऽस्मिन्प्राप्यते बुधैः |
text_mt: having attained which, rebirth in this worldly existence is not experienced by the wise." // 60ab

sanskrit_iast: [parabrahmanirūpaṇam]
meaning: [परब्रह्मनिरूपणम्]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān-
meaning: श्रीभगवान्-

sanskrit_iast: ānandalakṣaṇaṃ brahma sarvaheyavivarjitam || 60 ||
meaning: आनन्दलक्षणं ब्रह्म सर्वहेयविवर्जितम् || 60 ||
text_mt: "Brahman has bliss as its characteristic, and is devoid of all that is to be abandoned; // 60cd

sanskrit_iast:
svasaṃvedyamanaupamyaṃ parā kāṣṭhā parā gatiḥ |
sarvakriyāvinirmuktaṃ sarveṣāmāśrayaṃ prabhuḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
स्वसंवेद्यमनौपम्यं परा काष्ठा परा गतिः |
सर्वक्रियाविनिर्मुक्तं सर्वेषामाश्रयं प्रभुः || 61 ||
text_mt: it is self-aware, incomparable, the ultimate limit, the supreme goal, / freed from all action, the refuge of all, the Sovereign Lord. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇau yathā sarvaṃ mūrtaṃ saṅgi vyavasthitam |
tathā sarvaṃ tu sarvatra vidyate sarvagasya ca || 62 ||
meaning:
चिन्तामणौ यथा सर्वं मूर्तं सङ्गि व्यवस्थितम् |
तथा सर्वं तु सर्वत्र विद्यते सर्वगस्य च || 62 ||
text_mt: Just as everything possessing form is situated in contact within the wish-fulfilling jewel, / so indeed everything exists everywhere for the All-Pervading One. // 62

sanskrit_iast:
anādi tadanantaṃ ca na sattannāsaducyate |
sarvatra karavākpādaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham || 63 ||
meaning:
अनादि तदनन्तं च न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते |
सर्वत्र करवाक्पादं सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् || 63 ||
text_mt: It is beginningless and endless; it is said to be neither being nor non-being; / having hands, speech, and feet everywhere; having eyes, heads, and faces on all sides; // 63

sanskrit_iast:
sarvataḥśrutimadviddhi sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati |
saguṇairindriyaissarvairbhāsitaṃ caiva varjitam || 64 ||
meaning:
सर्वतःश्रुतिमद्विद्धि सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति |
सगुणैरिन्द्रियैस्सर्वैर्भासितं चैव वर्जितम् || 64 ||
text_mt: know it as having ears on all sides; it stands encompassing everything; / illuminated by all the senses that have attributes, and yet devoid [of them]. // 64

sanskrit_iast:
tadasaktaṃ hi sarvatra yattu sarvatra caiva hi |
nirguṇo guṇabhoktā ca sarvasyāntarbahiḥ sthitaḥ || 65 ||
meaning:
तदसक्तं हि सर्वत्र यत्तु सर्वत्र चैव हि |
निर्गुणो गुणभोक्ता च सर्वस्यान्तर्बहिः स्थितः || 65 ||
text_mt: For it is unattached everywhere, yet it is indeed everywhere; / devoid of attributes and yet the experiencer of attributes, situated inside and outside of everything. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
calācalaṃ tu tadviddhi sūkṣmatvānnopalabhyate |
dūrasthitastathā hṛtsthaḥ paramātmā paraḥ prabhuḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
चलाचलं तु तद्विद्धि सूक्ष्मत्वान्नोपलभ्यते |
दूरस्थितस्तथा हृत्स्थः परमात्मा परः प्रभुः || 66 ||
text_mt: Know it to be moving and unmoving; it is not perceived because of its subtlety; / standing far off, and likewise dwelling in the heart—the supreme self, the highest Sovereign Lord. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtebhyaścāvibhaktaṃ tadvibhaktamupalabhyate |
sa bhāvabhūtabhṛcca syātsaṃhartāpi sṛjatyapi || 67 ||
meaning:
भूतेभ्यश्चाविभक्तं तद्विभक्तमुपलभ्यते |
स भावभूतभृच्च स्यात्संहर्तापि सृजत्यपि || 67 ||
text_mt: It is undivided from beings, yet perceived as divided; / it is the sustainer of beings and states of existence, the destroyer as well as the creator. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśyaṃ jyotiṣāṃ tacca ajñānātparataḥ sthitam |
jñānaṃ tadeva jñeyaṃ cataddhyānenādhigamyate || 68  ||
meaning:
प्रकाश्यं ज्योतिषां तच्च अज्ञानात्परतः स्थितम् |
ज्ञानं तदेव ज्ञेयं चतद्ध्यानेनाधिगम्यते || 68  ||
text_mt: It is the light of lights, situated beyond ignorance; / it is knowledge itself and the object of knowledge; it is attained through meditation upon it. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavarṇarasairhīnaṃ sarvagandharasānvitam |
sarvajñassarvadarśī ca sarvassarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 69 ||
meaning:
सर्ववर्णरसैर्हीनं सर्वगन्धरसान्वितम् |
सर्वज्ञस्सर्वदर्शी च सर्वस्सर्वेश्वरः प्रभुः || 69 ||
text_mt: It is devoid of all colors and tastes, yet endowed with all scents and tastes; / omniscient, all-seeing, everything, the Lord of all, the Sovereign Lord, // 69

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśaktimayaścaiva svādhīnaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
anādiścāpyanantaśca sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
सर्वशक्तिमयश्चैव स्वाधीनः परमेश्वरः |
अनादिश्चाप्यनन्तश्च सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः || 70 ||
text_mt: consisting of all powers, independent, the Supreme Lord, / beginningless and endless, devoid of all suffering. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
viditvaivaṃ (evaṃ vetti?) paraṃ brahma jñānena parameṇa ca |
yadā na jāyate bhūyassaṃsāre'smiṃstadā pumān || 71 ||
meaning:
विदित्वैवं (एवं वेत्ति?) परं ब्रह्म ज्ञानेन परमेण च |
यदा न जायते भूयस्संसारेऽस्मिंस्तदा पुमान् || 71 ||
text_mt: Knowing the supreme Brahman in this way through supreme knowledge, / a man is never born again in this transmigratory existence." // 71

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ -
meaning: नारदः -

sanskrit_iast:
sarvataḥ pāṇipādādyairyaduktaṃ lakṣaṇaistvayā |
na caikamupapadyeta ghaṭate tadyathā'diśa || 72 ||
meaning:
सर्वतः पाणिपादाद्यैर्यदुक्तं लक्षणैस्त्वया |
न चैकमुपपद्येत घटते तद्यथाऽदिश || 72 ||
text_mt: "Regarding that which was stated by you with characteristics such as having hands and feet everywhere: / it is not possible for a single [entity]; explain how that is coherent." // 72

sanskrit_iast: p. 34) śrībhagavān-
meaning: प्. 34) श्रीभगवान्-

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya jagaddhātussarvajñatvā ca nārada |
mahimā'yamanantasya īśvaratvācca vidyate || 73 ||
meaning:
इति तस्य जगद्धातुस्सर्वज्ञत्वा च नारद |
महिमाऽयमनन्तस्य ईश्वरत्वाच्च विद्यते || 73 ||
text_mt: "Such greatness of that infinite One, the supporter of the world, exists, O Nārada, / because of omniscience and because of sovereignty. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
tasya sarvātiśāyitvaṃ yathā te na mayoditam |
anyathā vidyate tasya mahimā'yaṃ tathā'cyute || 74 ||
meaning:
तस्य सर्वातिशायित्वं यथा ते न मयोदितम् |
अन्यथा विद्यते तस्य महिमाऽयं तथाऽच्युते || 74 ||
text_mt: Its transcendence over all has not been explained to you by me [in ordinary terms]; / otherwise this greatness belongs to him in Acyuta [the Infallible One]. // 74

sanskrit_iast:
anādissarvapūrvatvānna sattannāsadityapi |
apratyakṣatayā'kṣāṇāṃ tadasadvijasattama || 75 ||
meaning:
अनादिस्सर्वपूर्वत्वान्न सत्तन्नासदित्यपि |
अप्रत्यक्षतयाऽक्षाणां तदसद्विजसत्तम || 75 ||
text_mt: It is beginningless because it precedes all, and it is said to be neither being nor non-being; / because of being imperceptible to the senses, it is non-being, O best of the twice-born. // 75

sanskrit_iast:
svasaṃvedyaṃ tu tadviddhi gandhaḥ puṣpādigo yathā |
tathā samastamākṣiptaṃ yasmādvai paramātmanā || 76 ||
meaning:
स्वसंवेद्यं तु तद्विद्धि गन्धः पुष्पादिगो यथा |
तथा समस्तमाक्षिप्तं यस्माद्वै परमात्मना || 76 ||
text_mt: Know it to be self-aware, like the fragrance residing in a flower and the like; / because everything indeed is pervaded by the supreme self, // 76

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvai sarvapāṇitvaṃ sarvagasyānumīyate |
nāvacchinnaṃ hi deśena na kālenāntarīkṛtam || 77 ||
meaning:
तस्माद्वै सर्वपाणित्वं सर्वगस्यानुमीयते |
नावच्छिन्नं हि देशेन न कालेनान्तरीकृतम् || 77 ||
text_mt: therefore having hands everywhere is inferred of the All-Pervading One; / for it is not delimited by space, nor separated by time. // 77

sanskrit_iast:
atassarvagatatvādvai sarvataḥpātprabhuḥ smṛtaḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ tiryagadhoyātairyathoccai(srai?)rbhāsayedraviḥ || 78 ||
meaning:
अतस्सर्वगतत्वाद्वै सर्वतःपात्प्रभुः स्मृतः |
ऊर्ध्वं तिर्यगधोयातैर्यथोच्चै(स्रै?)र्भासयेद्रविः || 78 ||
text_mt: Therefore, because of being all-pervading, the Sovereign Lord is considered to have feet everywhere; / just as the sun illuminates with rays going upward, crosswise, and downward, // 78

sanskrit_iast:
tadvatprakāśarūpatvātsarvacakṣustato hyajaḥ |
yathā sarveṣu gātreṣu pradhānaṃ gīyate śiraḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
तद्वत्प्रकाशरूपत्वात्सर्वचक्षुस्ततो ह्यजः |
यथा सर्वेषु गात्रेषु प्रधानं गीयते शिरः || 79 ||
text_mt: in the same way, because of having the nature of illumination, the Unborn One has eyes everywhere; / just as the head is sung as the principal among all limbs // 79

sanskrit_iast:
bhave'sminprākṛtānāṃ tu na tathā tasya sattama |
samatvātpāvanatvācca siddhassarvaśirāḥ prabhuḥ || 80 ||
meaning:
भवेऽस्मिन्प्राकृतानां तु न तथा तस्य सत्तम |
समत्वात्पावनत्वाच्च सिद्धस्सर्वशिराः प्रभुः || 80 ||
text_mt: in this world among ordinary beings, it is not so in his case, O best of men; / because of impartiality and purifying nature, the Sovereign Lord is established as having heads everywhere. // 80

sanskrit_iast:
yathā'nantarasāssarve tasya santi sadaiva hi |
sarvatra śāntarūpasya atassarvamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 81 ||
meaning:
यथाऽनन्तरसास्सर्वे तस्य सन्ति सदैव हि |
सर्वत्र शान्तरूपस्य अतस्सर्वमुखः स्मृतः || 81 ||
text_mt: Since all infinite tastes belong to him always, / whose nature is peaceful everywhere, therefore he is considered to have faces everywhere. // 81

sanskrit_iast:
śabdarāśiryato viddhi sa eva parameśvaraḥ |
sarvataḥ śrutimāṃścāto yathā dṛkśrāvakoragaḥ || 82 ||
meaning:
शब्दराशिर्यतो विद्धि स एव परमेश्वरः |
सर्वतः श्रुतिमांश्चातो यथा दृक्श्रावकोरगः || 82 ||
text_mt: Know that the Supreme Lord is himself the totality of sound; / therefore he has ears on all sides, just as a serpent has vision as its hearing. // 82

sanskrit_iast:
ayaḥpiṇḍe yathā vahnirbhinnastiṣṭhatyabhinnavat |
tadvatsarvamidaṃ devo vyāvṛ(pṛ ?)tya paritiṣṭhati || 83 ||
meaning:
अयःपिण्डे यथा वह्निर्भिन्नस्तिष्ठत्यभिन्नवत् |
तद्वत्सर्वमिदं देवो व्यावृ(पृ ?)त्य परितिष्ठति || 83 ||
text_mt: Just as fire in an iron ball remains distinct as if undivided, / so the God stands encompassing this entire [universe]. // 83

sanskrit_iast:
nirmale darpaṇe yadvatkiñcidvastvabhitiṣṭhati |
na ca taddarpaṇasyāsti asti tasya ca tadvija || 84 ||
meaning:
निर्मले दर्पणे यद्वत्किञ्चिद्वस्त्वभितिष्ठति |
न च तद्दर्पणस्यास्ति अस्ति तस्य च तद्विज || 84 ||
text_mt: Just as an object appears reflected in a clean mirror, / and it does not belong to the mirror, yet it is there for it, O twice-born; // 84

sanskrit_iast:
sendriyaistu guṇairevaṃ saṃyuktaścāpi varjitaḥ |
asminmāyāmaye viśve vyāpī sarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 85 ||
meaning:
सेन्द्रियैस्तु गुणैरेवं संयुक्तश्चापि वर्जितः |
अस्मिन्मायामये विश्वे व्यापी सर्वेश्वरः प्रभुः || 85 ||
text_mt: so the Sovereign Lord, the Ruler of all, is joined with the attributes of the senses and yet devoid [of them], / pervading in this universe composed of māyā. // 85

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadā viddhyasaktaśca yathā'mbhaḥ puṣkaracchade |
sarvabhṛdvaiśvarūpyācca amoghatvācca nirguṇaḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
सर्वदा विद्ध्यसक्तश्च यथाऽम्भः पुष्करच्छदे |
सर्वभृद्वैश्वरूप्याच्च अमोघत्वाच्च निर्गुणः || 86 ||
text_mt: Know him to be always unattached, like water on a lotus leaf; / the bearer of all because of universal form, and devoid of attributes because of infallibility. // 86

sanskrit_iast:
p. 35) udāsīnavadāsīno guṇānāṃ guṇabhuk tataḥ |
sarvadā'ntargatasyaiva kumbhasya ca yathodakam || 87 ||
meaning:
प्. 35) उदासीनवदासीनो गुणानां गुणभुक् ततः |
सर्वदाऽन्तर्गतस्यैव कुम्भस्य च यथोदकम् || 87 ||
text_mt: Remaining like one indifferent, he is therefore the experiencer of the attributes; / like the water of a pot that is always within, // 87

sanskrit_iast:
tathā sarvasya jagato vahirantarvyavasthitaḥ |
ghaṭasaṃsthaṃ yathā'kāśaṃ nīyamānaṃ vibhāvyate || 88 ||
meaning:
तथा सर्वस्य जगतो वहिरन्तर्व्यवस्थितः |
घटसंस्थं यथाऽकाशं नीयमानं विभाव्यते || 88 ||
text_mt: so he is situated inside and outside the whole world; / just as space located in a pot is perceived as being carried, // 88

sanskrit_iast:
nākāśaṃ kutracidyāti nayanāttu ghaṭasya ca |
calācalatvamevaṃ hi vibhoścaivānumīyate || 89 ||
meaning:
नाकाशं कुत्रचिद्याति नयनात्तु घटस्य च |
चलाचलत्वमेवं हि विभोश्चैवानुमीयते || 89 ||
text_mt: yet space goes nowhere, but [seems to] from the carrying of the pot; / in this way, the moving and unmoving nature of the All-Pervading One is inferred. // 89

sanskrit_iast:
bahuṣvambujapatreṣu vedhaṃ kurvankramātkramāt |
kālavaccātisūkṣmatvānna sadā'pyupalabhyate || 90 ||
meaning:
बहुष्वम्बुजपत्रेषु वेधं कुर्वन्क्रमात्क्रमात् |
कालवच्चातिसूक्ष्मत्वान्न सदाऽप्युपलभ्यते || 90 ||
text_mt: Piercing through many lotus petals one after another, / like time, because of extreme subtlety, he is not perceived even though always [present]. // 90

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānāccātidūrasthaṃ jñānātsambhāvyate hṛdi |
yadā tadā samīpasthaṃ svasaṃvedyaścidātmakaḥ || 91 ||
meaning:
अज्ञानाच्चातिदूरस्थं ज्ञानात्सम्भाव्यते हृदि |
यदा तदा समीपस्थं स्वसंवेद्यश्चिदात्मकः || 91 ||
text_mt: From ignorance he is situated very far off, but through knowledge he is conceived in the heart; / when [conceived] then, he is near, self-aware, consisting of consciousness. // 91

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśasya (śaḥ sa ?) ca yo vāyustaddvayorapyabhedataḥ (ditā?) |
tathā tasya(syā ?) vibhaktyaikyaṃ bhūtānāṃ hi parasya ca || 92 ||
meaning:
आकाशस्य (शः स ?) च यो वायुस्तद्द्वयोरप्यभेदतः (दिता?) |
तथा तस्य(स्या ?) विभक्त्यैक्यं भूतानां हि परस्य च || 92 ||
text_mt: Just as there is non-difference between space and its wind, / so there is undivided unity between the beings and the Supreme. // 92

sanskrit_iast:
cetanācetanāssarve bhūtāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ |
pūritāḥ parameśena rasenauṣadhayo yathā || 93 ||
meaning:
चेतनाचेतनास्सर्वे भूताः स्थावरजङ्गमाः |
पूरिताः परमेशेन रसेनौषधयो यथा || 93 ||
text_mt: All beings, conscious and unconscious, stationary and moving, / are filled by the Supreme Lord, as plants [are filled] with sap, // 93

sanskrit_iast:
ekenābhinnarūpeṇa bhūtabhṛttvena hetunā |
yathaiva sūryādhīne tu prakāśatamasī dvija || 94 ||
meaning:
एकेनाभिन्नरूपेण भूतभृत्त्वेन हेतुना |
यथैव सूर्याधीने तु प्रकाशतमसी द्विज || 94 ||
text_mt: by a single undivided form, by virtue of his being the bearer of beings; / just as light and darkness are dependent on the sun, O twice-born, // 94

sanskrit_iast:
tadvatsṛṣṭiṃ sasaṃhārāṃ svatantraḥ prakaroti ca |
prakāśo jyotiṣāṃ tacca śrotrādīnāṃ yathā manaḥ || 95 ||
meaning:
तद्वत्सृष्टिं ससंहारां स्वतन्त्रः प्रकरोति च |
प्रकाशो ज्योतिषां तच्च श्रोत्रादीनां यथा मनः || 95 ||
text_mt: so the independent One performs creation together with destruction; / and that is the light of lights, as the mind is for hearing and the other senses. // 95

sanskrit_iast:
śabdādike na saṃdṛṣṭe tathā'pi śruṇute'nyathā |
tamaso'nyo yathā'lokaścājñānāttatparastathā || 96 ||
meaning:
शब्दादिके न संदृष्टे तथाऽपि श्रुणुतेऽन्यथा |
तमसोऽन्यो यथाऽलोकश्चाज्ञानात्तत्परस्तथा || 96 ||
text_mt: Even when sound and the like are not seen, one hears otherwise; / just as light is other than darkness, so is he beyond ignorance. // 96

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ tadeva jñeyaṃ ca vahnerjvālā yathaiva hi |
varṇairvirahitaṃ sarvairnīrūpatvātsitādikaiḥ || 97 ||
meaning:
ज्ञानं तदेव ज्ञेयं च वह्नेर्ज्वाला यथैव हि |
वर्णैर्विरहितं सर्वैर्नीरूपत्वात्सितादिकैः || 97 ||
text_mt: He is knowledge itself and the object of knowledge, just like the flame of a fire; / devoid of all colors, such as white and the rest, because of formlessness, // 97

sanskrit_iast:
madhurādirasaistadvatkalpanārahitaṃ yataḥ |
mayūrakaṇṭhavatsarvairvarṇaistadupacaryate || 98 ||
meaning:
मधुरादिरसैस्तद्वत्कल्पनारहितं यतः |
मयूरकण्ठवत्सर्वैर्वर्णैस्तदुपचर्यते || 98 ||
text_mt: and likewise devoid of tastes such as sweet, because of being free from mental construction; / he is metaphorically described by all colors, like a peacock's neck." // 98

sanskrit_iast:
anubhāvādrasānāṃ ca tathā sarvarasātmakaḥ |
sarvavarṇarasairhīno yuktaścātassmṛto'cyutaḥ || 99 ||
meaning:
अनुभावाद्रसानां च तथा सर्वरसात्मकः |
सर्ववर्णरसैर्हीनो युक्तश्चातस्स्मृतोऽच्युतः || 99 ||
text_mt: And because he experiences all tastes, he thus consists of all tastes; / devoid of all colors and tastes, and yet endowed [with them], he is therefore remembered as Acyuta. // 99

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñassarvavettṛtvāddarśassarvatra darśanāt |
sāmyātsarveśvaraścaiva yatassarvajñatādibhiḥ || 100 ||
meaning:
सर्वज्ञस्सर्ववेत्तृत्वाद्दर्शस्सर्वत्र दर्शनात् |
साम्यात्सर्वेश्वरश्चैव यतस्सर्वज्ञतादिभिः || 100 ||
text_mt: He is all-knowing because he knows all; he is the seer because he sees everywhere; / and he is the Lord of all through equality, because of omniscience and the rest, // 100

sanskrit_iast:
p. 36) yuktaścāntassarvaśaktiḥ ṣāṅguṇyamahimānvitaḥ |
svādhīnaśca svatantratvātpurāṇatvādanādi tat || 101 ||
meaning:
प्. 36) युक्तश्चान्तस्सर्वशक्तिः षाङ्गुण्यमहिमान्वितः |
स्वाधीनश्च स्वतन्त्रत्वात्पुराणत्वादनादि तत् || 101 ||
text_mt: and endowed within [with] all potencies, possessed of the majesty of the six qualities; / he is self-dependent because of autonomy, and because of ancientness that is without beginning. // 101

sanskrit_iast:
na hyasyāntostyato'nantastṛptatvādduḥkhavarjitaḥ |
amūrta eva sarveśo hyabhyāsādupalabhyate || 102 ||
meaning:
न ह्यस्यान्तोस्त्यतोऽनन्तस्तृप्तत्वाद्दुःखवर्जितः |
अमूर्त एव सर्वेशो ह्यभ्यासादुपलभ्यते || 102 ||
text_mt: Indeed, he has no end, hence he is infinite; because of contentment, he is free of suffering; / the formless Lord of all is attained indeed through practice. // 102

sanskrit_iast:
yathā kāṣṭhāntarādvahnirghṛtaṃ kṣīrāntarādyathā |
svānubhāvādvinā naiva vaktuṃ saṃyujyate yathā || 103 ||
meaning:
यथा काष्ठान्तराद्वह्निर्घृतं क्षीरान्तराद्यथा |
स्वानुभावाद्विना नैव वक्तुं संयुज्यते यथा || 103 ||
text_mt: Just as fire [is obtained] from within wood, just as ghee [is obtained] from within milk, / just as it cannot be expressed without one's own experience, // 103

sanskrit_iast:
mādhuryamikṣusaṃsthaṃ ca amūrtamupalabhyate |
evaṃ svadehagaṃ devaṃ paramātmānamavyayam || 104 ||
meaning:
माधुर्यमिक्षुसंस्थं च अमूर्तमुपलभ्यते |
एवं स्वदेहगं देवं परमात्मानमव्ययम् || 104 ||
text_mt: and the sweetness dwelling in sugar cane is perceived without form, / even so the deity residing in one's own body, the supreme, imperishable Self, // 104

sanskrit_iast:
heyopādeyarahitaṃ susitānandavigraham |
pramāṇairaparicchaidyaṃ yatassaṃvinmayaṃ mahat || 105 ||
meaning:
हेयोपादेयरहितं सुसितानन्दविग्रहम् |
प्रमाणैरपरिच्छैद्यं यतस्संविन्मयं महत् || 105 ||
text_mt: free from what is to be rejected or acquired, whose form is pure bliss, / immeasurable by means of knowledge, because the Great One consists of consciousness, // 105

sanskrit_iast:
vibhāti hṛdayākāśe yeṣāṃ māyāvivarjitam |
eṣa nārāyaṇo devassarvopādhivivarjitaḥ || 106 ||
meaning:
विभाति हृदयाकाशे येषां मायाविवर्जितम् |
एष नारायणो देवस्सर्वोपाधिविवर्जितः || 106 ||
text_mt: shines in the heart-space of those [for whom it is] free of māyā. / This is the god Nārāyaṇa, completely free from all limiting adjuncts. // 106

sanskrit_iast:
svātmasaṃvedanatvāddyo vinā lakṣyaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ |
tamāśrayasvānirdeśyaṃ jñānena parameṇa ca || 107 ||
meaning:
स्वात्मसंवेदनत्वाद्द्यो विना लक्ष्यः परः प्रभुः |
तमाश्रयस्वानिर्देश्यं ज्ञानेन परमेण च || 107 ||
text_mt: Because of self-awareness, the supreme Lord is to be perceived without [intermediaries]; / take refuge in him who is indefinable, through supreme knowledge. // 107

sanskrit_iast:
yaccopamānai rahitaṃ vyavahārairdhiyo'kṣagaiḥ |
kāraṇaṃ tadanaupamyaṃ ye vidantyabhayāstu te || 108 ||
meaning:
यच्चोपमानै रहितं व्यवहारैर्धियोऽक्षगैः |
कारणं तदनौपम्यं ये विदन्त्यभयास्तु ते || 108 ||
text_mt: And that which is devoid of analogies, [inaccessible] to the sense-based operations of the intellect, / that incomparable cause—those who know [it] are fearless. // 108

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvātītaṃ paraṃ brahma sphaṭikāmalasannibham |
mokṣaṃ yānti ca te muktāḥ sthitisteṣāṃ pare pade || 109 ||
meaning:
भावातीतं परं ब्रह्म स्फटिकामलसन्निभम् |
मोक्षं यान्ति च ते मुक्ताः स्थितिस्तेषां परे पदे || 109 ||
text_mt: The supreme Brahman, transcending worldly existence, resembles a pure crystal; / and those liberated ones attain liberation; their abiding is in the supreme abode. // 109

sanskrit_iast:
nānābhedena bhedānāṃ nivasatyeka eva hi |
na tasya vidyate mānaṃ na ca rūpaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 110 ||
meaning:
नानाभेदेन भेदानां निवसत्येक एव हि |
न तस्य विद्यते मानं न च रूपं महात्मनः || 110 ||
text_mt: He alone indeed dwells through the diverse divisions of divided things; / there is no measure for him, nor any form of the Great Self. // 110

sanskrit_iast:
tejovāyvindubhāvena, padmasūtrāyutāyutāt |
koṣṭyaṃśena tu mānena susūkṣmeṣu sthito'ṇuṣu || 111 ||
meaning:
तेजोवाय्विन्दुभावेन, पद्मसूत्रायुतायुतात् |
कोष्ट्यंशेन तु मानेन सुसूक्ष्मेषु स्थितोऽणुषु || 111 ||
text_mt: In the mode of fire, wind, and moon, by a measure of a fraction of a cell / smaller than a hundred-millionth part of a lotus fiber, he resides in the subtlest atoms; // 111

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcicca tebhyaḥ sthūleṣu sthūlajyotiḥ puroditām |
pramāṇātsaṃsthito vyāpī paramātmā hyadhokṣajaḥ || 112 ||
meaning:
किञ्चिच्च तेभ्यः स्थूलेषु स्थूलज्योतिः पुरोदिताम् |
प्रमाणात्संस्थितो व्यापी परमात्मा ह्यधोक्षजः || 112 ||
text_mt: and in those [things] slightly coarser than them, the supreme Self, Adhokṣaja, / the All-Pervading One, abides through measure as the coarse light proclaimed before. // 112

sanskrit_iast:
vāyvātmanā sa bhūtānāṃ sthitaḥ kuṭilabhāvinām |
sargo rūpeṇa dhūtānāṃ pārthivānāmaśeṣataḥ || 113 ||
meaning:
वाय्वात्मना स भूतानां स्थितः कुटिलभाविनाम् |
सर्गो रूपेण धूतानां पार्थिवानामशेषतः || 113 ||
text_mt: As the wind, he resides in beings of crooked nature; / as form, [he is] the creation of the agitated earthly elements without remainder. // 113

sanskrit_iast:
sthitaḥṣaḍrasarūpeṇa sarvauṣadhiṣu sarvagaḥ |
anekābhiśca saṃjñābhistamavyayamupāsate || 114 ||
meaning:
स्थितःषड्रसरूपेण सर्वौषधिषु सर्वगः |
अनेकाभिश्च संज्ञाभिस्तमव्ययमुपासते || 114 ||
text_mt: The All-Pervading One resides in the form of the six tastes in all medicinal herbs; / and under various designations people worship that imperishable one: // 114

sanskrit_iast:
īśvaratvena viprendu puruṣatvena caiva hi |
śivasūryātmakatvena somatvena tathaiva ca || 115 ||
meaning:
ईश्वरत्वेन विप्रेन्दु पुरुषत्वेन चैव हि |
शिवसूर्यात्मकत्वेन सोमत्वेन तथैव च || 115 ||
text_mt: as the Lord, O moon among the twice-born, and as the Person indeed, / as the nature of Śiva and the Sun, and likewise as the Moon, // 115

sanskrit_iast:
p. 37) agnīṣomātmakatvena śabdatvenāpi vai punaḥ |
jyotirjñānātmakatvena kālatvena ca nārada || 116 ||
meaning:
प्. 37) अग्नीषोमात्मकत्वेन शब्दत्वेनापि वै पुनः |
ज्योतिर्ज्ञानात्मकत्वेन कालत्वेन च नारद || 116 ||
text_mt: as the nature of Agni and Soma, and again indeed as Sound, / as the nature of light and knowledge, and as Time, O Nārada, // 116

sanskrit_iast:
jīvakṣetrātmakatvena bhūtātmatvena vai tathā |
evamekaḥ paro devo nānāśaktyātmarūpadhṛt || 117 ||
meaning:
जीवक्षेत्रात्मकत्वेन भूतात्मत्वेन वै तथा |
एवमेकः परो देवो नानाशक्त्यात्मरूपधृत् || 117 ||
text_mt: as the nature of the individual self and field, and likewise as the nature of beings. / Thus the one supreme God bears forms of manifold powers. // 117

sanskrit_iast: nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma niṣṭhā sanbrahmavedinām |
meaning: नारायणः परं ब्रह्म निष्ठा सन्ब्रह्मवेदिनाम् |
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa is the supreme Brahman, being the final goal of the knowers of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: [sanidarśanamupāsakānāṃ brahmasampattinirūpaṇam]
meaning: [सनिदर्शनमुपासकानां ब्रह्मसम्पत्तिनिरूपणम्]
text_mt: [An illustrated demonstration of the worshippers' attainment of Brahman]

sanskrit_iast: yadvanmahāpurasyāntaryāyinaḥ praviśanti ca || 118 ||
meaning: यद्वन्महापुरस्यान्तर्यायिनः प्रविशन्ति च || 118 ||
text_mt: Just as travelers enter into a great city // 118

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadigbahunirmāṇa (?)stadvadviṣṇorupāsakāḥ |
dhyeyeṣvīśvarabhūteṣu dhyāyinastu sadaiva hi || 119 ||
meaning:
सर्वदिग्बहुनिर्माण (?)स्तद्वद्विष्णोरुपासकाः |
ध्येयेष्वीश्वरभूतेषु ध्यायिनस्तु सदैव हि || 119 ||
text_mt: [constructed] with many approaches from all directions, so do the worshippers of Viṣṇu; / and meditators, indeed, ever [absorbed] in the Lord who is their object of meditation, // 119

sanskrit_iast:
viśanti kṣīṇamohāśca yathā kṣīṇāmṛtā dvija |
kalā yā aindavāssūrye tadvadviṣṇau ca yoginaḥ || 120 ||
meaning:
विशन्ति क्षीणमोहाश्च यथा क्षीणामृता द्विज |
कला या ऐन्दवास्सूर्ये तद्वद्विष्णौ च योगिनः || 120 ||
text_mt: enter with their delusion destroyed, just as the lunar digits whose nectar is depleted / [enter] into the sun, O twice-born one, so do yogins [enter] into Viṣṇu. // 120

sanskrit_iast:
meghāddhārāgaṇenaiva pṛthagmbugataṃ kṣitau |
prāpnotyaikyaṃ tathā sarve bhagavatyapi yoginaḥ || 121 ||
meaning:
मेघाद्धारागणेनैव पृथग्म्बुगतं क्षितौ |
प्राप्नोत्यैक्यं तथा सर्वे भगवत्यपि योगिनः || 121 ||
text_mt: Just as water fallen separately upon the earth from a cloud in a multitude of showers / attains unity, so all yogins also [attain unity] in the Blessed One. // 121

sanskrit_iast:
yathā'nekendhanādīni saṃpraviṣṭāni pāvake |
alakṣyāṇi ca dagdhāni tadvadbrahmaṇyupāsakāḥ || 122 ||
meaning:
यथाऽनेकेन्धनादीनि संप्रविष्टानि पावके |
अलक्ष्याणि च दग्धानि तद्वद्ब्रह्मण्युपासकाः || 122 ||
text_mt: Just as many pieces of firewood and the like, having entered into fire, / are burned and become indistinguishable, so do worshippers in Brahman. // 122

sanskrit_iast:
saritsaṅghādyathā toyaṃ saṃpraviṣṭaṃ mahodadhau |
alakṣyaścodake bhedaḥ parasmin yogināṃ tathā || 123 ||
meaning:
सरित्सङ्घाद्यथा तोयं संप्रविष्टं महोदधौ |
अलक्ष्यश्चोदके भेदः परस्मिन् योगिनां तथा || 123 ||
text_mt: Just as water from a host of rivers, having entered into the great ocean, / has an indistinguishable difference in the water, so is it with yogins in the Supreme. // 123

sanskrit_iast:
upāsate yamātmajñā yatassūryo virājate |
tamāśraya mune śaśvadyasya koṭyaṃśajā vayam || 124 ||
meaning:
उपासते यमात्मज्ञा यतस्सूर्यो विराजते |
तमाश्रय मुने शश्वद्यस्य कोट्यंशजा वयम् || 124 ||
text_mt: Whom knowers of the self worship, from whom the sun shines— / take refuge in him constantly, O sage, of a ten-millionth part of whom we are born. // 124

sanskrit_iast:
tathā sahasramūrddhā yaḥ sahasrākṣassahasrapāt |
sahasrabāhubhiḥ pūrṇassahasrātmadharaḥ prabhuḥ || 125 ||
meaning:
तथा सहस्रमूर्द्धा यः सहस्राक्षस्सहस्रपात् |
सहस्रबाहुभिः पूर्णस्सहस्रात्मधरः प्रभुः || 125 ||
text_mt: Likewise, he who has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet, / filled with a thousand arms, the Lord who bears a thousand selves, // 125

sanskrit_iast:
sahasradīptibhiḥ sphītaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ kirīṭavān |
śrīvatsavakṣā viprendra kaustubhādyairalaṅkṛtaḥ || 126 ||
meaning:
सहस्रदीप्तिभिः स्फीतः श्रीनिवासः किरीटवान् |
श्रीवत्सवक्षा विप्रेन्द्र कौस्तुभाद्यैरलङ्कृतः || 126 ||
text_mt: abundant with a thousand radiances, the abode of Śrī, diademed, / with the śrīvatsa on his chest, O foremost of the twice-born, adorned with the Kaustubha and other ornaments, // 126

sanskrit_iast:
candrārkau nayanoddeśe jihvāsaṅghe(sthāne?) sarasvatī |
yasyocchvāsaśca pavanastasmādūrdhvastu kāvadhau (?) || 127 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रार्कौ नयनोद्देशे जिह्वासङ्घे(स्थाने?) सरस्वती |
यस्योच्छ्वासश्च पवनस्तस्मादूर्ध्वस्तु कावधौ (?) || 127 ||
text_mt: in the place of whose eyes are the moon and the sun, in the place of whose tongue is Sarasvatī, / and whose breath is the wind—what limit is there above him? // 127

sanskrit_iast:
śrotroddeśe diśo yasya vidiśo yasya bāhavaḥ |
pātālādau talaṃ yasya vijñeyaṃ pādasantatau || 128 ||
meaning:
श्रोत्रोद्देशे दिशो यस्य विदिशो यस्य बाहवः |
पातालादौ तलं यस्य विज्ञेयं पादसन्ततौ || 128 ||
text_mt: in the place of whose ears are the cardinal directions, whose arms are the intermediate directions, / whose sole is to be known in Pātāla and the other [netherworlds] down to the line of his feet, // 128

sanskrit_iast:
prabhā yasya ca kālāgnirjīmūtāḥ keśasantatiḥ |
romāṇi yasya vibudhā ṛṣayo romakūpagāḥ || 129 ||
meaning:
प्रभा यस्य च कालाग्निर्जीमूताः केशसन्ततिः |
रोमाणि यस्य विबुधा ऋषयो रोमकूपगाः || 129 ||
text_mt: whose brilliance is the fire of time, the rain-clouds the mass of his hair, / whose body-hairs are the gods, and the sages dwell in the pores of his hairs, // 129

sanskrit_iast:
p. 38) mukhe'gnirāpassvedo vai grahā ṛkṣādayo malam |
malamasyopacāratvānnatvevaṃ paramārthataḥ || 130 ||
meaning:
प्. 38) मुखेऽग्निरापस्स्वेदो वै ग्रहा ऋक्षादयो मलम् |
मलमस्योपचारत्वान्नत्वेवं परमार्थतः || 130 ||
text_mt: fire is in his mouth, water is his sweat, and the planets, asterisms, and the rest are his bodily waste— / his 'waste' is said only metaphorically, not in this way in the highest truth. // 130

sanskrit_iast:
idamuktaṃ mayā brahman brahmatattvaṃ yathārthataḥ |
yajjñātvā na punarbhūyo bhavameṣyāse saṅkulam || 131 ||
meaning:
इदमुक्तं मया ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मतत्त्वं यथार्थतः |
यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्भूयो भवमेष्यासे सङ्कुलम् || 131 ||
text_mt: This true nature of Brahman has been told by me as it truly is, O brahmin, / knowing which you will not again return to the troubled round of rebirth. // 131

sanskrit_iast:
khavatsarvagataṃ caiva yadyapyasmiṃścarācare |
sthitaṃ jñānaṃ vinā vipra tathā'pi hi sudurlabhaḥ || 132 ||
meaning:
खवत्सर्वगतं चैव यद्यप्यस्मिंश्चराचरे |
स्थितं ज्ञानं विना विप्र तथाऽपि हि सुदुर्लभः || 132 ||
text_mt: Even though it is all-pervading like space, residing in this mobile and immobile world, / nevertheless, O twice-born one, he is very difficult to attain without knowledge." // 132

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ
śuddhasargabrahmatattvākhyānaṃ nāma caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां
शुद्धसर्गब्रह्मतत्त्वाख्यानं नाम चतुर्थः पटलः || 4 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the fourth chapter, titled "The Exposition of the Pure Creation and the True Nature of Brahman," in the venerable Pāñcarātra Jayākhyasaṃhitā. // 4

sanskrit_iast: atha brahmajñānotpattyākhyānaṃ nāma pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: अथ ब्रह्मज्ञानोत्पत्त्याख्यानं नाम पञ्चमः पटलः
text_mt: Now begins the fifth chapter, titled "The Exposition of the Arising of the Knowledge of Brahman."

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ
meaning: नारदः

sanskrit_iast:
brahmābhinnaṃ vibho jñānaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ |
yena samprāpyate jñeyamantaḥkaraṇasaṃsthitam || 1 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माभिन्नं विभो ज्ञानं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः |
येन सम्प्राप्यते ज्ञेयमन्तःकरणसंस्थितम् || 1 ||
text_mt: "I wish to hear, in its true nature, of the knowledge non-different from Brahman, O All-Pervading One, / by which the object of knowledge residing in the inner organ is attained. // 1 //"

sanskrit_iast: [jñānasya yogābhyāsaikalabhyatvam]
meaning: [ज्ञानस्य योगाभ्यासैकलभ्यत्वम्]
text_mt: [Knowledge as attainable solely through the practice of yoga]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopādhivinirmuktaṃ jñānamekāntanirmalam |
utpadyate hi yuktasya yogābhyāsātkrameṇa tat || 2 ||
meaning:
सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्तं ज्ञानमेकान्तनिर्मलम् |
उत्पद्यते हि युक्तस्य योगाभ्यासात्क्रमेण तत् || 2 ||
text_mt: "Knowledge entirely free from all limiting adjuncts, supremely pure, / indeed arises gradually for the disciplined practitioner from the practice of yoga. // 2

sanskrit_iast: tena tatprāpyate vipra anyathā durlabhaṃ bhavet |
meaning: तेन तत्प्राप्यते विप्र अन्यथा दुर्लभं भवेत् |
text_mt: By that, O twice-born one, it is attained; otherwise it would be hard to obtain."

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ
meaning: नारदः

sanskrit_iast: kathamevaṃvidhaṃ jñānamutpadyeta jagatprabho || 3 ||
meaning: कथमेवंविधं ज्ञानमुत्पद्येत जगत्प्रभो || 3 ||
text_mt: "How could such knowledge arise, O Lord of the world, // 3

sanskrit_iast: yatassyājjñeyasamatā etadvistarato vada |
meaning: यतस्स्याज्ज्ञेयसमता एतद्विस्तरतो वद |
text_mt: whereby sameness with the object of knowledge would occur? Speak of this in detail!"

sanskrit_iast:
[bhagavacchaktisāmarthyādguṇasāmyāpattyā
svātmasvarūpajijñāsotpattiḥ]
meaning:
[भगवच्छक्तिसामर्थ्याद्गुणसाम्यापत्त्या
स्वात्मस्वरूपजिज्ञासोत्पत्तिः]
text_mt: [The arising of inquiry into the nature of one's own self through the state of equilibrium of the guṇas by the power of the Blessed One's potency]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast: saṃsārapādapasthānāṃ phalānāṃ caiva nārada || 4 ||
meaning: संसारपादपस्थानां फलानां चैव नारद || 4 ||
text_mt: "For the fruits hanging upon the tree of saṃsāra, O Nārada, // 4

sanskrit_iast:
pakvakarmarasānāṃ ca bhrāntānāṃ bhavasāgare |
bhagavacchaktisāmarthyādguṇasāmyaṃ bhavetkṣaṇāt || 5 ||
meaning:
पक्वकर्मरसानां च भ्रान्तानां भवसागरे |
भगवच्छक्तिसामर्थ्याद्गुणसाम्यं भवेत्क्षणात् || 5 ||
text_mt: and whose juice of past karma has ripened, who are wandering in the ocean of transmigratory existence, / by the power of the Blessed One's potency an equilibrium of the guṇas occurs in an instant. // 5

sanskrit_iast:
tatsāmyātkarmasamatā jāyate samanantaram |
tatsamatvādvicārastu pravartetātmalābhadaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
तत्साम्यात्कर्मसमता जायते समनन्तरम् |
तत्समत्वाद्विचारस्तु प्रवर्तेतात्मलाभदः || 6 ||
text_mt: From that equilibrium, an equality of karmas is produced immediately thereafter; / from that equality, inquiry that yields attainment of the self begins to operate: // 6

sanskrit_iast:
ko'haṃ kimātmakaścaiva kimidaṃ duḥkhapañjaram |
yatrāhamasamāśvastassaṃsthitassarvadaiva hi || 7 ||
meaning:
कोऽहं किमात्मकश्चैव किमिदं दुःखपञ्जरम् |
यत्राहमसमाश्वस्तस्संस्थितस्सर्वदैव हि || 7 ||
text_mt: 'Who am I, and of what nature am I? What is this cage of suffering, / in which I have remained at all times without solace?' // 7

sanskrit_iast: p. 39) iti mattvā tato yāti niṣpannasya gurorgṛham |
meaning: प्. 39) इति मत्त्वा ततो याति निष्पन्नस्य गुरोर्गृहम् |
text_mt: Reflecting thus, he then goes to the house of an accomplished guru. // p. 39

sanskrit_iast: [vividiṣayopasannasya śiṣyasyādhikārānuguṇamupāye niyojyatvam]
meaning: [विविदिषयोपसन्नस्य शिष्यस्याधिकारानुगुणमुपाये नियोज्यत्वम्]
text_mt: [The necessity of assigning the disciple who approaches with a desire to know to a means according to his qualification]

sanskrit_iast: jñātvā tasyāturatvaṃ ca sarvajño gurumūrtigaḥ || 8 ||
meaning: ज्ञात्वा तस्यातुरत्वं च सर्वज्ञो गुरुमूर्तिगः || 8 ||
text_mt: And recognizing his distress, the omniscient one residing in the guru's form, // 8

sanskrit_iast:
bhāti (va?) vyāpṛtikaṃ budhvā taṃ tathā viniyojayet |
sopalabdhe tu nirbīje svasāmarthyātpare pade || 9 ||
meaning:
भाति (व?) व्यापृतिकं बुध्वा तं तथा विनियोजयेत् |
सोपलब्धे तु निर्बीजे स्वसामर्थ्यात्परे पदे || 9 ||
text_mt: discerning his disposition [and] occupation, should employ him accordingly: / whether in the supreme, seedless state attained through perception by his own capacity, // 9

sanskrit_iast:
nirvāṇe tu nirātaṅke sānande cinmaye tu vā |
māntre'dhikriyame(?) vā'pi bhogamokṣapradakṣame || 10 ||
meaning:
निर्वाणे तु निरातङ्के सानन्दे चिन्मये तु वा |
मान्त्रेऽधिक्रियमे(?) वाऽपि भोगमोक्षप्रदक्षमे || 10 ||
text_mt: or in liberation free from affliction, blissful, and consisting of consciousness; / or in the realm of mantra capable of granting worldly enjoyment and liberation. // 10

sanskrit_iast: [svādhikārānuguṇaṃ mantrārādhane pravṛttasya jñānodayaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [स्वाधिकारानुगुणं मन्त्राराधने प्रवृत्तस्य ज्ञानोदयप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The manner of the arising of knowledge for one engaged in the worship of mantra according to his qualification]

sanskrit_iast:
mantrārādhanasaktastu tatsiddhīnāmalolupaḥ |
bhaktastaddhyānaniṣṭhaśca tatkriyāparamo mahān || 11 ||
meaning:
मन्त्राराधनसक्तस्तु तत्सिद्धीनामलोलुपः |
भक्तस्तद्ध्याननिष्ठश्च तत्क्रियापरमो महान् || 11 ||
text_mt: Devoted to the worship of mantra, yet not covetous of its attainments, / faithful, intent on meditation upon it, dedicated to its rituals, noble, // 11

sanskrit_iast:
tadādyabhimukhākāṃkṣī brahmacaryavrate sthitaḥ |
bhavaṃ bhāvayate samyak duḥkhaśokapradaṃ mahat || 12 ||
meaning:
तदाद्यभिमुखाकांक्षी ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितः |
भवं भावयते सम्यक् दुःखशोकप्रदं महत् || 12 ||
text_mt: longing to face that Primal One, established in the vow of celibacy, / he contemplates thoroughly transmigratory existence as producing great suffering and grief, // 12

sanskrit_iast:
anityamadhruvaṃ kaṣṭaṃ jarāmaraṇasaṅkulam |
dvandvayogabhayākrāntamaparyāptamanaśvaram || 13 ||
meaning:
अनित्यमध्रुवं कष्टं जरामरणसङ्कुलम् |
द्वन्द्वयोगभयाक्रान्तमपर्याप्तमनश्वरम् || 13 ||
text_mt: impermanent, unstable, difficult, fraught with old age and death, / overcome by the fear of contact with dualities, insufficient, and ceaseless. // 13

sanskrit_iast:
sadaitaccintanācchaśvattathā mantrādyanugrahāt |
niyamāccāpi śārīrātparaṃ vairāgyamāvahet || 14 ||
meaning:
सदैतच्चिन्तनाच्छश्वत्तथा मन्त्राद्यनुग्रहात् |
नियमाच्चापि शारीरात्परं वैराग्यमावहेत् || 14 ||
text_mt: From constantly contemplating this always, and through the grace of the mantra and other [means], / and also from bodily restraint, he attains supreme detachment. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
vairāgyācca tato vipra viṣayaiḥ kaluṣīkṛtam |
śaratkāle jalaṃ yadvaccittameti prasannatām || 15 ||
meaning:
वैराग्याच्च ततो विप्र विषयैः कलुषीकृतम् |
शरत्काले जलं यद्वच्चित्तमेति प्रसन्नताम् || 15 ||
text_mt: And from detachment, O brahmin, the mind defiled by sense objects / reaches lucidity, just as water does in the autumn season. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
prasannasthiratāṃ yāti nistaraṅga ivodadhiḥ |
nivātācaladīpābhamacalaṃ bodhasammukham || 16 ||
meaning:
प्रसन्नस्थिरतां याति निस्तरङ्ग इवोदधिः |
निवाताचलदीपाभमचलं बोधसम्मुखम् || 16 ||
text_mt: Serene, it attains stability like an ocean without waves; / resembling an unwavering lamp in a windless place, motionless, facing awakening. // 16

sanskrit_iast:
yattaccittamivā(mathā)pannaḥ pumāṃścaitanyalakṣaṇaḥ |
saṃbodhaṃ ca tadāpnoti tajjñānaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam || 17 ||
meaning:
यत्तच्चित्तमिवा(मथा)पन्नः पुमांश्चैतन्यलक्षणः |
संबोधं च तदाप्नोति तज्ज्ञानं परमं स्मृतम् || 17 ||
text_mt: Then, having attained, as it were, that mind, the person characterized by consciousness / obtains awakening; that is considered the supreme knowledge. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
saiva ciddhṛdayākāśe hyudetyādityavatkramāt |
tenādhigamyate jñeyaṃ yadvatsūryodayājjagat || 18 ||
meaning:
सैव चिद्धृदयाकाशे ह्युदेत्यादित्यवत्क्रमात् |
तेनाधिगम्यते ज्ञेयं यद्वत्सूर्योदयाज्जगत् || 18 ||
text_mt: That very consciousness gradually arises in the space of the heart like the sun; / by it the knowable is apprehended, just as the world is by sunrise. // 18

sanskrit_iast:
sambodho jñeyaniṣṭhā sā tadā'yāti śanaiśśanaiḥ |
tadā samarasatvaṃ hi saha tenaiva tasya hi || 19 ||
meaning:
सम्बोधो ज्ञेयनिष्ठा सा तदाऽयाति शनैश्शनैः |
तदा समरसत्वं हि सह तेनैव तस्य हि || 19 ||
text_mt: Awakening, which is fixed on the knowable, then comes little by little; / then indeed occurs his oneness of flavor with that [Supreme] alone. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyajñaptikaraṃ jñānaṃ kramopetaṃ ca nārada |
nirvāṇadamasaṅkīrṇamidaṃ te saṃprakāśitam || 20 ||
meaning:
ज्ञेयज्ञप्तिकरं ज्ञानं क्रमोपेतं च नारद |
निर्वाणदमसङ्कीर्णमिदं ते संप्रकाशितम् || 20 ||
text_mt: Knowledge that reveals the knowable, accompanied by stages, O Nārada, / granting liberation, unmixed—this has been fully revealed to you. // 20

sanskrit_iast:
yuktitastadabhinnaṃ ca bhedavatpratibhāti yat |
tathā'pīdaṃ svabhāvena viddhi nātaḥ paraṃ tu vai || 21 ||
meaning:
युक्तितस्तदभिन्नं च भेदवत्प्रतिभाति यत् |
तथाऽपीदं स्वभावेन विद्धि नातः परं तु वै || 21 ||
text_mt: By reasoning it is non-different, though it appears as differentiated; / nevertheless, know this by its own nature; there is indeed nothing beyond this. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
p. 40) vidyate brahmaśārdūla kiṃ vā tatra pravartate |
yathedaṃ te mayā vipra svālokaṃ prakaṭīkṛtam || 22 ||
meaning:
प्. 40) विद्यते ब्रह्मशार्दूल किं वा तत्र प्रवर्तते |
यथेदं ते मया विप्र स्वालोकं प्रकटीकृतम् || 22 ||
text_mt: Does it exist, O tiger among brahmins, or what operates there? / As this has been revealed to you by me, O brahmin, through its own illumination, // 22 [p. 40]

sanskrit_iast: anubhūtaṃ na bhūyastvaṃ mayā vaktuṃ hi śakṣyase |
meaning: अनुभूतं न भूयस्त्वं मया वक्तुं हि शक्ष्यसे |
text_mt: once experienced, you will indeed not be able to state it further to me.

sanskrit_iast: [brahmaṇo duravabodhatvam]
meaning: [ब्रह्मणो दुरवबोधत्वम्]
text_mt: [The incomprehensibility of Brahman]

sanskrit_iast: avācye vartate kutra vāg vai saṃvedanaṃ vinā || 23 ||
meaning: अवाच्ये वर्तते कुत्र वाग् वै संवेदनं विना || 23 ||
text_mt: Where does speech operate concerning the inexpressible, without direct perception? // 23

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇṇāṃ yadvadrasānāṃ ca svādutvaṃ nānubhūyate |
prākṛtaiḥ karaṇaistadvannābhivyaktiṃ bahirvrajet || 24 ||
meaning:
षण्णां यद्वद्रसानां च स्वादुत्वं नानुभूयते |
प्राकृतैः करणैस्तद्वन्नाभिव्यक्तिं बहिर्व्रजेत् || 24 ||
text_mt: Just as the sweetness of the six tastes cannot be experienced / by ordinary senses, so it cannot be manifested externally. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ hyupamānena tatpratyakṣaṃ prakāśyate |
pravartanārthaṃ mandānāṃ nāmandānāṃ tu vai punaḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
केवलं ह्युपमानेन तत्प्रत्यक्षं प्रकाश्यते |
प्रवर्तनार्थं मन्दानां नामन्दानां तु वै पुनः || 25 ||
text_mt: Direct perception of it is shown merely through analogy, / for the guidance of the dull-witted, but certainly not for the sharp. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
yogī samarasatvena vedaya tvaṃ vicārarataḥ |
tasmāttvameva viprendra anubhūtaṃ sthirīkuru || 26 ||
meaning:
योगी समरसत्वेन वेदय त्वं विचाररतः |
तस्मात्त्वमेव विप्रेन्द्र अनुभूतं स्थिरीकुरु || 26 ||
text_mt: As a yogin, delighted in inquiry, experience it through oneness of flavor; / therefore, O chief of brahmins, stabilize what you yourself have experienced, // 26

sanskrit_iast:
layameṣyasi yenātra nijānande hyanūpame |
bhūtānandasvarūpeṇa tyaktvā samyakparigraham || 27 ||
meaning:
लयमेष्यसि येनात्र निजानन्दे ह्यनूपमे |
भूतानन्दस्वरूपेण त्यक्त्वा सम्यक्परिग्रहम् || 27 ||
text_mt: whereby you will attain dissolution here in your own incomparable bliss, / in the form of the bliss of reality, having completely abandoned all possessions. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
niveditaṃ mayā yatte tattadvācyaṃ na jātu vai |
tvayā yadanubhūtaṃ ca tadānīṃ mayi manyase || 28 ||
meaning:
निवेदितं मया यत्ते तत्तद्वाच्यं न जातु वै |
त्वया यदनुभूतं च तदानीं मयि मन्यसे || 28 ||
text_mt: What has been disclosed to you by me cannot ever be expressed as this or that; / what has been experienced by you, that at that time you consider to be in me. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopamānarahitaṃ vāgatītaṃ svavedanam |
astīti paramaṃ vastu nirālambamatīndriyam || 29 ||
meaning:
सर्वोपमानरहितं वागतीतं स्ववेदनम् |
अस्तीति परमं वस्तु निरालम्बमतीन्द्रियम् || 29 ||
text_mt: Deceiving all comparison, beyond speech, self-known, / the supreme entity exists, without support, beyond the senses. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanyānandasaṃsthasya vyajyate karaṇairvinā |
karaṇāḥ prākṛtāssarve cittajāśca viśeṣataḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
आत्मन्यानन्दसंस्थस्य व्यज्यते करणैर्विना |
करणाः प्राकृतास्सर्वे चित्तजाश्च विशेषतः || 30 ||
text_mt: It is manifested without instruments to one residing in the bliss within the self; / all instruments are material, especially those born of the mind. // 30

sanskrit_iast: [mantrasamāghyormantrasya sukaropāyatvam]
meaning: [मन्त्रसमाघ्योर्मन्त्रस्य सुकरोपायत्वम्]
text_mt: [The easy approachability of mantra compared to meditative absorption]

sanskrit_iast:
upāyamatra mantraughāssamantrāste ca siddhidāḥ |
tasmānmudrādikaraṇā bhāvajāśca samādhayaḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
उपायमत्र मन्त्रौघास्समन्त्रास्ते च सिद्धिदाः |
तस्मान्मुद्रादिकरणा भावजाश्च समाधयः || 31 ||
text_mt: Here, the hosts of mantras are the means, and endowed with mantras they grant attainment; / therefore, the mudrās and other [gestures] and the meditative absorptions born of inner contemplation, // 31

sanskrit_iast:
kriyopetāstathā mantrāḥ sarve sadvastusādhakāḥ |
vighnāyutasahasraṃ tu parotsāhasamanvitam || 32 ||
meaning:
क्रियोपेतास्तथा मन्त्राः सर्वे सद्वस्तुसाधकाः |
विघ्नायुतसहस्रं तु परोत्साहसमन्वितम् || 32 ||
text_mt: as well as mantras accompanied by ritual actions, all accomplish the true entity. / For tens of thousands of obstacles, endowed with supreme zeal, // 32

sanskrit_iast:
praharantyaniśaṃ tacca sarva(syā)bhimukhasya ca |
mantrapūrvaṃ hi yatkiñcitsthūlaṃ brahmavyapekṣayā || 33 ||
meaning:
प्रहरन्त्यनिशं तच्च सर्व(स्या)भिमुखस्य च |
मन्त्रपूर्वं हि यत्किञ्चित्स्थूलं ब्रह्मव्यपेक्षया || 33 ||
text_mt: incessantly strike that and everyone who turns toward it. / Whatever begins with mantra, being gross in relation to Brahman, // 33

sanskrit_iast:
vighnajālasya sarvasya vīryadhvaṃsakaraṃ smṛtam |
yathāgnerdāhasāmarthyamudakena nipātyate || 34 ||
meaning:
विघ्नजालस्य सर्वस्य वीर्यध्वंसकरं स्मृतम् |
यथाग्नेर्दाहसामर्थ्यमुदकेन निपात्यते || 34 ||
text_mt: is known to destroy the potency of the entire web of obstacles, / just as the burning capacity of fire is subdued by water. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
p. 41) māyārūpastu vighnaugho mantrādyairupahanyate |
nikaṭasthā yathā rājñastvanyeṣāṃ sādhayanti ca || 35 ||
meaning:
प्. 41) मायारूपस्तु विघ्नौघो मन्त्राद्यैरुपहन्यते |
निकटस्था यथा राज्ञस्त्वन्येषां साधयन्ति च || 35 ||
text_mt: The host of obstacles consisting of māyā is struck down by mantras and other means; / just as those near the king accomplish for others // 35 [p. 41]

sanskrit_iast:
siddhiṃ rājopagāṃ śīghramevaṃ mantrādayaḥ param |
jñātvaivaṃ sarvadā vipra ya āste yatparāyaṇaḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
सिद्धिं राजोपगां शीघ्रमेवं मन्त्रादयः परम् |
ज्ञात्वैवं सर्वदा विप्र य आस्ते यत्परायणः || 46 ||
text_mt: success related to the king swiftly, so do mantras and the rest regarding the Supreme. / Knowing this, O brahmin, he who remains at all times devoted to that // 46

sanskrit_iast: abhīpsitena mārgeṇa niṣpadyetācirāttu saḥ |
meaning: अभीप्सितेन मार्गेण निष्पद्येताचिरात्तु सः |
text_mt: will be perfected before long by the desired path.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ brahmajñānotpattyākhyānaṃ
nāma pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां ब्रह्मज्ञानोत्पत्त्याख्यानं
नाम पञ्चमः पटलः || 5 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the fifth chapter, titled 'The Account of the Arising of Knowledge of Brahman', in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the venerable Pāñcarātra. // 5

sanskrit_iast: atha mukhyamantroddhāro nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: अथ मुख्यमन्त्रोद्धारो नाम षष्ठः पटलः
text_mt: Now begins the sixth chapter, titled 'Extraction of the Principal Mantra'.

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ
meaning: नारदः

sanskrit_iast:
tvatprasādena bhagavansaṃvillabdhā mayā parā |
manasaścañcalatvācca nahi me sthiratāṃ vrajet || 1 ||
meaning:
त्वत्प्रसादेन भगवन्संविल्लब्धा मया परा |
मनसश्चञ्चलत्वाच्च नहि मे स्थिरतां व्रजेत् || 1 ||
text_mt: By your grace, O Blessed One, supreme consciousness has been attained by me; / but due to the restlessness of the mind, it does not attain stability for me. // 1

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ pūrvoditānsarvānupāyānkathayasva me |
aśeṣāṃśca krameṇaiva bhogamokṣaphalapradān || 2 ||
meaning:
अतः पूर्वोदितान्सर्वानुपायान्कथयस्व मे |
अशेषांश्च क्रमेणैव भोगमोक्षफलप्रदान् || 2 ||
text_mt: Therefore, tell me all the means spoken of earlier, / without exception, in proper sequence, which bestow the fruits of enjoyment and liberation. // 2

sanskrit_iast: [mantranirūpaṇārambhaḥ]
meaning: [मन्त्रनिरूपणारम्भः]
text_mt: [Commencement of the exposition of mantras]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast:
sādhu nārada pṛṣṭo'haṃ sārabhūtamidaṃ tvayā |
mantrapūrvaṃ hi vai sarvaṃ yattvayā paricoditam || 3 ||
meaning:
साधु नारद पृष्टोऽहं सारभूतमिदं त्वया |
मन्त्रपूर्वं हि वै सर्वं यत्त्वया परिचोदितम् || 3 ||
text_mt: Well asked, O Nārada! This question asked by you is the very essence; / for everything about which you have inquired begins with mantra. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham |
sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpeṇa nānāsiddhiphalapradam || 4 ||
meaning:
तस्मान्मन्त्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शुभम् |
स्थूलसूक्ष्मस्वरूपेण नानासिद्धिफलप्रदम् || 4 ||
text_mt: Therefore, I shall proclaim the auspicious mantra that grants worldly enjoyment and liberation, / in its gross and subtle forms, bestowing the fruit of various attainments, // 4

sanskrit_iast: śaktyaṅgāvaraṇopetamanekādbhutadarśanam |
meaning: शक्त्यङ्गावरणोपेतमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् |
text_mt: endowed with powers, ancillary mantras, and enclosures, showing many wonders.

sanskrit_iast: [mātṛkāpīṭhaparikalpanāprakāraḥ]
meaning: [मातृकापीठपरिकल्पनाप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure for preparing the seat of the mātṛkā]

sanskrit_iast: bhūmibhāge same śuddhe mṛdgomayasulepite || 5 ||
meaning: भूमिभागे समे शुद्धे मृद्गोमयसुलेपिते || 5 ||
text_mt: On an even, clean piece of ground, smeared well with clay and cow dung, // 5

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyena saṃsikte candanādyupalepite |
nivāte ca susaṃcchanne dhūpairapyadhivāsite || 6 ||
meaning:
पञ्चगव्येन संसिक्ते चन्दनाद्युपलेपिते |
निवाते च सुसंच्छन्ने धूपैरप्यधिवासिते || 6 ||
text_mt: sprinkled with the five products of the cow, smeared with sandalwood and other [pastes], / windless, well-covered, and perfumed with incenses, // 6

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdukalhārakusumaiḥ kevalaiḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
praṇavādinamontena svanāmnā pūjya vai purā || 7 ||
meaning:
मृदुकल्हारकुसुमैः केवलैः कुसुमैः शुभैः |
प्रणवादिनमोन्तेन स्वनाम्ना पूज्य वै पुरा || 7 ||
text_mt: having first worshipped with soft white water lilies alone, [or] with pure flowers, / using his own name preceded by praṇava and ending with 'namaḥ', // 7

sanskrit_iast:
parijapyātha bahuśo mṛdaṃ bhūmau prasārya ca |
caturaśraṃ suvṛttaṃ ca dvihastaṃ hastameva vā || 8 ||
meaning:
परिजप्याथ बहुशो मृदं भूमौ प्रसार्य च |
चतुरश्रं सुवृत्तं च द्विहस्तं हस्तमेव वा || 8 ||
text_mt: and having recited repeatedly, and spreading clay on the ground, / square or well-rounded, two cubits or one cubit in size, // 8

sanskrit_iast: p. 42) susamaṃ mātṛkāpīṭhaṃ kṛtvā prastārya tāmapi |
meaning: प्. 42) सुसमं मातृकापीठं कृत्वा प्रस्तार्य तामपि |
text_mt: having made a very even seat of the mātṛkā, and also having laid it out: // p. 42

sanskrit_iast: [akṣareṣu vibhāvyo bhagavataḥ sthitibhedaḥ]
meaning: [अक्षरेषु विभाव्यो भगवतः स्थितिभेदः]
text_mt: [The distinct modes of the Blessed One's presence in the letters]

sanskrit_iast: ekaiva bhinnavargā ca vargānte'pyasamākṣarāḥ || 9 ||
meaning: एकैव भिन्नवर्गा च वर्गान्तेऽप्यसमाक्षराः || 9 ||
text_mt: It is single, yet has different groups, and the letters at the end of the groups are unequal. // 9

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśākṣara ādyastu akārādyo dvijottama |
visargāntasthitastasminnagnīṣomātmakaḥ prabhuḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
षोडशाक्षर आद्यस्तु अकाराद्यो द्विजोत्तम |
विसर्गान्तस्थितस्तस्मिन्नग्नीषोमात्मकः प्रभुः || 10 ||
text_mt: The first group consists of sixteen letters, beginning with 'a', O best among the twice-born; / ending with the visarga, in it the Lord abides, consisting of Agni and Soma. // 10

sanskrit_iast:
pañcārṇānāṃ tu pañcānāṃ vargāṇāṃ parameśvaraḥ |
susthitaḥ kādimāntānāṃ tattvātmatvena sarvadā || 11 ||
meaning:
पञ्चार्णानां तु पञ्चानां वर्गाणां परमेश्वरः |
सुस्थितः कादिमान्तानां तत्त्वात्मत्वेन सर्वदा || 11 ||
text_mt: In the five groups of five letters beginning with 'ka' and ending with 'ma', the Supreme Lord / is well-established at all times as the nature of the tattvas. // 11

sanskrit_iast:
jāgradādikrameṇaiva sthito'vasthātmanātra vai |
yādivānte caturvarṇe varge viprendra sattame || 12 ||
meaning:
जाग्रदादिक्रमेणैव स्थितोऽवस्थात्मनात्र वै |
यादिवान्ते चतुर्वर्णे वर्गे विप्रेन्द्र सत्तमे || 12 ||
text_mt: Abiding indeed here as the nature of the states, in the sequence of waking and the rest, / in the four-letter group beginning with 'ya' and ending with 'va', O excellent sage, best of Brahmins; // 12

sanskrit_iast:
turyātītātmarūpeṇa śādikṣānteṣu saṃsthitaḥ |
ālokastīkṣṇatā vyāptirgrahaṇaṃ kṣepaṇeraṇe || 13 ||
meaning:
तुर्यातीतात्मरूपेण शादिक्षान्तेषु संस्थितः |
आलोकस्तीक्ष्णता व्याप्तिर्ग्रहणं क्षेपणेरणे || 13 ||
text_mt: in those beginning with 'śa' and ending with 'kṣa', he is established as the nature of that which transcends the fourth [state]. / Light, sharpness, pervasion, grasping, throwing, urging, // 13

sanskrit_iast:
pākaḥ prāptiriti hyaṣṭau sūryabhāge vyavasthitāḥ |
akārādiṣu hrasveṣu varṇeṣveteṣvanukramāt || 14 ||
meaning:
पाकः प्राप्तिरिति ह्यष्टौ सूर्यभागे व्यवस्थिताः |
अकारादिषु ह्रस्वेषु वर्णेष्वेतेष्वनुक्रमात् || 14 ||
text_mt: cooking, and attainment: these eight are indeed established in the solar portion / among these short letters beginning with 'a', in proper order. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
dravatā śaityabhāvāśca tṛptiḥkāntiḥ prasannatā |
rasatā'hlāda ānando hyaṣṭau cāndrāstvimā matāḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
द्रवता शैत्यभावाश्च तृप्तिःकान्तिः प्रसन्नता |
रसताऽह्लाद आनन्दो ह्यष्टौ चान्द्रास्त्विमा मताः || 15 ||
text_mt: Fluidity, coldness, satisfaction, radiance, serenity, / sapidity, gladness, and bliss: these eight are considered lunar. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
ākārādiṣu dīrgheṣu saṃsthitā mātṛkātmanā |
avinābhāvarūpeṇa anyonyena sadaiva hi || 16 ||
meaning:
आकारादिषु दीर्घेषु संस्थिता मातृकात्मना |
अविनाभावरूपेण अन्योन्येन सदैव हि || 16 ||
text_mt: They reside in the long vowels beginning with 'ā' in the form of the mātṛkā, / through mutual, invariable concomitance, eternally indeed. // 16

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭānāmapi cāṣṭau tu saṃsthitā bahirantare |
kṣmāditattvasamūhastu puruṣāntaḥ krameṇa tu || 17 ||
meaning:
अष्टानामपि चाष्टौ तु संस्थिता बहिरन्तरे |
क्ष्मादितत्त्वसमूहस्तु पुरुषान्तः क्रमेण तु || 17 ||
text_mt: The eight of both [solar and lunar sets] abide externally and internally. / The collection of tattvas, however, beginning with earth and ending with puruṣa, in order, // 17

sanskrit_iast:
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptaṃ ca turyamūrdhve'tra vartate |
saṃsthitaḥ paramālokaśabdo nityoditaḥ paraḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तं च तुर्यमूर्ध्वेऽत्र वर्तते |
संस्थितः परमालोकशब्दो नित्योदितः परः || 18 ||
text_mt: and waking, dreaming, deep sleep, and the fourth [state] dwell above here. / Abiding as the supreme light and sound, eternally risen, supreme, // 18

sanskrit_iast:
parānandaśca samatā vedyavedakavarjitaḥ |
svarūpametatkathitaṃ turyātītātmano vibhoḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
परानन्दश्च समता वेद्यवेदकवर्जितः |
स्वरूपमेतत्कथितं तुर्यातीतात्मनो विभोः || 19 ||
text_mt: supreme bliss and equanimity, free from the known and the knower: / this is proclaimed as the intrinsic form of the all-pervading Lord whose nature transcends the fourth [state]. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
[evaṃ bhagavataḥ sthitiṃ vibhāvyollikhyamānānāmakṣarāṇaṃ
bhagavanmātṛkādeharūpatā]
meaning:
[एवं भगवतः स्थितिं विभाव्योल्लिख्यमानानामक्षराणं
भगवन्मातृकादेहरूपता]
text_mt: [The letters, being inscribed while meditating thus on the Lord's presence, have the form of the Lord's mātṛkā-body]

sanskrit_iast:
iti varṇaprabhāvaṃ ca vyāpakaṃ cānubhūtigam |
budhvā ca lipirūpeṇa saṃlikhedyena kenacit || 20 ||
meaning:
इति वर्णप्रभावं च व्यापकं चानुभूतिगम् |
बुध्वा च लिपिरूपेण संलिखेद्येन केनचित् || 20 ||
text_mt: Having understood thus the power of the letters, all-pervading and within experience, / one should write them down in the form of script with whatever [implement]; // 20

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvedyo'pi janenaiva na lipirvipra mātṛkāḥ |
paramaḥ puruṣo divyo yo'nubhūtaḥ purā tvayā || 21 ||
meaning:
संवेद्योऽपि जनेनैव न लिपिर्विप्र मातृकाः |
परमः पुरुषो दिव्यो योऽनुभूतः पुरा त्वया || 21 ||
text_mt: for the mātṛkās are to be known by people not merely as script, O Brahmin. / That supreme, divine Puruṣa who was experienced by you of old— // 21

sanskrit_iast: tasyāyaṃ mātṛkādehaḥ caturdhā saṃvyavasthitaḥ |
meaning: तस्यायं मातृकादेहः चतुर्धा संव्यवस्थितः |
text_mt: this is his mātṛkā-body, established in four ways.

sanskrit_iast: p. 43) [mātṛkāyāḥ svavigrahe nyāsakramaḥ]
meaning: प्. 43) [मातृकायाः स्वविग्रहे न्यासक्रमः]
text_mt: p. 43) [The order of nyāsa of the mātṛkā upon one's own body]

sanskrit_iast: sūtreṇa maṇayo yadvatprotāstvekena nārada || 22 ||
meaning: सूत्रेण मणयो यद्वत्प्रोतास्त्वेकेन नारद || 22 ||
text_mt: Just as gems are strung upon a single thread, O Nārada, // 22

sanskrit_iast:
tadvadvarṇā mayā tantusvarūpeṇāvyayātmanā |
iti cetasi vai kṛtvā mantrānuddharate ca yaḥ || 23 ||
meaning:
तद्वद्वर्णा मया तन्तुस्वरूपेणाव्ययात्मना |
इति चेतसि वै कृत्वा मन्त्रानुद्धरते च यः || 23 ||
text_mt: so the letters are [strung] by me in the form of a thread whose nature is imperishable. / Having kept this in mind, he who extracts the mantras // 23

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaprāptistasya mantrātprajāyate |
evaṃ svavigrahe nyasya mātṛkāṃ mantramātrakām || 24 ||
meaning:
दृष्टादृष्टफलप्राप्तिस्तस्य मन्त्रात्प्रजायते |
एवं स्वविग्रहे न्यस्य मातृकां मन्त्रमात्रकाम् || 24 ||
text_mt: attains the seen and unseen fruits born from that mantra. / Having thus applied the mātṛkā, consisting of mantras, to his own body, // 24

sanskrit_iast:
vastupūrṇeṣu tattveṣu sveṣu sveṣūditeṣu ca |
snātvā śuklāmbaradharassrakcandanavibhūṣitaḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
वस्तुपूर्णेषु तत्त्वेषु स्वेषु स्वेषूदितेषु च |
स्नात्वा शुक्लाम्बरधरस्स्रक्चन्दनविभूषितः || 25 ||
text_mt: when each of his own tattvas has arisen full of reality, / having bathed, wearing white garments, adorned with garlands and sandalwood paste, // 25

sanskrit_iast: [mantramātṛkoddhārakramaḥ]
meaning: [मन्त्रमातृकोद्धारक्रमः]
text_mt: [The procedure for extracting the mantra-mātṛkā]

sanskrit_iast:
tāmeva prastarenmantrī aṣṭavargāṃ pṛthaksthitām |
aṣṭāre tu mahācakre madhyataḥ suvibhūṣite || 26 ||
meaning:
तामेव प्रस्तरेन्मन्त्री अष्टवर्गां पृथक्स्थिताम् |
अष्टारे तु महाचक्रे मध्यतः सुविभूषिते || 26 ||
text_mt: the mantrin should lay out that very [mātṛkā] standing separately in eight groups / upon a great eight-spoked cakra, well-adorned in the middle, // 26

sanskrit_iast:
prāgarādi kṣakārāntamavargādikrameṇa tu |
madhyataḥ praṇavaṃ likhya varṇacakraṃ prabhuṃ param || 27 ||
meaning:
प्रागरादि क्षकारान्तमवर्गादिक्रमेण तु |
मध्यतः प्रणवं लिख्य वर्णचक्रं प्रभुं परम् || 27 ||
text_mt: beginning with the eastern spoke and ending with 'kṣa', in the order of the 'a'-group and the rest. / Having written the praṇava in the center—the cakra of letters, the supreme Lord— // 27

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaṃ tu svasaṃjñābhiścakrāreṣvakṣaraṃ likhet |
yāvanniṣpadyate vargasshitaḥ svaissvairarāntare || 28 ||
meaning:
एकैकं तु स्वसंज्ञाभिश्चक्रारेष्वक्षरं लिखेत् |
यावन्निष्पद्यते वर्गस्स्हितः स्वैस्स्वैररान्तरे || 28 ||
text_mt: he should write each letter upon the spokes of the cakra with their own names / until the group is completed, established in their respective spoke-intervals. // 28

sanskrit_iast: svaravyañjanasaṃyuktāṃ mātṛkāmagrato yajet |
meaning: स्वरव्यञ्जनसंयुक्तां मातृकामग्रतो यजेत् |
text_mt: He should worship the mātṛkā endowed with vowels and consonants in front.

sanskrit_iast: [mātṛkāpūjanaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [मातृकापूजनप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The manner of worshipping the mātṛkā]

sanskrit_iast: pādyārghyapuṣpadhūpena dīpena ca vilepanaiḥ || 29 ||
meaning: पाद्यार्घ्यपुष्पधूपेन दीपेन च विलेपनैः || 29 ||
text_mt: With water for the feet, respectful offering, flowers, incense, a lamp, and unguents, // 29

sanskrit_iast:
phalamūlādinaivedyairoṃnamomantramātṛke |
saṃpūjyaśca tato bhaktyā mātṛkāvigrahaḥ pumān || 30 ||
meaning:
फलमूलादिनैवेद्यैरोंनमोमन्त्रमातृके |
संपूज्यश्च ततो भक्त्या मातृकाविग्रहः पुमान् || 30 ||
text_mt: with food-offerings such as fruits and roots, with "oṃ namo mantramātṛke", / the Puruṣa whose body is the mātṛkā should then be worshipped with devotion. // 30

sanskrit_iast:
prāguktena svanāmnā vai praṇatyā praṇavena ca |
svābhidhābhiḥ krameṇāto hyekaikaṃ cākṣaraṃ yajet || 31 ||
meaning:
प्रागुक्तेन स्वनाम्ना वै प्रणत्या प्रणवेन च |
स्वाभिधाभिः क्रमेणातो ह्येकैकं चाक्षरं यजेत् || 31 ||
text_mt: Then he should worship each single letter in order by its own appellations, / with its own previously stated name, with bowings, and with the praṇava, // 31

sanskrit_iast: madhyāhnabhāskarākāraṃ prasphurantaṃ vicintya ca |
meaning: मध्याह्नभास्कराकारं प्रस्फुरन्तं विचिन्त्य च |
text_mt: meditating on it as flashing forth, having the appearance of the midday sun.

sanskrit_iast: [bhagavadrūpāṇāmakṣarāṇāmakārādikrameṇābhidhābhedaḥ]
meaning: [भगवद्रूपाणामक्षराणामकारादिक्रमेणाभिधाभेदः]
text_mt: [The different names of the forms of the Lord in the order of the letters beginning with 'a']

sanskrit_iast: akāraścāprameyaśca prathamo (bhavo ?) vyāpakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 32 ||
meaning: अकारश्चाप्रमेयश्च प्रथमो (भवो ?) व्यापकः स्मृतः || 32 ||
text_mt: The letter 'a' is remembered as the Immeasurable, the First, the All-Pervading. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
ādidevastathā'kāra ānando gopanaḥ smṛtaḥ |
rāmasaṃjña ikāraśca iṣṭa iddhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
आदिदेवस्तथाऽकार आनन्दो गोपनः स्मृतः |
रामसंज्ञ इकारश्च इष्ट इद्धः प्रकीर्तितः || 33 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ā' is remembered as the Primal God, Bliss, the Concealer. / The letter 'i' is named Rāma, proclaimed as the Desired, the Kindled. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
īkāraḥ pañca bindurvai viṣṇormāyā dvijādhipa |
ukāro bhuvanākhyaśca uddāma udayastathā || 34 ||
meaning:
ईकारः पञ्च बिन्दुर्वै विष्णोर्माया द्विजाधिप |
उकारो भुवनाख्यश्च उद्दाम उदयस्तथा || 34 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ī' is indeed the Five-Fold Bindu, the Māyā of Viṣṇu, O lord among the twice-born. / The letter 'u' is named the World, the Unrestrained, and the Arising. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
p. 44) ūkāra ūrjo lokeśaḥ prajñādhārastathaiva ca |
satyaśca ṛttadhāmā ca ṛkārassa tu cāṅkuśaḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
प्. 44) ऊकार ऊर्जो लोकेशः प्रज्ञाधारस्तथैव च |
सत्यश्च ऋत्तधामा च ऋकारस्स तु चाङ्कुशः || 35 ||
text_mt: p. 44) The letter 'ū' is Vigour, Lord of the World, and the Support of Wisdom. / The letter 'ṛ' is Truth, having Rta as Abode, and the Goad. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkāraṃ viṣṭaraṃ viddhi jvālā saiva prasāraṇam |
liṅgātmā bhagavānprokto ḷkārastārakassmṛtaḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
ऋकारं विष्टरं विद्धि ज्वाला सैव प्रसारणम् |
लिङ्गात्मा भगवान्प्रोक्तो ऌकारस्तारकस्स्मृतः || 36 ||
text_mt: Know the letter 'ṝ' to be the Seat, the Flame, and Expansion. / The Lord is taught as having the nature of the Liṅga; the letter 'ḷ' is remembered as the Rescuer. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
ḷkāro dīrghaghoṇaśca devadatto virāṭ sa tu |
tryaśra ekārasaṃjñastu jagadyoniravigrahaḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
ऌकारो दीर्घघोणश्च देवदत्तो विराट् स तु |
त्र्यश्र एकारसंज्ञस्तु जगद्योनिरविग्रहः || 37 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ḹ' is Long-Nosed, Devadatta, and Virāṭ. / That named the letter 'e' is the Triangle, the Womb of the World, the Bodiless. // 37

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryaṃ yogadhātā ca ai samairāvaṇassmṛtaḥ |
okāra otadehaśca odanassa ca vikramī || 38 ||
meaning:
ऐश्वर्यं योगधाता च ऐ समैरावणस्स्मृतः |
ओकार ओतदेहश्च ओदनस्स च विक्रमी || 38 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ai' is remembered as Sovereignty, Giver of Yoga, and Airāvaṇa with the Gods. / The letter 'o' has an Interwoven Body, is Nourishment, and the Valorous. // 38

sanskrit_iast:
aurvo'tha bhūdharākhyaśca aussmṛto hyauṣadhātmakaḥ |
trailokyaiśvaryado vyāpī vyomeśo'ṅkāra eva ca || 39 ||
meaning:
और्वोऽथ भूधराख्यश्च औस्स्मृतो ह्यौषधात्मकः |
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदो व्यापी व्योमेशोऽङ्कार एव च || 39 ||
text_mt: The letter 'au' is remembered as Aurva, named the Earth-Bearer, and consisting of Herbs. / The letter 'aṃ' is the Giver of Sovereignty over the Three Worlds, the All-Pervading, and the Lord of Ether. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
visargaḥ sṛṣṭikṛtkhyāto hyakāraḥ parameśvaraḥ |
kamalaśca karālaśca kakāraḥ prakṛtiḥ parā || 40 ||
meaning:
विसर्गः सृष्टिकृत्ख्यातो ह्यकारः परमेश्वरः |
कमलश्च करालश्च ककारः प्रकृतिः परा || 40 ||
text_mt: The visarga is known as the Creator; the letter 'aḥ' is the Supreme Lord. / The letter 'ka' is the Lotus, the Dreadful, and the Supreme Prakṛti. // 40

sanskrit_iast:
khakāraḥ kharvadehaśca vedātmā viśvabhāvanaḥ |
gadadhvaṃsī gakāraśca govindassa gadādharaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
खकारः खर्वदेहश्च वेदात्मा विश्वभावनः |
गदध्वंसी गकारश्च गोविन्दस्स गदाधरः || 41 ||
text_mt: The letter 'kha' has a Stunted Body, consists of the Veda, and is the Originator of the Universe. / The letter 'ga' is the Destroyer of Affliction, Govinda, and the Bearer of the Mace. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
ghakāraścaiva dharmāṃśustejasvī dīptimānsmṛtaḥ |
ṅakāra ekadaṃṣṭraśca bhūtātmā viśvabhāvakaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
घकारश्चैव धर्मांशुस्तेजस्वी दीप्तिमान्स्मृतः |
ङकार एकदंष्ट्रश्च भूतात्मा विश्वभावकः || 42 ||
text_mt: The letter 'gha' is remembered as the Sun, Splendid, and Luminous. / The letter 'ṅa' has a Single Tusk, is the Self of Beings, and Creator of the Universe. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
cakāraścaṃcalaścakrī candrāśussa ca kathyate |
chakāraḥ chalavidhvaṃsī chandaśchandaḥpatiḥ smṛtaḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
चकारश्चंचलश्चक्री चन्द्राशुस्स च कथ्यते |
छकारः छलविध्वंसी छन्दश्छन्दःपतिः स्मृतः || 43 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ca' is spoken of as Fickle, Bearer of the Discus, and having Moonbeams. / The letter 'cha' is remembered as Destroyer of Deceit, Metre, and Master of Metre. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
ajito janmahantā ca jakārassa ca śāśvataḥ |
jhaṣo jhakāraḥ kathitaḥ samātmā sāmapāṭhakaḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
अजितो जन्महन्ता च जकारस्स च शाश्वतः |
झषो झकारः कथितः समात्मा सामपाठकः || 44 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ja' is the Unconquered, the Slayer of Birth, and the Eternal. / The letter 'jha' is taught as Fish, Even-Minded, and Reciter of the Sāman. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
uttamastvīśvarākhyaśca jñakārastattvadhārakaḥ |
cāndrī ṭakāra āhlādo viśvāpyāyakaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
उत्तमस्त्वीश्वराख्यश्च ज्ञकारस्तत्त्वधारकः |
चान्द्री टकार आह्लादो विश्वाप्यायकरः स्मृतः || 45 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ña' is the Highest, named the Ruler, and Upholder of the Tattvas. / The letter 'ṭa' is remembered as Lunar, Joy, and Gladdener of the Universe. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
ṭhakāraḥ kaustubhaḥ prokto nemirdhārādharastathā |
ḍakāro daṇḍadhāraśca mausalo'khaṇḍavikramaḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
ठकारः कौस्तुभः प्रोक्तो नेमिर्धाराधरस्तथा |
डकारो दण्डधारश्च मौसलोऽखण्डविक्रमः || 46 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ṭha' is proclaimed as the Kaustubha, the Felley, and Cloud. / The letter 'ḍa' is the Staff-Bearer, Wielder of the Pestle, and of Unbroken Valour. // 46

sanskrit_iast:
ḍhakāro viśvarūpaśca vṛṣakarmā pratardanaḥ |
ṇakāro'bhayadaśśāstā vaikuṇṭhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
ढकारो विश्वरूपश्च वृषकर्मा प्रतर्दनः |
णकारोऽभयदश्शास्ता वैकुण्ठः परिकीर्तितः || 47 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ḍha' has All Forms, Performs Righteous Deeds, and is Pratardana. / The letter 'ṇa' is celebrated as Giver of Fearlessness, Teacher, and Vaikuṇṭha. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
tālalakṣmā takāraśca vairājassragdharassmṛtaḥ |
dhanvī bhuvanāpālaśca thakārassarvarodhakaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
ताललक्ष्मा तकारश्च वैराजस्स्रग्धरस्स्मृतः |
धन्वी भुवनापालश्च थकारस्सर्वरोधकः || 48 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ta' is marked by a Palm Tree, is Virāj, and Wearer of Garlands. / The letter 'tha' is the Bowman, Protector of the World, and Restrainer of All. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
p. 45) dattāvakāśo damano dakāraśśāntidaḥ smṛtaḥ |
dhakāraḥ śārṅgadhṛddhartā mādhavaśca prakīrtitaḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
प्. 45) दत्तावकाशो दमनो दकारश्शान्तिदः स्मृतः |
धकारः शार्ङ्गधृद्धर्ता माधवश्च प्रकीर्तितः || 49 ||
text_mt: p. 45) The letter 'da' is remembered as Giver of Space, Subduer, and Bestower of Peace. / The letter 'dha' is celebrated as Holder of Śārṅga, Supporter, and Mādhava. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
naro nārāyaṇaḥ panthā nakārassamudāhṛtaḥ |
pakāraḥ padmanābhaśca pavitraḥ paścimānanaḥ || 50 ||
meaning:
नरो नारायणः पन्था नकारस्समुदाहृतः |
पकारः पद्मनाभश्च पवित्रः पश्चिमाननः || 50 ||
text_mt: The letter 'na' is declared to be Nara, Nārāyaṇa, and the Path. / The letter 'pa' is Padmanābha, Pure, and West-Facing. // 50

sanskrit_iast:
phakāraḥ phullanayano lāṅgalī śvetasaṃjñikaḥ |
bakāro vāmano hrasvaḥ pūrṇāṅgassa ca gīyate || 51 ||
meaning:
फकारः फुल्लनयनो लाङ्गली श्वेतसंज्ञिकः |
बकारो वामनो ह्रस्वः पूर्णाङ्गस्स च गीयते || 51 ||
text_mt: The letter 'pha' has Blossoming Eyes, Holds a Plough, and is named White. / The letter 'ba' is sung as Vāmana, Short, and of Complete Limbs. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
bhallāyudho bhakāraśca jñeyassiddhiprado dhruvaḥ |
makāro mardanaḥ kālaḥ pradhānaḥ paripaṭhyate || 52 ||
meaning:
भल्लायुधो भकारश्च ज्ञेयस्सिद्धिप्रदो ध्रुवः |
मकारो मर्दनः कालः प्रधानः परिपठ्यते || 52 ||
text_mt: The letter 'bha' should be known as Armed with a Spear, Bestower of Attainment, and the Constant. / The letter 'ma' is recited as the Crusher, Time, and Pradhāna. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
caturgatiryakārastu sa sūkṣmaśśaṅkha ucyate |
aśeṣabhuvanādhāro ro'nalaḥ kālapāvakaḥ || 53 ||
meaning:
चतुर्गतिर्यकारस्तु स सूक्ष्मश्शङ्ख उच्यते |
अशेषभुवनाधारो रोऽनलः कालपावकः || 53 ||
text_mt: The letter 'ya' has Fourfold Movement, is Subtle, and called the Conch. / 'Ra' is the Support of Endless Worlds, Fire, and the Fire of Time. // 53

sanskrit_iast:
lakāro vibudhākhyastu dhareśaḥ puruṣeśvaraḥ |
varāhaścāmṛtādhāro vakāro varuṇassmṛtaḥ || 54 ||
meaning:
लकारो विबुधाख्यस्तु धरेशः पुरुषेश्वरः |
वराहश्चामृताधारो वकारो वरुणस्स्मृतः || 54 ||
text_mt: The letter 'la' is named the Wise, Lord of the Earth, and Lord of Men. / The letter 'va' is remembered as Varāha, Receptacle of Nectar, and Varuṇa. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
śakāraḥ śaṅkaraḥ śāntaḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
nṛsihmaścāgnirūpaśca ṣakāro bhāskarastathā || 55 ||
meaning:
शकारः शङ्करः शान्तः पुण्डरीकः प्रकीर्तितः |
नृसिह्मश्चाग्निरूपश्च षकारो भास्करस्तथा || 55 ||
text_mt: The letter 'śa' is proclaimed as Śaṅkara, Peaceful, and the Lotus. / The letter 'ṣa' is Narasiṃha, having the nature of Fire, and the Sun. // 55

sanskrit_iast:
sakāraścāmṛtaṃ tṛptissomastu paripaṭhyate |
sūryo hakāraḥ prāṇastu paramātmā prakīrtitaḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
सकारश्चामृतं तृप्तिस्सोमस्तु परिपठ्यते |
सूर्यो हकारः प्राणस्तु परमात्मा प्रकीर्तितः || 56 ||
text_mt: The letter 'sa' is recited as Nectar, Contentment, and Soma. / The letter 'ha' is proclaimed as the Sun, Prāṇa, and the Supreme Self. // 56

sanskrit_iast:
ananteśaḥ kṣakārastu vargānto garuḍassmṛtaḥ |
aśeṣasaṃjñā varṇānāmityetāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 57 ||
meaning:
अनन्तेशः क्षकारस्तु वर्गान्तो गरुडस्स्मृतः |
अशेषसंज्ञा वर्णानामित्येताः परिकीर्तिताः || 57 ||
text_mt: The letter 'kṣa' is remembered as the Lord of Ananta, the End of the Class, and Garuḍa. / Thus have these endless designations of the letters been proclaimed. // 57

sanskrit_iast:
anulomavilomena varṇādvarṇasya vai punaḥ |
saṃkhyā saṃjñā ca yā samyaksāmānyā sā mahāmate || 58 ||
meaning:
अनुलोमविलोमेन वर्णाद्वर्णस्य वै पुनः |
संख्या संज्ञा च या सम्यक्सामान्या सा महामते || 58 ||
text_mt: In direct and reverse order from letter to letter, / that enumeration and designation which is correct is general, O highly intelligent one. // 58

sanskrit_iast:
[bhagavadaṃśabhūtānāmakṣarāṇāmaṅgāṅgibhāvena
mithaḥasaṅgatānāṃ mantrotpattihetutā]
meaning:
[भगवदंशभूतानामक्षराणामङ्गाङ्गिभावेन
मिथःअसङ्गतानां मन्त्रोत्पत्तिहेतुता]
text_mt: [Letters being portions of the Lord, mutually connected as principal and subordinate parts, are the cause of the arising of mantras]

sanskrit_iast:
ete bhagavadaṃśāśca śabdā bhāsvaravigrahāḥ |
kāraṇaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ bhagavacchaktibṛṃhitāḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
एते भगवदंशाश्च शब्दा भास्वरविग्रहाः |
कारणं सर्वमन्त्राणां भगवच्छक्तिबृंहिताः || 59 ||
text_mt: These words, having radiant forms, are portions of the Lord; / bolstered by the power of the Lord, they are the cause of all mantras. // 59

sanskrit_iast:
parasparāṅgabhāvena mantrotpattiṃ vrajanti ca |
carācare'smiṃstannāsti yadamībhirna bhāvitam || 60 ||
meaning:
परस्पराङ्गभावेन मन्त्रोत्पत्तिं व्रजन्ति च |
चराचरेऽस्मिंस्तन्नास्ति यदमीभिर्न भावितम् || 60 ||
text_mt: Through mutual relation as subordinate parts, they attain the status of mantras. / There is nothing in this moving and unmoving [world] that is not pervaded by them. // 60

sanskrit_iast: kṛtvaivaṃ bhāvagāṃ vyāptiṃ varṇānāṃ pūjanakriyā |
meaning: कृत्वैवं भावगां व्याप्तिं वर्णानां पूजनक्रिया |
text_mt: Having thus effected the mental pervasion of the letters, the rite of worship [follows]:

sanskrit_iast: [mantroddhārakramaḥ]
meaning: [मन्त्रोद्धारक्रमः]

sanskrit_iast: svahṛccakre'tha bhūmiṣṭhe tato mantrānsamuddharet || 61 ||
meaning: स्वहृच्चक्रेऽथ भूमिष्ठे ततो मन्त्रान्समुद्धरेत् || 61 ||
text_mt: One should then extract the mantras within the cakra of one's own heart situated on the ground. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
vargāntamādyaṃ bījaṃ tu saptavargādvibheditam |
p. 46) pañcabinduyutaṃ mūrdhni vyomeśena niyojitam || 62 ||
meaning:
वर्गान्तमाद्यं बीजं तु सप्तवर्गाद्विभेदितम् |
