प्. 46) पञ्चबिन्दुयुतं मूर्ध्नि व्योमेशेन नियोजितम् || 62 ||
text_mt: The first seed-syllable is the end of the class, distinguished from the seven classes, / endowed with five bindus on the head, conjoined with the Lord of the Void. // 62

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ bījavaraṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
ananteśāttṛtīyaṃ tu svaravargāntayojitam || 63 ||
meaning:
इदं बीजवरं दिव्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् |
अनन्तेशात्तृतीयं तु स्वरवर्गान्तयोजितम् || 63 ||
text_mt: This divine, excellent seed-syllable grants the fruit of all desires. / The third from the Lord of Ananta, conjoined with the end of the vowel class, // 63

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ tasya tadbījaṃ jarāmṛtyubhayāpaham |
svarādyaṃ pañcamaṃ caiva pañcaviṃśena yojitam || 64 ||
meaning:
द्वितीयं तस्य तद्बीजं जरामृत्युभयापहम् |
स्वराद्यं पञ्चमं चैव पञ्चविंशेन योजितम् || 64 ||
text_mt: is its second seed-syllable, removing the fear of old age and death. / The first vowel and the fifth, conjoined with the twenty-fifth— // 64

sanskrit_iast:
tayorādyaṃ likhedbījaṃ bhogamokṣapradaṃ śubham |
namaskārapadopetaṃ sarvaśaktyāśrayaṃ prabhum || 65 ||
meaning:
तयोराद्यं लिखेद्बीजं भोगमोक्षप्रदं शुभम् |
नमस्कारपदोपेतं सर्वशक्त्याश्रयं प्रभुम् || 65 ||
text_mt: one should write the first seed-syllable of the two, auspicious, bestowing enjoyment and liberation, / endowed with the word of obeisance, resting on all powers, the Lord. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
etadvarṇatrayaṃ dehaḥ sthūlabhāso mama dvija |
bhūtadehavyapekṣāyāṃ kiñcitsūkṣmaśca nārada || 66 ||
meaning:
एतद्वर्णत्रयं देहः स्थूलभासो मम द्विज |
भूतदेहव्यपेक्षायां किञ्चित्सूक्ष्मश्च नारद || 66 ||
text_mt: This triad of letters is my gross-manifesting body, O twice-born one, / yet in comparison to the elemental body, it is somewhat subtle, O Nārada. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
paramūrttyantareṇaiva sthūla eva vibhāti ca |
atyutkṛṣṭaguṇairyukto hyadṛśyo yasya kasyacit || 67 ||
meaning:
परमूर्त्त्यन्तरेणैव स्थूल एव विभाति च |
अत्युत्कृष्टगुणैर्युक्तो ह्यदृश्यो यस्य कस्यचित् || 67 ||
text_mt: Through another supreme form, it shines as gross indeed; / endowed with exceedingly eminent qualities, it is invisible to anyone whatsoever. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
api cetkevalassarvāmarthasiddhiṃ prayacchati |
kiṃ punarmūrttimantreṇa dvādaśārṇena saṃyutaḥ || 68 ||
meaning:
अपि चेत्केवलस्सर्वामर्थसिद्धिं प्रयच्छति |
किं पुनर्मूर्त्तिमन्त्रेण द्वादशार्णेन संयुतः || 68 ||
text_mt: Even alone, it grants the attainment of all aims; / how much more so when conjoined with the twelve-syllabled icon-mantra! // 68

sanskrit_iast:
padaṃ nārāyaṇāyeti kuryādviśvātmane tataḥ |
hrīṃ svāhākārasaṃyukto mūrttimantro hyayaṃ smṛtaḥ || 69 ||
meaning:
पदं नारायणायेति कुर्याद्विश्वात्मने ततः |
ह्रीं स्वाहाकारसंयुक्तो मूर्त्तिमन्त्रो ह्ययं स्मृतः || 69 ||
text_mt: Then, to the Self of All, one should add the word 'nārāyaṇāya'; / conjoined with 'hrīṃ' and the word 'svāhā', this is remembered as the icon-mantra. // 69

sanskrit_iast: [mantramahimānuvarṇanam]
meaning: [मन्त्रमहिमानुवर्णनम्]
text_mt: [Description of the greatness of the mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
saṅkalpākalparūpastu tryarṇasyādyoditasya ca |
aṇimādiguṇādhāraḥ pātālotthānasiddhidaḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
सङ्कल्पाकल्परूपस्तु त्र्यर्णस्याद्योदितस्य च |
अणिमादिगुणाधारः पातालोत्थानसिद्धिदः || 70 ||
text_mt: The three-syllabled [mantra] first declared, whose nature is imagination and non-imagination, / is the foundation of qualities such as atomicity, and bestows the attainment of emerging from Pātāla. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣado mokṣakāmasya bhogakāmasya bhogadaḥ |
rājyado rājyakāmasya dhanakāmasya bhūtidaḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
मोक्षदो मोक्षकामस्य भोगकामस्य भोगदः |
राज्यदो राज्यकामस्य धनकामस्य भूतिदः || 71 ||
text_mt: It gives liberation to one desiring liberation, and gives enjoyment to one desiring enjoyment; / it gives kingship to one desiring kingship, and gives prosperity to one desiring wealth. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
yānyānprārthayate kāmānsarvānvai sādhakāya ca |
da(dā)tyuccāramātreṇa samyaktadbhāvitātmane || 72 ||
meaning:
यान्यान्प्रार्थयते कामान्सर्वान्वै साधकाय च |
द(दा)त्युच्चारमात्रेण सम्यक्तद्भावितात्मने || 72 ||
text_mt: Whatever desires he prays for, all of them indeed to the practitioner / it gives by mere utterance, to one whose mind is thoroughly contemplated on it. // 72

sanskrit_iast: [devatādhyānam]
meaning: [देवताध्यानम्]

sanskrit_iast:
anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ jagatsraṣṭāramīśvaram |
dhyāyeccaturbhuja vipra śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 73 ||
meaning:
अनादिनिधनं देवं जगत्स्रष्टारमीश्वरम् |
ध्यायेच्चतुर्भुज विप्र शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् || 73 ||
text_mt: One should meditate, O vipra, on the God without beginning or end, the creator of the world, the Lord, / having four arms, bearing the conch, discus, and mace, // 73

sanskrit_iast:
caturvaktraṃ sunayanaṃ sukāntaṃ padmapāṇinam |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ narasihmāsyaṃ vārāhaṃ kapilānanam || 74 ||
meaning:
चतुर्वक्त्रं सुनयनं सुकान्तं पद्मपाणिनम् |
वैकुण्ठं नरसिह्मास्यं वाराहं कपिलाननम् || 74 ||
text_mt: having four faces, beautiful eyes, lovely, with a lotus in hand: / Vaikuṇṭha, man-lion-faced, boar-faced, and Kapila-faced, // 74

sanskrit_iast:
śuklaṃ khageśvarārūḍhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ mālyāmbaradharaṃ vibhum || 75 ||
meaning:
शुक्लं खगेश्वरारूढं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् |
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नं माल्याम्बरधरं विभुम् || 75 ||
text_mt: white, mounted upon the Lord of Birds, adorned with all ornaments, / endowed with all auspicious marks, wearing garlands and garments, the all-pervading Lord, // 75

sanskrit_iast:
p. 47) kirīṭakaustubhadharaṃ karpūrāliptavigraham |
sūryāyutasahasrābhaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam || 76 ||
meaning:
प्. 47) किरीटकौस्तुभधरं कर्पूरालिप्तविग्रहम् |
सूर्यायुतसहस्राभं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् || 76 ||
text_mt: bearing a diadem and the Kaustubha, his body smeared with camphor, / shining like hundreds of thousands of suns, revered by all the gods. // 76

sanskrit_iast: [lakṣmyādīnāṃ bhagavadrūpe nityasānnidhyam]
meaning: [लक्ष्म्यादीनां भगवद्रूपे नित्यसान्निध्यम्]
text_mt: [The eternal presence of Lakṣmī and the others in the Lord's form]

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīḥ kīrttirjayā māyā devyastasyāśritāssadā |
svaśaktinicayopetā nirākārāstu niṣkalāḥ || 77 ||
meaning:
लक्ष्मीः कीर्त्तिर्जया माया देव्यस्तस्याश्रितास्सदा |
स्वशक्तिनिचयोपेता निराकारास्तु निष्कलाः || 77 ||
text_mt: Lakṣmī, Kīrti, Jayā, and Māyā are the goddesses eternally taking refuge in Him; / endowed with the multitude of their own powers, yet formless and unqualified. // 77

sanskrit_iast:
sūryasya raśmayo yadvadūrmayaścāmbudheriva |
sarvaiśvaryaprabhāvena kamalā śrīpatestathā || 78 ||
meaning:
सूर्यस्य रश्मयो यद्वदूर्मयश्चाम्बुधेरिव |
सर्वैश्वर्यप्रभावेन कमला श्रीपतेस्तथा || 78 ||
text_mt: Just as rays belong to the sun, and waves to the ocean, / so does Kamalā belong to the Lord of Śrī through the power of all sovereignty. // 78

sanskrit_iast:
nānāviśeṣalakṣmībhiḥ koṭisaṅkhyābhirāvṛtā |
kīrttistathāvidherdeva (naiva ?) vidhinā vigrahe vibhoḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
नानाविशेषलक्ष्मीभिः कोटिसङ्ख्याभिरावृता |
कीर्त्तिस्तथाविधेर्देव (नैव ?) विधिना विग्रहे विभोः || 79 ||
text_mt: Surrounded by diverse particular Lakṣmīs numbered in the millions, / in like manner is Kīrti, by that rule, in the body of the all-pervading Lord. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
tannāsti yanna hi tayā vyāptaṃ sāmānyadehayā |
yasya yā ca yadā kīrttissvasāmaryātprajāyate || 80 ||
meaning:
तन्नास्ति यन्न हि तया व्याप्तं सामान्यदेहया |
यस्य या च यदा कीर्त्तिस्स्वसामर्यात्प्रजायते || 80 ||
text_mt: There is nothing that is not pervaded by her, whose body is universal. / Whatever fame arises for whoever, whenever, through one's own capability, // 80

sanskrit_iast:
sā sā vipra smṛtā sarvā viśeṣapratipattibhiḥ |
jayā jayeśvarasyaivaṃ  vyāptibhāvena saṃsthitā || 81 ||
meaning:
सा सा विप्र स्मृता सर्वा विशेषप्रतिपत्तिभिः |
जया जयेश्वरस्यैवं  व्याप्तिभावेन संस्थिता || 81 ||
text_mt: all that, O vipra, is remembered through particular apprehensions. / Jayā likewise abides in the state of pervasion belonging to the Lord of Victory. // 81

sanskrit_iast:
yā kācidvidyate māyā jagatyasmin surādiṣu |
bhagavanmāyayodbhūtāṃ tāṃ viddhi paramāṃ tu vai || 82 ||
meaning:
या काचिद्विद्यते माया जगत्यस्मिन् सुरादिषु |
भगवन्माययोद्भूतां तां विद्धि परमां तु वै || 82 ||
text_mt: Whatever māyā exists in this world among gods and others, / know that to be arisen from the māyā of the Lord, supreme indeed. // 82

sanskrit_iast:
tadīyaṃ niṣkalaṃ rūpaṃ muktvā vai paramārthikam |
ko'smiṃstattvodadhau cāsti caturdhā munisattama || 83 ||
meaning:
तदीयं निष्कलं रूपं मुक्त्वा वै परमार्थिकम् |
कोऽस्मिंस्तत्त्वोदधौ चास्ति चतुर्धा मुनिसत्तम || 83 ||
text_mt: Leaving aside His unqualified, absolute form, / what is there in this ocean of tattvas that is fourfold, O best of sages? // 83

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavacchaktibhissamyagābhiryogavibhāgataḥ |
svālokajñānasāmarthyātsākāratvamupāgatāḥ || 84 ||
meaning:
भगवच्छक्तिभिस्सम्यगाभिर्योगविभागतः |
स्वालोकज्ञानसामर्थ्यात्साकारत्वमुपागताः || 84 ||
text_mt: Through these powers of the Lord, by division through yoga, / by the power of their own luminous knowledge, they have assumed embodied form. // 84

sanskrit_iast: [lakṣmyādīnāṃ dhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [लक्ष्म्यादीनां ध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The manner of meditation on Lakṣmī and the others]

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātavyāssādhakendreṇa yasya strīśca(striyaścāsya ?)svasiddhaye |
ekavaktrā dvinetrāśca dvibhujāścārukuṇḍalāḥ || 85 ||
meaning:
ध्यातव्यास्साधकेन्द्रेण यस्य स्त्रीश्च(स्त्रियश्चास्य ?)स्वसिद्धये |
एकवक्त्रा द्विनेत्राश्च द्विभुजाश्चारुकुण्डलाः || 85 ||
text_mt: His women should be meditated upon by the eminent practitioner for his own attainment: / single-faced, two-eyed, two-armed, with charming earrings, // 85

sanskrit_iast:
padmagarbhanibhāḥ kāntā mekhalādāmamaṇḍitāḥ |
śvetamālyāmbaradharā hārakeyūrabhūṣitāḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
पद्मगर्भनिभाः कान्ता मेखलादाममण्डिताः |
श्वेतमाल्याम्बरधरा हारकेयूरभूषिताः || 86 ||
text_mt: resembling the interior of a lotus, lovely, adorned with girdle-bands, / wearing white garlands and garments, adorned with necklaces and armlets, // 86

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāḥ pīnonnatapayodharāḥ |
prabuddhotpalavistīrṇalocanāśca smitānanāḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नाः पीनोन्नतपयोधराः |
प्रबुद्धोत्पलविस्तीर्णलोचनाश्च स्मिताननाः || 87 ||
text_mt: endowed with all auspicious marks, with full and raised breasts, / their eyes wide like blossomed blue lotuses, with smiling faces, // 87

sanskrit_iast:
caladdvirephapaṭalatulyairyuktāstathā'lakaiḥ |
lalāṭatilakaiścitrairvividhaiḥ parimaṇḍitāḥ || 88 ||
meaning:
चलद्द्विरेफपटलतुल्यैर्युक्तास्तथाऽलकैः |
ललाटतिलकैश्चित्रैर्विविधैः परिमण्डिताः || 88 ||
text_mt: endowed with curls resembling swarms of hovering black bees, / embellished with various brilliant forehead marks, // 88

sanskrit_iast:
āraktādhararaktāśca vaṃśamuktāphaladvijāḥ |
ardhacandralalāṭāśca ślakṣṇakuñcitamūrdhajāḥ || 89 ||
meaning:
आरक्ताधररक्ताश्च वंशमुक्ताफलद्विजाः |
अर्धचन्द्रललाटाश्च श्लक्ष्णकुञ्चितमूर्धजाः || 89 ||
text_mt: with reddish lower lips, teeth like bamboo pearls, / foreheads like the crescent moon, and smooth, curled hair on the head, // 89

sanskrit_iast:
p. 48) pāśāṅkuśadharā devyaḥ sarvakāmārthasādhakāḥ |
pūrvādidigvibhāgasthāḥ kesarāreṣu nārada || 90 ||
meaning:
प्. 48) पाशाङ्कुशधरा देव्यः सर्वकामार्थसाधकाः |
पूर्वादिदिग्विभागस्थाः केसरारेषु नारद || 90 ||
text_mt: the goddesses holding a noose and a goad, accomplishing all desires and aims, / situated in the directions beginning with the east, upon the filament-spokes, O Nārada, // 90

sanskrit_iast: baddhapadmāsanāścaiva devadevasya saṃukhāḥ |
meaning: बद्धपद्मासनाश्चैव देवदेवस्य संउखाः |
text_mt: seated in the lotus posture, facing the God of gods. // 91ab

sanskrit_iast: [lakṣmyādimantranirūpaṇopakramaḥ]
meaning: [लक्ष्म्यादिमन्त्रनिरूपणोपक्रमः]
text_mt: [Introduction to the exposition of the mantras of Lakṣmī and the others]

sanskrit_iast: mantrāṃstāsāṃ pravakṣyāmi pūjārthaṃ vividhānatha || 91 ||
meaning: मन्त्रांस्तासां प्रवक्ष्यामि पूजार्थं विविधानथ || 91 ||
text_mt: I shall now declare their various mantras for the purpose of worship, // 91cd

sanskrit_iast:
yaissamārādhitāḥ śaśvadabhīṣṭaṃ sādhayanti ca |
mūlamantrāddvitīyaṃ yatkevalaṃ bījanāyakam || 92 ||
meaning:
यैस्समाराधिताः शश्वदभीष्टं साधयन्ति च |
मूलमन्त्राद्द्वितीयं यत्केवलं बीजनायकम् || 92 ||
text_mt: worshipped by which they constantly accomplish what is desired. / That which is the second, single lord of seed-syllables from the root-mantra // 92

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyaṃ hṛdayaṃ hyetatsarvāsāṃ parikīrtitam |
mūrtimantracatuṣkaṃ tu krameṇāsāṃ pṛthakśṛṇu || 93 ||
meaning:
सामान्यं हृदयं ह्येतत्सर्वासां परिकीर्तितम् |
मूर्तिमन्त्रचतुष्कं तु क्रमेणासां पृथक्शृणु || 93 ||
text_mt: is proclaimed as the common heart for all of them. / Listen individually to their quartet of icon-mantras in order: // 93

sanskrit_iast: [lakṣmīmantraḥ]
meaning: [लक्ष्मीमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavaṃ coddharetpūrvaṃ hṛdbījaṃ tadanantaram |
dvirakṣare padaṃ lakṣmyai prāṅgamontaṃ niveśya ca || 94 ||
meaning:
प्रणवं चोद्धरेत्पूर्वं हृद्बीजं तदनन्तरम् |
द्विरक्षरे पदं लक्ष्म्यै प्राङ्गमोन्तं निवेश्य च || 94 ||
text_mt: One should first extract the praṇava, and immediately after that the heart-seed; / having placed the word 'lakṣmyai' in two syllables ending with the principal limb, // 94

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paramaśabdaṃ tu tadante puruṣeśvaram |
vargāntamāsvaropetaṃ vasthitāyai padaṃ nyaset || 95 ||
meaning:
ततः परमशब्दं तु तदन्ते पुरुषेश्वरम् |
वर्गान्तमास्वरोपेतं वस्थितायै पदं न्यसेत् || 95 ||
text_mt: then the word 'parama', and after it 'puruṣeśvara'; / one should set down the end of the class endowed with the vowel 'ā', [then] the word 'vasthitāyai', // 95

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyastaddhṛdayaṃ bījaṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ bījadvayaṃ tataḥ |
svāhāsamanvitaṃ vipra praṇavādyaṃ ca mantrarāṭ || 96 ||
meaning:
भूयस्तद्धृदयं बीजं श्रीं ह्रीं बीजद्वयं ततः |
स्वाहासमन्वितं विप्र प्रणवाद्यं च मन्त्रराट् || 96 ||
text_mt: again that heart-seed, then the pair of seed-syllables 'śrīṃ' and 'hrīṃ', / conjoined with 'svāhā', O vipra, beginning with the praṇava: [such is] the king of mantras. // 96

sanskrit_iast: mūrttimantrasametastu lakṣmyākhyo dvidaśākṣaraḥ |
meaning: मूर्त्तिमन्त्रसमेतस्तु लक्ष्म्याख्यो द्विदशाक्षरः |
text_mt: Joined with the icon-mantra, [the mantra] named after Lakṣmī consists of twenty syllables.

sanskrit_iast: [kīrttimantraḥ]
meaning: [कीर्त्तिमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: hṛdbījaṃ praṇavādyaṃ tu padaṃ kīrttyai tato namaḥ || 97 ||
meaning: हृद्बीजं प्रणवाद्यं तु पदं कीर्त्त्यै ततो नमः || 97 ||
text_mt: The heart-seed beginning with the praṇava, then the word 'kīrtyai', then 'namaḥ', // 97

sanskrit_iast:
sadoditānandapadaṃ vigrahāyai padaṃ tvanu |
hrīṃ klīṃ svāhāsametastu prāksaṃkhyaṃ kīrtimantrarāṭ || 98 ||
meaning:
सदोदितानन्दपदं विग्रहायै पदं त्वनु |
ह्रीं क्लीं स्वाहासमेतस्तु प्राक्संख्यं कीर्तिमन्त्रराट् || 98 ||
text_mt: the word 'sadoditānanda', and immediately following, the word 'vigrahāyai'; / joined with 'hrīṃ', 'klīṃ', and 'svāhā', having the previous number of syllables, is the king of Kīrti-mantras. // 98

sanskrit_iast: [jayāmantraḥ]
meaning: [जयामन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdbījaṃ praṇavopetaṃ jayāyai tryakṣaraṃ namaḥ |
svarādyaṃ jitaśabdaśca dhāmā varṇadvayaṃ tataḥ || 99 ||
meaning:
हृद्बीजं प्रणवोपेतं जयायै त्र्यक्षरं नमः |
स्वराद्यं जितशब्दश्च धामा वर्णद्वयं ततः || 99 ||
text_mt: The heart-seed conjoined with the praṇava, 'jayāyai', the three-syllabled 'namaḥ' [with seed]; / the initial vowel, the word 'jita', then the two syllables 'dhāmā', // 99

sanskrit_iast:
vasthitāyai padaṃ kṛtvā taddhṛdbījaṃ nyasetpunaḥ |
aśeṣabhuvanādhārāvasthitaṃ ca tṛtīyakam || 100 ||
meaning:
वस्थितायै पदं कृत्वा तद्धृद्बीजं न्यसेत्पुनः |
अशेषभुवनाधारावस्थितं च तृतीयकम् || 100 ||
text_mt: having formed the word 'vasthitāyai', one should place that heart-seed again; / and the third [seed], 'aśeṣabhuvanādhārāvasthitaṃ', // 100

sanskrit_iast:
vyomeśapañcabindussyātsvāhā tadanu nārada (vai padam) |
varṇādvidaśasaṃkhyaśca jayākhyo mantra uttamaḥ || 101 ||
meaning:
व्योमेशपञ्चबिन्दुस्स्यात्स्वाहा तदनु नारद (वै पदम्) |
वर्णाद्विदशसंख्यश्च जयाख्यो मन्त्र उत्तमः || 101 ||
text_mt: there should be the Lord of the Void with five bindus, followed by 'svāhā', O Nārada; / counting twenty syllables, this is the supreme mantra named after Jayā. // 101

sanskrit_iast: p. 49) [māyāmantraḥ]

prāgbījaṃ praṇavādyaṃ ca māyāyai ca tato namaḥ |
mohātītapadaṃ cātha nāntaṃ tadanu yojayet || 102 ||
meaning:
प्राग्बीजं प्रणवाद्यं च मायायै च ततो नमः |
मोहातीतपदं चाथ नान्तं तदनु योजयेत् || 102 ||
text_mt: The prior seed beginning with the praṇava, and 'māyāyai', then 'namaḥ'; / then one should join the word 'mohātīta', followed by that ending in 'n', // 102

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyasvarasaṃyuktaṃ dakāraṃ tadanantaram |
śṛtāyai tryakṣaraśśabdo māyābījaṃ tato bhavet || 103 ||
meaning:
द्वितीयस्वरसंयुक्तं दकारं तदनन्तरम् |
शृतायै त्र्यक्षरश्शब्दो मायाबीजं ततो भवेत् || 103 ||
text_mt: immediately after, the syllable 'da' joined with the second vowel; / the three-syllable word 'śritāyai', and then there should be the Māyā-seed: // 103

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānamanalārūḍhaṃ caturthasvarabhūṣitam |
trailokyaiśvaryadenaiva yuktaṃ svāhāntamuddharet || 104 ||
meaning:
प्रधानमनलारूढं चतुर्थस्वरभूषितम् |
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेनैव युक्तं स्वाहान्तमुद्धरेत् || 104 ||
text_mt: the pradhāna mounted on fire, adorned with the fourth vowel, / joined with the granter of dominion over the three worlds, ending in 'svāhā'—one should extract it. // 104

sanskrit_iast: māyāmantraśca pūrveṣāṃ varṇasaṃkhyāsamassmṛtaḥ |
meaning: मायामन्त्रश्च पूर्वेषां वर्णसंख्यासमस्स्मृतः |
text_mt: And the Māyā-mantra is taught to have the same number of syllables as the preceding ones.

sanskrit_iast: [hṛdādyaṅgamantranirūpaṇam]
meaning: [हृदाद्यङ्गमन्त्रनिरूपणम्]
text_mt: [Description of the Limb-Mantras Beginning with the Heart]

sanskrit_iast: aṅgāni devadevasya kathayiṣyāmi tattvataḥ || 105 ||
meaning: अङ्गानि देवदेवस्य कथयिष्यामि तत्त्वतः || 105 ||
text_mt: I shall describe in truth the limbs of the God of gods, // 105

sanskrit_iast:
sannaddhaḥsādhako yaistu avadhyastridaśairapi |
sādhayetsarvakāryāṇi yānyāyussukhadāni ca || 106 ||
meaning:
सन्नद्धःसाधको यैस्तु अवध्यस्त्रिदशैरपि |
साधयेत्सर्वकार्याणि यान्यायुस्सुखदानि च || 106 ||
text_mt: equipped with which a practitioner cannot be slain even by the thirty [gods], / and can accomplish all works that bestow longevity and happiness, // 106

sanskrit_iast: bhaktastadbhāvitātmā ca yadi mantrakriyāparaḥ |
meaning: भक्तस्तद्भावितात्मा च यदि मन्त्रक्रियापरः |
text_mt: if he is devoted, has his mind concentrated on Him, and is intent on ritual action with mantras.

sanskrit_iast: [hṛnmantraḥ]
meaning: [हृन्मन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: anantapūrvaṃ yadbījaṃ bindubhūṣitamuddharet || 107 ||
meaning: अनन्तपूर्वं यद्बीजं बिन्दुभूषितमुद्धरेत् || 107 ||
text_mt: One should extract that seed preceded by Ananta, adorned with the bindu; // 107

sanskrit_iast:
namo'ntaṃ praṇavādyaṃ tu hṛnmantraṃ viddhi niṣkalam |
asyaiva mūrttimantro yastaṃ te vacmi yathāsthitam || 108 ||
meaning:
नमोऽन्तं प्रणवाद्यं तु हृन्मन्त्रं विद्धि निष्कलम् |
अस्यैव मूर्त्तिमन्त्रो यस्तं ते वच्मि यथास्थितम् || 108 ||
text_mt: ending in 'namaḥ' and beginning with the praṇava, know this unqualified heart-mantra. / What is the icon-mantra of this very [heart], that I speak to you as it stands: // 108

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavo bindusaṃbhinnassūryassomo visargadhṛk |
śuciśabdaṃ tataḥ kuryādagnirūpamathoddharet || 109 ||
meaning:
प्रणवो बिन्दुसंभिन्नस्सूर्यस्सोमो विसर्गधृक् |
शुचिशब्दं ततः कुर्यादग्निरूपमथोद्धरेत् || 109 ||
text_mt: The praṇava divided by a bindu, the Sun, the Moon bearing the visarga; / then one should make the word 'śuci', then extract the form of Agni, // 109

sanskrit_iast:
dakāravarṇaṃ tadanu praṇavenāpyalaṅkṛtam |
hṛdayāya namaskuryāt hṛnmantro mūrtisaṃyutaḥ || 110 ||
meaning:
दकारवर्णं तदनु प्रणवेनाप्यलङ्कृतम् |
हृदयाय नमस्कुर्यात् हृन्मन्त्रो मूर्तिसंयुतः || 110 ||
text_mt: immediately after, the syllable 'da' adorned also with the praṇava; / one should offer homage to the heart: [this is] the heart-mantra conjoined with the icon[-mantra], // 110

sanskrit_iast: saptādaśākṣaro vipra sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ |
meaning: सप्तादशाक्षरो विप्र सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकः |
text_mt: consisting of seventeen syllables, O vipra, granting all attainments.

sanskrit_iast: [śiromantraḥ]
meaning: [शिरोमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: dvitīyasvarasaṃyuktaṃ tadeva śirasi nyaset || 111 ||
meaning: द्वितीयस्वरसंयुक्तं तदेव शिरसि न्यसेत् || 111 ||
text_mt: One should place that very [seed] conjoined with the second vowel on the head; // 111

sanskrit_iast:
evamuddhṛtya ca tatastasyādau praṇavaṃ nyaset |
praṇatiṃ cāvasāne tu mūrdhānaṃ viddhi niṣkalam || 112 ||
meaning:
एवमुद्धृत्य च ततस्तस्यादौ प्रणवं न्यसेत् |
प्रणतिं चावसाने तु मूर्धानं विद्धि निष्कलम् || 112 ||
text_mt: having extracted it thus, one should then place the praṇava at its beginning, / and a salutation at the end: know this unqualified head[-mantra]. // 112

sanskrit_iast:
mūrttimantramatho vakṣye asyaivānucarastu yaḥ |
proddharetpadmanābhākhyaṃ kevalaṃ tādṛśaṃ tvanu || 113 ||
meaning:
मूर्त्तिमन्त्रमथो वक्ष्ये अस्यैवानुचरस्तु यः |
प्रोद्धरेत्पद्मनाभाख्यं केवलं तादृशं त्वनु || 113 ||
text_mt: Now I shall state the icon-mantra that attends this very [head]: / one should extract the [seed] named Padmanābha alone, and immediately after that, one of like kind, // 113

sanskrit_iast:
aśeṣabhuvanādhāraṃ phalaṃ tasyāvasānagam |
p. 50) kālapāvakasaṃsthaṃ vai taṃ ca phāntaṃ dvijottama || 114 ||
meaning:
अशेषभुवनाधारं फलं तस्यावसानगम् |
प्. 50) कालपावकसंस्थं वै तं च फान्तं द्विजोत्तम || 114 ||
text_mt: the support of all the worlds, having 'phala' at its end, / situated on the fire of time, and that [syllable] ending in 'pha', O best of the twice-born. // 114

sanskrit_iast:
athoddharetprāṇasaṃjñaṃ madanenopari sthitam |
śirase ca padaṃ paścātsvāhā śabdastadantagaḥ || 115 ||
meaning:
अथोद्धरेत्प्राणसंज्ञं मदनेनोपरि स्थितम् |
शिरसे च पदं पश्चात्स्वाहा शब्दस्तदन्तगः || 115 ||
text_mt: Then one should extract [the syllable] called 'prāṇa', situated above with Madana; / and thereafter the word 'śirase', with the word 'svāhā' at its end. // 115

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśākṣaraṃ viddhi śiromantraṃ tu nārada |
meaning: त्रयोदशाक्षरं विद्धि शिरोमन्त्रं तु नारद |
text_mt: Know the head-mantra to have thirteen syllables, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast: [śikhāmantraḥ]
meaning: [शिखामन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: praṇavaṃ prathamaṃ dadyātsūryākhyaṃ tadanantaram || 116 ||
meaning: प्रणवं प्रथमं दद्यात्सूर्याख्यं तदनन्तरम् || 116 ||
text_mt: One should first provide the praṇava, immediately after it the [seed] named the Sun, // 116

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunā'laṅkṛtaṃ mūrdhnā trailokyaiśvaryadena ca |
namaścāsyāvasāne vai śikhāmantraśca niṣkalaḥ || 117 ||
meaning:
विष्णुनाऽलङ्कृतं मूर्ध्ना त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेन च |
नमश्चास्यावसाने वै शिखामन्त्रश्च निष्कलः || 117 ||
text_mt: adorned at the head with Viṣṇu, and with the granter of dominion over the three worlds; / and 'namaḥ' at its end: [such is] the unqualified śikhā-mantra. // 117

sanskrit_iast:
mūrttimantramathāsyaiva vacmi sarvārthasiddhidam |
padmanābhaśca (bhaṃ ca ?)rārūḍhaṃ dakāraṃ śaṅkhamūrdhvagam ||
118 ||
meaning:
मूर्त्तिमन्त्रमथास्यैव वच्मि सर्वार्थसिद्धिदम् |
पद्मनाभश्च (भं च ?)रारूढं दकारं शङ्खमूर्ध्वगम् ||
118 ||
text_mt: Now I shall tell its icon-mantra, granting the accomplishment of all aims: / Padmanābha mounted on 'ra', the syllable 'da', Śaṅkha standing above, // 118

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāttamotadehena protaṃ yatnena nārada |
kevalastālalakṣmāto rāmopeto narastataḥ || 119 ||
meaning:
कुर्यात्तमोतदेहेन प्रोतं यत्नेन नारद |
केवलस्ताललक्ष्मातो रामोपेतो नरस्ततः || 119 ||
text_mt: one should carefully weave it together with the body of Tamas, O Nārada; / alone, marked by Tāla, then Nara conjoined with Rāma, // 119

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāyai vauṣaḍantaśca śikhāmantro hyayaṃ smṛtaḥ |
sārdhatrayodaśārṇaśca nānāsiddhiphalapradaḥ || 120 ||
meaning:
शिखायै वौषडन्तश्च शिखामन्त्रो ह्ययं स्मृतः |
सार्धत्रयोदशार्णश्च नानासिद्धिफलप्रदः || 120 ||
text_mt: and ending with 'śikhāyai vauṣaṭ': this is taught as the śikhā-mantra; / having thirteen and a half syllables, it yields the fruits of various attainments. // 120

sanskrit_iast: [kavacamantraḥ]
meaning: [कवचमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast:
natipraṇavamadhye tu prāṇaṃ vyomavibhūṣitam |
pañcamasvarasaṃyuktaṃ kavacārṇaṃ vinirdiśet || 121 ||
meaning:
नतिप्रणवमध्ये तु प्राणं व्योमविभूषितम् |
पञ्चमस्वरसंयुक्तं कवचार्णं विनिर्दिशेत् || 121 ||
text_mt: Between the salutation and the praṇava, Prāṇa adorned with the void, / conjoined with the fifth vowel: one should prescribe this syllable of the armor. // 121

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasya mūrttimantre tu bhuktimuktyarthasiddhidam |
proddharecchaṅkārākhyaṃ tu ānandenābhyalaṅkṛtam || 122 ||
meaning:
कृष्णस्य मूर्त्तिमन्त्रे तु भुक्तिमुक्त्यर्थसिद्धिदम् |
प्रोद्धरेच्छङ्काराख्यं तु आनन्देनाभ्यलङ्कृतम् || 122 ||
text_mt: In the icon-mantra of Kṛṣṇa, granting the accomplishment of the ends of enjoyment and liberation: / one should extract the [seed] named Śaṅkara, adorned with Ānanda, // 122

sanskrit_iast:
varāhasthaṃ tamevātha vairājaṃ kevalaṃ tataḥ |
kevalaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ tu kevalaṃ kālapāvakam || 123 ||
meaning:
वराहस्थं तमेवाथ वैराजं केवलं ततः |
केवलं पुण्डरीकं तु केवलं कालपावकम् || 123 ||
text_mt: then that same [seed] standing on Varāha, then Vairāja alone, / Puṇḍarīka alone, the fire of time alone, // 123

sanskrit_iast:
caturgatisamārūḍhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ proddharettataḥ |
kavacāya padaṃ kuryāddhuṅkāreṇa vibhūṣitam || 124 ||
meaning:
चतुर्गतिसमारूढं वैकुण्ठं प्रोद्धरेत्ततः |
कवचाय पदं कुर्याद्धुङ्कारेण विभूषितम् || 124 ||
text_mt: then one should extract Vaikuṇṭha mounted on the four paths; / one should formulate the word 'kavacāya', adorned with the syllable 'huṃ'. // 124

sanskrit_iast: ubhayātmaiṣa uktastu mantraḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ |
meaning: उभयात्मैष उक्तस्तु मन्त्रः पञ्चदशाक्षरः |
text_mt: This mantra, of double nature, is taught to have fifteen syllables.

sanskrit_iast: [netramantraḥ]
meaning: [नेत्रमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: namontaḥ praṇavādyaśca prāṇo vyomavibhūṣitaḥ || 125 ||
meaning: नमोन्तः प्रणवाद्यश्च प्राणो व्योमविभूषितः || 125 ||
text_mt: Ending in 'namaḥ' and beginning with the praṇava, Prāṇa adorned with the void, // 125

sanskrit_iast:
aukārasvarasaṃyukto netramantrastu niṣkalaḥ |
pavitramanalārūḍhaṃ kamalaṃ gopanāṅkitam || 126 ||
meaning:
औकारस्वरसंयुक्तो नेत्रमन्त्रस्तु निष्कलः |
पवित्रमनलारूढं कमलं गोपनाङ्कितम् || 126 ||
text_mt: conjoined with the vowel 'au': this is the unqualified eye-mantra. / Pavitra mounted on fire, Kamala marked by concealment, // 126

sanskrit_iast:
p. 51) kevalaṃ śaṅkaraścānte rārūḍhaṃ paścimānanam |
ajitaścāmṛtādhārassaṃsthitaṃ proddharettataḥ || 127 ||
meaning:
प्. 51) केवलं शङ्करश्चान्ते रारूढं पश्चिमाननम् |
अजितश्चामृताधारस्संस्थितं प्रोद्धरेत्ततः || 127 ||
text_mt: alone, and Śaṅkara at the end mounted on 'ra' facing west; / Ajita, the support of nectar, situated—one should then extract it; // 127

sanskrit_iast:
dhareśaṃ kevalaṃ dadyānnetrāya tryakṣaraṃ padam |
tadante ca vauṣaṭ kuryānnetramantro hyayaṃ smṛtaḥ || 128 ||
meaning:
धरेशं केवलं दद्यान्नेत्राय त्र्यक्षरं पदम् |
तदन्ते च वौषट् कुर्यान्नेत्रमन्त्रो ह्ययं स्मृतः || 128 ||
text_mt: one should supply Dhareśa alone, the three-syllable word 'netrāya', / and at its end one should make 'vauṣaṭ': this is taught as the eye-mantra; // 128

sanskrit_iast: tripañcavarṇasaṃkhyastu sārddhārṇo dvija siddhidaḥ |
meaning: त्रिपञ्चवर्णसंख्यस्तु सार्द्धार्णो द्विज सिद्धिदः |
text_mt: numbering fifteen and a half syllables, O twice-born, it grants attainments.

sanskrit_iast: [astramantraḥ]
meaning: [अस्त्रमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ praṇavamadhyasthaḥ paramātmā hyanantaram || 129 ||
meaning: नमः प्रणवमध्यस्थः परमात्मा ह्यनन्तरम् || 129 ||
text_mt: Between 'namaḥ' and the praṇava stands the Supreme Self immediately after; // 129

sanskrit_iast:
savisargaḥsa evāstraṃ mūrttimantrasamanvitam |
dattāvakāśasaṃjñaṃ vai māyābhūṣitavigraham || 130 ||
meaning:
सविसर्गःस एवास्त्रं मूर्त्तिमन्त्रसमन्वितम् |
दत्तावकाशसंज्ञं वै मायाभूषितविग्रहम् || 130 ||
text_mt: with a visarga, that is the weapon, conjoined with the icon-mantra; / named Dattāvakāśa, its body adorned with Māyā, // 130

sanskrit_iast:
pavitraṃ sragdharārūḍhaṃ tadūrdhve codanaṃ nyaset |
madanaṃ satyasaṃsthaṃ ca pavitraṃ tālalakṣmagam || 131 ||
meaning:
पवित्रं स्रग्धरारूढं तदूर्ध्वे चोदनं न्यसेत् |
मदनं सत्यसंस्थं च पवित्रं ताललक्ष्मगम् || 131 ||
text_mt: Pavitra mounted on Sragdhara, above it one should place Codana; / Madana situated on Satya, and Pavitra gone to the mark of Tāla, // 131

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyastamanalastha ca kevalaṃ ca dhruvaṃ tataḥ |
tadante cāprameyaṃ tu somākhyaṃ coddharettataḥ || 132 ||
meaning:
भूयस्तमनलस्थ च केवलं च ध्रुवं ततः |
तदन्ते चाप्रमेयं तु सोमाख्यं चोद्धरेत्ततः || 132 ||
text_mt: again that [seed] on fire, and then Dhruva alone, / and at its end Aprameya, then one should extract that named Soma, // 132

sanskrit_iast:
vairājasthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha so'pi cānalasaṃsthitaḥ |
gopanenāṅkayettaṃ vai piṇḍo'yaṃ caturakṣaraḥ || 133 ||
meaning:
वैराजस्थं द्विजश्रेष्ठ सोऽपि चानलसंस्थितः |
गोपनेनाङ्कयेत्तं वै पिण्डोऽयं चतुरक्षरः || 133 ||
text_mt: standing on Vairāja, O best of the twice-born, and that too situated on fire; / one should mark it with concealment: this is a four-syllable cluster, // 133

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ ca tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ phaṭkārapadabhūṣitam |
caturdaśasvaraṃ hyastramarddhākṣaramanvitam || 134 ||
meaning:
केवलं च ततः सूक्ष्मं फट्कारपदभूषितम् |
चतुर्दशस्वरं ह्यस्त्रमर्द्धाक्षरमन्वितम् || 134 ||
text_mt: and then Sūkṣma alone, adorned with the word 'phaṭ'; / the weapon indeed has fourteen vowels, conjoined with a half-syllable. // 134

sanskrit_iast: [pūrvaṃ caturvaktratayoktasya devasya nṛsihmādyāsyatrayamantrāḥ]
meaning: [पूर्वं चतुर्वक्त्रतयोक्तस्य देवस्य नृसिह्माद्यास्यत्रयमन्त्राः]
text_mt: [The Mantras of the Three Faces, Beginning with Nṛsiṃha, of the God Previously Described as Four-Faced]

sanskrit_iast: sthitā nṛsihmapūrveṣu tānvakṣyāmi samāsataḥ || 135 ||
meaning: स्थिता नृसिह्मपूर्वेषु तान्वक्ष्यामि समासतः || 135 ||
text_mt: I shall describe in brief those residing in [the faces] beginning with Nṛsiṃha, // 135

sanskrit_iast:
sadehāśca pṛthagbhāge sāṅgāssaparivārakāḥ |
devasya vaktramātreṇa dhyeyāḥ pūjyāśca yatnataḥ || 136 ||
meaning:
सदेहाश्च पृथग्भागे साङ्गास्सपरिवारकाः |
देवस्य वक्त्रमात्रेण ध्येयाः पूज्याश्च यत्नतः || 136 ||
text_mt: with bodies in separate parts, with limbs and with retinues, / which are to be meditated upon and worshipped with care merely as faces of the God. // 136

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāpyāyayutaṃ vipra praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddharet |
ajitañcānalasthaṃ ca odanena samanvitam || 137 ||
meaning:
विश्वाप्याययुतं विप्र प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धरेत् |
अजितञ्चानलस्थं च ओदनेन समन्वितम् || 137 ||
text_mt: One should first extract the praṇava joined with Viśvāpyāyā, O vipra, / and Ajita standing on fire, conjoined with cooked food [i.e., 'o'], // 137

sanskrit_iast:
candriṇañcordhvataḥ kṛtvā vyāpanastasya copari |
proddharejjanmahantāraṃ tadadhassāmapāṭhakam || 138 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रिणञ्चोर्ध्वतः कृत्वा व्यापनस्तस्य चोपरि |
प्रोद्धरेज्जन्महन्तारं तदधस्सामपाठकम् || 138 ||
text_mt: having placed Candrin above, and Vyāpana upon it; / one should extract the slayer of birth, and beneath it the chanter of the Sāman, // 138

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāccānalasaṃsthaṃ ca r-urjaṃ vai tadadhaḥ punaḥ |
ūrdhve vyāpī tathā hyādau bhūdharaśca bhavetkramāt || 139 ||
meaning:
कुर्याच्चानलसंस्थं च र्-उर्जं वै तदधः पुनः |
ऊर्ध्वे व्यापी तथा ह्यादौ भूधरश्च भवेत्क्रमात् || 139 ||
text_mt:
And one should place it on fire, and further [place] ūrj beneath it;
above is vyāpin, and at the beginning should be the mountain-bearer (bhūdhara) in order. // 139

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍākṣaramidaṃ vipra dvitīyasya namontagam |
jvalanāyutaśabdaṃ ca dīptaye tryakṣaraṃ padam || 140 ||
meaning:
पिण्डाक्षरमिदं विप्र द्वितीयस्य नमोन्तगम् |
ज्वलनायुतशब्दं च दीप्तये त्र्यक्षरं पदम् || 140 ||
text_mt:
This is the conjunct syllable, O vipra, ending in 'namaḥ' for the second;
and the word 'jvalanāyuta', [then] the three-syllable word 'dīptaye', // 140

sanskrit_iast:
p. 52) nṛsihmāyeti ca padaṃ svāhā tadanu yojayet |
ūnaviṃśākṣaro mantro mūrtāmūrte nṛkesarī || 141 ||
meaning:
प्. 52) नृसिह्मायेति च पदं स्वाहा तदनु योजयेत् |
ऊनविंशाक्षरो मन्त्रो मूर्तामूर्ते नृकेसरी || 141 ||
text_mt:
and the word 'nṛsiṃhāya', then one should join 'svāhā';
this is the nineteen-syllable mantra of Nṛkesarin in the manifest and unmanifest [aspects]. // 141

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitassaṃsmṛto dhyātassañjaptaśca tato dvija |
nihanyātsāmayāndoṣāṃstathā bhūtagrahānapi || 142 ||
meaning:
पूजितस्संस्मृतो ध्यातस्सञ्जप्तश्च ततो द्विज |
निहन्यात्सामयान्दोषांस्तथा भूतग्रहानपि || 142 ||
text_mt:
Worshipped, remembered, meditated upon, and repeated, O twice-born,
it destroys the faults of [broken] vows as well as spirits and grahas. // 142

sanskrit_iast:
proddharetpraṇavañcādau sūryākhyaṃ tadanantaram |
tameva lokeśagataṃ vyoma cāndrī tadūrdhvataḥ || 143 ||
meaning:
प्रोद्धरेत्प्रणवञ्चादौ सूर्याख्यं तदनन्तरम् |
तमेव लोकेशगतं व्योम चान्द्री तदूर्ध्वतः || 143 ||
text_mt:
One should first extract the praṇava, and immediately after, that named sūrya;
that very [syllable] gone into lokeśa, the void, and cāndrī above it; // 143

sanskrit_iast:
rephabījamathādāya dharmāṃśuṃ tadadho nyaset |
tadadho hyanalaṃ bhūyaḥ prajñādhāropari sthitam || 144 ||
meaning:
रेफबीजमथादाय धर्मांशुं तदधो न्यसेत् |
तदधो ह्यनलं भूयः प्रज्ञाधारोपरि स्थितम् || 144 ||
text_mt:
then taking the repha-seed, one should place the sun (dharmāṃśu) beneath it;
beneath that, fire again, situated above the base of wisdom (prajñādhāra); // 144

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhātmā'sya cordhve tu cāndrī vyāpī kramādbhavet |
asya piṇḍadvayasyānte namaskāraṃ niyojayet || 145 ||
meaning:
औषधात्माऽस्य चोर्ध्वे तु चान्द्री व्यापी क्रमाद्भवेत् |
अस्य पिण्डद्वयस्यान्ते नमस्कारं नियोजयेत् || 145 ||
text_mt:
above it should be the essence of herbs (auṣadhātman), then cāndrī and vyāpin in order;
at the end of this pair of conjunct syllables one should join the salutation [namaḥ]; // 145

sanskrit_iast:
anantabhāsāya padaṃ kapilāya tato bhavet |
svāhāsamanvitaṃ kuryānmantraṃ saptadaśākṣaram || 146 ||
meaning:
अनन्तभासाय पदं कपिलाय ततो भवेत् |
स्वाहासमन्वितं कुर्यान्मन्त्रं सप्तदशाक्षरम् || 146 ||
text_mt:
then should be the word 'anantabhāsāya', [then] 'kapilāya';
one should make the seventeen-syllable mantra accompanied by 'svāhā'. // 146

sanskrit_iast:
atyugraṃ kapilaṃ nāmnā sarvadvandopaśāntidam |
prāyaścittavidhau nityaṃ japtavyassiddhihetukaḥ || 147 ||
meaning:
अत्युग्रं कपिलं नाम्ना सर्वद्वन्दोपशान्तिदम् |
प्रायश्चित्तविधौ नित्यं जप्तव्यस्सिद्धिहेतुकः || 147 ||
text_mt:
Extremely fierce, Kapila by name, bestowing pacification of all dualities,
it should be recited constantly in expiatory rites, bringing about success, // 147

sanskrit_iast:
tathā'pavargaprāptyarthamacireṇa tu nārada |
prāgoṅkāramathādāya govindākhyamathoddharet || 148 ||
meaning:
तथाऽपवर्गप्राप्त्यर्थमचिरेण तु नारद |
प्रागोङ्कारमथादाय गोविन्दाख्यमथोद्धरेत् || 148 ||
text_mt:
and also for attaining liberation without delay, O Nārada.
First taking the oṅkāra, one should then extract that called govinda, // 148

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣeśvaramasyātha otadehaṃ tadūrdhvagam |
tryailokyaiśvaryadopetaṃ ṭakārastasya copari || 149 ||
meaning:
पुरुषेश्वरमस्याथ ओतदेहं तदूर्ध्वगम् |
त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदोपेतं टकारस्तस्य चोपरि || 149 ||
text_mt:
[then] puruṣeśvara of this, then the body woven (ota) going above it,
endowed with the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds, and the letter 'ṭa' upon it; // 149

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtākhyaṃ varāhasthamūkāraṃ tadadho dvija |
okārāntaṃ tadūrdhve tu tryailokyaiśvaryadaṃ tataḥ || 150 ||
meaning:
अमृताख्यं वराहस्थमूकारं तदधो द्विज |
ओकारान्तं तदूर्ध्वे तु त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदं ततः || 150 ||
text_mt:
beneath it the letter 'ū' called amṛta, situated on the boar, O twice-born;
above it ending in the letter 'o', then the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds, // 150

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāpyāyasamāyuktamasyānte vinyasennamaḥ |
kṛṣṇavarṇadvayaṃ dadyātpiṅgalāya padaṃ tataḥ || 151 ||
meaning:
विश्वाप्यायसमायुक्तमस्यान्ते विन्यसेन्नमः |
कृष्णवर्णद्वयं दद्यात्पिङ्गलाय पदं ततः || 151 ||
text_mt:
conjoined with viśvāpyāyā; at the end of this one should deposit 'namaḥ';
one should supply the two black letters, then the word 'piṅgalāya', // 151

sanskrit_iast:
varāhāya padaṃ svāhā mantrassaptadaśākṣaraḥ |
śānti śrīpuṣṭimārogyaṃ kuryādāpyāyanaṃ smṛtam || 152 ||
meaning:
वराहाय पदं स्वाहा मन्त्रस्सप्तदशाक्षरः |
शान्ति श्रीपुष्टिमारोग्यं कुर्यादाप्यायनं स्मृतम् || 152 ||
text_mt:
[then] the word 'varāhāya' [and] 'svāhā'; this is the seventeen-syllable mantra.
It produces peace, prosperity, nourishment, and health; it is taught as invigorating. // 152

sanskrit_iast: goptavyaścaiva japtavyo vārāho bhuktimuktidaḥ |
meaning: गोप्तव्यश्चैव जप्तव्यो वाराहो भुक्तिमुक्तिदः |
text_mt: The [mantra] of Varāha is to be guarded and recited, granting enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast: [atha kaustubhādimantraḥ]
meaning: [अथ कौस्तुभादिमन्त्रः]
text_mt: [Now the mantras of Kaustubha and others]

sanskrit_iast: kaustubhādyaṅkuśāntāṃśca mantrānsarvānyathā śṛṇu || 153 ||
meaning: कौस्तुभाद्यङ्कुशान्तांश्च मन्त्रान्सर्वान्यथा शृणु || 153 ||
text_mt: Now hear properly all the mantras beginning with Kaustubha and ending with the goad, // 153

sanskrit_iast: yeṣāmanantavibhavaḥśaśvadārādhanādbhavet |
meaning: येषामनन्तविभवःशश्वदाराधनाद्भवेत् |
text_mt: from the constant worship of which endless power arises.

sanskrit_iast: [kaustubhamantraḥ]
meaning: [कौस्तुभमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: p. 53) kaustubho vyomasaṃbhinnaḥ paramātmā tato dvija || 154 ||
meaning: प्. 53) कौस्तुभो व्योमसंभिन्नः परमात्मा ततो द्विज || 154 ||
text_mt: Kaustubha is pierced by the void; then the Supreme Self (paramātman), O twice-born; // 154

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvādho'nalasaṃbhinnaṃ kuryāttadanu nārada |
akāreṇāṅkitaṃ taṃ vai taṃ tamūrjena kārayet || 155 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाधोऽनलसंभिन्नं कुर्यात्तदनु नारद |
अकारेणाङ्कितं तं वै तं तमूर्जेन कारयेत् || 155 ||
text_mt:
one should then make it pierced above and below by fire, O Nārada;
marked with the letter 'a', one should indeed combine that with ūrj; // 155

sanskrit_iast:
tato vyomānvito nemī namaskṛtiranantaram |
prabhātmane padaṃ dadyātkaustubhāya padaṃ tataḥ || 156 ||
meaning:
ततो व्योमान्वितो नेमी नमस्कृतिरनन्तरम् |
प्रभात्मने पदं दद्यात्कौस्तुभाय पदं ततः || 156 ||
text_mt:
then nemi conjoined with the void; immediately after, the salutation [namaḥ];
one should supply the word 'prabhātmane', then the word 'kaustubhāya', // 156

sanskrit_iast:
svāhānvitassapraṇavaḥ kaustubhasya prakīrttitaḥ |
ṣoḍaśārṇo mahāmantro nāsti tadyanna sādhayet || 157 ||
meaning:
स्वाहान्वितस्सप्रणवः कौस्तुभस्य प्रकीर्त्तितः |
षोडशार्णो महामन्त्रो नास्ति तद्यन्न साधयेत् || 157 ||
text_mt:
accompanied by 'svāhā' along with the praṇava: [this] is proclaimed as [the mantra] of Kaustubha.
It is a great sixteen-syllable mantra; there is nothing which it may not accomplish. // 157

sanskrit_iast: [mālāmantraḥ]
meaning: [मालामन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast:
proddharetpraṇavānte tu dhareśaṃ tadadho nyaset |
tṛptisaṃjñaṃ ca tasyādho varuṇaṃ viniveśya ca || 158 ||
meaning:
प्रोद्धरेत्प्रणवान्ते तु धरेशं तदधो न्यसेत् |
तृप्तिसंज्ञं च तस्याधो वरुणं विनिवेश्य च || 158 ||
text_mt:
At the end of the praṇava one should extract dhareśa, and place underneath it
that named tṛpti, and having placed Varuṇa beneath it, // 158

sanskrit_iast:
māyāvyomānvitaḥ piṇḍo namaskārasamanvitaḥ |
sthalavarṇadvayaṃ dadyājjalodbhūtapadaṃ tataḥ || 159 ||
meaning:
मायाव्योमान्वितः पिण्डो नमस्कारसमन्वितः |
स्थलवर्णद्वयं दद्याज्जलोद्भूतपदं ततः || 159 ||
text_mt:
the conjunct syllable conjoined with māyā and the void, accompanied by the salutation [namaḥ];
one should supply the two land-letters, then the word 'jalodbhūta', // 159

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣite vanamāle svāhā sametaṃ padaṃ tataḥ |
ekonaviṃśavarṇastu mālāmantra udāhṛtaḥ || 160 ||
meaning:
भूषिते वनमाले स्वाहा समेतं पदं ततः |
एकोनविंशवर्णस्तु मालामन्त्र उदाहृतः || 160 ||
text_mt:
then the word 'bhūṣite vanamāle' together with 'svāhā';
the nineteen-syllable garland-mantra has been declared, // 160

sanskrit_iast: abhīṣṭasiddhido vipra nityamārādhakasya ca |
meaning: अभीष्टसिद्धिदो विप्र नित्यमाराधकस्य च |
text_mt: bestowing the attainment of desires, O vipra, for the perpetual worshipper.

sanskrit_iast: [padmamantraḥ]
meaning: [पद्ममन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: praṇavasyāvasāne tu vāmanākhyaṃ niyojayet || 161 ||
meaning: प्रणवस्यावसाने तु वामनाख्यं नियोजयेत् || 161 ||
text_mt: At the end of the praṇava, one should join that named vāmana, // 161

sanskrit_iast:
somākhyaṃ tadadho yojya uddāmopari saṃsthitaḥ |
tryailokyaiśvaryadopetaḥ piṇḍo natisamanvitaḥ || 162 ||
meaning:
सोमाख्यं तदधो योज्य उद्दामोपरि संस्थितः |
त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदोपेतः पिण्डो नतिसमन्वितः || 162 ||
text_mt:
and having joined that named soma beneath it, situated upon uddāma,
the conjunct syllable endowed with the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds, accompanied by obeisance [namaḥ]; // 162

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnivāsapadaṃ dadyātpadmāya tadanantaram |
svāhānvitastu padmasya mantraḥ syāttridaśākṣaraḥ || 163 ||
meaning:
श्रीनिवासपदं दद्यात्पद्माय तदनन्तरम् |
स्वाहान्वितस्तु पद्मस्य मन्त्रः स्यात्त्रिदशाक्षरः || 163 ||
text_mt:
one should supply the word 'śrīnivāsa', immediately after that 'padmāya';
accompanied by 'svāhā', the mantra of the lotus shall have thirteen syllables; // 163

sanskrit_iast: prayacchatyatulāṃ bhūtiṃ bhaktānāmakṣayāṃ dvija |
meaning: प्रयच्छत्यतुलां भूतिं भक्तानामक्षयां द्विज |
text_mt: it grants peerless and imperishable power to devotees, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast: [śaṅkhamantraḥ]
meaning: [शङ्खमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: praṇavaṃ pūrvamādāya paramātmānamuddharet || 164 ||
meaning: प्रणवं पूर्वमादाय परमात्मानमुद्धरेत् || 164 ||
text_mt: First taking the praṇava, one should extract the Supreme Self (paramātman); // 164

sanskrit_iast:
bhedayedbhuvanāntena tryailokyaiśvaryadena tu |
namaskāraṃ kramaṃ kuryādetadevākṣaraṃ tridhā || 165 ||
meaning:
भेदयेद्भुवनान्तेन त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेन तु |
नमस्कारं क्रमं कुर्यादेतदेवाक्षरं त्रिधा || 165 ||
text_mt:
one should pierce it with the end of the worlds and with the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds;
one should make the salutation in order; this very syllable three times, // 165

sanskrit_iast:
mahāśaṅkhāya ca svāhā śaṅkhākhyastridaśākṣaraḥ |
yantraśśubhataraḥ prokto dhiyaṃ vidyāṃ prayacchati || 166 ||
meaning:
महाशङ्खाय च स्वाहा शङ्खाख्यस्त्रिदशाक्षरः |
यन्त्रश्शुभतरः प्रोक्तो धियं विद्यां प्रयच्छति || 166 ||
text_mt:
'mahāśaṅkhāya' and 'svāhā': the [mantra] named conch has thirteen syllables;
this most auspicious yantra is declared; it bestows intellect and knowledge. // 166

sanskrit_iast: p. 54) [cakramantraḥ]
meaning: प्. 54) [चक्रमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast:
śāśvataḥ praṇavānte tu rārūḍhassiddhikṛdyutaḥ |
tādṛśaścāpi kamalaḥ praphullanayanastataḥ || 167 ||
meaning:
शाश्वतः प्रणवान्ते तु रारूढस्सिद्धिकृद्युतः |
तादृशश्चापि कमलः प्रफुल्लनयनस्ततः || 167 ||
text_mt:
At the end of the praṇava is śāśvata mounted on 'ra', joined with siddhikṛt;
and likewise kamala, then praphullanayana; // 167

sanskrit_iast:
kevalassyāttadante tu hlādassvaravivarjitaḥ |
paramātmānamuddhṛtya aṅkuśādyena saṃyutam || 168 ||
meaning:
केवलस्स्यात्तदन्ते तु ह्लादस्स्वरविवर्जितः |
परमात्मानमुद्धृत्य अङ्कुशाद्येन संयुतम् || 168 ||
text_mt:
at its end should be alone hlāda devoid of vowels;
extracting the Supreme Self (paramātman), conjoined with the first of the goads, // 168

sanskrit_iast:
aurvāntenāṅkitaṃ mūrdhnā tadante yojayennamaḥ |
phaṭkāratritayaṃ paścādviṣṇucakrāya vai padam || 169 ||
meaning:
और्वान्तेनाङ्कितं मूर्ध्ना तदन्ते योजयेन्नमः |
फट्कारत्रितयं पश्चाद्विष्णुचक्राय वै पदम् || 169 ||
text_mt:
marked at the top with the end of Aurva, at its end one should join 'namaḥ';
afterward the triad of 'phaṭ', and indeed the word 'viṣṇucakrāya', // 169

sanskrit_iast:
svāhārṇadvitayaṃ cānte cākraṃ saptadaśākṣaram |
ardhākṣaracatuṣkena yuktaṃ sarvamidaṃ jagat || 170 ||
meaning:
स्वाहार्णद्वितयं चान्ते चाक्रं सप्तदशाक्षरम् |
अर्धाक्षरचतुष्केन युक्तं सर्वमिदं जगत् || 170 ||
text_mt:
and at the end the pair of syllables 'svāhā': the discus [mantra] has seventeen syllables;
endowed with four half-syllables, this entire universe [is pervaded by it]. // 170

sanskrit_iast: [gadāmantraḥ]
meaning: [गदामन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast:
uddharetpraṇavaṃ tvādau tadante ca gadādharam |
pradhānoparisaṃsthaṃ ca tadadhaḥ puruṣeśvaram || 171 ||
meaning:
उद्धरेत्प्रणवं त्वादौ तदन्ते च गदाधरम् |
प्रधानोपरिसंस्थं च तदधः पुरुषेश्वरम् || 171 ||
text_mt:
One should extract the praṇava first, and at its end the mace-bearer (gadādhara);
and situated upon pradhāna, and beneath it puruṣeśvara; // 171

sanskrit_iast:
jagadyoniyutaṃ mūrdhnā vyomeśamupari nyaset |
tato jakāramādāya viṣṭaropari saṃsthitam || 172 ||
meaning:
जगद्योनियुतं मूर्ध्ना व्योमेशमुपरि न्यसेत् |
ततो जकारमादाय विष्टरोपरि संस्थितम् || 172 ||
text_mt:
conjoined at the crown with the womb of the world, one should place the Lord of the Void above;
then taking the letter 'ja', situated upon the seat (viṣṭara), // 172

sanskrit_iast:
visargādyena saṃbhinnaṃ namaskāravibhūṣitam |
sahasrāśrigade svāhā gadākhyastridaśākṣaraḥ || 173 ||
meaning:
विसर्गाद्येन संभिन्नं नमस्कारविभूषितम् |
सहस्राश्रिगदे स्वाहा गदाख्यस्त्रिदशाक्षरः || 173 ||
text_mt:
pierced by the first of the visargas, adorned with the salutation [namaḥ];
'sahasrāśrigade svāhā': the [mantra] named mace has thirteen syllables; // 173

sanskrit_iast: abhīṣṭado mahāmantro vighnajālakṣayaṃkaraḥ |
meaning: अभीष्टदो महामन्त्रो विघ्नजालक्षयंकरः |
text_mt: the great mantra grants desires and brings about the destruction of the net of obstacles.

sanskrit_iast: [garuḍamantraḥ]
meaning: [गरुडमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: praṇavaṃ pūrvamādāya ananteśamataḥ param || 174 ||
meaning: प्रणवं पूर्वमादाय अनन्तेशमतः परम् || 174 ||
text_mt: First taking the praṇava, and after this the Lord of Ananta (ananteśa), // 174

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvā'dhonalasaṃbhinnaṃ satyādyaṃ tadadho nyaset |
tryailaukyaiśvaryadā dānatrailokyaiśvaryadena ca || 175 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाऽधोनलसंभिन्नं सत्याद्यं तदधो न्यसेत् |
त्र्यैलौक्यैश्वर्यदा दानत्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेन च || 175 ||
text_mt:
pierced above and below by fire; one should place the first of satya beneath it;
with the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds and the giver of sovereignty over the three worlds by gifts, // 175

sanskrit_iast:
śirasā bhūṣitaṃ kuryādvedātmānamathoddharet |
so'pyananteśavatkāryassvaravyañjanabhūṣitaḥ || 176 ||
meaning:
शिरसा भूषितं कुर्याद्वेदात्मानमथोद्धरेत् |
सोऽप्यनन्तेशवत्कार्यस्स्वरव्यञ्जनभूषितः || 176 ||
text_mt:
one should make it adorned on the head, and then extract the Self of the Vedas (vedātman);
that too is to be made like ananteśa, adorned with vowels and consonants; // 176

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭikṛtsahitaṃ bhūyaḥ kūṭaṃ dadyānnamontagam |
padañcānte'nantagate svāhāntaṃ garuḍāya ca || 177 ||
meaning:
सृष्टिकृत्सहितं भूयः कूटं दद्यान्नमोन्तगम् |
पदञ्चान्तेऽनन्तगते स्वाहान्तं गरुडाय च || 177 ||
text_mt:
again one should supply the kūṭa accompanied by the creator of emission (sṛṣṭikṛt), ending in 'namaḥ';
and at the end the word 'anantagate', and 'garuḍāya' ending in 'svāhā'. // 177

sanskrit_iast:
saptadaśākṣaro mantraḥ kīrttito garuḍasya ca |
yasya saṃsmaraṇātsamyaksamastāpallayaṃ vrajet || 178 ||
meaning:
सप्तदशाक्षरो मन्त्रः कीर्त्तितो गरुडस्य च |
यस्य संस्मरणात्सम्यक्समस्तापल्लयं व्रजेत् || 178 ||
text_mt:
The mantra of Garuḍa is proclaimed to have seventeen syllables;
by whose proper remembrance all misfortune goes to dissolution. // 178

sanskrit_iast: p. 55) [pāśamantraḥ]

ādāyādau tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ tasyārūḍhaṃ ca raṃ nyaset |
vyomānandasametaṃ ca kaḍhḍhakaḍhḍhapadaṃ tataḥ || 179 ||
meaning:
आदायादौ तु वैकुण्ठं तस्यारूढं च रं न्यसेत् |
व्योमानन्दसमेतं च कढ्ढकढ्ढपदं ततः || 179 ||
text_mt:
First taking vaikuṇṭha, one should place 'ra' mounted upon it,
and accompanied by the bliss of the void (vyomānanda); then the word 'kaḍhḍhakaḍhḍha', // 179

sanskrit_iast:
dhārādharadvayopetaṃ varapāśāya vai padam |
svāhā caiva tu tasyānte kuryāt saptadaśākṣaraḥ || 180 ||
meaning:
धाराधरद्वयोपेतं वरपाशाय वै पदम् |
स्वाहा चैव तु तस्यान्ते कुर्यात् सप्तदशाक्षरः || 180 ||
text_mt:
endowed with two cloud-letters (dhārādhara), indeed the word 'varapāśāya',
and at its end one should make 'svāhā': it has seventeen syllables; // 180

sanskrit_iast: sa tārako hyayaṃ mantraḥ pāśākhyaḥ kṣiprasiddhikṛt |
meaning: स तारको ह्ययं मन्त्रः पाशाख्यः क्षिप्रसिद्धिकृत् |
text_mt: this mantra named noose is indeed a savior, bringing about swift attainment.

sanskrit_iast: [aṅkuśamantraḥ]
meaning: [अङ्कुशमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: praṇavānte tataḥ kuryādvirāṭsaṃjñaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ || 181 ||
meaning: प्रणवान्ते ततः कुर्याद्विराट्संज्ञं तदूर्ध्वतः || 181 ||
text_mt: Then, after the praṇava, one should place the one named Virāṭ; above that, // 181

sanskrit_iast:
vyomaviprānalopetaṃ kamalaṃ tadanantaram |
ṛtadhāmoparisthaṃ ca vyoma tasyopari nyaset || 182 ||
meaning:
व्योमविप्रानलोपेतं कमलं तदनन्तरम् |
ऋतधामोपरिस्थं च व्योम तस्योपरि न्यसेत् || 182 ||
text_mt: immediately following, lotus (kamala) endowed with ether (vyoma), brāhmaṇa (vipra), and fire (anala); / and one should place ether resting above the abode of Ṛta (ṛtadhāman) upon that; // 182

sanskrit_iast:
padaṃ niśitaghoṇāya aṅkuśāya padaṃ tataḥ |
svāhānvitastripañcārṇo mantrarāḍaṅkuśasya ca || 183 ||
meaning:
पदं निशितघोणाय अङ्कुशाय पदं ततः |
स्वाहान्वितस्त्रिपञ्चार्णो मन्त्रराडङ्कुशस्य च || 183 ||
text_mt: then the word 'niśitaghoṇāya', then the word 'aṅkuśāya', / endowed with 'svāhā': the fifteen-syllabled king of mantras of the goad // 183

sanskrit_iast: śīghrakarmakaraḥ prokto nityamicchāntalakṣaṇaḥ |
meaning: शीघ्रकर्मकरः प्रोक्तो नित्यमिच्छान्तलक्षणः |
text_mt: is declared to be swift in accomplishing acts, constantly characterized by the limit of desire.

sanskrit_iast: [upāṅgapañcakanirūpaṇārambhaḥ]
meaning: [उपाङ्गपञ्चकनिरूपणारम्भः]
text_mt: [Beginning of the Description of the Five Minor Angas]

sanskrit_iast: upāṅgapañcakaṃ cātha satyādīnāṃ hi vācakam || 184 ||
meaning: उपाङ्गपञ्चकं चाथ सत्यादीनां हि वाचकम् || 184 ||
text_mt: And now the five minor aṅgas, which indeed express Satya and the others, // 184

sanskrit_iast:
brahmasvarūpamamalaṃ vyāpakaṃ sarvasiddhidam |
samyakśṛṇuṣva devarṣe sarahasyaṃ vadāmi te || 185 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मस्वरूपममलं व्यापकं सर्वसिद्धिदम् |
सम्यक्शृणुष्व देवर्षे सरहस्यं वदामि ते || 185 ||
text_mt: having the nature of Brahman, immaculate, all-pervading, granting all attainments: / listen carefully, divine sage; I will tell you [them] with their secret. // 185

sanskrit_iast:
yadvinyāsātsādhakasya siddho vai yatra kutracit |
phalado mantramūrtissyādacirāttanmayasya ca || 186 ||
meaning:
यद्विन्यासात्साधकस्य सिद्धो वै यत्र कुत्रचित् |
फलदो मन्त्रमूर्तिस्स्यादचिरात्तन्मयस्य च || 186 ||
text_mt: From whose nyāsa the practitioner becomes perfected anywhere whatsoever; / the mantra-body will before long grant fruit to one who has become identified with it. // 186

sanskrit_iast:
syāddeveśasamo mantrī tannyāsādvyāptibhāvanāt |
yāgāhutasya mantrasya śaktyaṅgādyāvṛtasya ca || 187 ||
meaning:
स्याद्देवेशसमो मन्त्री तन्न्यासाद्व्याप्तिभावनात् |
यागाहुतस्य मन्त्रस्य शक्त्यङ्गाद्यावृतस्य च || 187 ||
text_mt: From its nyāsa and from contemplating [its] pervasiveness, the mantrin becomes equal to the Lord of gods. / For the mantra summoned in sacrifice and surrounded by [mantras of] the power, aṅgas, and the rest, // 187

sanskrit_iast:
samyaṅnirodhasiddhyarthaṃ yojanīyaṃ sadaiva hi |
tathātmanaḥ kṛte nyāse nyaste copāṅgapañcake || 188 ||
meaning:
सम्यङ्निरोधसिद्ध्यर्थं योजनीयं सदैव हि |
तथात्मनः कृते न्यासे न्यस्ते चोपाङ्गपञ्चके || 188 ||
text_mt: it should always be applied for the sake of attaining complete restraint. / Likewise, when nyāsa is made on oneself and the five minor aṅgas are placed, // 188

sanskrit_iast: śaśvatsyāccittavṛttīnāṃ vikṣiptānāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ |
meaning: शश्वत्स्याच्चित्तवृत्तीनां विक्षिप्तानां च संयमः |
text_mt: there is constant restraint of distracted mental fluctuations.

sanskrit_iast: [satyādyupāṅgapañcakabījamantraḥ]
meaning: [सत्याद्युपाङ्गपञ्चकबीजमन्त्रः]
text_mt: [The Seed-Mantras of the Five Minor Angas, Satya and the Others]

sanskrit_iast: turyātītātmasaṃjño yo vargaḥ pañcārṇabhūṣitaḥ || 189 ||
meaning: तुर्यातीतात्मसंज्ञो यो वर्गः पञ्चार्णभूषितः || 189 ||
text_mt: The class named 'whose self transcends the fourth [state]', adorned with five phonemes: // 189

sanskrit_iast:
vilomena suparṇādyaṃ sthāpayitvā niyojya ca |
ādyaṃ vai bhūdharākhyena ūrjasaṃjñena cāparam || 190 ||
meaning:
विलोमेन सुपर्णाद्यं स्थापयित्वा नियोज्य च |
आद्यं वै भूधराख्येन ऊर्जसंज्ञेन चापरम् || 190 ||
text_mt: having placed and applied the one beginning with Suparṇa in reverse order— / the first with the one named mountain-bearer (bhūdhara), the second with the one named strength (ūrjas), // 190

sanskrit_iast:
lokeśena tṛtīyaṃ tu turyaṃ sākṣācca viṣṇunā |
p. 56) pañcamaṃ tvādidevena vyāpī sarvatra mūrdhani || 191 ||
meaning:
लोकेशेन तृतीयं तु तुर्यं साक्षाच्च विष्णुना |
प्. 56) पञ्चमं त्वादिदेवेन व्यापी सर्वत्र मूर्धनि || 191 ||
text_mt: the third with the lord of the world (lokeśa), the fourth directly with Viṣṇu, / and the fifth with the primal god (ādideva)—is all-pervading everywhere on the head. // 191

sanskrit_iast:
samastena dvijoṅkāre ekaikaṃ madhyataḥ kṣipet |
pañcakaṃ pañcasaṃjñasya bījabhūtamidaṃ smṛtam || 192 ||
meaning:
समस्तेन द्विजोङ्कारे एकैकं मध्यतः क्षिपेत् |
पञ्चकं पञ्चसंज्ञस्य बीजभूतमिदं स्मृतम् || 192 ||
text_mt: O twice-born, into the complete oṃkāra one should insert each one in the middle; / this is remembered as the group of five that constitutes the seed of the fivefold. // 192

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthitaṃ tu paratvena etasmātprabhavanti te |
saukṣmyena vyāpakatvena dhātṛtvena tu nārada || 193 ||
meaning:
संस्थितं तु परत्वेन एतस्मात्प्रभवन्ति ते |
सौक्ष्म्येन व्यापकत्वेन धातृत्वेन तु नारद || 193 ||
text_mt: Existing, however, in transcendence, they arise from this / through subtlety, pervasiveness, and sustaining power, O Nārada. // 193

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasminsamūhena pañcaite saṃvyavasthitāḥ |
praśāntahutabhugrūpāḥ paramantrasahoditāḥ || 194 ||
meaning:
एकैकस्मिन्समूहेन पञ्चैते संव्यवस्थिताः |
प्रशान्तहुतभुग्रूपाः परमन्त्रसहोदिताः || 194 ||
text_mt: These five are established as a group within each one, / having the form of extinguished fire, arising together with the supreme mantra. // 194

sanskrit_iast:
ādidevasya vai viṣṇoḥ satyākhyasya mahātmanaḥ |
mahāvibhavasaṃjñasya prathamo mantrarāṭ smṛtaḥ || 195 ||
meaning:
आदिदेवस्य वै विष्णोः सत्याख्यस्य महात्मनः |
महाविभवसंज्ञस्य प्रथमो मन्त्रराट् स्मृतः || 195 ||
text_mt: Of the primal god, the great-souled Viṣṇu named Satya / and called 'of great majesty' (mahāvibhava), the first king of mantras is remembered. // 195

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevasya ca vibhordvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
saṅkarṣaṇasya ca tato bījamuktaṃ tṛtīyakam || 196 ||
meaning:
वासुदेवस्य च विभोर्द्वितीयः परिकीर्तितः |
सङ्कर्षणस्य च ततो बीजमुक्तं तृतीयकम् || 196 ||
text_mt: The second is proclaimed as of the all-pervading Vāsudeva; / then the third seed is declared to belong to Saṅkarṣaṇa. // 196

sanskrit_iast:
caturthaṃ vipraśārdūla pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ |
upāṅgaṃ pañcamaṃ viddhi aniruddhātmano vibhoḥ || 197 ||
meaning:
चतुर्थं विप्रशार्दूल प्रद्युम्नस्य महात्मनः |
उपाङ्गं पञ्चमं विद्धि अनिरुद्धात्मनो विभोः || 197 ||
text_mt: Know the fourth, O tiger among brāhmaṇas, to belong to the great-souled Pradyumna, / and the fifth minor aṅga to belong to the all-pervading Lord Aniruddha. // 197

sanskrit_iast:
satyādyamaniruddhāntaṃ pavitraṃ mantrapañcakam |
upāṅgasaṃjñaṃ yo vetti sa satyaṃ vetti nānyathā || 198 ||
meaning:
सत्याद्यमनिरुद्धान्तं पवित्रं मन्त्रपञ्चकम् |
उपाङ्गसंज्ञं यो वेत्ति स सत्यं वेत्ति नान्यथा || 198 ||
text_mt: Whoever knows the pure group of five mantras beginning with Satya and ending with Aniruddha, / named the minor aṅgas, knows the truth, not otherwise. // 198

sanskrit_iast:
iti sūkṣmasvarūpasya vibhormantravarasya ca |
tryakṣarasya dvibījādyaṃ vyāpakasyāmalasya ca || 199 ||
meaning:
इति सूक्ष्मस्वरूपस्य विभोर्मन्त्रवरस्य च |
त्र्यक्षरस्य द्विबीजाद्यं व्यापकस्यामलस्य च || 199 ||
text_mt: Thus, of the supreme mantra of the all-pervading Lord of subtle nature, / which has three syllables and begins with two seeds, and is all-pervading and immaculate, // 199

sanskrit_iast:
mūrttimantrāditaḥ prokto mantrasaṃjño(gho ?) yathākramam |
abhīpsitapradassamyagbhaktānāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 200 ||
meaning:
मूर्त्तिमन्त्रादितः प्रोक्तो मन्त्रसंज्ञो(घो ?) यथाक्रमम् |
अभीप्सितप्रदस्सम्यग्भक्तानां भावितात्मनाम् || 200 ||
text_mt: the designation of mantras has been declared in proper order, beginning with the icon-mantra, / fully granting the desired [fruit] to devotees of cultivated self. // 200

sanskrit_iast:
atrāsakto bhava mune yajaitatpūjayasva ca |
vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena vāñchitaṃ yatprayachati || 201 ||
meaning:
अत्रासक्तो भव मुने यजैतत्पूजयस्व च |
विधिना शास्त्रदृष्टेन वाञ्छितं यत्प्रयछति || 201 ||
text_mt: Be devoted to this, O sage: offer this and worship [it] / according to the injunction seen in the scripture, for it grants what is desired. // 201

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ
meaning: नारदः

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlasūkṣmavibhāgena eṣa mantraḥ paro mayā |
jñātaḥ parasvarūpeṇa na jñātaḥ parameśvara || 202 ||
meaning:
स्थूलसूक्ष्मविभागेन एष मन्त्रः परो मया |
ज्ञातः परस्वरूपेण न ज्ञातः परमेश्वर || 202 ||
text_mt: By division into gross and subtle, this supreme mantra / has been understood by me; it has not been understood in its supreme nature, O Supreme Lord. // 202

sanskrit_iast:
purā'syaiva parā mūrttirmāntrī saṃsūcitā tvayā |
samācakṣva samāsena yadi sānugraho'si me || 203 ||
meaning:
पुराऽस्यैव परा मूर्त्तिर्मान्त्री संसूचिता त्वया |
समाचक्ष्व समासेन यदि सानुग्रहोऽसि मे || 203 ||
text_mt: Formerly, this very supreme sonic form was indicated by you; / explain it concisely if you have grace toward me. // 203

sanskrit_iast: [mantrasya parasvarūpanirūpaṇam]
meaning: [मन्त्रस्य परस्वरूपनिरूपणम्]
text_mt: [Determination of the Supreme Nature of the Mantra]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtimantraṃ vinā vipra yo mantraḥ prāgudīritaḥ |
p. 57) prabhavādyo visargāntassudhāsandohavigrahaḥ || 204 ||
meaning:
मूर्तिमन्त्रं विना विप्र यो मन्त्रः प्रागुदीरितः |
प्. 57) प्रभवाद्यो विसर्गान्तस्सुधासन्दोहविग्रहः || 204 ||
text_mt: Apart from the icon-mantra, O brāhmaṇa, the mantra that was uttered previously, / beginning with the source and ending with visarga, having a body of abundant nectar, // 204

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevamayaśśuddhassarvādhvātmā paraḥ prabhuḥ |
samastaśaktidehastu bhārūpassūkṣmarūpadhṛt || 205 ||
meaning:
सर्वदेवमयश्शुद्धस्सर्वाध्वात्मा परः प्रभुः |
समस्तशक्तिदेहस्तु भारूपस्सूक्ष्मरूपधृत् || 205 ||
text_mt: consisting of all deities, pure, the self of all paths, the supreme sovereign, / having a body of all powers, having the form of light, bearing a subtle form, // 205

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāmicchayā sthūlatāṃ gataḥ |
adhiṣṭhitassa vibhunā pareṇālokarūpiṇā || 206 ||
meaning:
संसारार्णवमग्नानामिच्छया स्थूलतां गतः |
अधिष्ठितस्स विभुना परेणालोकरूपिणा || 206 ||
text_mt: has reached grossness by [his] will for those immersed in the ocean of transmigratory existence, / presided over by the supreme, all-pervading Lord whose form is light, // 206

sanskrit_iast:
susūkṣmeṇāvigraheṇa sadālokarasātmanā |
aṇīyāṃsamaṇorviddhi mantraśaktiḥ parā hi sā || 207 ||
meaning:
सुसूक्ष्मेणाविग्रहेण सदालोकरसात्मना |
अणीयांसमणोर्विद्धि मन्त्रशक्तिः परा हि सा || 207 ||
text_mt: by means of the extremely subtle, bodiless self of the essence of perpetual light. / Know it to be smaller than the smallest, for that is the supreme mantra-power. // 207

sanskrit_iast:
upādhirahitaṃ śuddhaṃ matsāmīpyaphalapradam |
taccharīraṃ hi me mantraṃ paraṃ paraphalapradam || 208 ||
meaning:
उपाधिरहितं शुद्धं मत्सामीप्यफलप्रदम् |
तच्छरीरं हि मे मन्त्रं परं परफलप्रदम् || 208 ||
text_mt: Deceitless, pure, granting the fruit of proximity to me, / that body of mine is indeed the supreme mantra, granting the supreme fruit. // 208

sanskrit_iast:
[parasūkṣmasthūlarūpeṇa satāṃ mantrāṇāṃ saṃvinmayāt sarvataḥ
paratarātprādurbhāvanirūpaṇam]
meaning:
[परसूक्ष्मस्थूलरूपेण सतां मन्त्राणां संविन्मयात् सर्वतः
परतरात्प्रादुर्भावनिरूपणम्]
text_mt: [Determination of the Manifestation of Mantras Existing in Supreme, Subtle, and Gross Forms from the Supreme beyond All, Consisting of Consciousness]

sanskrit_iast:
nirvikāraśarīraṃ ca yāgākhyaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam |
turyātparaṃ padādasmāt jñeyākhyaṃ paramaṃ mama || 209 ||
meaning:
निर्विकारशरीरं च यागाख्यं परमं स्मृतम् |
तुर्यात्परं पदादस्मात् ज्ञेयाख्यं परमं मम || 209 ||
text_mt: And that immutable body, designated as sacrifice, is remembered as supreme; / beyond the fourth state, from this abode, my [body] is designated as the supreme object of knowledge, // 209

sanskrit_iast:
grāhyagrāhakanirmuktaṃ saṃvidānandalakṣaṇam |
tanmayāstaṃ prapaśyanti viśuddhenāntarātmanā || 210 ||
meaning:
ग्राह्यग्राहकनिर्मुक्तं संविदानन्दलक्षणम् |
तन्मयास्तं प्रपश्यन्ति विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना || 210 ||
text_mt: free from apprehended and apprehender, characterized by consciousness and bliss; / those who are composed of it behold it with a completely purified inner self, // 210

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ paraḥ prabhavati bhāḥśabdākhyaśca mantrarāṭ |
yatra saptapadārthaṃ tu vijñātaṃ vyaktimeti ca || 211 ||
meaning:
यतः परः प्रभवति भाःशब्दाख्यश्च मन्त्रराट् |
यत्र सप्तपदार्थं तु विज्ञातं व्यक्तिमेति च || 211 ||
text_mt: from which the supreme king of mantras, designated by the word 'light' (bhāḥ), arises, / in which the seven ontological categories, when understood, become manifest, // 211

sanskrit_iast:
yatra vai varṇarūpeṇa sarve lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
pradhānakāraṇānāṃ yaddvābhyāṃ yatparatassthitam || 212 ||
meaning:
यत्र वै वर्णरूपेण सर्वे लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः |
प्रधानकारणानां यद्द्वाभ्यां यत्परतस्स्थितम् || 212 ||
text_mt: in which indeed all worlds are established in the form of phonemes; / which stands beyond the two material causes (pradhānakāraṇa). // 212

sanskrit_iast:
mantrotpattikrameṇaiva yādṛksaṃsthaṃ tathā śṛṇu |
anukrameṇa saṃyojya sṛṣṭinyāyena nārada || 213 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रोत्पत्तिक्रमेणैव यादृक्संस्थं तथा शृणु |
अनुक्रमेण संयोज्य सृष्टिन्यायेन नारद || 213 ||
text_mt: Hear how it is situated precisely in the order of the origin of mantras, / having joined them in succession according to the rule of creation, O Nārada: // 213

sanskrit_iast:
saptakañcaiva varṇānāṃ saṃvibhaktivibhāvitam |
sūryasomāgnirūpaṃ tu pradhānapuruṣeśvaram || 214 ||
meaning:
सप्तकञ्चैव वर्णानां संविभक्तिविभावितम् |
सूर्यसोमाग्निरूपं तु प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरम् || 214 ||
text_mt: a heptad of phonemes differentiated by case-terminations, / having the forms of sun, moon, and fire, [consisting of] pradhāna, puruṣa, and the Lord, // 214

sanskrit_iast:
aśeṣabhuvanādhāraṃ tryailokyaiśvaryadāyakam |
eṣa varṇamayaḥ piṇḍaḥ paro me mantravigrahaḥ || 215 ||
meaning:
अशेषभुवनाधारं त्र्यैलोक्यैश्वर्यदायकम् |
एष वर्णमयः पिण्डः परो मे मन्त्रविग्रहः || 215 ||
text_mt: the support of all worlds, granting sovereignty over the three worlds: / this aggregate consisting of phonemes is my supreme mantra-body. // 215

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvagrāhyamanaupamyamaprakāśyamidaṃ mune |
prakāśito mayā te'dya jīvabhūto hi mantrarāṭ || 216 ||
meaning:
भावग्राह्यमनौपम्यमप्रकाश्यमिदं मुने |
प्रकाशितो मया तेऽद्य जीवभूतो हि मन्त्रराट् || 216 ||
text_mt: To be grasped through contemplation, peerless, not to be revealed, O sage: / this king of mantras, which is indeed the soul [of all mantras], has been revealed by me to you today. // 216

sanskrit_iast:
samastamantracakrasya sāmarthyajanako hi yaḥ |
mantreṇa tena vidhinā otaprotavyavasthayā || 217 ||
meaning:
समस्तमन्त्रचक्रस्य सामर्थ्यजनको हि यः |
मन्त्रेण तेन विधिना ओतप्रोतव्यवस्थया || 217 ||
text_mt: For it is that which generates efficacy for the entire circle of mantras; / by that mantra, in accordance with the rule, by way of warp and woof, // 217

sanskrit_iast:
adhiṣṭhito'pi bījo vai nirmalasphaṭiko yathā |
p. 58) nirmalenāmbareṇaiva dṛśyādṛśyena vai tathā || 218 ||
meaning:
अधिष्ठितोऽपि बीजो वै निर्मलस्फटिको यथा |
प्. 58) निर्मलेनाम्बरेणैव दृश्यादृश्येन वै तथा || 218 ||
text_mt: the seed is indeed presided over, like a stainless crystal / by a stainless sky, visible and invisible as well; // 218

sanskrit_iast: vyāptāstenāpare mantrāstathaiva paribhāvitāḥ |
meaning: व्याप्तास्तेनापरे मन्त्रास्तथैव परिभाविताः |
text_mt: the other mantras are pervaded by it, and in that very way they are realized.

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ
meaning: नारदः

sanskrit_iast: mantraḥ(ḥ ?)sṛṣṭikrameṇaiva yathāvannoditastvayā || 219 ||
meaning: मन्त्रः(ः ?)सृष्टिक्रमेणैव यथावन्नोदितस्त्वया || 219 ||
text_mt: The mantra was not properly declared by you according to the order of creation. // 219

sanskrit_iast:
tamādiśasva yenādya kṛtakṛtyo bhavāmyaham |
yo'vikāraḥ paraśśuddhassthitassaṃvedanātpare || 220 ||
meaning:
तमादिशस्व येनाद्य कृतकृत्यो भवाम्यहम् |
योऽविकारः परश्शुद्धस्स्थितस्संवेदनात्परे || 220 ||
text_mt: Instruct me on that, whereby I may accomplish my purpose today! / That which is immutable, supreme, pure, resting beyond consciousness— // 220

sanskrit_iast: sa kathaṃ vyāpakaṃ brahma mantramūrtitvamāgataḥ |
meaning: स कथं व्यापकं ब्रह्म मन्त्रमूर्तित्वमागतः |
text_mt: how has that all-pervading Brahman arrived at the state of a mantra-body?

sanskrit_iast: [mantrasṛṣṭikramavivecanam]
meaning: [मन्त्रसृष्टिक्रमविवेचनम्]
text_mt: [Examination of the Order of Creation of Mantras]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast: tasyaikāṃ paramāṃ śaktiṃ viddhi taddharmacāriṇīm || 221 ||
meaning: तस्यैकां परमां शक्तिं विद्धि तद्धर्मचारिणीम् || 221 ||
text_mt: Know his one supreme power that acts in accordance with his nature, // 221

sanskrit_iast:
yayopacaryate vipra sṛṣṭikṛtparameśvaraḥ |
bṛhmito yadbṛhatvena nityānandoditastathā || 222 ||
meaning:
ययोपचर्यते विप्र सृष्टिकृत्परमेश्वरः |
बृह्मितो यद्बृहत्वेन नित्यानन्दोदितस्तथा || 222 ||
text_mt: by which, O brāhmaṇa, the Supreme Lord, maker of creation, is served; / augmented by whose greatness, he is likewise arisen in eternal bliss. // 222

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadā nityaśuddho yastasyaitannopapadyate |
śaktyātmakassa bhagavānsarvaśaktyupabṛṃhitaḥ || 223 ||
meaning:
सर्वदा नित्यशुद्धो यस्तस्यैतन्नोपपद्यते |
शक्त्यात्मकस्स भगवान्सर्वशक्त्युपबृंहितः || 223 ||
text_mt: For him who is eternally and ever pure, this does not apply; / the Lord consists of power and is augmented by all powers. // 223

sanskrit_iast:
agnīṣomātmaketaṃ me (katvena ?) tulyakālaṃ hi mūrcchati |
prakāśastu bhavetsūrya āhlādassoma ucyate || 224 ||
meaning:
अग्नीषोमात्मकेतं मे (कत्वेन ?) तुल्यकालं हि मूर्च्छति |
प्रकाशस्तु भवेत्सूर्य आह्लादस्सोम उच्यते || 224 ||
text_mt: Through consisting of Agni and Soma, he indeed expands simultaneously: / the sun is light, while the moon is called delight. // 224

sanskrit_iast:
dvayorantargatā saṃvittābhyāmastodayāvapi |
pumānsa eva cinmūrttiragnīṣomamayo dvija || 225 ||
meaning:
द्वयोरन्तर्गता संवित्ताभ्यामस्तोदयावपि |
पुमान्स एव चिन्मूर्त्तिरग्नीषोममयो द्विज || 225 ||
text_mt: Consciousness is situated within both; both setting and rising are through them. / That very puruṣa, whose form is consciousness, consists of Agni and Soma, O twice-born one. // 225

sanskrit_iast:
yadagnirūpaṃ traiguṇyaṃ tacca vidyāmayaṃ tu vai |
cidātmā śalabho yadvattamadhiṣṭhāya tiṣṭhati || 226 ||
meaning:
यदग्निरूपं त्रैगुण्यं तच्च विद्यामयं तु वै |
चिदात्मा शलभो यद्वत्तमधिष्ठाय तिष्ठति || 226 ||
text_mt: The nature of the three guṇas that is the form of Agni is indeed composed of knowledge. / The conscious self presides over it, standing like a moth. // 226

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pradhānikīṃ bhūmiṃ tatrastho gamayetprabhuḥ |
puruṣeśvaratāṃ yāti kṣmātattve'dhiṣṭhite sati || 227 ||
meaning:
ततः प्रधानिकीं भूमिं तत्रस्थो गमयेत्प्रभुः |
पुरुषेश्वरतां याति क्ष्मातत्त्वेऽधिष्ठिते सति || 227 ||
text_mt: From there, staying therein, the Lord may conduct [him] to the realm of pradhāna; / he attains lordship over the puruṣas once the earth-tattva has been presided over. // 227

sanskrit_iast:
mameti vāsanāviddhastejasā paripūrayet |
tattvabṛndaṃ ca sakalaṃ trailokyaiśvaryatāṃ vrajet || 228 ||
meaning:
ममेति वासनाविद्धस्तेजसा परिपूरयेत् |
तत्त्वबृन्दं च सकलं त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यतां व्रजेत् || 228 ||
text_mt: Pierced by the latent impression 'mine', he should fill [it] with splendor; / and having gone to lordship over the three worlds, [he presides over] the entire multitude of tattvas. // 228

sanskrit_iast:
taijasādabhimānāttu tatastasmānnivartate |
svāṃ sthitiṃ samavāpnoti parāvasthāsthitiṃ punaḥ || 229 ||
meaning:
तैजसादभिमानात्तु ततस्तस्मान्निवर्तते |
स्वां स्थितिं समवाप्नोति परावस्थास्थितिं पुनः || 229 ||
text_mt: Then, however, he turns away from the conceit born of taijasa; / he attains his own state, the state of the supreme condition once again. // 229

sanskrit_iast:
gamayetsthūlarūpaṃ vā sūkṣmaṃ vā śaktiveṣṭitam |
dvayametatsamāśritya lokānugrahakṛdbhavet || 230 ||
meaning:
गमयेत्स्थूलरूपं वा सूक्ष्मं वा शक्तिवेष्टितम् |
द्वयमेतत्समाश्रित्य लोकानुग्रहकृद्भवेत् || 230 ||
text_mt: He may conduct either to the gross form or to the subtle one enveloped by power; / having resorted to these two, he becomes a shower of grace to the worlds. // 230

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprayacchati mokṣaṃ ca bhogaṃ rājyādikaṃ tu vā |
yattasmāttadupāsyo vai sthūlasūkṣmobhayātmakaḥ || 231 ||
meaning:
संप्रयच्छति मोक्षं च भोगं राज्यादिकं तु वा |
यत्तस्मात्तदुपास्यो वै स्थूलसूक्ष्मोभयात्मकः || 231 ||
text_mt: He grants liberation, or enjoyment such as kingship and the like; / because of that, he, consisting of both gross and subtle, is indeed to be worshipped. // 231

sanskrit_iast:
p. 59) tryakṣaraḥ paramo mantrastena saṃdīkṣayetkramāt |
bhavābdhipatitānbhaktānapareṇa tu (?)karhicit || 232 ||
meaning:
प्. 59) त्र्यक्षरः परमो मन्त्रस्तेन संदीक्षयेत्क्रमात् |
भवाब्धिपतितान्भक्तानपरेण तु (?)कर्हिचित् || 232 ||
text_mt: With that supreme three-syllable mantra he should initiate in due order / the devotees fallen into the ocean of worldly existence, but never with another. // 232

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣitaḥ pāśamukto vai tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ |
piṇḍapātābhilāṣī vā yogaikagatamānasaḥ || 233 ||
meaning:
दीक्षितः पाशमुक्तो वै त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः |
पिण्डपाताभिलाषी वा योगैकगतमानसः || 233 ||
text_mt: Initiated, freed from bonds, having abandoned all possessions, / or desiring the fall of the body, his mind fixed exclusively on yoga, // 233

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktaḥ paro yojanīyassarvo nirvāṇabhāgatha |
tatsthaḥ paraṃ padaṃ yāti sthūlasūkṣmobhayena tat || 234 ||
meaning:
भक्तः परो योजनीयस्सर्वो निर्वाणभागथ |
तत्स्थः परं पदं याति स्थूलसूक्ष्मोभयेन तत् || 234 ||
text_mt: the supreme devotee is to be united, completely partaking of nirvāṇa; / resting in it through both gross and subtle, he attains that supreme state. // 234

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktimetyacirādvipra bhavināṃ bhāvitātmanām |
upalabdhau tu satyāṃ vai saṃyuktaṃ caiva viṣṇunā || 235 ||
meaning:
व्यक्तिमेत्यचिराद्विप्र भविनां भावितात्मनाम् |
उपलब्धौ तु सत्यां वै संयुक्तं चैव विष्णुना || 235 ||
text_mt: It manifests before long, O brāhmaṇa, to worldly beings whose minds are cultivated; / and when realization occurs, he is indeed united with Viṣṇu. // 235

sanskrit_iast:
japamānastu yo dhyāyetpañcasthānavinirgatam |
sṛṣṭikrameṇa tasyāśu sidhyate manasepsitam || 236 ||
meaning:
जपमानस्तु यो ध्यायेत्पञ्चस्थानविनिर्गतम् |
सृष्टिक्रमेण तस्याशु सिध्यते मनसेप्सितम् || 236 ||
text_mt: He who recites and meditates upon it as having emerged from the five stations / in the order of creation, his heart's desire is quickly accomplished. // 236

sanskrit_iast:
vigrahāduditaṃ vā'tha vyāptisattāsamanvitam |
yatpadādavatīrṇaṃ ca tadākramya punarbahiḥ || 237 ||
meaning:
विग्रहादुदितं वाऽथ व्याप्तिसत्तासमन्वितम् |
यत्पदादवतीर्णं च तदाक्रम्य पुनर्बहिः || 237 ||
text_mt: Or having arisen from the body, endowed with pervasive existence, / and having traversed again outside the plane from which it descended, // 237

sanskrit_iast:
vartate vigrahaṃ tyaktvā saṃsmṛto mokṣamṛcchati |
dṛśyādvāyorgatipathādvyāpārācca krameṇa tu || 238 ||
meaning:
वर्तते विग्रहं त्यक्त्वा संस्मृतो मोक्षमृच्छति |
दृश्याद्वायोर्गतिपथाद्व्यापाराच्च क्रमेण तु || 238 ||
text_mt: he abides having abandoned the body; remembered, he attains liberation. / Gradually, from the perceptible course of the wind and from [sensory] activity, // 238

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhṛtya hṛdayātsarvaṃ sthānānyūrdhve tathaiva ca |
tatsevāmṛtasaṃbhinnānnityābhyāsācca nārada || 239 ||
meaning:
संहृत्य हृदयात्सर्वं स्थानान्यूर्ध्वे तथैव च |
तत्सेवामृतसंभिन्नान्नित्याभ्यासाच्च नारद || 239 ||
text_mt: having withdrawn everything from the heart, and likewise the upper stations, / permeated by the nectar of its service, and through constant practice, O Nārada, // 239

sanskrit_iast:
syātsthiratvaṃ śarīrasya bhogamokṣabalaṃ tathā |
tasmādasya sadā pūjā dhyānajapyamayī bhavet || 240 ||
meaning:
स्यात्स्थिरत्वं शरीरस्य भोगमोक्षबलं तथा |
तस्मादस्य सदा पूजा ध्यानजप्यमयी भवेत् || 240 ||
text_mt: there would be stability of the body, as well as the power of enjoyment and liberation. / Therefore, his worship should always consist of meditation and repetition. // 240

sanskrit_iast:
nopacāramayī kāryā puṣpadhūpādikairbahiḥ |
yatassakaladehasya pūjanaṃ vihitaṃ mune || 241 ||
meaning:
नोपचारमयी कार्या पुष्पधूपादिकैर्बहिः |
यतस्सकलदेहस्य पूजनं विहितं मुने || 241 ||
text_mt: It is not to be performed externally consisting of services with flowers, incense, and the like; / for the worship of the qualified body is prescribed, O sage. // 241

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvanā niṣkalākhyasya naitadasti dvayojjhite |
yadasyāvikṛtaṃ rūpaṃ tadanena tvadhiṣṭhitam || 242 ||
meaning:
भावना निष्कलाख्यस्य नैतदस्ति द्वयोज्झिते |
यदस्याविकृतं रूपं तदनेन त्वधिष्ठितम् || 242 ||
text_mt: The contemplation of what is called unqualified does not exist in that which is devoid of the pair; / whatever is his immutable form, that is presided over by this [mantra], // 242

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvyodayena yogena so'sya vai janako yataḥ |
asmātsiṃhmādivaccānyadevameva vibhāvayet || 243 ||
meaning:
भाव्योदयेन योगेन सोऽस्य वै जनको यतः |
अस्मात्सिंह्मादिवच्चान्यदेवमेव विभावयेत् || 243 ||
text_mt: because through the yoga of the arising of the object of contemplation, it is indeed his producer. / From this, just as for [forms] such as the Lion, one should likewise contemplate another deity // 243

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthagyāge samaste vā nirvighnaphalasiddhaye |
brahmaprāttau tathā bhoge dīkṣādye karmasaṃgrahe || 244 ||
meaning:
पृथग्यागे समस्ते वा निर्विघ्नफलसिद्धये |
ब्रह्मप्रात्तौ तथा भोगे दीक्षाद्ये कर्मसंग्रहे || 244 ||
text_mt: in a separate worship or in a combined one, for the accomplishment of fruit without obstacles, / in the attainment of Brahman and likewise in enjoyment, in the totality of rituals such as initiation. // 244

sanskrit_iast:
etadīyaṃ hi sāmarthyaṃ mantrasya tryakṣarasya tu |
boddhavyassa tridhaivātmā guṇatrayamayastathā || 245 ||
meaning:
एतदीयं हि सामर्थ्यं मन्त्रस्य त्र्यक्षरस्य तु |
बोद्धव्यस्स त्रिधैवात्मा गुणत्रयमयस्तथा || 245 ||
text_mt: Such indeed is the power of this three-syllable mantra; / it should be known that its self is threefold, consisting of the three guṇas. // 245

sanskrit_iast:
sadā vipra trilokātmā trivedātmā sa ucyate |
tretāgniṃ taṃ vijānīyātkarma vāṅmanase asau || 246 ||
meaning:
सदा विप्र त्रिलोकात्मा त्रिवेदात्मा स उच्यते |
त्रेताग्निं तं विजानीयात्कर्म वाङ्मनसे असौ || 246 ||
text_mt: He is always, O brāhmaṇa, called the soul of the three worlds, the soul of the three Vedas; / one should know him as the triple sacred fire, as action, speech, and mind. // 246

sanskrit_iast:
p. 60) manobuddhirahaṅkāro buddhikarmākṣabhūtavān |
somasūryāgnirūpeṇa tridhā so'pi trayo'kṣaraḥ (rāḥ ?) || 247 ||
meaning:
प्. 60) मनोबुद्धिरहङ्कारो बुद्धिकर्माक्षभूतवान् |
सोमसूर्याग्निरूपेण त्रिधा सोऽपि त्रयोऽक्षरः (राः ?) || 247 ||
text_mt: Mind, buddhi, ahaṅkāra, possessing the senses of knowledge and action and the elements; / in the form of soma, sun, and fire, those three syllables are also threefold. // 247

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva tṛtīyaśceśvaraśca saḥ |
sa ca nāḍītrayaṃ dehe sthānatrayasamanvitam || 248 ||
meaning:
प्रकृतिः पुरुषश्चैव तृतीयश्चेश्वरश्च सः |
स च नाडीत्रयं देहे स्थानत्रयसमन्वितम् || 248 ||
text_mt: He is prakṛti and puruṣa, and he is the third, the Lord; / and he is the triad of nāḍīs in the body, endowed with the triad of stations. // 248

sanskrit_iast:
evamevāsya mantrasya vaiśvarūpyaṃ ca nārada |
vyāpakatvaṃ ca yo vetti tatsatyaṃ vetti nānyathā || 249 ||
meaning:
एवमेवास्य मन्त्रस्य वैश्वरूप्यं च नारद |
व्यापकत्वं च यो वेत्ति तत्सत्यं वेत्ति नान्यथा || 249 ||
text_mt: He who knows the universal form and the pervasiveness / of this mantra just in this way, O Nārada, knows that which is true, not otherwise. // 249

sanskrit_iast:
iti mantragaṇo mukhyassarvoplavaśāntikṛt |
prakāśito yathā tathyaṃ nākhyeyo yasya kasyacit || 250 ||
meaning:
इति मन्त्रगणो मुख्यस्सर्वोप्लवशान्तिकृत् |
प्रकाशितो यथा तथ्यं नाख्येयो यस्य कस्यचित् || 250 ||
text_mt: Thus the primary group of mantras, bringing pacification of all afflictions, / has been revealed truthfully; it must not be told to just anyone. // 250

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ mukhyamantroddhāro nāma
ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां मुख्यमन्त्रोद्धारो नाम
षष्ठः पटलः || 6 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the sixth chapter, named 'The Extraction of the Primary Mantras', in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the revered Pāñcarātra. // 6

sanskrit_iast: atha upakaraṇamantroddhāro nāma saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: अथ उपकरणमन्त्रोद्धारो नाम सप्तमः पटलः
text_mt: Now begins the seventh chapter, named 'The Extraction of the Accessory Mantras'.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast:
athādhārāsanākhyānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu |
pūjanaṃ yairvinā vipra mantreśasya na jāyate || 1 ||
meaning:
अथाधारासनाख्यानां मन्त्राणां लक्षणं शृणु |
पूजनं यैर्विना विप्र मन्त्रेशस्य न जायते || 1 ||
text_mt: Now listen to the characteristics of the mantras designated as base and seat, / without which, O brāhmaṇa, the worship of the Lord of Mantras does not take place. // 1

sanskrit_iast: [ādhāraśaktimantraḥ]
meaning: [आधारशक्तिमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast:
aśeṣabhuvanādhārāmādhārādheyavannyaset |
paramātmani viprendra māyākhyo mata ūrdhvataḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
अशेषभुवनाधारामाधाराधेयवन्न्यसेत् |
परमात्मनि विप्रेन्द्र मायाख्यो मत ऊर्ध्वतः || 2 ||
text_mt: One should install the support of all worlds like a base and that which is supported / in the Supreme Self, O foremost of brāhmaṇas; above, it is regarded as consisting of māyā. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
namo'ntaṃ praṇavādyaṃ ca bījamādhāraśaktijam |
ādheyatulyasāmarthyamasya rūpaṃ tathāvidham || 3 ||
meaning:
नमोऽन्तं प्रणवाद्यं च बीजमाधारशक्तिजम् |
आधेयतुल्यसामर्थ्यमस्य रूपं तथाविधम् || 3 ||
text_mt: Ending in 'namaḥ' and beginning with the praṇava is the seed born of Ādhāraśakti; / its power is equal to what is supported, and its form is of such a nature. // 3

sanskrit_iast: [kūrmamantraḥ]
meaning: [कूर्ममन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast:
uddhṛtya praṇavaṃ pūrvamananteśasya pūrvajam |
tatkālapāvakenaiva bhinnaṃ kuryāddvijobhayoḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
उद्धृत्य प्रणवं पूर्वमनन्तेशस्य पूर्वजम् |
तत्कालपावकेनैव भिन्नं कुर्याद्द्विजोभयोः || 4 ||
text_mt: Having first extracted the praṇava, the elder brother of the Lord of Ananta, / one should separate it with the fire of time of both, O twice-born one, // 4

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyaiśvaryadenaivamūrjena tu tathā dvija |
namaskārānvitaṃ bījaṃ kūrmakālāgnivācakam || 5 ||
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेनैवमूर्जेन तु तथा द्विज |
नमस्कारान्वितं बीजं कूर्मकालाग्निवाचकम् || 5 ||
text_mt: with that which bestows lordship over the three worlds, and likewise with vigor, O twice-born one; / endowed with the salutation, this seed designates Kūrma and the fire of time. // 5

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśakterupari vimalaṃ dīptavigraham |
jvālāśatasamākīrṇaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 6 ||
meaning:
