sanskrit_iast: tadūrdhvasthasya padmasya prāguktā mantrayogataḥ |
meaning: तदूर्ध्वस्थस्य पद्मस्य प्रागुक्ता मन्त्रयोगतः |
text_mt: [The mudrā] of the lotus situated above that was previously spoken of, through mantra application.

sanskrit_iast: p. 76) [sūryendvagnilakṣaṇadhāmatrayamudrā]
meaning: प्. 76) [सूर्येन्द्वग्निलक्षणधामत्रयमुद्रा]
text_mt: [The Mudrā of the Three Abodes Characterized by the Sun, Moon, and Fire]

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasya tu hastasya tarjanyaṅguṣṭhamelanam || 76 ||
meaning: दक्षिणस्य तु हस्तस्य तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठमेलनम् || 76 ||
text_mt: Joining the forefinger and thumb of the right hand, // 76

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tadanu tadbandhaṃ vikāsya ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
samuttānaṃ punaḥ kuryācchākhāsaṅghaṃ pṛthaksthitam || 77 ||
meaning:
कृत्वा तदनु तद्बन्धं विकास्य च शनैः शनैः |
समुत्तानं पुनः कुर्याच्छाखासङ्घं पृथक्स्थितम् || 77 ||
text_mt: and then gradually opening that formation, / one should again make the group of fingers held separately, facing upwards. // 77

sanskrit_iast: dhāmatrayasya mudraiṣā haṃsākhyāṃ tu nibodha me |
meaning: धामत्रयस्य मुद्रैषा हंसाख्यां तु निबोध मे |
text_mt: This is the mudrā of the three abodes; now learn from me the one named Haṃsa.

sanskrit_iast: [haṃsamudrā]
meaning: [हंसमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: spaṣṭau prasāritau hastau kuryādañjalirūpakau || 78 ||
meaning: स्पष्टौ प्रसारितौ हस्तौ कुर्यादञ्जलिरूपकौ || 78 ||
text_mt: One should hold the two hands distinct and spread out, in the form of an añjali. // 78

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvāsanasya mudraiṣā suśuddhā paramārthakī |
eṣa āsanamantrāṇāṃ mudrābandho mayoditaḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
भावासनस्य मुद्रैषा सुशुद्धा परमार्थकी |
एष आसनमन्त्राणां मुद्राबन्धो मयोदितः || 79 ||
text_mt: This is the mudrā of the seat of contemplation, purely clean and ultimate. / Thus has been declared by me the formation of mudrās for the throne-mantras. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
kramātkṣetreśapūrvāṇāṃ bījānāṃ munisattama |
padmanidhyadhipāntānāṃ mudrādaśakamucyate || 80 ||
meaning:
क्रमात्क्षेत्रेशपूर्वाणां बीजानां मुनिसत्तम |
पद्मनिध्यधिपान्तानां मुद्रादशकमुच्यते || 80 ||
text_mt: In sequence, O best of sages, for the seeds beginning with Kṣetreśa / and ending with the Lord of the Lotus Treasure, the ten mudrās are proclaimed: // 80

sanskrit_iast: [kṣetreśamudrā]
meaning: [क्षेत्रेशमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast:
grastamaṅgulisaṃkhyātaṃ kṛtvā pāṇidvayena tu |
balātprapīḍayetkuryādaṅguṣṭhadvayamucchritam || 81 ||
meaning:
ग्रस्तमङ्गुलिसंख्यातं कृत्वा पाणिद्वयेन तु |
बलात्प्रपीडयेत्कुर्यादङ्गुष्ठद्वयमुच्छ्रितम् || 81 ||
text_mt: Interlocking the fingers of both hands, / one should press firmly and make both thumbs raised upright. // 81

sanskrit_iast: mudreyaṃ kṣetrapālasya śryādīnāmatha me śṛṇu |
meaning: मुद्रेयं क्षेत्रपालस्य श्र्यादीनामथ मे शृणु |
text_mt: This is the mudrā of Kṣetrapāla. Now hear from me [the mudrās] of Śrī and the others.

sanskrit_iast: [śrīmudrā]
meaning: [श्रीमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: uttānau tu karau kṛtvā nikaṭasthau tu nārada || 82 ||
meaning: उत्तानौ तु करौ कृत्वा निकटस्थौ तु नारद || 82 ||
text_mt: Turning both hands face upwards and holding them close, O Nārada, // 82

sanskrit_iast:
tadaṅgulīgaṇaṃ sarvaṃ kuñcitaṃ madhyasaṃsthitam |
aṅguṣṭhau patitau kṛtvā kramaśaḥ spaṣṭatāṃ nayet || 83 ||
meaning:
तदङ्गुलीगणं सर्वं कुञ्चितं मध्यसंस्थितम् |
अङ्गुष्ठौ पतितौ कृत्वा क्रमशः स्पष्टतां नयेत् || 83 ||
text_mt: all the fingers are bent and held in the middle; / letting the thumbs drop, one should gradually bring them to clarity. // 83

sanskrit_iast: śrībījasya tu mudraiṣā prathamaṃ kathitā tava |
meaning: श्रीबीजस्य तु मुद्रैषा प्रथमं कथिता तव |
text_mt: This mudrā of the seed of Śrī is told to you first.

sanskrit_iast: [caṇḍamudrā]
meaning: [चण्डमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: samutthāpya karādvāmāttarjanīṃ caṇḍabījajā || 84 ||
meaning: समुत्थाप्य कराद्वामात्तर्जनीं चण्डबीजजा || 84 ||
text_mt: Raising the forefinger from the left hand, it arises for the seed of Caṇḍa. // 84

sanskrit_iast: [pracaṇḍamudrā]
meaning: [प्रचण्डमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: tāmeva dakṣiṇāddhastātpracaṇḍākhyasya viddhi vai |
meaning: तामेव दक्षिणाद्धस्तात्प्रचण्डाख्यस्य विद्धि वै |
text_mt: Know indeed that very [finger raised] from the right hand for the one named Pracaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast: [jayamudrā]
meaning: [जयमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: madhyamādvāmahastādvai samutthāpya jayasya ca || 85 ||
meaning: मध्यमाद्वामहस्ताद्वै समुत्थाप्य जयस्य च || 85 ||
text_mt: Raising the middle finger from the left hand, [the mudrā] is of Jaya; // 85

sanskrit_iast: [vijayamudrā]
meaning: [विजयमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇādvijayākhyasya bījasya parikīrtitā || 86 ||
meaning: दक्षिणाद्विजयाख्यस्य बीजस्य परिकीर्तिता || 86 ||
text_mt: from the right, it is declared for the seed named Vijaya. // 86

sanskrit_iast: [gāṃgamudrā]
meaning: [गांगमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: vāmāccānāmikā prāgvatkṛtvā gāṅgasya viddhi tām |
meaning: वामाच्चानामिका प्राग्वत्कृत्वा गाङ्गस्य विद्धि ताम् |
text_mt: And raising the ring finger as before from the left, know that for Gāṅga.

sanskrit_iast: p. 77) [yāmunamudrā]
dakṣiṇādyāmunasyoktā mudrā bījasya nārada || 87 ||
meaning: दक्षिणाद्यामुनस्योक्ता मुद्रा बीजस्य नारद || 87 ||
text_mt: From the right, the mudrā is declared for the seed named Yāmuna, O Nārada. // 87

sanskrit_iast: [śaṅkhamudrā]
meaning: [शङ्खमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: nidhīśvarasya śaṅkhasya vāmahastātkaniṣṭhikā |
meaning: निधीश्वरस्य शङ्खस्य वामहस्तात्कनिष्ठिका |
text_mt: For the treasure-guardian Śaṅkha, [it is] the little finger from the left hand.

sanskrit_iast: [padmanidhimudrā]
meaning: [पद्मनिधिमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: padmākhyasyāparāddhastātsaiva cordhvīkṛtā yadā || 88 ||
meaning: पद्माख्यस्यापराद्धस्तात्सैव चोर्ध्वीकृता यदा || 88 ||
text_mt: For the one named Padma, when that same [finger] is raised up from the other hand. // 88

sanskrit_iast: [gaṇeśamudrā]
meaning: [गणेशमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇena tu hastena sāṅguṣṭhena ca muṣṭinā |
pradeśinīṃ hyanāmāṃ ca vāmahastasya pīḍayet || 89 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणेन तु हस्तेन साङ्गुष्ठेन च मुष्टिना |
प्रदेशिनीं ह्यनामां च वामहस्तस्य पीडयेत् || 89 ||
text_mt: With the right hand forming a fist with the thumb, / he should press the forefinger and ring finger of the left hand. // 89

sanskrit_iast:
prayatnakṛtaśaṅkhānāṃ pṛṣṭhe yojyā ca madhyamā |
lambamānakarākārā yathā saṃdṛśyate ca sā || 90 ||
meaning:
प्रयत्नकृतशङ्खानां पृष्ठे योज्या च मध्यमा |
लम्बमानकराकारा यथा संदृश्यते च सा || 90 ||
text_mt: The middle finger is to be joined to the back of the conch carefully formed, / so that it is seen having the shape of a hanging trunk. // 90

sanskrit_iast:
muṣṭernātisamīpasthāṃ vāmahastātkaniṣṭhikām |
dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhabāhye ca daṃṣṭrāvatparibhāvayet || 91 ||
meaning:
मुष्टेर्नातिसमीपस्थां वामहस्तात्कनिष्ठिकाम् |
दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठबाह्ये च दंष्ट्रावत्परिभावयेत् || 91 ||
text_mt: One should visualize the little finger from the left hand, not situated too close to the fist / and outside the right thumb, like a tusk. // 91

sanskrit_iast:
īṣattiryaktatassapaṣṭo vāmāṅguṣṭhastathā paraḥ |
yathā tau paridṛśyete gajakarṇopamau dvija || 92 ||
meaning:
ईषत्तिर्यक्ततस्सपष्टो वामाङ्गुष्ठस्तथा परः |
यथा तौ परिदृश्येते गजकर्णोपमौ द्विज || 92 ||
text_mt: Then, slightly obliquely distinct, the left thumb and likewise the other [thumb], / so that the two appear resembling elephant ears, O twice-born. // 92

sanskrit_iast: gaṇeśvarasya mudreyaṃ sarvavighnakṣayaṅkarī |
meaning: गणेश्वरस्य मुद्रेयं सर्वविघ्नक्षयङ्करी |
text_mt: This is the mudrā of the lord of Gaṇas, which destroys all obstacles.

sanskrit_iast: [vāgīśvarīmudrā]
meaning: [वागीश्वरीमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: suśliṣṭau maṇibandhau tu kṛtvā pāṇidvaye purā || 93 ||
meaning: सुश्लिष्टौ मणिबन्धौ तु कृत्वा पाणिद्वये पुरा || 93 ||
text_mt: Having first brought the two wrists together closely in the two hands, // 93

sanskrit_iast:
saṃlagnamagradeśāttu pronnataṃ madhyamāyutam |
pradeśinīdvayaṃ tadvatkṛtvā'nāmāyugaṃ tathā || 94 ||
meaning:
संलग्नमग्रदेशात्तु प्रोन्नतं मध्यमायुतम् |
प्रदेशिनीद्वयं तद्वत्कृत्वाऽनामायुगं तथा || 94 ||
text_mt: joining [them] at the tips, upright, along with the middle finger, / likewise making the pair of forefingers and so too the pair of ring fingers // 94

sanskrit_iast:
acalaṃ dviguṇīkṛtya namayettadadhomukham |
śanaiḥ śanaiḥspṛśedyāvatsvaṃ svaṃ pāṇitalaṃ dvija || 95 ||
meaning:
अचलं द्विगुणीकृत्य नमयेत्तदधोमुखम् |
शनैः शनैःस्पृशेद्यावत्स्वं स्वं पाणितलं द्विज || 95 ||
text_mt: motionless, doubled over, he should bend them face downward / slowly until each touches its own palm, O twice-born. // 95

sanskrit_iast:
spaṣṭaṃ suviralaṃ kuryādaṅguṣṭhadvitayaṃ dvija |
tadvatkanīyasīyugmaṃ samena dharaṇena tu || 96 ||
meaning:
स्पष्टं सुविरलं कुर्यादङ्गुष्ठद्वितयं द्विज |
तद्वत्कनीयसीयुग्मं समेन धरणेन तु || 96 ||
text_mt: He should keep the pair of thumbs clearly well separated, O twice-born; / likewise the pair of little fingers, held evenly. // 96

sanskrit_iast:
mudraiṣā vāgviśrūtyarthī yo badhnāti dine dine |
japamānastu tadbhāvī tasya cāvatarettu dhīḥ || 97 ||
meaning:
मुद्रैषा वाग्विश्रूत्यर्थी यो बध्नाति दिने दिने |
जपमानस्तु तद्भावी तस्य चावतरेत्तु धीः || 97 ||
text_mt: He who, desiring eloquence in speech, binds this mudrā day after day / while reciting [the mantra] and intent on that, his intellect descends [upon him]. // 97

sanskrit_iast: [gurumudrā]
meaning: [गुरुमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast:
sammukhau saṃpuṭīkṛtya dvau hastau saṃprasāritau |
viniyojyau lalāṭordhve śirasā'vanatena tu || 98 ||
meaning:
सम्मुखौ संपुटीकृत्य द्वौ हस्तौ संप्रसारितौ |
विनियोज्यौ ललाटोर्ध्वे शिरसाऽवनतेन तु || 98 ||
text_mt: Having cupped the two hands extended face-to-face, / they are to be placed above the forehead with bowed head. // 98

sanskrit_iast: p. 78) gurorgurutarasyāpi mudrā hyeṣā pituḥ pituḥ |
meaning: प्. 78) गुरोर्गुरुतरस्यापि मुद्रा ह्येषा पितुः पितुः |
text_mt: p. 78) This is the mudrā of the guru, and also of the higher guru, the father's father.

sanskrit_iast: [pitṛgaṇamudrāḥ]
meaning: [पितृगणमुद्राः]

sanskrit_iast: prottānaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ kṛtvāṅguligaṇaṃ tataḥ || 99 ||
meaning: प्रोत्तानं दक्षिणं पाणिं कृत्वाङ्गुलिगणं ततः || 99 ||
text_mt: Having turned the right hand upwards, then / bending slightly the fingers joined together // 99

sanskrit_iast:
saṃlagnaṃ kuñcayetkiñcidaṅguṣṭhaṃ saṃprasārya ca |
tiryagbhavaiḥ śanaiḥ kiñcitkuryādvā'dhomukhaṃ tataḥ || 100 ||
meaning:
संलग्नं कुञ्चयेत्किञ्चिदङ्गुष्ठं संप्रसार्य च |
तिर्यग्भवैः शनैः किञ्चित्कुर्याद्वाऽधोमुखं ततः || 100 ||
text_mt: and extending the thumb, / he should then make it slightly face downward, slowly, with transverse [movements]. // 100

sanskrit_iast:
mudrā pitṛgaṇasyaiṣā nityatṛptikarī smṛtā |
pūjākāle tu vai tasmāddarśanīyā prayatnataḥ || 101 ||
meaning:
मुद्रा पितृगणस्यैषा नित्यतृप्तिकरी स्मृता |
पूजाकाले तु वै तस्माद्दर्शनीया प्रयत्नतः || 101 ||
text_mt: This mudrā of the host of ancestors is remembered as granting perpetual satisfaction; / therefore it should be shown with effort at the time of worship. // 101

sanskrit_iast:
yo vai naimittikācchrāddhātparitoṣastu jāyate |
sa pitṝṇāṃ śataguṇo mudrābandhācca pūjanāt || 102 ||
meaning:
यो वै नैमित्तिकाच्छ्राद्धात्परितोषस्तु जायते |
स पितॄणां शतगुणो मुद्राबन्धाच्च पूजनात् || 102 ||
text_mt: Whatever satisfaction arises from an occasional śrāddha, / that is increased a hundredfold for the ancestors from forming the mudrā and from worship. // 102

sanskrit_iast: [siddhamudrā]
meaning: [सिद्धमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast:
karadvayaṃ samuttānaṃ nābhideśe niyojayet |
vāmasya dakṣiṇe(?) pṛṣṭhe mudraiṣā siddhasantateḥ || 103 ||
meaning:
करद्वयं समुत्तानं नाभिदेशे नियोजयेत् |
वामस्य दक्षिणे(?) पृष्ठे मुद्रैषा सिद्धसन्ततेः || 103 ||
text_mt: He should place the two hands upturned at the region of the navel, / [the right] on the back of the left hand; this is the mudrā of the succession of siddhas. // 103

sanskrit_iast: [varābhayamudre]
meaning: [वराभयमुद्रे]

sanskrit_iast:
suspaṣṭaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ svātmanastu parāṅmukham |
parāṅmukhaṃ lambamānaṃ vāmapāṇiṃ prakalpayet || 104 ||
meaning:
सुस्पष्टं दक्षिणं हस्तं स्वात्मनस्तु पराङ्मुखम् |
पराङ्मुखं लम्बमानं वामपाणिं प्रकल्पयेत् || 104 ||
text_mt: He should arrange the right hand very clearly turned away from oneself, / and the left hand turned away, hanging down. // 104

sanskrit_iast:
kramādvarābhayākhyaṃ tu idaṃ mudrādvayaṃ dvija |
vijñeyaṃ lokapālānāmindrādīnāṃ samāsataḥ || 105 ||
meaning:
क्रमाद्वराभयाख्यं तु इदं मुद्राद्वयं द्विज |
विज्ञेयं लोकपालानामिन्द्रादीनां समासतः || 105 ||
text_mt: In order, these two mudrās called Vara and Abhaya, O twice-born, / are to be known concisely for the world-protectors headed by Indra. // 105

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikena tu mantreṇa vajrādyena kramādyutām |
astrākhyāṃ śaktisaṃyuktāṃ prāguktāṃ saṃpradarśayet || 106 ||
meaning:
एकैकेन तु मन्त्रेण वज्राद्येन क्रमाद्युताम् |
अस्त्राख्यां शक्तिसंयुक्तां प्रागुक्तां संप्रदर्शयेत् || 106 ||
text_mt: With each mantra beginning with the thunderbolt in succession, / he should show the previously described [gesture] named astra, accompanied by śakti, // 106

sanskrit_iast: lokapālāyudhānāṃ tu pūjitānāṃ krameṇa vai |
meaning: लोकपालायुधानां तु पूजितानां क्रमेण वै |
text_mt: for the weapons of the world-protectors, worshipped in due order.

sanskrit_iast: [viṣvaksenamudrā]
meaning: [विष्वक्सेनमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: kaniṣṭhā'nāmikā madhyā vāmācca karamadhyagāḥ || 107 ||
meaning: कनिष्ठाऽनामिका मध्या वामाच्च करमध्यगाः || 107 ||
text_mt: The little finger, ring finger, and middle finger from the left [hand] situated in the palm, // 107

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāmaṅguṣṭhakaḥ pṛṣṭhe tarjanī pronnatā bhavet |
nāsāvaṃśapradeśasthā tato dakṣiṇapāṇinā || 108 ||
meaning:
तासामङ्गुष्ठकः पृष्ठे तर्जनी प्रोन्नता भवेत् |
नासावंशप्रदेशस्था ततो दक्षिणपाणिना || 108 ||
text_mt: their thumb on the back, and the forefinger raised upright / positioned at the region of the bridge of the nose; then with the right hand, // 108

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgulītritayenaivaṃ muṣṭiṃ badhvā tu pūrvavat |
tarjanīdviguṇaṃ kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhāgre nirodhayet || 109 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुलीत्रितयेनैवं मुष्टिं बध्वा तु पूर्ववत् |
तर्जनीद्विगुणं कृत्वा अङ्गुष्ठाग्रे निरोधयेत् || 109 ||
text_mt: forming a fist with three fingers in this way as before, / bending the forefinger double, he should press it against the tip of the thumb. // 109

sanskrit_iast:
prodyato bāhudaṇḍaḥ syāccakrakṣepe yathodyataḥ |
viṣvaksenasya mudreyaṃ viśvakarmanikartanī || 110 ||
meaning:
प्रोद्यतो बाहुदण्डः स्याच्चक्रक्षेपे यथोद्यतः |
विष्वक्सेनस्य मुद्रेयं विश्वकर्मनिकर्तनी || 110 ||
text_mt: The arm should be raised up as if ready to hurl a discus; / this is the mudrā of Viṣvaksena, which cuts away all karma. // 110

sanskrit_iast: p. 79) [āvāhanamudrā]
meaning: प्. 79) [आवाहनमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcidākuñcayeddhastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hṛdayopagam |
aṅguṣṭho viralaspaṣṭo mudrā hyāvāhane smṛtā || 111 ||
meaning:
किञ्चिदाकुञ्चयेद्धस्तं दक्षिणं हृदयोपगम् |
अङ्गुष्ठो विरलस्पष्टो मुद्रा ह्यावाहने स्मृता || 111 ||
text_mt: He should contract slightly the right hand brought near the heart, / the thumb separated and distinct; this is remembered as the mudrā for invocation. // 111

sanskrit_iast: [visarjanamudrā]
meaning: [विसर्जनमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgadhārāsamākārā viralāṅgulikāvubhau |
aṅguṣṭhau daṇḍavatkṛtvā muṣṭibandhaṃ śanaiśśanaiḥ || 112 ||
meaning:
खड्गधारासमाकारा विरलाङ्गुलिकावुभौ |
अङ्गुष्ठौ दण्डवत्कृत्वा मुष्टिबन्धं शनैश्शनैः || 112 ||
text_mt: Both [hands] having the shape of a sword blade with fingers separated, / making the two thumbs like rods, slowly making a fist // 112

sanskrit_iast: kuryātkaniṣṭhikādibhyo mudraiṣā syādvisarjane |
meaning: कुर्यात्कनिष्ठिकादिभ्यो मुद्रैषा स्याद्विसर्जने |
text_mt: beginning with the little finger—this is the mudrā for dismissal.

sanskrit_iast: [surabhimudrā]
meaning: [सुरभिमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: grathitau [dvau] karau kṛtvā suśliṣṭau cāpyadhomukhau || 113 ||
meaning: ग्रथितौ [द्वौ] करौ कृत्वा सुश्लिष्टौ चाप्यधोमुखौ || 113 ||
text_mt: Having intertwined the two hands, closely joined and turned face downward, // 113

sanskrit_iast:
kanīyasau tadāṅguṣṭhau suśleṣeṇa niyojya ca |
madhyamāṅguliyugmaṃ tu anyonyakarapṛṣṭhagam |
vikṣiptānāmikāyugmaṃ tarjanīyugalaṃ tathā || 114 ||
meaning:
कनीयसौ तदाङ्गुष्ठौ सुश्लेषेण नियोज्य च |
मध्यमाङ्गुलियुग्मं तु अन्योन्यकरपृष्ठगम् |
विक्षिप्तानामिकायुग्मं तर्जनीयुगलं तथा || 114 ||
text_mt: and then joining the little fingers and thumbs closely, / the pair of middle fingers placed on the back of the opposite hand, / the pair of ring fingers extended, and likewise the pair of forefingers: // 114

sanskrit_iast:
mudraiṣā kāmadhenvākhyā sarvecchāparipūraṇī |
dviprakāraṃ tu mudrāṇāṃ prayogaṃ nityamācaret || 115 ||
meaning:
मुद्रैषा कामधेन्वाख्या सर्वेच्छापरिपूरणी |
द्विप्रकारं तु मुद्राणां प्रयोगं नित्यमाचरेत् || 115 ||
text_mt: this is the mudrā called Kāmadhenu, fulfilling all desires. / One should daily perform the two-fold application of mudrās, // 115

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvinmayaṃ tu cādhyātmarūpaṃ bhāsvarasaṃpuṭam |
bāhyāntastrividhaṃ vipra karmavākcittajaṃ tu yat || 116 ||
meaning:
संविन्मयं तु चाध्यात्मरूपं भास्वरसंपुटम् |
बाह्यान्तस्त्रिविधं विप्र कर्मवाक्चित्तजं तु यत् || 116 ||
text_mt: consisting of consciousness, the internal form, a luminous casket, / and the three-fold external and internal [form], O brahmin, born of action, speech, and mind. // 116

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā mudrāṃ yo badhnāti vidhānavit |
tenedaṃ mudritaṃ viśvamapunarbhavasiddhidam || 117 ||
meaning:
अनेन विधिना मुद्रां यो बध्नाति विधानवित् |
तेनेदं मुद्रितं विश्वमपुनर्भवसिद्धिदम् || 117 ||
text_mt: Whoever, knowing the rule, binds a mudrā according to this rule, / by him this universe is sealed, bestowing the attainment of non-rebirth. // 117

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ mudrābandhākhyānaṃ nāma
aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां मुद्राबन्धाख्यानं नाम
अष्टमः पटलः || 8 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the eighth chapter, named The Exposition of the Formation of Mudrās, in the venerable Pāñcarātra Jayākhyasaṃhitā. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
atha pāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ snānavidhirnāma navamaḥ
paṭalaḥ
meaning:
अथ पाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां स्नानविधिर्नाम नवमः
पटलः
text_mt: Now begins the ninth chapter, named The Rule for Bathing, in the Pāñcarātra Jayākhyasaṃhitā.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast:
athādhikārasiddhyarthaṃ snānaṃ vakṣyāmi pūrvataḥ |
yena bhakto'bhiṣiktastu syādarho homayāgayoḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
अथाधिकारसिद्ध्यर्थं स्नानं वक्ष्यामि पूर्वतः |
येन भक्तोऽभिषिक्तस्तु स्यादर्हो होमयागयोः || 1 ||
text_mt: Now, for the attainment of qualification, I shall explain the bath first, / bathed by which the devotee becomes fit for the homa and sacrifice. // 1

sanskrit_iast: [snāne dvaividhyam]
meaning: [स्नाने द्वैविध्यम्]

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ kuryānmalasaṅkaraśuddhaye |
sāmānyavidhinā snātvā viśeṣavidhinā tataḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
स्नानं तु द्विविधं कुर्यान्मलसङ्करशुद्धये |
सामान्यविधिना स्नात्वा विशेषविधिना ततः || 2 ||
text_mt: One should perform a two-fold bath for the purification of impurities and mixture, / having bathed first according to the general rule, and then by the specific rule: // 2

sanskrit_iast: sāmānyaṃ laukikaṃ snānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtam |
meaning: सामान्यं लौकिकं स्नानं विशिष्टं मन्त्रसंस्कृतम् |
text_mt: the general is the ordinary bath, while the specific is consecrated with mantras.

sanskrit_iast: [śaucavidhiḥ]
meaning: [शौचविधिः]

sanskrit_iast: taccāpi śaucapūrvaṃ syāttadādau kathayāmi te || 3 ||
meaning: तच्चापि शौचपूर्वं स्यात्तदादौ कथयामि ते || 3 ||
text_mt: And that must be preceded by purificatory cleaning; I shall describe that to you first. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
p. 80) tisro liṅge mṛdo deyā ekaikāntaramṛttikāḥ |
pañca vāmakare deyāstisraḥ pāṇyorviśuddhaye || 4 ||
meaning:
प्. 80) तिस्रो लिङ्गे मृदो देया एकैकान्तरमृत्तिकाः |
पञ्च वामकरे देयास्तिस्रः पाण्योर्विशुद्धये || 4 ||
text_mt: p. 80) Three applications of clay are to be applied to the penis, with clay between each; / five are to be applied to the left hand, and three for the purification of both hands. // 4

sanskrit_iast:
mūtrotsarge śuddhireṣā purīṣasyāpyanantaram |
pañcāpāne mṛttikāssyustathaivāntaramṛttikāḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
मूत्रोत्सर्गे शुद्धिरेषा पुरीषस्याप्यनन्तरम् |
पञ्चापाने मृत्तिकास्स्युस्तथैवान्तरमृत्तिकाः || 5 ||
text_mt: This is the purification in urination. And after defecation, / there should be five applications of clay to the anus, and likewise clay between each. // 5

sanskrit_iast:
daśa vāmakare deyāssapta tūbhayahastayoḥ |
pādābhyāṃ trisṛbhiśśuddhirjaṅghāśuddhiśca pañcabhiḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
दश वामकरे देयास्सप्त तूभयहस्तयोः |
पादाभ्यां त्रिसृभिश्शुद्धिर्जङ्घाशुद्धिश्च पञ्चभिः || 6 ||
text_mt: Ten are to be applied to the left hand, and seven to both hands; / purification of both feet is with three, and purification of both calves with five. // 6

sanskrit_iast:
niyojayottato vipra kaṭyāṃ vai saptamṛttikāḥ |
svadehasvedadoṣaghnaṃ bāhyakardamaśāntaye || 7 ||
meaning:
नियोजयोत्ततो विप्र कट्यां वै सप्तमृत्तिकाः |
स्वदेहस्वेददोषघ्नं बाह्यकर्दमशान्तये || 7 ||
text_mt: Then, O vipra, he should apply seven applications of clay to the waist / to destroy the defect of sweat on one's body, for the removal of external dirt. // 7

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktānāṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ ca varṣāsvevaṃ nirūpitam |
prāvṛṭsūktāttadetasmādekamṛdvyapanodanam || 8 ||
meaning:
भक्तानां श्रोत्रियाणां च वर्षास्वेवं निरूपितम् |
प्रावृट्सूक्तात्तदेतस्मादेकमृद्व्यपनोदनम् || 8 ||
text_mt: This is taught during the rainy season for devotees and Vedic scholars; / from that [number] taught for the rainy season, one application of clay is subtracted [each time]: // 8

sanskrit_iast:
śaradgrīṣmavasanteṣu nityaṃ kāryā kriyāparaiḥ |
etasmādapi caikaikā parilopyā tu mṛttikā || 9 ||
meaning:
शरद्ग्रीष्मवसन्तेषु नित्यं कार्या क्रियापरैः |
एतस्मादपि चैकैका परिलोप्या तु मृत्तिका || 9 ||
text_mt: In autumn, summer, and spring, this must constantly be done by those devoted to ritual action; / and one application of clay is to be omitted even from this [reduced number] // 9

sanskrit_iast:
hemante śiśire vipra śrotriyaiḥ saṃyamasthitaiḥ |
pathi śaucaṃ prakartavyaṃ deśakālānurūpataḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
हेमन्ते शिशिरे विप्र श्रोत्रियैः संयमस्थितैः |
पथि शौचं प्रकर्तव्यं देशकालानुरूपतः || 10 ||
text_mt: in early winter and late winter, O vipra, by Vedic scholars abiding in restraint. / When on a journey, purificatory cleaning must be done according to place and time. // 10

sanskrit_iast: gandhalepamapāsyaivaṃ manaśśuddhyā viśudhyati |
meaning: गन्धलेपमपास्यैवं मनश्शुद्ध्या विशुध्यति |
text_mt: Having thus removed the smell and the smear, he becomes purified through purity of mind.

sanskrit_iast: [snānārthaṃ mṛtsaṃgrahaṇam]
meaning: [स्नानार्थं मृत्संग्रहणम्]
text_mt: [Gathering clay for the bath]

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ kṛtvā purā śaucaṃ samācamya tataḥ khanet || 11 ||
meaning: एवं कृत्वा पुरा शौचं समाचम्य ततः खनेत् || 11 ||
text_mt: Having first performed purificatory cleaning in this manner, and having sipped water, he should then dig // 11

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkunā hyastrajaptena śucisthānāttu mṛttikām |
gṛhītvā'streṇa saṅgṛhya yāyājjalaniketanam || 12 ||
meaning:
शङ्कुना ह्यस्त्रजप्तेन शुचिस्थानात्तु मृत्तिकाम् |
गृहीत्वाऽस्त्रेण सङ्गृह्य यायाज्जलनिकेतनम् || 12 ||
text_mt: clay from a clean place with a wooden peg consecrated with the astra-mantra; / having taken it up and held it with the astra-mantra, he should go to the body of water. // 12

sanskrit_iast: [snānavidhiḥ]
meaning: [स्नानविधिः]

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādau jalakūlaṃ tu kṣālayedastravāriṇā |
mṛdaḥ kṛtvā dvidhā sthāpya eka bhāgopagaṃ tataḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
तत्रादौ जलकूलं तु क्षालयेदस्त्रवारिणा |
मृदः कृत्वा द्विधा स्थाप्य एक भागोपगं ततः || 13 ||
text_mt: There, he should first wash the water's edge with astra-water; / dividing the clay into two portions and setting it down, then, joining one portion [to other substances], // 13

sanskrit_iast:
nidhāya gomayaṃ darbhānstilāstrānabhimantritān |
laukikaṃ gomayāḍhyena bhāgena [snānamācāret] || 14 ||
meaning:
निधाय गोमयं दर्भान्स्तिलास्त्रानभिमन्त्रितान् |
लौकिकं गोमयाढ्येन भागेन [स्नानमाचारेत्] || 14 ||
text_mt: having placed cow-dung, darbha grasses, and sesamum consecrated with the astra-mantra, / he should perform an ordinary bath with the portion enriched with cow-dung. // 14

sanskrit_iast: tata(tacca ?)snānaṃ purā kṛtvā vidhisnānaṃ samācaret |
meaning: तत(तच्च ?)स्नानं पुरा कृत्वा विधिस्नानं समाचरेत् |
text_mt: Having first performed that bath, he should perform the ritual bath.

sanskrit_iast: [vidhisnāne kramaḥ]
meaning: [विधिस्नाने क्रमः]

sanskrit_iast: vidhisnāne tu mṛdbhāgo yastaṃ kuryāddvidhā punaḥ || 15 ||
meaning: विधिस्नाने तु मृद्भागो यस्तं कुर्याद्द्विधा पुनः || 15 ||
text_mt: As for the portion of clay for the ritual bath, he should divide it again into two parts. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
pādādi kṣālyamekena pūrvavatkramayogataḥ |
pāṇiprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā vinimajya jalāntare || 16 ||
meaning:
पादादि क्षाल्यमेकेन पूर्ववत्क्रमयोगतः |
पाणिप्रक्षालनं कृत्वा विनिमज्य जलान्तरे || 16 ||
text_mt: The feet and other parts are to be washed with one part, in the proper order as before; / having washed both hands, having submerged himself in the water, // 16

sanskrit_iast: p. 81) [snānāṅgamantranyāsamudrābandhau]
meaning: प्. 81) [स्नानाङ्गमन्त्रन्यासमुद्राबन्धौ]
text_mt: p. 81) [Nyāsa of mantras and formation of mudrās as limbs of bathing]

sanskrit_iast:
samutthāya nyasenmantraṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vigrahe svake |
mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryānmudrābandhaṃ ca kārayet || 17 ||
meaning:
समुत्थाय न्यसेन्मन्त्रं षडङ्गं विग्रहे स्वके |
मन्त्रन्यासं ततः कुर्यान्मुद्राबन्धं च कारयेत् || 17 ||
text_mt: and having risen up, he should place the six-limbed mantra on his own body; / then he should perform the nyāsa of mantras and execute the formation of mudrās. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
kīṭādyaśucisamparkājjalasyāvahato dvija |
vahato'pyuddhṛtasyāpi śuddhirevaṃ bhavetpurā || 18 ||
meaning:
कीटाद्यशुचिसम्पर्काज्जलस्यावहतो द्विज |
वहतोऽप्युद्धृतस्यापि शुद्धिरेवं भवेत्पुरा || 18 ||
text_mt: Because of contact with impurities such as insects, O twice-born, whether the water is flowing, / or even when non-flowing or drawn out, this purification should first take place. // 18

sanskrit_iast:
nirmalaṃ vāruṇaṃ vipra candrārkakaratāpitam |
yadyapi syāttathā naivaṃ samyaṅmāntre kriyākrame || 19 ||
meaning:
निर्मलं वारुणं विप्र चन्द्रार्ककरतापितम् |
यद्यपि स्यात्तथा नैवं सम्यङ्मान्त्रे क्रियाक्रमे || 19 ||
text_mt: Even if the water of Varuṇa is spotless, O vipra, heated by the rays of the moon and sun, / it is still not so in the correct ritual procedure of mantras. // 19

sanskrit_iast: [pavitradhāraṇam]
meaning: [पवित्रधारणम्]

sanskrit_iast:
tripañcasaptakāṇḍotthaṃ draḍhimagranthisaṃyutam |
pavitrakadvayaṃ dārbhamastramantrābhimantritam || 20 ||
meaning:
त्रिपञ्चसप्तकाण्डोत्थं द्रढिमग्रन्थिसंयुतम् |
पवित्रकद्वयं दार्भमस्त्रमन्त्राभिमन्त्रितम् || 20 ||
text_mt: Having placed two pavitraka rings made of darbha grass, / made of three, five, or seven blades, joined with a firm knot, / consecrated with the astra-mantra, // 20

sanskrit_iast: hastadvaye'pi nikṣipya anāmāṅgulayoradhaḥ |
meaning: हस्तद्वयेऽपि निक्षिप्य अनामाङ्गुलयोरधः |
text_mt: on both hands, at the base of the ring fingers,

sanskrit_iast:
[vāmapāṇau mūlādisthānabhedena tredhā vibhaktāyā mṛdaḥ
krameṇāstrāditrayeṇābhimantraṇam]
meaning:
[वामपाणौ मूलादिस्थानभेदेन त्रेधा विभक्ताया मृदः
क्रमेणास्त्रादित्रयेणाभिमन्त्रणम्]
text_mt: [Consecration of the clay divided into three on the left hand at the base, middle, and tip, sequentially with the three mantras beginning with the astra]

sanskrit_iast: sāvaśeṣāṃ mṛdaṃ śeṣāṃ kṛtvā'dāyāstramuccaran || 21 ||
meaning: सावशेषां मृदं शेषां कृत्वाऽदायास्त्रमुच्चरन् || 21 ||
text_mt: he should make the remaining clay into a remainder, and taking it up while uttering the astra-mantra, // 21

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ tathā vāmapāṇau tu mūlamadhyāgrato bhajet |
sāstreṇa mūlamantreṇa japedaṅgairanukramāt || 22 ||
meaning:
तां तथा वामपाणौ तु मूलमध्याग्रतो भजेत् |
सास्त्रेण मूलमन्त्रेण जपेदङ्गैरनुक्रमात् || 22 ||
text_mt: he should divide it thus on his left hand into root, middle, and tip; / with the astra-mantra, with the root-mantra, and with the aṅga-mantras he should recite over them in succession. // 22

sanskrit_iast: [tatrāstrābhimantritāyā viniyogaḥ]
meaning: [तत्रास्त्राभिमन्त्रिताया विनियोगः]
text_mt: [Application of the portion consecrated with the astra-mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
astrajaptāṃ mṛdaṃ gṛhya kṣipeddikṣu vidikṣu ca |
adha ūrdhve ca tanmantraṃ (ntra ?) mudrābandhena saṃyutam || 23 ||
meaning:
अस्त्रजप्तां मृदं गृह्य क्षिपेद्दिक्षु विदिक्षु च |
अध ऊर्ध्वे च तन्मन्त्रं (न्त्र ?) मुद्राबन्धेन संयुतम् || 23 ||
text_mt: Taking the clay recited over with the astra-mantra, he should throw it in the cardinal and intermediate directions, / below, and above, with that mantra accompanied by the formation of mudrās. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
tena snānaharā vighnā digvidikparisaṃsthitāḥ |
prayānti vihvalībhūtā yāvattannopasaṃbhṛtam || 24 ||
meaning:
तेन स्नानहरा विघ्ना दिग्विदिक्परिसंस्थिताः |
प्रयान्ति विह्वलीभूता यावत्तन्नोपसंभृतम् || 24 ||
text_mt: By that, the obstacles that ruin bathing, residing in the cardinal and intermediate directions, / flee, bewildered, as long as that [space] is not dismantled. // 24

sanskrit_iast: [mūlamantritāyā mṛdo viniyogaḥ]
meaning: [मूलमन्त्रिताया मृदो विनियोगः]
text_mt: [Application of the clay consecrated with the root-mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdbhāgo mūlamantreṇa mantrito yaḥ purā sthitaḥ |
tamuccaraṃstamādāya toyamadhye vinikṣipet || 25 ||
meaning:
मृद्भागो मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रितो यः पुरा स्थितः |
तमुच्चरंस्तमादाय तोयमध्ये विनिक्षिपेत् || 25 ||
text_mt: As for that portion of clay which was previously consecrated with the root-mantra, / taking it while uttering that [mantra], he should cast it into the middle of the water. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
tena tat dvijaśārdūla tatkṣaṇādeva jāyate |
gaṅgātoyena saṃpūrṇaṃ yāmunena jalena ca || 26 ||
meaning:
तेन तत् द्विजशार्दूल तत्क्षणादेव जायते |
गङ्गातोयेन संपूर्णं यामुनेन जलेन च || 26 ||
text_mt: By that, O tiger among the twice-born, it instantly becomes / filled with the water of the Gaṅgā and with the water of the Yamunā. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
prāyāgaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca |
bhavanti sannidhībhūtā mantrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
प्रायागं चक्रतीर्थं च प्रभासं पुष्कराणि च |
भवन्ति सन्निधीभूता मन्त्रस्यास्य प्रभावतः || 27 ||
text_mt: Prayāga, Cakratīrtha, Prabhāsa, and the Puṣkaras / become present there by the power of this mantra. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
tato vai viṣṇutīrthāya mantrānte padamuccaret |
p. 82) sanamaskaṃ bhavettena viṣṇutīrthasya sannidhiḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
ततो वै विष्णुतीर्थाय मन्त्रान्ते पदमुच्चरेत् |
प्. 82) सनमस्कं भवेत्तेन विष्णुतीर्थस्य सन्निधिः || 28 ||
text_mt: Then, indeed, at the end of the mantra he should utter the word viṣṇutīrthāya / p. 82) together with namas; through that, the presence of the Viṣṇutīrtha comes about. // 28

sanskrit_iast: [tīrthāntare kevalamūlamantramātrayojanam]
meaning: [तीर्थान्तरे केवलमूलमन्त्रमात्रयोजनम्]
text_mt: [Employment of only the root-mantra at other tīrthas]

sanskrit_iast:
anyatīrthe yadā snānaṃ kuryāttatra ca yojayet |
kevalaṃ mūlamantraṃ tu viṣṇutīrthapadaṃ vinā || 29 ||
meaning:
अन्यतीर्थे यदा स्नानं कुर्यात्तत्र च योजयेत् |
केवलं मूलमन्त्रं तु विष्णुतीर्थपदं विना || 29 ||
text_mt: When he bathes at another tīrtha, he should employ there / only the root-mantra, without the word viṣṇutīrtha. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthāntareṣvidaṃ nāma na saṅkīrtayate sudhīḥ |
sannidhāne hi tīrthasya yadyanyāmabhidhāṃ smaret || 30 ||
meaning:
तीर्थान्तरेष्विदं नाम न सङ्कीर्तयते सुधीः |
सन्निधाने हि तीर्थस्य यद्यन्यामभिधां स्मरेत् || 30 ||
text_mt: At other tīrthas, a wise man does not utter this name; / for if, in the presence of one tīrtha, he should remember another name, // 30

sanskrit_iast:
snātakastasya tattīrthamabhiśapya kṣaṇaṃ vrajet |
nirjarāmbutaṭākādau sāmānyasnānakarmaṇi || 31 ||
meaning:
स्नातकस्तस्य तत्तीर्थमभिशप्य क्षणं व्रजेत् |
निर्जराम्बुतटाकादौ सामान्यस्नानकर्मणि || 31 ||
text_mt: having cursed that person who has bathed, that tīrtha will immediately depart. / In the common rite of bathing in waterfall streams, ponds, and the like, // 31

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgādīnāṃ nadīnāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ ca prakīrtitam |
māntre snānakrame samyagviṣṇutīrthāya kīrtayet || 32 ||
meaning:
गङ्गादीनां नदीनां च तीर्थानां च प्रकीर्तितम् |
मान्त्रे स्नानक्रमे सम्यग्विष्णुतीर्थाय कीर्तयेत् || 32 ||
text_mt: the invocation of rivers such as the Gaṅgā and of tīrthas is prescribed; / in the proper mantra-procedure of bathing, he should recite: "To Viṣṇutīrtha." // 32

sanskrit_iast: [aṅgamantrābhimantritasya mṛdbhāgasya viniyogaḥ]
meaning: [अङ्गमन्त्राभिमन्त्रितस्य मृद्भागस्य विनियोगः]
text_mt: [Application of the portion of clay consecrated with the aṅga-mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
tato'ṅgamantrajaptaṃ ca bhāgaṃ pāṇitale sthitam |
toyenāloḍhya masṛṇaṃ tāpayedarkaraśmibhiḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
ततोऽङ्गमन्त्रजप्तं च भागं पाणितले स्थितम् |
तोयेनालोढ्य मसृणं तापयेदर्करश्मिभिः || 33 ||
text_mt: Then, having dissolved with water the portion resting on the palm of his hand, / which was recited over with the aṅga-mantras, making it smooth, he should warm it with the sun's rays. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
meghacchanne svakaṃ mantraṃ sūryavatkhasthitaṃ smaret |
darśayitvā kare tasya tābhyāṃ sarvāṅgakaṃ spṛśet || 34 ||
meaning:
मेघच्छन्ने स्वकं मन्त्रं सूर्यवत्खस्थितं स्मरेत् |
दर्शयित्वा करे तस्य ताभ्यां सर्वाङ्गकं स्पृशेत् || 34 ||
text_mt: When it is overcast with clouds, he should meditate on his own mantra residing in the sky like the sun; / having shown [the clay] in his hand to it, he should touch all his limbs with both hands. // 34

sanskrit_iast: [tīrthasya paramīkaraṇaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [तीर्थस्य परमीकरणप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The method of elevating the tīrtha to the supreme state]

sanskrit_iast:
dhāraṇādvitayenātha tīrthasya sajalasya ca |
paramīkaraṇaṃ kuryādvidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 35 ||
meaning:
धारणाद्वितयेनाथ तीर्थस्य सजलस्य च |
परमीकरणं कुर्याद्विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा || 35 ||
text_mt: Then, by means of a pair of dhāraṇās, he should effect the elevation of the tīrtha / along with the water to the supreme state, by the rite seen in the rules. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśakterārabhya saṅkalpaviṣayāvadhi |
vahninā pūrayetsarvaṃ jvālāmālāvilena ca || 36 ||
meaning:
आधारशक्तेरारभ्य सङ्कल्पविषयावधि |
वह्निना पूरयेत्सर्वं ज्वालामालाविलेन च || 36 ||
text_mt: Beginning from the Ādhāraśakti up to the realm of mental intention, / he should fill everything with fire swirling with wreaths of flames. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
nirammayaṃ jagatkṛtvā tīrthaṃ śāntatanu smaret |
śānte saṃvinmaye viṣṇau bhūyastadavatārya ca || 37 ||
meaning:
निरम्मयं जगत्कृत्वा तीर्थं शान्ततनु स्मरेत् |
शान्ते संविन्मये विष्णौ भूयस्तदवतार्य च || 37 ||
text_mt: Having made the world devoid of water, he should visualize the tīrtha as having a tranquil body; / and having brought it down again into Viṣṇu, who is tranquil and composed of consciousness, // 37

sanskrit_iast:
niśāmbukaṇasaṅkāśamiyattākalpitaṃ purā |
smṛtvā śaktiprabhāvena brahmasroto vinirgatam || 38 ||
meaning:
निशाम्बुकणसङ्काशमियत्ताकल्पितं पुरा |
स्मृत्वा शक्तिप्रभावेन ब्रह्मस्रोतो विनिर्गतम् || 38 ||
text_mt: remembering that it was previously conceived with a specific measure resembling a drop of night-dew, / [and then remembering] the stream of Brahman that has issued forth by the power of Śakti, // 38

sanskrit_iast:
dhārākallolasaṅgīrṇaṃ patamānaṃ tu vegataḥ |
ābrahmabhavanaṃ sarvaṃ pūrayecchaśisannibham || 39 ||
meaning:
धाराकल्लोलसङ्गीर्णं पतमानं तु वेगतः |
आब्रह्मभवनं सर्वं पूरयेच्छशिसन्निभम् || 39 ||
text_mt: crowded with waves and billows, falling with great speed, / he should fill everything up to the abode of Brahmā, resembling the moon. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
vilokanapadaiśśaśvatsaṅghaṭṭaṃ taṃ tu bhāvayet |
samaste prāksvarūpeṇa tanmadhye tvāsanaṃ prabhoḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
विलोकनपदैश्शश्वत्सङ्घट्टं तं तु भावयेत् |
समस्ते प्राक्स्वरूपेण तन्मध्ये त्वासनं प्रभोः || 40 ||
text_mt: He should constantly contemplate that collision by means of the planes of vision; / when everything is in its original essential nature, having placed the Lord's seat in its midst, // 40

sanskrit_iast:
datvā tadupari brahman smarennārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
p. 83) candrakoṭisamaṃ śuddhasudhādhārāgaṇāvṛtam || 41 ||
meaning:
दत्वा तदुपरि ब्रह्मन् स्मरेन्नारायणं प्रभुम् |
प्. 83) चन्द्रकोटिसमं शुद्धसुधाधारागणावृतम् || 41 ||
text_mt: and upon it, O Brahman, he should meditate on the Lord Nārāyaṇa, / p. 83) equal to ten million moons, surrounded by multitudes of streams of pure nectar, // 41

sanskrit_iast:
sāhaṃśaktisamūhāḍhyaṃ prodgirantaṃ sudhārasam |
evaṃ kṛte sati bhavettīrthaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam || 42 ||
meaning:
साहंशक्तिसमूहाढ्यं प्रोद्गिरन्तं सुधारसम् |
एवं कृते सति भवेत्तीर्थं नारायणात्मकम् || 42 ||
text_mt: abundant with the assemblage of the 'I'-powers, pouring forth the juice of nectar. / When this is done, the tīrtha becomes identified with Nārāyaṇa. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
nimajjanaṃ tataḥ kuryādunmajjanasamanvitam |
gandhaissāmalakairhṛdyaiḥ pavitrairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
निमज्जनं ततः कुर्यादुन्मज्जनसमन्वितम् |
गन्धैस्सामलकैर्हृद्यैः पवित्रैर्विविधैः शुभैः || 43 ||
text_mt: Then he should immerse himself, followed by emerging; / with delightful, pure, diverse, and auspicious perfumes along with āmalaka fruits, // 43

sanskrit_iast: cakravartyupacāreṇa mantrī snāyādatandritaḥ |
meaning: चक्रवर्त्युपचारेण मन्त्री स्नायादतन्द्रितः |
text_mt: with an emperor's service, the mantrin should bathe unflaggingly.

sanskrit_iast: [atha snānottarāṅgavidhiḥ]
meaning: [अथ स्नानोत्तराङ्गविधिः]
text_mt: [Now the rule for the auxiliary acts after bathing]

sanskrit_iast: tataścāntarjalasthaśca smarenmantraṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 44 ||
meaning: ततश्चान्तर्जलस्थश्च स्मरेन्मन्त्रं स्वशक्तितः || 44 ||
text_mt: And then, standing in the water, he should meditate on the mantra according to his ability. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
bhāsvadbhāsvararūpo'sau udeti hṛdayāntare |
hṛdayādagrataścānte dvādaśāntena dūrataḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
भास्वद्भास्वररूपोऽसौ उदेति हृदयान्तरे |
हृदयादग्रतश्चान्ते द्वादशान्तेन दूरतः || 45 ||
text_mt: Having a radiant form like the sun, it rises within the heart, / and from the heart forward, at the end, at a distance up to the twelve-finger limit. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣasthaṃ tu nārada |
samutthāya jalātpaśyedgaganasthaṃ tameva hi || 46 ||
meaning:
परमं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यक्षस्थं तु नारद |
समुत्थाय जलात्पश्येद्गगनस्थं तमेव हि || 46 ||
text_mt: Having seen the supreme puruṣa directly present, O Nārada, / and rising from the water, he should look upon Him standing in the sky. // 46

sanskrit_iast:
tato'psu tāramāsādya upaviśya yathāsukham |
nyasedaṅkuśamudrāgre hṛnmantraṃ sitavigraham || 47 ||
meaning:
ततोऽप्सु तारमासाद्य उपविश्य यथासुखम् |
न्यसेदङ्कुशमुद्राग्रे हृन्मन्त्रं सितविग्रहम् || 47 ||
text_mt: Then, having reached the bank of the water and seated himself comfortably, / he should place the heart-mantra, white in form, at the tip of the goad-gesture. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
svenānilena saṃyuktaṃ recayettīrthamadhyataḥ |
pūrakeṇa samākṛṣya mudrāyuktena tatpunaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
स्वेनानिलेन संयुक्तं रेचयेत्तीर्थमध्यतः |
पूरकेण समाकृष्य मुद्रायुक्तेन तत्पुनः || 48 ||
text_mt: Combined with his own breath, he should exhale it into the middle of the sacred water; / drawing it back again through inhalation combined with the gesture, // 48

sanskrit_iast:
evañcopagataṃ tīrthaṃ purā kṛtvā tu nārada |
praṇavenopacārākhyahṛdayenācamettataḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
एवञ्चोपगतं तीर्थं पुरा कृत्वा तु नारद |
प्रणवेनोपचाराख्यहृदयेनाचमेत्ततः || 49 ||
text_mt: and having thus first brought forth the sacred water, O Nārada, / he should then sip water with the Praṇava and the heart-[mantra] called the service. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
suprasannena toyena jānvantasthena pāṇinā |
ekena pādyamantreṇa sopacārahṛdā dvija || 50 ||
meaning:
सुप्रसन्नेन तोयेन जान्वन्तस्थेन पाणिना |
एकेन पाद्यमन्त्रेण सोपचारहृदा द्विज || 50 ||
text_mt: With completely pure water, with the hand held within the knees, / with the single foot-water mantra and the service-heart[-mantra], O twice-born, // 50

sanskrit_iast:
dhvātvā tatra sthitaṃ devaṃ sāṅgaṃ saparivārakam |
japyamānaśca mantro'yamupasthānaṃ tu kārayet || 51 ||
meaning:
ध्वात्वा तत्र स्थितं देवं साङ्गं सपरिवारकम् |
जप्यमानश्च मन्त्रोऽयमुपस्थानं तु कारयेत् || 51 ||
text_mt: having meditated on the God stationed there, along with His limbs and retinue, / while this mantra is being recited, he should perform the morning praise. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavena tatassarvānpitṛdevāṃśca tarpayet |
tilamiśreṇa vidhivatsantyajetsnānakarpaṭam || 52 ||
meaning:
प्रणवेन ततस्सर्वान्पितृदेवांश्च तर्पयेत् |
तिलमिश्रेण विधिवत्सन्त्यजेत्स्नानकर्पटम् || 52 ||
text_mt: Then with the Praṇava he should make libations to all the ancestors and gods / mixed with sesamum according to the rule, and discard the bathing cloth. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
sudhautaṃ paridhāyātha vastrayugmamakhedadam |
athavā tadadhaśśāṭīṃ yogapaṭṭakasaṃyutām || 53 ||
meaning:
सुधौतं परिधायाथ वस्त्रयुग्ममखेददम् |
अथवा तदधश्शाटीं योगपट्टकसंयुताम् || 53 ||
text_mt: Then, putting on a pair of well-washed garments that cause no discomfort, / or an undergarment accompanied by a meditation-cloth— // 53

sanskrit_iast:
naikavastreṇa vai yasmādbhavitavyaṃ kadācana |
sthāne'straśodhite'nyasminnanantāsanasaṃsthitam || 54 ||
meaning:
नैकवस्त्रेण वै यस्माद्भवितव्यं कदाचन |
स्थानेऽस्त्रशोधितेऽन्यस्मिन्ननन्तासनसंस्थितम् || 54 ||
text_mt: since one should never be clad in only a single garment— / in another place purified by the weapon-[mantra], stationed on the seat of Ananta, // 54

sanskrit_iast:
p. 84) ādhāramāsanaṃ dhyātvā jalamadhye'cyutasya ca |
mantragrāmasamopetamāhūya viniveśya tam || 55 ||
meaning:
प्. 84) आधारमासनं ध्यात्वा जलमध्येऽच्युतस्य च |
मन्त्रग्रामसमोपेतमाहूय विनिवेश्य तम् || 55 ||
text_mt: having meditated on the support-seat of Acyuta in the middle of the water, / summoning Him together with the host of mantras and installing Him, // 55

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayedudakenaiva viṣvaksenāvasānakam |
svena svena tu mantreṇa pāṇibhyāmagrataḥ kramāt || 56 ||
meaning:
तर्पयेदुदकेनैव विष्वक्सेनावसानकम् |
स्वेन स्वेन तु मन्त्रेण पाणिभ्यामग्रतः क्रमात् || 56 ||
text_mt: he should make libations with water alone, ending with Viṣvaksena, / each with its own mantra, with both hands in front in due order. // 56

sanskrit_iast:
devatāśca munīnnāgān grahabhūtaviyaccarān |
santarpya sthāvarāntāṃśca svavaṃśaṃ tarpayetkramāt || 57 ||
meaning:
देवताश्च मुनीन्नागान् ग्रहभूतवियच्चरान् |
सन्तर्प्य स्थावरान्तांश्च स्ववंशं तर्पयेत्क्रमात् || 57 ||
text_mt: Having made libations to the deities, sages, nāgas, planets, spirits, and sky-farers, / down to the immovable beings, he should then make libations to his own lineage in due order. // 57

sanskrit_iast:
vrajantaṃ sāsanaṃ devaṃ jalamadhyāttatassmaret |
tīrthaśuddhau purā mantro nyasto'sāvapi dikṣu vai || 58 ||
meaning:
व्रजन्तं सासनं देवं जलमध्यात्ततस्स्मरेत् |
तीर्थशुद्धौ पुरा मन्त्रो न्यस्तोऽसावपि दिक्षु वै || 58 ||
text_mt: Then he should meditate on the God departing from the middle of the water together with the seat. / The mantra that had previously been placed in the directions for the purification of the sacred water, // 58

sanskrit_iast:
prerayanpūrvavaddevānprāṇāgreṇānilaṃ dvija |
tamekīkṛtya vai tena tyaktvā toyaṃ tu śuklavat || 59 ||
meaning:
प्रेरयन्पूर्ववद्देवान्प्राणाग्रेणानिलं द्विज |
तमेकीकृत्य वै तेन त्यक्त्वा तोयं तु शुक्लवत् || 59 ||
text_mt: impelling the gods as before with the tip of the breath, O twice-born, / uniting it with that and having released the water like something white, // 59

sanskrit_iast:
āpūrya hṛdi vinyasyet sopasaṃhāramudrayā |
ityuktamaudakaṃ snānamatha māntraṃ nibodha me || 60 ||
meaning:
आपूर्य हृदि विन्यस्येत् सोपसंहारमुद्रया |
इत्युक्तमौदकं स्नानमथ मान्त्रं निबोध मे || 60 ||
text_mt: filling [himself] and placing it in the heart with the withdrawal-gesture. / Thus has the water-bath been declared; now learn from me the mantra-bath. // 60

sanskrit_iast: [mantrasnānam]
meaning: [मन्त्रस्नानम्]

sanskrit_iast:
toyābhāve ca yatkuryāddurge kāle ca śītale |
gamane kṣiprasiddhau vā gurukārye svatantratām || 61 ||
meaning:
तोयाभावे च यत्कुर्याद्दुर्गे काले च शीतले |
गमने क्षिप्रसिद्धौ वा गुरुकार्ये स्वतन्त्रताम् || 61 ||
text_mt: And what he should do in the absence of water, in impassable terrain, in cold weather, / on a journey, or for swift accomplishment, or seeing independence in an important duty // 61

sanskrit_iast:
prāptāṃ vā vīkṣya viprendra niśābhāge dinasya vā |
prakṣālya pādāvācamya proddhṛtena tu vāriṇā || 62 ||
meaning:
प्राप्तां वा वीक्ष्य विप्रेन्द्र निशाभागे दिनस्य वा |
प्रक्षाल्य पादावाचम्य प्रोद्धृतेन तु वारिणा || 62 ||
text_mt: attained, O best of Brahmins, whether in a portion of the night or day: / having washed his feet and sipped water with water that has been drawn up, // 62

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ daśa diśaḥ prāgvatsaṃśodhyopaviśettataḥ |
astraṃ hastatale yojyaṃ kramānnyāsaṃ tatastanau || 63 ||
meaning:
स्नानं दश दिशः प्राग्वत्संशोध्योपविशेत्ततः |
अस्त्रं हस्ततले योज्यं क्रमान्न्यासं ततस्तनौ || 63 ||
text_mt: having purified the bath and the ten directions as before, he should then sit down; / the weapon-[mantra] is to be placed on the palm of the hand, and then the placement on the body in due order. // 63

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantrādi tatkuryātsarvamantragaṇena tu |
kevalādudakasnānātsaṃskāraparivarjitāt || 64 ||
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रादि तत्कुर्यात्सर्वमन्त्रगणेन तु |
केवलादुदकस्नानात्संस्कारपरिवर्जितात् || 64 ||
text_mt: He should perform that beginning with the root-mantra, with the whole collection of mantras. / Compared to a mere bath with water that is devoid of consecration, // 64

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāsādiṣu tīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ snātakasya ca |
jñeyaṃ śataguṇaṃ tasmānmantragrāmasya nārada || 65 ||
meaning:
प्रभासादिषु तीर्थेषु यत्फलं स्नातकस्य च |
ज्ञेयं शतगुणं तस्मान्मन्त्रग्रामस्य नारद || 65 ||
text_mt: whatever fruit belongs to one who has bathed at Prabhāsa and other holy places, / that from the host of mantras is to be known as a hundred times greater, O Nārada. // 65

sanskrit_iast: [dhyānasnānam]
meaning: [ध्यानस्नानम्]

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānasnānamatho vakṣye dvābhyāmapi paraṃ tu yat |
khasthitaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ mantramūrtiṃ prabhuṃ smaret || 66 ||
meaning:
ध्यानस्नानमथो वक्ष्ये द्वाभ्यामपि परं तु यत् |
खस्थितं पुण्डरीकाक्षं मन्त्रमूर्तिं प्रभुं स्मरेत् || 66 ||
text_mt: Now I shall teach the meditation-bath, which is superior even to both: / he should meditate on the Lord, the lotus-eyed, whose form is mantra, stationed in the sky. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
tatpādodakajāṃ dhārāṃ patamānāṃ svamūrdhani |
cintayedbrahmarandhreṇa praviśantīṃ svakāṃ tanum || 67 ||
meaning:
तत्पादोदकजां धारां पतमानां स्वमूर्धनि |
चिन्तयेद्ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण प्रविशन्तीं स्वकां तनुम् || 67 ||
text_mt: He should contemplate a stream born of the water of His feet falling upon his own head, / entering his own body through the aperture of Brahman. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
tayā saṃkṣālayetsarvamantardehagataṃ malam |
p. 85) tatkṣaṇādvirajā mantrī jāyate sphaṭikopamaḥ || 68 ||
meaning:
तया संक्षालयेत्सर्वमन्तर्देहगतं मलम् |
प्. 85) तत्क्षणाद्विरजा मन्त्री जायते स्फटिकोपमः || 68 ||
text_mt: With that he should wash away all the impurity situated inside the body; / from that moment, the mantra-practitioner becomes free from dust, resembling crystal. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ snānaṃ paraṃ māntrātsnānācchataguṇaṃ smṛtam |
tasmādekatamaṃ kāryaṃ snānaṃ śraddhāpareṇa tu || 69 ||
meaning:
इदं स्नानं परं मान्त्रात्स्नानाच्छतगुणं स्मृतम् |
तस्मादेकतमं कार्यं स्नानं श्रद्धापरेण तु || 69 ||
text_mt: This bath is higher than the mantra-bath, remembered as a hundred times greater; / therefore, one single bath should be performed by one devoted to faith. // 69

sanskrit_iast:
snānapūrvāḥ kriyāssarvā yatassamyakphalapradāḥ |
tasmātsnānaṃ purā kuryādya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
स्नानपूर्वाः क्रियास्सर्वा यतस्सम्यक्फलप्रदाः |
तस्मात्स्नानं पुरा कुर्याद्य इच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः || 70 ||
text_mt: Since all rites preceded by bathing bestow their fruit fully, / therefore one who desires his own welfare should first perform bathing. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
snānena nirmalo jantuḥ kṛtamātreṇa jāyate |
dvijendra nirvivekātmā kiṃ punaryaḥ kriyāparaḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
स्नानेन निर्मलो जन्तुः कृतमात्रेण जायते |
द्विजेन्द्र निर्विवेकात्मा किं पुनर्यः क्रियापरः || 71 ||
text_mt: By bathing, a living creature becomes stainless the moment it is done, / O chief of the twice-born, even one lacking discernment; how much more so one devoted to rites, // 71

sanskrit_iast: varṇadharmakramopetassādhumārgavyavasthitaḥ |
meaning: वर्णधर्मक्रमोपेतस्साधुमार्गव्यवस्थितः |
text_mt: endowed with the proper order of caste-duties and established on the path of the virtuous! // 72ab

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ snānavidhirnāma navamaḥ
paṭalaḥ || 9 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां स्नानविधिर्नाम नवमः
पटलः || 9 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the ninth chapter, named 'The Rule for Bathing', in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the venerable Pāñcarātra. // 9

sanskrit_iast: atha samādhikhyāpanaṃ nāma daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: अथ समाधिख्यापनं नाम दशमः पटलः
text_mt: Now the tenth chapter, named 'The Declaration of Absorption'.

sanskrit_iast: [dhyānārthaṃ nirjanasthānaṃ prati gamanam]
meaning: [ध्यानार्थं निर्जनस्थानं प्रति गमनम्]
text_mt: [Going to a solitary place for meditation]

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast:
sāstraṃ dūrvāṅkuraṃ datvā puṣpaṃ patraṃ tilāṃstu vā |
sodakānātmano mūrdhni śikhāsthāne ca nārada || 1 ||
meaning:
सास्त्रं दूर्वाङ्कुरं दत्वा पुष्पं पत्रं तिलांस्तु वा |
सोदकानात्मनो मूर्ध्नि शिखास्थाने च नारद || 1 ||
text_mt: Having placed a dūrvā sprout with the weapon-[mantra], a flower, a leaf, or sesamum seeds / accompanied by water upon his head, at the place of the crest-tuft, O Nārada, // 1

sanskrit_iast:
tataścodakasampūrṇaṃ bhāṇḍamādāya pāṇinā |
ekāntanirjanaṃ yāyānmanojñaṃ doṣavarjitam || 2 ||
meaning:
ततश्चोदकसम्पूर्णं भाण्डमादाय पाणिना |
एकान्तनिर्जनं यायान्मनोज्ञं दोषवर्जितम् || 2 ||
text_mt: and then taking a vessel filled with water in his hand, / he should go to a secluded, solitary place that is pleasant and free from defects. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
hṛnmadhyasthaṃ smare(ra ?)nmantraṃ prabuddhānalavigraham |
digantaramavīkṣanvai maunī saṃrodhitānilaḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
हृन्मध्यस्थं स्मरे(र ?)न्मन्त्रं प्रबुद्धानलविग्रहम् |
दिगन्तरमवीक्षन्वै मौनी संरोधितानिलः || 3 ||
text_mt: He should meditate on the mantra stationed in the middle of the heart, whose form is awakened fire, / not looking in other directions, remaining silent, with breath restrained. // 3

sanskrit_iast: [sthānaprāptisamaye kartavyāṃśaḥ]
meaning: [स्थानप्राप्तिसमये कर्तव्यांशः]
text_mt: [Action to be performed upon reaching the place]

sanskrit_iast:
prāpya sthānaṃ svamantraṃ tu nāsāgreṇa virecayet |
bahirastraṃ ca vinyasya caraṇena hanetkṣitim || 4 ||
meaning:
प्राप्य स्थानं स्वमन्त्रं तु नासाग्रेण विरेचयेत् |
बहिरस्त्रं च विन्यस्य चरणेन हनेत्क्षितिम् || 4 ||
text_mt: Having reached the place, he should exhale his mantra through the tip of his nose, / and having placed the weapon-[mantra] outside, he should strike the ground with his foot. // 4

sanskrit_iast: mantrapūrvaṃ smaredviṣṇuṃ sakalaṃ garuḍāsanam |
meaning: मन्त्रपूर्वं स्मरेद्विष्णुं सकलं गरुडासनम् |
text_mt: Preceded by the mantra, he should meditate on Viṣṇu with parts, seated on Garuḍa. // 5ab

sanskrit_iast: [darbhādyāsanavikalpaḥ]
meaning: [दर्भाद्यासनविकल्पः]
text_mt: [Options for seats of darbha grass and the like]

sanskrit_iast: ekadeśaṃ samāsādya badhnīyādrucirāsanam || 5 ||
meaning: एकदेशं समासाद्य बध्नीयाद्रुचिरासनम् || 5 ||
text_mt: Approaching one spot, he should prepare an attractive seat, // 5cd

sanskrit_iast: darbhe carmaṇi vastre vā phalake yajñakāṣṭhake |
meaning: दर्भे चर्मणि वस्त्रे वा फलके यज्ञकाष्ठके |
text_mt: on darbha grass, on a skin, or on a cloth, on a board of sacrificial wood. // 6ab

sanskrit_iast: [gurusmaraṇapūrvakamānasakriyānirvahaṇam]
meaning: [गुरुस्मरणपूर्वकमानसक्रियानिर्वहणम्]
text_mt: [Performance of mental rites preceded by remembrance of the teachers]

sanskrit_iast: abhivandya hariṃ bhaktyā manasā gurusantatim || 6 ||
meaning: अभिवन्द्य हरिं भक्त्या मनसा गुरुसन्ततिम् || 6 ||
text_mt: Having reverenced Hari with devotion, and mentally the succession of teachers, // 6cd

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā mānasīmājñāṃ tebhyastu śirasā nataḥ |
mānasīṃ nirvahetsarvāṃ kriyāṃ vipra yathāsthitām || 7 ||
meaning:
गृहीत्वा मानसीमाज्ञां तेभ्यस्तु शिरसा नतः |
मानसीं निर्वहेत्सर्वां क्रियां विप्र यथास्थिताम् || 7 ||
text_mt: having received their mental permission, bowed with his head to them, / he should carry out every mental rite as it stands, O Brahmin. // 7

sanskrit_iast: p. 86) [āsanaśuddhiḥ]

mūlamantrābhijaptena toyena prokṣya cāsanam |
cchoṭikāṃ mantrasaṃyuktāṃ dadyāttacchuddhaye punaḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
मूलमन्त्राभिजप्तेन तोयेन प्रोक्ष्य चासनम् |
च्छोटिकां मन्त्रसंयुक्तां दद्यात्तच्छुद्धये पुनः || 8 ||
text_mt: And having sprinkled the seat with water consecrated by the root-mantra, / he should then snap his fingers accompanied by the mantra for its purification. // 8

sanskrit_iast: [karaśuddhiḥ]
meaning: [करशुद्धिः]

sanskrit_iast:
hastaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kuryādyathā tacchṛṇu nārada |
dve tale hastapṛṣṭhe dve sarvāścāṅgulayastathā || 9 ||
meaning:
हस्तशुद्धिं ततः कुर्याद्यथा तच्छृणु नारद |
द्वे तले हस्तपृष्ठे द्वे सर्वाश्चाङ्गुलयस्तथा || 9 ||
text_mt: Then he should perform the purification of the hands; hear how that is done, O Nārada: / the two palms, the two backs of the hands, and likewise all the fingers, // 9

sanskrit_iast:
astramantreṇa saṃśodhya dhyānoccāraprayogataḥ |
kṛtvaivaṃ karaśuddhiṃ ca sthānaśuddhiṃ samācaret || 10 ||
meaning:
अस्त्रमन्त्रेण संशोध्य ध्यानोच्चारप्रयोगतः |
कृत्वैवं करशुद्धिं च स्थानशुद्धिं समाचरेत् || 10 ||
text_mt: having purified them with the weapon-mantra through the application of meditation and recitation. / Having thus performed the purification of the hands, he should carry out the purification of the place. // 10

sanskrit_iast: [sthānaśuddhiḥ]
meaning: [स्थानशुद्धिः]

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā devaṃ jvaladrūpaṃ sahasrārkasamaprabham |
jvālākoṭisamākīrṇaṃ vamantaṃ jvalanaṃ mukhāt || 11 ||
meaning:
ध्यात्वा देवं ज्वलद्रूपं सहस्रार्कसमप्रभम् |
ज्वालाकोटिसमाकीर्णं वमन्तं ज्वलनं मुखात् || 11 ||
text_mt: Having meditated on the God of blazing form, equal in splendor to a thousand suns, / surrounded by millions of flames, vomiting fire from His mouth, // 11

sanskrit_iast:
tena saṃpūrayetsarvamābrahmabhuvanāntimam |
digoghaṃ prajvalantaṃ ca bhāvayenmantratejasā || 12 ||
meaning:
तेन संपूरयेत्सर्वमाब्रह्मभुवनान्तिमम् |
दिगोघं प्रज्वलन्तं च भावयेन्मन्त्रतेजसा || 12 ||
text_mt: with that he should fill everything up to the realm of Brahman, / and he should contemplate the expanse of the directions blazing with the splendor of the mantra. // 12

sanskrit_iast:
kṣmāmaṇḍalamidaṃ sarvaṃ smaranpakvaṃ ca vahninā |
mantrajena dvijaśreṣṭha mṛṇmayaṃ bhājanaṃ yathā || 13 ||
meaning:
क्ष्मामण्डलमिदं सर्वं स्मरन्पक्वं च वह्निना |
मन्त्रजेन द्विजश्रेष्ठ मृण्मयं भाजनं यथा || 13 ||
text_mt: Meditating upon this entire circle of the earth as baked by the fire / born of the mantra, O best of the twice-born, just like an earthen vessel: // 13

sanskrit_iast:
sthānaśuddhirbhavatyevaṃ sudhākallolasecanāt |
bhūtaśuddhiṃ śṛṇu mune yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
स्थानशुद्धिर्भवत्येवं सुधाकल्लोलसेचनात् |
भूतशुद्धिं शृणु मुने यथावदनुपूर्वशः || 14 ||
text_mt: the purification of the place takes place in this way by sprinkling with billows of nectar. / Hear about the purification of the elements, O sage, properly and in succession. // 14

sanskrit_iast: [bhūtaśuddhiprakaraṇam]
meaning: [भूतशुद्धिप्रकरणम्]
text_mt: [Section on the purification of the elements]

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthvyaptejonilākāśaṃ śarīraṃ bhūtapañcakam |
indrajālopamaṃ viddhi jñānādyairujjhitaṃ guṇaiḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
पृथ्व्यप्तेजोनिलाकाशं शरीरं भूतपञ्चकम् |
इन्द्रजालोपमं विद्धि ज्ञानाद्यैरुज्झितं गुणैः || 15 ||
text_mt: Earth, water, fire, wind, and ether—know that the body is made of the five elements, / resembling a magic show, devoid of qualities such as knowledge. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
malinañcāsvatantra ca retoraktodbhavaṃ kṣayi |
yāvanna śodhitaṃ samyak dhāraṇābhirnirantaram || 16 ||
meaning:
मलिनञ्चास्वतन्त्र च रेतोरक्तोद्भवं क्षयि |
यावन्न शोधितं सम्यक् धारणाभिर्निरन्तरम् || 16 ||
text_mt: Impure, dependent on others, produced from semen and blood, perishable; / as long as it is not properly and continuously purified by the dhāraṇās, // 16

sanskrit_iast: tāvadetadayogyaṃ syānmantranyāsādivastuṣu |
meaning: तावदेतदयोग्यं स्यान्मन्त्रन्यासादिवस्तुषु |
text_mt: so long is it unfit for matters such as the imposition of mantras.

sanskrit_iast: [pṛthivyādibhūtānāṃ bījāni]
meaning: [पृथिव्यादिभूतानां बीजानि]
text_mt: [The seed-syllables of the elements earth and the rest]

sanskrit_iast: śaṅkaraścāgnirūpaśca somaḥsūryastadantakaḥ || 17 ||
meaning: शङ्करश्चाग्निरूपश्च सोमःसूर्यस्तदन्तकः || 17 ||
text_mt: Śaṅkara, Agnirūpa, Soma, Sūrya, and his ender: // 17

sanskrit_iast:
varṇapañcakametadvai yuktaṃ kuryātkrameṇa tu |
dhareśena varāheṇa analenātha kambunā || 18 ||
meaning:
वर्णपञ्चकमेतद्वै युक्तं कुर्यात्क्रमेण तु |
धरेशेन वराहेण अनलेनाथ कम्बुना || 18 ||
text_mt: one should indeed combine this set of five syllables in sequence / with Dhareśa, Varāha, Anala, and then Kambu, // 18

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānena dvijaśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ yojayettataḥ |
trailokyaiśvaryadopetamādidevaṃ ca mūrdhani || 19 ||
meaning:
प्रधानेन द्विजश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषां योजयेत्ततः |
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदोपेतमादिदेवं च मूर्धनि || 19 ||
text_mt: and then with Pradhāna, O best of the twice-born, of all of them; / and the Primeval God who grants lordship over the three worlds should be joined on the head. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
p. 87) pṛthvīkāgnimarudvyomabījānyetānyanukramāt |
pṛthvyādisaṃjñāyuktāni huṃphaḍantāni nārada || 20 ||
meaning:
प्. 87) पृथ्वीकाग्निमरुद्व्योमबीजान्येतान्यनुक्रमात् |
पृथ्व्यादिसंज्ञायुक्तानि हुंफडन्तानि नारद || 20 ||
text_mt: These are in sequence the seeds of earth, water, fire, wind, and ether, / combined with the names earth and the rest, ending in huṃ phaṭ, O Nārada, // 20

sanskrit_iast:
prāgoṅkāreṇa yuktāni bhūtaśuddhau tridhoccaret |
bhūteśvarāṇāṃ pañcānāṃ paratvena kramātsthitāḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
प्रागोङ्कारेण युक्तानि भूतशुद्धौ त्रिधोच्चरेत् |
भूतेश्वराणां पञ्चानां परत्वेन क्रमात्स्थिताः || 21 ||
text_mt: and preceded by the syllable Om; one should utter them three times in the purification of the elements. / Standing in sequence by virtue of the supremacy of the five lords of the elements, // 21

sanskrit_iast: [pṛthivyādibhūtānāṃ devatāḥ]
meaning: [पृथिव्यादिभूतानां देवताः]
text_mt: [The deities of the elements earth and the rest]

sanskrit_iast:
aniruddhādayaḥ pañca satyapūrvāḥ puroditāḥ |
śaktitvena ca vartante taiśca tānvyāharetkramāt || 22 ||
meaning:
अनिरुद्धादयः पञ्च सत्यपूर्वाः पुरोदिताः |
शक्तित्वेन च वर्तन्ते तैश्च तान्व्याहरेत्क्रमात् || 22 ||
text_mt: the five, Aniruddha and the others, preceded by Satya, were mentioned before, / and they abide in the form of Śakti; through them one should utter those [mantras] in order. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
[pṛthivyādimahābhūtānāṃ svavigrahe praveśana tadvyāpana
tadvilayanaprakārāḥ]
meaning:
[पृथिव्यादिमहाभूतानां स्वविग्रहे प्रवेशन तद्व्यापन
तद्विलयनप्रकाराः]
text_mt: [The methods of causing the great elements earth and the rest to enter one's own body, pervade it, and dissolve]

sanskrit_iast:
sauṣumnāddakṣiṇadvārānnirgamayya hariṃ bahiḥ |
sahasraravisaṅkāśaṃ vṛttamaṇḍalamadhyagam || 23 ||
meaning:
सौषुम्नाद्दक्षिणद्वारान्निर्गमय्य हरिं बहिः |
सहस्ररविसङ्काशं वृत्तमण्डलमध्यगम् || 23 ||
text_mt: Having caused Hari to go outside from the right door of the suṣumnā, / resembling a thousand suns, positioned in the middle of a circular orb, // 23

sanskrit_iast:
taptakāñcanavarṇābhamāsīnaṃ parame pade |
mantrātmānaṃ tu taṃ dhyātvā hyupari dvādaśāṅgule || 24 ||
meaning:
तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभमासीनं परमे पदे |
मन्त्रात्मानं तु तं ध्यात्वा ह्युपरि द्वादशाङ्गुले || 24 ||
text_mt: radiant with the color of molten gold, seated in the supreme abode— / having meditated upon him whose nature is mantra twelve finger-breadths above, // 24

sanskrit_iast:
prabhācakraṃ tu tadadhastattvādhiṣṭātṛsaṃyutaḥ |
niṣkalaṃ mantradehaṃ tu dhyātvā tu tadadhaḥ kramāt || 25 ||
meaning:
प्रभाचक्रं तु तदधस्तत्त्वाधिष्टातृसंयुतः |
निष्कलं मन्त्रदेहं तु ध्यात्वा तु तदधः क्रमात् || 25 ||
text_mt: and below that, the circle of radiance accompanied by the presiding deities of the principles, / and having meditated in sequence below that upon the partless mantra-body: // 25

sanskrit_iast: [tatrādau pṛthivītattvanilayanam]
meaning: [तत्रादौ पृथिवीतत्त्वनिलयनम्]
text_mt: [First, the dissolution of the earth-principle]

sanskrit_iast:
turyaśrāṃ pītabhāṃ bhūmiṃ cintayedvajralāñchitām |
śabdādyaiḥ pañcabhiryuktāṃ nagadrumasamākulām || 26 ||
meaning:
तुर्यश्रां पीतभां भूमिं चिन्तयेद्वज्रलाञ्छिताम् |
शब्दाद्यैः पञ्चभिर्युक्तां नगद्रुमसमाकुलाम् || 26 ||
text_mt: one should contemplate the earth as four-cornered, of yellow light, marked with a vajra, / endowed with the five [qualities] sound and the rest, crowded with mountains and trees, // 26

sanskrit_iast:
puraprākārasusariddvīpārṇavapariṣkṛtām |
saṃviśantīṃ smaredbāhyātpūrakeṇa svavigrahe || 27 ||
meaning:
पुरप्राकारसुसरिद्द्वीपार्णवपरिष्कृताम् |
संविशन्तीं स्मरेद्बाह्यात्पूरकेण स्वविग्रहे || 27 ||
text_mt: adorned with cities, ramparts, good rivers, continents, and oceans. / One should remember it entering into one's own body from outside by inhalation, // 27

sanskrit_iast:
proccārayaṃśca tanmantraṃ viśrāntāmatha cintayet |
jānvoḥ pādatalaṃ yāvattayā vyāptaṃ krameṇa tu || 28 ||
meaning:
प्रोच्चारयंश्च तन्मन्त्रं विश्रान्तामथ चिन्तयेत् |
जान्वोः पादतलं यावत्तया व्याप्तं क्रमेण तु || 28 ||
text_mt: and uttering its mantra, one should then contemplate it come to rest, / pervading gradually from the knees down to the soles of the feet. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhakena dvijaśreṣṭha mantramūrtau svake tataḥ |
śanaiḥ śanairlayam yātāṃ gandhaśaktau ca mantrarāṭ || 29 ||
meaning:
कुम्भकेन द्विजश्रेष्ठ मन्त्रमूर्तौ स्वके ततः |
शनैः शनैर्लयम् यातां गन्धशक्तौ च मन्त्रराट् || 29 ||
text_mt: Then, O best of the twice-born, by retention in one's own mantra-form, / O king of mantras, it gradually dissolves into the power of smell. // 29

sanskrit_iast: [jalatattvanilayanam]
meaning: [जलतत्त्वनिलयनम्]

sanskrit_iast:
gandhaśaktiṃ ca tāṃ paścādrecakena bahiḥkṣipet |
toyākhye ca mahādhāre tatastoyaṃ ca vaibhavam || 30 ||
meaning:
गन्धशक्तिं च तां पश्चाद्रेचकेन बहिःक्षिपेत् |
तोयाख्ये च महाधारे ततस्तोयं च वैभवम् || 30 ||
text_mt: And by exhalation one should then cast out that power of smell / into the great receptacle named water; and then the watery manifestation— // 30

sanskrit_iast:
samudrasasaritsroto rasaṣaṭkaṃ ca sauṣadhīḥ |
yāni yānyambubhūtāni bhūtāni bhuvanāntare || 31 ||
meaning:
समुद्रससरित्स्रोतो रसषट्कं च सौषधीः |
यानि यान्यम्बुभूतानि भूतानि भुवनान्तरे || 31 ||
text_mt: the oceans, streams of rivers, the six tastes, and medicinal plants, / whatever watery elements exist within the world— // 31

sanskrit_iast:
ardhacandrasamākāraṃ kamaladhvajaśobhitam |
vāruṇaṃ vibhavaṃ bāhye dhyātvā tenātha vigraham || 32 ||
meaning:
अर्धचन्द्रसमाकारं कमलध्वजशोभितम् |
वारुणं विभवं बाह्ये ध्यात्वा तेनाथ विग्रहम् || 32 ||
text_mt: having meditated outside on the manifestation belonging to Varuṇa, shaped like a half-moon, / adorned with a lotus-banner, and then filling the body with it // 32

sanskrit_iast:
p. 88) saṃpūrya pūrakākhyena karaṇena śanaiśśanaiḥ |
ūrumūlācca jānvantaṃ śarīraṃ maṇḍalaṃ svakam || 33 ||
meaning:
प्. 88) संपूर्य पूरकाख्येन करणेन शनैश्शनैः |
ऊरुमूलाच्च जान्वन्तं शरीरं मण्डलं स्वकम् || 33 ||
text_mt: gradually by the operation called inhalation, / one's own body-mandala from the base of the thighs to the knees // 33

sanskrit_iast:
tenākhilaṃ tu saṃvyāptaṃ kumbhakena smareddvija |
tanmadhye vāruṇaṃ mantraṃ dhāraṇākhyaṃ vicintya ca || 34 ||
meaning:
तेनाखिलं तु संव्याप्तं कुम्भकेन स्मरेद्द्विज |
तन्मध्ये वारुणं मन्त्रं धारणाख्यं विचिन्त्य च || 34 ||
text_mt: is completely pervaded by it—one should meditate on this by retention, O twice-born, / and having contemplated the mantra of Varuṇa, called dhāraṇā, within it, // 34

sanskrit_iast:
ammayaṃ vibhavaṃ sarvaṃ tanmadhye vilayaṃ gatam |
tatastaṃ rasaśaktau ca sā śaktirvahnimaṇḍale || 35 ||
meaning:
अम्मयं विभवं सर्वं तन्मध्ये विलयं गतम् |
ततस्तं रसशक्तौ च सा शक्तिर्वह्निमण्डले || 35 ||
text_mt: the entire watery manifestation is dissolved in its midst; / then that [is dissolved] into the power of taste, and that power into the orb of fire. // 35

sanskrit_iast: [tejastattvanilayanam]
meaning: [तेजस्तत्त्वनिलयनम्]
text_mt: [The dissolution of the fire-principle]

sanskrit_iast:
recakena vinikṣipya tato vānhaṃ ca vaibhavam |
trikoṇabhuvanākāraṃ dīptimadbhirvibhūṣitam || 36 ||
meaning:
रेचकेन विनिक्षिप्य ततो वान्हं च वैभवम् |
त्रिकोणभुवनाकारं दीप्तिमद्भिर्विभूषितम् || 36 ||
text_mt: Having expelled [it] by exhalation, then the fiery manifestation, / shaped like a triangular world, adorned with radiant things, // 36

sanskrit_iast:
vidyuccandrārkanakṣatramaṇiratnaiśca dhātubhiḥ |
svaprakāśaśarīraistu aśarīraiśca khecaraiḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
विद्युच्चन्द्रार्कनक्षत्रमणिरत्नैश्च धातुभिः |
स्वप्रकाशशरीरैस्तु अशरीरैश्च खेचरैः || 37 ||
text_mt: with lightning, moon, sun, constellations, gems, jewels, and minerals, / with self-luminous bodies and bodiless sky-farers, // 37

sanskrit_iast:
cinhitaṃ svastikairdīptairvyāpyaivaṃ vibhavaṃ mahat |
taijasaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ tanmātraṃ cātha saṃsmaret || 38 ||
meaning:
चिन्हितं स्वस्तिकैर्दीप्तैर्व्याप्यैवं विभवं महत् |
तैजसं मुनिशार्दूलं तन्मात्रं चाथ संस्मरेत् || 38 ||
text_mt: marked with radiant svastikas—thus pervading this great manifestation, / the fiery one, O tiger among sages, one should then remember that subtle element. // 38

sanskrit_iast:
tanmaṇḍalāntarasthaṃ tu proccaranvai tameva hi |
praviṣṭaṃ pūrvavaddhyāyettenaiva karaṇena tu || 39 ||
meaning:
तन्मण्डलान्तरस्थं तु प्रोच्चरन्वै तमेव हि |
प्रविष्टं पूर्ववद्ध्यायेत्तेनैव करणेन तु || 39 ||
text_mt: Abiding within that circle, reciting that very [mantra], / one should meditate on it entered as before by that very operation. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
ānābheḥ pāyuparyantaṃ vyāptaṃ kṛtvā'vadhārya ca |
taṃ vipra vibhavaṃ sarvaṃ taijasaṃ paribhāvayet || 40 ||
meaning:
आनाभेः पायुपर्यन्तं व्याप्तं कृत्वाऽवधार्य च |
तं विप्र विभवं सर्वं तैजसं परिभावयेत् || 40 ||
text_mt: Having made it pervade and fixing it from the navel down to the anus, / O vipra, one should contemplate that entire fiery manifestation. // 40

sanskrit_iast:
tanmantravigrahe śrāntaṃ mantraṃ taccānalātmakam |
rūpaśaktau layaṃ yātaṃ śaktissaṃvinmayī ca sā || 41 ||
meaning:
तन्मन्त्रविग्रहे श्रान्तं मन्त्रं तच्चानलात्मकम् |
रूपशक्तौ लयं यातं शक्तिस्संविन्मयी च सा || 41 ||
text_mt: At rest in that mantra-form, that mantra whose nature is fire / dissolves into the power of form; and that power consists of consciousness. // 41

sanskrit_iast: [vāyutattvanilayanam]
meaning: [वायुतत्त्वनिलयनम्]

sanskrit_iast:
tayā mantraśarīraṃ svaṃ svaśaktyā vilayīkṛtam |
recakena kṛtāṃ śaktiṃ vāyvādhāre bahiḥ kṣipet || 42 ||
meaning:
तया मन्त्रशरीरं स्वं स्वशक्त्या विलयीकृतम् |
रेचकेन कृतां शक्तिं वाय्वाधारे बहिः क्षिपेत् || 42 ||
text_mt: Through that, one's own mantra-body is dissolved by its own power; / one should cast out the power made by exhalation into the receptacle of wind outside. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu vāyavīyaṃ vai vaibhavaṃ bāhyataḥ smaret |
vṛttaṃ rājopalābhaṃ tu bimbairyuktaṃ tu taijasaiḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु वायवीयं वै वैभवं बाह्यतः स्मरेत् |
वृत्तं राजोपलाभं तु बिम्बैर्युक्तं तु तैजसैः || 43 ||
text_mt: Then one should mentally contemplate the aerial manifestation outside, / circular, with the luster of lapis lazuli, joined with fiery discs, // 43

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇaṃ nānāvidhairgandhairanekaistadguṇaistathā |
svamantreṇa samākrāntaṃ dhāraṇākhyena taṃ smaret || 44 ||
meaning:
पूर्णं नानाविधैर्गन्धैरनेकैस्तद्गुणैस्तथा |
स्वमन्त्रेण समाक्रान्तं धारणाख्येन तं स्मरेत् || 44 ||
text_mt: filled with diverse fragrances and many of its own qualities; / one should remember it pervaded by its own mantra called dhāraṇā. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
tathā svarūpaṃ tanmantraṃ dhyātvoccārya samāharet |
p. 89) pūrvoktakaraṇenaivaṃ ghrāṇāgreṇa śanaiśśanaiḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
तथा स्वरूपं तन्मन्त्रं ध्यात्वोच्चार्य समाहरेत् |
प्. 89) पूर्वोक्तकरणेनैवं घ्राणाग्रेण शनैश्शनैः || 45 ||
text_mt: Likewise, having meditated upon that mantra in its own form, and uttering it, one should draw it in / through the tip of the nose gradually by the operation mentioned before. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
ākaṇṭhānnābhideśāntaṃ tena vyāptaṃ tu bhāvayet |
prāguktakaraṇenaiva vāyavyaṃ vibhavaṃ tataḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
आकण्ठान्नाभिदेशान्तं तेन व्याप्तं तु भावयेत् |
प्रागुक्तकरणेनैव वायव्यं विभवं ततः || 46 ||
text_mt: One should contemplate [the region] from the throat down to the navel as pervaded by it; / then, by the operation mentioned before, the aerial manifestation // 46

sanskrit_iast:
adhiṣṭhātṛlayaṃ yātaṃ smṛtvā taṃ ca mahāmune |
sparśākhyāyāṃ mahāśaktau tāṃ śaktimavinaśvarīm || 47 ||
meaning:
अधिष्ठातृलयं यातं स्मृत्वा तं च महामुने |
स्पर्शाख्यायां महाशक्तौ तां शक्तिमविनश्वरीम् || 47 ||
text_mt: dissolves into the presiding deity; remembering that, O great sage, / into the great power called touch, that imperishable power // 47

sanskrit_iast: [ākāśatattvanilayanam]
meaning: [आकाशतत्त्वनिलयनम्]
text_mt: [The dissolution of the ether-principle]

sanskrit_iast:
vyāptāṃ nityāmadṛśyāṃ ca svaśaktivibhavānvitām |
śabdākhye tu mahādhāre nikṣipedvyomamaṇḍale || 48 ||
meaning:
व्याप्तां नित्यामदृश्यां च स्वशक्तिविभवान्विताम् |
शब्दाख्ये तु महाधारे निक्षिपेद्व्योममण्डले || 48 ||
text_mt: all-pervading, eternal, and invisible, endowed with the manifestation of its own power, / one should cast into the great receptacle named sound, in the circle of the ether. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā'tha vibhavaṃ sarvaṃ vyomākhyaṃ vigrahādbahiḥ |
nānāśabdasamākīrṇaṃ nīrūpaṃ cāñjanaprabham || 49 ||
meaning:
ध्यात्वाऽथ विभवं सर्वं व्योमाख्यं विग्रहाद्बहिः |
नानाशब्दसमाकीर्णं नीरूपं चाञ्जनप्रभम् || 49 ||
text_mt: Having meditated outside the body upon the entire manifestation called ether, / filled with diverse sounds, formless, with the luster of collyrium, // 49

sanskrit_iast:
avigrahaiśśabdamayaiḥ pūrṇaṃ siddhairasaṅkhyakaiḥ |
tanmadhye dhāraṇānmantraṃ vyomākhyaṃ saṃsmareddvija || 50 ||
meaning:
अविग्रहैश्शब्दमयैः पूर्णं सिद्धैरसङ्ख्यकैः |
तन्मध्ये धारणान्मन्त्रं व्योमाख्यं संस्मरेद्द्विज || 50 ||
text_mt: filled with countless bodiless siddhas made of sound, / in its midst, O twice-born, one should contemplate the dhāraṇā mantra named ether, // 50

sanskrit_iast:
dhārayantaṃ svamātmānaṃ svasāmarthyena sarvadā |
 śabdamatrāmarūpaṃ tu vyāpakaṃ vibhaveṣvapi || 51 ||
meaning:
धारयन्तं स्वमात्मानं स्वसामर्थ्येन सर्वदा |
 शब्दमत्रामरूपं तु व्यापकं विभवेष्वपि || 51 ||
text_mt: ever sustaining itself by its own potency, / formless, consisting of sound alone, all-pervading even among manifestations. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
dhiyā ca saṃparicchannaṃ kṛtvā vinyasya vigrahe |
prāguktakaraṇenaiva tena vyāptaṃ tu bhāvayet || 52 ||
meaning:
धिया च संपरिच्छन्नं कृत्वा विन्यस्य विग्रहे |
प्रागुक्तकरणेनैव तेन व्याप्तं तु भावयेत् || 52 ||
text_mt: Having mentally delimited it and deposited it in the body, / by the operation mentioned before, one should contemplate [the body] pervaded by it, // 52

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṇādbrahmarandhrāntaṃ vyomākhyaṃ vibhavena ca |
sandhārya kumbhakenaiva yāvatkālaṃ tu yoginā || 53 ||
meaning:
आकर्णाद्ब्रह्मरन्ध्रान्तं व्योमाख्यं विभवेन च |
सन्धार्य कुम्भकेनैव यावत्कालं तु योगिना || 53 ||
text_mt: from the ears up to the aperture of Brahman, along with the manifestation called ether; / holding it by retention for as long as [possible], the yogin // 53

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyetpariṇataṃ paścātsvamantre tu tathā mune |
vyomākhyaṃ dhāraṇāmantraṃ śabdaśaktau layaṃ gatam || 54 ||
meaning:
ध्यायेत्परिणतं पश्चात्स्वमन्त्रे तु तथा मुने |
व्योमाख्यं धारणामन्त्रं शब्दशक्तौ लयं गतम् || 54 ||
text_mt: should afterwards meditate upon it transformed into its own mantra, O sage; / the dhāraṇā mantra called ether dissolves into the power of sound. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
[śabdaśakteḥ kramāt gandhādiśaktinilayanāspadabhūtāyā
niṣkale'nupraveśabhāvanam]
meaning:
[शब्दशक्तेः क्रमात् गन्धादिशक्तिनिलयनास्पदभूताया
निष्कलेऽनुप्रवेशभावनम्]
text_mt: [The contemplation of the entrance into the partless of the power of sound, which is the locus of dissolution in sequence for the powers of smell and the rest]

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ śaktiṃ brahmarandhreṇa prayāntīmanubhāvayet |
yuktāṃ śakticatuṣkeṇa gandhādyenāvinaśvarīm || 55 ||
meaning:
तां शक्तिं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण प्रयान्तीमनुभावयेत् |
युक्तां शक्तिचतुष्केण गन्धाद्येनाविनश्वरीम् || 55 ||
text_mt: One should contemplate that imperishable power departing through the aperture of Brahman, / joined with the quartet of powers beginning with smell. // 55

sanskrit_iast:
āśrayenniṣkalaṃ mantraṃ vyomātītaṃ nirañjanam |
śaktayo yāśca satyādyāstāsāmapi paraśca yaḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
आश्रयेन्निष्कलं मन्त्रं व्योमातीतं निरञ्जनम् |
शक्तयो याश्च सत्याद्यास्तासामपि परश्च यः || 56 ||
text_mt: One should take refuge in the partless mantra, beyond ether, stainless, / and higher even than those powers that begin with Satī. // 56

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkaṃ (ṣṭhaṃ ?) taṃ niṣkalaṃ viddhi vyāptiḥ prāguditā'sya ca |
samantraṃ vibhavaṃ bhautamevamastaṃ nayetkramāt || 57 ||
meaning:
षट्कं (ष्ठं ?) तं निष्कलं विद्धि व्याप्तिः प्रागुदिताऽस्य च |
समन्त्रं विभवं भौतमेवमस्तं नयेत्क्रमात् || 57 ||
text_mt: Know that partless [mantra] to be the sixth; its pervasiveness was stated before. / Thus one should gradually dissolve the elemental manifestation together with its mantra. // 57

sanskrit_iast:
p. 90) [jīvasya padātpadāntaraprāpaṇakrameṇa dehāt sthūlāt
prabhācakraviśeṣaprāpaṇena kaivalyasthitiprāpaṇam]
meaning:
प्. 90) [जीवस्य पदात्पदान्तरप्रापणक्रमेण देहात् स्थूलात्
प्रभाचक्रविशेषप्रापणेन कैवल्यस्थितिप्रापणम्]
text_mt: p. 90) [Bringing about the state of absolute isolation by leading the individual soul from plane to plane, from the gross body to a specific circle of radiance]

sanskrit_iast:
caitanyaṃ jīvabhūtaṃ yatprasphurattārakopamam |
bhāvanīyaṃ tu viśrāntaṃ nissṛtaṃ bhūtapañjarāt || 58 ||
meaning:
चैतन्यं जीवभूतं यत्प्रस्फुरत्तारकोपमम् |
भावनीयं तु विश्रान्तं निस्सृतं भूतपञ्जरात् || 58 ||
text_mt: The consciousness which is the individual soul, resembling a flashing star, / having emerged from the cage of the elements, is to be contemplated at rest // 58

sanskrit_iast:
niṣprapañce pare mantre pañcaśaktyākhyavigrahe |
anena kramayogena jīvamātmānamātmanā || 59 ||
meaning:
निष्प्रपञ्चे परे मन्त्रे पञ्चशक्त्याख्यविग्रहे |
अनेन क्रमयोगेन जीवमात्मानमात्मना || 59 ||
text_mt: in the unmanifest supreme mantra whose form is called the five powers. / By this sequential practice, [the yogin] by means of the self // 59

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣate(kṣeta ?) taddhṛdākāśe acalaṃ sūryavarcasam |
sphuraddyutisamākīrṇamīśvaraṃ vyāpakaṃ param || 60 ||
meaning:
इक्षते(क्षेत ?) तद्धृदाकाशे अचलं सूर्यवर्चसम् |
स्फुरद्द्युतिसमाकीर्णमीश्वरं व्यापकं परम् || 60 ||
text_mt: should behold the individual soul, the self, in the space of its heart, unmoving, brilliant as the sun, / filled with flashing light, the sovereign, all-pervading, supreme. // 60

sanskrit_iast:
tato mantraśarīrasthaṃ samādhiṃ cābhyasetparam |
paraṃ mantraśarīraṃ yadvyaktamakṣarasantatau || 61 ||
meaning:
ततो मन्त्रशरीरस्थं समाधिं चाभ्यसेत्परम् |
परं मन्त्रशरीरं यद्व्यक्तमक्षरसन्ततौ || 61 ||
text_mt: Then one should also practice supreme absorption residing in the mantra-body, / which supreme mantra-body is manifested in the succession of syllables, // 61

sanskrit_iast:
sūryādivyomaparyantamatītaṃ śaktikāraṇaiḥ |
heyaṃ cetthamidaṃ budhvā yadā tatsthānabṛṃhitaḥ || 62 ||
meaning:
सूर्यादिव्योमपर्यन्तमतीतं शक्तिकारणैः |
हेयं चेत्थमिदं बुध्वा यदा तत्स्थानबृंहितः || 62 ||
text_mt: transcending [all] from the sun up to ether through the causal powers. / Knowing this to be abandoned thus, when reinforced in that place, // 62

sanskrit_iast:
atṛpto'kṛtakṛtyaśca mantrahṛtpadmasevanāt |
ṣaṭpadī(?)hyātmatattvaṃ ca jñānarajvā'valaṃvya ca || 63 ||
meaning:
अतृप्तोऽकृतकृत्यश्च मन्त्रहृत्पद्मसेवनात् |
षट्पदी(?)ह्यात्मतत्त्वं च ज्ञानरज्वाऽवलंव्य च || 63 ||
text_mt: insatiate and unfulfilled, through service to the lotus of the mantra-heart, / [like a bee] clinging to the rope of knowledge and to the self-principle, // 63

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtkoṭarordhvānniryāntaṃ svātmānaṃ svātmanā smaret |
bhārūpānnāḍimārgeṇa mantravahneśśikhā hi sā || 64 ||
meaning:
हृत्कोटरोर्ध्वान्निर्यान्तं स्वात्मानं स्वात्मना स्मरेत् |
भारूपान्नाडिमार्गेण मन्त्रवह्नेश्शिखा हि सा || 64 ||
text_mt: one should recollect one's own self emerging from the upper part of the heart cavity by oneself, / by way of the radiant nāḍī; for that is the flame of the mantra-fire, // 64

sanskrit_iast:
padmasūtrapratīkāśā suṣumnā cordhvagāminī |
tadbrahmarandhragāṃ smṛtvā supathā tena nārada || 65 ||
meaning:
पद्मसूत्रप्रतीकाशा सुषुम्ना चोर्ध्वगामिनी |
तद्ब्रह्मरन्ध्रगां स्मृत्वा सुपथा तेन नारद || 65 ||
text_mt: resembling a lotus fibre, the upward-going suṣumnā. / Recollecting it reaching the aperture of Brahman, along that good path, O Nārada, // 65

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiśśanaissvamātmānaṃ recya vijñānavāyunā |
māntraṃ kāraṇaṣaṭkaṃ ca evamavyāpakaṃ nyaset || 66 ||
meaning:
शनैश्शनैस्स्वमात्मानं रेच्य विज्ञानवायुना |
मान्त्रं कारणषट्कं च एवमव्यापकं न्यसेत् || 66 ||
text_mt: slowly, slowly expelling one's own self by the wind of discernment, / one should thus project the non-pervading group of six mantra-causes. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnuyācca tadūrdhvāttu yaḥ parātprabhuvigrahāt |
uditaṃ (to?) dvijaśārdūla tejaḥpuñjo hyanūpamaḥ || 67 ||
meaning:
प्राप्नुयाच्च तदूर्ध्वात्तु यः परात्प्रभुविग्रहात् |
उदितं (तो?) द्विजशार्दूल तेजःपुञ्जो ह्यनूपमः || 67 ||
text_mt: And above that, one should reach that peerless mass of radiance / which has arisen, O tiger among the twice-born, from the supreme body of the Lord, // 67

sanskrit_iast:
tatprabhācakranābhisthaṃ svānandānandananditam |
evaṃ padātpadasthasya ātmatattvasya nārada || 68 ||
meaning:
तत्प्रभाचक्रनाभिस्थं स्वानन्दानन्दनन्दितम् |
एवं पदात्पदस्थस्य आत्मतत्त्वस्य नारद || 68 ||
text_mt: situated in the navel of that circle of light, rejoicing in the bliss of its own bliss. / Thus, of the self-principle standing from stage to stage, O Nārada, // 68

sanskrit_iast:
tattva(sya ?)nirmuktadehasya kevalasya cidātmanaḥ |
ya udeti mahānandaḥ sā śaktirvaiṣṇavī parā || 69 ||
meaning:
तत्त्व(स्य ?)निर्मुक्तदेहस्य केवलस्य चिदात्मनः |
य उदेति महानन्दः सा शक्तिर्वैष्णवी परा || 69 ||
text_mt: of the isolated self of consciousness whose [gross] body has been cast off, / the great bliss that arises is the supreme Vaiṣṇava power. // 69

sanskrit_iast:
aluptakarmakartāraṃ jīvaṃ kṛtvā tamātmasāt |
yatroditā ca tatraiva punarevāvatiṣṭhate || 70 ||
meaning:
अलुप्तकर्मकर्तारं जीवं कृत्वा तमात्मसात् |
यत्रोदिता च तत्रैव पुनरेवावतिष्ठते || 70 ||
text_mt: Having made that individual soul, whose agency of action is undiminished, her own, / she abides once again in that very place where she arose. // 70

sanskrit_iast: tacca (taṃ ca?) saṅkalpanirmuktamavācyaṃ viddhi nārada |
meaning: तच्च (तं च?) सङ्कल्पनिर्मुक्तमवाच्यं विद्धि नारद |
text_mt: And know that to be free of conceptual construct, ineffable, O Nārada. // 70cd

sanskrit_iast:
p. 91) [tyaktatayā bhāvitasyāsya bhautikadehasya prajvālana
bhasmīkaraṇabhāvanam]
meaning:
प्. 91) [त्यक्ततया भावितस्यास्य भौतिकदेहस्य प्रज्वालन
भस्मीकरणभावनम्]
text_mt: p. 91) [The contemplation of blazing and reducing to ash this elemental body meditated upon as abandoned]

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ svasthānamāsādya tyaktvā bhautaṃ ca vigraham || 71 ||
