meaning: एवं स्वस्थानमासाद्य त्यक्त्वा भौतं च विग्रहम् || 71 ||
text_mt: Having thus attained one's own place and abandoned the elemental body, // 71

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthito dahetpiṇḍaṃ śaktitanmātravarjitam |
ṣāṭkośikamasāraṃ ca nirdagdhatṛṇarūpiṇam || 72 ||
meaning:
तत्र स्थितो दहेत्पिण्डं शक्तितन्मात्रवर्जितम् |
षाट्कोशिकमसारं च निर्दग्धतृणरूपिणम् || 72 ||
text_mt: standing there, one should burn the physical form, deprived of powers and subtle elements, / composed of six sheaths, unsubstantial, resembling burnt straw, // 72

sanskrit_iast:
icchānirmathanotthena mantrajena tu vahninā |
aśeṣabhuvanādhāraṃ caturgatisamanvitam || 73 ||
meaning:
इच्छानिर्मथनोत्थेन मन्त्रजेन तु वह्निना |
अशेषभुवनाधारं चतुर्गतिसमन्वितम् || 73 ||
text_mt: by the fire born of mantra that has arisen from the churning of the will. / [Visualising] the support of all the worlds, accompanied by the four states of existence // 73

sanskrit_iast:
lokeśoparisaṃsthaṃ ca vyomni tasyopari nyaset |
praṇavādinamo'ntaṃ ca icchāgnervācakaḥ svayam || 74 ||
meaning:
लोकेशोपरिसंस्थं च व्योम्नि तस्योपरि न्यसेत् |
प्रणवादिनमोऽन्तं च इच्छाग्नेर्वाचकः स्वयम् || 74 ||
text_mt: and situated above the world-protector, one should install it in the ether above him; / beginning with the praṇava and ending in namaḥ, it is itself expressive of the fire of will. // 74

sanskrit_iast:
tenāṅghrideśādārabhya taṃ piṇḍaṃ jvalitaṃ smaret |
bhasmarāśisamaprakhyaṃ śāntāgniṃ tadanu dvija || 75 ||
meaning:
तेनाङ्घ्रिदेशादारभ्य तं पिण्डं ज्वलितं स्मरेत् |
भस्मराशिसमप्रख्यं शान्ताग्निं तदनु द्विज || 75 ||
text_mt: By means of it, one should visualise that body ablaze starting from the region of the feet; / thereafter, O twice-born one, [visualise] the fire subsided, [the body] resembling a heap of ash. // 75

sanskrit_iast:
sāhlādena ca sūkṣmeṇa vyāpinoṅkārapūrviṇā |
namo'ntena tu tadbhasmapātaṃ dhyātvā'nvitastataḥ || 76 ||
meaning:
साह्लादेन च सूक्ष्मेण व्यापिनोङ्कारपूर्विणा |
नमोऽन्तेन तु तद्भस्मपातं ध्यात्वाऽन्वितस्ततः || 76 ||
text_mt: And with the blissful, subtle [mantra], preceded by the all-pervading Oṃ / and ending in namaḥ, one should then, concentrated, meditate upon the fall of that ash. // 76

sanskrit_iast: [bhasmāvaśeṣatayā bhāvitasya samāplāvanabhāvanā]
meaning: [भस्मावशेषतया भावितस्य समाप्लावनभावना]
text_mt: [The contemplation of flooding [the body] meditated upon as reduced to ash]

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānajenodakenātha bhūtiṃ saṃplāvya diggatām |
vinipātātsvamantreṇa siktena kṣīrarūpiṇā || 77 ||
meaning:
ध्यानजेनोदकेनाथ भूतिं संप्लाव्य दिग्गताम् |
विनिपातात्स्वमन्त्रेण सिक्तेन क्षीररूपिणा || 77 ||
text_mt: Then, having flooded the ash that has dispersed in all directions with water born of meditation, / sprinkled by its descent by its own mantra in the form of milk, // 77

sanskrit_iast: [athāpūrvatejomayaśarīrasṛṣṭibhāvanākramaḥ]
meaning: [अथापूर्वतेजोमयशरीरसृष्टिभावनाक्रमः]
text_mt: [Now, the sequence of contemplation for the creation of an unprecedented body composed of light]

sanskrit_iast:
varāhamamṛtārūḍhaṃ trailokyaiśvaryadānvitam |
dīpakaṃ dvitayenaitatsaṃpuṭīkṛtya pūrvavat || 78 ||
meaning:
वराहममृतारूढं त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदान्वितम् |
दीपकं द्वितयेनैतत्संपुटीकृत्य पूर्ववत् || 78 ||
text_mt: [one should use] the boar mounted on nectar, endowed with sovereignty over the three worlds; / having enclosed this illuminator with the two, as before, // 78

sanskrit_iast:
tena kṣīrārṇavākārāddhyāyedviśvaṃ carācaram |
pātyamānaṃ tadūrdhve tu dhārāsaṅgho dvijāmṛtaḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
तेन क्षीरार्णवाकाराद्ध्यायेद्विश्वं चराचरम् |
पात्यमानं तदूर्ध्वे तु धारासङ्घो द्विजामृतः || 79 ||
text_mt: one should meditate upon the whole moving and unmoving universe [as born] from the form of the ocean of milk. / Falling above it, O twice-born one, an immortal shower of streams, // 79

sanskrit_iast:
turyasthānādviniṣkrānto bhāvanīyo muhurmuhuḥ |
tatrādhāramayīṃ śaktiṃ madhye vinyasya vaiṣṇavīm || 80 ||
meaning:
तुर्यस्थानाद्विनिष्क्रान्तो भावनीयो मुहुर्मुहुः |
तत्राधारमयीं शक्तिं मध्ये विन्यस्य वैष्णवीम् || 80 ||
text_mt: issuing forth from the fourth state, is to be contemplated again and again. / Installing in its centre the Vaiṣṇava power whose essence is support, // 80

sanskrit_iast:
bījabhūtāṃ ca sarvasya tadutthaṃ cāmbujaṃ smaret |
ṣaḍadhvatattvabhūtaṃ ca sitaṃ tejomayaṃ śubham || 81 ||
meaning:
बीजभूतां च सर्वस्य तदुत्थं चाम्बुजं स्मरेत् |
षडध्वतत्त्वभूतं च सितं तेजोमयं शुभम् || 81 ||
text_mt: which is the seed of all, one should recollect the lotus arising from it, / consisting of the principles of the six paths, white, composed of light, auspicious, // 81

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalatritayākīrṇaṃ spuratkiraṇabhāsvaram |
mantrātmānaṃ ca tanmadhye dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 82 ||
meaning:
मण्डलत्रितयाकीर्णं स्पुरत्किरणभास्वरम् |
मन्त्रात्मानं च तन्मध्ये ध्यायेन्नारायणं प्रभुम् || 82 ||
text_mt: filled with the three circles, resplendent with flashing rays. / In the centre of it, one should meditate upon Lord Nārāyaṇa whose essence is mantra, // 82

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkalaṃ kevalaṃ śuddhaṃ pañcasanmantravigraham |
tanmantraśaktibhirbhūyo mūrcchitaṃ bhāvayeddvija || 83 ||
meaning:
निष्कलं केवलं शुद्धं पञ्चसन्मन्त्रविग्रहम् |
तन्मन्त्रशक्तिभिर्भूयो मूर्च्छितं भावयेद्द्विज || 83 ||
text_mt: partless, solitary, pure, whose body is the five noble mantras. / O twice-born one, one should contemplate him further suffused with the powers of that mantra, // 83

sanskrit_iast:
vyomādipañcabhūtīyaṃ mantramīśvarapañcakam |
p. 92) tebhyo'tha prasarantaṃ ca vyomādyaṃ vibhavaṃ smaret || 84 ||
meaning:
व्योमादिपञ्चभूतीयं मन्त्रमीश्वरपञ्चकम् |
प्. 92) तेभ्योऽथ प्रसरन्तं च व्योमाद्यं विभवं स्मरेत् || 84 ||
text_mt: the pentad of lords, the mantras of the five elements beginning with ether. / p. 92) Then one should recollect the manifestation beginning with ether spreading forth from them. // 84

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyogajanitaṃ piṇḍaṃ dhyāyedvibhavapañjarāt |
sahasrasūryasaṅkāśaṃ śatacandragabhastimat || 85 ||
meaning:
संयोगजनितं पिण्डं ध्यायेद्विभवपञ्जरात् |
सहस्रसूर्यसङ्काशं शतचन्द्रगभस्तिमत् || 85 ||
text_mt: From the cage of manifestation, one should meditate upon a body produced by their union, / resembling a thousand suns, possessing the rays of a hundred moons, // 85

sanskrit_iast:
nirmalasphaṭikaprakhyaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam |
janitvaivaṃ sapiṇḍaṃ tu paramaṃ bhogamokṣayoḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
निर्मलस्फटिकप्रख्यं जरामरणवर्जितम् |
जनित्वैवं सपिण्डं तु परमं भोगमोक्षयोः || 86 ||
text_mt: resembling spotless crystal, free from old age and death. / Having thus generated that body, the supreme instrument // 86

sanskrit_iast:
sādhanaṃ muniśārdūla sahajaṃ sarvadehinām |
tamāsādya krameṇaivaṃ sisṛkṣālakṣaṇena ca || 87 ||
meaning:
साधनं मुनिशार्दूल सहजं सर्वदेहिनाम् |
तमासाद्य क्रमेणैवं सिसृक्षालक्षणेन च || 87 ||
text_mt: of enjoyment and liberation, O tiger among sages, innate to all embodied beings, / having reached it in this sequential manner and characterised by the desire to emit, // 87

sanskrit_iast: svapādānnistaraṅgācca kṛtvā śaktyā sahodayam |
meaning: स्वपादान्निस्तरङ्गाच्च कृत्वा शक्त्या सहोदयम् |
text_mt: having caused its rising together with power from its own waveless state, // 87cd

sanskrit_iast: [jīvasya sṛṣṭe śarīre praveśanakramaḥ]
meaning: [जीवस्य सृष्टे शरीरे प्रवेशनक्रमः]
text_mt: [The sequence of introducing the individual soul into the created body]

sanskrit_iast: svānandaṃ ca mahānandātsvanantāccāśrayettataḥ || 88 ||
meaning: स्वानन्दं च महानन्दात्स्वनन्ताच्चाश्रयेत्ततः || 88 ||
text_mt: one should then resort to one's own bliss from the great bliss and from the infinite self. // 88

sanskrit_iast:
mārīcaṃ nābhasaṃ cakraṃ tasmādrūpaṃ svakaṃ ca yat |
sūryakoṭikarābhāsaṃ praspurantaṃ svabhāsasā || 89 ||
meaning:
मारीचं नाभसं चक्रं तस्माद्रूपं स्वकं च यत् |
सूर्यकोटिकराभासं प्रस्पुरन्तं स्वभाससा || 89 ||
text_mt: From that solar and ethereal circle, one's own form, / which shines like the rays of ten million suns, flashing with its own brilliance, // 89

sanskrit_iast:
kadambagolakākāraṃ niśāmbukaṇanirmalam |
evamātmānamānīya svasthānātsvātmanā dvija || 90 ||
meaning:
कदम्बगोलकाकारं निशाम्बुकणनिर्मलम् |
एवमात्मानमानीय स्वस्थानात्स्वात्मना द्विज || 90 ||
text_mt: round like a kadamba flower, spotless as a drop of night dew— / having thus brought the self from its own place by oneself, O twice-born one, // 90

sanskrit_iast:
viśenmantraśarīraṃ svaṃ brahmarandhreṇa pūrvavat |
jyotsnānāḍīpathenaiva puryaṣṭakakajāntaram (?) || 91 ||
meaning:
विशेन्मन्त्रशरीरं स्वं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण पूर्ववत् |
ज्योत्स्नानाडीपथेनैव पुर्यष्टककजान्तरम् (?) || 91 ||
text_mt: one should enter one's own mantra-body through the aperture of Brahman as before, / by the path of the moonlight nāḍī, into the midst of the subtle body, // 91

sanskrit_iast: svavācakaṃ bhāvayanvai dhvaninā niṣkalena tu |
meaning: स्ववाचकं भावयन्वै ध्वनिना निष्कलेन तु |
text_mt: contemplating its expressive sound with partless resonance. // 91cd

sanskrit_iast: [ātmamantraḥ]
meaning: [आत्ममन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: aśeṣabhuvanādhāraṃ viśvāpyāyakareṇa tu || 92 ||
meaning: अशेषभुवनाधारं विश्वाप्यायकरेण तु || 92 ||
text_mt: The support of all worlds, which causes the universe to thrive, // 92

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkayedamṛtākhyaṃ ca tadante cātmane namaḥ |
sa tārakastvayaṃ mantro vijñeyo hyātmavācakaḥ || 93 ||
meaning:
अङ्कयेदमृताख्यं च तदन्ते चात्मने नमः |
स तारकस्त्वयं मन्त्रो विज्ञेयो ह्यात्मवाचकः || 93 ||
text_mt: one should mark with that called amṛta, and at the end of it, 'ātmane namaḥ.' / This is the saving mantra, to be known indeed as expressive of the self. // 93

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu niṣkalo mantro yāvadbhānuṃ ca vigrahaḥ |
pañcakaṃ cābhimānaṃ tu āsādyālokavigraham || 94 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु निष्कलो मन्त्रो यावद्भानुं च विग्रहः |
पञ्चकं चाभिमानं तु आसाद्यालोकविग्रहम् || 94 ||
text_mt: Then the partless mantra, up to the sun, is the body; / and reaching the pentad of ego-sense, [forming] a body of light, // 94

sanskrit_iast:
svamantrādamṛtaughena secayedvigrahaṃ svakam |
tatassvatantraṃ taṃ bimbamākṛṣya hṛdi vinyaset || 95 ||
meaning:
स्वमन्त्रादमृतौघेन सेचयेद्विग्रहं स्वकम् |
ततस्स्वतन्त्रं तं बिम्बमाकृष्य हृदि विन्यसेत् || 95 ||
text_mt: one should sprinkle one's own body with the flood of nectar from one's own mantra. / Then, drawing forth that autonomous reflection, one should install it in the heart. // 95

sanskrit_iast:
nistaraṅgā parā śaktirmahānandamayī ca sā |
svānandācca prabhācakraṃ rūpamātmīyabhāsvaram || 96 ||
meaning:
निस्तरङ्गा परा शक्तिर्महानन्दमयी च सा |
स्वानन्दाच्च प्रभाचक्रं रूपमात्मीयभास्वरम् || 96 ||
text_mt: The motionless supreme power consists of great bliss, / and from its own bliss [arises] the circle of light, its radiant self-form. // 96

sanskrit_iast:
sauṣumnastādṛśo mārgaḥ piṇḍamantraśca niṣkalaḥ |
p. 93) śaktyādyo mantrasaṅgho'tha dhāraṇeśvarapañcakam || 97 ||
meaning:
सौषुम्नस्तादृशो मार्गः पिण्डमन्त्रश्च निष्कलः |
प्. 93) शक्त्याद्यो मन्त्रसङ्घोऽथ धारणेश्वरपञ्चकम् || 97 ||
text_mt: Such is the path of the suṣumnā, and the partless piṇḍamantra; / then the multitude of mantras beginning with Śakti, and the five lords of dhāraṇā. // 97

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ vibhavasaṅgho yaḥ piṇḍastatsāmudāyikaḥ |
smarejjvālīkṛtaṃ sarvamapṛthakca pṛthak sthitam || 98 ||
meaning:
तेषां विभवसङ्घो यः पिण्डस्तत्सामुदायिकः |
स्मरेज्ज्वालीकृतं सर्वमपृथक्च पृथक् स्थितम् || 98 ||
text_mt: The multitude of their manifestations is the aggregate piṇḍa. / One should contemplate all of it as blazing, existing both undivided and divided. // 98

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlasūkṣmaparākhyena trividhena tu nārada |
karaṇenoditā samyakśuddhireṣā ca bhautikī || 99 ||
meaning:
स्थूलसूक्ष्मपराख्येन त्रिविधेन तु नारद |
करणेनोदिता सम्यक्शुद्धिरेषा च भौतिकी || 99 ||
text_mt: By means of the three instruments called gross, subtle, and supreme, O Nārada, / this purification consisting of the elements has been fully declared. // 99

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktastvaṃ bhāvitātmā ca sthirabuddhiratandritaḥ |
priyo'pi me yathā tena sarahasyā prakīrtitā || 100 ||
meaning:
भक्तस्त्वं भावितात्मा च स्थिरबुद्धिरतन्द्रितः |
प्रियोऽपि मे यथा तेन सरहस्या प्रकीर्तिता || 100 ||
text_mt: Because you are a devotee whose self is cultivated, of firm intellect, and untiring, / and dear to me, it has been proclaimed with its secret. // 100

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tvaṃ mayi viprendra tvayyevaṃ yo bhaviṣyati |
tasyedaṃ prakaṭīkuryānnetarasyādharasya ca || 101 ||
meaning:
यथा त्वं मयि विप्रेन्द्र त्वय्येवं यो भविष्यति |
तस्येदं प्रकटीकुर्यान्नेतरस्याधरस्य च || 101 ||
text_mt: As you are toward me, O best of the twice-born, whoever will be thus toward you— / to him one should reveal this, and not to another who is inferior. // 101

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ bhavaharaṃ puṇyaṃ samādhiṃ bhūtaśuddhidam |
kevalaṃ yassamabhyasyetsa yāti brahma śāśvatam || 102 ||
meaning:
परं भवहरं पुण्यं समाधिं भूतशुद्धिदम् |
केवलं यस्समभ्यस्येत्स याति ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् || 102 ||
text_mt: Whoever solely practices this supreme, merit-yielding samādhi that removes worldly existence / and grants purification of the elements, goes to eternal Brahman. // 102

sanskrit_iast:
anena kiṃ punarvipra cittaṃ vigrahasaṃyutam |
saṃstutya yo yajeddevaṃ bhāvitātmā prasannadhīḥ || 103 ||
meaning:
अनेन किं पुनर्विप्र चित्तं विग्रहसंयुतम् |
संस्तुत्य यो यजेद्देवं भावितात्मा प्रसन्नधीः || 103 ||
text_mt: What need to say more, O twice-born, of him whose mind is united with the divine form, / who praises and worships the God, cultivated in self and of tranquil mind? // 103

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ samādhikhyāpanaṃ nāma
daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां समाधिख्यापनं नाम
दशमः पटलः || 10 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the tenth chapter, called 'Declaration of Samādhi', in the venerable Pāñcarātra Jayākhyasaṃhitā. // 10

sanskrit_iast: atha mantranyāsavidhirnāma ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: अथ मन्त्रन्यासविधिर्नाम एकादशः पटलः
text_mt: Now the eleventh chapter, called 'The Rule for Installation of Mantras'.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃśuddhavigraho mantrī mantranyāsaṃ samācaret |
yena vinyastamātreṇa devadevasamo bhavet || 1 ||
meaning:
संशुद्धविग्रहो मन्त्री मन्त्रन्यासं समाचरेत् |
येन विन्यस्तमात्रेण देवदेवसमो भवेत् || 1 ||
text_mt: One whose body is fully purified, knowing mantras, should perform installation of mantras, / by the mere installation of which he becomes equal to the God of gods. // 1

sanskrit_iast:
pūjādau sarvakāryāṇāmadhikāraśca jāyate |
bhavedvai sarvasiddhīnāmāvirbhāvastu yena ca || 2 ||
meaning:
पूजादौ सर्वकार्याणामधिकारश्च जायते |
भवेद्वै सर्वसिद्धीनामाविर्भावस्तु येन च || 2 ||
text_mt: And eligibility arises for all rites, beginning with worship; / and through it indeed comes the manifestation of all siddhis. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ kṛtvā nirbhayastiṣṭheddeśe duṣṭasamākule |
vijayaścāpamṛtyūnāṃ syādyena vihitena ca || 3 ||
meaning:
यं कृत्वा निर्भयस्तिष्ठेद्देशे दुष्टसमाकुले |
विजयश्चापमृत्यूनां स्याद्येन विहितेन च || 3 ||
text_mt: Having performed it, one remains fearless in a place teeming with the wicked, / and by its execution, victory over untimely deaths is achieved. // 3

sanskrit_iast: [āsanaparikalpanam]
meaning: [आसनपरिकल्पनम्]

sanskrit_iast:
kṣitāvupari vinyāsaṃ yatpurā phalakoditam |
tasmiṃścopari vinyāsaṃ samudraṃ padmasaṃyutam || 4 ||
meaning:
क्षितावुपरि विन्यासं यत्पुरा फलकोदितम् |
तस्मिंश्चोपरि विन्यासं समुद्रं पद्मसंयुतम् || 4 ||
text_mt: Upon the ground, the installation on a wooden board was described previously; / and above it, the installation of the ocean along with the lotus, // 4

sanskrit_iast:
svena svena tu mantreṇa dhyānayuktena yatnavān |
tārkṣyaṃ caiva tato nyasya dhyātvā copaviśettataḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
स्वेन स्वेन तु मन्त्रेण ध्यानयुक्तेन यत्नवान् |
तार्क्ष्यं चैव ततो न्यस्य ध्यात्वा चोपविशेत्ततः || 5 ||
text_mt: with each its own mantra, accompanied by meditation, the zealous practitioner [performs]; / then, having installed Tārkṣya and meditated, he should then sit down. // 5

sanskrit_iast: [āsanādbahiḥ prākāraparikalpanam]
meaning: [आसनाद्बहिः प्राकारपरिकल्पनम्]
text_mt: [Constructing the rampart outside the seat]

sanskrit_iast:
diśo virecya cāstreṇa punareva muhurmuhuḥ |
p. 94) śarajālopamaṃ smṛtvā prākāraṃ cāsanādbahiḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
दिशो विरेच्य चास्त्रेण पुनरेव मुहुर्मुहुः |
प्. 94) शरजालोपमं स्मृत्वा प्राकारं चासनाद्बहिः || 6 ||
text_mt: Clearing the directions with the weapon repeatedly, again and again, / and contemplating a rampart resembling a network of arrows outside the seat, // 6

sanskrit_iast:
saprākāraṃ tu saṃsthānaṃ kavacenāvakuṇṭhayet |
jvalatkañcukarūpeṇa
meaning:
सप्राकारं तु संस्थानं कवचेनावकुण्ठयेत् |
ज्वलत्कञ्चुकरूपेण
text_mt: he should veil the location together with the rampart with the armour, / in the form of a blazing coat of mail,

sanskrit_iast: [nyāsaprayojanam]
meaning: [न्यासप्रयोजनम्]

sanskrit_iast: yathā siddhādiṣu dvija || 7 ||
meaning: यथा सिद्धादिषु द्विज || 7 ||
text_mt: so that, O twice-born, among siddhas and the like // 7

sanskrit_iast:
gaganastheṣvadṛśyaḥ syādācarennyāsamātmanaḥ |
aguptasya yato vīryaṃ mantrajasyāharanti te || 8 ||
meaning:
गगनस्थेष्वदृश्यः स्यादाचरेन्न्यासमात्मनः |
अगुप्तस्य यतो वीर्यं मन्त्रजस्याहरन्ति ते || 8 ||
text_mt: dwelling in the sky, he becomes invisible; he should perform the installation on himself, / since they steal away the power born of mantras from one who is unprotected. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādanena vidhinā tvādau guptiṃ samācaret |
hastanyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā dehanyāsaṃ samācaret || 9 ||
meaning:
तस्मादनेन विधिना त्वादौ गुप्तिं समाचरेत् |
हस्तन्यासं पुरा कृत्वा देहन्यासं समाचरेत् || 9 ||
text_mt: Therefore, by this procedure, one should first effect protection: / having first performed installation on the hands, one should perform installation on the body. // 9

sanskrit_iast: [hastanyāsaḥ]
meaning: [हस्तन्यासः]

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhe mūlamantraṃ tu mūrtimantrasamanvitam |
evameva krameṇaiva tarjanyādiṣu devatāḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठे मूलमन्त्रं तु मूर्तिमन्त्रसमन्वितम् |
एवमेव क्रमेणैव तर्जन्यादिषु देवताः || 10 ||
text_mt: On the thumb, the root-mantra together with the mantra of the form; / just so in order, the deities on the index and the other [fingers], // 10

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhāntāsu vai sarvā nyasya cāṅgāni yojayet |
kaniṣṭhikādyāsu tato hṛdayādīnyanukramāt || 11 ||
meaning:
कनिष्ठान्तासु वै सर्वा न्यस्य चाङ्गानि योजयेत् |
कनिष्ठिकाद्यासु ततो हृदयादीन्यनुक्रमात् || 11 ||
text_mt: ending with the little finger; having installed all of them, one should assign the limbs: / then on [the fingers] beginning with the little finger, the heart and the rest in order, // 11

sanskrit_iast:
astramaṅguṣṭhake yāvatkarāgreṣu ca locanam |
nṛsihmaṃ dakṣiṇe haste vāme ca kapilaṃ nyaset || 12 ||
meaning:
अस्त्रमङ्गुष्ठके यावत्कराग्रेषु च लोचनम् |
नृसिह्मं दक्षिणे हस्ते वामे च कपिलं न्यसेत् || 12 ||
text_mt: up to the weapon on the thumb, and the eye on the fingertips. / One should install Nṛsiṃha on the right hand and Kapila on the left; // 12

sanskrit_iast:
vāmahastādi cobhābhyāṃ varāhaṃ cāṅgulīṣu ca |
kaustubhaṃ dakṣiṇatale vanamālāṃ tathā'pare || 13 ||
meaning:
वामहस्तादि चोभाभ्यां वराहं चाङ्गुलीषु च |
कौस्तुभं दक्षिणतले वनमालां तथाऽपरे || 13 ||
text_mt: and Varāha on the fingers with both, beginning with the left hand; / the Kaustubha on the right palm, and the forest garland on the other; // 13

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe madhyataḥ padmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ vāmatale nyaset |
anantāraṃ ca tatraiva cakramastraṃ mahāprabham || 14 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणे मध्यतः पद्मं शङ्खं वामतले न्यसेत् |
अनन्तारं च तत्रैव चक्रमस्त्रं महाप्रभम् || 14 ||
text_mt: the lotus in the middle of the right [palm], and the conch on the left palm; / and right there the weapon-discus of endless spokes and great radiance; // 14

sanskrit_iast:
gadāṃ ca dakṣiṇe haste jvalantīṃ svena tejasā |
aṅguṣṭhāddakṣiṇādādau vāmāntaṃ mūladeśataḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
गदां च दक्षिणे हस्ते ज्वलन्तीं स्वेन तेजसा |
अङ्गुष्ठाद्दक्षिणादादौ वामान्तं मूलदेशतः || 15 ||
text_mt: and the mace blazing with its own splendour in the right hand. / Beginning from the right thumb up to the left, from the base, // 15

sanskrit_iast:
gāruḍaṃ vinyasenmantraṃ daśasvaṅguliṣu kramāt |
vāmahastatale pāśamaṅkuśaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā || 16 ||
meaning:
गारुडं विन्यसेन्मन्त्रं दशस्वङ्गुलिषु क्रमात् |
वामहस्ततले पाशमङ्कुशं दक्षिणे तथा || 16 ||
text_mt: one should install the Gāruḍa mantra on the ten fingers in order. / On the left palm the noose, and likewise the goad on the right; // 16

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa hṛdayādyena ubhayorhastayornyaset |
satyādi cāniruddhāntamaupāṅgaṃ bījapañcakam || 17 ||
meaning:
क्रमेण हृदयाद्येन उभयोर्हस्तयोर्न्यसेत् |
सत्यादि चानिरुद्धान्तमौपाङ्गं बीजपञ्चकम् || 17 ||
text_mt: in order, beginning with the heart, one should install on both hands / the pentad of subordinate seed-syllables beginning with Satya and ending with Aniruddha. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
nakhādyāmaṇibandhāntaṃ kṛtsne pāṇiyuge tataḥ |
nyasetsaptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ sarvamantropari sthitam || 18 ||
meaning:
नखाद्यामणिबन्धान्तं कृत्स्ने पाणियुगे ततः |
न्यसेत्सप्ताक्षरं मन्त्रं सर्वमन्त्रोपरि स्थितम् || 18 ||
text_mt: Then, from the nails up to the wrists on the entire pair of hands, / one should install the seven-syllable mantra that stands above all mantras. // 18

sanskrit_iast: anena vidhinā pūrvaṃ hastanyāsaṃ samācaret |
meaning: अनेन विधिना पूर्वं हस्तन्यासं समाचरेत् |
text_mt: By this rule one should first perform installation on the hands.

sanskrit_iast: [dehanyāsāddhastanyāsasya prāthamye kāraṇam]
meaning: [देहन्यासाद्धस्तन्यासस्य प्राथम्ये कारणम्]
text_mt: [Reason for the precedence of installation on the hands over that on the body]

sanskrit_iast: p. 95) vaibhavī paramā śaktirhṛccakrakuharāntagā || 19 ||
meaning: प्. 95) वैभवी परमा शक्तिर्हृच्चक्रकुहरान्तगा || 19 ||
text_mt: The supreme manifesting power situated within the hollow of the heart-cakra, // 19

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyaṃ rūpamāsthāya daśadhā saṃvyavasthitā |
icchayā svapravāheṇa pāṇimārgeṇa nirgatāḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
वायव्यं रूपमास्थाय दशधा संव्यवस्थिता |
इच्छया स्वप्रवाहेण पाणिमार्गेण निर्गताः || 20 ||
text_mt: assuming an airy form, is stationed in tenfold manner; / by its own will, through its own flow, [these] have gone forth along the path of the hands; // 20

sanskrit_iast:
nāḍīdaśakamāśritya tā evāṅgulayo matāḥ |
ata eva dvijaśreṣṭha śaktyākhye prabhuvigrahe || 21 ||
meaning:
नाडीदशकमाश्रित्य ता एवाङ्गुलयो मताः |
अत एव द्विजश्रेष्ठ शक्त्याख्ये प्रभुविग्रहे || 21 ||
text_mt: resorting to the ten nāḍīs, they are regarded as the fingers themselves. / For this very reason, O best of the twice-born, on the Lord's body called Power, // 21

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaṃ mantragaṇaṃ nyasya tato bhūtamaye nyaset |
meaning: पूर्वं मन्त्रगणं न्यस्य ततो भूतमये न्यसेत् |
text_mt: having first installed the collection of mantras, one should then install it on the elemental one.

sanskrit_iast: [dehanyāsaḥ]
meaning: [देहन्यासः]

sanskrit_iast: vigrahe mantrasaṅghātaṃ yathāvadavadhāraya || 22 ||
meaning: विग्रहे मन्त्रसङ्घातं यथावदवधारय || 22 ||
text_mt: Comprehend properly the assemblage of mantras on the body: // 22

sanskrit_iast:
āmūrdhnaścaraṇāntaṃ ca mūlamantraṃ purā tanau |
vyāpakatvena vinyasya pādādbhūyaśśiro'ntimam || 23 ||
meaning:
आमूर्ध्नश्चरणान्तं च मूलमन्त्रं पुरा तनौ |
व्यापकत्वेन विन्यस्य पादाद्भूयश्शिरोऽन्तिमम् || 23 ||
text_mt: First having installed the root-mantra pervasively on the body from head to feet, / then again from the feet ending at the head, // 23

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtimantreṇa vai kuryānnyāsaṃ sarvāṅgakaṃ tataḥ |
mūrdhni vaktre'sayugme ca kramātsavyetare hṛdi || 24 ||
meaning:
मूर्तिमन्त्रेण वै कुर्यान्न्यासं सर्वाङ्गकं ततः |
मूर्ध्नि वक्त्रेऽसयुग्मे च क्रमात्सव्येतरे हृदि || 24 ||
text_mt: one should perform the installation on all limbs with the mantra of the form: / on the head, mouth, and pair of shoulders, in order on the right and other [side], on the heart, // 24

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭhe nābhau tathā kaṭyāṃ jānunoratha pādayoḥ |
krameṇa hāvasānaṃ ca nādyaṃ dvādaśavarṇakam || 25 ||
meaning:
पृष्ठे नाभौ तथा कट्यां जानुनोरथ पादयोः |
क्रमेण हावसानं च नाद्यं द्वादशवर्णकम् || 25 ||
text_mt: on the back, on the navel, and on the hips, on the two knees, and then on the two feet; / ending in 'ha' and beginning with 'na', the twelve-syllabled [mantra] in order. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
mūrttimantraṃ tu vinyasya devatāṃ tu tato nyaset |
vāmaskandhe tathā lakṣmīṃ kīrtiṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset || 26 ||
meaning:
मूर्त्तिमन्त्रं तु विन्यस्य देवतां तु ततो न्यसेत् |
वामस्कन्धे तथा लक्ष्मीं कीर्तिं दक्षिणतो न्यसेत् || 26 ||
text_mt: Having installed the mantra of the form, one should then install the deities: / Lakṣmī on the left shoulder, and Kīrti on the right; // 26

sanskrit_iast:
jayāṃ dakṣiṇapāṇisthāṃ māyāṃ vāme tathā nyaset |
hṛdayādīni cāṅgāni vinyasettadanantaram || 27 ||
meaning:
जयां दक्षिणपाणिस्थां मायां वामे तथा न्यसेत् |
हृदयादीनि चाङ्गानि विन्यसेत्तदनन्तरम् || 27 ||
text_mt: Jayā residing on the right hand, and likewise Māyā on the left. / Immediately thereafter one should install the limbs, the heart and the rest: // 27

sanskrit_iast:
stanāntare tu hṛnmantraṃ śiromantraṃ ca mūrdhani |
cūḍikāṃ ca śikhāsthāne skandhayoḥ kavacaṃ tataḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
स्तनान्तरे तु हृन्मन्त्रं शिरोमन्त्रं च मूर्धनि |
चूडिकां च शिखास्थाने स्कन्धयोः कवचं ततः || 28 ||
text_mt: the heart-mantra between the breasts, and the head-mantra on the head; / the crest-mantra at the place of the tuft, then the armour on the two shoulders; // 28

sanskrit_iast:
netrābhyāṃ vinyasennetramastraṃ pāṇitale dvija |
nṛsihmaṃ dakṣiṇe śrotre kapilañca kṛvāṭike || 29 ||
meaning:
नेत्राभ्यां विन्यसेन्नेत्रमस्त्रं पाणितले द्विज |
नृसिह्मं दक्षिणे श्रोत्रे कपिलञ्च कृवाटिके || 29 ||
text_mt: with both eyes one should install the eye[-mantra], and the weapon[-mantra] on the palms, O twice-born; / Nṛsiṃha on the right ear, and Kapila on the nape of the neck; // 29

sanskrit_iast:
vāmaśrotrāvadhau nyasya vārāhaṃ mantranāyakam |
vakṣasaḥ kaustubhaṃ madhye kaṇṭhe ca vanamālikām || 30 ||
meaning:
वामश्रोत्रावधौ न्यस्य वाराहं मन्त्रनायकम् |
वक्षसः कौस्तुभं मध्ये कण्ठे च वनमालिकाम् || 30 ||
text_mt: having installed the sovereign mantra of Varāha at the left ear, / the Kaustubha in the middle of the chest, and the forest garland on the neck; // 30

sanskrit_iast:
padmādīṃśca tataḥ prāgvadūrubhyāmantare dvija |
garuḍākhyaṃ mahāmantramathopāṅgaṃ gaṇaṃ nyaset || 31 ||
meaning:
पद्मादींश्च ततः प्राग्वदूरुभ्यामन्तरे द्विज |
गरुडाख्यं महामन्त्रमथोपाङ्गं गणं न्यसेत् || 31 ||
text_mt: and then the lotus and the rest between the thighs as before, O twice-born; / then one should install the great mantra called Garuḍa, and the group of subordinate limbs: // 31

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa vā'niruddhena prathamaṃ dvijasattama |
pādayorvastiśīrṣa ca nābhau hṛdi śikhāvadhau || 32 ||
meaning:
क्रमेण वाऽनिरुद्धेन प्रथमं द्विजसत्तम |
पादयोर्वस्तिशीर्ष च नाभौ हृदि शिखावधौ || 32 ||
text_mt: or in order, beginning first with Aniruddha, O best of the twice-born, / on the feet, the bladder, the head, the navel, the heart, up to the tuft. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
p. 96) satyādyena krameṇaiva bhūyastatpañcakaṃ nyaset |
brahmaraṃdhrāntare caiva hṛnmadhye nābhipuṣkare || 33 ||
meaning:
प्. 96) सत्याद्येन क्रमेणैव भूयस्तत्पञ्चकं न्यसेत् |
ब्रह्मरंध्रान्तरे चैव हृन्मध्ये नाभिपुष्करे || 33 ||
text_mt: In the order beginning with Satya, one should install that pentad again: / in the aperture of Brahman, in the middle of the heart, in the lotus of the navel, // 33

sanskrit_iast:
nābhimeḍhrāntare caiva pādayoḥ kramayogataḥ |
yojayecca tato dehe āmūrdhnaśca tanutravat || 34 ||
meaning:
नाभिमेढ्रान्तरे चैव पादयोः क्रमयोगतः |
योजयेच्च ततो देहे आमूर्ध्नश्च तनुत्रवत् || 34 ||
text_mt: between the navel and the penis, and on the feet, through the application of order; / and then one should apply it to the body up to the head like a coat of mail. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
saptākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
sarve mantrāstadantasthāsteṣāmantagartaśca saḥ || 35 ||
meaning:
सप्ताक्षरं महामन्त्रं विष्णुं नारायणं प्रभुम् |
सर्वे मन्त्रास्तदन्तस्थास्तेषामन्तगर्तश्च सः || 35 ||
text_mt: The seven-syllabled great mantra is Lord Viṣṇu Nārāyaṇa; / all mantras abide within it, and it resides within them. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
asyaiva mantrasaṅghasya paramaṃ karaṇañca saḥ |
sarveṣāṃ vartate mūrdhni tasmātsarvopari nyaset || 36 ||
meaning:
अस्यैव मन्त्रसङ्घस्य परमं करणञ्च सः |
सर्वेषां वर्तते मूर्ध्नि तस्मात्सर्वोपरि न्यसेत् || 36 ||
text_mt: And it is the supreme cause of this very host of mantras; / it stands at the head of all; therefore, one should install it above all. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
śakticakraṃ hṛdannābhiṃ(?)nānā tu munisattama |
nyastamātreṇa vai tena sandhānamupadyate || 37 ||
meaning:
शक्तिचक्रं हृदन्नाभिं(?)नाना तु मुनिसत्तम |
न्यस्तमात्रेण वै तेन सन्धानमुपद्यते || 37 ||
text_mt: The wheel of Śakti [is in] the heart and navel [...] variously, O best of sages; / as soon as it is installed, unification indeed arises. // 37

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ nyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā karayorvigrahe tataḥ |
meaning: एवं न्यासं पुरा कृत्वा करयोर्विग्रहे ततः |
text_mt: Having thus performed the installation first on the two hands, then on the body, // 38ab

sanskrit_iast: [tattanmudrāpradarśanam]
meaning: [तत्तन्मुद्राप्रदर्शनम्]
text_mt: [Display of the respective mudrās]

sanskrit_iast: mūlamantrādisarvasya nyastamantragaṇasya ca || 38 ||
meaning: मूलमन्त्रादिसर्वस्य न्यस्तमन्त्रगणस्य च || 38 ||
text_mt: for all [mantras] beginning with the root-mantra, and for the installed host of mantras, // 38cd

sanskrit_iast: mudrāṃ pradarśayetsvāṃ svāṃ mantranyāsasamanvitām |
meaning: मुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत्स्वां स्वां मन्त्रन्याससमन्विताम् |
text_mt: one should display each respective mudrā, accompanied by the installation of mantras. // 39ab

sanskrit_iast: [sādhakena kartavyadhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [साधकेन कर्तव्यध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Manner of meditation to be performed by the practitioner]

sanskrit_iast: tatassavigrahaṃ dhyāyedātmānaṃ viṣṇurūpiṇam || 39 ||
meaning: ततस्सविग्रहं ध्यायेदात्मानं विष्णुरूपिणम् || 39 ||
text_mt: Then, having assumed a form, one should meditate upon oneself as having the nature of Viṣṇu, // 39cd

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktadhyānayogena ṣāṅguṇyamahimāvṛtam |
svarūpaṃ viśvarūpaṃ vā yathābhimatarūpakam || 40 ||
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तध्यानयोगेन षाङ्गुण्यमहिमावृतम् |
स्वरूपं विश्वरूपं वा यथाभिमतरूपकम् || 40 ||
text_mt: through the meditation taught previously, surrounded by the greatness of the six qualities, / either in his essential form, in his universal form, or in any form one desires: // 40

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ sa bhagavānviṣṇurahaṃ nārāyaṇo hariḥ |
vāsudevo hyahaṃ vyāpī bhūtāvāso nirañjanaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
अहं स भगवान्विष्णुरहं नारायणो हरिः |
वासुदेवो ह्यहं व्यापी भूतावासो निरञ्जनः || 41 ||
text_mt: ‘I am that Blessed Lord Viṣṇu; I am Hari, Nārāyaṇa; / I indeed am Vāsudeva, all-pervading, the abode of beings, stainless.’ // 41

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ rūpamahaṅkāramāsādya sudṛḍhaṃ mune |
tanmayaścācireṇaiva jāyate sādhakottamaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
एवं रूपमहङ्कारमासाद्य सुदृढं मुने |
तन्मयश्चाचिरेणैव जायते साधकोत्तमः || 42 ||
text_mt: Attaining such an identity firmly, O sage, / the excellent practitioner quickly becomes identified with Him, // 42

sanskrit_iast:
nyāsāddhyānāttathā bhāvānmadhyamāccāpi yogajāt |
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ nyāsakarma mayā ca te || 43 ||
meaning:
न्यासाद्ध्यानात्तथा भावान्मध्यमाच्चापि योगजात् |
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं न्यासकर्म मया च ते || 43 ||
text_mt: from installation, from meditation, and from the intermediate contemplation born of yoga. / Thus the rite of installation has been declared briefly by me to you; // 43

sanskrit_iast: samācara yathānyāyaṃ gopayasva ca yatnataḥ |
meaning: समाचर यथान्यायं गोपयस्व च यत्नतः |
text_mt: practice it properly and conceal it with effort. // 44ab

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ mantranyāsavidhirnāma
ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां मन्त्रन्यासविधिर्नाम
एकादशः पटलः || 11 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the eleventh chapter, named the Rule for the Installation of Mantras, in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the venerable Pāñcarātra. // 11

sanskrit_iast: atha mānasayāgākhyānaṃ nāma dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: अथ मानसयागाख्यानं नाम द्वादशः पटलः
text_mt: Now, the twelfth chapter, named the Teaching on the Mental Sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ viṣṇumayo bhūtvā svātmanā sādhakaḥ purā |
mānasena tu yāgena tato viṣṇuṃ samarcayet || 1 ||
meaning:
एवं विष्णुमयो भूत्वा स्वात्मना साधकः पुरा |
मानसेन तु यागेन ततो विष्णुं समर्चयेत् || 1 ||
text_mt: Having thus become identified with Viṣṇu in oneself beforehand, / the practitioner should then worship Viṣṇu by means of the mental sacrifice. // 1

sanskrit_iast:
[mānasayāgopakrame avayavavibhāgaśaḥ sthānabhedena
ādhāraśaktyādipadmāntānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ kalpanāprakāraḥ]
meaning:
[मानसयागोपक्रमे अवयवविभागशः स्थानभेदेन
आधारशक्त्यादिपद्मान्तानां षण्णां कल्पनाप्रकारः]
text_mt: [At the commencement of the mental sacrifice: the method of conceiving the six [seats] beginning with the Ādhāraśakti and ending with the lotus according to division of parts and distinction of places]

sanskrit_iast:
nābhimeḍhrāntare dhyāyecchaktiṃ cādhārarūpiṇīm |
kālāgniṃ ca tadūrdhve tu anantaṃ tasya copari || 2 ||
meaning:
नाभिमेढ्रान्तरे ध्यायेच्छक्तिं चाधाररूपिणीम् |
कालाग्निं च तदूर्ध्वे तु अनन्तं तस्य चोपरि || 2 ||
text_mt: Between the navel and the penis, one should meditate on Śakti in the form of the support (ādhāra), / and above that, on the Fire of Time (Kālāgni), and upon that, on Ananta. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
tadūrdhve vasudhāṃ devīṃ caturbhiḥ pūritāṃ smaran |
kandānnābhyavasānācca caturddhā bhājitaiḥ padaiḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
तदूर्ध्वे वसुधां देवीं चतुर्भिः पूरितां स्मरन् |
कन्दान्नाभ्यवसानाच्च चतुर्द्धा भाजितैः पदैः || 3 ||
text_mt: Above that, recollecting the goddess Vasudhā filled by the four [quarters], / divided into four stations extending from the bulb to the navel. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
nābhau kṣīrārṇavaṃ dhyātvā tataḥ padmaṃ samutthitam |
sahasradalaparyantaṃ sahasrakiraṇāvṛtam || 4 ||
meaning:
नाभौ क्षीरार्णवं ध्यात्वा ततः पद्मं समुत्थितम् |
सहस्रदलपर्यन्तं सहस्रकिरणावृतम् || 4 ||
text_mt: Having meditated on the Ocean of Milk in the navel, [one should meditate on] a lotus risen therefrom, / extending up to a thousand petals, surrounded by a thousand rays, // 4

sanskrit_iast: [padmasyoparipīṭhakalpanam]
meaning: [पद्मस्योपरिपीठकल्पनम्]
text_mt: [Conceiving the throne above the lotus]

sanskrit_iast: sahasraraśmisaṅkāśaṃ tatpṛṣṭhe cāsanaṃ nyaset |
meaning: सहस्ररश्मिसङ्काशं तत्पृष्ठे चासनं न्यसेत् |
text_mt: resembling a thousand rays of light; and on its back one should install the seat. // 5ab

sanskrit_iast: [tasya pīṭhasya dharmādiṣoḍaśapādaparikalpanāprakāraḥ]
meaning: [तस्य पीठस्य धर्मादिषोडशपादपरिकल्पनाप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Manner of conceiving the sixteen legs of that throne, beginning with Dharma]

sanskrit_iast: dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca caturthakam || 5 ||
meaning: धर्मं ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं च चतुर्थकम् || 5 ||
text_mt: Dharma, knowledge, detachment, and sovereignty as the fourth: // 5cd

sanskrit_iast:
avatārya svamantreṇa āgneyādicatuṣṭaye |
catuṣkametadvinyasya yāvadīśānagocaram || 6 ||
meaning:
अवतार्य स्वमन्त्रेण आग्नेयादिचतुष्टये |
चतुष्कमेतद्विन्यस्य यावदीशानगोचरम् || 6 ||
text_mt: bringing them down with their own mantras in the four [directions] beginning with the southeast, / having installed this tetrad up to the realm of the northeast; // 6

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhapādacatuṣke tu sitāssihmānanā amī |
śarīrātpuruṣākārāḥ parotsāhasamanvitāḥ || 7 ||
meaning:
पीठपादचतुष्के तु सितास्सिह्मानना अमी |
शरीरात्पुरुषाकाराः परोत्साहसमन्विताः || 7 ||
text_mt: on the four legs of the throne, these [four] are white, with lion faces, / with human shapes from the body [down], endowed with supreme vigour. // 7

sanskrit_iast:
tatpūrvadigvibhāgādi yāvaduttaragocaram |
nyasyādharmaṃ tathā'jñānamavairāgyamanaiśvaram || 8 ||
meaning:
तत्पूर्वदिग्विभागादि यावदुत्तरगोचरम् |
न्यस्याधर्मं तथाऽज्ञानमवैराग्यमनैश्वरम् || 8 ||
text_mt: Beginning from the eastern sector of that up to the realm of the north, / having installed Adharma, as well as ignorance, non-detachment, and lack of sovereignty: // 8

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣākṛtayastvete bandhūkakusumojvalāḥ |
prāgīśānadigante tu prāgāgneyadigantare || 9 ||
meaning:
पुरुषाकृतयस्त्वेते बन्धूककुसुमोज्वलाः |
प्रागीशानदिगन्ते तु प्रागाग्नेयदिगन्तरे || 9 ||
text_mt: these have human forms and shine like the bandhūka flower. / In the intermediate space between the east and northeast, between the east and southeast, // 9

sanskrit_iast:
yātuvāruṇamadhye tu vāyavyavaruṇāntare |
ṛgvedādyaṃ catuṣkaṃ tu pītaṃ hayanarākṛtim || 10 ||
meaning:
यातुवारुणमध्ये तु वायव्यवरुणान्तरे |
ऋग्वेदाद्यं चतुष्कं तु पीतं हयनराकृतिम् || 10 ||
text_mt: between the southwest and west, and between the northwest and west: / the tetrad beginning with the Ṛgveda is yellow, shaped like horse-men. // 10

sanskrit_iast:
īśānasomadigmadhye antakāgnidigantare |
yāmyarākṣasamadhye tu saumyasāmīraṇāntare || 11 ||
meaning:
ईशानसोमदिग्मध्ये अन्तकाग्निदिगन्तरे |
याम्यराक्षसमध्ये तु सौम्यसामीरणान्तरे || 11 ||
text_mt: Between the northeast and north, between the south and southeast, / between the south and southwest, and between the north and northwest: // 11

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtādyaṃ yugasaṅghaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ vṛṣanarākṛtim |
sarve caturbhujāstvete dvābhyāṃ sandhārayanti ca || 12 ||
meaning:
कृताद्यं युगसङ्घं च कृष्णं वृषनराकृतिम् |
सर्वे चतुर्भुजास्त्वेते द्वाभ्यां सन्धारयन्ति च || 12 ||
text_mt: the group of yugas beginning with the Kṛta is black, shaped like bull-men. / All these have four arms, and with two they support // 12

sanskrit_iast: p. 98) pīṭhamañjalinā dvābhyāṃ praṇamanti jagatprabhum |
meaning: प्. 98) पीठमञ्जलिना द्वाभ्यां प्रणमन्ति जगत्प्रभुम् |
text_mt: the throne, and with two, in folded hands, they bow to the Lord of the world. // 13ab

sanskrit_iast:
[dharmādipīṭhasyopari avayavavibhāgaśaḥ sthānabhedena
sitakamalasūryendvagnipakṣirājāntāsanapañcakasyoparyupari
parikalpanaprakāraḥ]
meaning:
[धर्मादिपीठस्योपरि अवयवविभागशः स्थानभेदेन
सितकमलसूर्येन्द्वग्निपक्षिराजान्तासनपञ्चकस्योपर्युपरि
परिकल्पनप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Manner of conceiving, above the throne of Dharma and the others, the five seats beginning with the white lotus, sun, moon, fire, and ending with the king of birds, one above another according to division of parts and distinction of places]

sanskrit_iast: eṣāmupari vinyasya sitapadmāditastrayam || 13 ||
meaning: एषामुपरि विन्यस्य सितपद्मादितस्त्रयम् || 13 ||
text_mt: Above these, having installed the triad beginning with the white lotus // 13cd

sanskrit_iast:
prāguktaissvoditairmantrairuparyupari nārada |
tatpṛṣṭhe pakṣirājaṃ ca varāhaṃ tūbhayaṃ nyaset || 14 ||
meaning:
प्रागुक्तैस्स्वोदितैर्मन्त्रैरुपर्युपरि नारद |
तत्पृष्ठे पक्षिराजं च वराहं तूभयं न्यसेत् || 14 ||
text_mt: with their previously mentioned and prescribed mantras, one above the other, O Nārada; / on its back one should install both the king of birds and the Boar. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
ānābhi hṛdayāntaṃ ca pañcadhā susamaiḥ padaiḥ |
vikalpya bhāvayedvyāptimasya mantrāsanasya ca || 15 ||
meaning:
आनाभि हृदयान्तं च पञ्चधा सुसमैः पदैः |
विकल्प्य भावयेद्व्याप्तिमस्य मन्त्रासनस्य च || 15 ||
text_mt: Dividing [the space] into five strictly equal parts extending from the navel to the heart, / one should meditate on the pervasion of this throne of mantras. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
[ādhāraśaktiprabhṛti pakṣirājānteṣvekādaśapadeṣu
bhūtapañcakaprabhṛtīśvaraparyantānāṃ tattvānāṃ kramādvyāptiḥ]
meaning:
[आधारशक्तिप्रभृति पक्षिराजान्तेष्वेकादशपदेषु
भूतपञ्चकप्रभृतीश्वरपर्यन्तानां तत्त्वानां क्रमाद्व्याप्तिः]
text_mt: [The successive pervasion of the principles, beginning with the five gross elements and ending with Īśvara, across the eleven stations from Ādhāraśakti to the king of birds]

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśakterārabhya yāvanmāntraṃ paraṃ padam |
bhūtānyādhārāśaktau tu tanmātrāḥ kālapāvake || 16 ||
meaning:
आधारशक्तेरारभ्य यावन्मान्त्रं परं पदम् |
भूतान्याधाराशक्तौ तु तन्मात्राः कालपावके || 16 ||
text_mt: From the Ādhāraśakti up to the supreme mantra-station: / the elements [are seated] on the Ādhāraśakti, and the subtle elements in the Fire of Time; // 16

sanskrit_iast:
vāgādikaṃ tathaivākṣamanantaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitam |
śrotrādikaṃ dharaṇyāṃ ca manaḥ kṣīrārṇave dvija || 17 ||
meaning:
वागादिकं तथैवाक्षमनन्तं व्याप्य संस्थितम् |
श्रोत्रादिकं धरण्यां च मनः क्षीरार्णवे द्विज || 17 ||
text_mt: [the organs of action] beginning with speech, as well as the sense organs, abide pervading Ananta; / [the organs] beginning with the ear on Dharā; and the mind in the Ocean of Milk, O twice-born; // 17

sanskrit_iast:
anantadalapadme tu ahaṅkārassamāśritaḥ |
dviraṣṭakaṃ ca dharmādyamadhiṣṭhāya ca dhīssthitā || 18 ||
meaning:
अनन्तदलपद्मे तु अहङ्कारस्समाश्रितः |
द्विरष्टकं च धर्माद्यमधिष्ठाय च धीस्स्थिता || 18 ||
text_mt: egoity rests on the infinite-petalled lotus; / and intellect abides presiding over the sixteen beginning with Dharma; // 18

sanskrit_iast:
tadūrdhvapadme prakṛtirguṇasāmyā'vibhāginī |
dhāmatrayāśritaḥ kālo bhāvākhye puruṣaḥ sthitaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
तदूर्ध्वपद्मे प्रकृतिर्गुणसाम्याऽविभागिनी |
धामत्रयाश्रितः कालो भावाख्ये पुरुषः स्थितः || 19 ||
text_mt: Prakṛti, consisting of the equilibrium of the qualities and indivisible, rests on the lotus above that; / Time rests on the three luminaries; Puruṣa abides on that which is called Bhāva; // 19

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍaśceśvareṇaiva prabhutvena tvadhiṣṭhitaḥ |
ekādaśapadaṃ hyevaṃ mantramūrtau janārdane || 20 ||
meaning:
गरुडश्चेश्वरेणैव प्रभुत्वेन त्वधिष्ठितः |
एकादशपदं ह्येवं मन्त्रमूर्तौ जनार्दने || 20 ||
text_mt: and Garuḍa is presided over by Īśvara through lordship. / Thus is the eleven-fold station in Janārdana whose form is mantra, // 20

sanskrit_iast: āsīnaṃ ca śarīrasthamavibhaktaṃ vibhaktimat |
meaning: आसीनं च शरीरस्थमविभक्तं विभक्तिमत् |
text_mt: seated and located in the body, undivided yet possessed of divisions. // 21ab

sanskrit_iast: [viṣṇordhyānopakramaḥ]
meaning: [विष्णोर्ध्यानोपक्रमः]
text_mt: [Commencement of the meditation on Viṣṇu]

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇuṃ viśvātmakaṃ devamīśvarādhāravigraham || 21 ||
meaning: विष्णुं विश्वात्मकं देवमीश्वराधारविग्रहम् || 21 ||
text_mt: One should meditate on god Viṣṇu, the soul of all, whose body has Īśvara as its support, // 21cd

sanskrit_iast: svasthānācca samāyāntaṃ prākpravāheṇa bhāvayet |
meaning: स्वस्थानाच्च समायान्तं प्राक्प्रवाहेण भावयेत् |
text_mt: as arriving from his own place in an eastward stream. // 22ab

sanskrit_iast: [prathamaṃ mantrātparatarasvarūpasya bhāvanam]
meaning: [प्रथमं मन्त्रात्परतरस्वरूपस्य भावनम्]
text_mt: [First, the contemplation of the form higher than mantra]

sanskrit_iast: marīcicakraparyantaṃ mantrātparatarasthitim || 22 ||
meaning: मरीचिचक्रपर्यन्तं मन्त्रात्परतरस्थितिम् || 22 ||
text_mt: Extending to the circle of rays, the state higher than mantra // 22cd

sanskrit_iast: parasūkṣmavibhāgena tato mantrātmanā smaret |
meaning: परसूक्ष्मविभागेन ततो मन्त्रात्मना स्मरेत् |
text_mt: one should then recollect by means of the division of supreme and subtle, as having the nature of mantra. // 23ab

sanskrit_iast: [parasūkṣmobhayātmanā'vasthitasya mantrātmasvarūpasya bhāvanam]
meaning: [परसूक्ष्मोभयात्मनाऽवस्थितस्य मन्त्रात्मस्वरूपस्य भावनम्]
text_mt: [Contemplation of the nature consisting of mantra, existing both as supreme and subtle]

sanskrit_iast: paraṃ jyotirmayaṃ rūpamāhlādānandalakṣaṇam || 23 ||
meaning: परं ज्योतिर्मयं रूपमाह्लादानन्दलक्षणम् || 23 ||
text_mt: The supreme form consists of light, characterized by delight and bliss; // 23cd

sanskrit_iast: p. 99) sūkṣmaṃ cicchaktilakṣaṃ tu liṅgamātraṃ prakāśavat |
meaning: प्. 99) सूक्ष्मं चिच्छक्तिलक्षं तु लिङ्गमात्रं प्रकाशवत् |
text_mt: the subtle is characterized by the conscious power (cicchakti), a mere mark (liṅga), full of light. // 24ab

sanskrit_iast: [sthūlasvarūpasya smaraṇam]
meaning: [स्थूलस्वरूपस्य स्मरणम्]
text_mt: [Recollection of the gross form]

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ sthūlavapurdhyeyo nānārūpavibhāgaśaḥ || 24 ||
meaning: ततः स्थूलवपुर्ध्येयो नानारूपविभागशः || 24 ||
text_mt: Then the gross form is to be meditated upon according to its various form-divisions. // 24cd

sanskrit_iast: [parasūkṣmātmanā'vasthitasya mantramūrteviṣṇoraiśvaryam]
meaning: [परसूक्ष्मात्मनाऽवस्थितस्य मन्त्रमूर्तेविष्णोरैश्वर्यम्]
text_mt: [The sovereignty of Viṣṇu as the embodiment of mantra, existing as supreme and subtle]

sanskrit_iast:
vālāgraśatabhāgaśca pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ |
guṇabhoktā guṇādhāro guṇavānnirguṇastathā || 25 ||
meaning:
वालाग्रशतभागश्च प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः |
गुणभोक्ता गुणाधारो गुणवान्निर्गुणस्तथा || 25 ||
text_mt: And he is the hundredth part of the tip of a hair, the Lord of Pradhāna and Puruṣa, / the experiencer of the qualities, the support of the qualities, endowed with qualities, and likewise devoid of qualities. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
deheśvarassavikhyātassarvadevamayaḥ prabhuḥ |
aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣassarvadeheṣu tiṣṭhati || 26 ||
meaning:
देहेश्वरस्सविख्यातस्सर्वदेवमयः प्रभुः |
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषस्सर्वदेहेषु तिष्ठति || 26 ||
text_mt: Renowned as the Lord of the body, the Lord consists of all the gods; / as the Puruṣa measuring a thumb, he dwells in all bodies. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
maṇiryathā vibhāgena nīlapītādibhiryutaḥ |
rūpabhedamavāpnoti dhyānabhedāttathā vibhuḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
मणिर्यथा विभागेन नीलपीतादिभिर्युतः |
रूपभेदमवाप्नोति ध्यानभेदात्तथा विभुः || 27 ||
text_mt: Just as a jewel, depending on its division [of facets] and combined with blue, yellow, and other [colours], / takes on diverse appearances, so the all-pervading Lord [assumes various forms] through diversity of meditation. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāhyayaṃ tathā rudraścandrasūryau prajāpatiḥ |
paramātmasamudbhūtamantrājjātāstadātmakāḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माह्ययं तथा रुद्रश्चन्द्रसूर्यौ प्रजापतिः |
परमात्मसमुद्भूतमन्त्राज्जातास्तदात्मकाः || 28 ||
text_mt: For this Brahmā, Rudra, the moon and sun, and Prajāpati / are born from the mantra arising from the Supreme Self, possessing its nature. // 28

sanskrit_iast: [lakṣmyādibhiḥ sahaivapūjyatvam]
meaning: [लक्ष्म्यादिभिः सहैवपूज्यत्वम्]
text_mt: [His worship precisely along with Lakṣmī and the other goddesses]

sanskrit_iast:
buddhissantārikā yā vai pare taddharmadharmiṇī |
tatjñā vā (sā ?)prāgvibhāgena prabhā candramaso yathā || 29 ||
meaning:
बुद्धिस्सन्तारिका या वै परे तद्धर्मधर्मिणी |
तत्ज्ञा वा (सा ?)प्राग्विभागेन प्रभा चन्द्रमसो यथा || 29 ||
text_mt: That intellect which is the deliverer, sharing the properties of the Supreme, / or knowing it, [remains] formerly undivided like the radiance of the moon. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
avasthitā caturdhā vai śaktitvena jagadguroḥ |
jñānakriyāsvarūpeṇa īśitvānugrahātmanā || 30 ||
meaning:
अवस्थिता चतुर्धा वै शक्तित्वेन जगद्गुरोः |
ज्ञानक्रियास्वरूपेण ईशित्वानुग्रहात्मना || 30 ||
text_mt: It is fourfold disposed as the potency of the Teacher of the Universe, / in the form of knowledge and action, and consisting of lordship and grace. // 30

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaiva buddhipūrvāstāḥ prāguktāsu ca śaktiṣu |
vikāratvena vartante āsāmapi ca nārada || 31 ||
meaning:
पञ्चैव बुद्धिपूर्वास्ताः प्रागुक्तासु च शक्तिषु |
विकारत्वेन वर्तन्ते आसामपि च नारद || 31 ||
text_mt: Those five [tattvas] beginning with the intellect exist as transformations / within the potencies mentioned before, and even among these, O Nārada. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
buddhiṃ vinā catasṝṇāṃ vikṛtiścāpi naśvarī |
vyavasthitāścaturdhā yā lakṣmyādyā devatāstu tāḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
बुद्धिं विना चतसॄणां विकृतिश्चापि नश्वरी |
व्यवस्थिताश्चतुर्धा या लक्ष्म्याद्या देवतास्तु ताः || 32 ||
text_mt: Without the intellect, the transformation of the four is also perishable; / those which are arranged fourfold are the deities beginning with Lakṣmī. // 32

sanskrit_iast: tābhissaha sadā pūjyassāṅgo hṛtpadmakoṭare |
meaning: ताभिस्सह सदा पूज्यस्साङ्गो हृत्पद्मकोटरे |
text_mt: Together with them, he, with all his limbs, should always be worshipped in the hollow of the heart-lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
[paramātmanaḥ śaktibhūtānāṃ lakṣmyādīnāṃ
dharmajñānādivikṛtyaṣṭakamūlaprakṛtitvam]
meaning:
[परमात्मनः शक्तिभूतानां लक्ष्म्यादीनां
धर्मज्ञानादिविकृत्यष्टकमूलप्रकृतित्वम्]
text_mt: [Lakṣmī and the others, being potencies of the Supreme Self, as the root source of the eightfold transformations such as dharma and knowledge]

sanskrit_iast: etāsāṃ hi vikāraśca śreyomārganiyāmakāḥ || 33 ||
meaning: एतासां हि विकारश्च श्रेयोमार्गनियामकाः || 33 ||
text_mt: For their modification directs [beings] on the path to the highest good. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
sadaiva matprapannānāṃ janānāṃ ye'nurāgiṇaḥ |
saṃsthitāśca jagatyasmin dharmajñānādayastu te || 34 ||
meaning:
सदैव मत्प्रपन्नानां जनानां येऽनुरागिणः |
संस्थिताश्च जगत्यस्मिन् धर्मज्ञानादयस्तु ते || 34 ||
text_mt: Those [modifications] such as dharma and knowledge belong to those devoted beings / in this world who are ever surrendered to me. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ vai dvijaśreṣṭha vikāratvena saṃsthitam |
adharmādyaṃ catuṣkaṃ tu aśreyaḥ pathayojakam || 35 ||
meaning:
एतेषां वै द्विजश्रेष्ठ विकारत्वेन संस्थितम् |
अधर्माद्यं चतुष्कं तु अश्रेयः पथयोजकम् || 35 ||
text_mt: As a transformation of these, O best of the twice-born, there exists / the tetrad beginning with adharma, which attaches [one] to the path away from the highest good, // 35

sanskrit_iast:
gurvagnimantraśāstrāṇāṃ dūṣakādiṣu jantuṣu |
śeṣaṃ māyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ tāṃ māyāṃ viddhi māmakīm || 36 ||
meaning:
गुर्वग्निमन्त्रशास्त्राणां दूषकादिषु जन्तुषु |
शेषं मायामयं सर्वं तां मायां विद्धि मामकीम् || 36 ||
text_mt: among creatures who disparage the guru, the fire, the mantra, and the scriptures. / Everything else is made of māyā; know that māyā to be mine. // 36

sanskrit_iast: p. 100) pṛthagrūpaṃ tathaikyaṃ ca ābhyāmuktaṃ purā mayā |
meaning: प्. 100) पृथग्रूपं तथैक्यं च आभ्यामुक्तं पुरा मया |
text_mt: Both their distinct nature and their unity were told by me before.

sanskrit_iast:
[hṛtpuṇḍarīkamadhye'vasthāpitasya mantrātmanaḥ parasya caitanyajyotiṣo
viṣṇoḥ prabhāvaviśeṣaḥ]
meaning:
[हृत्पुण्डरीकमध्येऽवस्थापितस्य मन्त्रात्मनः परस्य चैतन्यज्योतिषो
विष्णोः प्रभावविशेषः]
text_mt: [The special majesty of Viṣṇu, who is the mantra-self and the supreme light of consciousness established in the center of the heart-lotus]

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ prakīrtitaṃ saṅghaṃ mantracakraṃ parātmakam || 37 ||
meaning: एवं प्रकीर्तितं सङ्घं मन्त्रचक्रं परात्मकम् || 37 ||
text_mt: Thus has been proclaimed the host, the circle of mantras whose essence is the Supreme, // 37

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamadhyasthaṃ caitanyajyotiravyayam |
kadambāgolakākāraṃ viśvarūpaṃ maṇiprabham || 38 ||
meaning:
हृत्पुण्डरीकमध्यस्थं चैतन्यज्योतिरव्ययम् |
कदम्बागोलकाकारं विश्वरूपं मणिप्रभम् || 38 ||
text_mt: residing in the center of the heart-lotus, the imperishable light of consciousness, / shaped like a kadamba flower-ball, multi-form, shining like a jewel, // 38

sanskrit_iast:
ratnadīpasamākāramacchinnaprasaraṃ mahat |
śrotrapūrvaiḥ kharandhraiśca raśmayastasya nirgatāḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
रत्नदीपसमाकारमच्छिन्नप्रसरं महत् |
श्रोत्रपूर्वैः खरन्ध्रैश्च रश्मयस्तस्य निर्गताः || 39 ||
text_mt: resembling a gem-lamp, of unbroken expansion, great; / its rays issue forth through the bodily apertures, beginning with the ears. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
chidrapūrṇādyathā kumbhānmahādīpayutāddhvija |
yāti bhāsāṃ gaṇo bāhye śarīrādevameva hi || 40 ||
meaning:
छिद्रपूर्णाद्यथा कुम्भान्महादीपयुताद्ध्विज |
याति भासां गणो बाह्ये शरीरादेवमेव हि || 40 ||
text_mt: Just as a mass of light goes outside from a pot / full of holes and holding a great lamp, O twice-born, precisely so it goes from the body. // 40

sanskrit_iast: mantro raśmisamūhastu nāḍībhiḥ prasaredbahiḥ |
meaning: मन्त्रो रश्मिसमूहस्तु नाडीभिः प्रसरेद्बहिः |
text_mt: The mantra, which is a collection of rays, diffuses outward through the nāḍīs.

sanskrit_iast: [sthairyādīnāṃ pṛthivyādiguṇānāmapi paramātmaikāśrayatvam]
meaning: [स्थैर्यादीनां पृथिव्यादिगुणानामपि परमात्मैकाश्रयत्वम्]
text_mt: [Even qualities of earth and other elements, such as firmness, having their sole refuge in the Supreme Self]

sanskrit_iast: apratyakṣassadā'kṣāṇāṃ mantrātmā'yamapi dvija || 41 ||
meaning: अप्रत्यक्षस्सदाऽक्षाणां मन्त्रात्माऽयमपि द्विज || 41 ||
text_mt: Although this mantra-self is always imperceptible to the senses, O twice-born, // 41

sanskrit_iast:
tathā'pyanena nyāyena pratyakṣamupalakṣyate |
bahisthitaṃ yadbhūtānāṃ kṣmādīnāṃ guṇapañcakam || 42 ||
meaning:
तथाऽप्यनेन न्यायेन प्रत्यक्षमुपलक्ष्यते |
बहिस्थितं यद्भूतानां क्ष्मादीनां गुणपञ्चकम् || 42 ||
text_mt: nevertheless it is recognized through perception by this rule of reasoning: / the five qualities of the elements, earth and the others, that are situated externally, // 42

sanskrit_iast:
tena taccopalabdhavyaṃ pratyakṣeṇa parokṣagam |
tasya bhaumo guṇasthairyaṃ tadguṇena hi sā sthirā || 43 ||
meaning:
तेन तच्चोपलब्धव्यं प्रत्यक्षेण परोक्षगम् |
तस्य भौमो गुणस्थैर्यं तद्गुणेन हि सा स्थिरा || 43 ||
text_mt: through that [external perception], that which is beyond perception is to be apprehended. / His earthy quality is firmness, for it is by his quality that she [the earth] is firm. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
parasparānubhāvena saṃvṛttau tadupāruhet |
āhlādo yastadīyo'pi satoye copalabhyate || 44 ||
meaning:
परस्परानुभावेन संवृत्तौ तदुपारुहेत् |
आह्लादो यस्तदीयोऽपि सतोये चोपलभ्यते || 44 ||
text_mt: When they coalesce through mutual influence, it ascends there. / The delight which is his is perceived also in water; // 44

sanskrit_iast:
toye guṇastu tasyāsti kathaṃ syādanyathā mune |
smṛtamātreṇa mantreṇa āhlādo mānaso mahān || 45 ||
meaning:
तोये गुणस्तु तस्यास्ति कथं स्यादन्यथा मुने |
स्मृतमात्रेण मन्त्रेण आह्लादो मानसो महान् || 45 ||
text_mt: and its quality is present in water; how else could it be, O sage, / that by merely remembering the mantra a great mental delight arises? // 45

sanskrit_iast:
rūpātmanā pariṇatassacāgnau pārameśvaraḥ |
yo rūpākhyo guṇaścāgnessamantrātmani tiṣṭhati || 46 ||
meaning:
रूपात्मना परिणतस्सचाग्नौ पारमेश्वरः |
यो रूपाख्यो गुणश्चाग्नेस्समन्त्रात्मनि तिष्ठति || 46 ||
text_mt: That quality of fire, supreme lordly, transformed as visible form, / which is called the quality of form in fire, abides in the mantra-self, // 46

sanskrit_iast:
tejo vinā yato dhyānaṃ kutracinnopalabhyate |
sparśadharmo hi yo vāyossa tadīyo mahāmate || 47 ||
meaning:
तेजो विना यतो ध्यानं कुत्रचिन्नोपलभ्यते |
स्पर्शधर्मो हि यो वायोस्स तदीयो महामते || 47 ||
text_mt: since without radiance meditation is nowhere perceived. / That property of touch which belongs to wind is his, O highly intelligent one; // 47

sanskrit_iast:
yo vāyavyo guṇassūkṣmassa ca mantratanau sthitaḥ |
sa cāntaḥkaraṇe caiva saṃhṛte syāttadutthitaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
यो वायव्यो गुणस्सूक्ष्मस्स च मन्त्रतनौ स्थितः |
स चान्तःकरणे चैव संहृते स्यात्तदुत्थितः || 48 ||
text_mt: that subtle quality of wind is situated in the body of the mantra, / and it arises from it when the internal organ is withdrawn. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
yadākāśasya śūnyatvamasti tasmāttadudbhavaḥ |
sa mantrātmani saṃviṣṭo guṇo hyasminmahāmate || 49 ||
meaning:
यदाकाशस्य शून्यत्वमस्ति तस्मात्तदुद्भवः |
स मन्त्रात्मनि संविष्टो गुणो ह्यस्मिन्महामते || 49 ||
text_mt: That voidness which belongs to space has its source in him; / for that quality entered into the mantra-self is in this [space], O highly intelligent one. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
p. 101) agrāhyatvācca karaṇaiḥ prākṛtairbhāvanāṃ vinā |
ityevaṃ mantrasāmarthyaṃ purā jñātvā yathārthataḥ || 50 ||
meaning:
प्. 101) अग्राह्यत्वाच्च करणैः प्राकृतैर्भावनां विना |
इत्येवं मन्त्रसामर्थ्यं पुरा ज्ञात्वा यथार्थतः || 50 ||
text_mt: And because he cannot be grasped by material organs without creative contemplation, / having thus understood correctly the power of the mantra beforehand, // 50

sanskrit_iast: [mudrāmantrapūrvakamāvāhanam]
meaning: [मुद्रामन्त्रपूर्वकमावाहनम्]
text_mt: [The invocation preceded by mudrā and mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
sannidhānaṃ bhavedyena pūjākāle hyupasthite |
mudrāsamanvito mantro ya āvāhanasaṃjñitaḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
सन्निधानं भवेद्येन पूजाकाले ह्युपस्थिते |
मुद्रासमन्वितो मन्त्रो य आवाहनसंज्ञितः || 51 ||
text_mt: by which presence is effected when the time of worship has arrived: / with the mudrā accompanying the mantra known as invocation, // 51

sanskrit_iast:
pūrakeṇa dvijaśreṣṭha manasā samudīrayet |
samāhūya tataḥ paścānmūrtimantreṇa cetasā || 52 ||
meaning:
पूरकेण द्विजश्रेष्ठ मनसा समुदीरयेत् |
समाहूय ततः पश्चान्मूर्तिमन्त्रेण चेतसा || 52 ||
text_mt: he should recite it mentally during inhalation, O best of the twice-born. / Having called [him] then mentally with the mūrtimantra, // 52

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānoktāṃ kalpayenmūrttiṃ tasya hṛtpadmamadhyagām |
pareṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ dhyāyenmūlamantraṃ jvalatprabham || 53 ||
meaning:
ध्यानोक्तां कल्पयेन्मूर्त्तिं तस्य हृत्पद्ममध्यगाम् |
परेणाधिष्ठितं ध्यायेन्मूलमन्त्रं ज्वलत्प्रभम् || 53 ||
text_mt: he should fashion his form, described in the meditation, as positioned in the center of the heart-lotus; / he should meditate on the root-mantra, blazing with light, presided over by the Supreme. // 53

sanskrit_iast: [āvāhitasya tasya saṃukhīkaraṇam]
meaning: [आवाहितस्य तस्य संउखीकरणम्]
text_mt: [Facing the invoked Lord]

sanskrit_iast:
sammukhīkaraṇaṃ kuryānmantramūrterdvijātmanaḥ |
ātmamantrādito bhūyo mantraissarvaiśca pūrvavat || 54 ||
meaning:
सम्मुखीकरणं कुर्यान्मन्त्रमूर्तेर्द्विजात्मनः |
आत्ममन्त्रादितो भूयो मन्त्रैस्सर्वैश्च पूर्ववत् || 54 ||
text_mt: He should face the mantra-embodiment of the twice-born soul / starting from the ātmamantra again with all the mantras as before. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
karanyāsaṃ vinā dehe nyāsaṃ tasya ca saṃsmaret |
puṣpamarghyaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ mālyaṃ vilepanam || 55 ||
meaning:
करन्यासं विना देहे न्यासं तस्य च संस्मरेत् |
पुष्पमर्घ्यं तथा धूपं दीपं माल्यं विलेपनम् || 55 ||
text_mt: Leaving out the installation on the hands, he should visualize the installation on his body; / flowers, arghya-water, incense, a lamp, a garland, anointing unguent, // 55

sanskrit_iast:
cetasā sādareṇaiva pādyapūrvaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ |
praṇāmamatha cāṣṭāṅgaṃ jayaśabdāṃśca mānasān || 56 ||
meaning:
चेतसा सादरेणैव पाद्यपूर्वं च भक्तितः |
प्रणाममथ चाष्टाङ्गं जयशब्दांश्च मानसान् || 56 ||
text_mt: along with water for washing the feet, [offered] through the mind with reverence and devotion; / then an eight-limbed prostration and mental shouts of victory; // 56

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā bhagavate brahmamudrāṃ vai saṃpradarśayet |
svāgataṃ tava deveśa sannidhiṃ bhajame'cyuta || 57 ||
meaning:
कृत्वा भगवते ब्रह्ममुद्रां वै संप्रदर्शयेत् |
स्वागतं तव देवेश सन्निधिं भजमेऽच्युत || 57 ||
text_mt: having done this, he should show the Brahmamudrā to the Lord: / “Welcome to you, O Lord of the gods! Abide in my presence, O Acyuta! // 57

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇa mānasīṃ pūjāṃ yathārthaparibhāvitām |
jñātvā tu suprasannaṃ taṃ prasādābhimukhaṃ prabhum || 58 ||
meaning:
गृहाण मानसीं पूजां यथार्थपरिभाविताम् |
ज्ञात्वा तु सुप्रसन्नं तं प्रसादाभिमुखं प्रभुम् || 58 ||
text_mt: Accept this mental worship, conceived in its true nature!” / Then, knowing that Lord to be gracious and inclined toward benevolence, // 58

sanskrit_iast: [atha vistareṇa mānasayāgārambhaḥ]
meaning: [अथ विस्तरेण मानसयागारम्भः]
text_mt: [Now the beginning of the mental sacrifice in detail]

sanskrit_iast:
vistareṇa dvijaśreṣṭha mānasaṃ yāgamārabhet |
saṅkalpajanitairdravyaiḥ pavitrairakṣayaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 59 ||
meaning:
विस्तरेण द्विजश्रेष्ठ मानसं यागमारभेत् |
सङ्कल्पजनितैर्द्रव्यैः पवित्रैरक्षयैः शुभैः || 59 ||
text_mt: he should begin the mental sacrifice in detail, O best of the twice-born, / with pure, inexhaustible, and auspicious substances produced from his volition. // 59

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradaṃ devaṃ mantramūrttidharaṃ yajet |
abhyaṅgodvartane pūrvaṃ snānaṃ cātha vilepanam || 60 ||
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदं देवं मन्त्रमूर्त्तिधरं यजेत् |
अभ्यङ्गोद्वर्तने पूर्वं स्नानं चाथ विलेपनम् || 60 ||
text_mt: He should worship the god who grants all desires and bears the form of the mantra: / first inunction and massage, then bathing and anointing unguent; // 60

sanskrit_iast:
vastrapūrvāṇi mālyāni sugandhāni nivedya ca |
hārakeyūrakaṭakairmukuṭairbhūṣitaṃ smaret || 61 ||
meaning:
वस्त्रपूर्वाणि माल्यानि सुगन्धानि निवेद्य च |
हारकेयूरकटकैर्मुकुटैर्भूषितं स्मरेत् || 61 ||
text_mt: and having offered fragrant garments, garlands, and the like, / he should visualize him adorned with necklaces, armlets, bracelets, and crowns, // 61

sanskrit_iast:
citreṇa kaṭisūtreṇa hemaratnamayena ca |
māṇikyaracitaiśśuddhairmuktāhāraiśca bhūṣayet || 62 ||
meaning:
चित्रेण कटिसूत्रेण हेमरत्नमयेन च |
माणिक्यरचितैश्शुद्धैर्मुक्ताहारैश्च भूषयेत् || 62 ||
text_mt: and with a variegated waist-band made of gold and gems; / he should adorn him with pure pearl necklaces fashioned with rubies; // 62

sanskrit_iast:
p. 102) saṃpūrṇendusamānaṃ ca hemadaṇḍasamanvitam |
chatraṃ nivedayedviṣṇormāyūraṃ vyajanaṃ śubham || 63 ||
meaning:
प्. 102) संपूर्णेन्दुसमानं च हेमदण्डसमन्वितम् |
छत्रं निवेदयेद्विष्णोर्मायूरं व्यजनं शुभम् || 63 ||
text_mt: and he should present to Viṣṇu a parasol resembling the full moon / and fitted with a golden handle, and an auspicious fan of peacock feathers; // 63

sanskrit_iast:
karpūracūrṇasaṃmiśraṃ sugandhi madhuraṃ bahu |
dhūpaṃ bhagavate datvā dīpamālāṃ ghṛtena ca || 64 ||
meaning:
कर्पूरचूर्णसंमिश्रं सुगन्धि मधुरं बहु |
धूपं भगवते दत्वा दीपमालां घृतेन च || 64 ||
text_mt: having offered the Lord abundant sweet, fragrant incense / blended with camphor powder, and a row of lamps with ghee, // 64

sanskrit_iast:
madhusarpiḥplutaṃ cātha madhuparkaṃ nivedya ca |
paśuṃ ca vividhaṃ mūrtaṃ pāvanaṃ śakuniṃ tathā || 65 ||
meaning:
मधुसर्पिःप्लुतं चाथ मधुपर्कं निवेद्य च |
पशुं च विविधं मूर्तं पावनं शकुनिं तथा || 65 ||
text_mt: and having presented honey-mixture overflowing with honey and clarified butter, / and various kinds of animals, represented mentally, and pure birds, // 65

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhīśśālidūrvāṃ ca satphalāḍhyaṃ vanaspatim |
mūrtaṃ nivedayetpūrvamidamannaṃ caturvidham || 66 ||
meaning:
औषधीश्शालिदूर्वां च सत्फलाढ्यं वनस्पतिम् |
मूर्तं निवेदयेत्पूर्वमिदमन्नं चतुर्विधम् || 66 ||
text_mt: herbs, śāli rice, and dūrvā grass, and trees rich with fine fruits, / he should first present this fourfold food in visualized form, // 66

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ śuddhaṃ bhakṣyabhojyānyanekaśaḥ |
hṛdyāni phalamūlāni ṣaḍ-ṛtuprabhavāni ca || 67 ||
meaning:
नैवेद्यं विविधं शुद्धं भक्ष्यभोज्यान्यनेकशः |
हृद्यानि फलमूलानि षड्-ऋतुप्रभवानि च || 67 ||
text_mt: manifold pure food-offerings, various foods to chew and eat, / and delightful fruits and roots produced in all six seasons. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍrasāni ca citrāṇi pānānyatha nivedya ca |
sarvāṇyātmopabhogyāni bhaktiśraddhāvaśāddvija || 68 ||
meaning:
षड्रसानि च चित्राणि पानान्यथ निवेद्य च |
सर्वाण्यात्मोपभोग्यानि भक्तिश्रद्धावशाद्द्विज || 68 ||
text_mt: And then, having offered various drinks endowed with the six tastes, / everything fit for his own enjoyment, impelled by devotion and faith, O twice-born, // 68

sanskrit_iast:
prāgdikṣvapyaviruddhāni devāya vinivedayet |
tantrīvādyānyanekāni nṛttageyānvitāni ca || 69 ||
meaning:
प्राग्दिक्ष्वप्यविरुद्धानि देवाय विनिवेदयेत् |
तन्त्रीवाद्यान्यनेकानि नृत्तगेयान्वितानि च || 69 ||
text_mt: and also things not prohibited, [facing] the eastern directions, he should offer [them] to the Lord: / numerous stringed instruments accompanied by dance and singing, // 69

sanskrit_iast:
bherīpaṭahaghoṣādistutipāṭhānvitāni ca |
cintayeddevadevasya lokatrayagatāni ca || 70 ||
meaning:
भेरीपटहघोषादिस्तुतिपाठान्वितानि च |
चिन्तयेद्देवदेवस्य लोकत्रयगतानि च || 70 ||
text_mt: and accompanied by the sounds of kettle-drums and tabors, and recitations of praise; / and he should contemplate [all these], throughout the three worlds, belonging to the God of gods. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
kiṅkiṇījālayuktena cāmareṇopavījya ca |
vitānakaṃ patākāśca dhvajāni vividhāni ca || 71 ||
meaning:
किङ्किणीजालयुक्तेन चामरेणोपवीज्य च |
वितानकं पताकाश्च ध्वजानि विविधानि च || 71 ||
text_mt: And having fanned him with a fly-whisk fitted with a cluster of small bells, / and having presented a canopy, banners, and various flags // 71

sanskrit_iast:
vinivedya vibhorbhaktyā prasannenāntarātmanā |
gajāśvadhenuyānāni suvastrālaṅkṛtāni ca || 72 ||
meaning:
विनिवेद्य विभोर्भक्त्या प्रसन्नेनान्तरात्मना |
गजाश्वधेनुयानानि सुवस्त्रालङ्कृतानि च || 72 ||
text_mt: to the Lord with devotion, with a serene inner self, / and having offered elephants, horses, cows, and vehicles adorned with fine garments, // 72

sanskrit_iast:
nivedya cāntarā tāni grāhayantaṃ smarettataḥ |
ātmānaṃ sasutāndārāṃstasmai ca namasā yutān || 73 ||
meaning:
निवेद्य चान्तरा तानि ग्राहयन्तं स्मरेत्ततः |
आत्मानं ससुतान्दारांस्तस्मै च नमसा युतान् || 73 ||
text_mt: he should then remember him within, making [him] accept them. / And having offered himself together with his sons and wives, bowing down // 73

sanskrit_iast:
nivedya praṇato mūrdhnā ānandāśrusamanvitaḥ |
kāmadhenumayīṃ mudrāṃ manasā mantrasaṃyutām || 74 ||
meaning:
निवेद्य प्रणतो मूर्ध्ना आनन्दाश्रुसमन्वितः |
कामधेनुमयीं मुद्रां मनसा मन्त्रसंयुताम् || 74 ||
text_mt: with his head bowed, filled with tears of joy, / having mentally formed the mudrā consisting of Kāmadhenu, joined with mantra, // 74

sanskrit_iast:
badhvā saṃcintayedviṣṇossarvakāmaprapūraṇīm |
hṛdvyomapuṣkarāgrasthaṃ devamiṣṭvā jagadgurum || 75 ||
meaning:
बध्वा संचिन्तयेद्विष्णोस्सर्वकामप्रपूरणीम् |
हृद्व्योमपुष्कराग्रस्थं देवमिष्ट्वा जगद्गुरुम् || 75 ||
text_mt: he should contemplate it as fulfilling all desires of Viṣṇu. / Having worshipped the God, the guru of the world, residing on the lotus at the summit of the sky of the heart, // 75

sanskrit_iast: samastamantradehaṃ tu sakalaṃ niṣkalātmakam |
meaning: समस्तमन्त्रदेहं तु सकलं निष्कलात्मकम् |
text_mt: whose body consists of all mantras, with form yet having the nature of the formless:

sanskrit_iast: [lakṣmyādyaṅgapūjanam tatralayayāgādibhedaḥ]
meaning: [लक्ष्म्याद्यङ्गपूजनम् तत्रलययागादिभेदः]
text_mt: [Worship of the ancillary deities such as Lakṣmī; the division into dissolution sacrifice and the others therein]

sanskrit_iast: śaktayaścāṅgaṣaṭkaṃ ca lāṃchanaṃ kamalādikam || 76 ||
meaning: शक्तयश्चाङ्गषट्कं च लांछनं कमलादिकम् || 76 ||
text_mt: the śaktis, the group of six limbs, the insignia such as the lotus, // 76

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇaṃ kaustubhādyaṃ ca vadanānāṃ tathā trayam |
p. 103) satyādyā mūrtayaścaiva dehe devasya bhāvitāḥ || 77 ||
meaning:
भूषणं कौस्तुभाद्यं च वदनानां तथा त्रयम् |
प्. 103) सत्याद्या मूर्तयश्चैव देहे देवस्य भाविताः || 77 ||
text_mt: the ornament such as the Kaustubha, and likewise the triad of faces, / and the forms such as Satya conceived in the body of the God, // 77

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpayya ca tathātvena sve sve sthāne tathātmakāḥ |
taddehasaṃsthitāssarve pūjanīyāḥ krameṇa tu || 78 ||
meaning:
व्यापय्य च तथात्वेन स्वे स्वे स्थाने तथात्मकाः |
तद्देहसंस्थितास्सर्वे पूजनीयाः क्रमेण तु || 78 ||
text_mt: having pervaded as such, having that nature, in each respective place, / all of them situated in his body are to be worshipped in order // 78

sanskrit_iast:
parivāraṃ vinā mantraiḥ svaiḥ svaiḥ puṣpānulepanaiḥ |
layayāgo hyayaṃ vipra lakṣmyādiṣvanukīrtitaḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
परिवारं विना मन्त्रैः स्वैः स्वैः पुष्पानुलेपनैः |
लययागो ह्ययं विप्र लक्ष्म्यादिष्वनुकीर्तितः || 79 ||
text_mt: without retinue, with their respective mantras, flowers, and unguents. / For this, O vipra, is proclaimed as the dissolution sacrifice regarding Lakṣmī and the others. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddhṛtkarṇikādhāre mūrtau vā yatra kutracit |
mūlamantraśarīrasthaṃ parivāraṃ yajetsadā || 80 ||
meaning:
तस्माद्धृत्कर्णिकाधारे मूर्तौ वा यत्र कुत्रचित् |
मूलमन्त्रशरीरस्थं परिवारं यजेत्सदा || 80 ||
text_mt: Therefore, in the receptacle of the pericarp of the heart, or in an image, or anywhere else, / he should always worship the retinue located in the body of the root-mantra. // 80

sanskrit_iast:
yāga eṣa layākhyastu saṃkṣiptassarvasiddhidaḥ |
mantrarāṭ karṇikāmadhye lakṣmyādyāḥ kesarādiṣu || 81 ||
meaning:
याग एष लयाख्यस्तु संक्षिप्तस्सर्वसिद्धिदः |
मन्त्रराट् कर्णिकामध्ये लक्ष्म्याद्याः केसरादिषु || 81 ||
text_mt: This sacrifice, called dissolution, is concise and yields all accomplishments. / Where the king of mantras is in the middle of the pericarp, Lakṣmī and the others are on the filaments and so forth, // 81

sanskrit_iast:
sākārāḥ kevalāssarve yatra bhogābhidhassa tu |
kevalena ca yāgena pṛthagbhūtena nārada || 82 ||
meaning:
साकाराः केवलास्सर्वे यत्र भोगाभिधस्स तु |
केवलेन च यागेन पृथग्भूतेन नारद || 82 ||
text_mt: and all are endowed with form and distinct, that is named [the sacrifice] of enjoyment. / And where the worship of the lotus and the others is performed by an isolated, // 82

sanskrit_iast:
pūjanaṃ kamalādīnāmadhikārābhidhassa tu |
sāṃprataṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ bhogayāgārthameva ca || 83 ||
meaning:
पूजनं कमलादीनामधिकाराभिधस्स तु |
सांप्रतं सर्वमन्त्राणां भोगयागार्थमेव च || 83 ||
text_mt: separate sacrifice, that is named [the sacrifice] of dominion, O Nārada. / Now, for the sake of the enjoyment sacrifice of all mantras, // 83

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpadme tu vibhāgena vinyāsamavadhāraya |
pūrvabhāge vibhorlakṣmīṃ kesarasthāṃ ca vinyaset || 84 ||
meaning:
हृत्पद्मे तु विभागेन विन्यासमवधारय |
पूर्वभागे विभोर्लक्ष्मीं केसरस्थां च विन्यसेत् || 84 ||
text_mt: comprehend the installation according to division in the lotus of the heart. / In the eastern part of the Lord, on a filament, he should install Lakṣmī; // 84

sanskrit_iast:
kīrttiṃ dakṣiṇatastasya pṛṣṭatastu jayāṃ hareḥ |
tasyaiva cottare bhāge māyāṃ kesaragāṃ nyaset || 85 ||
meaning:
कीर्त्तिं दक्षिणतस्तस्य पृष्टतस्तु जयां हरेः |
तस्यैव चोत्तरे भागे मायां केसरगां न्यसेत् || 85 ||
text_mt: Kīrti to the south of him, Jayā behind Hari, / and on the northern part of him he should install Māyā, residing on a filament. // 85

sanskrit_iast:
vidukṣvaṅgāni vinyasya kesareṣūpari dvija |
pūrvayāmyāntare viṣṇorhṛnmantraṃ viniveśya ca || 86 ||
meaning:
विदुक्ष्वङ्गानि विन्यस्य केसरेषूपरि द्विज |
पूर्वयाम्यान्तरे विष्णोर्हृन्मन्त्रं विनिवेश्य च || 86 ||
text_mt: Having installed the limbs in the intermediate directions upon the filaments, O twice-born, / and having placed the heart-mantra between the east and south of Viṣṇu, // 86

sanskrit_iast:
śiraḥpūrvottare dadyācchikhāṃ paścimadakṣiṇe |
paścimottaradiṅmadhye kavacaṃ vinyasedvibhoḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
शिरःपूर्वोत्तरे दद्याच्छिखां पश्चिमदक्षिणे |
पश्चिमोत्तरदिङ्मध्ये कवचं विन्यसेद्विभोः || 87 ||
text_mt: he should place the head in the north-east, the tuft in the south-west, / and he should install the armour of the Lord in the middle of the north-western direction. // 87

sanskrit_iast:
agrataḥ kesaroddeśe netraṃ dikṣvastrameva ca |
dakṣiṇe mantranāthasya padmapatre nṛkesarī || 88 ||
meaning:
अग्रतः केसरोद्देशे नेत्रं दिक्ष्वस्त्रमेव च |
दक्षिणे मन्त्रनाथस्य पद्मपत्रे नृकेसरी || 88 ||
text_mt: In front, in the region of the filament, the eye; and the weapon in the [four cardinal] directions. / On the lotus-petal to the south of the lord of mantras, the Man-Lion; // 88

sanskrit_iast:
kapilaḥ paścimenyasyo varāhaścottare dale |
kaustubhaṃ vanamālāṃ ca vibhoḥ pūrvadalāntare || 89 ||
meaning:
कपिलः पश्चिमेन्यस्यो वराहश्चोत्तरे दले |
कौस्तुभं वनमालां च विभोः पूर्वदलान्तरे || 89 ||
text_mt: Kapila is to be installed in the west, and the Boar on the northern petal; / the Kaustubha and the garland of forest flowers in the middle of the eastern petal of the Lord; // 89

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsihmakroḍamantrābhyāṃ samīpe taddaladvaye |
padmaśaṅkhau tu vinyasya gadācakre tathaiva ca || 90 ||
meaning:
नृसिह्मक्रोडमन्त्राभ्यां समीपे तद्दलद्वये |
पद्मशङ्खौ तु विन्यस्य गदाचक्रे तथैव च || 90 ||
text_mt: on the two petals near those of the mantras of the Man-Lion and the Boar, / having installed the lotus and conch, and likewise the mace and discus; // 90

sanskrit_iast:
samīpe ratnamālāṃ ca garuḍaṃ nātidūrataḥ |
pāśaṃ ca tatsamīpe tu gadāyā nikaṭe'ṅkuśam || 91 ||
meaning:
समीपे रत्नमालां च गरुडं नातिदूरतः |
पाशं च तत्समीपे तु गदाया निकटेऽङ्कुशम् || 91 ||
text_mt: and nearby, the necklace of gems, and Garuḍa not too far away; / the noose near it, and the goad close to the mace. // 91

sanskrit_iast:
aniruddhādyupāṅgāni patrāgreṣu tu vinyaset |
p. 104) saummāpyadakṣiṇe pūrve karṇikāsaṃsthitasya ca || 92 ||
meaning:
अनिरुद्धाद्युपाङ्गानि पत्राग्रेषु तु विन्यसेत् |
प्. 104) सौम्माप्यदक्षिणे पूर्वे कर्णिकासंस्थितस्य च || 92 ||
text_mt: He should install the secondary limbs such as Aniruddha on the tips of the petals; / on the north, west, south, and east of the one situated on the pericarp, // 92

sanskrit_iast:
tadīśapatrādārabhya dalāgreṣu caturṣvapi |
satyamantraṃ tu vinyasya yāvadvāyudalāvadhi || 93 ||
meaning:
तदीशपत्रादारभ्य दलाग्रेषु चतुर्ष्वपि |
सत्यमन्त्रं तु विन्यस्य यावद्वायुदलावधि || 93 ||
text_mt: and having installed the Satyamantra on all four petal-tips, / beginning from its north-eastern petal up to the limit of the wind-petal. // 93

sanskrit_iast:
brahmarandhrādviniṣkrānte mūlamantrasya nārada |
prabhānāle nirādhāre pracaradraśmipallave || 94 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मरन्ध्राद्विनिष्क्रान्ते मूलमन्त्रस्य नारद |
प्रभानाले निराधारे प्रचरद्रश्मिपल्लवे || 94 ||
text_mt: Having emerged from the aperture of Brahman of the root-mantra, O Nārada, / upon a stalk of light, supportless, with shoots of radiant rays spreading, // 94

sanskrit_iast:
ānandakesarākīrṇe mahānandākhyakarṇike |
nyasetsaptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ niṣkalaṃ tu ca kevalam || 95 ||
meaning:
आनन्दकेसराकीर्णे महानन्दाख्यकर्णिके |
न्यसेत्सप्ताक्षरं मन्त्रं निष्कलं तु च केवलम् || 95 ||
text_mt: crowded with filaments of bliss, whose pericarp is called great bliss, / he should install the seven-syllable mantra, formless and pure. // 95

sanskrit_iast:
yadvai tadbhāvabhāvitvametāvattasya pūjanam |
saṅkalpajanitairbhogairvikalpapadavartibhiḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
यद्वै तद्भावभावित्वमेतावत्तस्य पूजनम् |
सङ्कल्पजनितैर्भोगैर्विकल्पपदवर्तिभिः || 96 ||
text_mt: To the extent that there is immersion in that state, such is his worship. / With objects of enjoyment produced by mental resolve, belonging to the plane of conceptual thought, // 96

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ syātpūjanaṃ tasya yatastebhyaḥ sthitaḥ pare |
nyasyaivaṃ mantrasaṅghaṃ tu pūrvavatpūjayetkramāt || 97 ||
meaning:
कथं स्यात्पूजनं तस्य यतस्तेभ्यः स्थितः परे |
न्यस्यैवं मन्त्रसङ्घं तु पूर्ववत्पूजयेत्क्रमात् || 97 ||
text_mt: how could there be worship of him, since he stands beyond them? / Having thus installed the collection of mantras, he should worship them in sequence as before, // 97

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaikaikaṃ svamantreṇa taddhyānamavadhāraya |
bhogasthāne ca mantrāṇāṃ yatsadā saṃprayojayet || 98 ||
meaning:
ध्यात्वैकैकं स्वमन्त्रेण तद्ध्यानमवधारय |
भोगस्थाने च मन्त्राणां यत्सदा संप्रयोजयेत् || 98 ||
text_mt: having contemplated each one with its own mantra. Comprehend that visualization / which he should always apply in the locus of enjoyment of the mantras. // 98

sanskrit_iast:
yatpūrvaṃ kathitaṃ rūpaṃ mantrāṇāṃ niṣkalaṃ mayā |
sakalena bahisthena churitaṃ bhāvayettataḥ || 99 ||
meaning:
यत्पूर्वं कथितं रूपं मन्त्राणां निष्कलं मया |
सकलेन बहिस्थेन छुरितं भावयेत्ततः || 99 ||
text_mt: The formless nature of the mantras that was previously described by me— / he should then conceive it as overlaid with the formed [nature] situated outside, // 99

sanskrit_iast:
nirmalaṃ sphaṭikaṃ yadvaduparāgeṇa kenacit |
sphaṭikaṃ coparāgasya nāntaraṃ saṃviśedyathā || 100 ||
meaning:
निर्मलं स्फटिकं यद्वदुपरागेण केनचित् |
स्फटिकं चोपरागस्य नान्तरं संविशेद्यथा || 100 ||
text_mt: just as pure crystal [is overlaid] by some tint; / and just as the crystal does not enter into the interior of the tint, // 100

sanskrit_iast:
uparāgastvanicchātassaṃviśetsphaṭikāntaram |
evaṃ hi sakalaṃ rūpaṃ niṣkalena saha smaret || 101 ||
meaning:
उपरागस्त्वनिच्छातस्संविशेत्स्फटिकान्तरम् |
एवं हि सकलं रूपं निष्कलेन सह स्मरेत् || 101 ||
text_mt: yet the tint, without intention, enters into the interior of the crystal, / even so he should remember the formed state together with the formless. // 101

sanskrit_iast:
bhogasthānagatasyaiva viddhi taccobhayātmakam |
adhikārapadasthasya mantrasya munisattama || 102 ||
meaning:
भोगस्थानगतस्यैव विद्धि तच्चोभयात्मकम् |
अधिकारपदस्थस्य मन्त्रस्य मुनिसत्तम || 102 ||
text_mt: Know that this belonging to the locus of enjoyment has both natures. / For the mantra situated in the plane of dominion, O best of sages, // 102

sanskrit_iast:
sakalaṃ yojayeddhyānaṃ tasya hṛptadmamadhyagam |
nirādhārasthitaṃ dhyāyettadrūpaṃ niṣkalaṃ tu tat || 103 ||
meaning:
सकलं योजयेद्ध्यानं तस्य हृप्तद्ममध्यगम् |
निराधारस्थितं ध्यायेत्तद्रूपं निष्कलं तु तत् || 103 ||
text_mt: he should apply formed meditation, going into the middle of its heart-lotus; / but he should meditate on that formless nature as resting without support. // 103

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnātmabhyāṃ tatastābhyāmekatvena sthitiṃ purā |
iti cetasi vai kṛtvā tatassaṃpūjayeddvija || 104 ||
meaning:
भिन्नात्मभ्यां ततस्ताभ्यामेकत्वेन स्थितिं पुरा |
इति चेतसि वै कृत्वा ततस्संपूजयेद्द्विज || 104 ||
text_mt: Having previously resolved in mind that they abide in unity, / though their natures are distinct, he should then perform worship, O twice-born. // 104

sanskrit_iast:
pādapaśca yathā bhaumairguṇairdūratare sthitaḥ |
pādapīyairguṇaistadvaddūre tiṣṭhati medinī || 105 ||
meaning:
पादपश्च यथा भौमैर्गुणैर्दूरतरे स्थितः |
पादपीयैर्गुणैस्तद्वद्दूरे तिष्ठति मेदिनी || 105 ||
text_mt: Just as a tree stands far away from earthy qualities, / and likewise the earth stands far away from qualities of the tree, // 105

sanskrit_iast:
sakalākalamantrābhyāmavinābhāva īdṛśaḥ |
kevalātsakalāddhyānātpadasiddhirna jāyate || 106 ||
meaning:
सकलाकलमन्त्राभ्यामविनाभाव ईदृशः |
केवलात्सकलाद्ध्यानात्पदसिद्धिर्न जायते || 106 ||
text_mt: such is the inseparable connection between the formed and formless mantras. / From mere meditation on the formed, the attainment of the state does not arise; // 106

sanskrit_iast:
p. 105) svabhāvaniṣkalānmantrāttadvaddūre ca siddhayaḥ |
ata eva kramāddhyātaiḥ pūjitaistoṣitaistataḥ || 107 ||
meaning:
प्. 105) स्वभावनिष्कलान्मन्त्रात्तद्वद्दूरे च सिद्धयः |
अत एव क्रमाद्ध्यातैः पूजितैस्तोषितैस्ततः || 107 ||
text_mt: likewise, attainments are far removed from a mantra that is purely formless by nature. / Therefore, after they have been meditated upon in order, worshipped, and propitiated, // 107

sanskrit_iast: [viśeṣapūjanam]
meaning: [विशेषपूजनम्]

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣapūjanaṃ vipra kalpayedacyutasya tu |
sauvarṇapuṣpasaṃpūrṇamañjaliṃ saṃprasārya ca || 108 ||
meaning:
विशेषपूजनं विप्र कल्पयेदच्युतस्य तु |
सौवर्णपुष्पसंपूर्णमञ्जलिं संप्रसार्य च || 108 ||
text_mt: he should perform the special worship of Acyuta, O vipra. / And having extended his joined palms filled with golden flowers, // 108

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantraṃ samuccārya prayatnātpūrakādibhiḥ |
dīrghaghaṇṭāravaprakhyaṃ yāvattatsaṃbhavāvadhi || 109 ||
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रं समुच्चार्य प्रयत्नात्पूरकादिभिः |
दीर्घघण्टारवप्रख्यं यावत्तत्संभवावधि || 109 ||
text_mt: and having enunciated the root-mantra with effort through inhalation and the rest, / resembling the prolonged sound of a bell, as long as it can be produced, // 109

sanskrit_iast:
sphuradraśmicayākīrṇamagnyarkenduśataprabham |
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devamañcalau sannirodhayet || 110 ||
meaning:
स्फुरद्रश्मिचयाकीर्णमग्न्यर्केन्दुशतप्रभम् |
ध्यात्वा नारायणं देवमञ्चलौ सन्निरोधयेत् || 110 ||
text_mt: having contemplated God Nārāyaṇa, crowded with a mass of sparkling rays, / possessing the brilliance of a hundred fires, suns, and moons, he should confine [him] in his joined palms. // 110

sanskrit_iast:
tamañjaliṃ kṣipenmūrdhni tasminvai mantravigrahe |
arghyaṃ nivedayedbhūyaḥ punaḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ śubham || 111 ||
meaning:
तमञ्जलिं क्षिपेन्मूर्ध्नि तस्मिन्वै मन्त्रविग्रहे |
अर्घ्यं निवेदयेद्भूयः पुनः पुष्पाञ्जलिं शुभम् || 111 ||
text_mt: He should cast those joined palms onto the head of that mantra-body; / he should again offer arghya water, and once more an auspicious handful of flowers. // 111

sanskrit_iast:
mudrāṃ sandarśya mūlākhyāṃ mānasaṃ japamārabhet |
