saṃkhyāhīnaṃ yathāśakti ghaṇṭhākhyakaraṇena ca || 112 ||
meaning:
मुद्रां सन्दर्श्य मूलाख्यां मानसं जपमारभेत् |
संख्याहीनं यथाशक्ति घण्ठाख्यकरणेन च || 112 ||
text_mt: Having displayed the mudrā called the root, he should begin mental recitation, / without counting, according to his capacity, and by means of the performance called the bell. // 112

sanskrit_iast:
bhogasthānagatānāṃ ca lakṣmyādīnāṃ krameṇa ca |
manasā darśayenmudrāṃ japaṃ kuryātsakṛtsakṛt || 113 ||
meaning:
भोगस्थानगतानां च लक्ष्म्यादीनां क्रमेण च |
मनसा दर्शयेन्मुद्रां जपं कुर्यात्सकृत्सकृत् || 113 ||
text_mt: And in due order, for Lakṣmī and the others situated in the place of enjoyment, / he should mentally display the mudrā and perform recitation once each. // 113

sanskrit_iast:
srotramantraiḥ pavitraiśca stutvā samyakprasādayet |
evaṃ krameṇa viprendra kṛtvā yāgaṃ tu mānasam || 114 ||
meaning:
स्रोत्रमन्त्रैः पवित्रैश्च स्तुत्वा सम्यक्प्रसादयेत् |
एवं क्रमेण विप्रेन्द्र कृत्वा यागं तु मानसम् || 114 ||
text_mt: Having praised [them] with holy stream-mantras, he should properly propitiate [them]. / Having thus performed the mental sacrifice in due order, O best of Brahmins, // 114

sanskrit_iast: [atha mānasa homaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [अथ मानस होमप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Now the method of mental fire-oblation]

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ tathāvidhaṃ kuryānmokṣalakṣmīpradaṃ śubham |
nābhicakrāntarasthaṃ tu dhyāyedvanhigra(gṛ ?)haṃ mune || 115 ||
meaning:
होमं तथाविधं कुर्यान्मोक्षलक्ष्मीप्रदं शुभम् |
नाभिचक्रान्तरस्थं तु ध्यायेद्वन्हिग्र(गृ ?)हं मुने || 115 ||
text_mt: he should perform a homa of that kind, auspicious and bestowing the fortune of liberation. / He should meditate on the house of fire situated within the navel-circle, O sage, // 115

sanskrit_iast:
trikoṇaṃ triguṇenaiva avyaktenāvṛtaṃ pari |
dhyānāraṇiṃ tu nirmathya cidagnimavatārya ca || 116 ||
meaning:
त्रिकोणं त्रिगुणेनैव अव्यक्तेनावृतं परि |
ध्यानारणिं तु निर्मथ्य चिदग्निमवतार्य च || 116 ||
text_mt: triangular, enclosed entirely by the unmanifest consisting of the three guṇas. / And having churned the fire-stick of meditation and brought down the fire of consciousness, // 116

sanskrit_iast:
suśuddhaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ dīptaṃ sadaivordhvaśikhaṃ dvija |
vāsudevātmakaṃ yasmātsa vasatyantarātmasu || 117 ||
meaning:
सुशुद्धं संस्कृतं दीप्तं सदैवोर्ध्वशिखं द्विज |
वासुदेवात्मकं यस्मात्स वसत्यन्तरात्मसु || 117 ||
text_mt: pure, consecrated, blazing, always with upright flame, O twice-born, / having the nature of Vāsudeva, since he dwells within inner selves, // 117

sanskrit_iast:
proccarenmūlamantraṃ tu yāvacchabdasya gocaram |
tatrasthamāhareddivyamāhlādājyāmṛtaṃ param || 118 ||
meaning:
प्रोच्चरेन्मूलमन्त्रं तु यावच्छब्दस्य गोचरम् |
तत्रस्थमाहरेद्दिव्यमाह्लादाज्यामृतं परम् || 118 ||
text_mt: he should enunciate the root-mantra as far as the range of sound extends. / Remaining there, he should extract the divine, supreme nectar of ghee consisting of bliss, // 118

sanskrit_iast:
brahmasarpiḥsamudrādyannistaraṅgāptarisrutam |
gṛhītvā'mṛtamārgeṇa brahmarandhreṇa saṃviśet || 119 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मसर्पिःसमुद्राद्यन्निस्तरङ्गाप्तरिस्रुतम् |
गृहीत्वाऽमृतमार्गेण ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण संविशेत् || 119 ||
text_mt: which has flowed forth from the ocean of Brahman-ghee without waves, obtained [by him]. / Having taken [it] through the path of nectar, he should enter through the aperture of Brahman. // 119

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayānmadhyamārgeṇa cinmayena sadīptinā |
prollasantaṃ smarenmantraṃ brahmasaktyupabṛṃhitam || 120 ||
meaning:
हृदयान्मध्यमार्गेण चिन्मयेन सदीप्तिना |
प्रोल्लसन्तं स्मरेन्मन्त्रं ब्रह्मसक्त्युपबृंहितम् || 120 ||
text_mt: Through the central path from the heart, which consists of consciousness and is endowed with light, / he should remember the mantra flashing forth, augmented by the power of Brahman. // 120

sanskrit_iast:
p. 106) svakāraṇāgnau nābhisthe ya ūrdhvendhanavatsthitaḥ |
svabhāvadīptabrahmāgnau paritaścodarojvalam || 121 ||
meaning:
प्. 106) स्वकारणाग्नौ नाभिस्थे य ऊर्ध्वेन्धनवत्स्थितः |
स्वभावदीप्तब्रह्माग्नौ परितश्चोदरोज्वलम् || 121 ||
text_mt: It stands in its own causal fire situated in the navel, like upright fuel, / in the naturally blazing Brahman-fire, brilliant all around within the belly. // 121

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtvā mantraṃ tu tanmūrdhni patamānaṃ dvijāmbarāt |
cintayedamṛtaṃtvājyaṃ purā yaccāhṛtaṃ dvija || 122 ||
meaning:
स्मृत्वा मन्त्रं तु तन्मूर्ध्नि पतमानं द्विजाम्बरात् |
चिन्तयेदमृतंत्वाज्यं पुरा यच्चाहृतं द्विज || 122 ||
text_mt: Having remembered the mantra falling onto its summit from the sky, O twice-born, / he should contemplate the ghee, the nectar that was previously fetched, O twice-born, // 122

sanskrit_iast:
cidagnimeva santarpya nābhau mantrasvarūpiṇam |
jvālāgrāvasthitaṃ caiva bhūyo hṛtpaṅkaje smaret || 123 ||
meaning:
चिदग्निमेव सन्तर्प्य नाभौ मन्त्रस्वरूपिणम् |
ज्वालाग्रावस्थितं चैव भूयो हृत्पङ्कजे स्मरेत् || 123 ||
text_mt: satiating the fire of consciousness itself in the form of the mantra in the navel; / and situated at the tip of the flame, he should remember [it] again in the lotus of the heart. // 123

sanskrit_iast:
proccārayaṃśca mantreśaṃ plutaṃ dhyānasamanvitam |
kṛtvaivamekasandhānaṃ sthānadvayagatasya ca || 124 ||
meaning:
प्रोच्चारयंश्च मन्त्रेशं प्लुतं ध्यानसमन्वितम् |
कृत्वैवमेकसन्धानं स्थानद्वयगतस्य च || 124 ||
text_mt: And while enunciating the lord of mantras prolonged, accompanied by meditation, / having thus effected the unification of what is located in the two places, // 124

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇormantrasvarūpasya nānāmantrātmakasya ca |
sarvaṃ tu sanyasetpaścāttasminmantrakṛtaṃ ca yat || 125 ||
meaning:
विष्णोर्मन्त्रस्वरूपस्य नानामन्त्रात्मकस्य च |
सर्वं तु सन्यसेत्पश्चात्तस्मिन्मन्त्रकृतं च यत् || 125 ||
text_mt: of Viṣṇu whose essence is mantra and whose self consists of various mantras, / he should then deposit in him all that was produced by mantra. // 125

sanskrit_iast:
toyapuṣpākṣataiḥ pūrṇaṃ bhāvayeddakṣiṇaṃ karam |
tanmadhye niṣkalaṃ mantraṃ saṃsmaretkiraṇākulam || 126 ||
meaning:
तोयपुष्पाक्षतैः पूर्णं भावयेद्दक्षिणं करम् |
तन्मध्ये निष्कलं मन्त्रं संस्मरेत्किरणाकुलम् || 126 ||
text_mt: He should imagine his right hand full of water, flowers, and unhusked barley grains; / in the middle of it, he should remember the undivided mantra, filled with rays. // 126

sanskrit_iast:
yāgotthāṃ phalasaṃpattiṃ lakṣmīrupāṃ vicintya ca |
mūlamantraṃ samuccārya pāṇimadhye tathā smaret || 127 ||
meaning:
यागोत्थां फलसंपत्तिं लक्ष्मीरुपां विचिन्त्य च |
मूलमन्त्रं समुच्चार्य पाणिमध्ये तथा स्मरेत् || 127 ||
text_mt: And having contemplated the attainment of the fruit arising from sacrifice in the form of Lakṣmī, / having enunciated the root-mantra, he should likewise remember [it] in the middle of his hand. // 127

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaśca niṣkalaṃ mantraṃ tasyāmupari bhāvayet |
saśīrṣe jānunī bhūmau kṛtvā viṣṇornivedayet || 128 ||
meaning:
भूयश्च निष्कलं मन्त्रं तस्यामुपरि भावयेत् |
सशीर्षे जानुनी भूमौ कृत्वा विष्णोर्निवेदयेत् || 128 ||
text_mt: And again he should imagine the undivided mantra above it; / having placed his knees on the ground together with his head, he should offer [it] to Viṣṇu. // 128

sanskrit_iast:
prasādābhimukhenātha tena taccātmasātkṛtam |
bhāvanīyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha parituṣṭena cādarāt || 129 ||
meaning:
प्रसादाभिमुखेनाथ तेन तच्चात्मसात्कृतम् |
भावनीयं द्विजश्रेष्ठ परितुष्टेन चादरात् || 129 ||
text_mt: Then it should be meditated on, O best of Brahmins, as appropriated by him / who is disposed toward grace and fully pleased with respect. // 129

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ yo mānaso yāgo jarāvyādhibhayāpahaḥ |
pāpoghasargaśamano bhavābhāvakaro dvija || 130 ||
meaning:
अयं यो मानसो यागो जराव्याधिभयापहः |
पापोघसर्गशमनो भवाभावकरो द्विज || 130 ||
text_mt: This mental sacrifice, which removes fear of old age and disease, / which pacifies the flood of sins and produces the cessation of worldly existence, O twice-born, // 130

sanskrit_iast:
satatābhyāsayogena dehapātātpramocayet |
yastvevaṃ parayā bhaktyā sakṛdācarate naraḥ || 131 ||
meaning:
सतताभ्यासयोगेन देहपातात्प्रमोचयेत् |
यस्त्वेवं परया भक्त्या सकृदाचरते नरः || 131 ||
text_mt: through the practice of constant repetition, liberates [one] from the falling of the body. / But that person who performs [it] once with supreme devotion, // 131

sanskrit_iast:
kramoditena vidhinā tasya tuṣyāmyahaṃ mune |
yājakānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ pradhānatvena varttate || 132 ||
meaning:
क्रमोदितेन विधिना तस्य तुष्याम्यहं मुने |
याजकानां च सर्वेषां प्रधानत्वेन वर्त्तते || 132 ||
text_mt: according to the rule set forth in order—with him I am pleased, O sage; / and he exists as foremost among all sacrificers. // 132

sanskrit_iast:
tārayetsvapitṝnyātāneṣyāṃścaiva tu sāṃpratāt |
kiṃ punarnityayukto yastadbhāvagatamānasaḥ || 133 ||
meaning:
तारयेत्स्वपितॄन्यातानेष्यांश्चैव तु सांप्रतात् |
किं पुनर्नित्ययुक्तो यस्तद्भावगतमानसः || 133 ||
text_mt: He delivers his ancestors of the past, and those of the future from the present onward; / what then of him who is constantly disciplined, whose mind has attained his state, // 133

sanskrit_iast:
mantrārādhanamārgasthaśraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ |
na tasya punarāvṛttissa yāti paramaṃ padam || 134 ||
meaning:
मन्त्राराधनमार्गस्थश्रद्धाभक्तिसमन्वितः |
न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिस्स याति परमं पदम् || 134 ||
text_mt: who stands upon the path of mantra-worship, endowed with faith and devotion? / For him there is no return; he goes to the supreme abode. // 134

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvaivaṃ yatnato nityaṃ kuryādyāgaṃ tu mānasam |
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mayoktaṃ te'dya nārada || 135 ||
meaning:
ज्ञात्वैवं यत्नतो नित्यं कुर्याद्यागं तु मानसम् |
इदं रहस्यं परमं मयोक्तं तेऽद्य नारद || 135 ||
text_mt: Knowing this, one should always perform the mental sacrifice with effort. / This supreme secret has been spoken by me to you today, O Nārada. // 135

sanskrit_iast:
p. 107) nāśiṣyāṇāṃ ca vaktavyaṃ nābhaktānāṃ kadācana |
atyantabhavabhītānāṃ bhaktānāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 136 ||
meaning:
प्. 107) नाशिष्याणां च वक्तव्यं नाभक्तानां कदाचन |
अत्यन्तभवभीतानां भक्तानां भावितात्मनाम् || 136 ||
text_mt: It should not be spoken to non-disciples, nor ever to the non-devoted; / to those terrified of worldly existence, devoted, whose minds are cultured, // 136

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ rahasyaṃ vaktavyaṃ samyagbhāvaṃ parīkṣya ca |
meaning: इदं रहस्यं वक्तव्यं सम्यग्भावं परीक्ष्य च |
text_mt: this secret should be spoken, after having thoroughly examined their disposition.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ mānasayāgo nāma dvādaśaḥ
paṭalaḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां मानसयागो नाम द्वादशः
पटलः || 12 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the twelfth chapter, called The Mental Sacrifice, in the venerable Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the Pāñcarātra. // 12

sanskrit_iast: atha bāhyayāgākhyānaṃ nāma trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: अथ बाह्ययागाख्यानं नाम त्रयोदशः पटलः
text_mt: Now the thirteenth chapter, called The Account of External Sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast:
purā'nena vidhānena kṛtvā yāgaṃ tu mānasam |
karmaṇā bhaktiyuktena maṇḍalasthaṃ yajettataḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
पुराऽनेन विधानेन कृत्वा यागं तु मानसम् |
कर्मणा भक्तियुक्तेन मण्डलस्थं यजेत्ततः || 1 ||
text_mt: Having first performed the mental sacrifice according to this procedure, / he should then worship [him] situated in the maṇḍala through devotion-filled ritual. // 1

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamadhye ya iṣṭo mantragaṇaḥ purā |
prasphurantaṃ tamatraiva prāṇāpānagataṃ smaret || 2 ||
meaning:
हृत्पुण्डरीकमध्ये य इष्टो मन्त्रगणः पुरा |
प्रस्फुरन्तं तमत्रैव प्राणापानगतं स्मरेत् || 2 ||
text_mt: The assembly of mantras that was previously worshipped in the middle of the heart-lotus, / he should remember that flashing forth right here, located in the prāṇa and apāna breaths. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
visarjayenna taṃ yāvanna kṛtā bāhyataḥ kriyāḥ |
nyasanīyo hyayaṃ yasmādarghyapātre dvijottama || 3 ||
meaning:
विसर्जयेन्न तं यावन्न कृता बाह्यतः क्रियाः |
न्यसनीयो ह्ययं यस्मादर्घ्यपात्रे द्विजोत्तम || 3 ||
text_mt: He should not dismiss it as long as the external rites have not been performed, / for this is to be deposited in the arghya vessel, O best of Brahmins, // 3

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍale hyakṣasūtre ca kuṇḍamadhyagate'nale |
meaning: मण्डले ह्यक्षसूत्रे च कुण्डमध्यगतेऽनले |
text_mt: in the maṇḍala, on the rosary, and in the fire situated within the pit.

sanskrit_iast: [praśnaprativacanamukhena bāhyayāgasyāvaśyakatvanirūpaṇam]
meaning: [प्रश्नप्रतिवचनमुखेन बाह्ययागस्यावश्यकत्वनिरूपणम्]
text_mt: [Determination of the necessity of external sacrifice by way of question and answer]

sanskrit_iast: [nāradaḥ]
meaning: [नारदः]

sanskrit_iast: bhagavaṃstvatprasādena jñāto hyajñānanāśanaḥ || 4 ||
meaning: भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन ज्ञातो ह्यज्ञाननाशनः || 4 ||
text_mt: O Blessed One, by your grace, that which destroys ignorance has indeed been understood, // 4

sanskrit_iast:
jñānavijñānasahito hṛdyāgassarvasiddhidaḥ |
kimarthaṃ bāhyataḥ pūjā kāryā vai maṇḍalāntare || 5 ||
meaning:
ज्ञानविज्ञानसहितो हृद्यागस्सर्वसिद्धिदः |
किमर्थं बाह्यतः पूजा कार्या वै मण्डलान्तरे || 5 ||
text_mt: the sacrifice in the heart, accompanied by knowledge and discernment, bestowing all accomplishments. / For what purpose must worship be performed externally within a maṇḍala? // 5

sanskrit_iast: etadācakṣva bhagavaṃstatra me saṃśayo mahān |
meaning: एतदाचक्ष्व भगवंस्तत्र मे संशयो महान् |
text_mt: Explain this, O Blessed One; herein lies my great doubt.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast: bāhyotthā vāsanā vipra bahujanmārjitā dṛḍhā || 6 ||
meaning: बाह्योत्था वासना विप्र बहुजन्मार्जिता दृढा || 6 ||
text_mt: The latent trace arising from the external is firm, O Brahmin, accumulated over many births; // 6

sanskrit_iast:
lolīkṛto'nayā hyātmā śuddho'śuddhasvarūpayā |
yā mantraviṣayā śuddhā kriyā śāntasvarūpadā || 7 ||
meaning:
लोलीकृतोऽनया ह्यात्मा शुद्धोऽशुद्धस्वरूपया |
या मन्त्रविषया शुद्धा क्रिया शान्तस्वरूपदा || 7 ||
text_mt: by this [trace], whose nature is impure, the pure self is made agitated. / That pure ritual having mantra as its object, which bestows a peaceful nature— // 7

sanskrit_iast:
samutthānavināśārthamasyāssā saṃprakīrtitā |
sa bāhyābhyantarābhyāṃ ca kriyābhyāṃ tanmayo bhavet || 8 ||
meaning:
समुत्थानविनाशार्थमस्यास्सा संप्रकीर्तिता |
स बाह्याभ्यन्तराभ्यां च क्रियाभ्यां तन्मयो भवेत् || 8 ||
text_mt: it is proclaimed for the sake of the destruction of the rise of that [latent trace]. / By both external and internal rituals, he becomes identical with that. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍhotthavāsanānāṃ ca tānavaṃ syācchanaiśśanaiḥ |
yanmayassādhako vipra dehasthassāṃprato bhavet || 9 ||
meaning:
दृढोत्थवासनानां च तानवं स्याच्छनैश्शनैः |
यन्मयस्साधको विप्र देहस्थस्सांप्रतो भवेत् || 9 ||
text_mt: And there will be gradual thinning of firmly arisen latent traces. / Having become identical with that which the practitioner now is while residing in the body, O Brahmin, // 9

sanskrit_iast: tanmayo dehapātātsyādityetatkathitaṃ mayā |
meaning: तन्मयो देहपातात्स्यादित्येतत्कथितं मया |
text_mt: he will become identical with that upon the fall of the body; thus has this been declared by me.

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ-
meaning: नारदः-

sanskrit_iast: brūhi me devadeveśa maṇḍale yajanaṃ yathā || 10 ||
meaning: ब्रूहि मे देवदेवेश मण्डले यजनं यथा || 10 ||
text_mt: Tell me, O Lord of the gods of gods, how worship is done in the maṇḍala, // 10

sanskrit_iast: p. 108) svarūpaṃ maṇḍalasyāpi yadi sānugraho'si me |
meaning: प्. 108) स्वरूपं मण्डलस्यापि यदि सानुग्रहोऽसि मे |
text_mt: and also the nature of the maṇḍala, if you are gracious to me.

sanskrit_iast: śrī bhagavān
meaning: श्री भगवान्

sanskrit_iast: [maṇḍala vinyāsaḥ]
meaning: [मण्डल विन्यासः]

sanskrit_iast: śṛṇu maṇḍalavinyāsaṃ viṣṇoradbhutatejasaḥ || 11 ||
meaning: शृणु मण्डलविन्यासं विष्णोरद्भुततेजसः || 11 ||
text_mt: Hear the arrangement of the maṇḍala of Viṣṇu of wondrous splendour; // 11

sanskrit_iast:
pravakṣyāmi samāsena yena śreyo hyavāpsyasi |
parīkṣya vividhāmurvīṃ gandhavarṇassānvitām || 12 ||
meaning:
प्रवक्ष्यामि समासेन येन श्रेयो ह्यवाप्स्यसि |
परीक्ष्य विविधामुर्वीं गन्धवर्णस्सान्विताम् || 12 ||
text_mt: I shall explain [it] in brief, by which you will indeed attain the highest good. / Having examined the diverse ground, endowed with [pleasant] smell and colour, // 12

sanskrit_iast:
lāṅgalādyaiḥ purā yatnāskṛtvā tu pariśodhitām |
duṣṭaśalyavinirmuktāṃ hastibhāravatīṃ dṛḍhām || 13 ||
meaning:
लाङ्गलाद्यैः पुरा यत्नास्कृत्वा तु परिशोधिताम् |
दुष्टशल्यविनिर्मुक्तां हस्तिभारवतीं दृढाम् || 13 ||
text_mt: having previously purified it with effort by means of ploughs and the like, / freed from noxious bones and thorns, capable of bearing the weight of an elephant, firm, // 13

sanskrit_iast:
tatpṛṣṭhe maṇḍapaṃ kuryātsudhādhavalitaṃ śubham |
vitānakapatākābhirvastraiśca supariṣkṛtam || 14 ||
meaning:
तत्पृष्ठे मण्डपं कुर्यात्सुधाधवलितं शुभम् |
वितानकपताकाभिर्वस्त्रैश्च सुपरिष्कृतम् || 14 ||
text_mt: on its surface he should construct an auspicious pavilion, whitewashed with lime, / beautifully adorned with canopies, banners, and cloths. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādau lakṣayedbudhyā brahmasthānaṃ prayatnataḥ |
vṛkṣajām(?)unnatāṃ kuryādvediṃ yāga(ge ?)dvijādhikā(yatā?)m || 15 ||
meaning:
तत्रादौ लक्षयेद्बुध्या ब्रह्मस्थानं प्रयत्नतः |
वृक्षजाम्(?)उन्नतां कुर्याद्वेदिं याग(गे ?)द्विजाधिका(यता?)म् || 15 ||
text_mt: There he should first identify with care the Brahmasthāna through his intellect; / he should make an elevated altar born of trees […] for the sacrifice […]. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
astrābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā pañcagavyaṃ tu tejasā |
upalipyāgratassūtraṃ vedikāmabhimantrya ca || 16 ||
meaning:
अस्त्राभिमन्त्रितं कृत्वा पञ्चगव्यं तु तेजसा |
उपलिप्याग्रतस्सूत्रं वेदिकामभिमन्त्र्य च || 16 ||
text_mt: Having consecrated the five products of the cow with the astra-mantra through [spiritual] fire, / having smeared [the ground], and having first consecrated the cord and the altar, // 16

sanskrit_iast:
dadyātpūrvaparaṃ sūtraṃ tatra madhye ca nārada |
aṣṭahastaṃ tadarddhaṃ vā caturasraṃ tu sādhayet || 17 ||
meaning:
दद्यात्पूर्वपरं सूत्रं तत्र मध्ये च नारद |
अष्टहस्तं तदर्द्धं वा चतुरस्रं तु साधयेत् || 17 ||
text_mt: he should lay down the east-west cord in its middle, O Nārada; / he should construct a square of eight cubits or half of that. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
mānādardhārdhasūtreṇa brahmasthānasthitena ca |
digdvayānmadhyasūtraṃ tu cinhīkṛtya samaṃ yathā || 18 ||
meaning:
मानादर्धार्धसूत्रेण ब्रह्मस्थानस्थितेन च |
दिग्द्वयान्मध्यसूत्रं तु चिन्हीकृत्य समं यथा || 18 ||
text_mt: With a cord of one quarter of the measure located at the Brahmasthāna, / marking the middle cord from the two directions so that it is even, // 18

sanskrit_iast:
cinhācinhagataṃ sūtraṃ kṛtvā tadanu nārada |
ullaṅghyollaṅghya vai kuryāllāṃchane saumyayāmyage || 19 ||
meaning:
चिन्हाचिन्हगतं सूत्रं कृत्वा तदनु नारद |
उल्लङ्घ्योल्लङ्घ्य वै कुर्याल्लांछने सौम्ययाम्यगे || 19 ||
text_mt: having then drawn the cord from mark to mark, O Nārada, / crossing over repeatedly, he should make marks in the northern and southern directions. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
evamevāpare cinhe tadvattasmiṃśca digdvaye |
kuryāttenaiva sūtreṇa cinhāccinhagatena ca || 20 ||
meaning:
एवमेवापरे चिन्हे तद्वत्तस्मिंश्च दिग्द्वये |
कुर्यात्तेनैव सूत्रेण चिन्हाच्चिन्हगतेन च || 20 ||
text_mt: In the very same way at the other mark, likewise in those two directions, / he should do it with that very cord extending from mark to mark. // 20

sanskrit_iast:
prasāryorddhasthitaṃ sūtraṃ matsyasandhidvaye dvija |
dakṣiṇottaradigyātaṃ prākpūrvāparasaṃsthitam || 21 ||
meaning:
प्रसार्योर्द्धस्थितं सूत्रं मत्स्यसन्धिद्वये द्विज |
दक्षिणोत्तरदिग्यातं प्राक्पूर्वापरसंस्थितम् || 21 ||
text_mt: Extending the cord held above at the two fish-intersections, O twice-born, / running in the north-south direction, as previously established in the east-west direction, // 21

sanskrit_iast:
tato mānārdhasūtreṇa cinhayeddikcatuṣṭayam |
teṣu cinheṣu vai pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā taccātha sūtrakam || 22 ||
meaning:
ततो मानार्धसूत्रेण चिन्हयेद्दिक्चतुष्टयम् |
तेषु चिन्हेषु वै पृष्ठे कृत्वा तच्चाथ सूत्रकम् || 22 ||
text_mt: then with a cord of half the measure he should mark the four directions. / Placing that cord behind those marks, // 22

sanskrit_iast:
sallāṃchya koṇabhāgānvai pūrvatulyaistu lāṃchitaiḥ |
didgalasthena sūtreṇa tatassūtracatuṣṭayam || 23 ||
meaning:
सल्लांछ्य कोणभागान्वै पूर्वतुल्यैस्तु लांछितैः |
दिद्गलस्थेन सूत्रेण ततस्सूत्रचतुष्टयम् || 23 ||
text_mt: duly marking the corner sections with marks equal to the previous ones, / by means of the cord situated at the edge of the directions, then four cords // 23

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādvai kṣetrasidhyarthaṃ koṇātkoṇe ca nārada |
p. 109) samaiḥ padaistu tatkṣetraṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśadhā tataḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
दद्याद्वै क्षेत्रसिध्यर्थं कोणात्कोणे च नारद |
प्. 109) समैः पदैस्तु तत्क्षेत्रं कृत्वा षोडशधा ततः || 24 ||
text_mt: he should lay from corner to corner for the sake of establishing the field, O Nārada. / Then, having divided that field into sixteen with equal squares, // 24

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhistu padairmadhye padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet |
tadvadaṣṭāsu vai kuryādāśāsu kamalāṣṭakam || 25 ||
meaning:
चतुर्भिस्तु पदैर्मध्ये पद्ममष्टदलं लिखेत् |
तद्वदष्टासु वै कुर्यादाशासु कमलाष्टकम् || 25 ||
text_mt: he should draw an eight-petalled lotus in the center with four squares; / likewise he should make eight lotuses in the eight directions. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
dikṣu padmacatuṣkaṃ tu devīnāṃ pūjanāya ca |
vidukṣvanyāni catvāri satyāntā yeṣvavasthitāḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
दिक्षु पद्मचतुष्कं तु देवीनां पूजनाय च |
विदुक्ष्वन्यानि चत्वारि सत्यान्ता येष्ववस्थिताः || 26 ||
text_mt: The four lotuses in the cardinal directions are for worshipping the goddesses, / and the other four are in the intermediate directions, in which those ending with Satya are situated. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ madhye tu navamaṃ pūjyate yatra keśavaḥ |
madhyamaṃ kamalaṃ kṣetraṃ caturddhā bhrāmayenmune || 27 ||
meaning:
तेषां मध्ये तु नवमं पूज्यते यत्र केशवः |
मध्यमं कमलं क्षेत्रं चतुर्द्धा भ्रामयेन्मुने || 27 ||
text_mt: In the middle of them is the ninth, where Keśava is worshipped. / He should sweep [circles in] the central lotus-field fourfold, O sage: // 27

sanskrit_iast:
varjayitvā'ṣṭamāṃśaṃ tu vyoma tenārdhato bahiḥ |
bhramaṇenāntarasthena bhavati dvija karṇikā || 28 ||
meaning:
वर्जयित्वाऽष्टमांशं तु व्योम तेनार्धतो बहिः |
भ्रमणेनान्तरस्थेन भवति द्विज कर्णिका || 28 ||
text_mt: setting aside an eighth part, [that is] the space; by half beyond that, / by the innermost sweeping, O twice-born, the pericarp is formed; // 28

sanskrit_iast:
kesarāṇi dvitīyena tṛtīye patrasandhayaḥ |
patrāgrāṇi caturthena bhramaṇopari kalpayet || 29 ||
meaning:
केसराणि द्वितीयेन तृतीये पत्रसन्धयः |
पत्राग्राणि चतुर्थेन भ्रमणोपरि कल्पयेत् || 29 ||
text_mt: the filaments are formed by the second, the junctions of the petals in the third, / and he should fashion the tips of the petals upon the fourth sweeping. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
koṇātkoṇagataṃ tasminpadme sūtradvayaṃ kṣipet |
sūtrāṇāmantare bhūyaḥ kṣipetsūtrāṣṭhakaṃ tathā || 30 ||
meaning:
कोणात्कोणगतं तस्मिन्पद्मे सूत्रद्वयं क्षिपेत् |
सूत्राणामन्तरे भूयः क्षिपेत्सूत्राष्ठकं तथा || 30 ||
text_mt: In that lotus he should cast two cords running from corner to corner; / between the cords he should again cast eight cords in the same way. // 30

sanskrit_iast:
padmasandhisthasūtreṇa dikkrameṇa dalāṣṭakam |
bhrāmya vṛttārthayogena evamanye bahisthitāḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
पद्मसन्धिस्थसूत्रेण दिक्क्रमेण दलाष्टकम् |
भ्राम्य वृत्तार्थयोगेन एवमन्ये बहिस्थिताः || 31 ||
text_mt: With the cord situated at the junction of the petals, [he forms] the eight petals in the order of the directions; / having swept them by the use of half-circles, in this way the others situated outside, // 31

sanskrit_iast:
padmāḥ kāryāḥ prayatnena susamāśca parasparam |
caturdhā keśarāṃśaṃ tu patre patre vibhajya ca || 32 ||
meaning:
पद्माः कार्याः प्रयत्नेन सुसमाश्च परस्परम् |
चतुर्धा केशरांशं तु पत्रे पत्रे विभज्य च || 32 ||
text_mt: the lotuses should be made with effort, perfectly equal to one another. / Dividing the filament-portion into four on each petal, // 32

sanskrit_iast:
kesaratritayaṃ madhye ekaikena yathā bhavet |
saṃsaktanavapadme tu garbhasyārdhena vīdhikāḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
केसरत्रितयं मध्ये एकैकेन यथा भवेत् |
संसक्तनवपद्मे तु गर्भस्यार्धेन वीधिकाः || 33 ||
text_mt: so that there is a triad of filaments in the middle by each [division]; / in the nine conjoined lotuses, corridors [are made] by half of the interior. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāya vīdhivistārān ṣaḍaṃśaṃ vā'tha pañcakam |
tena padmasamūhasya caturaśraṃ likhedbahiḥ || 34 ||
meaning:
आधाय वीधिविस्तारान् षडंशं वाऽथ पञ्चकम् |
तेन पद्मसमूहस्य चतुरश्रं लिखेद्बहिः || 34 ||
text_mt: Fixing the width of the corridors to a sixth or a fifth part, / by that he should draw a square on the outside of the cluster of lotuses. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
tattridhā vibhajeddikṣu pīṭhaḥ syātpādagātrabhṛt |
digpadmaṃ parito dvāraṃ kuryāddikṣu caturṣvapi || 35 ||
meaning:
तत्त्रिधा विभजेद्दिक्षु पीठः स्यात्पादगात्रभृत् |
दिग्पद्मं परितो द्वारं कुर्याद्दिक्षु चतुर्ष्वपि || 35 ||
text_mt: He should divide it threefold in the cardinal directions; there should be a pedestal bearing feet and limbs. / He should make a doorway around the directional lotus in all four directions. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
tasminbhāgadvayenaiva karṇaṃ kuryāddvijottama |
caturbhirupakarṇaṃ tu koṇaṃ koṇaṃ bhavettataḥ || 36 ||
meaning:
तस्मिन्भागद्वयेनैव कर्णं कुर्याद्द्विजोत्तम |
चतुर्भिरुपकर्णं तु कोणं कोणं भवेत्ततः || 36 ||
text_mt: On it he should make an ear with two parts, O best of the twice-born, / and a subordinate ear with four; then there should be corner after corner. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
dvāviṃśatipadaiḥ pūrṇamekīkṛtya viśodhya ca |
viviktaṃ paścimadvāraṃ kuryādrekhāvivarjitam || 37 ||
meaning:
द्वाविंशतिपदैः पूर्णमेकीकृत्य विशोध्य च |
विविक्तं पश्चिमद्वारं कुर्याद्रेखाविवर्जितम् || 37 ||
text_mt: Completing it with twenty-two squares, joining and purifying [them], / he should make the secluded western doorway free of lines. // 37

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikāṃ pītavarṇena pītaraktena kesarān |
patrāṣṭakaṃ sitaṃ kuryādantarālaṃ nabhassamam || 38 ||
meaning:
कर्णिकां पीतवर्णेन पीतरक्तेन केसरान् |
पत्राष्टकं सितं कुर्यादन्तरालं नभस्समम् || 38 ||
text_mt: He should make the pericarp with the colour yellow, the filaments yellow-red, / the eight petals white, and the intervening space resembling the sky. // 38

sanskrit_iast:
p. 110) pītena pīṭhakoṇādi gātrakāṇyaruṇena tu |
sitaṃ dvāracatuṣkaṃ tu koṇātraktena bhūṣayet || 39 ||
meaning:
प्. 110) पीतेन पीठकोणादि गात्रकाण्यरुणेन तु |
सितं द्वारचतुष्कं तु कोणात्रक्तेन भूषयेत् || 39 ||
text_mt: With yellow [he should colour] the corners and other parts of the pedestal, but the limbs with red; / the four doorways should be white, and he should adorn each corner with red. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
bāhye rekhātrayaṃ dadyādraktapītāsitāntimam |
antaḥśaktigatenaiva svaraṣoḍaśakena ca || 40 ||
meaning:
बाह्ये रेखात्रयं दद्याद्रक्तपीतासितान्तिमम् |
अन्तःशक्तिगतेनैव स्वरषोडशकेन च || 40 ||
text_mt: On the outside he should draw three lines, ending in red, yellow, and black, / with the sixteen vowels adhering to the internal power. // 40

sanskrit_iast: [maṇḍale prakārabhedāḥ phalabhedāśca]
meaning: [मण्डले प्रकारभेदाः फलभेदाश्च]
text_mt: [Varieties of Maṇḍalas and Varieties of Their Fruits]

sanskrit_iast:
athavā dvādaśāraṃ tu dvādaśasvarabhāvitam |
aṣṭāraṃ vilikhennityaṃ nābhinemisamanvitam || 41 ||
meaning:
अथवा द्वादशारं तु द्वादशस्वरभावितम् |
अष्टारं विलिखेन्नित्यं नाभिनेमिसमन्वितम् || 41 ||
text_mt: Or else he should always draw [a wheel] of twelve spokes imbued with the twelve vowels, / or one of eight spokes, endowed with a hub and a rim, // 41

sanskrit_iast:
vargāṣṭakena vai vyāptā arā ṛjvassuśobhanāḥ |
cakranābhau likhetpadmaṃ pūrvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 42 ||
meaning:
वर्गाष्टकेन वै व्याप्ता अरा ऋज्वस्सुशोभनाः |
चक्रनाभौ लिखेत्पद्मं पूर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् || 42 ||
text_mt: with its straight, very beautiful spokes pervaded by the eight [consonant] groups. / In the hub of the wheel he should draw a lotus marked with the previously mentioned characteristics. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhodare'thavā lekhyaṃ paṅkajaṃ sumanoharam |
kaumodakyāṃ puro vā'pi bimbe vā kaustubhopame || 43 ||
meaning:
शङ्खोदरेऽथवा लेख्यं पङ्कजं सुमनोहरम् |
कौमोदक्यां पुरो वाऽपि बिम्बे वा कौस्तुभोपमे || 43 ||
text_mt: Or a very captivating lotus is to be drawn inside a conch, / or on the Kaumodakī, or in front, or on a disk resembling the Kaustubha, // 43

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpamālākṛtau vā'tha yathākāmāptaye mune |
svalāṃchanākṛtau yāge dadātyabhimataṃ viduḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
पुष्पमालाकृतौ वाऽथ यथाकामाप्तये मुने |
स्वलांछनाकृतौ यागे ददात्यभिमतं विदुः || 44 ||
text_mt: or in the form of a garland of flowers, for attaining whatever is desired, O sage; / in a sacrifice performed in the shape of his own emblem, the wise know it gives what is wished. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
navanābhau parāṃ siddhimaihikāmuṣmikīṃ labhet |
padmodare kṛte yāge sadā lakṣmīḥ pravardhate || 45 ||
meaning:
नवनाभौ परां सिद्धिमैहिकामुष्मिकीं लभेत् |
पद्मोदरे कृते यागे सदा लक्ष्मीः प्रवर्धते || 45 ||
text_mt: In a [maṇḍala] of nine hubs he obtains supreme perfection, both in this world and the next; / when the sacrifice is made in the interior of a lotus, fortune ever increases. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
cakramadhye bhavedrājyaṃ śatrupakṣakṣayaṅkaram |
śāntikarmaṇi vai śaṅkhe gadāyāṃ subhago bhavet || 46 ||
meaning:
चक्रमध्ये भवेद्राज्यं शत्रुपक्षक्षयङ्करम् |
शान्तिकर्मणि वै शङ्खे गदायां सुभगो भवेत् || 46 ||
text_mt: In the center of a wheel there will be kingship that destroys the faction of enemies; / in a conch for pacifying rites; on a mace one becomes fortunate; // 46

sanskrit_iast:
kaustubhe rājyalābhastu puṣṭirvai puṣpamaṇḍale |
eṣa padmodaro yāgaḥ padmādermadhyagaḥ smṛtaḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
कौस्तुभे राज्यलाभस्तु पुष्टिर्वै पुष्पमण्डले |
एष पद्मोदरो यागः पद्मादेर्मध्यगः स्मृतः || 47 ||
text_mt: on a Kaustubha there is acquisition of kingship; and prosperity in a flower-circle. / This sacrifice in the belly of a lotus is remembered as centered on lotuses and the like. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
[maṇḍalasyeva kumbha puṣpamaṇḍala sthaṇḍila pratimādīnāmapi
bāhyayāga pradeśatvavidhānam]
meaning:
[मण्डलस्येव कुम्भ पुष्पमण्डल स्थण्डिल प्रतिमादीनामपि
बाह्ययाग प्रदेशत्वविधानम्]
text_mt: [Injunction of the Pitcher, Flower-Circle, Mound, Image, etc., Like the Maṇḍala, as Places for External Sacrifice]

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvarṇakasaṃyuktastvanyaḥ kumbhodare śṛṇu |
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vā ghaṭaṃ dṛḍham || 48 ||
meaning:
नानावर्णकसंयुक्तस्त्वन्यः कुम्भोदरे शृणु |
सौवर्णं राजतं ताम्रं मृण्मयं वा घटं दृढम् || 48 ||
text_mt: Listen now to another [sacrifice] endowed with various colours, in the belly of a pitcher: / a firm pot of gold, silver, copper, or clay, // 48

sanskrit_iast:
kālamūlaistu rahitaṃ trāsaprāṇavivarjitam | (?)
kṣīrapūrṇa tu taṃ kuryāddadhnā vā gandhavāriṇā || 49 ||
meaning:
कालमूलैस्तु रहितं त्रासप्राणविवर्जितम् | (?)
क्षीरपूर्ण तु तं कुर्याद्दध्ना वा गन्धवारिणा || 49 ||
text_mt: free from black roots, devoid of cracks and flaws […]; / he should make it filled with milk, or curd, or perfumed water, // 49

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaratnauṣadhīgāḍhaṃ kuśadūrvāphalodaram |
siddhārthakākṣatopetaṃ kuṅkumodakabhāvitam || 50 ||
meaning:
सर्वरत्नौषधीगाढं कुशदूर्वाफलोदरम् |
सिद्धार्थकाक्षतोपेतं कुङ्कुमोदकभावितम् || 50 ||
text_mt: thick with all gems and medicinal herbs, with kuśa grass, dūrvā grass, and fruits inside, / accompanied by white mustard and unbroken grains, infused with saffron-water, // 50

sanskrit_iast:
praśastataruśākhābhiḥ komalābhiralaṅkṛtam |
śaṅkhasvastikapadmaiśca carcitaṃ candanena ca || 51 ||
meaning:
प्रशस्ततरुशाखाभिः कोमलाभिरलङ्कृतम् |
शङ्खस्वस्तिकपद्मैश्च चर्चितं चन्दनेन च || 51 ||
text_mt: adorned with tender branches of auspicious trees, / anointed with sandalwood and [marked with] conches, svastikas, and lotuses, // 51

sanskrit_iast:
p. 111) śobhitaṃ ca sitairvastraiḥ paṭṭaiścaiva sragādibhiḥ |
tanmadhye cāsanaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye tu janārdanaḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
प्. 111) शोभितं च सितैर्वस्त्रैः पट्टैश्चैव स्रगादिभिः |
तन्मध्ये चासनं पद्मं तन्मध्ये तु जनार्दनः || 52 ||
text_mt: beautified with white cloths, silk fillets, garlands, and the like. / In the middle of it is a lotus seat, and in the middle of that is Janārdana, // 52

sanskrit_iast:
vainateyoparisthastu lakṣmādyāḥ pūrvavatsthitāḥ |
saṃkṣepapūjanārthaṃ tu kumbhe yāgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 53 ||
meaning:
वैनतेयोपरिस्थस्तु लक्ष्माद्याः पूर्ववत्स्थिताः |
संक्षेपपूजनार्थं तु कुम्भे यागः प्रकीर्तितः || 53 ||
text_mt: situated upon Garuda, while Lakṣmī and the others stand as before. / For the purpose of condensed worship, the sacrifice is proclaimed to be in a pitcher. // 53

sanskrit_iast:
upalipya sthalaṃ vātha gomayena mṛdāmbhasā |
varttulaṃ parīyāttatra dadyādvā caturaśrakam || 54 ||
meaning:
उपलिप्य स्थलं वाथ गोमयेन मृदाम्भसा |
वर्त्तुलं परीयात्तत्र दद्याद्वा चतुरश्रकम् || 54 ||
text_mt: Or having smeared a spot of ground with cow-dung, earth, and water, / he should trace a circle there, or he should make a square, // 54

sanskrit_iast:
yathā kālodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pavitraiḥ kaṭamuktaye |
tatra saṃpūjayeddevamathavā munisattama || 55 ||
meaning:
यथा कालोद्भवैः पुष्पैः पवित्रैः कटमुक्तये |
तत्र संपूजयेद्देवमथवा मुनिसत्तम || 55 ||
text_mt: with pure seasonal flowers, to be released from affliction; / there he should worship the God, or else, O best of sages, // 55

sanskrit_iast:
ahataṃ susitaṃ vastraṃ dhūpagandhādivāsitam |
pṛṣṭhatastu sthale datvā tatropari yajeddharim || 56 ||
meaning:
अहतं सुसितं वस्त्रं धूपगन्धादिवासितम् |
पृष्ठतस्तु स्थले दत्वा तत्रोपरि यजेद्धरिम् || 56 ||
text_mt: having placed upon the ground behind [it] a brand-new, bright-white cloth / perfumed with incense, scents, and the like, he should worship Hari upon it. // 56

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāṃ kārayedvā'tha ghātumṛcchailadārujām |
sapadmaṃ kevalaṃ vā'tha bhadrapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet || 57 ||
meaning:
प्रतिमां कारयेद्वाऽथ घातुमृच्छैलदारुजाम् |
सपद्मं केवलं वाऽथ भद्रपीठं प्रकल्पयेत् || 57 ||
text_mt: Or he should have an image made of metal, clay, stone, or wood; / or he should fashion an auspicious seat, either with a lotus or plain; // 57

sanskrit_iast:
kevale toyamadhye vā dīpte'gnau dhūmavarjite |
sthitamāyatane vā'tha sākāraṃ parameśvaram || 58 ||
meaning:
केवले तोयमध्ये वा दीप्तेऽग्नौ धूमवर्जिते |
स्थितमायतने वाऽथ साकारं परमेश्वरम् || 58 ||
text_mt: or in pure water alone, or in a blazing fire free from smoke, / or [worship] the Supreme Lord possessing form as situated in a temple. // 58

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ surasiddhāvadhāritam |
ṛṣibhirmanujairvā'tha bhaktiyuktaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam || 59 ||
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रधरं विष्णुं सुरसिद्धावधारितम् |
ऋषिभिर्मनुजैर्वाऽथ भक्तियुक्तैः प्रतिष्ठितम् || 59 ||
text_mt: [worship] Viṣṇu holding the conch and discus, comprehended by the gods and siddhas, / or established by ṛṣis or humans filled with devotion. // 59

sanskrit_iast:
tanmūrtau ca svamantreṇa yajedāvāhanaṃ vinā |
bhūmiṣṭhe hyacale vipra pāṣāṇe cakralāṃcchite || 60 ||
meaning:
तन्मूर्तौ च स्वमन्त्रेण यजेदावाहनं विना |
भूमिष्ठे ह्यचले विप्र पाषाणे चक्रलांच्छिते || 60 ||
text_mt: And in his image he should worship with his own mantra, without invocation, / or on an immovable stone fixed in the earth, O Brahmin, marked with a discus, // 60

sanskrit_iast:
cale vā śaṅkhapadmākhyamudrābhirvipra mudrite |
tatropari yathāpūrvaṃ tathā saṃpūjayetprabhum || 61 ||
meaning:
चले वा शङ्खपद्माख्यमुद्राभिर्विप्र मुद्रिते |
तत्रोपरि यथापूर्वं तथा संपूजयेत्प्रभुम् || 61 ||
text_mt: or on a movable [stone] stamped with the signs named Conch and Lotus, O Brahmin; / upon it he should worship the Lord as before. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
ebhiryāgaparairmadhyādekaṃ niṣpādya yatnataḥ |
karmaṇā bhaktiyuktena pūjayetsarvakāmadam || 62 ||
meaning:
एभिर्यागपरैर्मध्यादेकं निष्पाद्य यत्नतः |
कर्मणा भक्तियुक्तेन पूजयेत्सर्वकामदम् || 62 ||
text_mt: Having carefully prepared one from among these [supports] dedicated to sacrifice, / he should worship the granter of all desires with ritual action endowed with devotion, // 62

sanskrit_iast: yathāśaktyupacāreṇa vibhavena tu vā mune |
meaning: यथाशक्त्युपचारेण विभवेन तु वा मुने |
text_mt: or with means according to his ability, O sage.

sanskrit_iast: [atha maṇḍale bāhyayāgaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [अथ मण्डले बाह्ययागप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Now, the procedure of the external sacrifice in the maṇḍala]

sanskrit_iast: arghyapātraṃ samādāya suvarṇarajatādijam || 63 ||
meaning: अर्घ्यपात्रं समादाय सुवर्णरजतादिजम् || 63 ||
text_mt: Having taken up an arghya-vessel made of gold, silver, or the like, // 63

sanskrit_iast:
śailaṃ mṛddārujaṃ vā'tha palāśāṃbujaparṇajam |
astrodakena prakṣālya lepayetkuṅkumādibhiḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
शैलं मृद्दारुजं वाऽथ पलाशांबुजपर्णजम् |
अस्त्रोदकेन प्रक्षाल्य लेपयेत्कुङ्कुमादिभिः || 64 ||
text_mt: or of stone, clay, or wood, or made of the leaves of palāśa or lotus, / washing it with astra-water, he should smear it with saffron and the like. // 64

sanskrit_iast: anekāṅgaṃ ca tatrārghyaṃ yojayedastrasaṃskṛtam |
meaning: अनेकाङ्गं च तत्रार्घ्यं योजयेदस्त्रसंस्कृतम् |
text_mt: And he should prepare therein the arghya consisting of many ingredients, consecrated with the astra.

sanskrit_iast: p. 112) [arghyadravyāṇi]
meaning: प्. 112) [अर्घ्यद्रव्याणि]

sanskrit_iast: siddhārthakāstilādūrvāssayavāssitataṇḍulāḥ || 65 ||
meaning: सिद्धार्थकास्तिलादूर्वास्सयवास्सिततण्डुलाः || 65 ||
text_mt: White mustard seeds, sesamum, dūrvā grass, barley, white unbroken rice, // 65

sanskrit_iast:
toyakṣīraphalopetā idamarghyamudāhṛtam |
āpyāyya mūlamantreṇa sudhāsandohamūrtinā || 66 ||
meaning:
तोयक्षीरफलोपेता इदमर्घ्यमुदाहृतम् |
आप्याय्य मूलमन्त्रेण सुधासन्दोहमूर्तिना || 66 ||
text_mt: accompanied by water, milk, and fruit: this is declared to be the arghya. / Having invigorated it with the root-mantra whose nature is an abundance of nectar, // 66

sanskrit_iast: [arghyasya viniyogaḥ]
meaning: [अर्घ्यस्य विनियोगः]

sanskrit_iast:
pātradvayasthitaṃ tena kṛtvā bhāgadvayaṃ mune |
ekasminniṣkalādhāre saṃsthitaṃ niṣkalātmakam || 67 ||
meaning:
पात्रद्वयस्थितं तेन कृत्वा भागद्वयं मुने |
एकस्मिन्निष्कलाधारे संस्थितं निष्कलात्मकम् || 67 ||
text_mt: having divided it into two parts placed in two vessels, O sage— / one residing in the partless vessel, of a partless nature, // 67

sanskrit_iast:
mantracakraṃ svavīryeṇa prasphurattacca vinyaset |
saṃsthāpya maṇḍalāgre tu pūjyaṃ puṣpādinā purā || 68 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रचक्रं स्ववीर्येण प्रस्फुरत्तच्च विन्यसेत् |
संस्थाप्य मण्डलाग्रे तु पूज्यं पुष्पादिना पुरा || 68 ||
text_mt: the circle of mantras, flashing with its own power, he should install; / having placed it before the maṇḍala, it is to be worshipped first with flowers and the like. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
dhāraṇādvitayenaiva agnīṣomamayena ca |
samyagdvitīyaṃ saṃskuryādyathāvadavadhāraya || 69 ||
meaning:
धारणाद्वितयेनैव अग्नीषोममयेन च |
सम्यग्द्वितीयं संस्कुर्याद्यथावदवधारय || 69 ||
text_mt: By means of the two dhāraṇās, consisting of fire and moon, / he should properly consecrate the second; hear [how] in due order: // 69

sanskrit_iast:
pracaṇḍakiraṇavrātairbhāskarīyairdahetpurā |
saṃcintya bhasmabhūtaṃ tu tataḥ pūrṇenduraśmibhiḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
प्रचण्डकिरणव्रातैर्भास्करीयैर्दहेत्पुरा |
संचिन्त्य भस्मभूतं तु ततः पूर्णेन्दुरश्मिभिः || 70 ||
text_mt: he should first burn [the substances] with the fierce rays belonging to the sun; / having meditated upon [them] as reduced to ashes, then, with the rays of the full moon, // 70

sanskrit_iast:
āpūryāmṛtakalloladhārāpātena nārada |
kāntimaccintayedbhūyo yaddagdhaṃ bhānunā tu vai || 71 ||
meaning:
आपूर्यामृतकल्लोलधारापातेन नारद |
कान्तिमच्चिन्तयेद्भूयो यद्दग्धं भानुना तु वै || 71 ||
text_mt: having flooded them with a falling stream of waves of nectar, O Nārada, / he should meditate again upon that which was burned by the sun as radiant. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantrādibhirmukhyairmantraistadabhimantrya ca |
badhvākāmadudhāṃ mudrāṃ sravantīṃ mantrasaṃyutām || 72 ||
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रादिभिर्मुख्यैर्मन्त्रैस्तदभिमन्त्र्य च |
बध्वाकामदुधां मुद्रां स्रवन्तीं मन्त्रसंयुताम् || 72 ||
text_mt: And having consecrated that with the principal mantras, beginning with the root-mantra, / having formed the wish-granting cow mudrā, flowing, accompanied by mantra, // 72

sanskrit_iast:
gorūpāṃ himaśailābhāṃ nirādhārapathasthitām |
gandhadigdhau karau kṛtvā arghyapātroddhṛtena ca || 73 ||
meaning:
गोरूपां हिमशैलाभां निराधारपथस्थिताम् |
गन्धदिग्धौ करौ कृत्वा अर्घ्यपात्रोद्धृतेन च || 73 ||
text_mt: having the form of a cow, resembling the snow-mountain, situated on the path without support; / having anointed both hands with perfume, with [water] taken from the arghya-vessel // 73

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalaṃ maṇṭapaṃ prokṣya yāgadravyāṇyaśeṣataḥ |
dāhayedastramantreṇa mūlena plāvayettataḥ || 74 ||
meaning:
मण्डलं मण्टपं प्रोक्ष्य यागद्रव्याण्यशेषतः |
दाहयेदस्त्रमन्त्रेण मूलेन प्लावयेत्ततः || 74 ||
text_mt: having sprinkled the maṇḍala, the pavilion, and all the sacrificial substances without exception, / he should burn [them] with the astra-mantra, and then inundate [them] with the root-mantra. // 74

sanskrit_iast:
nirmalo dravyasaṅghaśca yāgayogyo bhavettadā |
namaskṛtya tato viṣṇuṃ mūlamantraṃ samuccaret || 75 ||
meaning:
निर्मलो द्रव्यसङ्घश्च यागयोग्यो भवेत्तदा |
नमस्कृत्य ततो विष्णुं मूलमन्त्रं समुच्चरेत् || 75 ||
text_mt: Then the collection of substances becomes spotless and fit for sacrifice. / Having then bowed down to Viṣṇu, he should utter the root-mantra. // 75

sanskrit_iast: [dvārapūjā]
meaning: [द्वारपूजा]

sanskrit_iast:
svamūrtisaṃsthitaḥ pūjyaḥ puṣpairañjalisaṃsthitaiḥ |
arghyapātraṃ samādāya puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ vilepanam || 76 ||
meaning:
स्वमूर्तिसंस्थितः पूज्यः पुष्पैरञ्जलिसंस्थितैः |
अर्घ्यपात्रं समादाय पुष्पं धूपं विलेपनम् || 76 ||
text_mt: Abiding in his own form, he is to be worshipped with flowers held in joined palms. / Having taken up the arghya-vessel, [offering] flowers, incense, ointment, // 76

sanskrit_iast: dīpanaivedyaparyantaṃ dvāraṃ bāhyaṃ tato yajet |
meaning: दीपनैवेद्यपर्यन्तं द्वारं बाह्यं ततो यजेत् |
text_mt: up to lamp and food-offering, he should then worship the outer door.

sanskrit_iast: [dvāradevatāpūjā]
meaning: [द्वारदेवतापूजा]

sanskrit_iast: udumbarasya mūle tu bahirdvārasya madhyataḥ || 77 ||
meaning: उदुम्बरस्य मूले तु बहिर्द्वारस्य मध्यतः || 77 ||
text_mt: At the base of the threshold, in the middle of the outer door, // 77

sanskrit_iast:
p. 113) bhūmiṣṭhaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca pūjayettadanantaram |
dvāropari sthitāṃ lakṣmīmūrdhvasaṃsthaṃ udumbare || 78 ||
meaning:
प्. 113) भूमिष्ठं क्षेत्रपालं च पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् |
द्वारोपरि स्थितां लक्ष्मीमूर्ध्वसंस्थं उदुम्बरे || 78 ||
text_mt: p. 113) he should immediately thereafter worship Kṣetrapāla situated on the ground, / and Lakṣmī situated above the door, on the upper lintel; // 78

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇottaraśākhābhyāṃ mūle caṇḍapracaṇḍakau |
tadvajjayaṃ ca vijayaṃ bāhye dvārasya cāntare || 79 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणोत्तरशाखाभ्यां मूले चण्डप्रचण्डकौ |
तद्वज्जयं च विजयं बाह्ये द्वारस्य चान्तरे || 79 ||
text_mt: on the right and left jambs at the base, Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa, / and likewise Jaya and Vijaya, on the outside and the inside of the door; // 79

sanskrit_iast:
śākhādvayasya madhye tu vāmadakṣiṇataḥ kramāt |
gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ caiva pūjayettadanantaram || 80 ||
meaning:
शाखाद्वयस्य मध्ये तु वामदक्षिणतः क्रमात् |
गङ्गां च यमुनां चैव पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् || 80 ||
text_mt: in the middle of the two jambs, on the left and right in order, / he should immediately thereafter worship Gaṅgā and Yamunā. // 80

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva kramayogena dvārasyābhyantarasthitau |
nidhīśau śaṅkhapadmākhyāvarghyapuṣpādibhiryajet || 81 ||
meaning:
तेनैव क्रमयोगेन द्वारस्याभ्यन्तरस्थितौ |
निधीशौ शङ्खपद्माख्यावर्घ्यपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत् || 81 ||
text_mt: In that very same sequence, the two treasure-guardians named Śaṅkha and Padma / situated within the door, he should worship with arghya, flowers, and the like. // 81

sanskrit_iast: [yāgamaṃdirapraveśavidhiḥ]
meaning: [यागमंदिरप्रवेशविधिः]
text_mt: [Rule for entering the sacrifice chamber]

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvaiva dvārayāgaṃ tu tataḥ puṣpaṃ ca sammukham |
gṛhītvā'ṅguṣṭhapūrveṇa aṅgulītritayena tu || 82 ||
meaning:
कृत्वैव द्वारयागं तु ततः पुष्पं च सम्मुखम् |
गृहीत्वाऽङ्गुष्ठपूर्वेण अङ्गुलीत्रितयेन तु || 82 ||
text_mt: Having performed the sacrifice at the door, taking a flower in front / with the three fingers beginning with the thumb, // 82

sanskrit_iast:
abhimantrya tadastreṇa cakraṃ tadupari smaret |
niśitāraṃ jvaladrūpaṃ varṣantamanalāśanim || 83 ||
meaning:
अभिमन्त्र्य तदस्त्रेण चक्रं तदुपरि स्मरेत् |
निशितारं ज्वलद्रूपं वर्षन्तमनलाशनिम् || 83 ||
text_mt: consecrating it with the astra, he should visualize the discus above it, / sharp-spoked, blazing in form, raining fire and thunderbolts, // 83

sanskrit_iast:
kṣayakṛdvighnajālānāṃ kṣipedyāgagṛhāntare |
dakṣiṇāṃ tarjanīṃ vipra kuryādūrdhvamukhīṃ tataḥ || 84 ||
meaning:
क्षयकृद्विघ्नजालानां क्षिपेद्यागगृहान्तरे |
दक्षिणां तर्जनीं विप्र कुर्यादूर्ध्वमुखीं ततः || 84 ||
text_mt: the destroyer of all obstacles, and cast [it] into the sacrificial chamber. / Then, O Brahmin, he should point the right forefinger upwards, // 84

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāmantreṇa saṃyuktāṃ vidyudvilasitaprabhām |
smṛtvā bhrāmayamāṇastāṃ saṃviśedyāgamandiram || 85 ||
meaning:
शिखामन्त्रेण संयुक्तां विद्युद्विलसितप्रभाम् |
स्मृत्वा भ्रामयमाणस्तां संविशेद्यागमन्दिरम् || 85 ||
text_mt: joined with the śikhā-mantra, having the flashing brilliance of lightning; / visualizing it, turning it around, he should enter the sacrificial chamber. // 85

sanskrit_iast: [upaveśanaśeṣabhūtamāsanaprokṣaṇādi]
meaning: [उपवेशनशेषभूतमासनप्रोक्षणादि]
text_mt: [Sprinkling the seat and other preliminaries to sitting]

sanskrit_iast:
svāsanaṃ ca tataḥ prokṣya arghyapātrodakena ca |
sāstreṇa tāḍya puṣpeṇa tatpṛṣṭhe kramaśo dvija || 86 ||
meaning:
स्वासनं च ततः प्रोक्ष्य अर्घ्यपात्रोदकेन च |
सास्त्रेण ताड्य पुष्पेण तत्पृष्ठे क्रमशो द्विज || 86 ||
text_mt: Then, having sprinkled his own seat with the water from the arghya-vessel, / striking it with a flower accompanied by the astra, on its surface in order, O twice-born, // 86

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśaktipūrvaṃ tu mantrasaṅghaṃ prapūjayet |
upaviśya tataḥ paścāt
meaning:
आधारशक्तिपूर्वं तु मन्त्रसङ्घं प्रपूजयेत् |
उपविश्य ततः पश्चात्
text_mt: he should worship the collection of mantras beginning with Ādhāraśakti. / Having then sat down,

sanskrit_iast: [pūjanāṅgabhūtāvekṣaṇaprokṣaṇaviśeṣau]
meaning: [पूजनाङ्गभूतावेक्षणप्रोक्षणविशेषौ]
text_mt: [The special gaze and sprinkling as limbs of worship]

sanskrit_iast: hṛdayasthaṃ ca tatparam || 87 ||
meaning: हृदयस्थं च तत्परम् || 87 ||
text_mt: and that supreme // 87

sanskrit_iast:
tejo nārāyaṇākhyaṃ tu tatkuryānnetramadhyagam |
vāsudevābhidhānaṃ tu prāguktaṃ ca samāśrayet || 88 ||
meaning:
तेजो नारायणाख्यं तु तत्कुर्यान्नेत्रमध्यगम् |
वासुदेवाभिधानं तु प्रागुक्तं च समाश्रयेत् || 88 ||
text_mt: splendour situated in the heart, called Nārāyaṇa, he should bring into the centre of his eyes; / and he should resort to that named Vāsudeva which was spoken of before. // 88

sanskrit_iast:
nirīkṣya sakalaṃ samyakstabdhanetrayugena ca |
maṇḍalañcārghyapātraṃ tu punaḥ prokṣya kuśāmbhasā || 89 ||
meaning:
निरीक्ष्य सकलं सम्यक्स्तब्धनेत्रयुगेन च |
मण्डलञ्चार्घ्यपात्रं तु पुनः प्रोक्ष्य कुशाम्भसा || 89 ||
text_mt: Having looked upon everything thoroughly with unblinking eyes, / and having again sprinkled the maṇḍala and the arghya-vessel with kuśa-water, // 89

sanskrit_iast: [ādhāraśaktyādyāsanakalpanatatpūjanakramaḥ]
meaning: [आधारशक्त्याद्यासनकल्पनतत्पूजनक्रमः]
text_mt: [The procedure of fashioning and worshipping the seats beginning with Ādhāraśakti]

sanskrit_iast:
pūjanaṃ prārabhetpaścātsārdhyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ krameṇa tu |
p. 114) ādhāraśakterārabhya anusandhānapūrvakam || 90 ||
meaning:
पूजनं प्रारभेत्पश्चात्सार्ध्यैः पुष्पैः क्रमेण तु |
प्. 114) आधारशक्तेरारभ्य अनुसन्धानपूर्वकम् || 90 ||
text_mt: he should then begin the worship in order with flowers and arghya, / p. 114) starting from Ādhāraśakti, accompanied by meditation. // 90

sanskrit_iast:
yugāvasānaṃ prāk datvā sthūlaṃ mantrāsanāsanam |
tatrordhve madhyadeśe'pi prāguktavidhinā nyaset || 91 ||
meaning:
युगावसानं प्राक् दत्वा स्थूलं मन्त्रासनासनम् |
तत्रोर्ध्वे मध्यदेशेऽपि प्रागुक्तविधिना न्यसेत् || 91 ||
text_mt: Having first offered the gross seat of the mantras up to the end of the yuga, / above it, in the central region also, he should install [them] according to the previously stated rule: // 91

sanskrit_iast:
dviraṣṭakaṃ tu dharmādyaṃ kāntimatpararūpadhṛt |
tacca ṣoḍaśakaṃ nyasya bhūyo bhūyo digaṣṭake || 92 ||
meaning:
द्विरष्टकं तु धर्माद्यं कान्तिमत्पररूपधृत् |
तच्च षोडशकं न्यस्य भूयो भूयो दिगष्टके || 92 ||
text_mt: the twice-eight, beginning with dharma, radiant, bearing the supreme form. / And having installed that group of sixteen again and again in the eight directions, // 92

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmarūpadharaṃ vipra prākpadādīśagocaram |
padmādivanhiveśmāntamekaikasminnyasettataḥ || 93 ||
meaning:
सूक्ष्मरूपधरं विप्र प्राक्पदादीशगोचरम् |
पद्मादिवन्हिवेश्मान्तमेकैकस्मिन्न्यसेत्ततः || 93 ||
text_mt: assuming a subtle form, O Brahmin, from the east to the northeast, / from the lotus to the fire-enclosure, he should install them on each one. // 93

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva garbhadeśasthaṃ hyanusandhāya vinyaset |
bhāvāsanāvasānāntaṃ (naṃ tat ?) mantraiḥ svaissvairathārcayet || 94 ||
meaning:
तदेव गर्भदेशस्थं ह्यनुसन्धाय विन्यसेत् |
भावासनावसानान्तं (नं तत् ?) मन्त्रैः स्वैस्स्वैरथार्चयेत् || 94 ||
text_mt: Meditating on that very [group] situated in the central womb, he should install it; / up to the end of the bhāvāsana, he should then worship [them] each with their own mantras, // 94

sanskrit_iast: uparyupari yogena puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ |
meaning: उपर्युपरि योगेन पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः |
text_mt: one above the other in sequence, with flowers, incense, and ointments.

sanskrit_iast: [caturasrāyatamaṇḍalakalpanam]
meaning: [चतुरस्रायतमण्डलकल्पनम्]
text_mt: [Fashioning the rectangular maṇḍala]

sanskrit_iast: yugāvasāne pīṭhasya pṛṣṭhe vidhisamīpataḥ || 95 ||
meaning: युगावसाने पीठस्य पृष्ठे विधिसमीपतः || 95 ||
text_mt: At the end of the yuga, at the back of the seat, near the ritual enclosure, // 95

sanskrit_iast:
kalpanājanitaṃ kuryāccaturasrāyataṃ tataḥ |
maṇḍalaṃ devadevasya dakṣiṇe maṇḍalopari || 96 ||
meaning:
कल्पनाजनितं कुर्याच्चतुरस्रायतं ततः |
मण्डलं देवदेवस्य दक्षिणे मण्डलोपरि || 96 ||
text_mt: he should then make, generated by mental conception, an oblong rectangular / maṇḍala to the right of the God of gods, above the maṇḍala, // 96

sanskrit_iast: vāyavyakoṇādārabhya yāvadīśānagocaram |
meaning: वायव्यकोणादारभ्य यावदीशानगोचरम् |
text_mt: starting from the northwest corner up to the domain of the northeast.

sanskrit_iast: [gaṇeśādipūjanam]
meaning: [गणेशादिपूजनम्]

sanskrit_iast: tatrādau tu svamantreṇa gaṇeśaṃ pūjayetdvijaḥ || 97 ||
meaning: तत्रादौ तु स्वमन्त्रेण गणेशं पूजयेत्द्विजः || 97 ||
text_mt: There, first of all, the twice-born should worship Gaṇeśa with his own mantra; // 97

sanskrit_iast:
tato vāgīśvarīṃ devīṃ tadante garuḍaṃ yajet |
pūjayecca tato bhaktyā guruṃ paramasaṃjñitat || 98 ||
meaning:
ततो वागीश्वरीं देवीं तदन्ते गरुडं यजेत् |
पूजयेच्च ततो भक्त्या गुरुं परमसंज्ञितत् || 98 ||
text_mt: then the goddess Vāgīśvarī, and after that he should worship Garuda; / then with devotion he should worship the guru designated as supreme. // 98

sanskrit_iast:
parameṣṭhī tataḥ pūjyastataḥ pitṛgaṇaṃ yajet |
ādisiddhasamūhaṃ ca bhagavaddhyānatatparam || 99 ||
meaning:
परमेष्ठी ततः पूज्यस्ततः पितृगणं यजेत् |
आदिसिद्धसमूहं च भगवद्ध्यानतत्परम् || 99 ||
text_mt: Parameṣṭhin is then to be worshipped; then he should worship the host of ancestors / and the group of primordial siddhas intent on meditation on the Lord. // 99

sanskrit_iast: anujñāṃ prārthayettebhyo yathānukramameva ca |
meaning: अनुज्ञां प्रार्थयेत्तेभ्यो यथानुक्रममेव च |
text_mt: He should request permission from them in proper order.

sanskrit_iast: [hṛdayakamalādbhagavata āvāhana pūjanaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [हृदयकमलाद्भगवत आवाहन पूजनप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of invocation and worship of the Lord from the lotus of the heart]

sanskrit_iast: gṛhītvā śirasā tāṃ ca tata āvāhayetprabhum || 100 ||
meaning: गृहीत्वा शिरसा तां च तत आवाहयेत्प्रभुम् || 100 ||
text_mt: Receiving it with his head, he should then invoke the Lord. // 100

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhya mantreṇa mune mudrāyuktena bhaktitaḥ |
proccārya mūlamantraṃ tu hṛdayasthaṃ ca sarvagam || 101 ||
meaning:
आवाह्य मन्त्रेण मुने मुद्रायुक्तेन भक्तितः |
प्रोच्चार्य मूलमन्त्रं तु हृदयस्थं च सर्वगम् || 101 ||
text_mt: Invoking with the mantra, O sage, joined with the mudrā, with devotion, / and pronouncing the root-mantra residing in the heart and all-pervading, // 101

sanskrit_iast:
avatārya krameṇaiva recakena śanaiśśanaiḥ |
nāḍībhyāṃ sandhideśena nīrūpeṇāmalena ca || 102 ||
meaning:
अवतार्य क्रमेणैव रेचकेन शनैश्शनैः |
नाडीभ्यां सन्धिदेशेन नीरूपेणामलेन च || 102 ||
text_mt: gradually bringing [him] down very slowly with exhalation, / through the channels by the junction point, formless, taintless, // 102

sanskrit_iast:
kalpanārahitenaiva cidbhāvābhāsitena ca |
sarvagasya tato vipra sārghyaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ vibhoḥ || 103 ||
meaning:
कल्पनारहितेनैव चिद्भावाभासितेन च |
सर्वगस्य ततो विप्र सार्घ्यं पुष्पाञ्जलिं विभोः || 103 ||
text_mt: free from conceptual thought, and illuminated by the nature of consciousness; / then, O brahmin, [offering] to the all-pervading Lord an añjali of flowers with arghya, // 103

sanskrit_iast:
p. 115) nikṣipyāthomukhenaiva pāṇiyugmena mūrdhani |
layayāgoktavidhinā pūjayetprathamaṃ tataḥ || 104 ||
meaning:
प्. 115) निक्षिप्याथोमुखेनैव पाणियुग्मेन मूर्धनि |
लययागोक्तविधिना पूजयेत्प्रथमं ततः || 104 ||
text_mt: having cast [it] upon his head with both hands facing downwards, / he should then first worship according to the procedure taught for the dissolution sacrifice, // 104

sanskrit_iast: puṣpārghyalepanairdhūpairmūlamantrādibhiḥ kramāt |
meaning: पुष्पार्घ्यलेपनैर्धूपैर्मूलमन्त्रादिभिः क्रमात् |
text_mt: with flowers, arghya, unguents, and incenses, in order with the root-mantra and the rest.

sanskrit_iast: [lakṣmyādīnāṃ dhyānapūrvako nyāsakramaḥ]
meaning: [लक्ष्म्यादीनां ध्यानपूर्वको न्यासक्रमः]
text_mt: [The order of installation preceded by meditation on Lakṣmī and the others]

sanskrit_iast: tato bhagavato viṣṇorbhāsā bhāsvaravigrahāt || 105 ||
meaning: ततो भगवतो विष्णोर्भासा भास्वरविग्रहात् || 105 ||
text_mt: Then, from the Lord Viṣṇu whose form is radiant with light, // 105

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmyādīrnissṛtā dhyāyetsphuliṅganicayā yathā |
bhogasthāne yathāyogamekaikaṃ vinyasettataḥ || 106 ||
meaning:
लक्ष्म्यादीर्निस्सृता ध्यायेत्स्फुलिङ्गनिचया यथा |
भोगस्थाने यथायोगमेकैकं विन्यसेत्ततः || 106 ||
text_mt: he should meditate on Lakṣmī and the others emerging like hosts of sparks; / he should then install each one appropriately in the place of enjoyment. // 106

sanskrit_iast: [maṇḍale mantranyāsakramaḥ]
meaning: [मण्डले मन्त्रन्यासक्रमः]
text_mt: [The order of installation of mantras on the maṇḍala]

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalopari mantraṃ ca yathā tadavadhāraya |
ūrdhvataḥ padmamadhye tu yathā bhūtaṃ tathā nyaset || 107 ||
meaning:
मण्डलोपरि मन्त्रं च यथा तदवधारय |
ऊर्ध्वतः पद्ममध्ये तु यथा भूतं तथा न्यसेत् || 107 ||
text_mt: And comprehend how the mantra [is placed] upon the maṇḍala: / from above, in the middle of the lotus, he should install [it] just as it is, // 107

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantraṃ dvijaśreṣṭha mūrtiyuktaṃ tu pūrvavat |
tadagrasaṃsthite padme lakṣmīṃ vai karṇikāntare || 108 ||
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रं द्विजश्रेष्ठ मूर्तियुक्तं तु पूर्ववत् |
तदग्रसंस्थिते पद्मे लक्ष्मीं वै कर्णिकान्तरे || 108 ||
text_mt: the root-mantra endowed with the form as before, O best of the twice-born. / On the lotus situated in front of that, Lakṣmī indeed within the pericarp; // 108

sanskrit_iast:
kīrti dakṣiṇabhāgasthe pṛṣṭhage tu jayāṃ nyaset |
māyāṃ cottarapadme tu karṇikānte'tha vinyaset || 109 ||
meaning:
कीर्ति दक्षिणभागस्थे पृष्ठगे तु जयां न्यसेत् |
मायां चोत्तरपद्मे तु कर्णिकान्तेऽथ विन्यसेत् || 109 ||
text_mt: on the one on the southern side, Kīrti; on the one behind, he should install Jayā; / and on the northern lotus, within the pericarp, he should then install Māyā; // 109

sanskrit_iast:
āgneye hṛdayaṃ madhye śirastvīśānapaṅkaje |
śikhāṃ rākṣasadiṅmadhye kavacaṃ vāyugocare || 110 ||
meaning:
आग्नेये हृदयं मध्ये शिरस्त्वीशानपङ्कजे |
शिखां राक्षसदिङ्मध्ये कवचं वायुगोचरे || 110 ||
text_mt: in the south-east, the heart; in the middle of the north-eastern lotus, the head; / in the middle of the south-western quarter, the śikhā; in the reach of the north-west, the armour; // 110

sanskrit_iast:
atha madhyasthite padme devasya purato dale |
netramantraṃ vinyasettu vidikpatreṣu cāstrarāṭ || 111 ||
meaning:
अथ मध्यस्थिते पद्मे देवस्य पुरतो दले |
नेत्रमन्त्रं विन्यसेत्तु विदिक्पत्रेषु चास्त्रराट् || 111 ||
text_mt: then on the petal situated in front of the deity in the lotus located in the center, / he should install the eye-mantra, and the king of weapons on the petals of the intermediate directions. // 111

sanskrit_iast:
atraiva nārasihmākhyaṃ(dyaṃ ?) varāhāntatrayaṃ kramāt |
dikṣu patratrayaṃ(ye ?) viṣṇoryāmye pratyaktathottare || 112 ||
meaning:
अत्रैव नारसिह्माख्यं(द्यं ?) वराहान्तत्रयं क्रमात् |
दिक्षु पत्रत्रयं(ये ?) विष्णोर्याम्ये प्रत्यक्तथोत्तरे || 112 ||
text_mt: Here itself the triad beginning with Narasiṃha and ending with Varāha in order, / in the cardinal directions, on the three petals of Viṣṇu: in the south, in the west, and in the north. // 112

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīkamalayantrā(patrā ?)ṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ kaustubhaṃ nyaset |
tadvaddhṛtpaṅkajīyānāṃ vanamālāṃ niveśya ca || 113 ||
meaning:
लक्ष्मीकमलयन्त्रा(पत्रा ?)णां सर्वेषां कौस्तुभं न्यसेत् |
तद्वद्धृत्पङ्कजीयानां वनमालां निवेश्य च || 113 ||
text_mt: On all petals of Lakṣmī's lotus, he should install the Kaustubha; / likewise, having introduced the forest-garland on those belonging to the heart-lotus; // 113

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtipaṅkajapatrāṇāṃ padmamāhūya vinyaset |
śaṅkhaṃ śikhābjapatrāṇāṃ jayābje cakrameva ca || 114 ||
meaning:
कीर्तिपङ्कजपत्राणां पद्ममाहूय विन्यसेत् |
शङ्खं शिखाब्जपत्राणां जयाब्जे चक्रमेव च || 114 ||
text_mt: on the petals of Kīrti's lotus, invoking, he should install the lotus; / the conch on the petals of the śikhā's lotus, and the discus on Jayā's lotus; // 114

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu tatra padme tu patrasthāṃ vinyasedgadām |
māyāmbujacchade vipra nyasetpāśaṃ tato dvija || 115 ||
meaning:
ततस्तु तत्र पद्मे तु पत्रस्थां विन्यसेद्गदाम् |
मायाम्बुजच्छदे विप्र न्यसेत्पाशं ततो द्विज || 115 ||
text_mt: then on that lotus, he should install the mace situated on the petal; / on the petal of Māyā's lotus, O brahmin, he should then install the noose, O twice-born; // 115

sanskrit_iast:
śīrṣādhāre tu vai padme patrāṇāmaṅkuśaṃ tataḥ |
nyaseddvāracatuṣke tu samāhūya khageśvaram || 116 ||
meaning:
शीर्षाधारे तु वै पद्मे पत्राणामङ्कुशं ततः |
न्यसेद्द्वारचतुष्के तु समाहूय खगेश्वरम् || 116 ||
text_mt: on the lotus that is the base of the head, then the goad on its petals; / then in the four doorways, having invoked the lord of birds, // 116

sanskrit_iast:
p. 116) karṇikāyāṃ nyasetsatyaṃ hṛnmantrasya tato(tho ?)pari |
āśritya dakṣiṇaṃ bhāgamatha brahmāmbujopari || 117 ||
meaning:
प्. 116) कर्णिकायां न्यसेत्सत्यं हृन्मन्त्रस्य ततो(थो ?)परि |
आश्रित्य दक्षिणं भागमथ ब्रह्माम्बुजोपरि || 117 ||
text_mt: he should install Satya on the pericarp, then above the heart-mantra, / resorting to the right side; then upon the lotus of Brahman, // 117

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtaṃ mūrtavyapekṣāyāṃ nyastaṃ mantreṣu nārada |
śirasyūrdhve tu vinyasya vāsudevaṃ tathaiva ca || 118 ||
meaning:
मूर्तं मूर्तव्यपेक्षायां न्यस्तं मन्त्रेषु नारद |
शिरस्यूर्ध्वे तु विन्यस्य वासुदेवं तथैव च || 118 ||
text_mt: the manifest [one] when expecting the manifest is installed upon the mantras, O Nārada. / And having installed Vāsudeva above on the head in that manner, // 118

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāyāmupari nyāsaṃ kuryātsaṅkarṣaṇasya tu |
athordhve karṇikāyāstu pradyumnaṃ kavacopari || 119 ||
meaning:
शिखायामुपरि न्यासं कुर्यात्सङ्कर्षणस्य तु |
अथोर्ध्वे कर्णिकायास्तु प्रद्युम्नं कवचोपरि || 119 ||
text_mt: he should perform the installation of Saṅkarṣaṇa above upon the śikhā; / then above the pericarp, Pradyumna upon the armour; // 119

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmyādiṣvaniruddhaṃ ca ādheyatvena copari |
tatassaptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ mūlamantropari nyaset || 120 ||
meaning:
लक्ष्म्यादिष्वनिरुद्धं च आधेयत्वेन चोपरि |
ततस्सप्ताक्षरं मन्त्रं मूलमन्त्रोपरि न्यसेत् || 120 ||
text_mt: and Aniruddha upon Lakṣmī and the others, as that which is supported above. / Then he should install the seven-syllable mantra upon the root-mantra; // 120

sanskrit_iast:
prācyādāvīśaparyantamindrādyaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ bahiḥ |
nāgeśaṃ vinyaseccheṣamadhaḥsthamatha cordhvagam || 121 ||
meaning:
प्राच्यादावीशपर्यन्तमिन्द्राद्यं चाष्टकं बहिः |
नागेशं विन्यसेच्छेषमधःस्थमथ चोर्ध्वगम् || 121 ||
text_mt: outside, the group of eight beginning with Indra from the east up to the lord of the north-east; / he should install the lord of serpents, Śeṣa, below, and then above, // 121

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ ca sureśānamevaṃ lokeśasantatim |
nyasettadanu cāstrāṇi bahisteṣāṃ tu vinyaset || 122 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं च सुरेशानमेवं लोकेशसन्ततिम् |
न्यसेत्तदनु चास्त्राणि बहिस्तेषां तु विन्यसेत् || 122 ||
text_mt: Brahmā, the lord of the gods. In this way he should install the succession of world-protectors. / After that, he should install the weapons outside them, // 122

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādikramayogena yāvadīśānagocaram |
adho nāgeśvarāstraṃ ca brahmāstramupari nyaset || 123 ||
meaning:
पूर्वादिक्रमयोगेन यावदीशानगोचरम् |
अधो नागेश्वरास्त्रं च ब्रह्मास्त्रमुपरि न्यसेत् || 123 ||
text_mt: by order beginning with the east up to the realm of the north-east; / and below, the weapon of the lord of serpents, and above, he should install the weapon of Brahmā. // 123

sanskrit_iast:
tryambakottaradigbhyāṃ tu madhyataḥ khasthitaṃ smaret |
viṣvaksenaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha āyāntaṃ gaganāntarāt || 124 ||
meaning:
त्र्यम्बकोत्तरदिग्भ्यां तु मध्यतः खस्थितं स्मरेत् |
विष्वक्सेनं द्विजश्रेष्ठ आयान्तं गगनान्तरात् || 124 ||
text_mt: Between the north-east and the north, he should remember Viṣvaksena / stationed in the sky in the middle, O best of the twice-born, arriving from the midst of the heavens. // 124

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ nyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā mantrāṇāṃ maṇḍalāntare |
meaning: एवं न्यासं पुरा कृत्वा मन्त्राणां मण्डलान्तरे |
text_mt: Having previously performed the installation of mantras within the maṇḍala in this way, // 125

sanskrit_iast: [atha mantrāṇāṃ yathānyāsaṃ dhyānavidhiḥ]
meaning: [अथ मन्त्राणां यथान्यासं ध्यानविधिः]
text_mt: [The rule of meditation on the mantras according to their installation]

sanskrit_iast: tatassaṃcintayeddhyānamekaikasya yathāsthitam || 125 ||
meaning: ततस्संचिन्तयेद्ध्यानमेकैकस्य यथास्थितम् || 125 ||
text_mt: he should then contemplate the visualization of each one as it stands. // 125

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantrasya devā(vī ?)nāṃ purā proktaṃ mayā mune |
noktaṃ yaddhṛdayādīnāṃ tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu || 126 ||
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रस्य देवा(वी ?)नां पुरा प्रोक्तं मया मुने |
नोक्तं यद्धृदयादीनां तदेकाग्रमनाः शृणु || 126 ||
text_mt: That of the root-mantra and of the goddesses was taught by me previously, O sage; / hear with a focused mind that of the heart and the others which was not spoken: // 126

sanskrit_iast: [hṛdayamantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [हृदयमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the heart-mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
sitaśoṇitavarṇābhamekavaktraṃ caturbhujam |
garuḍāsanasaṃsthaṃ ca padmaśaṅkhakarānvitam || 127 ||
meaning:
सितशोणितवर्णाभमेकवक्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् |
गरुडासनसंस्थं च पद्मशङ्खकरान्वितम् || 127 ||
text_mt: Possessing the lustrous hue of white and red, single-faced, four-armed, / seated on the throne of Garuda, and endowed with lotus and conch in his hands; // 127

sanskrit_iast:
mudrālaṅkṛtimat dhyāyeddakṣiṇaṃ cāparaṃ karam |
vāmapāṇiṃ dvitīyaṃ ca saṃyuktamabhayena tu || 128 ||
meaning:
मुद्रालङ्कृतिमत् ध्यायेद्दक्षिणं चापरं करम् |
वामपाणिं द्वितीयं च संयुक्तमभयेन तु || 128 ||
text_mt: he should meditate on the other right hand as ornamented with the mudrā, / and the second left hand endowed with [the gesture of] fearlessness; // 128

sanskrit_iast:
sitābharaṇamālyaiśca karpūrāliptavigraham |
sammukhaṃ devadevasya hṛnmantraṃ saṃsmaretsadā || 129 ||
meaning:
सिताभरणमाल्यैश्च कर्पूरालिप्तविग्रहम् |
सम्मुखं देवदेवस्य हृन्मन्त्रं संस्मरेत्सदा || 129 ||
text_mt: his body smeared with camphor, with white ornaments and garlands, / facing the god of gods: he should constantly remember the heart-mantra. // 129

sanskrit_iast: p. 117) [śiromantradhyāna prakāraḥ]
meaning: प्. 117) [शिरोमन्त्रध्यान प्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the head-mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
bandhujīvopamaṃ raktaṃ padmacakrodyataṃdvija |
svamudrāsaṃyutaṃ dhyāyetpāṇinā varadena ca || 130 ||
meaning:
बन्धुजीवोपमं रक्तं पद्मचक्रोद्यतंद्विज |
स्वमुद्रासंयुतं ध्यायेत्पाणिना वरदेन च || 130 ||
text_mt: Resembling the bandhujīva flower, red, holding up the lotus and the discus, O twice-born, / he should meditate on him endowed with his own mudrā and with a hand granting boons; // 130

sanskrit_iast:
kuṅkumena viliptāṅgaṃ raktabhāsaṃ manoharam |
raktābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ raktapuṣpavibhūṣitam || 131 ||
meaning:
कुङ्कुमेन विलिप्ताङ्गं रक्तभासं मनोहरम् |
रक्ताभरणसंयुक्तं रक्तपुष्पविभूषितम् || 131 ||
text_mt: his limbs smeared with saffron, of red brilliance, charming, / adorned with red ornaments, decorated with red flowers, // 131

sanskrit_iast: sammukhaṃ mantranāthasya śiromantraṃ ca saṃsmaret |
meaning: सम्मुखं मन्त्रनाथस्य शिरोमन्त्रं च संस्मरेत् |
text_mt: facing the lord of mantras: he should remember the head-mantra.

sanskrit_iast: [śikhāmantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [शिखामन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the śikhā-mantra]

sanskrit_iast: calālipaṭalābhaṃ tu padmakaumodakīdharam || 132 ||
meaning: चलालिपटलाभं तु पद्मकौमोदकीधरम् || 132 ||
text_mt: Resembling a swarm of moving bees, holding a lotus and Kaumodakī, // 132

sanskrit_iast:
ātmīyamudrāṃ dharttāraṃ yuktaṃ cābhayapāṇinā |
yuktaṃ mṛgamadenaiva puṣpādyairasitaiśca tam || 133 ||
meaning:
आत्मीयमुद्रां धर्त्तारं युक्तं चाभयपाणिना |
युक्तं मृगमदेनैव पुष्पाद्यैरसितैश्च तम् || 133 ||
text_mt: bearing his own mudrā, and endowed with a hand of fearlessness, / smeared with musk, and with black flowers and the like, // 133

sanskrit_iast: īṣatsmitānanaṃ dhyāyecchikhāmantraṃ ca nārada |
meaning: ईषत्स्मिताननं ध्यायेच्छिखामन्त्रं च नारद |
text_mt: with a gently smiling face: he should meditate on the śikhā-mantra, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast: [kavacamantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [कवचमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the armour-mantra]

sanskrit_iast: madhupiṅgalavarṇābhaṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ tathā || 134 ||
meaning: मधुपिङ्गलवर्णाभं शङ्खचक्रधरं तथा || 134 ||
text_mt: Having the lustrous colour of tawny honey, likewise holding a conch and a discus, // 134

sanskrit_iast:
svamudrāvyagritaṃ dhyāyetpāṇiyugmayuto(taṃ) param |
miśrairvilepanairliptaṃ miśraiḥ puṣpādibhistathā || 135 ||
meaning:
स्वमुद्राव्यग्रितं ध्यायेत्पाणियुग्मयुतो(तं) परम् |
मिश्रैर्विलेपनैर्लिप्तं मिश्रैः पुष्पादिभिस्तथा || 135 ||
text_mt: he should meditate on him occupied with his own mudrā, endowed with a supreme pair of hands, / smeared with mixed unguents, and likewise with mixed flowers and the like, // 135

sanskrit_iast: nirīkṣya(kṣa ?)māṇaṃ ca vibhoḥ kavacaṃ saṃsmareddvija |
meaning: निरीक्ष्य(क्ष ?)माणं च विभोः कवचं संस्मरेद्द्विज |
text_mt: and gazing upon the Lord: he should remember the armour, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast: [netramantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [नेत्रमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the eye-mantra]

sanskrit_iast: raktapītaprabhaṃ caiva gadāpadmodyataṃ kramāt || 136 ||
meaning: रक्तपीतप्रभं चैव गदापद्मोद्यतं क्रमात् || 136 ||
text_mt: Having the splendour of red and yellow, and raising the mace and lotus in order // 136

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāparahastābhyāṃ yuktaṃ caiva svamudrayā |
sakāśmīreṇa liptāṅgaṃ candanena sitena ca || 137 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणापरहस्ताभ्यां युक्तं चैव स्वमुद्रया |
सकाश्मीरेण लिप्ताङ्गं चन्दनेन सितेन च || 137 ||
text_mt: with the right and left hands, and endowed with his own mudrā, / his limbs smeared with saffron and white sandalwood, // 137

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpābharaṇavāsobhiḥ pītairmaṇḍitavigraham |
saṃsmarennetramantraṃ tu sunetraṃ ca smitānanam || 138 ||
meaning:
पुष्पाभरणवासोभिः पीतैर्मण्डितविग्रहम् |
संस्मरेन्नेत्रमन्त्रं तु सुनेत्रं च स्मिताननम् || 138 ||
text_mt: his body adorned with yellow flowers, ornaments, and garments; / he should remember the eye-mantra, beautiful-eyed and with a smiling face. // 138

sanskrit_iast: [astramantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [अस्त्रमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the weapon-mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
rājopaladyutimuṣaṃ gadācakrodyataṃ mahat |
yuktaṃ caiva svamudrābhyāṃ suvarṇasadṛśaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 139 ||
meaning:
राजोपलद्युतिमुषं गदाचक्रोद्यतं महत् |
युक्तं चैव स्वमुद्राभ्यां सुवर्णसदृशैः शुभैः || 139 ||
text_mt: Surpassing the brilliance of lapis lazuli, holding up the mace and discus, immense, / and endowed with his two mudrās, auspicious and resembling gold, // 139

sanskrit_iast:
yuktamābharaṇādyaiśca pralayānalavikramam |
astramantraṃ vibhordhyāyetsammukhaṃ svāminaḥ sadā || 140 ||
meaning:
युक्तमाभरणाद्यैश्च प्रलयानलविक्रमम् |
अस्त्रमन्त्रं विभोर्ध्यायेत्सम्मुखं स्वामिनः सदा || 140 ||
text_mt: adorned with ornaments and the like, possessing the valor of the dissolution fire; / he should meditate on the all-pervading Lord's weapon-mantra, always facing his Master. // 140

sanskrit_iast:
ekavaktrāḥ smṛtāḥ sarve sarve ca garuḍāsanāḥ |
itīdamuktamaṅgānāṃ dhyānaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham || 141 ||
meaning:
एकवक्त्राः स्मृताः सर्वे सर्वे च गरुडासनाः |
इतीदमुक्तमङ्गानां ध्यानं पापहरं शुभम् || 141 ||
text_mt: All are remembered as single-faced, and all seated upon Garuda. / Thus has been stated this meditation on the ancillary [mantras], which removes sin and is auspicious. // 141

sanskrit_iast: p. 118) nṛsiṃhapūrvamantrāṇāṃ trayāṇāmavadhāraya |
meaning: प्. 118) नृसिंहपूर्वमन्त्राणां त्रयाणामवधारय |
text_mt: Understand the three mantras beginning with Nṛsiṃha: // 142ab

sanskrit_iast: [nṛsihmamantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [नृसिह्ममन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the Nṛsiṃha-mantra]

sanskrit_iast: pralayāmbudanirghoṣaṃ prodvamantaṃ ca pāvakam || 142 ||
meaning: प्रलयाम्बुदनिर्घोषं प्रोद्वमन्तं च पावकम् || 142 ||
text_mt: having the roar of dissolution clouds, and vomiting forth fire, // 142cd

sanskrit_iast:
padmaśaṅkhagadācakradharttāraṃ parameśvaram |
dravaccāmīkarābhāsaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitam || 143 ||
meaning:
पद्मशङ्खगदाचक्रधर्त्तारं परमेश्वरम् |
द्रवच्चामीकराभासं नानाभरणभूषितम् || 143 ||
text_mt: bearing the lotus, conch, mace, and discus, the Supreme Lord, / having the appearance of molten gold, adorned with various ornaments, // 143

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvilepanāṅgaṃ ca prabhūtasragdharaṃ dvija |
raktakauśeyavasanaṃ nṛsihmaṃ saṃsmaredvibhum || 144 ||
meaning:
नानाविलेपनाङ्गं च प्रभूतस्रग्धरं द्विज |
रक्तकौशेयवसनं नृसिह्मं संस्मरेद्विभुम् || 144 ||
text_mt: his limbs anointed with various ointments, wearing abundant garlands, O twice-born, / clad in red silk garments: he should remember the all-pervading Nṛsiṃha. // 144

sanskrit_iast: [kapilamantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [कपिलमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the Kapila-mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
udayādityasaṅkāśaṃ piṅgalaśmaśrulocanam |
caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ padmādyairupaśobhitam || 145 ||
meaning:
उदयादित्यसङ्काशं पिङ्गलश्मश्रुलोचनम् |
चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं पद्माद्यैरुपशोभितम् || 145 ||
text_mt: Resembling the rising sun, with tawny beard and eyes, / four-armed, of noble frame, adorned with [weapons] beginning with the lotus, // 145

sanskrit_iast:
sitavastrottarīyaṃ ca muktābharaṇabhūṣitam |
sitamālyadharaṃ dhyāyetkāpilaṃ mantranāyakam || 146 ||
meaning:
सितवस्त्रोत्तरीयं च मुक्ताभरणभूषितम् |
सितमाल्यधरं ध्यायेत्कापिलं मन्त्रनायकम् || 146 ||
text_mt: having a white cloth and upper garment, adorned with pearl ornaments, / wearing a white garland: he should meditate on the leader of mantras pertaining to Kapila. // 146

sanskrit_iast: [vārāhadhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [वाराहध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on Varāha]

sanskrit_iast:
rājāśmarāśivarṇābhaṃ pītābharaṇabhūṣitam |
mahādyutidharaṃ dhyāyeccaturhastaṃ ca nārada || 147 ||
meaning:
राजाश्मराशिवर्णाभं पीताभरणभूषितम् |
महाद्युतिधरं ध्यायेच्चतुर्हस्तं च नारद || 147 ||
text_mt: Resembling the colour of a heap of lapis lazuli, adorned with yellow ornaments, / possessing great brilliance: he should meditate on him as four-armed, O Nārada, // 147

sanskrit_iast:
prāgvallāñchanasaṅghena kamalādyena maṇḍitam |
varāhamantranāthaṃ ca madhupiṅgalalocanam || 148 ||
meaning:
प्राग्वल्लाञ्छनसङ्घेन कमलाद्येन मण्डितम् |
वराहमन्त्रनाथं च मधुपिङ्गललोचनम् || 148 ||
text_mt: adorned, as before, with a multitude of insignia beginning with the lotus, / the lord of the Varāha-mantra, having eyes tawny like honey, // 148

sanskrit_iast:
caladvidyudbhruvaṃ raudraṃ jvālāśmasrusaṭaṃ smaret |
bālacandrāgratulyena yuktaṃ daṃṣṭrādvayena tu || 149 ||
meaning:
चलद्विद्युद्भ्रुवं रौद्रं ज्वालाश्मस्रुसटं स्मरेत् |
बालचन्द्राग्रतुल्येन युक्तं दंष्ट्राद्वयेन तु || 149 ||
text_mt: with eyebrows like flashing lightning, terrible, with a mane like flaming stones, / endowed with a pair of tusks resembling the tip of the crescent moon. // 149

sanskrit_iast:
padmāsanopaviṣṭāśca cintayantaḥ svakāraṇam |
sammukhāḥ karṇikādhaḥsthāḥ smartavyāḥ sarvadā mune || 150 ||
meaning:
पद्मासनोपविष्टाश्च चिन्तयन्तः स्वकारणम् |
सम्मुखाः कर्णिकाधःस्थाः स्मर्तव्याः सर्वदा मुने || 150 ||
text_mt: Seated in the lotus posture, contemplating their own cause, / facing forward, situated beneath the pericarp: they are always to be remembered, O sage. // 150

sanskrit_iast: [kaustubhādidhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [कौस्तुभादिध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on Kaustubha and the rest]

sanskrit_iast:
kaustubhaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyāyetsahasrārkasamaprabham |
nānāvarṇadharāṃ devīṃ vanamālāṃ tathaiva ca || 151 ||
meaning:
कौस्तुभं द्विभुजं ध्यायेत्सहस्रार्कसमप्रभम् |
नानावर्णधरां देवीं वनमालां तथैव च || 151 ||
text_mt: He should meditate on the Kaustubha as two-armed, with splendour equal to a thousand suns; / and likewise the goddess, the forest-garland, possessing various colours, // 151

sanskrit_iast:
kāntāṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ prauḍhastrīsadṛśīṃ dvija |
puṇḍarīkaprabhaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ kundendusannibham || 152 ||
meaning:
कान्तां कमलपत्राक्षीं प्रौढस्त्रीसदृशीं द्विज |
पुण्डरीकप्रभं पद्मं शङ्खं कुन्देन्दुसन्निभम् || 152 ||
text_mt: charming, with eyes like lotus petals, resembling a mature woman, O twice-born; / the lotus, having the splendour of a white lotus; the conch, resembling the jasmine and moon; // 152

sanskrit_iast:
rājopalaprabhaṃ cakraṃ hemābhāṃ saṃsmaredgadām |
dviraṣṭavarṣavatkāntāṃ kumārīṃ navayuvanām || 153 ||
meaning:
राजोपलप्रभं चक्रं हेमाभां संस्मरेद्गदाम् |
द्विरष्टवर्षवत्कान्तां कुमारीं नवयुवनाम् || 153 ||
text_mt: the discus, having the splendour of lapis lazuli; he should remember the mace as possessing the appearance of gold, / charming like a maiden of sixteen years, a youthful maiden. // 153

sanskrit_iast: [garuḍadhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [गरुडध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on Garuda]

sanskrit_iast:
raktatuṇḍaṃ mahāprāṇaṃ bhīmabhukuṭilocanam |
p. 119) dravaccāmīkarākāraṃ pakṣamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 154 ||
meaning:
रक्ततुण्डं महाप्राणं भीमभुकुटिलोचनम् |
प्. 119) द्रवच्चामीकराकारं पक्षमण्डलमण्डितम् || 154 ||
text_mt: With a red beak, of great vitality, with terrible knitting of the brow and eyes, / having the form of molten gold, adorned with a circle of wings, // 154

sanskrit_iast: saṃsmaredgaruḍaṃ vipra gṛdhravaktraṃ pṛthūdaram |
meaning: संस्मरेद्गरुडं विप्र गृध्रवक्त्रं पृथूदरम् |
text_mt: he should remember Garuda, O vipra, vulture-faced and large-bellied. // 155ab

sanskrit_iast: [pāśāṅkuśayordhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [पाशाङ्कुशयोर्ध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the noose and goad]

sanskrit_iast: navadūrvāṅkuraśyāmaṃ pāśeśaṃ pannagānanam || 155 ||
meaning: नवदूर्वाङ्कुरश्यामं पाशेशं पन्नगाननम् || 155 ||
text_mt: Dark as a fresh blade of dūrvā grass, the lord of the noose, serpent-faced; // 155cd

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmaredaṅkuśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dīrghanāsaṃ bhayānakam |
svamudrālaṅkṛtāḥ sarve dvibhujāścārukuṇḍalāḥ || 156 ||
meaning:
संस्मरेदङ्कुशं कृष्णं दीर्घनासं भयानकम् |
स्वमुद्रालङ्कृताः सर्वे द्विभुजाश्चारुकुण्डलाः || 156 ||
text_mt: he should remember the goad as black, long-nosed, terrifying. / All are adorned with their own mudrās, two-armed, with beautiful earrings, // 156

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātavyāḥ puruṣākārāḥ svaprabhābhirvirājitāḥ |
etallāñchanamantrāṇāṃ dhyānamuktaṃ mayā mune || 157 ||
meaning:
ध्यातव्याः पुरुषाकाराः स्वप्रभाभिर्विराजिताः |
एतल्लाञ्छनमन्त्राणां ध्यानमुक्तं मया मुने || 157 ||
text_mt: to be meditated upon in human form, shining with their own splendours. / This meditation on the mantras of the insignia has been spoken by me, O sage. // 157

sanskrit_iast: [satyādipañcakadhyānaprakārāḥ]
meaning: [सत्यादिपञ्चकध्यानप्रकाराः]
text_mt: [The procedures of meditation on the group of five beginning with Satya]

sanskrit_iast:
satyādīnāmatha dhyānaṃ samāsādavadhāraya |
dvibhujaṃ saṃsmaretsatyaṃ sitaminduśatākṛtim || 158 ||
meaning:
सत्यादीनामथ ध्यानं समासादवधारय |
द्विभुजं संस्मरेत्सत्यं सितमिन्दुशताकृतिम् || 158 ||
text_mt: Now understand briefly the meditation on Satya and the others: / he should remember Satya as two-armed, white, having the appearance of a hundred moons, // 158

sanskrit_iast:
varadābhayahastaṃ ca dhyānonmīlitalocanam |
sitakauśeyavasanaṃ muktādāmādyalataṅkṛm || 159 ||
meaning:
वरदाभयहस्तं च ध्यानोन्मीलितलोचनम् |
सितकौशेयवसनं मुक्तादामाद्यलतङ्कृम् || 159 ||
text_mt: with hands bestowing boons and freedom from fear, eyes opened in meditation, / wearing white silk garments, adorned with pearl necklaces and the like, // 159

sanskrit_iast:
sitacandanaliptāṅgaṃ sitapuṣpavibhūṣitam |
ūrdhvasthaṃ mantranāthasya brahmapu(pa ?)trasthitaṃ smaret || 160 ||
meaning:
सितचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गं सितपुष्पविभूषितम् |
ऊर्ध्वस्थं मन्त्रनाथस्य ब्रह्मपु(प ?)त्रस्थितं स्मरेत् || 160 ||
text_mt: his limbs smeared with white sandalwood, decorated with white flowers; / situated above the lord of mantras, he should remember him standing on a lotus petal, // 160

sanskrit_iast:
padmāsanenopaviṣṭaṃ prasannavadanaṃ dvija |
evaṃ vidhaṃ tato dhyāyedvāsudevaṃ caturbhujam || 161 ||
meaning:
पद्मासनेनोपविष्टं प्रसन्नवदनं द्विज |
एवं विधं ततो ध्यायेद्वासुदेवं चतुर्भुजम् || 161 ||
text_mt: seated in the lotus posture, with a serene countenance, O twice-born. / In such a manner he should then meditate on Vāsudeva as four-armed, // 161

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhapadmadharaṃ caiva varadābhayadaṃ vibhum |
praśāntahutabhugrūpaṃ na sitaṃ nāticāruṇam || 162 ||
meaning:
शङ्खपद्मधरं चैव वरदाभयदं विभुम् |
प्रशान्तहुतभुग्रूपं न सितं नातिचारुणम् || 162 ||
text_mt: holding the conch and lotus, and bestowing boons and freedom from fear, all-pervading, / of the form of a tranquil fire, neither white nor excessively red. // 162

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyetsaṅkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ pradyumnaṃ saṃsmarettataḥ |
pītacampakavarṇābhaṃ kamalāyatalocanam || 163 ||
meaning:
ध्यायेत्सङ्कर्षणं देवं प्रद्युम्नं संस्मरेत्ततः |
पीतचम्पकवर्णाभं कमलायतलोचनम् || 163 ||
text_mt: He should meditate on the god Saṅkarṣaṇa; then he should remember Pradyumna, / having the colour and splendour of a yellow campaka, with wide eyes like lotus flowers. // 163

sanskrit_iast:
śaradgaganasaṅkāśamaniruddhaṃ smarettataḥ |
vāsudevasamāḥ sarve bhujābharaṇalāñchanaiḥ || 164 ||
meaning:
शरद्गगनसङ्काशमनिरुद्धं स्मरेत्ततः |
वासुदेवसमाः सर्वे भुजाभरणलाञ्छनैः || 164 ||
