text_mt: Then he should remember Aniruddha, resembling the autumn sky. / All are equal to Vāsudeva in arms, ornaments, and insignia; // 164

sanskrit_iast: upaviṣṭāstathaivete brahmarandhrāmbujeṣu ca |
meaning: उपविष्टास्तथैवेते ब्रह्मरन्ध्राम्बुजेषु च |
text_mt: and they are likewise seated in the lotuses of the aperture of Brahman. // 165ab

sanskrit_iast: [saptākṣaramantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [सप्ताक्षरमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of meditation on the seven-syllable mantra]

sanskrit_iast: suśuddhasphaṭikaprakhyaṃ nīrūpamiva (mapi ?)rūpiṇam || 165 ||
meaning: सुशुद्धस्फटिकप्रख्यं नीरूपमिव (मपि ?)रूपिणम् || 165 ||
text_mt: Resembling pure crystal, possessed of form as if formless, // 165cd

sanskrit_iast:
sarvākāradharaṃ caiva sarvākāravivarjitam |
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ ca sarvato'kṣiśiromukham || 166 ||
meaning:
सर्वाकारधरं चैव सर्वाकारविवर्जितम् |
सर्वतः पाणिपादं च सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् || 166 ||
text_mt: assuming all forms and devoid of all form, / having hands and feet everywhere, eyes, heads, and faces everywhere; // 166

sanskrit_iast:
prasannaraśmijālena sphaṭikāmalarūpiṇā |
p. 120) svadehanissṛtenaiva bhāsitaṃ paritaḥ prabhum || 167 ||
meaning:
प्रसन्नरश्मिजालेन स्फटिकामलरूपिणा |
प्. 120) स्वदेहनिस्सृतेनैव भासितं परितः प्रभुम् || 167 ||
text_mt: the Lord illumined all around by a web of serene rays / issuing from his own body, having the spotless form of crystal, // 167

sanskrit_iast:
pratibimbati vai yasminmantracakraṃ yathāsthitam |
dhyāyetsaptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ bhogasthānagataṃ mune || 168 ||
meaning:
प्रतिबिम्बति वै यस्मिन्मन्त्रचक्रं यथास्थितम् |
ध्यायेत्सप्ताक्षरं मन्त्रं भोगस्थानगतं मुने || 168 ||
text_mt: in whom the circle of mantras is truly reflected as it exists: / he should meditate on the seven-syllable mantra situated in the place of enjoyment, O sage. // 168

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ dhyātvā samabhyarcya yathānyāsakrameṇa ca |
meaning: एवं ध्यात्वा समभ्यर्च्य यथान्यासक्रमेण च |
text_mt: Having thus meditated and thoroughly worshipped according to the sequence of installation, // 169ab

sanskrit_iast: [dhyānānānantaraṃ nyāsakrameṇa mantragaṇasya bāhyayāgaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [ध्यानानानन्तरं न्यासक्रमेण मन्त्रगणस्य बाह्ययागप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure of external sacrifice of the host of mantras according to the sequence of installation following meditation]

sanskrit_iast: arghaiḥ pādyaistathā puṣpaiḥ sugandhairanulepanaiḥ || 169 ||
meaning: अर्घैः पाद्यैस्तथा पुष्पैः सुगन्धैरनुलेपनैः || 169 ||
text_mt: with arghya-offerings, pādya-water, flowers, fragrant ointments, // 169cd

sanskrit_iast:
śālipūrṇotthitāghārapṛṣṭhasaṃsthairanekaśaḥ |
sugandhaghṛtadīpaiśca puṣpālambanacarcitaiḥ || 170 ||
meaning:
शालिपूर्णोत्थिताघारपृष्ठसंस्थैरनेकशः |
सुगन्धघृतदीपैश्च पुष्पालम्बनचर्चितैः || 170 ||
text_mt: placed repeatedly upon broad dishes filled with rice, / and with fragrant ghee lamps strewn with garlands of flowers, // 170

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmodaiśśubhoddipairacchinnairguggulānvitaiḥ |
bhakṣyairbhojyaistathā lehyaiḥ peyairanyairanekadhā || 171 ||
meaning:
महामोदैश्शुभोद्दिपैरच्छिन्नैर्गुग्गुलान्वितैः |
भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैस्तथा लेह्यैः पेयैरन्यैरनेकधा || 171 ||
text_mt: with greatly fragrant, auspicious, blazing, unbroken [incense] mixed with guggulu; / with foods that are chewed, eaten, licked, and various kinds to be drunk; // 171

sanskrit_iast:
madhuparkaiśca mātrābhiḥ phalamūlairanekaśaḥ |
pāyasairvividhairdivyaiḥ modakaiḥ kṛsarādibhiḥ || 172 ||
meaning:
मधुपर्कैश्च मात्राभिः फलमूलैरनेकशः |
पायसैर्विविधैर्दिव्यैः मोदकैः कृसरादिभिः || 172 ||
text_mt: and with honey-mixtures in proper measures, with fruits and roots in abundance, / with various divine milk-rice dishes, sweetmeats, kṛsara, and the like, // 172

sanskrit_iast:
susaṃskṛtaiśca bahubhirmadhvājyādipariplutaiḥ |
ekaikasmiṃstu vai bhoge mudrāṃ kāmadughāṃ purā || 173 ||
meaning:
सुसंस्कृतैश्च बहुभिर्मध्वाज्यादिपरिप्लुतैः |
एकैकस्मिंस्तु वै भोगे मुद्रां कामदुघां पुरा || 173 ||
text_mt: well-prepared and abundant, overflowing with honey, ghee, and the like: / for each separate enjoyment, he should first meditate as before // 173

sanskrit_iast:
samantrāṃ pūrvavaddhyāyetprokṣayerdarghyavāriṇā |
datvā puṣpārghyamupari saṃspṛśedviṣṇupāṇinā || 174 ||
meaning:
समन्त्रां पूर्ववद्ध्यायेत्प्रोक्षयेर्दर्घ्यवारिणा |
दत्वा पुष्पार्घ्यमुपरि संस्पृशेद्विष्णुपाणिना || 174 ||
text_mt: on the Kāmadhenu mudrā with its mantra, and sprinkle with arghya-water. / Having offered an arghya of flowers upon it, he should touch it with the hand of Viṣṇu. // 174

sanskrit_iast:
nivedayettato vipra śirasā'vanatena ca |
yatkiñcanmānase yāge purā proktaṃ mayā ca te || 175 ||
meaning:
निवेदयेत्ततो विप्र शिरसाऽवनतेन च |
यत्किञ्चन्मानसे यागे पुरा प्रोक्तं मया च ते || 175 ||
text_mt: Then, O vipra, with head bowed low, he should present it. / Whatever was previously stated by me to you in the mental sacrifice, // 175

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ devadevasya bahumūrtaṃ nivedayet |
asannidhiśca yo bhogo hyaṅgabhāvamanuvrajet || 176 ||
meaning:
तत्सर्वं देवदेवस्य बहुमूर्तं निवेदयेत् |
असन्निधिश्च यो भोगो ह्यङ्गभावमनुव्रजेत् || 176 ||
text_mt: all that he should present in manifold forms to the God of gods. / And whatever enjoyment is not directly present, entering into an ancillary state, // 176

sanskrit_iast:
tattaddhyātvā tu manasā bhaktyā viṣṇornivedayet |
yathānukramato hyevaṃ sarvamantragaṇaṃ mune || 177 ||
meaning:
तत्तद्ध्यात्वा तु मनसा भक्त्या विष्णोर्निवेदयेत् |
यथानुक्रमतो ह्येवं सर्वमन्त्रगणं मुने || 177 ||
text_mt: having meditated on each one in the mind, he should present it with devotion to Viṣṇu. / Having thus worshipped the entire host of mantras in sequence, O sage, // 177

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭvā pūrvaṃ vidhānena bhūyaḥ saṃpūjya keśavam |
meaning: इष्ट्वा पूर्वं विधानेन भूयः संपूज्य केशवम् |
text_mt: first according to rule, and having worshipped Keśava once more: // 178ab

sanskrit_iast: [puṣpāñjaliprakāraḥ]
meaning: [पुष्पाञ्जलिप्रकारः]

sanskrit_iast: mūlamantraṃ samuccārya puṣpairāpūrya cāñjalim || 178 ||
meaning: मूलमन्त्रं समुच्चार्य पुष्पैरापूर्य चाञ्जलिम् || 178 ||
text_mt: having recited the root-mantra and filled his folded hands with flowers, // 178cd

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye paramātmānaṃ mantraṃ māṇikyadīdhitim |
samastamantrasaṃlīnaṃ dhyāyeduddhārayogataḥ || 179 ||
meaning:
तन्मध्ये परमात्मानं मन्त्रं माणिक्यदीधितिम् |
समस्तमन्त्रसंलीनं ध्यायेदुद्धारयोगतः || 179 ||
text_mt: he should meditate through the practice of extraction on the Supreme Self, the mantra radiant as a ruby, / dissolved within all mantras, in their midst, // 179

sanskrit_iast:
pūrakādivibhāgena śabdenātiplutātmanā |
yāvacchabdāvasānastho vyajyate'sāvanekadhā || 180 ||
meaning:
पूरकादिविभागेन शब्देनातिप्लुतात्मना |
यावच्छब्दावसानस्थो व्यज्यतेऽसावनेकधा || 180 ||
text_mt: by means of the division of inhalation and the rest, with sound of a highly protracted nature, / until, residing at the end of the sound, it is manifested in various ways. // 180

sanskrit_iast:
p. 121) tantrīśabdātmanā vipra tato bhāsātmanā tu vai |
hlādātmanā ca tadanu ānandavibhavātmanā || 181 ||
meaning:
प्. 121) तन्त्रीशब्दात्मना विप्र ततो भासात्मना तु वै |
ह्लादात्मना च तदनु आनन्दविभवात्मना || 181 ||
text_mt: as having the nature of lute-sound, O Brahmin, and then indeed as having the nature of radiance, / and thereafter as having the nature of delight, and as having the nature of the power of bliss; // 181

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvapadātītaḥ sarvatra vibhavātmanā |
saccidghanorminirmuktaśāntabodhāntarātmanā || 182 ||
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वपदातीतः सर्वत्र विभवात्मना |
सच्चिद्घनोर्मिनिर्मुक्तशान्तबोधान्तरात्मना || 182 ||
text_mt: beyond all words, everywhere by virtue of his omnipresence, / as the inner Self of tranquil consciousness freed from the waves of being and consciousness; // 182

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ṣaḍūrminirmuktaṃ vikalpātītagocaram |
avagāhya krameṇātha punaretya padātpadam || 183 ||
meaning:
एवं षडूर्मिनिर्मुक्तं विकल्पातीतगोचरम् |
अवगाह्य क्रमेणाथ पुनरेत्य पदात्पदम् || 183 ||
text_mt: having thus entered [that which is] free from the six waves, whose sphere is beyond conceptual thought, / and then coming down again step by step, // 183

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā mantraṃ sahastrāṃśuṃ sahasrakarajāmṛtam |
recakena vinikṣipya devadevasya mūrdhani || 184 ||
meaning:
ध्यात्वा मन्त्रं सहस्त्रांशुं सहस्रकरजामृतम् |
रेचकेन विनिक्षिप्य देवदेवस्य मूर्धनि || 184 ||
text_mt: having meditated on the thousand-rayed mantra, the nectar born of a thousand rays, / he deposits it with an exhalation upon the head of the God of gods. // 184

sanskrit_iast: tato'chinnaṃ kare kṛtvā dhūpapātraṃ tu dakṣiṇe |
meaning: ततोऽछिन्नं करे कृत्वा धूपपात्रं तु दक्षिणे |
text_mt: Then, taking the unbroken incense-burner in his right hand— // 185ab

sanskrit_iast: [dhūpapātravidhiḥ]
meaning: [धूपपात्रविधिः]

sanskrit_iast: padmacakrāṅkitaṃ divyamādhāraṃ kañjarūpiṇam || 185 ||
meaning: पद्मचक्राङ्कितं दिव्यमाधारं कञ्जरूपिणम् || 185 ||
text_mt: a divine receptacle marked with lotus and discus, having the form of a lotus, // 185cd

sanskrit_iast:
ekanālaṃ ca kartavyaṃ (kurvīta ?) śeṣaṃ saptaphaṇaṃ vibhum |
baddhāñjalipuṭaṃ nityaṃ dhyāyantaṃ kāraṇaṃ param || 186 ||
meaning:
एकनालं च कर्तव्यं (कुर्वीत ?) शेषं सप्तफणं विभुम् |
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटं नित्यं ध्यायन्तं कारणं परम् || 186 ||
text_mt: one should make it with a single stalk, and the all-pervading Śeṣa with seven hoods, / having his palms joined, always meditating on the supreme cause; // 186

sanskrit_iast:
cakralāṅgalahastaṃ ca padmāsanagataṃ vibhum |
kartavyaṃ (kurvīta ?) dhūpagharttāraṃ kiṅkiṇījālaśobhitam || 187 ||
meaning:
चक्रलाङ्गलहस्तं च पद्मासनगतं विभुम् |
कर्तव्यं (कुर्वीत ?) धूपघर्त्तारं किङ्किणीजालशोभितम् || 187 ||
text_mt: and the all-pervading lord with discus and plough in hand, seated on a lotus, / one should make as the bearer of the incense, adorned with a network of tiny bells. // 187

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ taccakrahṛdayaṃ padmaṃ hṛtkoṭaraṃ viduḥ |
cakre yā yā (ye ye ?) arākhyā (ssyu ?)stā nāḍyo vai dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ||
188 ||
meaning:
चक्रं तच्चक्रहृदयं पद्मं हृत्कोटरं विदुः |
चक्रे या या (ये ये ?) अराख्या (स्स्यु ?)स्ता नाड्यो वै द्वादश स्मृताः ||
188 ||
text_mt: They know that discus to be the heart of the discus, and the lotus to be the hollow of the heart; / whatever are called spokes in the discus are known as the twelve nāḍīs. // 188

sanskrit_iast:
kiṅkiṇyo yāḥ smṛtā vipra jñeyāstāḥ sūkṣmanāḍayaḥ |
yāsāṃ vai madhyamā śaktirbhujaṅgakuṭilopamā || 189 ||
meaning:
किङ्किण्यो याः स्मृता विप्र ज्ञेयास्ताः सूक्ष्मनाडयः |
यासां वै मध्यमा शक्तिर्भुजङ्गकुटिलोपमा || 189 ||
text_mt: The tiny bells that are mentioned, O Brahmin, are to be understood as the subtle channels, / among which the central power is like a coiled serpent, // 189

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmadhūsaravarṇābhā aṇḍaṃ bhitvā vinirgatā |
kālāgnihṛdayotthā sā satyānte tu layaṃ gatā || 190 ||
meaning:
धूमधूसरवर्णाभा अण्डं भित्वा विनिर्गता |
कालाग्निहृदयोत्था सा सत्यान्ते तु लयं गता || 190 ||
text_mt: having the smoky grey hue, having split the egg and gone forth, / rising from the heart of the fire of time, and dissolved at the end of the Satya [world]. // 190

sanskrit_iast:
tayā saṃbodhito hyātmā mantramūrtidharaḥ prabhuḥ |
sannidhau bhavati, kṣipramavyucchinnaṃ dahettathā || 191 ||
meaning:
तया संबोधितो ह्यात्मा मन्त्रमूर्तिधरः प्रभुः |
सन्निधौ भवति, क्षिप्रमव्युच्छिन्नं दहेत्तथा || 191 ||
text_mt: Awakened by her, the Self, the Lord bearing the mantra-form, / comes into presence; likewise, it should burn without interruption. // 191

sanskrit_iast: [dhūpapātramantravidhānam]
meaning: [धूपपात्रमन्त्रविधानम्]
text_mt: [Rule for the mantra of the incense-burner]

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇānena viprarṣe tanmantramavadhāraya |
oṅkāraṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya paramātmā tataḥ punaḥ || 192 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रेणानेन विप्रर्षे तन्मन्त्रमवधारय |
ओङ्कारं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य परमात्मा ततः पुनः || 192 ||
text_mt: Understand that mantra, O Brahmin-seer, by this mantra: / first extracting the syllable OṂ, then next the word "paramātmā" // 192

sanskrit_iast:
vyomānandena saṃyuktamanantāya padaṃ tataḥ |
kālāgnirūpāya padaṃ jagaddhūmapadaṃ tathā || 193 ||
meaning:
व्योमानन्देन संयुक्तमनन्ताय पदं ततः |
कालाग्निरूपाय पदं जगद्धूमपदं तथा || 193 ||
text_mt: joined with "vyomānandena", then the word "anantāya", / the word "kālāgnirūpāya", and the word "jagaddhūma", // 193

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhine padaṃ kuryātsarvagandhavahāya ca |
p. 122) namaḥ svāhāsamāyuktamekatriṃśākṣaraṃ param || 194 ||
meaning:
सुगन्धिने पदं कुर्यात्सर्वगन्धवहाय च |
प्. 122) नमः स्वाहासमायुक्तमेकत्रिंशाक्षरं परम् || 194 ||
text_mt: one should utter the word "sugandhine", and "sarvagandhavahāya", / accompanied by "namaḥ" and "svāhā", the supreme thirty-one-syllable [mantra]. // 194

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ dvija samākhyātaṃ dhūpapātrasya nārada |
mudrādhyānasamāyuktaṃ (ktāṃ ?) sarvasiddhikaraṃ (rīṃ ?) param (rām
?) || 195 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रं द्विज समाख्यातं धूपपात्रस्य नारद |
मुद्राध्यानसमायुक्तं (क्तां ?) सर्वसिद्धिकरं (रीं ?) परम् (राम्
?) || 195 ||
text_mt: This mantra of the incense-burner has been proclaimed to you, O Brahmin Nārada, / accompanied by mudrā and meditation, granting all perfections, supreme. // 195

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitāṃ dhūpitāṃ liptāṃ mantravinyastavigrahām |
ekīkṛtya svaśabdena hṛdgatenāntarātmanā || 196 ||
meaning:
पूजितां धूपितां लिप्तां मन्त्रविन्यस्तविग्रहाम् |
एकीकृत्य स्वशब्देन हृद्गतेनान्तरात्मना || 196 ||
text_mt: Having united [the burner], worshipped, censed, smeared, its form installed with mantra, / with his own inner Self, situated in the heart, through his own sound, // 196

sanskrit_iast: [ghaṇṭācālanavidhānam]
meaning: [घण्टाचालनविधानम्]
text_mt: [Rule for ringing the bell]

sanskrit_iast:
sañcālayettatassamyaksaśabdāṃ cakracinhitām |
trailokyadrāviṇīṃ ghaṇṭāṃ sarvaduṣṭanibarhiṇīm || 197 ||
meaning:
सञ्चालयेत्ततस्सम्यक्सशब्दां चक्रचिन्हिताम् |
त्रैलोक्यद्राविणीं घण्टां सर्वदुष्टनिबर्हिणीम् || 197 ||
text_mt: he should then sound properly the resonant bell marked with a discus, / which puts to flight the three worlds and destroys all wicked beings. // 197

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā dūtī hi mantrāṇāṃ suptānāṃ ca prabodhinī |
vāraṇī sarvavighnānāṃ sarvamantraprasādinī || 198 ||
meaning:
एषा दूती हि मन्त्राणां सुप्तानां च प्रबोधिनी |
वारणी सर्वविघ्नानां सर्वमन्त्रप्रसादिनी || 198 ||
text_mt: For she is the messenger of the mantras and the awakener of the sleeping, / the averter of all obstacles, the gracious pacifier of all mantras. // 198

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavānte dhvanirhyeṣa śabdaśaktau layaṃ gataḥ |
varṇadehāḥ smṛtā mantrā mantradehāśca devatāḥ || 199 ||
meaning:
प्रणवान्ते ध्वनिर्ह्येष शब्दशक्तौ लयं गतः |
वर्णदेहाः स्मृता मन्त्रा मन्त्रदेहाश्च देवताः || 199 ||
text_mt: For at the end of the praṇava, this sound dissolves into the power of sound; / mantras are taught as having phonemes for bodies, and deities have mantras for bodies. // 199

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṇṭāstanitamūlāste prabuddhāḥ karmasiddhidāḥ |
paraśabdotthitā śaktirghaṇṭāstanitarūpiṇī || 200 ||
meaning:
घण्टास्तनितमूलास्ते प्रबुद्धाः कर्मसिद्धिदाः |
परशब्दोत्थिता शक्तिर्घण्टास्तनितरूपिणी || 200 ||
text_mt: Having the chime of the bell as their source, awakened, they grant success in rituals; / the power arising from the supreme sound has the form of the bell's ringing; // 200

sanskrit_iast:
varṇatvaṃ samanuprāptā tairvarṇairmunisattama |
mantrāṇāṃ kalpanādehā nānākārāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 201 ||
meaning:
वर्णत्वं समनुप्राप्ता तैर्वर्णैर्मुनिसत्तम |
मन्त्राणां कल्पनादेहा नानाकाराः सहस्रशः || 201 ||
text_mt: having attained the nature of phonemes—through those phonemes, O best of sages, / are the conceptual bodies of mantras formed in thousands of diverse aspects, // 201

sanskrit_iast:
svecchayā tvanayā śaktyā sāmarthyātsvātmanassvayam |
anugrahārthamiha hi bhaktānāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 202 ||
meaning:
स्वेच्छया त्वनया शक्त्या सामर्थ्यात्स्वात्मनस्स्वयम् |
अनुग्रहार्थमिह हि भक्तानां भावितात्मनाम् || 202 ||
text_mt: spontaneously by this power, through its own capacity, / for the grace of devotees with cultivated minds in this world. // 202

sanskrit_iast:
mananānmuniśārdūla trāṇaṃ kurvanti vai tataḥ |
dadate padamātmīyaṃ tasmānmantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 203 ||
meaning:
मननान्मुनिशार्दूल त्राणं कुर्वन्ति वै ततः |
ददते पदमात्मीयं तस्मान्मन्त्राः प्रकीर्तिताः || 203 ||
text_mt: Because they protect through being contemplated, O tiger among sages, / and grant their own state, they are called mantras. // 203

sanskrit_iast:
anabhivyaktaśabdāste nirākārāstathaiva ca |
ghaṇṭāyāṃ cālyamānāyāṃ niryānti ca sahasraśaḥ || 204 ||
meaning:
अनभिव्यक्तशब्दास्ते निराकारास्तथैव च |
घण्टायां चाल्यमानायां निर्यान्ति च सहस्रशः || 204 ||
text_mt: Being unmanifest sounds and formless, / when the bell is rung, they issue forth by thousands. // 204

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva muniśreṣṭha mantramātā prakīrtitā |
eṣā ghaṇṭābhidhā śaktirvāgīśī ca sarasvatī || 205 ||
meaning:
अत एव मुनिश्रेष्ठ मन्त्रमाता प्रकीर्तिता |
एषा घण्टाभिधा शक्तिर्वागीशी च सरस्वती || 205 ||
text_mt: Therefore, O best of sages, she is proclaimed as the Mother of Mantras, / this power called the Bell, the ruler of speech and Sarasvatī. // 205

sanskrit_iast:
vāci mantrāḥ sthitāssarve vācyā mantre pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
mantrarūpātmakaṃ viśvaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ tataḥ || 206 ||
meaning:
वाचि मन्त्राः स्थितास्सर्वे वाच्या मन्त्रे प्रतिष्ठिताः |
मन्त्ररूपात्मकं विश्वं स बाह्याभ्यन्तरं ततः || 206 ||
text_mt: All mantras reside in speech, and the signified reside in the mantra; / the universe, both external and internal, consists of the form of mantra. // 206

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṇṭāśabdagataṃ sarvaṃ tasmāttāṃ cālayetpurā |
āvāhane'rghye dhūpe ca dīpe naivedyajoṣaṇe || 207 ||
meaning:
घण्टाशब्दगतं सर्वं तस्मात्तां चालयेत्पुरा |
आवाहनेऽर्घ्ये धूपे च दीपे नैवेद्यजोषणे || 207 ||
text_mt: Everything resides in the sound of the bell; therefore, one should ring it first / in invocation, in [offering] the arghya, in incense, in light, and in presenting the food-offering. // 207

sanskrit_iast:
nityameva prayuñjīta samyaṅmantrārthasiddhaye |
p. 123) pūjākālaṃ vinā'nyatra hitaṃ nāsyāḥ pracālanam || 208 ||
meaning:
नित्यमेव प्रयुञ्जीत सम्यङ्मन्त्रार्थसिद्धये |
प्. 123) पूजाकालं विनाऽन्यत्र हितं नास्याः प्रचालनम् || 208 ||
text_mt: One should always employ it properly for the accomplishment of the mantras' purpose; / its sounding is not beneficial anywhere except at the time of worship. // 208

sanskrit_iast:
nānayā tu vinā kāryaṃ pūjanaṃ siddhimicchatā |
yasmāttasmātparaṃ mantrametadīyamidaṃ śṛṇu || 209 ||
meaning:
नानया तु विना कार्यं पूजनं सिद्धिमिच्छता |
यस्मात्तस्मात्परं मन्त्रमेतदीयमिदं शृणु || 209 ||
text_mt: Worship should never be performed without it by one who desires perfection; / therefore, listen to this supreme mantra belonging to it. // 209

sanskrit_iast: [ghaṇṭāmantranirūpaṇam]
meaning: [घण्टामन्त्रनिरूपणम्]
text_mt: [Explanation of the bell-mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
ādāya praṇavaṃ pūrvamananteśaṃ tataḥ param |
taccānalena saṃbhinnamūrdhvādho munisattama || 210 ||
meaning:
आदाय प्रणवं पूर्वमनन्तेशं ततः परम् |
तच्चानलेन संभिन्नमूर्ध्वाधो मुनिसत्तम || 210 ||
text_mt: Taking the praṇava first, and after that Ananteśa, / and that combined above and below with the fire, O best of sages, // 210

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyaiśvaryadenātha lāñchayetpañcabindunā |
dadyādasyāvasāne tu jagaddhvanipadaṃ tataḥ || 211 ||
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेनाथ लाञ्छयेत्पञ्चबिन्दुना |
दद्यादस्यावसाने तु जगद्ध्वनिपदं ततः || 211 ||
text_mt: one should then mark it with the five bindus granting lordship over the three worlds; / at its end one should place the word "jagaddhvani", // 211

sanskrit_iast:
mantramātre padaṃ cānyatsvāhākṣarasamanvitam |
tadante paramātmānaṃ prajñādhāropari sthitam || 212 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रमात्रे पदं चान्यत्स्वाहाक्षरसमन्वितम् |
तदन्ते परमात्मानं प्रज्ञाधारोपरि स्थितम् || 212 ||
text_mt: and the other word "mantramātre", accompanied by the syllable "svāhā"; / at the end of that, the supreme Self situated upon the support of wisdom, // 212

sanskrit_iast:
bhūdhareṇa yutaṃ mūrdhnā bhūdharopari vinyaset |
viśvāpyāyakarāntasthaṃ trailokyaiśvaryadaṃ mune || 213 ||
meaning:
भूधरेण युतं मूर्ध्ना भूधरोपरि विन्यसेत् |
विश्वाप्यायकरान्तस्थं त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदं मुने || 213 ||
text_mt: endowed with the mountain-bearer on his head, one should install upon the mountain-bearer, / residing within that which nourishes the universe, granting sovereignty over the three worlds, O sage. // 213

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśākṣaro mantro ghaṇṭākhyassarvasiddhikṛt |
vinyāsakāle yasyā vai plutamuccārayettataḥ || 214 ||
meaning:
त्रयोदशाक्षरो मन्त्रो घण्टाख्यस्सर्वसिद्धिकृत् |
विन्यासकाले यस्या वै प्लुतमुच्चारयेत्ततः || 214 ||
text_mt: The thirteen-syllable mantra named the Bell achieves all perfections; / at the time of its installation, one should recite it protractedly. // 214

sanskrit_iast: [ghaṇṭādhyānaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [घण्टाध्यानप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Manner of meditating on the bell]

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānayuktaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha taddhyānamavadhāraya |
adhomukhaṃ tu brahmāṇḍaṃ dhyāyejjanaravākulam || 215 ||
meaning:
ध्यानयुक्तं द्विजश्रेष्ठ तद्ध्यानमवधारय |
अधोमुखं तु ब्रह्माण्डं ध्यायेज्जनरवाकुलम् || 215 ||
text_mt: Understand that meditation, O best of the twice-born, accompanied by visualisation: / one should meditate on the universe facing downward, filled with the roar of people, // 215

sanskrit_iast:
sanālaṃ ca tadūrdhve tu padmamaṣṭadalaṃ tathā |
prakīrṇapatraṃ susitaṃ (ta ?) kesarālaṃ (liṃ ?) sukarṇikam || 216 ||
meaning:
सनालं च तदूर्ध्वे तु पद्ममष्टदलं तथा |
प्रकीर्णपत्रं सुसितं (त ?) केसरालं (लिं ?) सुकर्णिकम् || 216 ||
text_mt: and above that, an eight-petalled lotus with its stalk, / with spread petals, pure white, with filaments and a fine pericarp. // 216

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye cintayeddevīṃ vargāṣṭaka bhujānvitām |
mukhyahastacatuṣke tu lāñchanaṃ kamalādikam || 217 ||
meaning:
तन्मध्ये चिन्तयेद्देवीं वर्गाष्टक भुजान्विताम् |
मुख्यहस्तचतुष्के तु लाञ्छनं कमलादिकम् || 217 ||
text_mt: In its centre one should contemplate the goddess endowed with eight arms [representing] the eight groups; / in her four principal hands are the emblems, lotus and the rest: // 217

sanskrit_iast:
kamalaṃ ca tataḥ śaṅkhaṃ pāśaṃ caivāṅkuśaṃ kramāt |
sphaṭikaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca tathā vijñānapustakam || 218 ||
meaning:
कमलं च ततः शङ्खं पाशं चैवाङ्कुशं क्रमात् |
स्फटिकं चाक्षसूत्रं च तथा विज्ञानपुस्तकम् || 218 ||
text_mt: the lotus, and then the conch, the noose, and the goad in order, / and a crystal rosary, as well as the book of transcendent knowledge; // 218

sanskrit_iast:
abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva hastadvidvitaye pare |
padmāsane copaviṣṭhāṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇām || 219 ||
meaning:
अभयं वरदं चैव हस्तद्विद्वितये परे |
पद्मासने चोपविष्ठां पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणाम् || 219 ||
text_mt: and the gestures of fearlessness and boon-bestowal in the other two pairs of hands; / seated upon a lotus-seat, with eyes wide as lotus petals, // 219

sanskrit_iast:
padmagarbhapratīkāśāṃ padmamālāvibhūṣitām |
vidyābharaṇasaṃchannāṃ pītavastraviveṣṭitām || 220 ||
meaning:
पद्मगर्भप्रतीकाशां पद्ममालाविभूषिताम् |
विद्याभरणसंछन्नां पीतवस्त्रविवेष्टिताम् || 220 ||
text_mt: resembling the interior of a lotus, adorned with a garland of lotuses, / covered with the ornament of knowledge, wrapped in yellow garments. // 220

sanskrit_iast: darśayeddevadevasya mudrāṃ nārāyaṇātmanaḥ |
meaning: दर्शयेद्देवदेवस्य मुद्रां नारायणात्मनः |
text_mt: He should show to the God of gods the mudrā of the nature of Nārāyaṇa. // 221ab

sanskrit_iast: [lakṣmyādimantrāṇāmabhyarcanam]
meaning: [लक्ष्म्यादिमन्त्राणामभ्यर्चनम्]
text_mt: [Worship of the mantras of Lakṣmī and the others]

sanskrit_iast: lakṣmyādīnāṃ tato bhaktyā mantrāṇāṃ ca mahāmune || 221 ||
meaning: लक्ष्म्यादीनां ततो भक्त्या मन्त्राणां च महामुने || 221 ||
text_mt: Then with devotion [he should worship] the mantras of Lakṣmī and the others, O great sage, // 221cd

sanskrit_iast: p. 124) bhūyo'rghyapuṣpagandhena dhūpāntena samarcayet |
meaning: प्. 124) भूयोऽर्घ्यपुष्पगन्धेन धूपान्तेन समर्चयेत् |
text_mt: again with arghya, flowers, and incense, concluding with incense. // 222ab

sanskrit_iast: [atha stutiḥ]
meaning: [अथ स्तुतिः]

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ stuvīta deveśaṃ stotreṇānena nārada || 222 ||
meaning: ततः स्तुवीत देवेशं स्तोत्रेणानेन नारद || 222 ||
text_mt: Then he should praise the Lord of gods with this hymn, O Nārada: // 222cd

sanskrit_iast:
samyakpraṇavapūrveṇa namo'ntena tu vai tridhā |
jitante puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana || 223 ||
meaning:
सम्यक्प्रणवपूर्वेण नमोऽन्तेन तु वै त्रिधा |
जितन्ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष नमस्ते विश्वभावन || 223 ||
text_mt: fully preceded by the praṇava and ending in 'namaḥ', three times indeed: / 'Victory to You, O lotus-eyed one! Salutation to You, O Creator of the universe! // 223

sanskrit_iast: namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣapūrvaja |
meaning: नमस्तेऽस्तु हृषीकेश महापुरुषपूर्वज |
text_mt: Salutation be to You, O Hṛṣīkeśa, first-born of the Great Puruṣa!' // 224ab

sanskrit_iast: [madhuparkādisamarpaṇaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [मधुपर्कादिसमर्पणप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure for offering the honey-mixture and other items]

sanskrit_iast: japanvai dadhisaṃpūrṇaṃ madhunā sarpiṣā'nvitam || 224 ||
meaning: जपन्वै दधिसंपूर्णं मधुना सर्पिषाऽन्वितम् || 224 ||
text_mt: While reciting [the mantra], holding in the palm of his hand a vessel full of curd, / combined with honey and clarified butter, // 224cd

sanskrit_iast:
pātraṃ karatale kṛtvā tanmadhyasthaṃ prabhuṃ smaret |
mūlamantreṇa tadvastu svarūpāduditena ca || 225 ||
meaning:
पात्रं करतले कृत्वा तन्मध्यस्थं प्रभुं स्मरेत् |
मूलमन्त्रेण तद्वस्तु स्वरूपादुदितेन च || 225 ||
text_mt: he should remember the Lord situated within it, / with the root-mantra and as arisen from His own form, // 225

sanskrit_iast:
lasatpīyūṣakallolasattaraṅgeṇa nārada |
tannivedya punarbhaktyā bhūyaḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet || 226 ||
meaning:
लसत्पीयूषकल्लोलसत्तरङ्गेण नारद |
तन्निवेद्य पुनर्भक्त्या भूयः पुष्पाञ्जलिं क्षिपेत् || 226 ||
text_mt: with gleaming surges and splendid waves of nectar, O Nārada. / Having offered that with devotion, he should again cast a handful of flowers. // 226

sanskrit_iast:
tato nivedayedviṣṇorhiraṇyakaṭakādikam |
anantaraṃ nimittārthaṃ tāmbūlaṃ tadanantaram || 227 ||
meaning:
ततो निवेदयेद्विष्णोर्हिरण्यकटकादिकम् |
अनन्तरं निमित्तार्थं ताम्बूलं तदनन्तरम् || 227 ||
text_mt: Then he should offer to Viṣṇu gold, bracelets, and the like, / immediately thereafter for the sake of the rite, and immediately after that, betel. // 227

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya gandhatoyena arghyapātroddhṛtena vai |
pāṇiyugmaṃ yathā vai syātsārdhamatyantanirmalam || 228 ||
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य गन्धतोयेन अर्घ्यपात्रोद्धृतेन वै |
पाणियुग्मं यथा वै स्यात्सार्धमत्यन्तनिर्मलम् || 228 ||
text_mt: Having washed both hands with scented water / drawn from the arghya-vessel, so that they become thoroughly and exceedingly pure, // 228

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyadhūpapātrādyaiḥ pātraiśca nirmalīkṛtam |
kṛtvā tadgandhadigdhau tau arghyeṇārcya parasparam || 229 ||
meaning:
नैवेद्यधूपपात्राद्यैः पात्रैश्च निर्मलीकृतम् |
कृत्वा तद्गन्धदिग्धौ तौ अर्घ्येणार्च्य परस्परम् || 229 ||
text_mt: cleansed by vessels such as the food-offering and incense vessels, / and having smeared them with that scent, honoring them reciprocally with arghya, // 229

sanskrit_iast: tannivedya vibhoḥ paścādvākkarmamanasā'nvitaḥ |
meaning: तन्निवेद्य विभोः पश्चाद्वाक्कर्ममनसाऽन्वितः |
text_mt: he should offer that to the all-pervading Lord, afterwards accompanied by speech, action, and mind: // 230ab

sanskrit_iast: [bāhyayāgaparisamāpanakramaḥ]
meaning: [बाह्ययागपरिसमापनक्रमः]
text_mt: [The procedure for concluding the external sacrifice]

sanskrit_iast: puṇḍarīkākṣa viśvātmanmantramūrte janārdana || 230 ||
meaning: पुण्डरीकाक्ष विश्वात्मन्मन्त्रमूर्ते जनार्दन || 230 ||
text_mt: 'O lotus-eyed one, O Self of all, O embodiment of mantra, O Janārdana! // 230cd

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇedaṃ jagannātha mama dīnasya śāśvata |
ityuktvā sodakaṃ puṣpaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇapāṇigam || 231 ||
meaning:
गृहाणेदं जगन्नाथ मम दीनस्य शाश्वत |
इत्युक्त्वा सोदकं पुष्पं कृत्वा दक्षिणपाणिगम् || 231 ||
text_mt: Accept this, O Lord of the world, from me, a wretched one, O eternal Lord!' / Having spoken thus, placing a flower with water in his right hand, // 231

sanskrit_iast:
agrato nikṣipedviṣṇormūlamantreṇa nārada |
bhāvayecca tatassamyaksphurantīṃ tārakāvalīm || 232 ||
meaning:
अग्रतो निक्षिपेद्विष्णोर्मूलमन्त्रेण नारद |
भावयेच्च ततस्सम्यक्स्फुरन्तीं तारकावलीम् || 232 ||
text_mt: he should cast it before Viṣṇu with the root-mantra, O Nārada. / And then he should properly visualize the radiant row of stars // 232

sanskrit_iast:
praviṣṭāṃ bhavagadvakre vakrāntāddhṛdgatāṃ punaḥ |
hṛdayāddvijaśārdūla saṃhārākhyakrameṇa tu || 233 ||
meaning:
प्रविष्टां भवगद्वक्रे वक्रान्ताद्धृद्गतां पुनः |
हृदयाद्द्विजशार्दूल संहाराख्यक्रमेण तु || 233 ||
text_mt: that has entered the mouth of the Lord, and from His mouth has reached the heart again; / and from the heart, O tiger among the twice-born, in the order called dissolution, // 233

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavadbrahmarandhreṇa pareṇa saha yojayet |
bhagavantaṃ tato nattvā aṣṭāṃgena tu bhaktitaḥ || 234 ||
meaning:
पूर्ववद्ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण परेण सह योजयेत् |
भगवन्तं ततो नत्त्वा अष्टांगेन तु भक्तितः || 234 ||
text_mt: he should unite it with the Supreme through the aperture of Brahman as before. / Then, having bowed down to the Lord with eight limbs out of devotion, // 234

sanskrit_iast:
p. 125) samutthāyāsanāttasminnarghyapuṣpe vinikṣipet |
yasmāttatkṣaṇamantraṃ(?) tu na śūnyaṃ saṃparityajet || 235 ||
meaning:
प्. 125) समुत्थायासनात्तस्मिन्नर्घ्यपुष्पे विनिक्षिपेत् |
यस्मात्तत्क्षणमन्त्रं(?) तु न शून्यं संपरित्यजेत् || 235 ||
text_mt: rising from his seat, he should cast arghya and flowers upon it, / because he should not leave that moment's seat empty: // 235

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānātjñānato vā'pi yātamūnādhikaṃ ca yat |
dāsasya mama dīnasya kṣantavyaṃ lokalocana || 236 ||
meaning:
अज्ञानात्ज्ञानतो वाऽपि यातमूनाधिकं च यत् |
दासस्य मम दीनस्य क्षन्तव्यं लोकलोचन || 236 ||
text_mt: 'Whatever has been deficient or redundant, whether done through ignorance or knowledge, / must be forgiven to me, a wretched servant, O Eye of the world!' // 236

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyaṃsahitāyāṃ bāhyayāgākhyānaṃ nāma
trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यंसहितायां बाह्ययागाख्यानं नाम
त्रयोदशः पटलः || 13 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, named 'The Exposition of the External Sacrifice', in the venerable Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the Pāñcarātra. // 13

sanskrit_iast: atha japavidhānaṃ nāma caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: अथ जपविधानं नाम चतुर्दशः पटलः
text_mt: Now the fourteenth chapter, named 'The Procedure for Japa'.

sanskrit_iast: nāradaḥ-
meaning: नारदः-

sanskrit_iast:
brūhi me devadeveśa viṣṇorvibhavamātmanaḥ |
nirṇayaṃ japayajñasya na jñātaṃ tatkathaṃ bhavet || 1 ||
meaning:
ब्रूहि मे देवदेवेश विष्णोर्विभवमात्मनः |
निर्णयं जपयज्ञस्य न ज्ञातं तत्कथं भवेत् || 1 ||
text_mt: "Tell me, O Lord of the gods of gods, the glory of Viṣṇu Himself, / and the determination of the sacrifice of japa; how can that which is not understood be known?" // 1

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavānuvāca
meaning: श्रीभगवानुवाच

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ santarpya deveśaṃ kumbhe vā maṇḍalādiṣu |
japayajñavidhānena devaṃ santarpayettataḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
एवं सन्तर्प्य देवेशं कुम्भे वा मण्डलादिषु |
जपयज्ञविधानेन देवं सन्तर्पयेत्ततः || 2 ||
text_mt: "Having thus gratified the Lord of gods in the pot or in the maṇḍalas and the like, / he should then gratify the god according to the procedure of the sacrifice of japa. // 2

sanskrit_iast: tadā sa sarvakāmārthānmanaseṣṭānprayacchati |
meaning: तदा स सर्वकामार्थान्मनसेष्टान्प्रयच्छति |
text_mt: Then He grants all desired ends wished for in the mind. // 3ab

sanskrit_iast: [japasya traividhyam]
meaning: [जपस्य त्रैविध्यम्]

sanskrit_iast: japaṃ tu trividhaṃ kuryādakṣasūtrakarārpitaḥ || 3 ||
meaning: जपं तु त्रिविधं कुर्यादक्षसूत्रकरार्पितः || 3 ||
text_mt: Holding the rosary in his hand, he should perform japa of three kinds: // 3cd

sanskrit_iast:
vācikaṃ kṣudrakarmabhya upāṃśuṃ siddhikarmaṇi |
mānasaṃ mokṣakamārthaṃ dhyāyeddevaṃ tu sarvataḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
वाचिकं क्षुद्रकर्मभ्य उपांशुं सिद्धिकर्मणि |
मानसं मोक्षकमार्थं ध्यायेद्देवं तु सर्वतः || 4 ||
text_mt: vocal for minor rites, whispered in a rite for siddhi, / and mental for the sake of liberation; and he should meditate on the god everywhere. // 4

sanskrit_iast: akṣasūtraṃ śubhaṃ kāryamadṛśyamitarairjanaiḥ |
meaning: अक्षसूत्रं शुभं कार्यमदृश्यमितरैर्जनैः |
text_mt: An auspicious rosary should be made, unseen by other people. // 5ab

sanskrit_iast: [akṣasūtravidhānam tatra maṇipramāṇādiviśeṣāḥ]
meaning: [अक्षसूत्रविधानम् तत्र मणिप्रमाणादिविशेषाः]
text_mt: [The rule for the rosary, therein the particulars such as bead sizes]

sanskrit_iast: akṣāsthimātrairmaṇibhirjyeṣṭhaṃ kuryātsuvarttulam || 5 ||
meaning: अक्षास्थिमात्रैर्मणिभिर्ज्येष्ठं कुर्यात्सुवर्त्तुलम् || 5 ||
text_mt: He should make the superior one perfectly spherical with beads the size of vibhītaka nuts. // 5cd

sanskrit_iast:
ghātrīphalānāṃ garbheṇa pramāṇaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam |
badarāsthipramāṇena kanīyaṃḥ samudāhṛtam || 6 ||
meaning:
घात्रीफलानां गर्भेण प्रमाणं मध्यमं स्मृतम् |
बदरास्थिप्रमाणेन कनीयंः समुदाहृतम् || 6 ||
text_mt: The size of an āmalaka fruit's seed is considered intermediate; / and the size of a jujube seed is declared to be the smallest. // 6

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tadardhaṃ pādameva vā |
kuryāttacca vidhānoktaṃ vidhinā pratikarmaṇi || 7 ||
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं पूर्णं तदर्धं पादमेव वा |
कुर्यात्तच्च विधानोक्तं विधिना प्रतिकर्मणि || 7 ||
text_mt: He should make it full with one hundred and eight [beads], or half that, or a quarter, / prescribed according to rule, in each rite according to injunction. // 7

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ dravyasidhyarthamuttamaṃ tatra kārayet |
puṣṭyarthaṃ rūpalābhāya rājataṃ pitṛkarmaṇi || 8 ||
meaning:
सौवर्णं द्रव्यसिध्यर्थमुत्तमं तत्र कारयेत् |
पुष्ट्यर्थं रूपलाभाय राजतं पितृकर्मणि || 8 ||
text_mt: There he should have a superior one made of gold for attaining wealth; / one of silver for nourishment and obtaining beauty, in rites for the ancestors; // 8

sanskrit_iast:
medhāvīryamahātejolābhārthaṃ tāmrameva ca |
madhyamaṃ muniśārdūla kāryaṃ caivākṣasūtrakam || 9 ||
meaning:
मेधावीर्यमहातेजोलाभार्थं ताम्रमेव च |
मध्यमं मुनिशार्दूल कार्यं चैवाक्षसूत्रकम् || 9 ||
text_mt: and one made of copper for obtaining intellect, vigor, and great splendor. / An intermediate rosary should be made, O tiger among sages, // 9

sanskrit_iast:
p. 126) yakṣāṇāṃ yakṣiṇīnāṃ ca sādhane trapujaṃ smṛtam |
rākṣasānāṃ piśācānāṃ vaśe sīsamayaṃ tu vai || 10 ||
meaning:
प्. 126) यक्षाणां यक्षिणीनां च साधने त्रपुजं स्मृतम् |
राक्षसानां पिशाचानां वशे सीसमयं तु वै || 10 ||
text_mt: one made of tin is prescribed in the propitiation of yakṣas and yakṣiṇīs; / and one made of lead for subjugating rākṣasas and piśācas. // 10

sanskrit_iast:
pātālasādhanārthaṃ tu arītimayamucyate |
sapannagānāṃ nāgānāṃ sādhane syāttu kāṃsyajam || 11 ||
meaning:
पातालसाधनार्थं तु अरीतिमयमुच्यते |
सपन्नगानां नागानां साधने स्यात्तु कांस्यजम् || 11 ||
text_mt: For propitiating the netherworld, one of brass is taught; / and in propitiating serpents with snakes, it should be made of bell-metal. // 11

sanskrit_iast:
kanīyastu tadā kuryādāyasaṃ kṣudrakarmaṇi |
iti dhātumayānāṃ ca sūtrāṇāṃ vidhayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
कनीयस्तु तदा कुर्यादायसं क्षुद्रकर्मणि |
इति धातुमयानां च सूत्राणां विधयः स्मृताः || 12 ||
text_mt: Then he should make the smallest one of iron for minor rites. / Thus are declared the rules for rosaries made of metals. // 12

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣye maṇimayānāṃ ca vibhāgaṃ munisattama |
sarvaṃ maṇimayaṃ caiva āyurārogyabhūtidam || 13 ||
meaning:
वक्ष्ये मणिमयानां च विभागं मुनिसत्तम |
सर्वं मणिमयं चैव आयुरारोग्यभूतिदम् || 13 ||
text_mt: I shall also speak of the division of those made of gems, O best of sages. / Every [rosary] made of gems bestows long life, health, and prosperity; // 13

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣadaṃ tu viśeṣeṇa sphāṭikaṃ śāntikarmaṇi |
tritayaṃ cottamādyaṃ yatsamaṃ sarveṣu karmasu || 14 ||
meaning:
मोक्षदं तु विशेषेण स्फाटिकं शान्तिकर्मणि |
त्रितयं चोत्तमाद्यं यत्समं सर्वेषु कर्मसु || 14 ||
text_mt: and one of crystal especially bestows liberation in a rite of pacification. / That triad beginning with the superior is equal in all rites. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
mūlajānāmatho vakṣye bījānāṃ vidhimuttamam |
saubhāgye vaidrumaṃ kāryamuttamādyaṃ sadā trayam || 15 ||
meaning:
मूलजानामथो वक्ष्ये बीजानां विधिमुत्तमम् |
सौभाग्ये वैद्रुमं कार्यमुत्तमाद्यं सदा त्रयम् || 15 ||
text_mt: Now I shall speak of the superior rule for seeds originating from plants. / For good fortune, one of coral should be made; the triad beginning with the superior is always [applicable]. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
muktyarthaṃ putra dīptaistu puṣpaṣairdopraśāntaye |
vakṣye jalotthitānāṃ ca viṣayaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 16 ||
meaning:
मुक्त्यर्थं पुत्र दीप्तैस्तु पुष्पषैर्दोप्रशान्तये |
वक्ष्ये जलोत्थितानां च विषयं सर्वसिद्धिदम् || 16 ||
text_mt: For liberation, O son, with bright [seeds], and with flowers for the pacification of blemishes. / I shall also speak of the category of things born in water, which bestows all accomplishments: // 16

sanskrit_iast:
padmabījaiśca śāṅkhaiśca śrīkāmo japamārabhet |
āyuḥprajñāyaśaśśāntau mauktikaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 17 ||
meaning:
पद्मबीजैश्च शाङ्खैश्च श्रीकामो जपमारभेत् |
आयुःप्रज्ञायशश्शान्तौ मौक्तिकं सर्वसिद्धिदम् || 17 ||
text_mt: one who desires prosperity should begin japa with lotus seeds and conch beads; / one of pearl bestows all accomplishments for long life, wisdom, fame, and pacification. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
uttamādivibhāgena tritayaṃ yatprakīrtitam |
ebhyo madhyādekatamaṃ grāhyaṃ caiva śubhe dine || 18 ||
meaning:
उत्तमादिविभागेन त्रितयं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् |
एभ्यो मध्यादेकतमं ग्राह्यं चैव शुभे दिने || 18 ||
text_mt: Regarding that triad which has been proclaimed according to the division beginning with superior, / on an auspicious day one should choose any one from among these. // 18

sanskrit_iast: [maṇīnāṃ kṣālanaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [मणीनां क्षालनप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure for washing the beads]

sanskrit_iast: sāstreṇa gandhatoyena kṣālayettadanantaram |
meaning: सास्त्रेण गन्धतोयेन क्षालयेत्तदनन्तरम् |
text_mt: Immediately after, he should wash [them] with scented water with the astra[-mantra]. // 19ab

sanskrit_iast: [sūtraviśeṣavidhānam]
meaning: [सूत्रविशेषविधानम्]

sanskrit_iast: śāṇaṃ kārpāsakaṃ vā'tha prāpya sūtraṃ navaṃ dṛḍham || 19 ||
meaning: शाणं कार्पासकं वाऽथ प्राप्य सूत्रं नवं दृढम् || 19 ||
text_mt: Having obtained a fresh, strong cord of hemp or cotton, // 19cd

sanskrit_iast:
triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya caturthā vā yathā dṛḍham |
suveṣṭitaṃ tu vai kṛtvā kṣālayetpūrvavaddvija || 20 ||
meaning:
त्रिगुणं त्रिगुणीकृत्य चतुर्था वा यथा दृढम् |
सुवेष्टितं तु वै कृत्वा क्षालयेत्पूर्ववद्द्विज || 20 ||
text_mt: three-ply made three-fold, or four-fold so that it is strong, / having wound it well, he should wash it as before, O twice-born. // 20

sanskrit_iast: [sūtre maṇīnāṃ yojanaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [सूत्रे मणीनां योजनप्रकारः]
text_mt: [The procedure for joining the beads on the cord]

sanskrit_iast:
nikṣepyā maṇayastasminsandhānakramayuktitaḥ |
maṇayassusamāssarve ūnādhikyavivarjitāḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
निक्षेप्या मणयस्तस्मिन्सन्धानक्रमयुक्तितः |
मणयस्सुसमास्सर्वे ऊनाधिक्यविवर्जिताः || 21 ||
text_mt: The beads are to be strung on it according to the method of joining; / all the beads must be thoroughly uniform, free from deficiency or excess, // 21

sanskrit_iast:
japārthaṃ muniśārdūla nityaṃ mantreṣu niṣkale |
maṇibhiḥ kramasūtraistu mutantukala niṣkale (?) || 22 ||
meaning:
जपार्थं मुनिशार्दूल नित्यं मन्त्रेषु निष्कले |
मणिभिः क्रमसूत्रैस्तु मुतन्तुकल निष्कले (?) || 22 ||
text_mt: for the sake of japa, O tiger among sages, constantly in mantras without parts. / With beads and ordered cords […] in the unmanifest, // 22

sanskrit_iast:
p. 127) sakale tu yathecchā vai sūtrārthaṃ maṇigolakāḥ | (?)
yugalaṃ yugalaṃ sūtre parasparamukhaṃ dvija || 23 ||
meaning:
प्. 127) सकले तु यथेच्छा वै सूत्रार्थं मणिगोलकाः | (?)
युगलं युगलं सूत्रे परस्परमुखं द्विज || 23 ||
text_mt: and in the manifest, as desired, the bead-globes for the cord [should be arranged], / each pair facing one another on the cord, O twice-born, // 23

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhasya lagnaṃ vā yathā syādyojayettathā |
sandhāya cātisuśliṣṭaṃ gahanaṃ na bhavedyathā || 24 ||
meaning:
पृष्ठं पृष्ठस्य लग्नं वा यथा स्याद्योजयेत्तथा |
सन्धाय चातिसुश्लिष्टं गहनं न भवेद्यथा || 24 ||
text_mt: or joined back-to-back, so he should join them, / having fitted them very closely so that it is not impenetrable. // 24

sanskrit_iast: [akṣasūtrasya valayākāratāpādanam]
meaning: [अक्षसूत्रस्य वलयाकारतापादनम्]
text_mt: [Giving the rosary the form of a ring]

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamaṇīnāṃ tu protānāṃ munisattama |
avyucchinnena tenaiva tvekena protatantunā || 25 ||
meaning:
परस्परमणीनां तु प्रोतानां मुनिसत्तम |
अव्युच्छिन्नेन तेनैव त्वेकेन प्रोततन्तुना || 25 ||
text_mt: When the beads have been strung mutually, O best of sages, / with that very same unbroken thread on which they were strung, // 25

sanskrit_iast:
maṇibhyāṃ saṅgamoddeśātsūtraṃ sūtreṇa veṣṭayet |
yathā syātkaṭakākāraṃ stabdhaṃ vṛttaṃ vibhaktimat || 26 ||
meaning:
मणिभ्यां सङ्गमोद्देशात्सूत्रं सूत्रेण वेष्टयेत् |
यथा स्यात्कटकाकारं स्तब्धं वृत्तं विभक्तिमत् || 26 ||
text_mt: from the point of union of the two beads, he should wrap cord with cord, / so that it takes the shape of a bracelet, rigid, circular, and divided into parts. // 26

sanskrit_iast: [akṣasūtre merukalpanam]
meaning: [अक्षसूत्रे मेरुकल्पनम्]
text_mt: [Arranging the meru on the rosary]

sanskrit_iast:
grandhisandhāvato vipra maṇisakhyādhikaṃ tataḥ |
meruṃ prakalpayenmadhye ekena gulikena ca || 27 ||
meaning:
ग्रन्धिसन्धावतो विप्र मणिसख्याधिकं ततः |
मेरुं प्रकल्पयेन्मध्ये एकेन गुलिकेन च || 27 ||
text_mt: At the junction of the knot, O brahmin, beyond the count of the beads, / he should then fashion the meru in the middle with a single bead. // 27

sanskrit_iast: [akṣasūtrasaṃśodhanāvadhānam]
meaning: [अक्षसूत्रसंशोधनावधानम्]
text_mt: [Rules for purifying the rosary]

sanskrit_iast:
vilipya candanādyaistu sthāpayedbhājane śubhe |
saṃpūjya puṣpadhūpādyaistasya śuddhimathācaret || 28 ||
meaning:
विलिप्य चन्दनाद्यैस्तु स्थापयेद्भाजने शुभे |
संपूज्य पुष्पधूपाद्यैस्तस्य शुद्धिमथाचरेत् || 28 ||
text_mt: Having smeared it with sandal and [other unguents], he should place it in an auspicious vessel; / having worshipped it with flowers, incense, and the like, he should then perform its purification. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhamastreṇa saṃcintya varmaṇā māruteritam |
āplāvya mūlamantreṇa paramāmṛtarūpiṇā || 29 ||
meaning:
दग्धमस्त्रेण संचिन्त्य वर्मणा मारुतेरितम् |
आप्लाव्य मूलमन्त्रेण परमामृतरूपिणा || 29 ||
text_mt: Thinking of it as burnt by the astra, driven by the wind with the kavaca, / and inundated with the mūlamantra in the form of supreme nectar, // 29

sanskrit_iast: saṃśodhyaivaṃ purā sūtraṃ dehavaccintayettataḥ |
meaning: संशोध्यैवं पुरा सूत्रं देहवच्चिन्तयेत्ततः |
text_mt: having thus first purified the cord, he should then contemplate it like a body.

sanskrit_iast: [akṣasūtrasya divyadehatvena cintanam]
meaning: [अक्षसूत्रस्य दिव्यदेहत्वेन चिन्तनम्]
text_mt: [Contemplation of the rosary as having a divine body]

sanskrit_iast: caturbhujaṃ tu virajo nārāyaṇamivāparam || 30 ||
meaning: चतुर्भुजं तु विरजो नारायणमिवापरम् || 30 ||
text_mt: He should recall it as four-armed, immaculate, like another Nārāyaṇa, // 30

sanskrit_iast:
varadābhayahastaṃ ca baddhāñjalidharaṃ smaret |
brahmadvārasthitaṃ tacca sūtraṃ dhyāyecchikhopamam || 31 ||
meaning:
वरदाभयहस्तं च बद्धाञ्जलिधरं स्मरेत् |
ब्रह्मद्वारस्थितं तच्च सूत्रं ध्यायेच्छिखोपमम् || 31 ||
text_mt: with hands bestowing boons and freedom from fear, and holding folded hands. / And he should meditate on that cord resting at the door of Brahman, resembling a tuft of hair, // 31

sanskrit_iast: svamantreṇa dvijaśreṣṭha mantramatra nibodhatu |
meaning: स्वमन्त्रेण द्विजश्रेष्ठ मन्त्रमत्र निबोधतु |
text_mt: with its own mantra, O best of the twice-born; hear the mantra here:

sanskrit_iast: [akṣasūtramantraḥ]
meaning: [अक्षसूत्रमन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast: proddharetpraṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ tadante kaustubhaṃ nyaset || 32 ||
meaning: प्रोद्धरेत्प्रणवं पूर्वं तदन्ते कौस्तुभं न्यसेत् || 32 ||
text_mt: He should first extract the praṇava; after that he should place kaustubha; // 32

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyaiśvaryadopetaṃ gopanenāṅkayecca tat |
tadante tvakṣasūtrāya padaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ nyaset || 33 ||
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदोपेतं गोपनेनाङ्कयेच्च तत् |
तदन्ते त्वक्षसूत्राय पदं पञ्चाक्षरं न्यसेत् || 33 ||
text_mt: he should mark that which bestows sovereignty over the three worlds with concealing; / after that he should place the five-syllable word akṣasūtrāya, // 33

sanskrit_iast: namaskārānvitaḥ prokto hyakṣasūtrasya mantrarāṭ |
meaning: नमस्कारान्वितः प्रोक्तो ह्यक्षसूत्रस्य मन्त्रराट् |
text_mt: endowed with namas—thus is declared the king of mantras of the rosary.

sanskrit_iast: [svamantreṇākṣasūtrasya sakalīkaraṇapūjane]
meaning: [स्वमन्त्रेणाक्षसूत्रस्य सकलीकरणपूजने]
text_mt: [Sakalīkaraṇa and worship of the rosary with its own mantra]

sanskrit_iast: sakalīkaraṇaṃ kuryānmantreṇānena tasya vai || 34 ||
meaning: सकलीकरणं कुर्यान्मन्त्रेणानेन तस्य वै || 34 ||
text_mt: He should indeed perform the sakalīkaraṇa of it with this mantra, // 34

sanskrit_iast: p. 128) pūjayecca svamantreṇa tatastatsanghaye kramāt |
meaning: प्. 128) पूजयेच्च स्वमन्त्रेण ततस्तत्सन्घये क्रमात् |
text_mt: and then worship it with its own mantra in its collection in due order.

sanskrit_iast: [vaiṣṇavyāḥ paraśakterakṣasūtre bhāvanākramavidhānam]
meaning: [वैष्णव्याः परशक्तेरक्षसूत्रे भावनाक्रमविधानम्]
text_mt: [Prescription of the order of meditation on the supreme Vaiṣṇava power in the rosary]

sanskrit_iast: yā parā vaiṣṇavī śaktirabhinnā paramātmanaḥ || 35 ||
meaning: या परा वैष्णवी शक्तिरभिन्ना परमात्मनः || 35 ||
text_mt: That supreme Vaiṣṇava power which is non-different from the Supreme Self, // 35

sanskrit_iast:
pracalatpūrṇacandrābhā sūryavatkiraṇāvṛtā |
yugakṣayograhutabhuktejasā tīvṛbṛṃhitā || 36 ||
meaning:
प्रचलत्पूर्णचन्द्राभा सूर्यवत्किरणावृता |
युगक्षयोग्रहुतभुक्तेजसा तीवृबृंहिता || 36 ||
text_mt: radiant like a trembling full moon, enveloped in rays like the sun, / intensely augmented by the radiance of the fire that consumes fiercely at the end of an aeon, // 36

sanskrit_iast:
prāgvatsṛṣṭikrameṇaiva smareddhṛtpadmamadhyagām |
pūrakeṇa tu viprendra kumbhakena nirodhitām || 37 ||
meaning:
प्राग्वत्सृष्टिक्रमेणैव स्मरेद्धृत्पद्ममध्यगाम् |
पूरकेण तु विप्रेन्द्र कुम्भकेन निरोधिताम् || 37 ||
text_mt: he should recall, following the sequence of creation as before, situated in the centre of the heart-lotus, / [drawn] by inhalation, O chief of brahmins, and restrained by retention. // 37

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpadmādutthitāṃ bhūyo brahmarandhrāvadhiṃ smaret |
brahmarandhrāttato vipra prollasantīṃ śanaiśśanaiḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
हृत्पद्मादुत्थितां भूयो ब्रह्मरन्ध्रावधिं स्मरेत् |
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रात्ततो विप्र प्रोल्लसन्तीं शनैश्शनैः || 38 ||
text_mt: He should again recall it risen from the heart-lotus up to the aperture of Brahman, / and then, O brahmin, shining forth gradually from the aperture of Brahman, // 38

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavatsandhimārgeṇa cintayeddvādaśāntagām | (?)
recakākhyena yogena tayā sūtraṃ tu bhāvayet || 39 ||
meaning:
पूर्ववत्सन्धिमार्गेण चिन्तयेद्द्वादशान्तगाम् | (?)
रेचकाख्येन योगेन तया सूत्रं तु भावयेत् || 39 ||
text_mt: he should contemplate it going to the end of the twelve along the junction-path as before; / by means of the yoga called exhalation, he should infuse the cord with it. // 39

sanskrit_iast: [akṣasūtraprabhodbhāsitatvena yāgālayasmaraṇam]
meaning: [अक्षसूत्रप्रभोद्भासितत्वेन यागालयस्मरणम्]
text_mt: [Recollection of the sacrificial hall as illuminated by the radiance of the rosary]

sanskrit_iast: bhāsitaṃ cātha sūtreṇa sarvaṃ yāgālayaṃ smaret |
meaning: भासितं चाथ सूत्रेण सर्वं यागालयं स्मरेत् |
text_mt: And then he should recall the whole sacrificial hall illuminated by the cord,

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇenduneva gaganaṃ,
meaning: पूर्णेन्दुनेव गगनं,

sanskrit_iast:
[mantrātmano bhagavacchatteḥ sūtrasya mantrākṣarāṇāṃ
caikībhūtatvabhāvanavidhiḥ]
meaning:
[मन्त्रात्मनो भगवच्छत्तेः सूत्रस्य मन्त्राक्षराणां
चैकीभूतत्वभावनविधिः]
text_mt: [The rule for meditating on the oneness of the Lord's power, which is the self of the mantra, the cord, and the syllables of the mantra]

sanskrit_iast: niṣkalo mantrarāṭ tataḥ || 40 ||
meaning: निष्कलो मन्त्रराट् ततः || 40 ||
text_mt: then the partless king of mantras, // 40

sanskrit_iast:
mantrabṛndasamāyukto magnastatreti cintayet |
mantrātmā bhagavacchaktissūtramantrākṣarāṇi vai || 41 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रबृन्दसमायुक्तो मग्नस्तत्रेति चिन्तयेत् |
मन्त्रात्मा भगवच्छक्तिस्सूत्रमन्त्राक्षराणि वै || 41 ||
text_mt: joined with the host of mantras, he should contemplate as immersed therein. / The power of the Lord, which is the self of the mantra, the cord, and the syllables of the mantra— // 41

sanskrit_iast: sarvamekīkṛtaṃ dhyāyedyathā kṣīreṇa sodakam |
meaning: सर्वमेकीकृतं ध्यायेद्यथा क्षीरेण सोदकम् |
text_mt: he should meditate upon all this made one, like water with milk.

sanskrit_iast: [sakalaniṣkalamantrasya sṛṣṭikrameṇākṣasūtre sānnidhyacintanam]
meaning: [सकलनिष्कलमन्त्रस्य सृष्टिक्रमेणाक्षसूत्रे सान्निध्यचिन्तनम्]
text_mt: [Contemplation of the presence of the mantra, both with and without parts, in the rosary according to the sequence of creation]

sanskrit_iast: tatra puṣpāñjalau pṛṣṭhe gṛhītvā cintayedimam || 42 ||
meaning: तत्र पुष्पाञ्जलौ पृष्ठे गृहीत्वा चिन्तयेदिमम् || 42 ||
text_mt: Taking it there on the reverse side in a handful of flowers, he should contemplate this: // 42

sanskrit_iast:
susaṃskṛtākṣasūtrasya patantaṃ pṛṣṭhato dvija |
sṛṣṭikramātsamāyātaṃ mantraṃ sakalaniṣkalam || 43 ||
meaning:
सुसंस्कृताक्षसूत्रस्य पतन्तं पृष्ठतो द्विज |
सृष्टिक्रमात्समायातं मन्त्रं सकलनिष्कलम् || 43 ||
text_mt: falling upon the back of the well-consecrated rosary, O twice-born, / the mantra, possessing parts and partless, arrived in the sequence of creation, // 43

sanskrit_iast: sphuliṅgagaṇasaṅkāśamādheyatanutāṃ gatam |
meaning: स्फुलिङ्गगणसङ्काशमाधेयतनुतां गतम् |
text_mt: resembling a swarm of sparks, having attained the condition of the body to be supported.

sanskrit_iast: [bhagavatprārthanāpūrvaka tadabhyanujñayā'kṣasūtrasya grahaṇam]
meaning: [भगवत्प्रार्थनापूर्वक तदभ्यनुज्ञयाऽक्षसूत्रस्य ग्रहणम्]
text_mt: [Taking the rosary with the Lord's permission preceded by prayer to the Lord]

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ vijñāpya deveśamakṣasūtramayācyuta || 44 ||
meaning: इदं विज्ञाप्य देवेशमक्षसूत्रमयाच्युत || 44 ||
text_mt: Having petitioned the Lord of Gods with this: 'O Acyuta, bestow this rosary // 44

sanskrit_iast:
prayaccha mantrajāpārthaṃ smareddattaṃ ca tena tat |
gṛhīsvā śirasā paścātprasīda iti coccaret || 45 ||
meaning:
प्रयच्छ मन्त्रजापार्थं स्मरेद्दत्तं च तेन तत् |
गृहीस्वा शिरसा पश्चात्प्रसीद इति चोच्चरेत् || 45 ||
text_mt: upon me for the sake of mantra-japa', he should recall that it has been given by Him. / Having received it with his head, he should afterwards utter: 'Be gracious!' // 45

sanskrit_iast: [abhyarcanapūrvakamakṣasūtre mantrasya pratiṣṭhāpanakramaḥ]
meaning: [अभ्यर्चनपूर्वकमक्षसूत्रे मन्त्रस्य प्रतिष्ठापनक्रमः]
text_mt: [The sequence of establishing the mantra in the rosary preceded by worship]

sanskrit_iast: prāptaṃ saṃsnāpayetpaścādarghyapātrācca vāriṇā |
meaning: प्राप्तं संस्नापयेत्पश्चादर्घ्यपात्राच्च वारिणा |
text_mt: He should afterwards bathe what was received with water from the arghya-vessel,

sanskrit_iast: p. 129) saṃpūjya puṣpadhūpādyairmantraṃ tava ca vinyaset || 46 ||
meaning: प्. 129) संपूज्य पुष्पधूपाद्यैर्मन्त्रं तव च विन्यसेत् || 46 ||
text_mt: and having worshipped it with flowers, incense, and the like, he should install the mantra there: // 46

sanskrit_iast:
sādhāraṃ sādhanaṃ caiva śaktipūrvaissamāvṛtam |
sannidhau bhava deveśa sanniruddho bhavācyuta || 47 ||
meaning:
साधारं साधनं चैव शक्तिपूर्वैस्समावृतम् |
सन्निधौ भव देवेश सन्निरुद्धो भवाच्युत || 47 ||
text_mt: 'With support and with the instrument, and surrounded by the primary powers, / be present, O Lord of Gods! Be restrained [here], O Acyuta, // 47

sanskrit_iast:
sūtrākhye maṇijāle'sminyāvaccaṃdrārkatārakam |
evaṃ mune pratiṣṭhāpya mantraṃ sūtre'kṣasaṃjñike || 48 ||
meaning:
सूत्राख्ये मणिजालेऽस्मिन्यावच्चंद्रार्कतारकम् |
एवं मुने प्रतिष्ठाप्य मन्त्रं सूत्रेऽक्षसंज्ञिके || 48 ||
text_mt: in this web of beads called a cord, as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure!' / Having thus established the mantra in the cord called akṣa, O sage, // 48

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣṭhitasya vai paścānmudrāṃ svāṃ ca pradarśayet |
meaning: प्रतिष्ठितस्य वै पश्चान्मुद्रां स्वां च प्रदर्शयेत् |
text_mt: he should then show its own mudrā to the one established.

sanskrit_iast: [akṣasūtramudrā]
meaning: [अक्षसूत्रमुद्रा]

sanskrit_iast: lagnaṃ tiryaggataṃ kuryātkuñcitaṃ dakṣiṇātkarāt || 49 ||
meaning: लग्नं तिर्यग्गतं कुर्यात्कुञ्चितं दक्षिणात्करात् || 49 ||
text_mt: He should place [the four fingers] adjoining, transverse, and bent from the right hand; // 49

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣkamaṅgulīnāṃ ca aṅguṣṭhāgreṇa saṃspṛśet |
tarjanādikrameṇaiva kaniṣṭhāntaṃ dvijottama || 50 ||
meaning:
चतुष्कमङ्गुलीनां च अङ्गुष्ठाग्रेण संस्पृशेत् |
तर्जनादिक्रमेणैव कनिष्ठान्तं द्विजोत्तम || 50 ||
text_mt: and he should touch the group of four fingers with the tip of the thumb, / in order beginning with the forefinger and ending with the little finger, O best of the twice-born. // 50

sanskrit_iast:
saṃspṛśantaṃ kaniṣṭhāntamaṅguṣṭhaṃ cordhvamānayet |
akṣasūtrasya mudraiṣā nityasannidhikāriṇī || 51 ||
meaning:
संस्पृशन्तं कनिष्ठान्तमङ्गुष्ठं चोर्ध्वमानयेत् |
अक्षसूत्रस्य मुद्रैषा नित्यसन्निधिकारिणी || 51 ||
text_mt: Touching up to the little finger, he should bring the thumb upwards. / This is the mudrā of the rosary, which effects perpetual presence. // 51

sanskrit_iast: japaṃ samārabhetpaścādadṛśyamitarairjanaiḥ |
meaning: जपं समारभेत्पश्चाददृश्यमितरैर्जनैः |
text_mt: Afterwards he should begin the japa, invisible to other people.

sanskrit_iast: [japārambhātprākkartavyo'nusandhānaviśeṣaḥ]
meaning: [जपारम्भात्प्राक्कर्तव्योऽनुसन्धानविशेषः]
text_mt: [The specific reflection to be made before beginning japa]

sanskrit_iast: karaṇaṃ vāṅmanaścaiva mantreṇa paramātmanā || 52 ||
meaning: करणं वाङ्मनश्चैव मन्त्रेण परमात्मना || 52 ||
text_mt: He should first contemplate the organ, and speech and mind, // 52

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunā śaktirūpeṇa bhāvitaṃ bhāvayetpurā |
cetasā yadupārūḍhaṃ tadyuktaṃ vastu vāggatam || 53 ||
meaning:
विष्णुना शक्तिरूपेण भावितं भावयेत्पुरा |
चेतसा यदुपारूढं तद्युक्तं वस्तु वाग्गतम् || 53 ||
text_mt: as infused by the mantra, by the Supreme Self, by Viṣṇu in the form of power. / That which has ascended in thought, the object endowed with that, situated in speech, // 53

sanskrit_iast:
vastuyuktaṃ ca caitanyaṃ vāktṛtīyā ca nārada |
samārohetkarmapade vikāratve śanaiśśanaiḥ || 54 ||
meaning:
वस्तुयुक्तं च चैतन्यं वाक्तृतीया च नारद |
समारोहेत्कर्मपदे विकारत्वे शनैश्शनैः || 54 ||
text_mt: consciousness endowed with the object, and speech as the third, O Nārada, / should gradually ascend to the state of action in the condition of transformation. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vivartate mantrasturyājjāgrāvadhi kramāt |
prātilomyena vai vipra punareva nivartate || 55 ||
meaning:
एवं विवर्तते मन्त्रस्तुर्याज्जाग्रावधि क्रमात् |
प्रातिलोम्येन वै विप्र पुनरेव निवर्तते || 55 ||
text_mt: Thus the mantra evolves gradually from the fourth state up to waking; / in reverse order, O brahmin, it indeed turns back again. // 55

sanskrit_iast:
karaṇaṃ vāksvarūpaṃ syādvākca cidrūpiṇī bhavet |
yaccittaṃ sa bhavenmantro yo mantrassa tvajo hariḥ || 56 ||
meaning:
करणं वाक्स्वरूपं स्याद्वाक्च चिद्रूपिणी भवेत् |
यच्चित्तं स भवेन्मन्त्रो यो मन्त्रस्स त्वजो हरिः || 56 ||
text_mt: The organ would be of the nature of speech, and speech would consist of consciousness; / that which is mind becomes the mantra; that which is the mantra is the unborn Hari. // 56

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādyajāgratparyantaṃ punaratraiva saṃnayet |
vyāpakaṃ yatparaṃ brahma śaktirnārāyaṇī ca yā || 57 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माद्यजाग्रत्पर्यन्तं पुनरत्रैव संनयेत् |
व्यापकं यत्परं ब्रह्म शक्तिर्नारायणी च या || 57 ||
text_mt: He should lead it back right here from Brahman down to waking. / That all-pervading Supreme Brahman, and that power of Nārāyaṇa— // 57

sanskrit_iast:
sā hyeva pariṇāmena turyākhyaṃ bhajate padam |
turyaṃ suṣuptatāmeti suṣuptaṃ svapnatāṃ vrajet || 58 ||
meaning:
सा ह्येव परिणामेन तुर्याख्यं भजते पदम् |
तुर्यं सुषुप्ततामेति सुषुप्तं स्वप्नतां व्रजेत् || 58 ||
text_mt: she indeed, through transformation, assumes the state called the fourth; / the fourth attains deep sleep; deep sleep goes to the state of dreaming; // 58

sanskrit_iast: jāgratvaṃ svapnamāyāti evaṃ jāgrāditaḥ punaḥ |
meaning: जाग्रत्वं स्वप्नमायाति एवं जाग्रादितः पुनः |
text_mt: dreaming arrives at the waking state. In this way, again from waking,

sanskrit_iast: p. 130) [jāgradādibhedanirūpaṇam]
meaning: प्. 130) [जाग्रदादिभेदनिरूपणम्]
text_mt: [Determination of the differences between waking and the other states]

sanskrit_iast: bhagavacchaktiparyantaṃ sandhānaṃ caikatāṃ smaret || 59 ||
meaning: भगवच्छक्तिपर्यन्तं सन्धानं चैकतां स्मरेत् || 59 ||
text_mt: up to the power of the Lord, he should recall the union and unity. // 59

sanskrit_iast:
yadanityamidaṃ vipra citravatparidṛśyate |
bāhyaṃ viṣayajālaṃ ca jāgradetadudāhṛtam || 60 ||
meaning:
यदनित्यमिदं विप्र चित्रवत्परिदृश्यते |
बाह्यं विषयजालं च जाग्रदेतदुदाहृतम् || 60 ||
text_mt: This which is transient, O brahmin, perceived like a painting, / and the external web of sense-objects—this is called waking. // 60

sanskrit_iast:
anityapratipattiryā asminnupari sarvadā |
bhaṅgure svapnatulyo yassa svapno jāgrakāraṇam || 61 ||
meaning:
अनित्यप्रतिपत्तिर्या अस्मिन्नुपरि सर्वदा |
भङ्गुरे स्वप्नतुल्यो यस्स स्वप्नो जाग्रकारणम् || 61 ||
text_mt:
The cognition of the impermanent that always exists upon this [waking state],
frail and dream-like—that is dreaming, the cause of waking. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
suṣuptaṃ śāntatāṃ viddhi svapnavṛtteḥ paraṃ tu yat |
śaktirūpasya vai viṣṇoḥ prāptasturyatvameti saḥ || 62 ||
meaning:
सुषुप्तं शान्ततां विद्धि स्वप्नवृत्तेः परं तु यत् |
शक्तिरूपस्य वै विष्णोः प्राप्तस्तुर्यत्वमेति सः || 62 ||
text_mt:
Know deep sleep to be stillness beyond the activity of dreaming;
reaching the form of power of Viṣṇu, he attains the fourth state. // 62

sanskrit_iast:
tayā saha samatvaṃ ca turyātītaṃ taducyate |
mantrātītaṃ paraṃ mantraṃ sthūlasūkṣmadvayaṃ tathā || 63 ||
meaning:
तया सह समत्वं च तुर्यातीतं तदुच्यते |
मन्त्रातीतं परं मन्त्रं स्थूलसूक्ष्मद्वयं तथा || 63 ||
text_mt:
And equality with that [power] is said to be beyond the fourth state.
Beyond the mantra, the supreme mantra, as well as the gross and subtle pair, // 63

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ pañcamaṃ vipra ekatvenānusandhayet |
kṛtvaivamanusandhānaṃ prārabheta japaṃ tathā || 64 ||
meaning:
आत्मानं पञ्चमं विप्र एकत्वेनानुसन्धयेत् |
कृत्वैवमनुसन्धानं प्रारभेत जपं तथा || 64 ||
text_mt:
and the self as the fifth, O brahmin, he should integrate into oneness.
Having thus made this integration, he should then begin the japa. // 64

sanskrit_iast: [antarhṛtpuṇḍarīkādiva bahirakṣasūtre mantrasyodaya kramabhāvanam]
meaning: [अन्तर्हृत्पुण्डरीकादिव बहिरक्षसूत्रे मन्त्रस्योदय क्रमभावनम्]
text_mt: [Meditation on the order of the mantra's arising, inside in the heart-lotus and the like, as well as outside on the rosary]

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamadhyastho bhārūpaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
nirmalasphaṭikaprakhyaḥ prasphuranyaḥ svatejasā || 65 ||
meaning:
हृत्पुण्डरीकमध्यस्थो भारूपः परमेश्वरः |
निर्मलस्फटिकप्रख्यः प्रस्फुरन्यः स्वतेजसा || 65 ||
text_mt:
The Supreme Lord, abiding in the middle of the heart-lotus, whose nature is light,
resembling a spotless crystal, flashing forth with His own splendour— // 65

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śabdamayī śaktī(ktiḥ ?)jvālāvannissṛtaṃ mahat (tāhiyā ?) |
taddharmadharmiṇī śuddhā tasyā vai varṇasantatiḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
तस्य शब्दमयी शक्ती(क्तिः ?)ज्वालावन्निस्सृतं महत् (ताहिया ?) |
तद्धर्मधर्मिणी शुद्धा तस्या वै वर्णसन्ततिः || 66 ||
text_mt:
from Him, His sonic power has emerged like a great flame;
sharing His qualities, pure, His succession of phonemes // 66

sanskrit_iast:
nissṛtā mantrajananī tadagrāccaiva mantrarāṭ |
nissṛtaṃ(tu) yathā puṣpaṃ latāgrānmunisattama || 67 ||
meaning:
निस्सृता मन्त्रजननी तदग्राच्चैव मन्त्रराट् |
निस्सृतं(तु) यथा पुष्पं लताग्रान्मुनिसत्तम || 67 ||
text_mt:
has issued forth as the mother of mantras, and from its tip the king of mantras,
just as a flower emerges from the tip of a creeper, O best of sages. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
evamevākṣasūtre tu uditaṃ ca kramaṃ smaret |
hṛllayaṃ tallayīkuryāddhṛllayasya ca tattathā || 68 ||
meaning:
एवमेवाक्षसूत्रे तु उदितं च क्रमं स्मरेत् |
हृल्लयं तल्लयीकुर्याद्धृल्लयस्य च तत्तथा || 68 ||
text_mt:
Just so he should recall the order that has arisen upon the rosary:
he should dissolve it into that which is dissolved in the heart, and that likewise into that which is dissolved in the heart, // 68

sanskrit_iast: ekasya mantranāthasya antarbāhyoditasya ca |
meaning: एकस्य मन्त्रनाथस्य अन्तर्बाह्योदितस्य च |
text_mt: of the single Lord of Mantras who has arisen internally and externally.

sanskrit_iast: [japasaṅkhyāvidhānam]
meaning: [जपसङ्ख्याविधानम्]

sanskrit_iast: yadaikaṃ tajjapo vipra lakṣasaṃkhyābhidho bhavet || 69 ||
meaning: यदैकं तज्जपो विप्र लक्षसंख्याभिधो भवेत् || 69 ||
text_mt: When it is one, O brahmin, that japa is designated as amounting to one hundred thousand. // 69

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ lakṣasthito yasmājjapastu parisaṃkhyate |
prayatnādakṣasūtreṇa japasaṃkhyā tu sā smṛtā || 70 ||
meaning:
एवं लक्षस्थितो यस्माज्जपस्तु परिसंख्यते |
प्रयत्नादक्षसूत्रेण जपसंख्या तु सा स्मृता || 70 ||
text_mt:
Because japa fixed at one hundred thousand is thus enumerated,
that, through effort with the rosary, is traditionally known as the count of japa. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
anena kramayogena viṣṇuvatkaraṇaṃ bhavet |
viṣṇuvadyogamāśritya akṣamakṣaṃ samāharet || 71 ||
meaning:
अनेन क्रमयोगेन विष्णुवत्करणं भवेत् |
विष्णुवद्योगमाश्रित्य अक्षमक्षं समाहरेत् || 71 ||
text_mt:
By this ritual sequence, action becomes like that of Viṣṇu;
resorting to yoga like Viṣṇu, he should draw bead after bead, // 71

sanskrit_iast: saha prāṇodayenaiva niṣṭhākṣaṃ yāvadeva hi |
meaning: सह प्राणोदयेनैव निष्ठाक्षं यावदेव हि |
text_mt: along with the rise of the breath, right up to the final bead.

sanskrit_iast: p. 131) [merorlaṅghananiṣedhaḥ]
meaning: प्. 131) [मेरोर्लङ्घननिषेधः]
text_mt: p. 131) [Prohibition of crossing over the meru]

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryānmerumūrtisthitasya ca || 72 ||
meaning: ततः प्रदक्षिणं कुर्यान्मेरुमूर्तिस्थितस्य च || 72 ||
text_mt: Then he should make a circumambulation of that which is situated in the form of the meru, // 72

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkalasya ca mantrasya tadūrdhve'vasthitasya ca |
grandhīrūpasya ca vibhoramalasya mahātmanaḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
निष्कलस्य च मन्त्रस्य तदूर्ध्वेऽवस्थितस्य च |
ग्रन्धीरूपस्य च विभोरमलस्य महात्मनः || 73 ||
text_mt:
and of the partless mantra situated above it,
and of the all-pervading, spotless, great-souled [Lord] who has the form of the knot. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭhena laṅghanaṃ yasmādvarjanīyaṃ tu nārada |
merumūle'ṅguliprāntaṃ śiṣṭaṃ kṛtvā śanaiśśanaiḥ || 74 ||
meaning:
पृष्ठेन लङ्घनं यस्माद्वर्जनीयं तु नारद |
मेरुमूलेऽङ्गुलिप्रान्तं शिष्टं कृत्वा शनैश्शनैः || 74 ||
text_mt:
Since, O Nārada, crossing over by the back is to be avoided,
leaving the tip of the finger at the base of the meru, slowly and slowly // 74

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhasya bhramaṃ kuryānnamerorlaṅghanaṃ bhavet |
aṅguṣṭhamūlamadhye ca bhrāmaṇīyaṃ ca chatravat || 75 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठस्य भ्रमं कुर्यान्नमेरोर्लङ्घनं भवेत् |
अङ्गुष्ठमूलमध्ये च भ्रामणीयं च छत्रवत् || 75 ||
text_mt:
he should make a turn of the thumb, so that no crossing over of the meru occurs;
and it should be turned like an umbrella at the base of the thumb. // 75

sanskrit_iast: vidhinā'nena japtavyo mantro dhyānasamanvitaḥ |
meaning: विधिनाऽनेन जप्तव्यो मन्त्रो ध्यानसमन्वितः |
text_mt: According to this rule, the mantra should be recited, accompanied by meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
[śāntikapauṣṭikādinimittabhedena mantrasya bhinnabhinnarūpatayā
dhyānavidhānam]
meaning:
[शान्तिकपौष्टिकादिनिमित्तभेदेन मन्त्रस्य भिन्नभिन्नरूपतया
ध्यानविधानम्]
text_mt: [Rules for meditating on the mantra in different forms according to the difference of motives such as pacification and nourishment]

sanskrit_iast: śāntike sphāṭikābhaṃ ca pītaṃ dhyāyecca pauṣṭike || 76 ||
meaning: शान्तिके स्फाटिकाभं च पीतं ध्यायेच्च पौष्टिके || 76 ||
text_mt: In a pacifying rite he should meditate on it as crystal-like, and as yellow in a nourishing rite; // 76

sanskrit_iast:
vaśye kiṃśukapuṣpābhamākṛṣṭau nṛpaśailavat |
māraṇe kajjalābhaṃ tu vidveṣe cāṣapakṣavat || 77 ||
meaning:
वश्ये किंशुकपुष्पाभमाकृष्टौ नृपशैलवत् |
मारणे कज्जलाभं तु विद्वेषे चाषपक्षवत् || 77 ||
text_mt:
in subjugation, like a kiṃśuka flower; in attraction, like [the colour of] a mountain of cinnabar;
in eradication, like collyrium; in causing hostility, like the wing of a roller bird; // 77

sanskrit_iast: uccāṭane ca dhūmrābhaṃ mantraṃ dhyāyejjapetsadā |
meaning: उच्चाटने च धूम्राभं मन्त्रं ध्यायेज्जपेत्सदा |
text_mt: and in expulsion, he should meditate on the mantra as smoke-coloured and recite it constantly.

sanskrit_iast: [parāparabhedena japasya dvaividhyam]
meaning: [परापरभेदेन जपस्य द्वैविध्यम्]
text_mt: [Twofold division of japa by the distinction between higher and lower]

sanskrit_iast: parāparasvarūpeṇa japastu dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 78 ||
meaning: परापरस्वरूपेण जपस्तु द्विविधः स्मृतः || 78 ||
text_mt: Japa is remembered to be twofold in nature: higher and lower. // 78

sanskrit_iast:
paradehaprade (ve ?)śe ca tattvānāṃ preraṇe dvijaṃ |
krūrakarmaṇi sidhyarthaṃ japo jyotirmayassmṛtaḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
परदेहप्रदे (वे ?)शे च तत्त्वानां प्रेरणे द्विजं |
क्रूरकर्मणि सिध्यर्थं जपो ज्योतिर्मयस्स्मृतः || 79 ||
text_mt:
For entering another's body and impelling the principles, O twice-born,
and for the success of fierce acts, japa is remembered as consisting of light. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāntarlīnamamalaṃ śabdaṃ tu paribhāvayet |
bhuktimuktiprasidhyarthaṃ doṣaduḥkhakṣayaṅkaram || 80 ||
meaning:
तत्रान्तर्लीनममलं शब्दं तु परिभावयेत् |
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रसिध्यर्थं दोषदुःखक्षयङ्करम् || 80 ||
text_mt:
There he should contemplate the spotless sound dissolved within,
which brings about the destruction of flaws and sorrow, for the accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation. // 80

sanskrit_iast:
śāntau tu sarvakāryāṇāṃ sidhyarthamavicārataḥ |
sukhasaubhāgyasidhyarthaṃ tathā'pyādhānakarmaṇi || 81 ||
meaning:
शान्तौ तु सर्वकार्याणां सिध्यर्थमविचारतः |
सुखसौभाग्यसिध्यर्थं तथाऽप्याधानकर्मणि || 81 ||
text_mt:
For pacification, for the accomplishment of all undertakings without doubt,
for the attainment of happiness and good fortune, and likewise in an act of revitalisation, // 81

sanskrit_iast:
japo bhavati śabdākhyastatrāntastu vibhāvayet |
niśāmbukaṇasaṅkāśaprakāśātmajanārdanam || 82 ||
meaning:
जपो भवति शब्दाख्यस्तत्रान्तस्तु विभावयेत् |
निशाम्बुकणसङ्काशप्रकाशात्मजनार्दनम् || 82 ||
text_mt:
the japa is termed sonic; there he should contemplate within
Janārdana, whose luminous self resembles a drop of dew at night. // 82

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpadmāttu svamantreṇaṃ bhāvayecchabdamutthitam |
nityoditaṃ tu tenaiva prayatnahari (rahi ?) tena tu || 83 ||
meaning:
हृत्पद्मात्तु स्वमन्त्रेणं भावयेच्छब्दमुत्थितम् |
नित्योदितं तु तेनैव प्रयत्नहरि (रहि ?) तेन तु || 83 ||
text_mt:
He should contemplate the sound arisen from the heart-lotus by means of his own mantra,
ever-arisen indeed by it, devoid of [forced] effort, // 83

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāpannapadasthena bhāvanāmiśritena ca |
japyamānastu vai mantrassarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 84 ||
meaning:
प्राणापन्नपदस्थेन भावनामिश्रितेन च |
जप्यमानस्तु वै मन्त्रस्सर्वकामफलप्रदः || 84 ||
text_mt:
resting in the place reached by prāṇa, combined with contemplation;
recited in this way, the mantra indeed bestows the fruit of all desires. // 84

sanskrit_iast:
p. 132) atha prayatnajanitaṃ śabdamutthāpya nārada |
kevalaṃ tu svamantreṇa baddhalakṣastu pūrvavat || 85 ||
meaning:
प्. 132) अथ प्रयत्नजनितं शब्दमुत्थाप्य नारद |
केवलं तु स्वमन्त्रेण बद्धलक्षस्तु पूर्ववत् || 85 ||
text_mt:
p. 132) Now, raising the sound produced with effort, O Nārada,
solely by means of his own mantra, fixing his aim as before, // 85

sanskrit_iast:
akṣarādakṣaraṃ yātamṛtadoṣeṇa varjitam |
vilambitaṃ ca nātītaṃ tathā'sphuṭapadojjhitam || 86 ||
meaning:
अक्षरादक्षरं यातमृतदोषेण वर्जितम् |
विलम्बितं च नातीतं तथाऽस्फुटपदोज्झितम् || 86 ||
text_mt:
proceeding from syllable to syllable, free from all faults,
neither drawn out nor hurried, and devoid of indistinct words, // 86

sanskrit_iast: cittavikṣeparahitamatyutkṛṣṭadhiyā'nvitam |
meaning: चित्तविक्षेपरहितमत्युत्कृष्टधियाऽन्वितम् |
text_mt: free from mental distraction, endowed with an exceedingly elevated intellect.

sanskrit_iast: [adhikāriṇāṃ sattvādiguṇabhedena japakālabhedaḥ]
meaning: [अधिकारिणां सत्त्वादिगुणभेदेन जपकालभेदः]
text_mt: [Difference in the time of japa according to the difference of the qualities of sattva and the others of the qualified practitioners]

sanskrit_iast: pūrvānhe madhyabhāge'tha aparānhe dinasya tu || 87 ||
meaning: पूर्वान्हे मध्यभागेऽथ अपरान्हे दिनस्य तु || 87 ||
text_mt: In the morning, in the middle part, and in the afternoon of the day, // 87

sanskrit_iast:
kramādvai sātvikādīnāṃ velātrayamudāhṛtam |
evaṃ kṛtvā japanvipra vinivedya ca yāgavat || 88 ||
meaning:
क्रमाद्वै सात्विकादीनां वेलात्रयमुदाहृतम् |
एवं कृत्वा जपन्विप्र विनिवेद्य च यागवत् || 88 ||
text_mt:
three times are stated respectively for the sāttvika and other [practitioners].
Reciting thus, O brahmin, and offering it as in a sacrifice, // 88

sanskrit_iast:
mantrātmā bhagavānviṣṇuracirātsiddhido bhavet |
pratimāsaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha iṣṭvā'rghyakusumādibhiḥ || 89 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रात्मा भगवान्विष्णुरचिरात्सिद्धिदो भवेत् |
प्रतिमासं द्विजश्रेष्ठ इष्ट्वाऽर्घ्यकुसुमादिभिः || 89 ||
text_mt:
the Lord Viṣṇu, who is the mantra itself, quickly becomes the bestower of success.
Every month, O best of the twice-born, having worshipped with arghya, flowers, and the like, // 89

sanskrit_iast: [akṣasūtrasyapunarnavīkaraṇa prācīnasūtraparityāgayorvidhānam]
meaning: [अक्षसूत्रस्यपुनर्नवीकरण प्राचीनसूत्रपरित्यागयोर्विधानम्]
text_mt: [Rules for renewing the rosary and discarding the old thread]

sanskrit_iast:
sandhānamupasaṃhṛtya pūrvaṃ yaccākṣasūtrakam |
visarjanākhyamantreṇa mudrāyuktena nārada || 90 ||
meaning:
सन्धानमुपसंहृत्य पूर्वं यच्चाक्षसूत्रकम् |
विसर्जनाख्यमन्त्रेण मुद्रायुक्तेन नारद || 90 ||
text_mt:
withdrawing the integration that was previously in the rosary
with the mantra named dismissal, accompanied by the mudrā, O Nārada, // 90

sanskrit_iast:
sūtraṃ cābhinavaṃ kṛtvā prāgvatsaṃskṛtya veṣṭayet |
yathāsthitaṃ maṇīnāṃ ca yojanaṃ cācaretpunaḥ || 91 ||
meaning:
सूत्रं चाभिनवं कृत्वा प्राग्वत्संस्कृत्य वेष्टयेत् |
यथास्थितं मणीनां च योजनं चाचरेत्पुनः || 91 ||
text_mt:
and making a new cord, having consecrated it as before, he should wind it;
and he should perform the stringing of the beads once again as they were. // 91

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsnāpya vidhivanmantrī bhūyastasmiṃstu vinyaset |
purā yadāhṛtaṃ caiva sūtracchedabhayāttataḥ || 92 ||
meaning:
संस्नाप्य विधिवन्मन्त्री भूयस्तस्मिंस्तु विन्यसेत् |
पुरा यदाहृतं चैव सूत्रच्छेदभयात्ततः || 92 ||
text_mt:
Having bathed them according to rule, the mantrin should once more install in it
what was previously drawn into it; then, out of fear of the cord breaking, // 92

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ kṛtvā tathā homaṃ tatkarmachidrakāraṇam |
purāṇasūtramādāya vibhajettantujaṃ ca tat || 93 ||
meaning:
पूजां कृत्वा तथा होमं तत्कर्मछिद्रकारणम् |
पुराणसूत्रमादाय विभजेत्तन्तुजं च तत् || 93 ||
text_mt:
having performed worship and likewise homa for flaws in that act,
taking the old cord, he should undo that which is made of threads; // 93

sanskrit_iast:
badhvā pāṣāṇakhaṇḍe ca agādhe'mbhasi nikṣipet |
viṣvaksenīyamantreṇa kṣiptvā'camya smareddharim || 94 ||
meaning:
बध्वा पाषाणखण्डे च अगाधेऽम्भसि निक्षिपेत् |
विष्वक्सेनीयमन्त्रेण क्षिप्त्वाऽचम्य स्मरेद्धरिम् || 94 ||
text_mt:
binding it to a piece of stone, he should cast it into deep water;
having thrown it with the Viṣvaksena-mantra and sipped water, he should remember Hari // 94

sanskrit_iast: mūlamantraṇa viprendra saptavārānsamāhitaḥ |
meaning: मूलमन्त्रण विप्रेन्द्र सप्तवारान्समाहितः |
text_mt: with the root-mantra seven times, attentive, O prince among brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpañcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ japavidhānaṃ nāma caturdaśaḥ
paṭalaḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
इति श्रीपञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां जपविधानं नाम चतुर्दशः
पटलः || 14 ||
text_mt: Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named 'Rules for Japa', in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the venerable Pāñcarātra. // 14

sanskrit_iast: athāgnikāryavidhānaṃ nāma pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
meaning: अथाग्निकार्यविधानं नाम पञ्चदशः पटलः
text_mt: Now begins the fifteenth chapter, named 'Rules for the Fire Ritual'.

sanskrit_iast: śrībhagavān
meaning: श्रीभगवान्

sanskrit_iast:
japaṃ kṛtvā yathāśakti japānte pūjayetprabhum |
bhaktitaścārghyapuṣpābhyāṃ tato dhūpānulepanaiḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
जपं कृत्वा यथाशक्ति जपान्ते पूजयेत्प्रभुम् |
भक्तितश्चार्घ्यपुष्पाभ्यां ततो धूपानुलेपनैः || 1 ||
text_mt:
Having performed japa according to his capacity, at the conclusion of japa he should worship the Lord
with devotion, with arghya and flowers, and then with incenses and unguents. // 1

sanskrit_iast: paścātsantarpayedvipra agnimadhyagataṃ prabhum |
meaning: पश्चात्सन्तर्पयेद्विप्र अग्निमध्यगतं प्रभुम् |
text_mt: Afterwards, O brahmin, he should gratify the Lord situated in the middle of the fire.

sanskrit_iast: p. 133) [kuṇḍaparikalpanavidhānārambhaḥ]
meaning: प्. 133) [कुण्डपरिकल्पनविधानारम्भः]
text_mt: p. 133) [Beginning of the rules for preparing the kuṇḍa]

sanskrit_iast: devāduttaradigbhāge kuṇḍaṃ kuryātsalakṣaṇam || 2 ||
meaning: देवादुत्तरदिग्भागे कुण्डं कुर्यात्सलक्षणम् || 2 ||
text_mt: To the north of the deity he should make a kuṇḍa possessing the proper characteristics, // 2

sanskrit_iast:
devāgārāttu vā'nyatra bhūmibhāge salakṣaṇe |
dhūmanirgamanopetamaṇṭape susame śubhe || 3 ||
meaning:
देवागारात्तु वाऽन्यत्र भूमिभागे सलक्षणे |
धूमनिर्गमनोपेतमण्टपे सुसमे शुभे || 3 ||
text_mt:
or elsewhere from the deity's temple, on a piece of ground endowed with the proper characteristics,
in an auspicious, level pavilion provided with an exit for smoke. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kuryātpurā vediṃ caturaśrāṃ samantataḥ |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kuryātkuṇḍaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
तत्र कुर्यात्पुरा वेदिं चतुरश्रां समन्ततः |
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नां कुर्यात्कुण्डं तदूर्ध्वतः || 4 ||
text_mt:
There he should first make an altar, square on all sides,
endowed with all auspicious characteristics; above it he should make the kuṇḍa. // 4

sanskrit_iast:
caturaśraṃ samaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vartulaṃ vā manoramam |
dvigvidiksaṃsthitaṃ caiva kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ hitam || 5 ||
meaning:
चतुरश्रं समं श्रेष्ठं वर्तुलं वा मनोरमम् |
द्विग्विदिक्संस्थितं चैव काम्यानां कर्मणां हितम् || 5 ||
text_mt: [It may be] square, regular, and superior, or pleasingly circular, / or situated in the cardinal and intermediate directions, suited for rites performed for specific desires. // 5

sanskrit_iast: niṣkāmo vā sakāmo vā madhyatassarvadikṣu ca |
meaning: निष्कामो वा सकामो वा मध्यतस्सर्वदिक्षु च |
text_mt: Whether free from desire or possessing desires, in the center and in all directions:

sanskrit_iast: [kuṇḍānāṃ digbhedena phalabhedaḥ]
meaning: [कुण्डानां दिग्भेदेन फलभेदः]
text_mt: [Different results according to the direction of the kuṇḍas]

sanskrit_iast: īśānadiggate kuṇḍe mantrātmā tapito hariḥ || 6 ||
meaning: ईशानदिग्गते कुण्डे मन्त्रात्मा तपितो हरिः || 6 ||
text_mt: When Hari, whose self is mantra, is gratified in a kuṇḍa situated in the northeast direction, // 6

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti siddhiṃ bhaulokīṃ tatsiddhīpsormahātmanaḥ |
viyadgatiparaḥ kuṇḍe juhuyātpūrvadiksthite || 7 ||
meaning:
ददाति सिद्धिं भौलोकीं तत्सिद्धीप्सोर्महात्मनः |
वियद्गतिपरः कुण्डे जुहुयात्पूर्वदिक्स्थिते || 7 ||
text_mt: he grants earthly success to that great-souled man who desires such success. / One intent on aerial movement should offer oblations in a kuṇḍa situated in the eastern direction. // 7

sanskrit_iast:
ripūṇāṃ nigrahārthāya homamāgneyadiggate |
homaṃ dakṣiṇadikkuṇḍe śāntyarthī hyācaretsadā || 8 ||
meaning:
रिपूणां निग्रहार्थाय होममाग्नेयदिग्गते |
होमं दक्षिणदिक्कुण्डे शान्त्यर्थी ह्याचरेत्सदा || 8 ||
text_mt: For the subjugation of enemies, [he should perform] the oblation in one situated in the southeast direction; / one desiring pacification should always perform the oblation in a southern-direction kuṇḍa. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
utsādanārthamanyeṣāṃ kuṇḍe naiṛtadiggate |
apamṛtyujayārthī ca sarvopaplavaśāntaye || 9 ||
meaning:
उत्सादनार्थमन्येषां कुण्डे नैऋतदिग्गते |
अपमृत्युजयार्थी च सर्वोपप्लवशान्तये || 9 ||
text_mt: For the eradication of others, [the oblation is done] in a kuṇḍa situated in the southwest direction; / and one desiring the conquest of untimely death, for the pacification of all afflictions, // 9

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ vāruṇadikkuṇḍe mantrassantarpito yadā |
(hutvā vāruṇadikkuṇḍe mantraṃ santarpayetsudhīḥ?)
yadā vāyavyadikkuṇḍe mantrassantarpitastadā || 10 ||
meaning:
होमं वारुणदिक्कुण्डे मन्त्रस्सन्तर्पितो यदा |
(हुत्वा वारुणदिक्कुण्डे मन्त्रं सन्तर्पयेत्सुधीः?)
यदा वायव्यदिक्कुण्डे मन्त्रस्सन्तर्पितस्तदा || 10 ||
text_mt:
[performs] the oblation in a kuṇḍa of the western direction, when the mantra is gratified. / (Having offered in a western kuṇḍa, the wise man should gratify the mantra?)
When the mantra is gratified in a kuṇḍa of the northwest direction, then // 10

sanskrit_iast:
vividhāni nidhānāni prayaścha(ccha)tyacireṇa tu |
ārogyaṃ saṃpadaṃ puṣṭiṃ pradadāti ca mantrarāṭ || 11 ||
meaning:
विविधानि निधानानि प्रयश्छ(च्छ)त्यचिरेण तु |
आरोग्यं संपदं पुष्टिं प्रददाति च मन्त्रराट् || 11 ||
text_mt: the king of mantras quickly bestows various treasures; / and he grants health, prosperity, and nourishment, // 11

sanskrit_iast: tarpitassaumyadikkuṇḍe nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
meaning: तर्पितस्सौम्यदिक्कुण्डे नात्र कार्या विचारणा |
text_mt: when gratified in a kuṇḍa of the northern direction; there should be no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast: [āhutisaṅkhyābhedena kuṇḍānāṃ mānabhedaḥ]
meaning: [आहुतिसङ्ख्याभेदेन कुण्डानां मानभेदः]
text_mt: [Different measurements of kuṇḍas according to the number of oblations]

sanskrit_iast: śatārdhasaṅkhyahome ca kuṇḍaṃ syāddvādaśāṅgulam || 12 ||
meaning: शतार्धसङ्ख्यहोमे च कुण्डं स्याद्द्वादशाङ्गुलम् || 12 ||
text_mt: In an offering of fifty oblations, the kuṇḍa should be twelve digits [wide]. // 12

sanskrit_iast:
home sāṣṭaśate caivamuṣṭyaratnisamaṃ bhavet |
home sārdhaśate caiva sāratnissakaniṣṭhikā || 13 ||
meaning:
होमे साष्टशते चैवमुष्ट्यरत्निसमं भवेत् |
होमे सार्धशते चैव सारत्निस्सकनिष्ठिका || 13 ||
text_mt: In an offering of one hundred and eight, it should be equal to a fist-aratni; / and in an offering of one hundred and fifty, an aratni with the little finger. // 13

sanskrit_iast:
hastaṃ sahasrahome tu ayutākhye dvihastakam |
lakṣahome caturhastaṃ koṭihome'ṣṭa hastakam || 14 ||
meaning:
हस्तं सहस्रहोमे तु अयुताख्ये द्विहस्तकम् |
लक्षहोमे चतुर्हस्तं कोटिहोमेऽष्ट हस्तकम् || 14 ||
text_mt: In an offering of a thousand, a cubit; in one termed ten thousand, two cubits; / in an offering of a hundred thousand, four cubits; and in an offering of ten million, eight cubits. // 14

sanskrit_iast: p. 134) [khātamānam]

vistārārdhena sarvatra khātastu pariśasyate |
svīyātprāṅmekhalāmānādāyaṃ khāte yugaṃ puraḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
विस्तारार्धेन सर्वत्र खातस्तु परिशस्यते |
स्वीयात्प्राङ्मेखलामानादायं खाते युगं पुरः || 15 ||
