text_mt: The excavation is everywhere praised as half the width; / [extending] outward from the excavation in front by two [digits] from one's earlier measurement of the mekhala, // 15

sanskrit_iast: tyaktvā tu mekhalābandhaṃ tataścaiva samārabhet |
meaning: त्यक्त्वा तु मेखलाबन्धं ततश्चैव समारभेत् |
text_mt: leaving [space for] the construction of the mekhala, he should then begin.

sanskrit_iast: [kuṇḍamānabhedena mekhalānāṃ mānabhedāḥ]
meaning: [कुण्डमानभेदेन मेखलानां मानभेदाः]
text_mt: [Different measurements of the mekhalas according to the measurement of the kuṇḍa]

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇaṃ mekhalānāṃ ca yavadvādaśasammitam || 16 ||
meaning: प्रमाणं मेखलानां च यवद्वादशसम्मितम् || 16 ||
text_mt: The measurement of the mekhalas is stated to be twelve barley-corns // 16

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāṅgulamānasya kuṇḍasya parikīrtitam |
vistāratulyamucchrāyo mekhalānāṃ mahāmate || 17 ||
meaning:
द्वादशाङ्गुलमानस्य कुण्डस्य परिकीर्तितम् |
विस्तारतुल्यमुच्छ्रायो मेखलानां महामते || 17 ||
text_mt: for a kuṇḍa measuring twelve digits. / The height of the mekhalas is equal to their width, O wise one. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalātritayaṃ caivamekīkṛtya tu jāyate |
vistārastu tatocchrāyassārdhaṃ tu caturaṅgulam || 18 ||
meaning:
मेखलात्रितयं चैवमेकीकृत्य तु जायते |
विस्तारस्तु ततोच्छ्रायस्सार्धं तु चतुरङ्गुलम् || 18 ||
text_mt: And when the triad of mekhalas is combined together, / their width and then height become four and a half digits. // 18

sanskrit_iast:
ratnimātrasya kuṇḍasya mekhalā dvyaṅgulāḥ smṛtāḥ |
aṅgulaṃ sakaniṣṭhasya kuṇḍasyārdhottaraṃ dvayam || 19 ||
meaning:
रत्निमात्रस्य कुण्डस्य मेखला द्व्यङ्गुलाः स्मृताः |
अङ्गुलं सकनिष्ठस्य कुण्डस्यार्धोत्तरं द्वयम् || 19 ||
text_mt: For a kuṇḍa of an aratni, the mekhalas are taught to be two digits; / for a kuṇḍa of [an aratni] with the little finger, two and a half digits. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
tryaṅgulā hastamātrasya kuṇḍasya samatā smṛtā |
dvihastasya dvijaśreṣṭha mekhalāścaturaṅgulāḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
त्र्यङ्गुला हस्तमात्रस्य कुण्डस्य समता स्मृता |
द्विहस्तस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठ मेखलाश्चतुरङ्गुलाः || 20 ||
text_mt: For a kuṇḍa measuring one cubit, the uniform [size] is taught to be three digits; / for one of two cubits, O best of the twice-born, the mekhalas are four digits. // 20

sanskrit_iast:
caturhastasya kartavyāssarvāścaiva ṣaḍaṅgulāḥ |
aṣṭāṅguliśca kuṇḍasya aṣṭahastasya kīrtitāḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
चतुर्हस्तस्य कर्तव्यास्सर्वाश्चैव षडङ्गुलाः |
अष्टाङ्गुलिश्च कुण्डस्य अष्टहस्तस्य कीर्तिताः || 21 ||
text_mt: For one of four cubits, all should be made six digits; / and for a kuṇḍa of eight cubits, they are taught to be eight digits. // 21

sanskrit_iast: [nābhilakṣaṇam]
meaning: [नाभिलक्षणम्]

sanskrit_iast:
diṅmadhye'pyatha kuṇḍasya nābhiṃ (?) kuryāddvijottama |
aśvatthapatrasadṛśīṃ mekhalopari saṃsthitām || 22 ||
meaning:
दिङ्मध्येऽप्यथ कुण्डस्य नाभिं (?) कुर्याद्द्विजोत्तम |
अश्वत्थपत्रसदृशीं मेखलोपरि संस्थिताम् || 22 ||
text_mt: Then, in the middle of a direction of the kuṇḍa, O best of the twice-born, he should make a navel, / resembling a leaf of the sacred fig tree, positioned above the mekhala. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
yaduktaṃ prāṅmayā mānaṃ mekhalānāṃ krameṇa tu |
ekīkṛtya tu tatsarvaṃ madhyātsūtreṇa lāñchayet || 23 ||
meaning:
यदुक्तं प्राङ्मया मानं मेखलानां क्रमेण तु |
एकीकृत्य तु तत्सर्वं मध्यात्सूत्रेण लाञ्छयेत् || 23 ||
text_mt: Combining together that entire measurement of the mekhalas / which was previously stated by me in order, he should mark it from the center with a cord. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
ardhamardhenduvadbāhyāttatra cātiśayena ca |
mukhādyabhyantaraṃ yāvatkrameṇānena hrāsayet || 24 ||
meaning:
अर्धमर्धेन्दुवद्बाह्यात्तत्र चातिशयेन च |
मुखाद्यभ्यन्तरं यावत्क्रमेणानेन ह्रासयेत् || 24 ||
text_mt: [Shaped] like a half-moon at the outside by half, and prominently there, / he should diminish it by this procedure from the mouth up to the interior, // 24

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayoḥ pakṣayorvipra gajoṣṭhākṛtivattathā |
pṛṣṭhato mekhalamānātkiñcitkāryā dvijonnatā || 25 ||
meaning:
उभयोः पक्षयोर्विप्र गजोष्ठाकृतिवत्तथा |
पृष्ठतो मेखलमानात्किञ्चित्कार्या द्विजोन्नता || 25 ||
text_mt: on both flanks, O brahmin, shaped like an elephant's lip; / at the back it should be made slightly elevated above the mekhala's height, O twice-born. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
ekamekhalamānācca tryaṃśenārdhena vā mune |
krameṇa hrāsayettāvattāvadvai mekhalocchṛtiḥ || 26 ||
meaning:
एकमेखलमानाच्च त्र्यंशेनार्धेन वा मुने |
क्रमेण ह्रासयेत्तावत्तावद्वै मेखलोच्छृतिः || 26 ||
text_mt: And from the measurement of one mekhala, by a third or a half, O sage, / he should diminish it gradually until it reaches the height of the mekhala. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
īṣaduccā bhavetsā vai mekhalopari saṃsthitā |
ekamekhalaturyāṃśamānaṃ kuṇḍāntare dvija || 27 ||
meaning:
ईषदुच्चा भवेत्सा वै मेखलोपरि संस्थिता |
एकमेखलतुर्यांशमानं कुण्डान्तरे द्विज || 27 ||
text_mt: It should be slightly elevated, situated upon the mekhala; / having the measurement of a fourth part of one mekhala inside the kuṇḍa, O twice-born, // 27

sanskrit_iast:
p. 135) yonyeṣu (?) nissṛtaṃ kuryāttamevādhogataṃ tu vai |
ākramya mekhalābhūmiṃ yāvatkhātaṃ tu saṃspṛśet || 28 ||
meaning:
प्. 135) योन्येषु (?) निस्सृतं कुर्यात्तमेवाधोगतं तु वै |
आक्रम्य मेखलाभूमिं यावत्खातं तु संस्पृशेत् || 28 ||
text_mt: he should make it project into the yoni, and descending downward, / traversing the surface of the mekhala until it touches the excavation. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
ityetatkathitaṃ nābherlakṣaṇaṃ ca yathāsthitam |
sādhanaṃ caturaśrasya viddhi kuṇḍasya yāgavat || 29 ||
meaning:
इत्येतत्कथितं नाभेर्लक्षणं च यथास्थितम् |
साधनं चतुरश्रस्य विद्धि कुण्डस्य यागवत् || 29 ||
text_mt: Thus has the characteristic of the navel been declared as it is; / know the preparation of the square kuṇḍa as sacrificial. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
caturaśrasya vai madhye sūtraṃ kṛtvā bhramaṃ (?) tataḥ |
caturaśraṃ samaṃ kuryātsarvadikkoṇa varjitam || 30 ||
meaning:
चतुरश्रस्य वै मध्ये सूत्रं कृत्वा भ्रमं (?) ततः |
चतुरश्रं समं कुर्यात्सर्वदिक्कोण वर्जितम् || 30 ||
text_mt: Having placed a cord in the center of the square and then made a rotation, / he should make a uniform square, devoid of corners in all directions. // 30

sanskrit_iast: [kuṇḍānāṃ vikalpaḥ]
meaning: [कुण्डानां विकल्पः]

sanskrit_iast:
nityanaimittake home vṛttaṃ vā caturaśrakam |
trimekhalaṃ tu kartavyamoṣṭhanābhisamanvitam || 31 ||
meaning:
नित्यनैमित्तके होमे वृत्तं वा चतुरश्रकम् |
त्रिमेखलं तु कर्तव्यमोष्ठनाभिसमन्वितम् || 31 ||
text_mt: In daily and occasional oblations, [the kuṇḍa may be] circular or square, / made with three mekhalas, endowed with a lip and a navel, // 31

sanskrit_iast:
dvimekhalaṃ vā viprendra suślakṣṇaṃ ca manoramam |
ekamekhalakaṃ vā'pi kuṇḍaṃ kṣepaṇi(?)ṇakarmaṇi || 32 ||
meaning:
द्विमेखलं वा विप्रेन्द्र सुश्लक्ष्णं च मनोरमम् |
एकमेखलकं वाऽपि कुण्डं क्षेपणि(?)णकर्मणि || 32 ||
text_mt: or with two mekhalas, O foremost of brahmins, very smooth and charming, / or a kuṇḍa with a single mekhala in a rite of casting off. // 32

sanskrit_iast: [kuṇḍe havanasya prāśastyam]
meaning: [कुण्डे हवनस्य प्राशस्त्यम्]
text_mt: [The excellence of offering in a kuṇḍa]

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāccalaṃ sthiraṃ vā'pi na hi kuṇḍaṃ vinā śubham |
havanaṃ vipra mantrāṇāṃ tasmātkuṇḍaṃ ca sādhayet || 33 ||
meaning:
कुर्याच्चलं स्थिरं वाऽपि न हि कुण्डं विना शुभम् |
हवनं विप्र मन्त्राणां तस्मात्कुण्डं च साधयेत् || 33 ||
text_mt: He may make it movable or fixed; for without a kuṇḍa, / the offering of mantras is not auspicious, O brahmin; therefore he should prepare a kuṇḍa. // 33

sanskrit_iast: [deśakālavaiguṇyena kuṇḍasyāsambhave havanaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [देशकालवैगुण्येन कुण्डस्यासम्भवे हवनप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Method of oblation when a kuṇḍa is impossible due to deficiency of place and time]

sanskrit_iast:
deśakālavaśāccaiva kuṇḍaṃ na ghaṭate yadi |
taṃ vinā havanacchedo na kāryassiddhimicchatā || 34 ||
meaning:
देशकालवशाच्चैव कुण्डं न घटते यदि |
तं विना हवनच्छेदो न कार्यस्सिद्धिमिच्छता || 34 ||
text_mt: If a kuṇḍa cannot be produced on account of place and time, / an interruption of the offering must not be made without it by one desiring success. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
śodhite hyupalipte ca sthale calamṛdānvite |
homastu vihitassamyak mantrasyāmantritasya ca || 35 ||
meaning:
शोधिते ह्युपलिप्ते च स्थले चलमृदान्विते |
होमस्तु विहितस्सम्यक् मन्त्रस्यामन्त्रितस्य च || 35 ||
text_mt: On a purified and smeared ground supplied with soft earth, / the oblation of the mantra, consecrated by mantra, is duly prescribed. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍikā caturaśrā tu bahissarvatra śasyate |
madhye padmaṃ prakurvīta śrīpadmaṃ padmamadhyagam || 36 ||
meaning:
पिण्डिका चतुरश्रा तु बहिस्सर्वत्र शस्यते |
मध्ये पद्मं प्रकुर्वीत श्रीपद्मं पद्ममध्यगम् || 36 ||
text_mt: A square base outside is praised everywhere; / in the middle he should make a lotus, an auspicious lotus situated within the lotus. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛte śubhe kuṇḍe agnikāryaṃ samācaret |
yāgagehāttu vā'nyasminyadi gehe mahāmune || 37 ||
meaning:
एवं कृते शुभे कुण्डे अग्निकार्यं समाचरेत् |
यागगेहात्तु वाऽन्यस्मिन्यदि गेहे महामुने || 37 ||
text_mt: When an auspicious kuṇḍa has been thus made, he should perform the fire ritual; / or, if in a building other than the sacrificial pavilion, O great sage, // 37

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavadvārayāgaṃ tu kṛtvā saṃpraviśettataḥ |
tatraiva yadi vā kuryāddatvā'nyaccāsanaṃ śubham || 38 ||
meaning:
पूर्ववद्वारयागं तु कृत्वा संप्रविशेत्ततः |
तत्रैव यदि वा कुर्याद्दत्वाऽन्यच्चासनं शुभम् || 38 ||
text_mt: he should perform the door-sacrifice as before and then enter; / or if he performs it right there, having placed another auspicious seat, // 38

sanskrit_iast: tatra pūrvoktavidhinā upaviśya samāhitaḥ |
meaning: तत्र पूर्वोक्तविधिना उपविश्य समाहितः |
text_mt: having seated himself there according to the previously stated rule, concentrated in mind:

sanskrit_iast: [kuṇḍasaṃskāraprakāraḥ]
meaning: [कुण्डसंस्कारप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Method of consecration of the kuṇḍa]

sanskrit_iast: kuṇḍasyārambhakāle tu saṃskārā na kṛtā yadi || 39 ||
meaning: कुण्डस्यारम्भकाले तु संस्कारा न कृता यदि || 39 ||
text_mt: If the consecrations were not performed at the time of beginning the kuṇḍa, // 39

sanskrit_iast:
niṣpannasya ca te sarve vidheyāśca krameṇa tu |
tāḍayedastramantreṇa puṣpairdakṣiṇapāṇinā || 40 ||
meaning:
निष्पन्नस्य च ते सर्वे विधेयाश्च क्रमेण तु |
ताडयेदस्त्रमन्त्रेण पुष्पैर्दक्षिणपाणिना || 40 ||
text_mt: they must all be performed in sequence once it is finished. / He should strike [it] with the weapon-mantra, with flowers in his right hand; // 40

sanskrit_iast:
p. 136) gṛhītvā caikadeśāttu kuṇḍamadhyācca mṛtkaṇam |
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu hṛdayena samuddharet || 41 ||
meaning:
प्. 136) गृहीत्वा चैकदेशात्तु कुण्डमध्याच्च मृत्कणम् |
अङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्यां तु हृदयेन समुद्धरेत् || 41 ||
text_mt: and taking a particle of earth from one part of the center of the kuṇḍa / with the thumb and ring finger, he should lift it out with the heart[-mantra]; // 41

sanskrit_iast:
astreṇaiva samīkṛtya na syānnimnonnataṃ yathā |
secayetkavacenaiva kuṭṭayettadanantaram || 42 ||
meaning:
अस्त्रेणैव समीकृत्य न स्यान्निम्नोन्नतं यथा |
सेचयेत्कवचेनैव कुट्टयेत्तदनन्तरम् || 42 ||
text_mt: leveling [it] with the weapon[-mantra] so that it is neither depressed nor elevated, / he should sprinkle it with the armour[-mantra] and pound it immediately thereafter; // 42

sanskrit_iast:
lepayedgandhatoyena astreṇa pariśodhayet |
ullikhedastrarājena darbhakāṇḍena yatnataḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
लेपयेद्गन्धतोयेन अस्त्रेण परिशोधयेत् |
उल्लिखेदस्त्रराजेन दर्भकाण्डेन यत्नतः || 43 ||
text_mt: he should smear it with scented water, purify it with the weapon[-mantra], / and carefully trace lines with the king of weapons using a stalk of darbha grass. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmāvabhyantare kuṇḍe dakṣiṇāśāditaḥ kramāt |
uttarāśāvadhiryāvaddadyādrekhātrayaṃ samam || 44 ||
meaning:
भूमावभ्यन्तरे कुण्डे दक्षिणाशादितः क्रमात् |
उत्तराशावधिर्यावद्दद्याद्रेखात्रयं समम् || 44 ||
text_mt: On the ground inside the kuṇḍa, in sequence from the southern quarter / up to the northern quarter, he should make three equal lines; // 44

sanskrit_iast:
pratyagbhāgātsamārabhya nayetpūrvamukhaṃ tu tat |
tanmadhye tritayaṃ cānyadrekhāṇāmuttarāmukham || 45 ||
meaning:
प्रत्यग्भागात्समारभ्य नयेत्पूर्वमुखं तु तत् |
तन्मध्ये त्रितयं चान्यद्रेखाणामुत्तरामुखम् || 45 ||
text_mt: beginning from the western section, he should carry them facing east; / in their middle [he should make] another triad of lines facing north. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
evamullikhya vidhinā prokṣayetkavacena tu |
acchinnāgraistato darbhairastramantrābhimantritaiḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
एवमुल्लिख्य विधिना प्रोक्षयेत्कवचेन तु |
अच्छिन्नाग्रैस्ततो दर्भैरस्त्रमन्त्राभिमन्त्रितैः || 46 ||
text_mt: Having drawn the lines thus according to rule, he should sprinkle [them] with the armour[-mantra], / and then with unbroken-tipped darbha grasses consecrated with the weapon-mantra // 46

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍabhittigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ protthitaṃ paribhūṣayet |
kṛtvaivamakṣavāṭaṃ tu kuṇḍasaṃskāramuttamam || 47 ||
meaning:
कुण्डभित्तिगणं सर्वं प्रोत्थितं परिभूषयेत् |
कृत्वैवमक्षवाटं तु कुण्डसंस्कारमुत्तमम् || 47 ||
text_mt: he should adorn all the raised walls of the kuṇḍa. / Having thus made an enclosure, the excellent preparation of the kuṇḍa [is complete]. // 47

sanskrit_iast: [nābhipūjanam]
meaning: [नाभिपूजनम्]

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyarcya tato'rghyādyairmadhyataḥ praṇavena tu |
tenaiva vidhinā nābhiṃ pūjayeccandrasannibhām || 48 ||
meaning:
समभ्यर्च्य ततोऽर्घ्याद्यैर्मध्यतः प्रणवेन तु |
तेनैव विधिना नाभिं पूजयेच्चन्द्रसन्निभाम् || 48 ||
text_mt: Then, having worshipped in the centre with arghya and the like using the praṇava, / he should worship according to the same rule the navel resembling the moon. // 48

sanskrit_iast: [mekhalāpūjanam]
meaning: [मेखलापूजनम्]

sanskrit_iast: mekhalātrayapūjāyāṃ hṛnmantraṃ tu prayojayet |
meaning: मेखलात्रयपूजायां हृन्मन्त्रं तु प्रयोजयेत् |
text_mt: In the worship of the triad of mekhalās he should employ the heart-mantra.

sanskrit_iast: [mekhalātraye tattvatrayasya pūjanam]
meaning: [मेखलात्रये तत्त्वत्रयस्य पूजनम्]
text_mt: [Worship of the triad of principles on the triad of mekhalās]

sanskrit_iast: tatastatvatrayaṃ pūjyaṃ mekhalātritayopari || 49 ||
meaning: ततस्तत्वत्रयं पूज्यं मेखलात्रितयोपरि || 49 ||
text_mt: Then the triad of principles is to be worshipped upon the triad of mekhalās: // 49

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānapuruṣeśākhyaṃ praṇavatritayena ca |
arghyairvilepanairdhūpairiṣṭvā kuṇḍaṃ purā dvija || 50 ||
meaning:
प्रधानपुरुषेशाख्यं प्रणवत्रितयेन च |
अर्घ्यैर्विलेपनैर्धूपैरिष्ट्वा कुण्डं पुरा द्विज || 50 ||
text_mt: namely, Pradhāna, Puruṣa, and Īśa, along with the triad of praṇavas. / Having previously worshipped the kuṇḍa with offerings of arghya, unguents, and incense, O twice-born, // 50

sanskrit_iast:
[kuṇḍamadhye ādhāraśaktyādyāsanakalpanapūrvakaṃ
nārāyaṇākhyāyāḥ śakteḥ sthāpanaprakāraḥ]
meaning:
[कुण्डमध्ये आधारशक्त्याद्यासनकल्पनपूर्वकं
नारायणाख्यायाः शक्तेः स्थापनप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Procedure for establishing the power called Nārāyaṇa after arranging the seat beginning with the supporting power in the middle of the kuṇḍa]

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpathe tu kuṇḍasthe sapuṣpaṃ darbhaviṣṭaram |
hṛnmantreṇa ca vinyasya tatroparyatha pūjayet || 51 ||
meaning:
चतुष्पथे तु कुण्डस्थे सपुष्पं दर्भविष्टरम् |
हृन्मन्त्रेण च विन्यस्य तत्रोपर्यथ पूजयेत् || 51 ||
text_mt: he should place a seat of darbha grass along with flowers at the intersection situated in the kuṇḍa / with the heart-mantra, and then worship upon it. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjyāgniṃ samādāya sambhrāmyāyatanaṃ tridhā |
yonimārgeṇa nikṣipya vahnibījamanusmaret || 52 ||
meaning:
सम्पूज्याग्निं समादाय सम्भ्राम्यायतनं त्रिधा |
योनिमार्गेण निक्षिप्य वह्निबीजमनुस्मरेत् || 52 ||
text_mt: Having worshipped [it], taking the fire, carrying [it] thrice around the precinct, / and depositing it by way of the yoni, he should remember the seed-syllable of fire. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
p. 137) ādhāraśaktipūrvaṃ ca āsanaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yat |
tatra nārāyaṇākhyāṃ vai śaktiṃ vidyotalakṣaṇām || 53 ||
meaning:
प्. 137) आधारशक्तिपूर्वं च आसनं वैष्णवं च यत् |
तत्र नारायणाख्यां वै शक्तिं विद्योतलक्षणाम् || 53 ||
text_mt: And on the Vaiṣṇava seat which begins with the supporting power, / there [he visualises] the power named Nārāyaṇa, characterised by radiance, // 53

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmyākṛtipadaṃ prāptāmamṛtāvṛtadehinīm |
sarvātiśayarūpāṃ ca sarvaśaktisamanvitām || 54 ||
meaning:
लक्ष्म्याकृतिपदं प्राप्ताममृतावृतदेहिनीम् |
सर्वातिशयरूपां च सर्वशक्तिसमन्विताम् || 54 ||
text_mt: which has attained the state of the form of Lakṣmī, whose body is enveloped in nectar, / having a form supreme above all, endowed with all powers, // 54

sanskrit_iast:
saukumāryeṇa rūpeṇa sarvavastvantarasthitām |
śāśvatīṃ sṛṣṭimārgeṇa avatārya hṛdambuje || 55 ||
meaning:
सौकुमार्येण रूपेण सर्ववस्त्वन्तरस्थिताम् |
शाश्वतीं सृष्टिमार्गेण अवतार्य हृदम्बुजे || 55 ||
text_mt: abiding within all entities through her delicate form, / eternal; having brought her down into the heart-lotus by the path of creation, // 55

sanskrit_iast:
purā dhyānakrameṇaiva hṛnmantreṇa hṛdambujāt |
svanāmapadayuktena sanamaḥpraṇavādinā || 56 ||
meaning:
पुरा ध्यानक्रमेणैव हृन्मन्त्रेण हृदम्बुजात् |
स्वनामपदयुक्तेन सनमःप्रणवादिना || 56 ||
text_mt: previously in the sequence of meditation, from the heart-lotus by means of the heart-mantra, / joined with the word of her own name, preceded by the praṇava and namaḥ, // 56

sanskrit_iast:
recakena vinikṣipya kuṇḍahṛtpadmamadhyataḥ |
saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ padmamudrāṃ padarśya ca || 57 ||
meaning:
रेचकेन विनिक्षिप्य कुण्डहृत्पद्ममध्यतः |
संपूज्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः पद्ममुद्रां पदर्श्य च || 57 ||
text_mt: emitting [her] with the exhalation into the centre of the heart-lotus of the kuṇḍa, / having worshipped her with scent, flowers, and the like, and having shown the lotus-mudrā, // 57

sanskrit_iast: cakramantreṇa saṃyuktāmevaṃ kuryācca sannidhim |
meaning: चक्रमन्त्रेण संयुक्तामेवं कुर्याच्च सन्निधिम् |
text_mt: he should thus bring about her presence, joined with the discus-mantra.

sanskrit_iast: [vahnerutpādanakramaḥ]
meaning: [वह्नेरुत्पादनक्रमः]
text_mt: [The sequence of producing the fire]

sanskrit_iast: ādau ca bhagavacchaktervahnerutpādanāya ca || 58 ||
meaning: आदौ च भगवच्छक्तेर्वह्नेरुत्पादनाय च || 58 ||
text_mt: And at the beginning, for the generation of the Lord's power as fire, // 58

sanskrit_iast:
ādāyāraṇijaṃ cāgniṃ sūryakāntodbhavaṃ tu vā |
lohapāṣāṇajaṃ vā'tha aduṣṭaṃ laukikaṃ tu vā || 59 ||
meaning:
आदायारणिजं चाग्निं सूर्यकान्तोद्भवं तु वा |
लोहपाषाणजं वाऽथ अदुष्टं लौकिकं तु वा || 59 ||
text_mt: taking fire produced from fire-sticks, or arising from a sun-gem, / or produced from iron and stone, or unpolluted common [fire], // 59

sanskrit_iast: taijase tāmrapātre'tha mṛṇmaye'bhinave tathā |
meaning: तैजसे ताम्रपात्रेऽथ मृण्मयेऽभिनवे तथा |
text_mt: in a vessel made of bell-metal or of copper, or in a fresh earthen one,

sanskrit_iast: [agnestāḍanaprokṣaṇādayo bāhyāḥ pañcasaṃskārāḥ]
meaning: [अग्नेस्ताडनप्रोक्षणादयो बाह्याः पञ्चसंस्काराः]
text_mt: [The five external consecrations of the fire, such as striking and sprinkling]

sanskrit_iast: santāḍya cāstramantreṇa prokṣayecchikhayā ca tam || 60 ||
meaning: सन्ताड्य चास्त्रमन्त्रेण प्रोक्षयेच्छिखया च तम् || 60 ||
text_mt: having struck it with the weapon-mantra, he should sprinkle it with the śikhā[-mantra]; // 60

sanskrit_iast:
arcayetkavacenaiva kavacenāvakuṇṭhya ca |
plāvayedamṛtenaiva netramantreṇa nārada || 61 ||
meaning:
अर्चयेत्कवचेनैव कवचेनावकुण्ठ्य च |
प्लावयेदमृतेनैव नेत्रमन्त्रेण नारद || 61 ||
text_mt: he should worship it with the armour[-mantra], veil it with the armour[-mantra], / and flood it with nectar using the eye-mantra, O Nārada. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
[agneḥ svātmanyupaśamāpādanapūrvakaṃ sṛṣṭikrameṇa
padātpadamavatāritasya nābhigatatvacintanam]
meaning:
[अग्नेः स्वात्मन्युपशमापादनपूर्वकं सृष्टिक्रमेण
पदात्पदमवतारितस्य नाभिगतत्वचिन्तनम्]
text_mt: [Contemplation of the fire reaching the navel after bringing it to rest within oneself and bringing it down stage by stage via the sequence of creation]

sanskrit_iast:
pūrakeṇopasṛtyātha svātmanyupaśamaṃ nayet |
kramādānandaśaktau tu prāgvaduddhṛtya yojayet || 62 ||
meaning:
पूरकेणोपसृत्याथ स्वात्मन्युपशमं नयेत् |
क्रमादानन्दशक्तौ तु प्राग्वदुद्धृत्य योजयेत् || 62 ||
text_mt: Then, drawing it in with the inhalation, he should bring it to rest within himself; / having raised it as before, he should unite it gradually with the power of bliss. // 62

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭikrameṇa tadbhūyo hyavatārya padātpadam |
śabdāspadāvadhiryāvatsmarennābhigataṃ tataḥ || 63 ||
meaning:
सृष्टिक्रमेण तद्भूयो ह्यवतार्य पदात्पदम् |
शब्दास्पदावधिर्यावत्स्मरेन्नाभिगतं ततः || 63 ||
text_mt: Bringing it down again step by step according to the sequence of creation, / down to the domain of sound, he should then contemplate it situated in the navel. // 63

sanskrit_iast: [nābhikuṇḍasthatayā bhāvite tejoviśeṣe homakramaḥ]
meaning: [नाभिकुण्डस्थतया भाविते तेजोविशेषे होमक्रमः]
text_mt: [The procedure of offering oblation into the special light visualised as present in the navel-kuṇḍa]

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavena tu nābhisthamagnīṣomātmakaṃ yajet |
tridhā samidbhirbhinnena ada(ha ?) mādibhirādarāt || 64 ||
meaning:
प्रणवेन तु नाभिस्थमग्नीषोमात्मकं यजेत् |
त्रिधा समिद्भिर्भिन्नेन अद(ह ?) मादिभिरादरात् || 64 ||
text_mt: With the praṇava he should worship the one residing in the navel, whose nature is fire and soma, / divided into three with kindling sticks, respectfully with the initial [syllables] a, da [ha], and the like. // 64

sanskrit_iast:
trayāṇāmatha bījena bhinnenātha yajeddvija |
p. 138) ekāhutipradānena tatrastho budhyate yathā || 65 ||
meaning:
त्रयाणामथ बीजेन भिन्नेनाथ यजेद्द्विज |
प्. 138) एकाहुतिप्रदानेन तत्रस्थो बुध्यते यथा || 65 ||
text_mt: Then, O twice-born, he should worship with the differentiated seed-syllables of the three, / so that by the offering of a single oblation, he who resides there is awakened. // 65

sanskrit_iast: tena mārgeṇa japtavyaṃ dhyātvā cājyāmṛtaṃ hṛdi |
meaning: तेन मार्गेण जप्तव्यं ध्यात्वा चाज्यामृतं हृदि |
text_mt: Having meditated in his heart on the nectar of clarified butter, he should recite by that path.

sanskrit_iast: [tasyāgneḥ svamantreṇa nābhīkuṇḍādutthāpanam]
meaning: [तस्याग्नेः स्वमन्त्रेण नाभीकुण्डादुत्थापनम्]
text_mt: [Raising of that fire from the navel-kuṇḍa by its own mantra]

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ svamantreṇotthāpyo nābhikuṇḍāddhutāśanaḥ || 66 ||
meaning: ततः स्वमन्त्रेणोत्थाप्यो नाभिकुण्डाद्धुताशनः || 66 ||
text_mt: Then the fire is to be raised from the navel-kuṇḍa with its own mantra. // 66

sanskrit_iast: [agnermantraḥ]
meaning: [अग्नेर्मन्त्रः]

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā'dau praṇavaṃ vipra tadante tvajitaṃ nyaset |
aśeṣabhuvanādhāramatha ūrdhve'sya yojayet || 67 ||
meaning:
कृत्वाऽदौ प्रणवं विप्र तदन्ते त्वजितं न्यसेत् |
अशेषभुवनाधारमथ ऊर्ध्वेऽस्य योजयेत् || 67 ||
text_mt: Having placed the praṇava at the beginning, O Brahmin, after it he should install "ajita"; / then above it he should add "aśeṣabhuvanādhāram". // 67

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvādhobhyāṃ ca tasyaiva bhūdharorjau nyasettataḥ |
trailokyaiśvaryadaṃ mūrdhni bījasyāsya mahāmate || 68 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाधोभ्यां च तस्यैव भूधरोर्जौ न्यसेत्ततः |
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदं मूर्ध्नि बीजस्यास्य महामते || 68 ||
text_mt: And above and below it he should place "bhūdhara" and "ūrj"; / on the head of this seed-syllable, O wise one, [he places] that which bestows the sovereignty of the three worlds. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ krameṇa saṃyojya dhareśādyaṃ ca saptakam |
suparṇasaṃjñāparyantaṃ saptakasyāsya yojayet || 69 ||
meaning:
ततः क्रमेण संयोज्य धरेशाद्यं च सप्तकम् |
सुपर्णसंज्ञापर्यन्तं सप्तकस्यास्य योजयेत् || 69 ||
text_mt: Then, having combined in sequence the group of seven beginning with "dhareśa" / and ending with the name "suparṇa", he should join to this group of seven // 69

sanskrit_iast:
urdhvādhobhyāṃ ca nālaṃ tu māyāvyome tathopari |
tejase padamādāya tataḥ saptārciṣe padam || 70 ||
meaning:
उर्ध्वाधोभ्यां च नालं तु मायाव्योमे तथोपरि |
तेजसे पदमादाय ततः सप्तार्चिषे पदम् || 70 ||
text_mt: the stalk above and below, and above [that] the māyā-space; / having taken the word "tejase", then the word "saptārciṣe", // 70

sanskrit_iast: svāhāsamanvitaścāgnermantro hyaṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ |
meaning: स्वाहासमन्वितश्चाग्नेर्मन्त्रो ह्यष्टादशाक्षरः |
text_mt: and accompanied by "svāhā", is the eighteen-syllable mantra of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
[svamantreṇa nābhīkuṇḍādudbodhitasya tejasaḥ pātrasthavahnau
prakṣepaḥ]
meaning:
[स्वमन्त्रेण नाभीकुण्डादुद्बोधितस्य तेजसः पात्रस्थवह्नौ
प्रक्षेपः]
text_mt: [Casting the splendour awakened from the navel-kuṇḍa with its own mantra into the fire in the vessel]

sanskrit_iast: dhūdhūśabdaśarīrāntaṃ (?) sacchabdālokabodhitam || 71 ||
meaning: धूधूशब्दशरीरान्तं (?) सच्छब्दालोकबोधितम् || 71 ||
text_mt: Terminating in the bodily sound of roaring, awakened by the perception of the pure sound, // 71

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpadhūmanirmuktaṃ saccaitanyasphuliṅginam |
nādāntena kṣipedvipra siddhimārgeṇa pūrvavat || 72 ||
meaning:
विकल्पधूमनिर्मुक्तं सच्चैतन्यस्फुलिङ्गिनम् |
नादान्तेन क्षिपेद्विप्र सिद्धिमार्गेण पूर्ववत् || 72 ||
text_mt: free from the smoke of conceptual thought, with sparks of pure consciousness, / he should cast it, O Brahmin, with the end of the sound (nādānta) through the path of perfection, as before. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
purā hṛte ca pātrasthe vanhau vanhi (hniṃ ?) viśuddhaye |
karadvayena cādāya bhrāmya kuṇḍe vinikṣipet || 73 ||
meaning:
पुरा हृते च पात्रस्थे वन्हौ वन्हि (ह्निं ?) विशुद्धये |
करद्वयेन चादाय भ्राम्य कुण्डे विनिक्षिपेत् || 73 ||
text_mt: And into the fire previously taken in the vessel, for purification of the fire, / taking [it] with both hands and circling it, he should deposit it in the kuṇḍa. // 73

sanskrit_iast: [kuṇḍamadhye prakṣiptasyāgneścintanaviśeṣaḥ]
meaning: [कुण्डमध्ये प्रक्षिप्तस्याग्नेश्चिन्तनविशेषः]
text_mt: [Specific visualisation of the fire cast into the kuṇḍa]

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍamadhyasthayā cātha śaktyā nārāyaṇākhyayā |
nāsāgreṇa tamagniṃ ca ghrātaṃ dhyāyetsvahṛdgatam || 74 ||
meaning:
कुण्डमध्यस्थया चाथ शक्त्या नारायणाख्यया |
नासाग्रेण तमग्निं च घ्रातं ध्यायेत्स्वहृद्गतम् || 74 ||
text_mt: And he should visualise that fire, having entered his own heart, / inhaled through the tip of the nose by the power named Nārāyaṇa situated in the centre of the kuṇḍa. // 74

sanskrit_iast: [vahnerudbodhanam]
meaning: [वह्नेरुद्बोधनम्]

sanskrit_iast:
tripañca sapta vā dadyāt samidhe hṛdayena ca |
vahnerudbodhanārthaṃ tu netramantreṇa nārada || 75 ||
meaning:
त्रिपञ्च सप्त वा दद्यात् समिधे हृदयेन च |
वह्नेरुद्बोधनार्थं तु नेत्रमन्त्रेण नारद || 75 ||
text_mt: He should offer three, five, or seven kindling sticks with the heart[-mantra]; / and for the purpose of awakening the fire, [he offers] with the eye-mantra, O Nārada. // 75

sanskrit_iast: [paryagnikaraṇam]
meaning: [पर्यग्निकरणम्]

sanskrit_iast: paryagnikaraṇaṃ kuryāddhṛdayenārdrapāṇinā |
meaning: पर्यग्निकरणं कुर्याद्धृदयेनार्द्रपाणिना |
text_mt: He should perform the circling with fire with the heart[-mantra], with wet hands.

sanskrit_iast: [paristaraṇam]
meaning: [परिस्तरणम्]

sanskrit_iast: staraṃ tato'stramantreṇa caturdikṣu tridhā tridhā || 76 ||
meaning: स्तरं ततोऽस्त्रमन्त्रेण चतुर्दिक्षु त्रिधा त्रिधा || 76 ||
text_mt: Then, with the weapon-mantra, [he makes] the grass-strewing in the four directions, threefold each, // 76

sanskrit_iast:
p. 139) prāgādau tu yathāmūlaṃ tadagraiśchāditaṃ bhavet |
kuryāt starasamāptiṃ tu sarvadā'tmana uttare || 77 ||
meaning:
प्. 139) प्रागादौ तु यथामूलं तदग्रैश्छादितं भवेत् |
कुर्यात् स्तरसमाप्तिं तु सर्वदाऽत्मन उत्तरे || 77 ||
text_mt: beginning in the east, so that the roots are covered by their tips; / he should always complete the grass-strewing to his own north. // 77

sanskrit_iast: staroparyatha saṃsthāpya vanhikāryopayogi yat |
meaning: स्तरोपर्यथ संस्थाप्य वन्हिकार्योपयोगि यत् |
text_mt: Then, having placed upon the grass-strewing whatever is useful for the fire ritual,

sanskrit_iast: [praṇītāpātreghmasruksruvādyupakaraṇadravyasādanam]
meaning: [प्रणीतापात्रेघ्मस्रुक्स्रुवाद्युपकरणद्रव्यसादनम्]
text_mt: [Procuring the implement-materials such as praṇītā vessel, kindling wood, sruc and sruva]

sanskrit_iast: praṇītāpātrayugmaṃ tu tathedhmayugalaṃ tu vai || 78 ||
meaning: प्रणीतापात्रयुग्मं तु तथेध्मयुगलं तु वै || 78 ||
text_mt: namely, the pair of praṇītā vessels and the pair of bundles of kindling sticks, // 78

sanskrit_iast:
sraksruvadvitayaṃ caivamājyasthālīṃ tathaiva hi |
sarvaṃ saṃprokṣya mūlena nidhāyātha staropari || 79 ||
meaning:
स्रक्स्रुवद्वितयं चैवमाज्यस्थालीं तथैव हि |
सर्वं संप्रोक्ष्य मूलेन निधायाथ स्तरोपरि || 79 ||
text_mt: as well as the pair of sruc and sruva, and likewise the vessel of clarified butter; / having sprinkled everything with the root-mantra and placed it on the grass-strewing, // 79

sanskrit_iast:
praṇītāpātramāpūrya toyena tadanantaram |
tatrāsanavaraṃ dhyātvā viṣṇumūlena vinyaset || 80 ||
meaning:
प्रणीतापात्रमापूर्य तोयेन तदनन्तरम् |
तत्रासनवरं ध्यात्वा विष्णुमूलेन विन्यसेत् || 80 ||
text_mt: having then filled the praṇītā vessel with water, / contemplating an excellent seat there, he should deposit it with the root-mantra of Viṣṇu. // 80

sanskrit_iast: yāga(ge ?)yajñapiti(te?)rmantramevaṃ saṃsthāpya cottare |
meaning: याग(गे ?)यज्ञपिति(ते?)र्मन्त्रमेवं संस्थाप्य चोत्तरे |
text_mt: Having thus established to the north the mantra of the lord of the sacrifice in the sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast: [paridhividhānam]
meaning: [परिधिविधानम्]

sanskrit_iast: pradadyācca tato vipra paridhīnhṛdayena ca || 81 ||
meaning: प्रदद्याच्च ततो विप्र परिधीन्हृदयेन च || 81 ||
text_mt: And then, O brahmin, he should place the surrounding sticks with the heart-mantra, // 81

sanskrit_iast:
yajñakāṣṭhodbhavānspaṣṭānsaparṇānhastasammitān |
caturyavaparīṇāhānagāre hastasammite || 82 ||
meaning:
यज्ञकाष्ठोद्भवान्स्पष्टान्सपर्णान्हस्तसम्मितान् |
चतुर्यवपरीणाहानगारे हस्तसम्मिते || 82 ||
text_mt: made of sacrificial wood, distinct, bearing leaves, measured at a cubit, / with a circumference of four barley-corns, for an abode measuring a cubit. // 82

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣāṃ dvyaṅgulā vṛddhiḥ paridhīnāṃ dvijottama |
yāvadaṣṭakaraṃ kuṇḍamata ūrdhvaṃ na kārayet || 83 ||
meaning:
अन्येषां द्व्यङ्गुला वृद्धिः परिधीनां द्विजोत्तम |
यावदष्टकरं कुण्डमत ऊर्ध्वं न कारयेत् || 83 ||
text_mt: For others, O best of the twice-born, the increase of the surrounding sticks is two digits, / up to a kuṇḍa of eight cubits; above this he should not make [them]. // 83

sanskrit_iast: [brahmādilokapālārcanam]
meaning: [ब्रह्मादिलोकपालार्चनम्]
text_mt: [Worship of the world-protectors beginning with Brahmā]

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṭarāṇi tato dadyātteṣu pṛṣṭhe hṛdā mune |
tatpṛṣṭhe pūjayennityaṃ lokapālānsvadiksthitān || 84 ||
meaning:
विष्टराणि ततो दद्यात्तेषु पृष्ठे हृदा मुने |
तत्पृष्ठे पूजयेन्नित्यं लोकपालान्स्वदिक्स्थितान् || 84 ||
text_mt: He should then place seats upon them, on their back, with the heart[-mantra], O sage; / on their back he should always worship the world-protectors situated in their own directions: // 84

sanskrit_iast: brahmamāhendrarudrādīngandhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
meaning: ब्रह्ममाहेन्द्ररुद्रादीन्गन्धपुष्पादिभिः शुभैः |
text_mt: those beginning with Brahmā, Mahendra, and Rudra, with auspicious scents, flowers, and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast: [sruksruvayoḥ saṃskārakramaḥ]
meaning: [स्रुक्स्रुवयोः संस्कारक्रमः]
text_mt: [Procedure for the consecration of the sruc and sruva]

sanskrit_iast: sruksuvābhyāṃ ca saṃskāramupayāmāgragaiḥ kuśaiḥ || 85 ||
meaning: स्रुक्सुवाभ्यां च संस्कारमुपयामाग्रगैः कुशैः || 85 ||
text_mt: And [he performs] consecration for the sruc and sruva with kusa blades positioned on the tip of the upayāma. // 85

sanskrit_iast:
sruvaṃ dvādaśadhā śodhyaṃ hyastreṇoṣṇena vāriṇā |
tathaiva dvijaśārdūla sruksaṃśodhyā dvidhaiva tu || 86 ||
meaning:
स्रुवं द्वादशधा शोध्यं ह्यस्त्रेणोष्णेन वारिणा |
तथैव द्विजशार्दूल स्रुक्संशोध्या द्विधैव तु || 86 ||
text_mt: The sruva is to be purified twelve times with the weapon[-mantra] and with hot water; / likewise, O tiger among the twice-born, the sruc is to be purified in just two ways. // 86

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣālyau sruksruvau hyevaṃ śikhāmantreṇa vai tataḥ |
kuṇḍasthenāgninā tāpyau
meaning:
संक्षाल्यौ स्रुक्स्रुवौ ह्येवं शिखामन्त्रेण वै ततः |
कुण्डस्थेनाग्निना ताप्यौ
text_mt: Having washed the sruc and sruva in this manner, then with the śikhā-mantra / they are to be heated by the fire situated in the kuṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast: [sruksruvayorlakṣaṇam]
meaning: [स्रुक्स्रुवयोर्लक्षणम्]
text_mt: [Characteristics of the sruc and sruva]

sanskrit_iast: tayorlakṣaṇamucyate || 87 ||
meaning: तयोर्लक्षणमुच्यते || 87 ||

sanskrit_iast:
svabāhudaṇḍamānena mantrajñaḥ kalpayetpurā |
p. 140) daivīsruksiddhaye kāṣṭaṃ vistārācca ṣaḍaṅgulam || 88 ||
meaning:
स्वबाहुदण्डमानेन मन्त्रज्ञः कल्पयेत्पुरा |
प्. 140) दैवीस्रुक्सिद्धये काष्टं विस्ताराच्च षडङ्गुलम् || 88 ||
text_mt: The knower of mantras should first fashion wood measuring the length of his own arm / and six digits in breadth, for the realization of the divine sruc. // 88

sanskrit_iast:
dairghyādbhāgadvayenātha daṇḍamaṣṭāsramucyate |
sārdhadvyaṅgulamānaṃ tu kṛtvā śeṣaṃ tu śodhayet || 89 ||
meaning:
दैर्घ्याद्भागद्वयेनाथ दण्डमष्टास्रमुच्यते |
सार्धद्व्यङ्गुलमानं तु कृत्वा शेषं तु शोधयेत् || 89 ||
text_mt: The handle is said to be eight-sided, with two parts out of its length; / having made the measure two and a half digits, he should shape the remainder. // 89

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśaṃ daṇḍamūle tu kuryātpadmānanaṃ śubham |
karṇikāstho yathā daṇḍo bhavedvai munisattama || 90 ||
meaning:
कलशं दण्डमूले तु कुर्यात्पद्माननं शुभम् |
कर्णिकास्थो यथा दण्डो भवेद्वै मुनिसत्तम || 90 ||
text_mt: At the root of the handle he should make an auspicious pot with an opening like a lotus, / so that the handle rests upon the pericarp, O best of sages, // 90

sanskrit_iast:
trivaliṃ tvathavā śaṅkhaṃ yathā daṇḍastadāsyagaḥ |
kṛtvā'grasthaṃ dvidhā bhāgaṃ samāṃśena prayatnataḥ || 91 ||
meaning:
त्रिवलिं त्वथवा शङ्खं यथा दण्डस्तदास्यगः |
कृत्वाऽग्रस्थं द्विधा भागं समांशेन प्रयत्नतः || 91 ||
text_mt: or having three folds, or a conch, so that the handle enters its mouth. / Having divided the part situated at the front into two equal portions with care, // 91

sanskrit_iast:
dvyaṅgulaṃ cātha bhāgasya vaipulyaṃ cāgrataḥ kramāt |
daṇḍāvasthasya bhāgasya tryaṅgulaṃ paritaḥ samam || 92 ||
meaning:
द्व्यङ्गुलं चाथ भागस्य वैपुल्यं चाग्रतः क्रमात् |
दण्डावस्थस्य भागस्य त्र्यङ्गुलं परितः समम् || 92 ||
text_mt: the width of the portion in front is two digits successively; / for the portion resting on the handle, it is three digits, even all around. // 92

sanskrit_iast:
datvā bhramaṃ tataḥ kuryānnimnaṃ khātaṃ salakṣaṇam |
tanmadhye paṅkajaṃ kuryātpraphullaṃ cordhvapallavam || 93 ||
meaning:
दत्वा भ्रमं ततः कुर्यान्निम्नं खातं सलक्षणम् |
तन्मध्ये पङ्कजं कुर्यात्प्रफुल्लं चोर्ध्वपल्लवम् || 93 ||
text_mt: Having made a rotation, he should then make a sunken hollow having the prescribed marks; / in its middle he should fashion a blooming lotus with upward-facing sprouts. // 93

sanskrit_iast:
ājyakośaṃ tu taṃ viddhi saptapañcapalopamam |
padmamadhye nimagnā ca karṇikā vai sakesarā || 94 ||
meaning:
आज्यकोशं तु तं विद्धि सप्तपञ्चपलोपमम् |
पद्ममध्ये निमग्ना च कर्णिका वै सकेसरा || 94 ||
text_mt: Know that to be the ghee-receptacle, resembling seven or five palas; / and in the middle of the lotus, the pericarp with filaments is sunken. // 94

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāraṃ bahiścakraṃ padmasyāṣṭadalasya ca |
padmabāhye tu kartavyaṃ śaṅkhaṃ koṇacatuṣṭaye || 95 ||
meaning:
द्वादशारं बहिश्चक्रं पद्मस्याष्टदलस्य च |
पद्मबाह्ये तु कर्तव्यं शङ्खं कोणचतुष्टये || 95 ||
text_mt: Outside the eight-petalled lotus there is a twelve-spoked wheel; / and on the outside of the lotus a conch should be made at the four corners. // 20

sanskrit_iast:
tato'grabhāgasya mune pārśvayorubhayorapi |
ekaikamaṅgulaṃ śodhyaṃ sa vibhājyastridhā tataḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
ततोऽग्रभागस्य मुने पार्श्वयोरुभयोरपि |
एकैकमङ्गुलं शोध्यं स विभाज्यस्त्रिधा ततः || 96 ||
text_mt: Then, O sage, on both sides of the front portion, / one digit on each side is to be carved away; it is then to be divided into three. // 96

sanskrit_iast:
karṇamekena bhāgena madhye tvasyau (tvaṃsau ?) dvayena tu |
vicchinnaṃ vaktramaṃsābhyāṃ madhyamekāṅgulena tu || 97 ||
meaning:
कर्णमेकेन भागेन मध्ये त्वस्यौ (त्वंसौ ?) द्वयेन तु |
विच्छिन्नं वक्त्रमंसाभ्यां मध्यमेकाङ्गुलेन तु || 97 ||
text_mt: The ear is one part, but in the middle the shoulders are two; / the face is separated from the shoulders by one digit in the middle. // 97

sanskrit_iast:
vistāraṃ karṇatulyaṃ tu varjayitvā tataḥ purā |
karṇadeśātsamārabhya śeṣaṃ tu pariśodhayet || 98 ||
meaning:
विस्तारं कर्णतुल्यं तु वर्जयित्वा ततः पुरा |
कर्णदेशात्समारभ्य शेषं तु परिशोधयेत् || 98 ||
text_mt: First having set aside a width equal to the ear, / beginning from the region of the ear, he should carve the remainder // 98

sanskrit_iast:
kramāgatena sūtreṇa syādvārāhānanaṃ yathā |
tataḥ puṣkarapatrāttu mukhāgraṃ yāvadeva hi || 99 ||
meaning:
क्रमागतेन सूत्रेण स्याद्वाराहाननं यथा |
ततः पुष्करपत्रात्तु मुखाग्रं यावदेव हि || 99 ||
text_mt: with a cord applied in succession, so that it becomes like the snout of a boar. / Then, from the lotus leaf right up to the tip of the mouth, // 99

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādājyapraṇālaṃ tu samaṃ nyūnāṅgulaṃ mune |
īṣadvai kramasūkṣmaṃ ca nājyaṃ yāti yathā drutam || 100 ||
meaning:
कुर्यादाज्यप्रणालं तु समं न्यूनाङ्गुलं मुने |
ईषद्वै क्रमसूक्ष्मं च नाज्यं याति यथा द्रुतम् || 100 ||
text_mt: he should make the channel for the ghee, even, measuring less than a digit, O sage, / and slightly tapering gradually, so that the ghee does not flow swiftly. // 100

sanskrit_iast:
hastamātraṃ tataḥ  kuryātsruvaṃ vipra manoramam |
vistāraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vaipulyācca tadardhataḥ || 101 ||
meaning:
हस्तमात्रं ततः  कुर्यात्स्रुवं विप्र मनोरमम् |
विस्तारं द्व्यङ्गुलं काष्ठं वैपुल्याच्च तदर्धतः || 101 ||
text_mt: Then, O brahmin, he should make a charming sruva measuring a cubit; / the wood should be two digits in width and half of that in thickness. // 101

sanskrit_iast:
vistāramānādagre'sya vṛttaṃ kuryāddviraṅgulam |
kramāttannimnakhātaṃ ca golake caiva mudritam || 102 ||
meaning:
विस्तारमानादग्रेऽस्य वृत्तं कुर्याद्द्विरङ्गुलम् |
क्रमात्तन्निम्नखातं च गोलके चैव मुद्रितम् || 102 ||
text_mt: At its tip, according to the measure of the width, he should make a circle of two digits; / gradually there is a sunken hollow, imprinted in a sphere, // 102

sanskrit_iast:
p. 141) madhye mṛgapadākāracinhena tu virājitam |
vistārasya tribhāgena grīvā sāśrā triraṅgulā || 103 ||
meaning:
प्. 141) मध्ये मृगपदाकारचिन्हेन तु विराजितम् |
विस्तारस्य त्रिभागेन ग्रीवा साश्रा त्रिरङ्गुला || 103 ||
text_mt: adorned in the middle with a mark shaped like a deer's hoof; / the neck is one-third of the width, angular, and three digits [long]. // 103

sanskrit_iast:
mūle cobhayataḥ kuryātsvastikaṃ dvyaṅgulāyatam |
vicitraracanāyuktaṃ daṇḍaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ tu vā bhavet || 104 ||
meaning:
मूले चोभयतः कुर्यात्स्वस्तिकं द्व्यङ्गुलायतम् |
विचित्ररचनायुक्तं दण्डं श्लक्ष्णं तु वा भवेत् || 104 ||
text_mt: At the base, on both sides, he should make a svastika two digits in length; / the handle should be endowed with varied design or smooth. // 104

sanskrit_iast:
sruvamevaṃvidhaṃ kuryāddhomakarmaṇi sādhakaḥ |
saṃskārārthaṃ tatognervai tena homaṃ samācaret || 105 ||
meaning:
स्रुवमेवंविधं कुर्याद्धोमकर्मणि साधकः |
संस्कारार्थं ततोग्नेर्वै तेन होमं समाचरेत् || 105 ||
text_mt: The practitioner should make a sruva of such a kind for the rite of oblation; / then, for the consecration of the fire, he should perform the oblation with it. // 105

sanskrit_iast: [agneḥ saṃskāradvaividhyam]
meaning: [अग्नेः संस्कारद्वैविध्यम्]
text_mt: [The two kinds of consecration of the fire]

sanskrit_iast:
agneśca daśa saṃskārāḥ kuṇḍamadhyagatasya ca |
bāhye tu pañcasaṃskārā evaṃ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ || 106 ||
meaning:
अग्नेश्च दश संस्काराः कुण्डमध्यगतस्य च |
बाह्ये तु पञ्चसंस्कारा एवं पञ्चदश स्मृताः || 106 ||
text_mt: There are ten consecrations of the fire situated within the kuṇḍa, / and five consecrations externally; thus fifteen are traditionally taught. // 106

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃ bāhye arcanaṃ cāvakuṇṭhanam |
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ vanheḥ pañcaite kathitāḥ purā || 107 ||
meaning:
प्रोक्षणं ताडनं बाह्ये अर्चनं चावकुण्ठनम् |
अमृतीकरणं वन्हेः पञ्चैते कथिताः पुरा || 107 ||
text_mt: Sprinkling, striking, worship externally, veiling, / and making the fire immortal—these five were declared earlier. // 107

sanskrit_iast: [agnergarbhanyāsādisaṃskārāḥ]
meaning: [अग्नेर्गर्भन्यासादिसंस्काराः]
text_mt: [Consecrations of the fire: placing the embryo and others]

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍamadhye tu vai vipra prāglakṣmyāṃ tu prayojanam |
garbhanyāsaṃ puṃsavanaṃ tato vai vaktrakalpanā || 108 ||
meaning:
कुण्डमध्ये तु वै विप्र प्राग्लक्ष्म्यां तु प्रयोजनम् |
गर्भन्यासं पुंसवनं ततो वै वक्त्रकल्पना || 108 ||
text_mt: Within the kuṇḍa, O brahmin, in the east on Lakṣmī, the rites are to be employed: / placing the embryo, the rite for procuring a male child, then the fashioning of the mouth, // 108

sanskrit_iast:
sīmantaṃ vaktraniryāsaṃ niṣkrāmaṃ jātakarma ca |
nāmadhyeyaṃ ca bhogaṃ ca prāśanādyaṃ dvijākhilam || 109 ||
meaning:
सीमन्तं वक्त्रनिर्यासं निष्क्रामं जातकर्म च |
नामध्येयं च भोगं च प्राशनाद्यं द्विजाखिलम् || 109 ||
text_mt: parting the hair, the emergence of the mouth, the first exit, the birth rite, / naming, enjoyment, the first feeding and so forth, completely, O twice-born, // 109

sanskrit_iast: adhikāraṃ ca sarvānvai hṛdā kuryācca nārada |
meaning: अधिकारं च सर्वान्वै हृदा कुर्याच्च नारद |
text_mt: and investiture—he should perform all [these] with the heart[-mantra], O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast: [athājyasaṃskārāḥ]
meaning: [अथाज्यसंस्काराः]

sanskrit_iast: ājyakarmaṇi vai kuryāddaśaivaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 110 ||
meaning: आज्यकर्मणि वै कुर्याद्दशैवं विधिपूर्वकम् || 110 ||
text_mt: In the rite of the ghee, he should thus perform ten according to the rules: // 110

sanskrit_iast:
adhiśrayaṇamādau hṛnmantreṇa kavacena ca |
saṃplavotplavane caiva upādhiśrayaṇaṃ tathā || 111 ||
meaning:
अधिश्रयणमादौ हृन्मन्त्रेण कवचेन च |
संप्लवोत्प्लवने चैव उपाधिश्रयणं तथा || 111 ||
text_mt: first, placing over the fire with the heart-mantra and the armour[-mantra], / floating and skimming, and likewise placing adjacent, // 111

sanskrit_iast:
prasādīkaraṇaṃ caiva pavitrīkaraṇaṃ tathā |
tato nīrājanaṃ nāma trīṇyetāni ca nārada || 112 ||
meaning:
प्रसादीकरणं चैव पवित्रीकरणं तथा |
ततो नीराजनं नाम त्रीण्येतानि च नारद || 112 ||
text_mt: clarifying and purifying, / then waving lights; these three, O Nārada, // 112

sanskrit_iast:
hṛnmantreṇa ca kāryāṇi kavacenāvakuṇṭhanam |
avalokāmṛtīkārau tenaiva tadanantaram || 113 ||
meaning:
हृन्मन्त्रेण च कार्याणि कवचेनावकुण्ठनम् |
अवलोकामृतीकारौ तेनैव तदनन्तरम् || 113 ||
text_mt: are to be performed with the heart-mantra; veiling is with the armour[-mantra]; / immediately after that, gazing and making immortal with the same. // 113

sanskrit_iast:
bhāṇḍasthasya yadājyasya darbhaiḥ prajvalitaiḥ purā |
sparśanaṃ viddhi saṃskāramadhiśrayaṇasaṃjñakam || 114 ||
meaning:
भाण्डस्थस्य यदाज्यस्य दर्भैः प्रज्वलितैः पुरा |
स्पर्शनं विद्धि संस्कारमधिश्रयणसंज्ञकम् || 114 ||
text_mt: Know the touching of the ghee situated in the vessel / with kindled darbha grass first to be the consecration named 'placing over the fire.' // 114

sanskrit_iast:
p. 142) tataḥ pāṇidvayenaiva anāmāṅguṣṭhapīḍitam |
madhyanamraṃ kuśākāṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā'jyopari || 115 ||
meaning:
प्. 142) ततः पाणिद्वयेनैव अनामाङ्गुष्ठपीडितम् |
मध्यनम्रं कुशाकाण्डं गृहीत्वाऽज्योपरि || 115 ||
text_mt: Then, having taken with both hands a blade of kusa pressed by the ring finger and thumb / and bent in the middle, over the ghee // 115

sanskrit_iast:
nayettaccanayedvipra tamagnau nikṣipetkuśam |
saṃplavotplavanāvetau saṃskārau parikīrtitau || 116 ||
meaning:
नयेत्तच्चनयेद्विप्र तमग्नौ निक्षिपेत्कुशम् |
संप्लवोत्प्लवनावेतौ संस्कारौ परिकीर्तितौ || 116 ||
text_mt: he should move it back and forth, O brahmin, and cast that kusa into the fire; / these two consecrations are proclaimed as 'floating' and 'skimming.' // 116

sanskrit_iast:
upādhiśrayaṇaṃ nāma yattadrāvaṇamucyate |
parivartanamanyasminbhāṇḍe doṣāpanuttaye || 117 ||
meaning:
उपाधिश्रयणं नाम यत्तद्रावणमुच्यते |
परिवर्तनमन्यस्मिन्भाण्डे दोषापनुत्तये || 117 ||
text_mt: That which is called its melting is termed 'placing adjacent'; / pouring it into another vessel for the removal of defects // 117

sanskrit_iast:
prasādīkaraṇaṃ hyetattato dārbhaṃ pavitrakam |
vinikṣipecca tanmadhye pavitrīkaraṇaṃ ca tat || 118 ||
meaning:
प्रसादीकरणं ह्येतत्ततो दार्भं पवित्रकम् |
विनिक्षिपेच्च तन्मध्ये पवित्रीकरणं च तत् || 118 ||
text_mt: is indeed 'clarifying'; then he should cast a purifier of darbha / into its middle, and that is 'purifying.' // 118

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍādulmukamādāya jvalantaṃ dhūmavarjitam |
tenāvartaṃ sakṛdvipra tadvai nīrājanaṃ smṛtam || 119 ||
meaning:
कुण्डादुल्मुकमादाय ज्वलन्तं धूमवर्जितम् |
तेनावर्तं सकृद्विप्र तद्वै नीराजनं स्मृतम् || 119 ||
text_mt: Taking a blazing brand free from smoke from the kuṇḍa, / circling once with it, O brahmin—that is remembered as 'waving lights.' // 119

sanskrit_iast:
nīrajīkṛtya tatpaścātkavacodaragaṃ smaret |
avakuṇṭhanametaddhi tarjanyā yatpradakṣiṇam || 120 ||
meaning:
नीरजीकृत्य तत्पश्चात्कवचोदरगं स्मरेत् |
अवकुण्ठनमेतद्धि तर्जन्या यत्प्रदक्षिणम् || 120 ||
text_mt: Having made it free of dust, he should then visualize it within the interior of the armour; / this is 'veiling,' which is done circumambulating with the index finger. // 120

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā hṛdayasthena dṛggatenāvalokanam |
nirīkṣaṇamidaṃ vipra tatastatropari smaret || 121 ||
meaning:
तेजसा हृदयस्थेन दृग्गतेनावलोकनम् |
निरीक्षणमिदं विप्र ततस्तत्रोपरि स्मरेत् || 121 ||
text_mt: Gazing is by the radiance situated in the heart, reached to the eye; / this is the 'inspecting,' O brahmin; then, above it, he should meditate on // 121

sanskrit_iast:
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ dhenumudrāsamanvitam |
mantraṃ vai saurabheyaṃ ca sphuradinduśatapratham || 122 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यस्थं धेनुमुद्रासमन्वितम् |
मन्त्रं वै सौरभेयं च स्फुरदिन्दुशतप्रथम् || 122 ||
text_mt: the Saurabheya mantra, situated in the middle of the lunar disc, accompanied by the dhenumudrā, / radiating with the light of a hundred shining moons. // 122

sanskrit_iast:
tadantarasthaṃ mantreśaṃ himācalanibhaṃ smaret |
tatsrutairamṛtaughaiśca śaśijairdhenujairapi || 123 ||
meaning:
तदन्तरस्थं मन्त्रेशं हिमाचलनिभं स्मरेत् |
तत्स्रुतैरमृतौघैश्च शशिजैर्धेनुजैरपि || 123 ||
text_mt: Within it he should visualize the Lord of Mantras, resembling the Snow Mountain, / and through the streams of nectar flowing from it, born of the moon and also born of the cow, // 123

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃskārasaṃyuktaṃ smaredājyaṃ ca bhāvitam |
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ nāma idaṃ te saṃprakāśitam || 124 ||
meaning:
सर्वसंस्कारसंयुक्तं स्मरेदाज्यं च भावितम् |
अमृतीकरणं नाम इदं ते संप्रकाशितम् || 124 ||
text_mt: he should meditate on the clarified butter, consecrated with all rites and infused [with power]. / This, called 'immortalization', has been revealed to you. // 124

sanskrit_iast: avalokyāmṛtīkṛtya dātavye caiva cakṣuṣī |
meaning: अवलोक्यामृतीकृत्य दातव्ये चैव चक्षुषी |
text_mt: Having inspected and immortalized [it], the two eyes are to be offered.

sanskrit_iast: [sruksruvābhyāṃ kuṇḍasya dakṣiṇavāmabhāgayoḥ kramādājyahomaḥ]
meaning: [स्रुक्स्रुवाभ्यां कुण्डस्य दक्षिणवामभागयोः क्रमादाज्यहोमः]
text_mt: [Oblation of clarified butter successively into the right and left sides of the kuṇḍa with sruc and sruva]

sanskrit_iast: sruva(ca ?) mājyena saṃpūrya sūryabījena cintayet || 125 ||
meaning: स्रुव(च ?) माज्येन संपूर्य सूर्यबीजेन चिन्तयेत् || 125 ||
text_mt: Having filled the sruva with clarified butter, he should meditate with the seed-syllable of the sun, // 125

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṃśuṃ ca tanmadhye dadyātkuṇḍasya dakṣiṇe |
aparasminsruve dhyātvā somākhyenākṣareṇa tu || 126 ||
meaning:
सहस्रांशुं च तन्मध्ये दद्यात्कुण्डस्य दक्षिणे |
अपरस्मिन्स्रुवे ध्यात्वा सोमाख्येनाक्षरेण तु || 126 ||
text_mt: and offer to the Thousand-Rayed One in its middle on the right side of the kuṇḍa. / Then in the other ladle, having meditated with the syllable named Soma, // 126

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇaṃ śaśāṅkabījaṃ ca pradadyāttu taduttare |
meaning: पूर्णं शशाङ्कबीजं च प्रदद्यात्तु तदुत्तरे |
text_mt: he should offer the full [oblation] with the moon seed-syllable on the north of it.

sanskrit_iast: [kuṇḍasya madhyabhāge agnīṣomātmakasya yajanaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [कुण्डस्य मध्यभागे अग्नीषोमात्मकस्य यजनप्रकारः]
text_mt: [Manner of worshipping the nature of Agni-Soma in the middle part of the kuṇḍa]

sanskrit_iast: tābhyāmabhyantare paścādagnīṣomātmakaṃ yajet || 127 ||
meaning: ताभ्यामभ्यन्तरे पश्चादग्नीषोमात्मकं यजेत् || 127 ||
text_mt: After those two, he should worship in the interior that which consists of Agni and Soma: // 127

sanskrit_iast:
yadbījaṃ hi satattvasya śarīrasyākhilasya ca |
avibhāgena vai yatra saṃsthitā dehadhātavaḥ || 128 ||
meaning:
यद्बीजं हि सतत्त्वस्य शरीरस्याखिलस्य च |
अविभागेन वै यत्र संस्थिता देहधातवः || 128 ||
text_mt: the seed-syllable which belongs to the real principle and to the entire body, / wherein the bodily constituents are situated without distinction; // 128

sanskrit_iast:
p. 143) bahiḥ (rhi ?) kaṇṭhopamaṃ dhyātvā lakṣmībījāntarasthitam |
uktaṃ (kta ?) bījadvayenaiva mantreṇaikīkṛtena vai || 129 ||
meaning:
प्. 143) बहिः (र्हि ?) कण्ठोपमं ध्यात्वा लक्ष्मीबीजान्तरस्थितम् |
उक्तं (क्त ?) बीजद्वयेनैव मन्त्रेणैकीकृतेन वै || 129 ||
text_mt: having meditated on it resembling a peacock's throat, situated within the Lakṣmī seed-syllable, / with the aforesaid pair of seed-syllables unified into a single mantra, // 129

sanskrit_iast: prāgvaddhṛtaṃ svayaṃ dadyāddhyāna(ta ?)mastrasamanvitam |
meaning: प्राग्वद्धृतं स्वयं दद्याद्ध्यान(त ?)मस्त्रसमन्वितम् |
text_mt: he should himself offer clarified butter as before, accompanied by meditation and the weapon.

sanskrit_iast: [tilādihomadravyāṇāmājyena saṃskāraḥ]
meaning: [तिलादिहोमद्रव्याणामाज्येन संस्कारः]
text_mt: [Consecration of oblational substances such as sesame with clarified butter]

sanskrit_iast: tataścājyena saṃskāryāḥ sarvahomyāstilādayaḥ || 130 ||
meaning: ततश्चाज्येन संस्कार्याः सर्वहोम्यास्तिलादयः || 130 ||
text_mt: Then, all oblational substances such as sesame are to be consecrated with clarified butter. // 130

sanskrit_iast: [agnergarbhādhānādisaṃskārāṇāṃ vivecanam]
meaning: [अग्नेर्गर्भाधानादिसंस्काराणां विवेचनम्]
text_mt: [Explanation of the rites of conception and so forth for the fire]

sanskrit_iast:
agnerhome'tha kartavyaḥ sarvasaṃskārasiddhaye |
hṛdā'nalaṃ puṭīkṛtya karmanāma samuccaret || 131 ||
meaning:
अग्नेर्होमेऽथ कर्तव्यः सर्वसंस्कारसिद्धये |
हृदाऽनलं पुटीकृत्य कर्मनाम समुच्चरेत् || 131 ||
text_mt: Now an oblation is to be made into the fire for the accomplishment of all life-cycle rites. / Having enclosed the fire with the heart-mantra, he should utter the name of the rite, // 131

sanskrit_iast: saṃpādayāmi svāhāntaḥ sarvakarmasvayaṃ kramaḥ |
meaning: संपादयामि स्वाहान्तः सर्वकर्मस्वयं क्रमः |
text_mt: ending with 'saṃpādayāmi svāhā'; this is the sequence in all rites.

sanskrit_iast: [atha tatra garbhādhānasaṃskāravivecanam]
meaning: [अथ तत्र गर्भाधानसंस्कारविवेचनम्]
text_mt: [Now, explanation of the conception rite therein]

sanskrit_iast: śrīkukṣikuhare yadvai bahiṣṭhasya praveśanam || 132 ||
meaning: श्रीकुक्षिकुहरे यद्वै बहिष्ठस्य प्रवेशनम् || 132 ||
text_mt: The entry of that which is outside into the cavity of Śrī's womb— // 132

sanskrit_iast: garbhādhānaṃ tu taṃ viddhi saṃskāraṃ prathamaṃ mune |
meaning: गर्भाधानं तु तं विद्धि संस्कारं प्रथमं मुने |
text_mt: know that, O sage, to be the first life-cycle rite, the conception rite.

sanskrit_iast: [puṃsavanam]
meaning: [पुंसवनम्]

sanskrit_iast: ghrāṇayogācca yā śaktirvanhi(nheḥ ?) śrījaṭhare sthitā || 133 ||
meaning: घ्राणयोगाच्च या शक्तिर्वन्हि(न्हेः ?) श्रीजठरे स्थिता || 133 ||
text_mt: And the power of fire situated in Śrī's belly through the connection of scent, // 133

sanskrit_iast:
jvālārūpā'kṣayā sūkṣmā tasyāścitprasaro hi yaḥ |
bhagavacchakticaitanyasaṃsargācca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 134 ||
meaning:
ज्वालारूपाऽक्षया सूक्ष्मा तस्याश्चित्प्रसरो हि यः |
भगवच्छक्तिचैतन्यसंसर्गाच्च शनैः शनैः || 134 ||
text_mt: flame-formed, imperishable, subtle, whose expansion of consciousness [develops] / gradually from contact with the consciousness of the Lord's power— // 134

sanskrit_iast:
satve (smṛtvai ?) tajjuhuyādājyaṃ tanmantreṇoditena ca |
bhavetpuṃsavanaṃ cāgneścicchaktinayanāttu vai || 135 ||
meaning:
सत्वे (स्मृत्वै ?) तज्जुहुयादाज्यं तन्मन्त्रेणोदितेन च |
भवेत्पुंसवनं चाग्नेश्चिच्छक्तिनयनात्तु वै || 135 ||
text_mt: having meditated on it, he should offer clarified butter with its spoken mantra. / And the puṃsavana of the fire occurs through bringing forth the conscious power. // 135

sanskrit_iast: [atha vaktrakalpanā]
meaning: [अथ वक्त्रकल्पना]

sanskrit_iast:
tasya cārciṣmato vaktrātprabuddhasyodbhavanti tāḥ |
āloke dahane śaktyā (ktā ?) nirākārasya sāṃpratam || 136 ||
meaning:
तस्य चार्चिष्मतो वक्त्रात्प्रबुद्धस्योद्भवन्ति ताः |
आलोके दहने शक्त्या (क्ता ?) निराकारस्य सांप्रतम् || 136 ||
text_mt: From the mouth of that awakened, flaming one, they arise, / capable of illumination and burning; of him who is now formless, // 136

sanskrit_iast: golakākṛtimātrasya viddhi tāṃ vaktrakalpanām |
meaning: गोलकाकृतिमात्रस्य विद्धि तां वक्त्रकल्पनाम् |
text_mt: having only a spherical shape, know that to be the formation of the mouths.

sanskrit_iast: [saptānāṃ vaktrārciṣāṃ nāmāni]
meaning: [सप्तानां वक्त्रार्चिषां नामानि]
text_mt: [Names of the seven flames of the mouth]

sanskrit_iast: tāsāṃ vaktrārciṣāṃ caiva śṛṇu nāmāni nārada || 137 ||
meaning: तासां वक्त्रार्चिषां चैव शृणु नामानि नारद || 137 ||
text_mt: And hear the names of those mouth-flames, O Nārada: // 137

sanskrit_iast:
prabhā dīptiḥ prakāśā ca marīcistapanī tathā |
karālā lelihā caiva kuṇḍaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitāḥ || 138 ||
meaning:
प्रभा दीप्तिः प्रकाशा च मरीचिस्तपनी तथा |
कराला लेलिहा चैव कुण्डं व्याप्य व्यवस्थिताः || 138 ||
text_mt: Prabhā, Dīpti, and Prakāśā, Marīci, and Tapanī, / Karālā, and Lelihā, stationed pervading the kuṇḍa. // 138

sanskrit_iast:
īśapūrvāgnidigbhāge prabhādyaṃ tritayaṃ smṛtam |
rakṣovāruṇavāyavye marīcyādyaṃ trayaṃ tu tat || 139 ||
meaning:
ईशपूर्वाग्निदिग्भागे प्रभाद्यं त्रितयं स्मृतम् |
रक्षोवारुणवायव्ये मरीच्याद्यं त्रयं तु तत् || 139 ||
text_mt: The triad beginning with Prabhā is taught in the northeast, east, and southeast; / and the triad beginning with Marīci is in the southwest, west, and northwest; // 139

sanskrit_iast: p. 144) udagdiṅmadhyato yāmye sthitaikā lelihā'bhidhā |
meaning: प्. 144) उदग्दिङ्मध्यतो याम्ये स्थितैका लेलिहाऽभिधा |
text_mt: one named Lelihā stands from the middle of the north to the south.

sanskrit_iast: [vaktrārciṣāṃ bījagaṇaḥ]
meaning: [वक्त्रार्चिषां बीजगणः]
text_mt: [Group of seed-syllables for the flames of the mouth]

sanskrit_iast: āsāṃ bījagaṇaṃ viśvaṃ vahnibījāvasānakam || 140 ||
meaning: आसां बीजगणं विश्वं वह्निबीजावसानकम् || 140 ||
text_mt: The whole group of seed-syllables for these ends with the fire seed-syllable, // 140

sanskrit_iast: pūrvoditakrameṇaiva praṇavādyaṃ namo'ntakam |
meaning: पूर्वोदितक्रमेणैव प्रणवाद्यं नमोऽन्तकम् |
text_mt: beginning with the praṇava and ending with 'namaḥ', precisely in the manner previously stated.

sanskrit_iast: [atha sīmantaḥ]
meaning: [अथ सीमन्तः]

sanskrit_iast: avyaktāśca tadantasthāḥ śiraḥpāṇyādayo'khilāḥ || 141 ||
meaning: अव्यक्ताश्च तदन्तस्थाः शिरःपाण्यादयोऽखिलाः || 141 ||
text_mt: And all the unmanifest limbs within it, such as head and hands, // 141

sanskrit_iast:
svāṃ svāṃ vai karmasīmānaṃ prabuddhāḥ saṃśrayanti ye |
vibhāgakalpanā teṣāṃ sīmantaṃ tadudāhṛtam || 142 ||
meaning:
स्वां स्वां वै कर्मसीमानं प्रबुद्धाः संश्रयन्ति ये |
विभागकल्पना तेषां सीमन्तं तदुदाहृतम् || 142 ||
text_mt: which, having awakened, resort each to its own boundary of action— / the conception of their division is called the partioning of the hair. // 142

sanskrit_iast: [atha vaktraniryāsaḥ]
meaning: [अथ वक्त्रनिर्यासः]

sanskrit_iast:
narasihmādayo vaktrāḥ sphurattārakasannibhāḥ |
śakticaitanyamadhyasthāḥ sā ca śaktistadātmanā || 143 ||
meaning:
नरसिह्मादयो वक्त्राः स्फुरत्तारकसन्निभाः |
शक्तिचैतन्यमध्यस्थाः सा च शक्तिस्तदात्मना || 143 ||
text_mt: The faces beginning with Narasiṃha, resembling glittering stars, / situated in the midst of the conscious power; and that power, transformed completely // 143

sanskrit_iast:
samyak pariṇatā vipra tasmāttā niṣkramanti vai |
svasvasthāne svavīryeṇa vaktraniryāsa ucyate || 144 ||
meaning:
सम्यक् परिणता विप्र तस्मात्ता निष्क्रमन्ति वै |
स्वस्वस्थाने स्ववीर्येण वक्त्रनिर्यास उच्यते || 144 ||
text_mt: into that nature, O brahmin—from it they indeed go forth, / each to its own place by its own power; this is called the emergence of the faces. // 144

sanskrit_iast: [atha niṣkrāmaḥ]
meaning: [अथ निष्क्रामः]

sanskrit_iast:
mukhaśvāso (se ?) na niryātadhyānaṃ śrīkukṣigocarāt |
niṣkrāmaḥ saha vai vahneḥ saṃskāro juhuyācca tam || 145 ||
meaning:
मुखश्वासो (से ?) न निर्यातध्यानं श्रीकुक्षिगोचरात् |
निष्क्रामः सह वै वह्नेः संस्कारो जुहुयाच्च तम् || 145 ||
text_mt: The visualized emergence with the breath of the mouth from the realm of Śrī's belly / is the fire's life-cycle rite of emergence; and he should offer for it. // 145

sanskrit_iast: [atha jātakam]
meaning: [अथ जातकम्]

sanskrit_iast: nissṛtasya ca vai garbhājjātakaṃ tadudāhṛtam |
meaning: निस्सृतस्य च वै गर्भाज्जातकं तदुदाहृतम् |
text_mt: And when it has come out of the womb, that is declared to be the birth-rite.

sanskrit_iast: [prāśanam]
meaning: [प्राशनम्]

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyamadhusarpibhyāṃ snānaṃ saṃprāśanaṃ dvija || 146 ||
meaning: हिरण्यमधुसर्पिभ्यां स्नानं संप्राशनं द्विज || 146 ||
text_mt: A bath and feeding with gold, honey, and clarified butter, O twice-born. // 146

sanskrit_iast: [nāmakaraṇam]
meaning: [नामकरणम्]

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāttadanu vai nāma jātasyāgneḥ prayatnataḥ |
nāmakārāvasānaṃ ca praṇavaṃ vaiṣṇavāgnaye || 147 ||
meaning:
कुर्यात्तदनु वै नाम जातस्याग्नेः प्रयत्नतः |
नामकारावसानं च प्रणवं वैष्णवाग्नये || 147 ||
text_mt: Thereafter, he should diligently bestow a name on the fire that has been born, / ending with the suffix -nāma, with the praṇava, for the Vaiṣṇava fire. // 147

sanskrit_iast: [bhogaḥ]

annaprāśanapūrvastu bhogo dārāvasānikaḥ |
abhyaṅga ekaḥ saṃskāro hotavyaḥ pūrvavaddvija || 148 ||
meaning:
अन्नप्राशनपूर्वस्तु भोगो दारावसानिकः |
अभ्यङ्ग एकः संस्कारो होतव्यः पूर्ववद्द्विज || 148 ||
text_mt: Enjoyment begins with the first feeding of solid food and ends with marriage; / unction is one rite; oblation is to be made as before, O twice-born. // 148

sanskrit_iast: [athādhikāraḥ]
meaning: [अथाधिकारः]

sanskrit_iast: tato'dhikārasaṃjñastu saṃskāro bahurūpadhṛt |
meaning: ततोऽधिकारसंज्ञस्तु संस्कारो बहुरूपधृत् |
text_mt: Then the rite named 'investiture with authority', which assumes manifold forms.

sanskrit_iast: [uktasaṃskārasaṃskṛtasyāgnernārāyaṇatvena dhyānam]
meaning: [उक्तसंस्कारसंस्कृतस्याग्नेर्नारायणत्वेन ध्यानम्]
text_mt: [Meditation on the fire consecrated by the aforesaid rites as Nārāyaṇa]

sanskrit_iast: iti saṃskārasaṃśuddhaṃ vahniṃ nārāyaṇātmakam || 149 ||
meaning: इति संस्कारसंशुद्धं वह्निं नारायणात्मकम् || 149 ||
text_mt: Having thus visualized the fire, purified by the life-cycle rites, having the nature of Nārāyaṇa, // 149

sanskrit_iast:
p. 145) caturbhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ śaṅkhacakragadābjinam |
kuṇḍamadhyasthitaṃ dhyātvā udayārkasamaprabham || 150 ||
meaning:
प्. 145) चतुर्भुजं चतुर्वक्त्रं शङ्खचक्रगदाब्जिनम् |
कुण्डमध्यस्थितं ध्यात्वा उदयार्कसमप्रभम् || 150 ||
text_mt: four-armed, four-faced, holding conch, discus, mace, and lotus, / situated in the center of the kuṇḍa, radiant like the rising sun, // 150

sanskrit_iast: [jvālāmārgeṇa hṛdaye praviṣṭatvabhāvanam]
meaning: [ज्वालामार्गेण हृदये प्रविष्टत्वभावनम्]
text_mt: [Visualization of entry into the heart along the path of flames]

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tajjanitaṃ(tāṃ ?) kuṇḍājjvālāmārgeṇa cāgatām |
parānandaprakāśābhāṃnāsikyā(?)dvādaśāvadhi || 51 ||
meaning:
तत्र तज्जनितं(तां ?) कुण्डाज्ज्वालामार्गेण चागताम् |
परानन्दप्रकाशाभांनासिक्या(?)द्वादशावधि || 51 ||
text_mt: then [the power] produced from it, which has arrived from the kuṇḍa by the path of flames, / shining with the light of supreme bliss, extending up to twelve [finger-breadths] from the nose, // 151

sanskrit_iast: tato'vatārayogena praviṣṭāṃ bhāvayeddhṛdi |
meaning: ततोऽवतारयोगेन प्रविष्टां भावयेद्धृदि |
text_mt: he should then meditate upon as having entered his heart by the process of descent.

sanskrit_iast: [atha saṃskṛtasyāgneḥ pūjanam]
meaning: [अथ संस्कृतस्याग्नेः पूजनम्]
text_mt: [Now, worship of the consecrated fire]

sanskrit_iast: saṃskṛtasyātha vai vahneḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu bhaktitaḥ || 152 ||
meaning: संस्कृतस्याथ वै वह्नेः पूजां कृत्वा तु भक्तितः || 152 ||
text_mt: Then, having performed the worship of the consecrated fire with devotion, // 152

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpairdhūpena dadhnā ca tilairakṣatamiśritaiḥ |
annairbhakṣyaphalopetairājyena kramaśo dvija || 153 ||
meaning:
पुष्पैर्धूपेन दध्ना च तिलैरक्षतमिश्रितैः |
अन्नैर्भक्ष्यफलोपेतैराज्येन क्रमशो द्विज || 153 ||
text_mt: with flowers, incense, curd, and sesame seeds mixed with unbroken grain, / with cooked food accompanied by delicacies and fruits, and with ghee in due order, O twice-born one, // 153

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇahṛdayenaiva svamantreṇānalaṃ tataḥ |
tarpayeta yathāśakti tilājyādyairanukramāt || 154 ||
meaning:
संपूर्णहृदयेनैव स्वमन्त्रेणानलं ततः |
तर्पयेत यथाशक्ति तिलाज्याद्यैरनुक्रमात् || 154 ||
text_mt: with a fulfilled heart and using his own mantra, he should then satisfy the fire / according to his capacity, with sesame, ghee, and other substances in succession. // 154

sanskrit_iast: agneḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā vauṣaḍantāṃ ghṛtena ca |
meaning: अग्नेः पूर्णाहुतिं दत्वा वौषडन्तां घृतेन च |
text_mt: Having offered the full offering to the fire ending in 'vauṣaṭ' with ghee,

sanskrit_iast: [agnimadhye devasya pūjanam]
meaning: [अग्निमध्ये देवस्य पूजनम्]
text_mt: [Worship of the deity in the middle of the fire]

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ pūjā prakartavyā devasyāgnestu madhyataḥ || 155 ||
meaning: ततः पूजा प्रकर्तव्या देवस्याग्नेस्तु मध्यतः || 155 ||
text_mt: worship of the deity should then be performed in the middle of the fire. // 155

sanskrit_iast: [tatra prathamaṃ vanheḥ smaraṇaprakāraḥ]
meaning: [तत्र प्रथमं वन्हेः स्मरणप्रकारः]
text_mt: [There, first the manner of visualizing the fire]

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ taṃ ca smaredvahniṃ sākāraṃ niṣkalaprabham |
svayogabalavīryeṇa vyāpakaṃ sarvadiggatam || 156 ||
meaning:
पूर्वं तं च स्मरेद्वह्निं साकारं निष्कलप्रभम् |
स्वयोगबलवीर्येण व्यापकं सर्वदिग्गतम् || 156 ||
text_mt: First, he should meditate on that fire endowed with form yet possessing undivided light, / all-pervading by the power of his yoga, extending to all directions, // 156

sanskrit_iast:
sarvataḥ karavākpādaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham |
kadambakusumākāraṃ svaprabhābhirvirājitam || 157 ||
meaning:
सर्वतः करवाक्पादं सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् |
कदम्बकुसुमाकारं स्वप्रभाभिर्विराजितम् || 157 ||
text_mt: with hands, speech, and feet on all sides, with eyes, heads, and faces on all sides, / shaped like a kadamba flower, resplendent with its own radiance, // 157

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍamāpūrayansarvaṃ sarvākṛtyā ca sarvataḥ |
evaṃ hi vitato vyāpī nirākāraḥ sudīptimān || 158 ||
meaning:
कुण्डमापूरयन्सर्वं सर्वाकृत्या च सर्वतः |
एवं हि विततो व्यापी निराकारः सुदीप्तिमान् || 158 ||
text_mt: filling the whole kuṇḍa completely in all aspects. / Thus indeed, spread out, pervasive, formless, and brilliantly blazing, // 158

sanskrit_iast: [vyomavadvyāpakatayā bhāvitasyāgnermadhye devayajanam]
meaning: [व्योमवद्व्यापकतया भावितस्याग्नेर्मध्ये देवयजनम्]
text_mt: [Worship of the deity in the midst of the fire meditated upon as all-pervasive like space]

sanskrit_iast:
vahniṃ tu vyomavaddhyātvā tanmadhye pūjayetprabhum |
gandhapuṣpādinā caiva
meaning:
वह्निं तु व्योमवद्ध्यात्वा तन्मध्ये पूजयेत्प्रभुम् |
गन्धपुष्पादिना चैव
text_mt: meditating upon the fire as like space, he should worship the Lord in its center, / with perfume, flowers, and the like;

sanskrit_iast: [astrādiyajanam]
meaning: [अस्त्रादियजनम्]

sanskrit_iast: tato'straṃ kavacaṃ yajet || 159 ||
meaning: ततोऽस्त्रं कवचं यजेत् || 159 ||
text_mt: then he should worship the weapon and the armour. // 159

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe bāhumārge tu aniruddhasamīpataḥ |
agnīṣomātmakaṃ tatra ātmarakṣārthameva ca || 160 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणे बाहुमार्गे तु अनिरुद्धसमीपतः |
अग्नीषोमात्मकं तत्र आत्मरक्षार्थमेव च || 160 ||
text_mt: On the path of the right arm, near Aniruddha, / consisting of Agni and Soma, for the purpose of self-protection, // 160

sanskrit_iast: p. 146) devaṃ cakrasthitaṃ cakraṃ
meaning: प्. 146) देवं चक्रस्थितं चक्रं
text_mt: he [worships] the deity, the discus stationed in the discus.

sanskrit_iast: [atha homavidhānam]
meaning: [अथ होमविधानम्]

sanskrit_iast: tato homaṃ samārabhet |
meaning: ततो होमं समारभेत् |

sanskrit_iast: tilairghṛtasamāyuktaiḥ dravyaiḥ sarvaiśca yājñikaiḥ || 161 ||
meaning: तिलैर्घृतसमायुक्तैः द्रव्यैः सर्वैश्च याज्ञिकैः || 161 ||
text_mt: with sesame seeds mixed with ghee and with all sacrificial substances, // 161

sanskrit_iast: sugandhājyaplutaiścaiva kurvīta vidhivattataḥ |
meaning: सुगन्धाज्यप्लुतैश्चैव कुर्वीत विधिवत्ततः |
text_mt: inundated with fragrant ghee, according to rule.

sanskrit_iast: [lakṣmyādīnāṃ homasaṅkhyāvidhānam]
meaning: [लक्ष्म्यादीनां होमसङ्ख्याविधानम्]
text_mt: [The rule for the number of oblations for Lakṣmī and others]

sanskrit_iast: mūlamantrāccaturthāṃśaṃ lakṣmyādīnāṃ ca homayet || 162 ||
meaning: मूलमन्त्राच्चतुर्थांशं लक्ष्म्यादीनां च होमयेत् || 162 ||
text_mt: He should offer for Lakṣmī and the others a fourth of the [oblations of the] root-mantra. // 162

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgānāṃ śaktihomācca ardhaṃ tu juhuyāttataḥ |
tadardhena tu vaktrāṇāṃ homaṃ kuryāddvijottama || 163 ||
meaning:
अङ्गानां शक्तिहोमाच्च अर्धं तु जुहुयात्ततः |
तदर्धेन तु वक्त्राणां होमं कुर्याद्द्विजोत्तम || 163 ||
text_mt: From the oblation for the Śaktis, he should then offer half for the ancillary limbs; / with half of that, O best of the twice-born, he should make oblations for the faces. // 163

sanskrit_iast:
vaktrebhyaḥ kaustubhādīnāmardhaṃ tu parihomayet |
satyādīnāṃ tadardhaṃ tu tebhyaścārdhaṃ pare'kṣare || 164 ||
meaning:
वक्त्रेभ्यः कौस्तुभादीनामर्धं तु परिहोमयेत् |
सत्यादीनां तदर्धं तु तेभ्यश्चार्धं परेऽक्षरे || 164 ||
text_mt: He should offer half of the [oblations of the] faces for Kaustubha and the others; / half of that for Satya and the others; and half of those to the supreme Imperishable. // 164

sanskrit_iast: ardhamardhāṃśasaṃyuktamadhikaṃ cāgravartinām |
meaning: अर्धमर्धांशसंयुक्तमधिकं चाग्रवर्तिनाम् |
text_mt: With each being half, augmented by half a portion, and more for those situated in front,

sanskrit_iast: [japānuguṇyena homasya kartavyatā]
meaning: [जपानुगुण्येन होमस्य कर्तव्यता]
text_mt: [The duty to perform oblations corresponding to the recitation]

sanskrit_iast: japakāle yathā home kartavyaṃ siddhimicchatā || 165 ||
meaning: जपकाले यथा होमे कर्तव्यं सिद्धिमिच्छता || 165 ||
text_mt: as at the time of recitation, so in the oblation it must be performed by one desiring success. // 165

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ jñātvā tataḥ kuryātkoṭihomācchatāvadhi |
yasmādatarpito mantro na kadācitphalapradaḥ || 166 ||
meaning:
एवं ज्ञात्वा ततः कुर्यात्कोटिहोमाच्छतावधि |
यस्मादतर्पितो मन्त्रो न कदाचित्फलप्रदः || 166 ||
text_mt: Knowing this, he should then perform it from ten million oblations down to a hundred; / for a mantra that is not satisfied never bestows results, // 166

sanskrit_iast: kāmairavaśyaphaladairdeśakālasamudbhavaiḥ |
meaning: कामैरवश्यफलदैर्देशकालसमुद्भवैः |
text_mt: with desires that necessarily bear fruit arising according to place and time.

sanskrit_iast: [homadravyanirūpaṇam]
meaning: [होमद्रव्यनिरूपणम्]

sanskrit_iast: tilairghṛtena payasā dadhnā vā pāyasena tu || 167 ||
meaning: तिलैर्घृतेन पयसा दध्ना वा पायसेन तु || 167 ||
text_mt: [He should offer] with sesame seeds, ghee, milk, curd, or milk-rice, // 167

sanskrit_iast:
siddhānnaiḥ sādhitairbhakṣyairbījalājaiśca taṇḍulaiḥ |
mūlaiḥ phalaiḥ pallavairvā supraśastaiśca komalaiḥ || 168 ||
meaning:
सिद्धान्नैः साधितैर्भक्ष्यैर्बीजलाजैश्च तण्डुलैः |
मूलैः फलैः पल्लवैर्वा सुप्रशस्तैश्च कोमलैः || 168 ||
text_mt: with cooked rice, prepared delicacies, seeds, parched grain, and husked rice, / with roots, fruits, or tender, highly praised shoots, // 168

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhaiḥ sthalapadmādyaiḥ puṣpairvipra sitādikaiḥ |
guggulenājyamiśreṇa sājyaśrīveṣṭakena vā || 169 ||
meaning:
सुगन्धैः स्थलपद्माद्यैः पुष्पैर्विप्र सितादिकैः |
गुग्गुलेनाज्यमिश्रेण साज्यश्रीवेष्टकेन वा || 169 ||
text_mt: with fragrant flowers such as the land-lotus, O twice-born, white and other varieties, / with guggulu mixed with ghee, or with turpentine resin mixed with ghee, // 169

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrīphalairvā sarasairutpalaiśca śubhaistathā |
susitaiḥ sitararaktaiśca padmairbilvaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ || 170 ||
meaning:
धात्रीफलैर्वा सरसैरुत्पलैश्च शुभैस्तथा |
सुसितैः सितररक्तैश्च पद्मैर्बिल्वैः सुशोभनैः || 170 ||
text_mt: or with juicy myrobalan fruits, auspicious blue lotuses, / very white or white-and-red lotuses, and very beautiful bilva fruits, // 170

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvākāṇḍairabhagnāgraiḥ dantisaddantanirmalaiḥ |
edhoṃbhirbrahmavṛkṣotthaiḥ kṣīradrumamayaistathā || 171 ||
meaning:
दूर्वाकाण्डैरभग्नाग्रैः दन्तिसद्दन्तनिर्मलैः |
एधोंभिर्ब्रह्मवृक्षोत्थैः क्षीरद्रुममयैस्तथा || 171 ||
text_mt: with blades of dūrvā grass having unbroken tips, spotless like the fine tusks of an elephant, / with firewood obtained from the sacred tree and from milky trees, // 171

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtā kṣīrasaṃyuktā audumbaryo madhuplutāḥ |
acchinnāgrā hyabhagnāśca kaṇṭakaiḥ parivarjitāḥ || 172 ||
meaning:
अमृता क्षीरसंयुक्ता औदुम्बर्यो मधुप्लुताः |
अच्छिन्नाग्रा ह्यभग्नाश्च कण्टकैः परिवर्जिताः || 172 ||
text_mt: [or with] guḍūcī combined with milk, [or firewood of] udumbara drenched in honey, / with tips unsevered and unbroken, devoid of thorns, // 172

sanskrit_iast: sarvāstrimadhuraktāśca ghṛtayuktāstu vā punaḥ |
meaning: सर्वास्त्रिमधुरक्ताश्च घृतयुक्तास्तु वा पुनः |
text_mt: all anointed with the three sweets, or again endowed with ghee.

sanskrit_iast: p. 147) [homadravyabhedena phalabhedaḥ]
meaning: प्. 147) [होमद्रव्यभेदेन फलभेदः]
text_mt: [Different results according to different oblation substances]

sanskrit_iast: ājyayuktaistilaiḥ śāntiḥ siddhayaḥ sakalāstathā || 173 ||
meaning: आज्ययुक्तैस्तिलैः शान्तिः सिद्धयः सकलास्तथा || 173 ||
text_mt: With sesame seeds mixed with ghee [comes] pacification and all supernatural powers; // 173

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena payasā dadhnā homastṛptiṃ prayacchati |
pāyasena tu siddhānnairbhakṣyaiḥ puṣṭiḥ sadā bhavet || 174 ||
meaning:
घृतेन पयसा दध्ना होमस्तृप्तिं प्रयच्छति |
पायसेन तु सिद्धान्नैर्भक्ष्यैः पुष्टिः सदा भवेत् || 174 ||
text_mt: oblation with ghee, milk, and curd gives contentment; / with milk-rice, cooked grains, and delicacies there is always prosperity. // 174

sanskrit_iast:
bījairdhānyaistaṇḍulaiśca tarpito mantrarāḍ bhavet |
prayacchati sadā śreyaḥ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 175 ||
meaning:
बीजैर्धान्यैस्तण्डुलैश्च तर्पितो मन्त्रराड् भवेत् |
प्रयच्छति सदा श्रेयः प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः || 175 ||
text_mt: When the king of mantras is satisfied with seeds, grains, and husked rice, / the Supreme Lord, being pleased, always bestows welfare. // 175

sanskrit_iast:
pallavaiḥ phalamūlaiśca homastuṣṭiṃ prayacchati |
jahāti cāpamṛtyuṃ ca rogāṃścopaśamaṃ nayet || 176 ||
meaning:
पल्लवैः फलमूलैश्च होमस्तुष्टिं प्रयच्छति |
जहाति चापमृत्युं च रोगांश्चोपशमं नयेत् || 176 ||
text_mt: Oblation with shoots, fruits, and roots bestows satisfaction, / wards off untimely death, and brings diseases to cessation. // 176

sanskrit_iast:
tarpitaḥ sthalapadmādyaiḥ puṣpaiścānyaiḥ sitādikaiḥ |
saubhāgyamatulaṃ vipra acirātsaṃprayacchati || 177 ||
meaning:
तर्पितः स्थलपद्माद्यैः पुष्पैश्चान्यैः सितादिकैः |
सौभाग्यमतुलं विप्र अचिरात्संप्रयच्छति || 177 ||
text_mt: Satisfied with land-lotuses and other flowers, white and other [colors], / O twice-born one, he quickly bestows peerless good fortune. // 177

sanskrit_iast:
guggulvādyairdvijārogyaṃ śubhairdhātrīphalaistathā |
ājyāktaiḥ padmabījaiśca lakṣmīṃ śīghraṃ prayacchati || 178 ||
meaning:
गुग्गुल्वाद्यैर्द्विजारोग्यं शुभैर्धात्रीफलैस्तथा |
आज्याक्तैः पद्मबीजैश्च लक्ष्मीं शीघ्रं प्रयच्छति || 178 ||
text_mt: With guggulu and the like, O twice-born, [comes] freedom from disease, as also with auspicious myrobalan fruits; / and with lotus seeds smeared with ghee, he quickly bestows wealth. // 178

sanskrit_iast:
utpalairvaśyakāmastu bhogakāmaśca homayet |
dūrvāmṛtābhirhomena āyuṣo vṛddhimāpnuyāt || 179 ||
meaning:
उत्पलैर्वश्यकामस्तु भोगकामश्च होमयेत् |
दूर्वामृताभिर्होमेन आयुषो वृद्धिमाप्नुयात् || 179 ||
text_mt: One desiring subjugation or one desiring enjoyment should offer with blue lotuses; / by oblation with dūrvā grass and guḍūcī, one attains an increase of life-span. // 179

sanskrit_iast: edhobhiśca śubhairhomāddoṣaśāntipradaḥ prabhuḥ |
meaning: एधोभिश्च शुभैर्होमाद्दोषशान्तिप्रदः प्रभुः |
text_mt: And through oblation with auspicious firewoods, the Lord bestows the pacification of faults.

sanskrit_iast: [āhutipramāṇabhedaḥ]
meaning: [आहुतिप्रमाणभेदः]

sanskrit_iast: tilānāṃ śasyate homaḥ satataṃ mṛgamudrayā || 180 ||
meaning: तिलानां शस्यते होमः सततं मृगमुद्रया || 180 ||
text_mt: The oblation of sesame seeds is always recommended to be done with the deer-gesture. // 180

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtasya kāṣi(rṣa ?)ko homaḥ kṣīrasya ca viśeṣataḥ |
śuktimātrāhutirdadhnaḥ prasṛtiḥ pāyasasya ca || 181 ||
meaning:
घृतस्य काषि(र्ष ?)को होमः क्षीरस्य च विशेषतः |
शुक्तिमात्राहुतिर्दध्नः प्रसृतिः पायसस्य च || 181 ||
text_mt: The oblation of ghee is one karṣa, and especially so for milk; / the oblation of curd is a śukti-measure, and a handful of milk-rice; // 181

sanskrit_iast:
grāsārdhamātramannānāṃ bhakṣyāṇāṃ svapramāṇataḥ |
sarveṣāmeva bījānāṃ muṣṭinā homamācaret || 182 ||
meaning:
ग्रासार्धमात्रमन्नानां भक्ष्याणां स्वप्रमाणतः |
सर्वेषामेव बीजानां मुष्टिना होममाचरेत् || 182 ||
text_mt: the measure of half a morsel of cooked grains, and of delicacies according to their own size; / he should perform the oblation of all seeds by the fistful. // 182

sanskrit_iast:
agrāṅgulistu lājānāṃ śālīnāṃ pañcakaṃ hunet (?) |
phalānāṃ svapramāṇaṃ ca pallavānāṃ tathaiva ca || 183 ||
meaning:
अग्राङ्गुलिस्तु लाजानां शालीनां पञ्चकं हुनेत् (?) |
फलानां स्वप्रमाणं च पल्लवानां तथैव च || 183 ||
text_mt: The fingertip [measure] of parched grain; he should offer five [grains] of rice; / of fruits according to their own size, and likewise of shoots; // 183

sanskrit_iast:
tritīyaṃ mūlakhaṇḍānāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ svapramāṇataḥ |
karkandhumātragulikā hotavyā guggulaissadā || 184 ||
meaning:
त्रितीयं मूलखण्डानां पुष्पाणां स्वप्रमाणतः |
कर्कन्धुमात्रगुलिका होतव्या गुग्गुलैस्सदा || 184 ||
text_mt: a third for pieces of root; of flowers according to their own size; / a pill the size of a jujube should always be offered with guggulu; // 184

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrīphalapramāṇāṃ vā saṃbhave sati homayet |
dūrvākāṇḍāni viprendra caturaṣṭāṅgulāni vā || 185 ||
meaning:
धात्रीफलप्रमाणां वा संभवे सति होमयेत् |
दूर्वाकाण्डानि विप्रेन्द्र चतुरष्टाङ्गुलानि वा || 185 ||
text_mt: or, if available, he should offer one the size of a myrobalan fruit; / stems of dūrvā grass, O chief of the twice-born, should be four or eight finger-breadths, // 185

sanskrit_iast: samitpradeśamānena samacchedā tvaganvitā |
meaning: समित्प्रदेशमानेन समच्छेदा त्वगन्विता |
text_mt: or according to the span-measure of firewood, evenly cut and retaining their bark.

sanskrit_iast: [svāhākāra vaṣaṭkāra vauṣaṭkārādiprayoge nimittabhedanirūpaṇam]
meaning: [स्वाहाकार वषट्कार वौषट्कारादिप्रयोगे निमित्तभेदनिरूपणम्]
text_mt: [Specification of the occasions for using the syllables svāhā, vaṣaṭ, vauṣaṭ, etc.]

sanskrit_iast: svāhākāraṃ sadā home pūrṇāyāṃ vauṣaḍeva ca || 186 ||
meaning: स्वाहाकारं सदा होमे पूर्णायां वौषडेव च || 186 ||
text_mt: The exclamation 'svāhā' is always [used] in oblation, and 'vauṣaṭ' in the full offering. // 186

sanskrit_iast:
p. 148) tameva śāntike kuryādvaṣaḍvā'pyayane sadā |
svadhā pitṛkriyāyāṃ ca phaṭkāraḥ kṣayakarmaṇi || 187 ||
meaning:
प्. 148) तमेव शान्तिके कुर्याद्वषड्वाऽप्ययने सदा |
स्वधा पितृक्रियायां च फट्कारः क्षयकर्मणि || 187 ||
text_mt: He should use that very [syllable] in pacification rites, or 'vaṣaṭ' always in rites of nourishment; / 'svadhā' in rites for the ancestors, and the exclamation 'phaṭ' in rites of destruction; // 187

sanskrit_iast: vidveṣe huṃ vaśe hīṃ ca namo mokṣaprasiddhaye |
meaning: विद्वेषे हुं वशे हीं च नमो मोक्षप्रसिद्धये |
text_mt: 'huṃ' in rites of creating enmity, 'hrīṃ' in subjugation, and 'namaḥ' for the attainment of liberation.

sanskrit_iast: [pūrṇāhutiprakāraḥ]
meaning: [पूर्णाहुतिप्रकारः]

sanskrit_iast: karmahomāvasāne ca ghṛtenāpūrya ca sruva(ca)m || 188 ||
meaning: कर्महोमावसाने च घृतेनापूर्य च स्रुव(च)म् || 188 ||
text_mt: At the conclusion of the ritual oblations, having filled the ladle with ghee, // 188

sanskrit_iast:
abhāvāttu prabhūtasya (?) homadravyena pūrayet |
tatropari ghṛtaṃ dadyāttatorghyakusumādibhiḥ || 189 ||
meaning:
अभावात्तु प्रभूतस्य (?) होमद्रव्येन पूरयेत् |
तत्रोपरि घृतं दद्यात्ततोर्घ्यकुसुमादिभिः || 189 ||
text_mt: If there is not an abundance [of ghee], one should fill it with sacrificial substances. / One should put ghee on top of that, and then, with arghya, flowers, and the rest, // 189

sanskrit_iast:
mūladeśātsamārabhya sruksaṃpūjyā sruvānvitā |
ghṛtayuktaṃ tu taddravyaṃ srucaḥ puṣkarakukṣigam || 190 ||
meaning:
मूलदेशात्समारभ्य स्रुक्संपूज्या स्रुवान्विता |
घृतयुक्तं तु तद्द्रव्यं स्रुचः पुष्करकुक्षिगम् || 190 ||
text_mt: the sruc along with the sruva should be worshipped, beginning from the base. / The substance mixed with ghee, situated in the belly of the bowl of the sruc, // 190

sanskrit_iast:
dravaccandropamaṃ dhyāyettataḥ pūrṇaṃ samuddharet |
srugdaṇḍaṃ dehanābhau tu mūle saṃrodhya saṃsmaret || 191 ||
meaning:
द्रवच्चन्द्रोपमं ध्यायेत्ततः पूर्णं समुद्धरेत् |
स्रुग्दण्डं देहनाभौ तु मूले संरोध्य संस्मरेत् || 191 ||
text_mt: one should meditate upon as resembling the melting moon; then one should raise the full ladle. / Fastening the handle of the sruc at the base of the bodily navel, one should contemplate // 191

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkalaṃ mantranāthaṃ tu pūrṇaśītāṃśusannibham |
āmūlācca marucchaktyā proddharecca svavigrahāt || 192 ||
meaning:
निष्कलं मन्त्रनाथं तु पूर्णशीतांशुसन्निभम् |
आमूलाच्च मरुच्छक्त्या प्रोद्धरेच्च स्वविग्रहात् || 192 ||
text_mt: the partless Lord of Mantras, resembling the full moon. / And from the root, by the power of the vital breath, one should raise [him] from one's own body, // 192

sanskrit_iast:
vidhāya ceśvarādhāre tasmāddhārāmṛtaṃ mahat |
nāsikāsandhimārgeṇa srukpadme patitaṃ smaret || 193 ||
meaning:
विधाय चेश्वराधारे तस्माद्धारामृतं महत् |
नासिकासन्धिमार्गेण स्रुक्पद्मे पतितं स्मरेत् || 193 ||
text_mt: and placing [him] in the seat of the Lord, one should visualize a great stream of nectar / falling from that [seat] into the lotus-bowl of the sruc along the path of the junction of the nostrils. // 193

sanskrit_iast:
sāmṛtāmājyadhārāṃ ca vasudhārāmiva kṣipet |
mukhamadhye tu mantrasya tadbrahmavivare'thavā || 194 ||
meaning:
सामृतामाज्यधारां च वसुधारामिव क्षिपेत् |
मुखमध्ये तु मन्त्रस्य तद्ब्रह्मविवरेऽथवा || 194 ||
text_mt: One should cast that stream of ghee containing nectar like a continuous stream of wealth / into the midst of the mouth of the mantra, or into its aperture of Brahman. // 194

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpadmāntargatāṃ samyakpraviṣṭāmanubhāvayet |
tayā vai bṛṃhitaṃ mantraṃ bhāvayedbrahmadhārayā || 195 ||
meaning:
हृत्पद्मान्तर्गतां सम्यक्प्रविष्टामनुभावयेत् |
